reviews.author: Lindsey H
reviews.text: Pricing structure is deceiving. We called with a clogged kitchen sink and were told $89. We ourselves had already tried clearing the p-trap and snaking the branch pipe before having them come out. We asked if it could be the main line. The plumber walks in, doesn’t even turn on the sink or other faucets to diagnose issue himself and says with certainty it’s not the mainline, it’s a clog in the branch. Their deal is only for the mainline so it’ll be an additional $217 for basic snaking of the branch pipe (which should work since his “is better spin rate than ours”) or $1100 to jet clear the pipe if it doesn’t. I’m sorry, that is ridiculous pricing without any guarantee or trying to confirm the issue first. We refused to proceed without any further validation or assurances so he made us still pay the $89 “for his estimate” and left. Definitely not how you should be doing business. (Yes, we filled out the survey. Yes, we called and were told a manager would call us back. No, no call and all we’ve gotten is a text estimate re-forwarded to us)

reviews.author: Taylor Krmmer
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with this plumber. From the start, they were extremely professional and respectful of my home. They took the time to thoroughly inspect the issue, clearly explained what was causing the problem, and walked me through the best options to fix it. I really appreciated how they made sure I understood everything before moving forward.
The work was completed efficiently and with great attention to detail. It was obvious they cared about doing the job right the first time rather than just rushing through. I feel confident that the repair will hold up long-term, and it’s reassuring to know I can rely on them for future needs.
If you’re looking for someone who combines professionalism, skill, and clear communication, I highly recommend this plumber.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 4480 Bridgeway Ave STE B, Columbus, OH 43219, USA

reviews.author: Nick Lilly
reviews.text:
The technicians that finally showed up saved the rating.

Their offsite call center is among the worst. They quoted me a tech would arrive in 2 hours at 9am on Thursday. I called again at 1pm and they couldn’t tell me anything other than they were behind due to high volume of calls which I understood because of the rain storm. The problem arose when I called again at 7pm and she told me the tech assigned to me was off at 6pm and no one was coming. I had to call for that info. That should have been a phone call to me.

Robert finally arrived at noon the following day and quickly addressed the problem. Quoted me a price that was pretty high based on reviews I’ve read from other companies. I was fine with paying because he was there and had the parts ready and we’re expected to get rain again soon. Robert and his partner did a great and timely job.

reviews.author: S P.
reviews.text:
After dealing with recurring plumbing issues, we feel incredibly fortunate to have connected with Christian from Roto-Rooter. What began as a service call for a standard toilet leak has evolved into a trusted professional partnership; he is now the only plumber we call. Christian consistently makes a stellar impression from the moment he arrives. He is punctual, friendly, and always introduces himself before getting to work. He has earned our complete confidence to the point that we trust him to work unsupervised, which speaks volumes about his integrity and professionalism.
Over the past few months, Christian has navigated us through several complex issues, including a sump pump failure. His approach is both strategic and highly technical. While waiting for parts to arrive, he expertly locked down the affected systems and installed new lines to ensure we remained functional with minimal disruption. He takes the time to explain the "why" behind an issue in plain English and lays out all available options and recommendations without any pressure.
Christian returned to install the new parts the moment they arrived, ensuring everything was back to peak performance. It is rare to find a technician who combines high-level technical skill with such genuine care for his clients. While we hope we won’t need a plumber anytime soon, we know exactly who we are calling if we do. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kevin Jankowski
reviews.text: We had our garbage disposal go out suddenly and start leaking.  We called on Saturday at around Noon, and our tech, Terry came out ASAP.  He quickly diagnosed the problem, and went to get a new disposal for us.  He installed it fast!  He was extremely nice and very personable.  I'd highly recommend and would use them for future services.  Thanks!

reviews.author: Margaret Hall
reviews.text: Travis did a great job.  He arrived well within the time frame, he diagnosed the problem, and then gave a clear explanation of how to fix it.  He was very upfront about the pricing and what needed to be done.  He was personable, approachable, and easy to work with.  Very friendly and caring.  I appreciate his expertise and hard work.  After he finished with the emergency in the bathroom, he installed a new kitchen sink.  The job took all day and involved back-up help and several trips to Home Depot.  Travis stuck with it and worked hard.  Everything looks great and works perfectly.  Thank you, Travis.

reviews.author: Tayy Fink
reviews.text: Terry came out promptly after my initial call to Roto Rooter and was very polite and answered all of my questions to help me understand my situation. He was able to give me a very well explained estimate today. I just unfortunately did not have the funds at this moment to move forward with work. But I would absolutely recommend Roto Rooter to anyone who needs a responsive and reliable plumber!

plumbers.name: 1-Tom-Plumber
plumbers.address: 24 Whitney Dr Suite A, Milford, OH 45150, USA

reviews.author: Angie Baby
reviews.text: Our 85 year old home has old steel pipes. I was draining dishwater from kitchen sink and water pouring out the basement ceiling. My husband ran upstairs to see what I had done. An hour later (now midnight) he had sawed thru back of under-sink cabinetry and found a rust hole in original drain pipe. The pipe turned a sharp left behind dishwater and down to basement. We knew it would require more than my husband to do all this repair. I checked BBB and Google reviews and 1-Tom Plumber had excellent comments. I made an appointment and Brad was out the next a.m. He did a thorough inspection of the problem and worked out an estimate with the office. He said the job was going to take a big chunk of the day as well as another worker. We paid $99 for his time and efforts. Once we agreed to the work to be done, this money was deducted from our total when the job was done. Brad and Parker did a TON of working; moving dishwasher and stove away from wall, checking roof vents, installing and removing pipes. About 6 hours and everything looked good. Even though the job entailed more work than expected, the estimate stayed the same. This really made a good impression on us. So very satisfied with the professionalism and the skill level shown by these young men. Thanks so much.

reviews.author: Jeff Stover
reviews.text: Totally professional quality work and done when stated for a reasonable price. New water heater and water treatment system installed today and totally satisfied. Brad the plumber gave us an estimate and he came back and installed the job which was great to have the same guy both bid and do the work. I have had One Tom plumbing do all my work over the past 2 years and they are fantastic.

reviews.author: Katlynn Weeks
reviews.text: Cullen came out today to check out our backed up line. He was professional and did a great job, I love workers who come and leave the place without trace of their work. A+ he also has some great jokes!

reviews.author: Tamika Perryman
reviews.text: My family was in need of a pluming company and a friend of mines told me  call 1 ton plumber . I called the dispatch ( Jennifer ) was amazing and another young lady I spoke with. So (Jacob) came out on 2/1 . He was so professional young man took his time found out the problem fixed the leak it was a drain issue we was having . He was so patient and he had several other jobs to go but you would have thought we was it the way he made sure he resolved the issue … Great experience!! I don’t even do review but this one was well deserved 💯💯💯💯💯💯 and he cleaned up 💯

reviews.author: Brandon Patrick
reviews.text:
I originally had Brad come over to check my hot water heater to see if it needed replaced. After getting quotes on that, I actually had a leak in another room that I had him check while he was here. He was able to take care of the leak in just that visit, which took a lot of anxiety off of me. He then made a return visit to install a new hot water tank. The service was excellent. He was kind, he educated me and he kept the job clean the whole time.
I will most definitely be a repeat customer, Not just because of the great service, But because I was able to trust the person performing the work. After being scammed in the past by other contractors, It’s nice to finally be able to say I can trust at least one.

plumbers.name: Black Diamond Plumbing & Mechanical Inc.
plumbers.address: 1400 Miller Pkwy, McHenry, IL 60050, USA

reviews.author: Shy Teal
reviews.text:
I’m a proud Diamond Member and officially part of the prestige family! My electrician was hands down the best — knowledgeable, patient, and professional from start to finish. I asked about 101 questions in under a minute, and he still managed to multitask, explain everything clearly, and get the job done right.

He even fixed the light in my kitchen over the sink — someone before me thought it made more sense to put a plug there instead of an actual light switch and outlet combo (don’t ask 😅). But he got it working perfectly!

Now I’ve got lights shining where there were no lights before! My utility room is beautifully lit with new canned lights — oh my God, excellent, très bien!

As a single woman, finding honest, respectful professionals means everything. I felt comfortable, informed, and completely taken care of. Black Diamond is a true one-stop shop — they go the extra mile and make your home shine, literally and figuratively!

reviews.author: Steven
reviews.text: Life savers! And I’m not even a customer. Well, I am now. I had a flat and without hesitation a representative from Black Diamond pulled over and hopped out with a battery operated compressor to help. It ended up being a pretty bad gash in the sidewall and wasn’t holding air. So he went back to the truck and got some rubber cement to help hold the air so I could get to a safer spot to change the tire. It was a busy two way street and he went above and beyond trying to help. And he did! Thank you so much. Praying I don’t having any plumbing issues, but if I do, I know who I’m calling.

reviews.author: J L
reviews.text:
I am so thankful for Black Diamond!

They have single handedly helped me repair and maintain my home with ease and savings since 2019.

Over the years, they have installed my furnace, air conditioner, replaced water shut off valves, garbage disposal, electric doorbell (Brennan was awesome), and most recently my water tank heater (Trevor and Keith were wonderful).

I always get several quotes for big repairs and Black Diamond is always the best!! They are worth every penny.  Honest up front pricing, no surprises, service windows are convenient, always on time, no employee turnover (i have had the same techs) and always knowledgeable and respectful. Their scheduling/customer service team is so kind and literally always answers my calls. Their quality is so good even my HVAC permit inspector raved about them when he came.

It is a god send to have one company offer the best service in all areas, plumbing,HVAC, and electrical and with the most experienced technicians, best schedulers/customer service, and for the best prices.

Thank you!

reviews.author: James Mashinter
reviews.text: I called Black diamond,about having my kitchen drain cleaned. Mario,was the plumbing technician who arrived on time. He looked over the situation,and got to work. He took great care in making sure my issue was resolved to the best of his abilities. I would highly recommend Black diamond,if all of their employees are as committed to excellent work,this is a company worth having a positive experience with.

reviews.author: Evette Rolon
reviews.text: First off I like to share that my family and I are not familiar with well water as we come from Chicago. We are not familiar with how well water works and almost gotten taking for a hell of a ride but thanks to Colten and black diamond they have been a blessing for my family and I. we HIGHLY recommend them especially Colton. Very intelligent, understanding, respectful, honest person. I work from home and the staff respected that and worked around my schedule. Everyone from the customer service department to the staff that came to work on our house were very polite and kind to us. Thank you for everything you have done for us. May God bless you guys.

plumbers.name: Horizon Services - Air Conditioning, Heating, Plumbing, & Electrical
plumbers.address: 17 Roland Ave, Mt Laurel Township, NJ 08054, USA

reviews.author: Nancy Johnson
reviews.text: We had to get our HVAC system replaced as well as the  duct work. For being such a big job they were able to complete the work quickly and for a reasonable price. I have to admit I I can be difficult at times but they were all professional and respectful. I am very pleased.

reviews.author: Jaime Politano
reviews.text: I had some plumbing and a few other issues that needed to be taken care of.  Victor came by to inspect everything and advise me of what was needed.  He gave me a few different options to help me decide what would work best for me.  He was very patient in answering my questions.  As he finished each step, he would check to ensure everything was working correctly and gave a final overall inspection upon completion.   For the second appointment, Victor and Brian arrived to do an installation and take care of a few other matters.  They both were friendly, courteous, knowledgeable, thorough and determined to make sure everything was done right.  I am extremely happy with the excellent work done by both Victor and Brian.

reviews.author: Anthony Hall
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with the electrician who serviced my home. James Ortiz was professional, knowledgeable, and respectful of my space from start to finish. He arrived on time, clearly explained the work that needed to be done, and completed everything efficiently.

What stood out most was his attention to detail and commitment to quality. James made sure everything was functioning properly before leaving and took the time to answer all of my questions.

It’s refreshing to work with someone who values both excellent service and customer satisfaction. I would definitely recommend James Ortiz to anyone looking for reliable and trustworthy electrical work.

reviews.author: Emily Simon
reviews.text: Our heater went out around 6:30 PM, and we were very anxious about it. Called Horizon and they got us an appointment right away. Technician Chris Gonzalez was communicative, empathetic and offered great guidance on our system which is nearly 20 years old. He was quickly able to identify the source of the issue and within 10 minutes of his arrival it was back up and running. Great price, great customer service. Would definitely use them again for any future needs!

reviews.author: Donna Jeffreys
reviews.text: Couldn't have asked for better technicians than Ben and Peter. After explaining what needed to be done including prices Ben installed a New hot water heater and a New faucet in my home. His work looks good and it's nice to have hot water again also a faucet that I no longer need to caulk. Peter thoroughly inspected my Air conditioning system inside and outside then explained what needs to be done. These gentlemen were very professional and thoughtful. I appreciate that so much, they were a pleasure to do business with, I'd recommend them for sure ‼️

plumbers.name: Air Comfort Solutions
plumbers.address: 905 Messenger Ln, Moore, OK 73160, USA

reviews.author: Felicia Moore
reviews.text:
Corey and David were so kind, knowledgeable and helpful. The work is difficult but took time to make sure I understood my new system. Thanks fellas!

Hello. Although my previous review is glowing about how quickly ACS handled the install, etc., I cannot say the same about after the work. First, the workers left black streaks in my carpet in my hallway where the new unit was installed. They should have covered the work area. I cannot get the marks removed which will cost me more. I even sent in pics of the carpet but got no response. Next, I learned only after The City came to inspect the work, how my cabinets which houses my hot water tank and AC/Heat unit were full of insulation. How dangerous was that! And with my physical condition it was extremely difficult to clean that all out. Lastly, communicate between ACS and The City's inspections department is very poor. I first must say, I 💯 understand neither ACS or The City can give an exact hout for when an inspection will be completed. But, there should be a way the day is known. I gave ACS the desired day and only because that day had bad weather, I contacted The City. That's when I was told the inspections have wait periods that are determined by which type of inspection. So you see, I would have wasted a day from work waiting at home when the inspectors came the next day instead. This was not because of bad weather. There needs to be a better stream of communication and understanding in the process between ACS and The City so the customer has some idea. I am sure I left a bad taste in my supervisor's mouth, being so out of sorts and leaving work without proper notice. Good customer service comes before, during and after the service, and is more than being nice. These are very kind and friendly folks, TRUE. They simple need to out themselves in the customer 's shoes to see if their processes make sense, and are complete.

reviews.author: Denise Slattery
reviews.text: Matt and his apprentice, Michael, were very professional but easy to talk to. They replaced the 50+ yr old panel in garage, installed 5 new smoke alarms, main disconnect, and a surge protector with the main. They also installed a disconnect and surge protector for the AC unit. Total time was about 4 hours one day and 7 hours the next. I welcome them to come back should I need further electrical work done in the future.

reviews.author: Jackson Longan
reviews.text: Ryan from Air Comfort Solution recently installed a 220 outlet in my garage for EV charging, and I couldn't be happier with the service. He was professional, courteous, and did excellent work. What impressed me most was his dedication to customer satisfaction – he even got his manager to approve extra discounts to earn my business on the spot! I highly recommend Ryan and Air Comfort Solution for any electrical needs.

reviews.author: Jacki
reviews.text: We are very upset with the service we received from Air Comfort Solutions and High Tech... we had a pipe burst and had called for an appointment 12/20. A technician came 12/21 and quoted us for the job, they were suppose to fix the whole pipe plus connections and t pipes back to the water heater. We got approved for a loan for $2065.00 (since there is no way we could afford to do this on our own), but we had trouble with their online service and the loan was never confirmed plus we didn't sign anything for the job. When the actual technician came he only replaced a small section of the pipe that had burst and when asked about the rest of the job he said he wasn't doing that. Air Comfort still want us to pay for the whole job they didn't do, I've called serval times and keep getting the run around, the plumbing manager was suppose to call me and still hasn't....now the loan company for said job is calling every day for payments, we will never use this company again!

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: I used Air Comfort Solutions to replace both of my AC units and paid several thousands of dollars.  The crew that did the installation did not even tell me when they were done, they left my bedroom closet a mess, tracked mud all over my driveway, didn’t replace the air filters like they promised, and didn’t even tell me where the ac unit manuals were.   Additionally, they broke the wood frame leading up into my attic and left the broken piece inside my attic without saying one word!  I had to text and call them several times to finally get these issues resolved.  This was a horrible experience and I will make every effort to steer other customers away from this unprofessional company.

plumbers.name: Allen Service
plumbers.address: 101 S Link Ln, Fort Collins, CO 80524, USA

reviews.author: Brian South
reviews.text: I called Allen Service to help diagnose and fix an electrical issue at my house.  They were super nice and accommodating over the phone.  The tech who came out, Tony, was really great.  Got the work all done the same day.  Easy to work with and very professional.  Allen Service (and Tony) are my go-to for anything electrical now. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Suzanne Caldwell
reviews.text:
I can’t  say enough good things about this company! they truly saved the day at my rental unit! I had six other plumbers and drain specialists come through, and none of them could figure out why water was leaking onto the floor. It was frustrating and costly chasing dead ends.
Then I called these guys, and they nailed it right away. They found the issue quickly and efficiently, saving me from more unnecessary headaches. What stood out most was their incredible communication—they kept me fully in the loop every step of the way, explaining what they were doing and why.
Nate was awesome from the start—professional, knowledgeable, and a pleasure to work with. Mathew and Mason absolutely knocked it out of the park with their skills and teamwork. The whole team was trustworthy, honest, and didn’t try to upsell or push unnecessary work. In fact, they came up with a cheaper, smarter solution to my issue!  I’m so happy I called them!  Thanks so much guys!

reviews.author: Riley
reviews.text: Tyler installed a new whole water filtration system in our home. Tyler was amazing. He looked at our entire system, offered many different solutions and price points. Walked through each system and answered all questions. He did not pressure any kind if decision. After choosing the filter that would work best, he scheduled the install. It turned out way better than expected. The plumbing is very clean and orderly. He also took into account our biggest complaint about our current system and added in solutions to prevent that with the new system. I cannot recommend Tyler enough!

reviews.author: SSB
reviews.text: We have used Allen for a few years now and always come away with having had excellent service.  Response times have been reasonable, the techs have been exceptional in their knowledge, thoroughness and skill and the office personnel are polite and helpful on the phone.  Also, we’ve had no hard-sell from them about other services we “should” get—which we find annoying.  A gentle suggestion is all that is necessary.  Yes, my family and I very much recommend Allen.

reviews.author: arielle sawyer
reviews.text: Was very happy with my service. Gregory did a great job was so polite and kind. He was upfront and explained things well. He also was cool about my interest in what he was doing and my questions.  I will be calling Allen again for future services.

plumbers.name: F.H. Furr Plumbing, Heating, Air Conditioning & Electrical
plumbers.address: 685 Lofstrand Ln, Rockville, MD 20850, USA

reviews.author: John Hodges
reviews.text: Competent, professional and systematic and his approach to assessing our electrical condition. Was able to identify some problems we had in with some exterior lighting and repaired it during his visit. Gave us honest estimate about any upgrade that you may want. I was extremely satisfied with this young man’s ability. Look forward to working with him again in the future..

reviews.author: A Smith
reviews.text: Extremely professional team, arriving and surveying home before commencing work. Went miles beyond what I expected. Definitely will be rebooking when time comes for HVAC system cleaning.

reviews.author: Debra Givens
reviews.text: Kyle Burke did an excellent job installing my hot water heater and replacing the pipes.  I would definitely recommend Kyle Burke to my friends and family.  Kyle take pride in his work and it definitely shows. I will personally request for Kyle to do my inspections when it due.

reviews.author: Charese “Reese” Williams
reviews.text:
Jackson Saron was absolutely outstanding! He’s a true MacGyver when it comes to plumbing. He cleanly replaced my old, dead garbage disposal with total professionalism and precision. His diagnosis was spot-on, and he even caught a separate leak that I hadn’t noticed yet.

The install was smooth, efficient, and expertly done. I truly appreciate the attention to detail and the level of care he showed throughout the visit.

I will most definitely be calling F.H. Furr again for any future home issues. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Alton Jones
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with technician S. Richardson and would highly recommend his services.

He provided a courtesy call prior to arrival and showed up exactly within the timeframe he stated, which I greatly appreciated. Upon arrival, he was professional and respectful—introducing himself and covering his shoes to protect our floors, even though I told him it wasn’t necessary.

After removing the cover from the electrical panel, he immediately identified a serious issue unrelated to the original service call. He discovered a charred wire inside the panel that had the potential to cause a fire. He promptly brought it to my attention, clearly explained the associated risk, and obtained my approval before making the necessary repairs. His attention to detail and safety-first approach were impressive.

Once the hazardous condition was corrected, he completed the original service request efficiently and professionally. After finishing, he verbally explained additional preventative services that could help mitigate future issues due to the condition of the power panel and later sent a written estimate via text that same day.

Overall, we are extremely pleased with his workmanship, professionalism, and thoroughness. We will absolutely request him again for any future electrical needs.

plumbers.name: ARS / Rescue Rooter
plumbers.address: 6029 Campus Cir Dr W Ste 150, Irving, TX 75063, USA

reviews.author: Sean Ball
reviews.text: After 1 year, this system started to leak. The installer used a stainless supply and coupled it with galvanized connectors for the expansion tank.  The galvanic corrosion caused a leak and the buildup of rust had these components nearly blocked. The expansion tank was only pressurized to 1/2 of my line pressure.  As a consumer I should not have to double check your work. If it was intentional to create a system that was doomed to fail or negligence on the part of the installers, this should have been caught when the salesman came to inspect the work. Do better.  The labor alone was 2.5x the cost of the entire previous tank replacement.

reviews.author: Ellie Jeong
reviews.text:
Their hydrojetting service was flawless. It was a drain we had been trying to clear ourselves with various machines. Their hydrojetting service completed the job in less than 30 minutes.
Their 2 technician was nice.
They provided same-day service.
I would have been more satisfied if their prices were a bit lower, but in the end,
I'm satisfied and grateful.

reviews.author: Gregg Williams
reviews.text: I must of just been unlucky after looking through all of these reviews. My wife and I just moved into our home and one of the toilets were leaking from the backside. To start off, my appointment was scheduled any time between 10-2. 2 o'clock rolls around, no call/text about the plumber running late because of another job. I waited till about 3 and called their number to see what was going on. The woman I spoke to said she was going to reach out to dispatch or plumber, I can't remember. Another hour passes, still hadn't heard anything. I called again around 4 and they said the plumber was running behind because of another job. I said, "do you guys normally let people know that kind of thing?" The woman said, "yes sir." That's all she said. Anyways, the plumber gets here at 6:30 that evening, you know, only 4.5 hours after the appointment window had closed. He said he needed to change out the bolts and gasket. I said, "okay great." He finishes the work and goes on his way. An hour later I use the restroom and hear dripping from the back of the toilet. So here we are present day. My appointment window was this morning from 8-12. I stayed home from work hoping that they'd get here early enough so I could go in for a half day. It is now 4:16 and 1 phone call later, still no plumber has shown up. Completely unacceptable. The picture shows how much water has leaked since this morning around 7 a.m.

reviews.author: Marco Montalvo
reviews.text: We have used ARS in the past for our AC installation and we continue to use them due to the nature of good work quality and best in service. Our service representative Kevin and are two install technicians  Saul and Paul made our situation and  experience pleasant. Saul and Paul are very knowledgeable and understanding of what to do.  I asked questions and they automatically had an answer and was up to par with the installation. Overall ARS knows how to build their team to provide a good service and product to us consumers. Thank you ARS now our family can stay warm and cool at the same time.

reviews.author: Amiracle Johnson
reviews.text: I needed my main line cleaned out because it was clogged due to some flushable wipes so I tried cleaning it myself for three hours and I saw I wasn’t getting anywhere so I looked on the internet and saw they were running a special for $79 main line clean out and gave them a call. I called them at 4:30 and they were at my house by 6:45. Elijah was out technician and he was great! So polite, knowledgeable, and efficient! Elijah was in and out within 45 minutes! I was super impressed!! What could have been a multiple day issue was resolved in a matter of a few hours. Thank you to this company and thank you Elijah ! Definitely will use this company in the future!

plumbers.name: Stan's Heating, Air, Plumbing & Electrical
plumbers.address: 6016 Dillard Cir, Austin, TX 78752, USA

reviews.author: Chris Lindley
reviews.text: Stan's is great. They are quick to resolve issues with my AC, most recently a total and complete AC replacement.  This job costed near $16,000 and Stan's guys had it up and in the attic, all new ducting, and an outside unit installed in about seven hours. The only reason I wouldn't give them five stars, is a small hiccup caused by a hardware issue.  I don't blame Stan's for the hardware issue that they resolved in 48 hours. I wasn't a huge fan of being asked for payment when my AC wasn't working. I called the sales representative to kindly speak about the hardware issue, and he skips over my concern and starts talking money... well, that was a downer.  Overall result, very expensive job, house seems cooler than it has ever been, work crews and follow up technicians were great.  I highly recommend Stan's for HVAC.

reviews.author: Steph K
reviews.text:
I had Stan’s out on 9/12/25 to replace a metal sheet, clean my drip pan, and replace styrofoam from my previously failing evaporator coil—damaged components from an earlier leak. This should have been covered under warranty, as I had Gold Plan maintenance in March 2025 and renewed.

When they corrected some of the components, they damaged my ceiling and insulation by forgetting to glue condensation tubes, causing a second leak that same day. Weeks of my requests for insurance or reimbursement have been ignored. I had to cut a hole in my ceiling myself on 9/13/25 to prevent mold and have already spent over a thousand dollars on inspections and property damage, with total damages in the thousands.

The HVAC unit still isn’t fully fixed, and I’m left to handle the property damage myself - including mold. As a Gold Plan member, I should be reimbursed directly—not forced to go through my builder, as they suggested. This is untimely, unprofessional, and unacceptable. I cannot recommend Stan’s.

Update 10.23.25: still no direct reimbursement or insurance from Stan’s AC with the property damages.

reviews.author: Larry Dash
reviews.text: Mr Robert Mendoza and Mr Daniel did an amazing Job replacing my evaparator coil which leaked with the new one. He took the time out to explain to me every detail he was doing as I asked questions. They both did a outstanding job. They made sure they put plastic down on my wooden floors as well

reviews.author: Cameron Helweg
reviews.text:
What a horrible experience. Stan's came recommended. At first they seemed great. I spent THOUSANDS of dollars with them. Having them remove my septic system and install lines to the city plumbing. There were some challenges but they stepped up and resolved. Gave them a chance to do some work on my AC but they dropped the ball in getting a fan motor and the work done timely. I was a maintenance director for Target, so I am not unfair in my expectations for service and I have had licenses in both fields so know the challenges.
They just collected 1100.00 for jetting my drain lines again. They had done so right after the septic service 4 years ago (with camera work) so the condition of the lines was known and there was no "build up" concern at either event. Now 4 months after cleaning and with just one person in the house, the tech out yesterday claims the lines are too clogged and will need new lines run. reviews.text: As you can imagine, having a major plumbing issue first thing in the morning is NOT an ideal start to the day. I called Roto-Rooter and they sent a plumber within an hour. reviews.author: David Loftus
reviews.text: We have had problems with clogs and slow drains in our basement bathroom for the past few years but other plumbing fixtures in our house were perfectly fine.  Other plumbers have repeatedly plunged and snaked, but our problems have always returned within a few weeks.  Enter Vince from Roto Rooter.  He asked very intelligent diagnostic questions about exactly what we were experiencing, and immediately pinpointed a sewage backup valve sunk in our basement slab.  He explained how a normally protective flapper in the valve can break down and collect debris.  Sure enough, when he disassembled the valve, all manner of debris and backed up sewage came spewing out.  Turns out the other plumbers probably even damaged the valve further as they crudely snaked the lines.  He gave us a less expensive option to try to rebuild the 34 year old valve, or a reasonable price to replace it.  With the repeated problems we've had, we opted to fix it right and replace it. Vince was very polite and conscientious about keeping his work area clean, especially challenging given the nature of the work.  With a new valve installed and our lines verified clear with his sophisticated camera, we are now finally confident that we have the problem solved.  We will be calling for Vince for any future plumbing problems we have!

The two men were clean and professional

reviews.author: Ron J
reviews.text: Prompt service.  Although the technician was unable to clear this outside underground drain, he made a good attempt and gathered enough diagnostic info to determine that the corrugated tubing had probably collapsed.  I was totally satisfied with the effort.   He was totally up front with the chances of success (didn't make any wild promises) and the initial costs ($499 for service call and first hour).

reviews.author: Angela Roberts
reviews.text:
Tim B. (Tech 617) came out and repaired issues I had in 2 bathrooms. He was patient, thorough and explained everything and the repairs didn't take long at all.
Greatly appreciated, fixed issues ive been dealing with for years.
Will definitely use again for future repairs.

reviews.author: Zain Khan
reviews.text:
I scheduled a service appointment with Roto-Rooter for an 8:00–10:00 AM window and not a single person showed up. This is easily one of the most frustrating and disrespectful service experiences I’ve ever dealt with.

I sat around waiting the entire morning while they kept changing the technician’s ETA over and over. Every time I called, I got bounced around on the phone with no real answers. It felt like they were just wasting my time. The technician wouldn’t even pick up the phone when I tried to call.

If you give someone a time window, show up or at least communicate honestly. Don’t leave customers waiting around for hours with no explanation. This kind of service is unacceptable and completely unprofessional.

Since nobody from this company could handle a simple appointment properly, I will also be issuing a formal complaint to corporate and filing a complaint with the Better Business Bureau. People deserve to know what kind of service they might be dealing with before wasting their time.

reviews.author: jean creadick
reviews.text: Jeremy and his assistant James were awesome, they installed my new water heater and timer with great attention to detail.  Jeremy, as the lead, is very knowledgeable and respectful of his assistant, which says so much right there.  He was thorough, knowledgeable, focused and respectful throughout the process.  I would call him again if I had any other plumbing issues.  Highly recommended.  Thank you, Jeremy and James!

reviews.author: Janice Kamai
reviews.text: Jeremy my plumber was awesome! He explained in detail the options on my shower valve and washer pipe fixture’s where I could understand. Excellent service, very respectful, and fast at getting the job done. He came immediately on an after hours on-call and I appreciated that. I would recommend this company and him to many. I chose Steve’s Plumbing because I see the van mostly everyday in Waianae and knew they must do great service and…he proved it. Very satisfied customer. Thank you Jeremy.

reviews.author: Sarah Lee
reviews.text:
The technician came to look at my AC unit and find out what is wrong with and fixed it. It took him about 90 minutes all together except for the time he was waiting for his coworker to drop off the part.

This company charges a flat rate for the job they do and will not itemize the cost of parts or labor.

My invoice only stated that it cost $533.00 to
replace the electrical connector.

The technician was suppose to get back to me about returning to clean the AC, but I never heard from him and he never replied when I texted him.....it makes me regret giving him a tip the first time.

In my opinion, this company is a total rip-off.

Finally after living in our home for 20 plus years a plumber took the time to explain why our water valves weee failing so often.  Calcium! Soloman was outstanding. Showed up on time, worked efficiently, communicated clearly, and handled unforeseen issues professionally. When he finished, he left the space spotless.

Was very impressed with their friendliness and professionalism.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Brian Bernhardt
reviews.text: We had a very professional installation of a new HVAC system from our comfort consultant Steven J. to our installers James an Blake. Price was unbeatable! All 3 were friendly and explained everything that was going to happen. Installers took their time to ensure everything was correct. Then did an excellent job of cleaning up.

reviews.author: ITz DewieJR
reviews.text: Logan Services did a fantastic job assessing my heating problem with my 31 year old Trane furnace. It was discussed with Anthony (repair) what my options were and he was honest and friendly trying to find the best solution for me. Brett came shortly after and was extremely thorough and a pleasure to work with when deciding which new furnace to get. Installers Nathan and Devin did a fantastic job installing my new Trane furnace and the finished product not only looks clean but performs top notch. Thank you Logan Services for your help and great staff members!

reviews.author: Mya Litt
reviews.text:
*** update*** Beyond pleased with the system I had installed today. For 2 years, I would not get good heat upstairs in my Cape Cod. Tonight, so much heat blew that I had to turn down the temp to 68! I never imagined my upstairs could get so hot!!! Thank you Logan for changing this!!!

As a former employee when I needed a new furnace Logan was my first choice to call. Honest, trustworthy, customer centric, and reliable would be how I described my experience.

The home warranty company would not cover a cracked heat exchanger and the company they sent wanted an exorbitant amount to replace. Logan, gave me an honest and beyond fair price for the same replacement. Logan also included updating my flue pipe that the other company wanted to charge me extra for.

If you are on the fence about an having to replace or repair your heating, cooling or plumbing needs, I would definitely recommend this company.

Thank you Steven Jones for getting me a great price along with quick and easy financing. Also to Bobby & Blake for doing an awesome job with the install. You all rock!!!

reviews.author: Cheri Lavender
reviews.text: Professional work! Replaced our 21+ year system and identified a coolant line that was too small per new code. Work was completed in 8hrs. reviews.text: We had a major plumbing issue in the kitchen. Technicians Charlie and Logan spent 10 hours completing the job. Even on hour 10 they were upbeat, friendly and finished the job perfectly. Great Techs, great company!

He wore booties through the house so he didn't track in snow and mud. The pricing was super fair and affordable. I could not be happier and I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Erin
reviews.text: New HVAC unit installed today—both furnace and AC—and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish. Our salesperson, Mark, was incredibly helpful, knowledgeable, and kind, answering every question and guiding us through the process with ease. The installation team was just as impressive: punctual, efficient, and extremely respectful of our home. Everything was completed smoothly and with great care. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Whitey Kollmeier
reviews.text: Woke up to no hot water on a Saturday with a 1 degree temperature outside and called your service line. Nick was here in less than two hours to replace the thermostat on our tank. Professional, courteous and competent. Outstanding service!! Thank you.

reviews.author: Dana B
reviews.text: I called Schneller Knochelmann when my furnace stopped working.  The technician told me it could be repaired, but strongly pushed replacing the entire unit instead.  They used aggressive same-day sales tactics, saying the quoted price was only valid that day. I agreed to the replacement and have regretted it ever since.  From the moment the new furnace was installed, it was problem after problem.  Right away, it couldn’t cool the upstairs at all. We had multiple nights where the upstairs temperature was over 80 degrees.  Schneller Knochelmann sent several different technicians, and required multiple follow up calls from me before they admitted that the furnace had been installed incorrectly and sent a more senior tech to fix it.  Only then did it finally cool the upstairs properly.  Fast forward to the following winter where we called them again due to an odor. Their technician said there was a gas leak in the furnace and that a special part had to be ordered to fix it.  After the part was installed, though, the odor continued, so we called a plumber, thinking it might be a plumbing issue.  The plumber could not find any plumbing issue and when I mentioned the previous gas leak in the furnace, he asked if he could check it.  Good thing he did because he discovered that it was still leaking gas.  He said the gas line connection at the furnace was done terribly and was leaking - he fixed it immediately.  Unfortunately, it didn’t end there.  A couple of months later, the furnace stopped blowing hot air altogether.  I called a different HVAC company, and once again, the issue was traced back to incorrect installation by Schneller Knochelmann.  The new HVAC company fixed the problem and I will be using them from now on.  Between the aggressive sales tactics, repeated installation errors, constant follow-ups required on my end, and a gas leak that was never properly fixed, my experience was extremely frustrating and alarming.  I strongly recommend staying as far away as possible from Schneller Knochelmann.

plumbers.name: Superior Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3991 Royal Dr NW, Kennesaw, GA 30144, USA

reviews.author: Doug Lynn
reviews.text:
Fantastic experience with superior today!
Water heater was leaking it was Saturday and Chelsea answers the phone immediately no holds at superior and was able to get me in same day with the most fantastic tech
Joel came and took out the builder installed water  heater and installed the new one. His work is a work of art . He took a bunch of jumbled pipes and elbows fittings and cleaned them up and re installed everything to perfection. He is talented, experienced and  I was fortunate to have  a dedicated master plumber perform the replacement especially on a Saturday
Thanks to superior plumbing once again for being there !

He was very friendly and helpful including great tips to prevent the issue from happening again.

reviews.text: Today is Tuesday. Last Wednesday woke up in the wee hours to no heat. Long story short, called during regular hours, tech came out, fixed the problem. Today, lead tech calls me at 8:30 AM, arrives at 9:15. We go through everything. Not sure when the other 3 techs showed up, but they were done and gone by 1:45. All were respectful of me and my property, and they explained it all to me and answered all my questions. Yeah, I am very happy! I did business with them when it was just Falls Heating and Cooling and I will continue to use them now that they are Sal's. I do recommend them and will do so to anyone who asks or who tells me of needing  someone that does what they do. I'm a boomer. I've dealt with a lot of companies that do the same stuff. I will stay with Sal's.

reviews.text: My technician was Mark Capitoni, he phoned to let me know his ETA,  my appointment time was between 3-5pm and Mark arrived around 3:15, which I was happy with not having to wait an hour or close to the scheduled appointment time. Mark was pleasant and very personable; he patiently took the time to make sure I understood exactly what equipment I needed and why to complete the job and informed me about the different financing options available as well as providing additional discounts that helped lower the total cost in getting the job done properly.

reviews.author: Ski Ba
reviews.text:

Let it run and risk real bad stuff or replace the unit. I replaced the unit. Cody dispatched them out within a week and I had a new furnace installed no issues. Been a few months since the install and everything works perfectly. They are fast, efficient and honest. If you are looking for a review of Sals that isnt AI generated or an angry Customer mad they let their furnace go and dont have the immediate funds to cover, here is your review. The only issue I had with the service was that the guys didn't accept my tip, or the white monster cans I left for them as a gag gift.

If you want a cheap service that will leave you hanging try another business. If you want a fair price for a reasonable turnaround that is covered under warranties, give Sals a call.

Very satisfied with my experience and will request hector moving forward.

I look forward to working with them in the future... for regular maintenance hopefully; if a problem arises though I know they will be here to help.

reviews.author: Jeremy McCurley
reviews.text: The guy Brian came out and told us what the problem was and he didn't  charge us and even told me how to fix it and I am pretty good at home fixes so I fixed myself. Immediately he made a call and connected me with Justin who first thing this am came over and provided an estimate which no one could beat!! Ms. J Pulphus

reviews.author: Michael Mabe
reviews.text: Having the right light fixture in a room makes all the difference, hiring the right person to install it is twice as important. Ethan Knoer, the electrician who installed my dining room light,  embodied the perfect professional for the job! Professional, courtesy and attention to detail were his trade in stock! Five star review for this young man. From moving the fixture to the center of the room, solid installation, clean up, even having the right cap for where the old fixture was made for the perfect experience. Even offering to help move furniture back was what  elevates the experience. If I could give him 6 stars, I would! I would go with Advance Services again and would request  Ethan every time. Thank you Advance Services and a big thank you to Ethan Knoes for a job well done

reviews.author: Ashley Louden
reviews.text:
We can’t say enough great things about Joseph Redmond with Absolute Services. Because of how much we trust his work, we purchased their lifetime membership (a one-time $100 fee), which includes free yearly maintenance and free inspections, and it has been more than worth it.

During his most recent maintenance visit, Joseph took the time to thoroughly inspect everything and helped us understand that our hot water heater is over 20 years old and past its life expectancy, allowing us to plan ahead before it fails unexpectedly. He also helped us figure out why our toilet wasn’t working properly and explained that it needs to be replaced. What really stood out was that he never once pressured us to buy anything or upsell services—he simply provided honest, knowledgeable advice so we could make informed decisions.

This wasn’t our first great experience with Joseph. Last year, he came out to help us fix our outside faucets that broke during the winter, and once again he was professional, efficient, and incredibly helpful.

Joseph’s customer service has been outstanding every single time we’ve worked with him. He is knowledgeable, patient, honest, and genuinely cares about his customers. Absolute Services is very lucky to have him, he is a huge asset to their company, and we always feel confident knowing Joseph is handling our plumbing needs. We will always request him for our plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Dedra Thomson
reviews.text: Thank you Brad and Absolute Services. Brad arrived on time, was easy to talk with to make sure we were on the same page installing my chandelier and he even insisted on cleaning up! Ask for Brad. Thanks for a job well done

reviews.author: Linda Humphrey
reviews.text: I have been with Done Plumbing for a long time and always been happy with their work.  This was the biggest job yet and took  2 days. They did a wonderful job and always kept me posted as to what they were doing and when they would be turning off the heat or water etc. They had to move a lot of things in my basement and nothing was broken and everything put back where it belonged. They worked very hard and were always friendly.  I was impressed that everyone had a specific job to do and did it well. I had plumbers, workers that took out the pipe, some with cameras, some that put in the new pipe and mixed the cement to cover it all up.  I have pictures and an estimated bill that they went over with me. I am now going to file a claim with my Insurance company to see if I can get some of the money back and they have a special person who just does claims that is working with me. I like that they are a family business and each person has their special job to do. Many thanks to Done Plumbing for a job well done.

He is an excellent role model for a service provider!  Whatever he's getting paid now, he deserves more!

plumbers.name: Anderson Plumbing, Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 1830 John Towers Ave, El Cajon, CA 92020, USA

reviews.author: Cristal Herrera
reviews.text: Fernando Garcia provided optimal customer service. He conducted a thorough inspection of my air conditioning unit and figured out what was causing the circuit breaker to trip. He explained what he was doing each step of the way and what the numbers, that were coming up on his gadgets, represented. He provided me with detailed recommendations based on his findings and a clear explanation so I could understand why these recommendations were needed. All in all I am very satisfied with the service Fernando provided. I would definitely recommend this company!

reviews.author: Astrid Ruefli
reviews.text: We had our HVAC tune-up service today. The tech left greasy finger prints all over the access panel (see picture). All he did was take picture of our system and said we needed to get it replaced. He called a project manager who arrived within 30 minutes and gave me a quote for 42k to replace our current system with a heat pump system. No need for new ducts or electrical panels, so this price was just for labor, permit, and two 4 ton heat pumps. The quote was not itemized and this was after a $2k ‘discount’ for being members of their annual maintenance plan. The project manager then proceeded to tell me that if I waived the 3 day cancelation they could install on Monday and he could reduce to $35,980 because he had a job that they finished a job early and needed to get the crew on a project Monday to fill a scheduling gap. I felt pressured and the lack of transparency on the breakdown of cost of labor and the heat pump system made me feel really uneasy. I don’t doubt that we need a new system but the sales tactics and pressure was very unprofessional and I can see that a lot of vulnerable people with good credit ratings would end up using their financing option and just going for this type of sales tactic. Be careful and make sure you ask for break down if cost of labor vs equipment.

reviews.author: Tanya Byers
reviews.text: I recently had an HVAC Service home appt with Technicians Joshua and Raul. Both young men were professional, friendly and very respectful of my home. They spent an adequate amount of time with me, listened to my concerns and explained the next steps. I loved that Joshua took photos of my furnace after he inspected it, pointed out and explained the problem areas of concern. He also provided me with solution based options. I felt like they understood my concerns and Joshua went as far as to reach out to his superior who also scheduled an appt to come out to my home the following day. I appreciate that Anderson has been in business for many years and have employed many skilled technicians with expertise  in various specialized fields.

reviews.author: Louisa Nieves
reviews.text: We had a stopped up bathroom sink. We tried to fix it ourselves but it did not work. We called Anderson and within a few hours we had Kristina at our house to do the repair. She explained what was needed. We liked what she said and agreed to the price. Kristina was very knowledgeable and professional. She cleaned the area afterwards. I would highly recommend Kristina for any of your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Tony Vitale
reviews.text: We had a leaky shower valve at one of our rental houses and called Anderson Plumbing. They responded quickly and sent Miguel Arechiga out the same day to assess the problem. Miguel was professional, explained the repair clearly, and provided a quote on the spot. He returned as scheduled and completed the repair efficiently. The shower now works perfectly, and the whole process was smooth and stress-free. We appreciate the prompt, quality service—thank you, Anderson Plumbing and Miguel!

plumbers.name: Fix-it 24/7 Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: 16360 Table Mountain Pkwy, Golden, CO 80403, USA

reviews.author: James Jiron
reviews.text: “Fix-it 24/7 has completely renewed my faith in the HVAC industry. No upselling, no bogus fees—just honest pricing and professional service. Christian Straughn serviced both of my furnaces and worked tirelessly to clean a fan that was covered in paint, when other companies would have just sold me a new one. They also serviced my water heater a few weeks ago, and I’ll definitely book them for spring AC maintenance. Highly recommend!”

reviews.author: Donna Delahooke
reviews.text: Nothing says surprise like finding out your furnace is failing right before Christmas. The defect was discovered (thankfully) during our yearly maintenance. The next day Fixit 24/7 was able to install a new furnace ON THE SAME DAY! The technicians arrived on time, covered my floors with protective covering, and removed the old  and installed the new furnace within 4 hours.  Everyone was professional and friendly. It was a very good outcome from a very bad diagnosis.

reviews.author: Lana Fernandez
reviews.text: Our furnace stopped working one evening and Fix-It was incredibly responsive. They got a tech out the same night and let us know the evaluation cost upfront. Antonio quickly diagnosed the issue and gave us a price for parts and labor. The next morning he brought the part and we paid the agreed price, which was fair and reasonable. He worked efficiently and even taught us how to prevent this in the future. We will definitely use this company again.

reviews.author: Gilda Higgins
reviews.text: I have been with 888 Heating for years, and was not aware they had merged with or had been bought by Fix-it 24/7 until I scheduled my yearly maintenance appointment.  I was skeptical,  because I have had excellent service from 888, and wasn't sure if this company could meet  the quality of service I have received in the past. I am happy to say that Antonio B. not only met, but exceeded my expectations! He provided one of the most thorough maintenance tune-ups I have had. He was very professional,  courteous,  and knowledgeable.  He explained what he was going to do, and provided before and after pictures of his work. I told him that I hoped he was as good as 888, and he said that he hopes he can be better! He was right!

reviews.author: Bubbles 5062
reviews.text: Thank You to Dennis G of Fix-it 24/7.  He arrived as scheduled with a great attitude.  Dennis assessed the issue with my bathtub drains and determined they needed to be replaced.  I received detailed information on options and costs. Dennis provided Excellent Customer Service and Workmanship. The work area was left in good order. He definitely deserves 5 stars. 😊

plumbers.name: Lee's Air, Plumbing, & Heating
plumbers.address: 5456 W Mission Ave, Fresno, CA 93722, USA

reviews.author: Eric Stafford
reviews.text:
Jose Luis with Lee’s Roofing did a great job repairing my roof gutter. It is fastened together and working great. He also helped to add extra support to the gutter as well. Photos show Jose Luis’s  amazing job. Complete customer satisfaction.
