Luke 12:8 Jesus Christ said “ I say to you, Whoever will acknowledge me before men, the Son of man will also acknowledge before the angels of God.”

reviews.author: Justin Gibson
reviews.text: Juan did a professional job! Our 25 year old 40 gal water heater started Leaking so it was time for replacement. We upgraded to a 50 gal unit. Very clean installation and no mess left after the job. Thank you for the good work!

reviews.author: Kate Bonilla
reviews.text:
Michael Rojas was a great HVAC technician to work with.  He’s friendly, kind and helpful and wants to make sure that you understand all items discussed.  Since I am not an HVAC professional, a lot of things pertaining to furnaces and AC units are new concepts to me. Michael made sure to take his time and answer all my questions.  I appreciate his hard work and care and making sure our systems work their best so we don’t have any problems when we really need them to work.  Thank you, Michael, we appreciate you!

We have used Lee’s Air for the last five years For plumbing and HVAC and have been very happy with the company as a whole.  I’ve  always found their staff to be friendly, helpful and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Bee Cee
reviews.text:
(For Mary's roof) Lee's Roofing is amazing. Every agent we delt with was proffessional,  helpful, and a joy to interact with. They also assisted with resources for financing. The crew was extremely fast and efficient (Our entire roof in 2 days!!!). We thank you very much for the beautiful roof and making this whole experience worry free.

-Mary and family

reviews.author: Angela Castaneda
reviews.text: Zachary was amazing! My window was 8-10am, he called me at 7:45am to advised his ETA was 20 mins. I was concerned because I work from home and had to support a last-minute project during that time window. I almost canceled but due to the call and I was able to coordinate the when the door would be open. Zachary supported the repair without interrupting, or creating work stoppage for me, he was friendly informative about the diagnostic that was needed .

plumbers.name: 5 Star Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4616 Roseville Rd, North Highlands, CA 95660, USA

reviews.author: Joseph Maskiewicz
reviews.text:
Amir from 5 Star Plumbing was excellent. Pricing was very reasonable, and scheduling was easy. We booked Wednesday night for 4:30pm the next day, and he was able to show up early at 11am.

He coordinated seamlessly with my contractor, removed the old water heater in the late morning, and returned late afternoon to install a Bradford White unit with a thermal expansion tank after drywall was finished. My contractor said Amir was friendly and got along with everyone.

Professional, efficient, and easy to work with. Highly recommend Amir and 5 Star Plumbing.

First pic is old water heater.
Second pic is new water heater.

reviews.author: John Wachter
reviews.text: Same-day call and service within 4 Hours window. The newly installed gas water heater working great. Dave is a very experienced technician, high quality workmanship. I highly recommend 5 Star Plumbing to my neighbors.

reviews.author: Ben O
reviews.text: Our washer and dryer piping was leaking. 5 star plumbing came out and quickly and professionally fixed the issue, cleaned up after themselves - and did a really good job throughout. I can’t say enough at how well Eze did on the job, and they let me know the job is warranties since the work is through them, which I love. I would use them again  for this last project and will use them for future plumbing projects.

reviews.author: Norman Thompson JR
reviews.text:
The technician arrived on time at 12:30 and he was professional.
Here it is 4:30 and he just got done installing a 50 gallon water heater. Some of the things were out of his control. What normally takes 1 and 1/2 hours took two and a half hours longer.
The pan that went underneath the heater he used the last one at his previous job so he had to go get another one.
Then the manufacturer failed to put in the vent that goes on top of the heater. After half an hour of looking then another twenty minutes of phone calls with me helping him on a couple he found one at Red's Plumbing. He drove up there and bought the last one. Rheems fault.
Things happen. We have water though.
I work nights. It's going to be a long night  on two hours of sleep.
The install looks sharp. Thank you.
The end. Zzzzzzzzz

reviews.author: Kelly Williams
reviews.text: Amazing company, amazing service. I had an emergency plumbing issue, a sewage stoppage, so I contacted 5 Star due to the great reviews. Amir came out the next morning and cleared everything for me. He explained everything he needed to do and was so friendly and professional about it. He cleared the problem, which I thought would take all day but he was done in hours. The pricing was very reasonable for the problem I had. They are now my go to plumbers. Thank you 5 Star!!

plumbers.name: Wilson Plumbing, Heating, Cooling and Electric
plumbers.address: 1501 Commerce Dr, Stow, OH 44224, USA

reviews.author: Daniel Filice
reviews.text:
(Updated) Art Kelly was the service tech for my Healthy Home care plan inspection and he created a great experience. He was personable, thorough and articulate, didn’t try to oversell me and went the extra mile to get me a fair price on my PRV replacement.

Wilson Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric just earned a lifelong customer thanks to two outstanding technicians who serviced my home today.

Plumber – Hithem Judeh
Hithem replaced my PRV valve and was incredibly thorough and thoughtful throughout the entire visit. He clearly explained what the new water pressure would mean, what to expect going forward, and made sure I understood everything before he left. While he was here, he also noticed a few other small issues around the house, corrected them on the spot, and didn’t charge me for those quick fixes. That level of care and integrity is rare and seriously appreciated.

Electrician – Alan Yeager
Alan was very down-to-earth, efficient, and clearly great at what he does. He replaced my recessed lighting and garage switches quickly and cleanly, and then went the extra mile by installing a few additional fixtures I had purchased but didn’t end up needing for the original project. On top of that, he gave me really helpful insight and recommendations for my outdoor lighting needs.

Based on the service these two provided, I would 100% recommend Wilson Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric to anyone looking for reliable, professional, and friendly home service.

reviews.author: Amy Norris
reviews.text: Technician Brian Hughes from Wilson just installed a vent on my new furnace so I have heat in my basement! He did an amazing job! He was very thorough and cleaned up afterwards. I am very pleased with the service I received.

reviews.author: Ian Whitesel
reviews.text: Yovel came to look at my furnace, and he did a fantastic job. Very personable and friendly, very knowledgeable. Gave me a fair and honest break down of my set up. He is a credit to his employer!

reviews.author: Khyle Halstead
reviews.text: Cole, Ryan and Chuck all did a fantastic job installing my new High Efficiency Furnace! They kept me in the loop with everything they were doing, were very respectful, clean and walked me through how to operate my new thermostat and some cool features that come with it. They displayed great craftsmanship, efficiency and professionalism. I am very happy with the work they did and will definitely be calling them again when it’s time to do the AC.

reviews.author: Justin McLoughlin
reviews.text: I signed up for a preventative maintenance check and just had my first preventative appt.  It was great.  Definitely puts my mind at ease to know what's coming and how my systems are doing.  Great work by Jacob Sidoti to walk me through it.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Cleveland
plumbers.address: 7525 Hub Pkwy, Valley View, OH 44125, USA

reviews.author: Chris Stergar
reviews.text: First I was told my window was noon to 4 pm. I got a call at around 10:15 that the tech would be at my house at 11AM, making me hurry to get home in time. Tech reviewed kitchen sink, tub, and recommended a valve replacement for the kitchen shut off and provided the quote. Tech started in the tub. I heard him talking to himself. After a little while, he got his stuck snake out of the drain. He then started on the kitchen sink. After a while, a second tech showed up to help him with the sink. They worked together and got the sink working well. The second tech must have left. First tech showed me the stacks for the toilet and tub, and explained why he recommended replacement and said he would send a quote. He told me about his stuck snake, he wasn’t going to charge me for snaking it, but it was draining slowly still. I told him it wasn’t draining, but he insisted he put more water in it. I then went to the shutoff and asked if it was replaced. He thanked me for reminding him. Fixed it, I paid and he left. I went into bathroom. Tub was not draining at all. I grabbed my auger. Sent it down five times. Pulled out three large clumps of hair. Tub is now draining. Not as big of a deal to me since I wasn’t charged, but if it was someone incapable of clearing it, just wanted to let you know.

reviews.author: Timothy Jones
reviews.text: I called Mr. Rooter on 12/28/25 and advised them that I needed a technician to come out same day.  I had to shut the water off to my house to change a Moen shower faucet cartridge.  The cartridge was stuck and would not come out.  Mr. Rooter showed up around 6 pm.  He spent no more than an hour.  He said the cartridge was fixed and asked me to turn the water on only to tell me to immediately turn off the water.  He said he installed the cartridge upside down.  He later said he corrected the problem.  I asked him is any water dripping from the spout.  He said no.  He turned the water on quick and turned it off.  The water some water coming out of the spout, but I assumed that was from the technician just turning off the water.  He immediately left.  I went upstairs into the bathroom and watched a steady flow of water coming from the spout.  I called Mr. Rooter about 2 to 3 minutes after the technician left.  I was wanting the technician to turn around and fix the problem he created.  Customer service said he cannot turn around and I would have to wait until 8 am to 12 pm the following day even though they advertise they are 24/7 service.  All she kept doing was apologizing like some AI operator.  So, I paid $370.00 (with a senior discount) for work that made the situation worse.  I uploaded a video so you can see how much water is leaking.  It is not a drip; it is a flow.  I would shut the water off to my house, but family members need access to the bathroom and water.  I'm sure this will jack up my water bill on top of getting ripped off.  I thought Mr. Rooter had a good reputation.  I tried uploading a video put this review put out by Mr. Rooter would allow me.  So, I several pictures and they uploaded them.  Not ask good as video, but the pictures show the constant flow of water.

reviews.author: Halle Esson
reviews.text: Mr. Rooter was able to schedule a technician very quickly to assist with clogged plumbing with our kitchen sink.  They both snaked the line and did a high pressure flush which doubled the price I was paying.  It was great service and they were able to fix my problem quickly, I just thought the price was a bit high.  But maybe that is common when you need someone there quickly.  Overall I would recommend them for a job where you need something fixed quickly.  Very professional and courteous.

reviews.author: Ybr2020
reviews.text: My experience with Mr. Rooter was a pleasant one. They came out fast and gave me a quote. Very professional! I appreciate how they made me feel like a priority.

reviews.author: Austin Cassill
reviews.text: Matt Omilion did an incredible job replacing our water heater. Despite their estimate service being down for over an hour, he stayed late and ensured the job was done properly. He was very knowledgeable and happy to answer any questions that I had. He brought several items up to code - such as adding a shut off valve to the pipe feeding the heater. He thoroughly checked for leaks and provided us with a high level of confidence in reliability and safety. We would definitely hire Mr. Rooter (and Matt) for plumbing related issues again in the future. Thank you!

plumbers.name: Metro Plumbing, Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 8988 Fuller Rd, Chattanooga, TN 37421, USA

reviews.author: Wes Daniel
reviews.text: All in all a great experience. Setting up an apportionment was easy, they found my septic tank and asked if I wanted to dig it to save some money, (of course I do). He came back with the truck 3 hours later and had the tank pumped in 45minutes. Made it very affordable, the office staff and the project manager Adam was great to do business with.

reviews.author: Amanda Harper
reviews.text: We have had nothing but good experiences with Metro! We have had them look at our a/c, plumbing, and septic tank within a month and every time they have been extremely helpful! Josh went above and beyond to really help us with our house and even gave incredibly helpful advice! Nico was also very helpful and thorough when checking out a/c. Overall I would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking to have work done on your home!

reviews.author: Mrsvonbabb
reviews.text: Fixed my leak and cleaned up my yard. Excellent job. I couldn't be more pleased with the end results.

reviews.author: D 4 N i E L
reviews.text: Well, I cannot recommend Metro enough. They quickly responded to our appointment request, and sent two of the most friendly, professional and knowledgeable servicemen we've ever had in our home (Ryan and Jason, Chattanooga area). They not only did an awesome job on the repair/clean-up, but also took the time to talk to us about different areas of concern around the house, discussed options/services, answered questions... and all without being the typical "pushy salesmen". They made us feel comfortable enough to make our own educated decision regarding our repair options (shower temp. issue), and overall left a great impression on us with their excellent customer service and communication. Kudos to these two gentleman for going above and beyond with everything they did today. We will 100% be calling Metro again for any future service needs. Thanks again, guys!

reviews.author: James Fisher
reviews.text:
My experience with Metro as a first time customer highlighted their smooth and convenient scheduling process as well as the quality of their certified professional staff.  Brayden (McFall) was knowledgeable and he clearly provided me with evidence in support of his recommendations for remedying the cause of our leak (a damaged water fixture supply line). He provided repair in a timely and efficient manner. He also performed an evaluation of our whole home plumbing status and recommended maintenance to extend the life of our water heaters and ensure proper functioning.

I will gladly seek out Metro and b their certified plumber, Brayden, for our future plumbing and HVAC needs.

plumbers.name: Blue Sky Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric
plumbers.address: 9830 Interstate 70 Frontage Rd S, Wheat Ridge, CO 80033, USA

reviews.author: greg bortz
reviews.text:
I have waited to do any kind of comment or review.
It is often said to never review anything while angry. Don't "YELP" angry.
The work done by Blue Sky Plumbing was done in September 2025
It is now mid January 2026.

I've had a great deal of time to look at all aspects of the work and formulate my opinion.
Right after the work was "completed" I called the representative who originally estimated / Sold the job
He came to our property to look over the work and listen to my concerns / complaints.

To start the two people who performed the work were polite enough with me, the home owner.
While on the job there were all kinds of mixed communications between the two. I noted at times they were conflicted and would appear to argue.
Other times over the few days here the seemed to be on the same page.
On at least one occasion one of them seemed possibly ill or lacking much if any motivation to work.

All of this is what resulted in the condition our property was left in at the conclusion of the job.
The approach to the job seemed to be to get things done as quickly as could be done.
I've found that most contractors take this approach to save as much in labor cost as possible, regardless of work quality at times.

I've taken several pictures of the finished work as well as the condition of the property upon completion of the job.

Here is a list of my concerns and complaints expressed to the Blue Sky Representative for this job.

A great deal of over spray  due to neglect of proper prep prior to painting the installed gas line
This left our brick, foundation, and cedar gate painted with gloss black.
I consider this to be damage to our property that could have easily avoided with attention to detail.
Blue Sky got paid, our property got sprayed.

According to the licensed inspector who reviewed the work, it was not even necessary, according to code,
to paint many of the unions and valves that were painted in whole. That being said, the very last piece of black pipe installed
was left unpainted and left to rust in the rain. Left unpainted after it was explained to me by Blue Sky
how it was required that the entirety of the gas line be painted (again, not necessary) Again a lack of attention to detail.

During excavation the downspout drain to the garage was destroyed . No repair or replacement was offered.

Debris was left on the property from work performed.

When a Blue Sky crew returned to fill the trench that was dug by a company they contracted. A few people showed up to refill the ditch by hand with shovels
as opposed to using the same contractor that dug by machine. It took a much longer amount of time, and the yard was left considerably uneven. This again, I assume
was in an effort to save expense, where as bringing a grader back for a fill and a few passes to even things out would have left our yard as it was prior to the work performed.

reviews.author: Jamie Miller
reviews.text: We had such a great experience with this team! From start to finish, everyone we worked with was respectful, knowledgeable, and clearly took pride in their work. Daniel, Joseph, Phaylan, Fernando, and Jayden were all fantastic—professional, friendly, and extremely thorough. From the initial visit and quote to the completion of the project, their attention to detail and care really stood out. It’s so refreshing to work with people who genuinely care about doing a great job. Highly recommend this company and this crew!

reviews.author: Haley Clark
reviews.text:
Andres with Blue Sky Plumbing was awesome. We had a cracked outdoor spigot pipe, and he handled everything quickly and professionally. He was knowledgeable, extremely kind, and took the time to clearly explain what he found and how he fixed it.

The company was very responsive, he arrived right on time, and he left the area clean when he was done. He even helped communicate with our landlord since we rent, which made a stressful situation so much easier. Pricing was transparent and very fair. We would absolutely request him again and highly recommend him

reviews.author: Margaret Eckel
reviews.text: Blue Sky did an excellent job installing our new boiler after our original one needed to be replaced after 40 years.  They worked diligently and together to replace it in a couple of days.  A beautiful job, respectful of us and our schedules.  Great work!  A piece of art!!

reviews.author: Sheryl M.
reviews.text: We have had Blue Sky twice now for issues in our home. Once for a furnace that would not start and yesterday for a backed up sewer. Both times they arrived within the time window, did the work professionally and with friendly communication and were done in a reasonable amount of time for a reasonable fee. Both service technicians who came were personable, knowledgeable and communicated well with us on what the issue was and how they were going to resolve it and the price estimate for the work. I really appreciated the fact that they texted me with a picture of the technician coming so I knew who he was before his arrival - thereby giving me peace of mind as to who I was letting into my home - and that they told me a couple little personal things about him.  This company is the real deal - competent, easy to trust with their client transparency at all levels and clean, reliable technicians. I also like it is a local, family owned business. We will continue to hire and highly recommend them for Plumbing, Heating and Electric needs around our home

plumbers.address: 2279 Romig Rd, Akron, OH 44320, USA

reviews.author: Lauren McIntyre
reviews.text: We called Jennings because we tried to replace some porch lights and found a major electrical mess due to the previous homeowners. Josh came out to assess the situation and gave us an accurate price to re-install one of the electrical boxes, both of our new lights, and caulk it up so the same issues don’t happen again. He even had the correct screws for the light fixtures - which Amazon didn’t think we needed 😒 (and would have stopped us if we had tried to install them ourselves). It looks so much better and we feel better knowing it’s installed correctly. Thanks!

reviews.author: k bloom
reviews.text:

From the outset, Matt was professional, personable and willing to show and explain everything he was doing for my boiler cleaning. I knew it was time for replacement, a topic I brought up, not him. I will also be a customer for life! I wasn't aware they provided more services than just HVAC, but I'm very glad I made the call. reviews.author: George Jensen

reviews.author: Kayla Stephan

The work was done efficiently and with great attention to detail, and he made sure everything was cleaned and working perfectly before he left. It’s clear he takes pride in his work and cares about providing excellent service. I would highly recommend Drew and Jennings Home Services to anyone in need of reliable plumbing services.

reviews.author: RIck Weber

I would not hesitate to use this company again.  This was my first time using Jennings but now have very good impression of this company.

plumbers.name: ARS / Rescue Rooter
plumbers.address: 4071 Powell Ave, Nashville, TN 37204, USA

reviews.author: Stacy Rihel
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about the service we received from ARS.  Our water tank basically blew out and we had water all over the garage.  We called several places for a quote on a Sunday.  Not only was their quote free of charge (even if we decided not to go with them), they responded immediately.  They had a technician, who was authorized to give full quotes on extra large tanks, out to our house within just a few hours.  The office also called twice to give us updates on his arrival.

The service technician,  Jerad, was so very nice and very professional.   He was knowledgeable about the entire process and answered every single question we had.  Even when we had to ask more after he left.  Jerad made the process so easy.  The quotes were very reasonably priced.

Casey, the installation technician came with the new unit the very next day!!  Customer service called to confirm his arrival time and kept me informed.   Casey arrived on time and was super personable.   He was polite,  funny, and professional.   He made the installation look easy!  He even cleaned up the water from the old tanks mess!

I would hire this company again without question!
5 stars to Customer service (thanks ladies)!
5 stars to Jerad and 5 stars to Casey!

As for the Essency tank, 5 stars on looks! It is very esthetically pleasing.   But right now, that is all I can say since it is brand new.  I will review the tank on its own after a few months.

Thank you, team ARS, for such a wonderful experience.   You made spending money not hurt so bad.. lol!

I recommend ARS, and I would definitely recommend William to do whatever work that you need done.

Bishnu, Carlos, Ivan, and Ian did a fantastic job installing our new HVAC system and removing all the old!

reviews.text: I cannot say enough, good things about my experience with mighty plumbing. I got a new mini split in my workshop, which was installed very professionally and cleanly. He told me that I should get a new subpanel and that whoever had done it before the wiring was under gauged. He then went in my crawlspace and saw that my house was also not grounded and up to Code since it is an older house. My main breaker box was only rated for 125 Amps and we could upgraded it to 200 Amps. He told me he could get everything done the next day. He arrived at 9:45 AM and didn’t leave till after 10 PM. The guy just crushed it. He was awesome to work with. I kept asking him if he could get it all done in one day and he kept reassuring me I am not leaving till it’s all done. reviews.author: Johana Mercado
reviews.text:
I needed a new AC/HVAC system. I went through Home Depot and they sent Jazz Heating, Air Conditioning and Plumbing to install the system. I met Jesus Prado who did an amazing job installing the heating system. However they came across a challenging task installing the AC system because it needed to be in the a new spot that would have enough space to pass the 5 feet code. They decided to put the AC on the opposite side of the house.  Because of the  high ceiling that has no access to the attic,  they had to go through the gutter line to insert the wirings. They ran the wires through the attic, come out on the other side of the house breaking the 2nd gutter line. Then they made another hole to go into the garage. The system works great but now  I have broken gutters with holes on my walls.

I was told by Jesus that Jazz will send someone to fix the gutters. Days passed and no one came or called. The rain was coming and I have leak points that will create water damage. At that point I was beginning to panic when the office was ignoring my calls despite of multiple messages. It was really hard to get through to get that taken care of and I felt that they didn’t know how to handle the situation they put me in.  Until I called Jesus and told him that they have not sent anybody to fix the gutter line or to weather proof the leak points. He understood my concern and he came right away to patch the broken cement around the insertion site, sealed it and artistically cut out pieces of metal to shield the site from the rain.  He took the time and made sure he was meeting my expectations. Finally the gutters need to be artistically fixed. Jazz does not do gutters, so I called quality roofing services, Inc. to get an estimate. Jesus said he will run it by his boss to cover the expenses.

Thank you Jesus for making sure that this job gets done!

Jesus you make Jazz company look good. People like you who knows customer service and the importance of protecting their property needs to be recognized. You have the capacity of pleasing your customer even if it’s not your line of work. Thank you for  listening and acting to make sure I am happy doing business with Jazz.  You made that possible when I was almost regretting it.

Otherwise the price was great, it took some hoops but the installment was done as it should. One happy jazz customer here thanks to Jesus.

reviews.author: Adrianne
reviews.text:
I had an emergency situation when I noticed one of my dogs kept going to the same spot outside. When I walked over, I could hear water running before I even saw anything. I went into the basement and found water spewing everywhere from a split pipe connected to our outdoor spigot. I immediately shut off the main water valve and called J & J Plumbing Heating Cooling & Electric.

They were able to dispatch David C. to my home in LaGrange, Ohio the same day within a few hours. David was extremely professional, friendly, and patient. He explained everything in detail as he assessed the situation and showed me where the pipe had split in multiple places, even though we had turned off the shutoff and removed the hose well before winter.

He didn’t have PEX on his truck that day, so he safely capped the PVC pipe so we could turn our water back on and scheduled a return visit to complete the permanent repair. When he came back, David replaced the damaged section with PEX to allow for better expansion if freezing occurs, installed a much better shutoff valve, and even relocated the pipe farther inside the house to reduce the risk of this happening again. He confirmed there were no leaks and waited to make sure everything was working properly, which gave me real peace of mind.

He wore boot covers every time he entered the house, kept the area clean, and was very respectful of our home. Pricing was explained upfront with full transparency. While they may be slightly higher than some, the quick response, professionalism, and quality of work absolutely made it worth it.

I would definitely call J & J again and highly recommend David C. and their team.
