The air quality in our home is undeniably improved to awesome. 40 year old ducts, they just get nasty over time. Call Hiller. They'll pro fix it. Thanks guys.

reviews.author: Ryan Whitcomb
reviews.text: The technician arrived on time, was professional and nice, and performed a thorough maintenance on our system. He explained everything he did clearly, made sure all components were operating properly. We appreciate the attention to detail and the respectful service. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Hunter A.
reviews.text: Nathan was great. He was quick, knowledgeable, and friendly. He provided me with extra information about preventative maintenance and informed me of a couple of other issues I had and what costs for repair would be and how I could fix them myself. Edit: The service was also completed at 8pm, and I called at 7pm, they were extremely responsive.

reviews.author: Heidi Reeves
reviews.text: I had a major plumbing backup, several toilets and showers backing up and filling with sewage.  Not good!!  Hiller dispatched someone the same day.  Caleb was the technician and he was great!  He was kind, professional and explained everything fully.  He was clearly experienced and made an effort to save me money.  I would definitely recommend this company and Caleb specifically.

plumbers.name: P.K. Wadsworth Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 34280 Solon Rd, Solon, OH 44139, USA

reviews.author: Peter Giang
reviews.text: I had my annual furnace inspection. Technician was here for all 10 minutes (literally) and left. Dusty, dirty filter was left behind and the power to the house was off the entire time. This leaves me wondering if he has known the true working status of the furnace. I truly believe he did not do a thorough inspection. I hope the regional manager reads this and give a formal counseling to this kind of work ethic because know it is not representative of the company.

reviews.author: Nancy Thrams
reviews.text: PK Wadsworth is the best.  We have used other local services in the past and needed a change because of increased prices. So ask around in our neighborhood and PK name came up with very positive comments. So we gave them a call and have found them to be excellent and the right cost. And if you have a boiler, Mike is really great. Found him to be honest and very knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Brandon Boehlke
reviews.text: The electrical department at PK is amazing they give free quotes for panel changes and generators and even if your not looking for that their service call fees are the lowest I have heard about anywhere! Call PK Wadsworth for great experienced electricians!

reviews.author: Check One
reviews.text: We couldn’t be happier with the HVAC service from Mike M, who was absolutely fantastic! From the moment he arrived, he was friendly, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. He explained everything in a clear way, and made sure all of our questions were answered. You can tell Mike truly cares about doing the job right. Everything was done efficiently, educating us along the way which gave us real peace of mind knowing that our system is now running safely and smoothly. The whole experience was smooth and stress-free. We’d highly recommend Mike M who provided top-notch service! Thank you Mike!

reviews.author: Fe Olson
reviews.text:
Mike Marcinick is Awesome  and knowledgeable Technician! He was able  to diagnose are problem with our Boiler Heating System. We even had some options on fixing it or install a new system. Mike was so courteous towards us and we felt he was doing his best for us.
Also I want to give additional compliments to the other technicians that made all this possible on the pictures posted on the boiler installation
Eric A. Bowen:
Who inspected the old boiler and recommended the best boiler replacement.  He also made finance advice that got the ball rolling.  He m a de it so easy and was able to get the boiler installation started the next day.
Jermaine Jolly and two other helper Technicians that made the installation efficient.
The Master Technician who made all his knowledge and expertise to get the Boiler upand running..You and your crew are so AWESOME  !!  The heat is working great and we are so thankful for PK Wadsworth coming to the rescue.  We highly recommend this company for your Heating and Cooling needs.

plumbers.name: EJ Plumbing & Water Heaters
plumbers.address: 1170 Martin Ave, Santa Clara, CA 95050, USA

reviews.author: Aladdin Nassar
reviews.text:
We bought our tankless water heater from EJ Plumbing 2 years ago.  And we had it serviced today for its annual maintenance.  We've been loyal customers of EJ Plumbing.  We love their prompt response, professionalism, clear communication and follow up.  I have personally communicated with the company's owner, Danny, on numerous occasions and found him deeply committed to taking good care of his customers.

Today's service was done by German who went above and beyond to make sure our water heater is fully serviced and as good as new.

reviews.author: Teri Chiang
reviews.text: I could not be happier with the HUGE job EJ Plumbing did for me. My slow shower drain turned out to be caused by disintegrated plumbing under my 70-year old house (tree roots came up when they snaked the drain, ugh). Jonathan was extremely helpful in diagnosing it, and supervisor Ryan Kennedy came right away to work out potential solutions to a very extensive and expensive problem. Ryan and Jonathan used a camera with a tracker to trace the issue through the lines. No perfect options with rotting plumbing under a slab. They listened to my priorities and we agreed on the best, least invasive solution. They came out promptly to start the job - a whole team digging through my brick walkway and front yard to replace the outdoor line, followed by cutting into my drywall to spray an epoxy liner through my indoor lines. They were extremely careful, hardworking and professional. Best of all, they took such incredible care putting everything back, including my yard, drywall and checkerboard brick walkway. Above and beyond!!! I am so impressed. Very very happy with EJ's honesty, reliability, professionalism, skill and even artistry. I had used them before for a small, simple job but this was a huge, difficult effort and I could not be more pleased. Thanks to Ryan, Jonathan, Ivan, Gerardo and the whole team at EJ for your excellent service!!!

reviews.author: Yan Du
reviews.text: EJ plumbing was great! We called Monday late afternoon (for a non-urgent issue) and got an appointment with Luis the very next morning. After considering our options we decided to replace the toilet that we had issue with. We ordered a toilet from Lowe’s and had it delivered that same day. Luis came back on Wednesday and installed the new toilet for us. The whole installation took less than one hour and we are very happy with the result! Would definitely use EJ plumbing for future needs!

reviews.author: The Dawleys
reviews.text: I had used Wizard Plumbing in the past but when I called to schedule work I was informed that the 2 companies had merged. EJ was great. Isaac J.  Was on time, professional, knowledgeable, informative and straightforward in communication. I had 2 under sink valves replaced along with an old leaking hose fitting outside that needed to be  soldered and fitted with a threaded end piece.  Work was done well and quickly.

reviews.author: daviddaemon
reviews.text:
On Wednesday March 4th, I corresponded via text messages with "Linda at EJ Home Services" and she arranged for a water hammer arrestor estimate to occur at my house in Sunnyvale on Friday, March 6th. She offered me two timeframes, 8-12 or 12-5, and I chose 12-5.  Her last text said:

"Sounds good... you're all set for Friday in the 12-5pm window. Thanks again, and we'll be in touch shortly to confirm the next steps."

E & J did not appear in the 12-5pm window or at any other time.   The estimate was not completed. EJ did not call, text or email me about anything.

My time is valuable and I chose EJ to complete a simple estimate based on their reviews. Setting up the appointment, Linda at EJ sent me 13 texts which gave me assurance that they were thorough. As I squandered an afternoon waiting for them to show, I have now chosen not to patronize EJ and offer my story for your consideration. Beware of Chatbots.

plumbers.name: Absolute Plumbing, Electrical, Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 5590 Havana St Unit A, Denver, CO 80239, USA

reviews.author: Brian Bogle
reviews.text: I was having thermostat & temperature-regulation issues at my Wheat Ridge home.  I had used Absolute in the past, and they sent out technician Richard Brown, who was incredibly helpful.  He correctly diagnosed the issue, found the cause of the problems, and got my heating system back running before noon the day of my service.  Richard was also superbly communicative throughout the process (a HUGE deal for me).  He said when he was on his way, explained issues as they were discovered, and clearly outlined costs associated with the parts & labor.  After the issue was resolved, Richard relayed that he stands by his work -- giving me peace of mind.  Thanks so much to Richard Brown and the Absolute team!

reviews.author: Heather
reviews.text: We have been working with Absolute Plumbing for a couple years and they have always been extremely professional and knowledgable as well as reasonably priced. We had two technicians come out. The first, Gabriel, was very friendly and super knowledgable. He was able to fix our issue , fast and efficient. The next day we had Dylan come out to scope our line and he was very friendly and knowledgable as well. Both did an excellent job!

reviews.author: Camille S
reviews.text:
Vincent  installed a Toto toilet with a bidet & replaced the water supply line ($592)
Ian installed a GFCI outlet to operate the bidet ($425)

both techs were excellent!  incredibly knowledgeable, answered all questions & then some & cleaned up afterwards

I will use again should the need arise

reviews.author: Grant Boies
reviews.text:
I call this morning and Absolute was able to dispatch a technician this afternoon! Richard was polite, had a great attitude, and was able to diagnose and repair our boiler quickly and for a fair price!
I’ll definitely be calling back whenever I need anything else for our pluming!

reviews.author: Sherri M
reviews.text: Keith with electrical installed a new breaker box in my home. He was thoughtful, friendly, and thorough; and stayed until the job was complete. He even made sure I had electricity at my workstation so I was able to work all day. I'm very happy with his service.

plumbers.name: Golden West Plumbing, Heating, Air Conditioning, and Electrical
plumbers.address: 4217 Delaware St, Denver, CO 80216, USA

reviews.author: Sean Von Manowski
reviews.text: Jason was fantastic. He took the time to carefully diagnose what was, at first glance, a simple fix on our boiler. After investigating thoroughly, he uncovered a mistake made during installation and got it fixed the next day. He showed that he really cared and was very professional. Great experience.

reviews.author: Inna Jeltai
reviews.text:
My first impression of this company was excellent thanks to the representative on the phone. She answered on a Saturday, was very polite, professional, and friendly, and communicated everything clearly. She kept her promises, followed up by phone and text, and arranged a same-day emergency appointment without any extra charges — which I really appreciated.

Chris, the technician, was also fantastic. He arrived on time (even earlier than expected), explained everything about my furnace in a way I could easily understand, and patiently answered all of my questions. He fixed the issue and walked me through different options without any pressure. Very professional, knowledgeable, and kind.

Overall, I’m very happy with the service and the company — both on the phone and in person. A great first impression!

reviews.author: Holly Robinson
reviews.text: Carlos was wonderful. Scheduling was easy and I was surprised they could get someone out to my house on a cold weekend when I knew they were busy. Not only did he diagnose the problem promptly but we had a solution within an hour and restored heat by dinner time. He treated our home like his now. He was on task, tidy and friendly. Very professional and trustworthy. We won’t use anyone else!

reviews.author: Fatima Mayorga
reviews.text: Everyone at Golden West is great, including the office staff. Josh who was the lead Tech is processional and knowledgeable, the same applies for Riley their electrician. These guys go above and beyond to repair and diagnose any problems. They are my go to company for any plumbing, heating and air-conditioning services. Try them, you won’t be disappointed, they are the BEST IN TOWN!

reviews.author: Pete Jimenez
reviews.text: Anthony L. did an exceptional job! From the start, he attentively listened to our electrical requirements, was incredibly polite, friendly, knowledgeable, and professional. In a matter of several hours he designed and installed an appropriate electrical upgrade, all while adhering to our budget. I highly recommend Golden West Plumbing, Heating, Air Conditioning , and Electrical to  neighbors, friends and family!

plumbers.name: A-Abel Family of Companies
plumbers.address: 440 Congress Park Dr, Washington Township, OH 45459, USA

reviews.author: Brian Wisniewski
reviews.text: My furnace went out one evening.  I booked an appointment online for the next day. By 8:30 I had a confirmation text with a window of time for my appointment.  And by 9:00 I had a text that the technician was on his way. He was thorough,  explained everything he was doing and gave me options.   He even realized after he left that he missed a step. So he called me back and returned to finish the job right.  He could've easily skipped that and I would never had know.  Im very impressed that he was so honest.  I am very pleased with my service.  Would definitely use again.

reviews.author: Kevin Hoffer
reviews.text: I recently built a large detached garage with a loft area.  It was an Amish-built garage, but after the structure was finished, I was responsible for serving as the general contractor for the electrical, HVAC, insulation, drywall, and garage door installation.  A-Abel was by far the most reliable of all the trade contractors I had to deal with.  They also installed a Generac whole-house generator for me at the same time.  This was a complicated installation, with excavation, gas-line work, in-house panel work, and of course a new panel installation in the garage.  Caleb, Jacob, and Jeremy were all phenomenal, and I am very happy with the result.  They were very professional and reliable, and you could count on them to show up when they said they would.  The communications with them were top notch, and I can't make a higher recommendation.  I would use A-Abel for all of my future electrical needs.

reviews.author: Marissa Manzella
reviews.text: Mark and Tristan came out and performed a generator outlet install and they were fantastic!! The guys were super nice and knowledgeable and walked us through proper use several times.  Jacob, the owner, worked some magic and got us scheduled same day so we could prep for an upcoming storm.  Highly recommend, I’ll definitely be using the company again!

reviews.author: Paul Schaeffer
reviews.text: Had a garbage disposal that started leaking and went out.  Went to the A-Able website on a Sunday and made an appointment for Monday.  Monday morning I received a text that my appointment was confirmed and the technician was on the way.  A nice man entered my house, inspected the unit, confirmed the leaks and cracks and suggested replacement.  He had the exact same unit on the truck which had lasted me 15 years and operated flawlessly for that time.  He did not try to upsell me, in fact when I asked about a higher performance unit, he explained why I might not consider that a better option.  He gave me price quotes for both the one recommended and the one I asked about and I picked the one he recommended.  30 minutes later the job was done, quick, clean, professional, and middle of the road priced with appropriate warranties.  He even gave me a photo of the serial number on the unit for registration so I didn't have to climb under the sink to find it. Easiest plumbing problem I have had fixed maybe ever, and just before Christmas I was glad I didn't get upsold something I didn't really need.  Thank you A-Able.  Fantastic job performed by a mighty elf.

reviews.author: d m
reviews.text: I have used A-Able two times, both times highly satisfied. Jason was the technician the first time and was so professional, courteous and simply an all round good guy that I requested him for the second issue. He was thorough in his investigation of my problem, his truck was clean, he insisted on wearing his boot covers, he simply was what I would call the "perfect tech". I have a feeling it is not just Jason that makes this company one that you want to deal with though. From the time I spoke to the person answering their phone until Jason left, everything, my information gathering, scheduling, confirming the appointment time and the half hour notice of Jason on his way, was handled the way it should be. I owned and operation a commercial HVAC company for many years, I recruiter my very best people from personal experience as they worked for other companies. Jason and their phone operator would both be ones that I would want working for me if I wasn't retired. I know this may sound like a commercial for A-Able, but it's not. My wife and I have no extra money anymore and we need to be very careful with what we have so it's nice to know there are still honest companies out there. When you have a problem give the a try. The owner of A-Able should be very proud of what he has built.

plumbers.name: Jolly Plumbing | Drains | Heating | Air
plumbers.address: 101 Beacon Dr #1, Wilder, KY 41076, USA

reviews.author: Wayne Dutle
reviews.text: Where do I begin? From the first consultation with Tony, we knew we would go with Jolly for our tankless water heater install. Tony was very respectful and thorough in explaining everything to us on the options we had, along with any questions. Tony was prompt in his communication and performed excellent work. His attention to detail while installing the new water heater really showed and you can tell that he takes pride in his work. Tony went above and beyond for us and I would recommend him to anyone. Thanks again, Tony!

reviews.author: Theresa Studer
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Jolly Plumbing/Drains/Heating/Air when our furnace went out overnight. They were able to get a technician to our house first thing in the morning, which we really appreciated. Jeremy & Miguel were both professional and courteous. Jeremy was especially friendly and very knowledgeable - he clearly explained what was going on and what needed to be done. They fixed and cleaned the furnace efficiently and had us warm again in no time. Excellent service all around. Highly recommend Jolly!

reviews.author: Steven Roushar
reviews.text:
I really appreciated the help of Jolly. We just bought a house a couple weeks ago and had Nathan come out to inspect our HVAC system. He was able to show me the ins and outs of my system and how to properly maintain the things I needed to maintain. He was on time and a great communicator. Thanks for the help Nathan

We had other plumbing work done after we discovered a leak from our laundry room pipe last week from Clay and he did a great job. All in all I’m happy with their work, communication and overall company. So happy I got a monthly membership with them.

reviews.author: Cheryl D. Armstrong
reviews.text: Blake and Aidan are excellent to work with. So courteous and professional.  Blake is very patient and explains things you need to know thoroughly so that you understand without any pressure.  I really enjoy working with him and recommend his services highly!!

reviews.author: Caleb Mitchener
reviews.text:
Jolly has done a great job with every service we have needed. We recently had a pipe crack under our house causing water to seep up into our basement and Jolly was able to get somebody out to us right way that same day. Tyler, Blake and Gavin did a tremendous job with the re-pipe of our basement and installation of a new water heater. Tyler was great at breaking down the process of repairs while talking us through our options. The prices were very reasonable for the amount of work that was done and they had great financing options available. The company does a very thorough job following up on any questions one may have after the job is done.

The Jolly membership plan is also great because it comes with a 10% discount on repairs as well as numerous other perks. Overall we have been very satisfied with the prompt, friendly and knowledgeable service we have received from this company.

Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Steve Huff Plumbing, Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 113 Witherspoon Dr, Kingsport, TN 37663, USA

reviews.author: Bob Welch
reviews.text:
Replacement of the water service line from the meter to the house. The technician arrived when scheduled and made an assessment of the problem. He completely discussed the issue, offered corrective action with costs for each.
I chose an option to replace. The technician and his apprentice showed up when scheduled and commenced a difficult job. In the 3 days they were here I was extremely pleased with how professional they were. They went out of their way to make the job as little a problem to my handicapped lifestyle. The technician even discovered issues with my plumbing and corrected them to bring the system into compliance with code.
Needless to say I will use them again. In fact I signed up for their annual maintenance program. I strongly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Lara Nagle
reviews.text: Our plumber Chris did a very thorough assessment of the house and worked diligently for hours to address a long list of fixture updates and repairs. I also really appreciate how communicative he was, and willing and able to answer all of my questions. Chris and his assistant were respectful of our house and kept everything clean. So far, the repaired items are working well and most of the work is under warranty in case something happens. It did seem relatively expensive but the service was very professional.

reviews.author: Rachel P
reviews.text: Excellent service and experience. During a major storm they sent Zack out for the initial assessment. He was very polite and quickly found my heating issue. John N. came out within 24 hours and did the actual repair. He was another super polite, efficient guy. They were sensitive to keeping the house clean and worked quickly. Issue resolved and my heat is back on! Thanks Zack and John N.

reviews.author: Joe Oliver
reviews.text: Had them replace my 50 yr old leaking home water supply line. My yard is red clay and I understand the problems this causes. BUT they made an unbelievable mess.  Not only in my yard but also my neighbors and the street is still a mud hole. They also damaged my concrete driveway. I complained and someone from the office called and asured me there would be a follow up to this. Still waiting.

reviews.author: Pam
reviews.text:
Our technician Chris did a great job!! He had previously installed a water heater at my old house and did a fantastic job so I was glad
to see him. We had a leaky pipe under the house this time. He fixed it quickly and assessed the condition of the piping under the house and gave us options for further repairs. Can’t go wrong with Steve Huff Plumbing!

plumbers.name: Eco Plumbers, Electricians, and HVAC Technicians
plumbers.address: 1851 S Metro Pkwy, Dayton, OH 45459, USA

reviews.author: Sarrist “Sarrist”
reviews.text:
This will be a 2 part review.  I am looking to replace a water heater and called Eco as a third estimate.  I wasted the time to listen to the other two.  The Eco Rep Jeff Passarge was courteous when he showed up as i had a sales person here as well who had overstayed his welcome.  Jeff took his time without direction to take pictures and assess the situation.  Once he had gathered the info he excused himself to write up estimates for 3 different water heaters.

Once i was able to get rid of the salesman, Jeff was quick and to the point.  He offered me his suggestions and recommendations.  He educated me on my needs and installation and gave advice in MY best interest to get the job done right.  He was courteous and attentive, open to my questions.  He worked out installation for the next day and went over all financing options to explain the costs. He told me he had 4 years in the service but he has a bright future and an amazing asset to the Eco company.

Thank You Jeff and Eco for a painless estimate, can't wait to see you in action tomorrow!

Nathan and Owen arrived a little late only because they weren't the scheduled installers.  Both young men introduced themselves and went straight to work replacing my garbage disposal and water heater from tank to tankless.

They made sure to keep the mess to a minimum and would explain each step  as they went.  Nathan worked diligently to remove and replace the water heater while his apprentice Owen replaced my garbage disposal.  Both were motivated and worked for a solid 5 hours to completion.

Going from a tank water heater to tank less is more extensive than i thought so i was appreciative they tried to move as quickly as possible to finish.  When everything was complete they cleaned up any mess and walked me thru my new system, twice!

I'm definitely a fan of ECO now as all parties involved were professional, friendly and efficient completing the tasks required.  I will be speaking highly of the company and its employees!

Thanks Nathan , Owen and all the ECO employees who helped with my project.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Viets
reviews.text: Logan did a great job installing our new furnace. The crew was very timely,  polite and professional. Furnace works great!

reviews.author: Christopher Lutz
reviews.text: I was highly satisfied with Eco both as a company and with the employees I interacted with. I met with four separate companies for my HVAC estimates and they were the only ones with both good financing options and good prices. I got a good system at a reasonable price. As far as the installation I thought Eagle and crew were extremely professional. Their workmanship was stellar with great attention to detail. Lightyears better than what we had before.

reviews.author: Dayton Ohio
reviews.text:
The guys from ECO that came out to install our new system was phenomenal. Rock star status in my book! Super professional, love the work they did, and left zero mess behind. I couldn't be happier with our purchase! The work was completed in record time the same day!
-  I woke up refreshed and feeling nice and cool at home today! It's in the 90's today....
THANK YOU SO MUCH!

I had ECO come out in October 2025 for our initial start up of the furnace and did an inspection. The Technicians were prompt, professional, knowledgeable, and courteous!

Our ECO install over the past summer was a great investment!

Thanks again!

reviews.author: Maria Blankenship
reviews.text: Adam was great.  He explained everything in detail and answered any questions I had.  I am very impressed with how quickly I can get an appointment scheduled.  All the technicians so far have been courteous and thoughtful and very knowledgeable.  Looking forward to my new hvac system.

plumbers.name: Schuler Service, Inc.
plumbers.address: 1314 Tilghman St, Allentown, PA 18102, USA

reviews.author: Stacey Silliman
reviews.text: Kevin and Cayden looked at my sump pump and Kevin did suggest a new one since mine was not functioning. I expected as much and he and Cayden had it installed quickly and professionally. I love Schuler Service. Always professional and helpful and I am a repeat customer and always will be. Also thanks to the kind receptionists too for being so nice and decent when booking. Everyone has great customer service skills which means a lot to me. Five stars. I would give them 100 stars if I could!

reviews.author: D F
reviews.text:
If you live in Macungie Borough like me, you may enjoy “great” water pressure … but be careful, because you could unknowingly have *100 psi* running through your pipes, like I did!  At least, before Chuck Bell from Schuler installed a PRV (pressure reducing valve) to bring it down to a safe level.

It’s never fun to spend money on something you didn’t know you needed (and isn’t in budget).  But Chuck eased that blow by being patient (VERY patient) with my uncertainty and million questions.  Even when I asked the same thing multiple times, he was never impatient nor did he get offended - he stayed calm and kind.

Chick went out of his way to help set my mind at ease about the project and expenditure.  He went above and beyond: checking the pressure setting on my expansion tank (and matching it to the house pressure, as it should have been); measuring the temperature of my hot water; (and increasing the temperature on my heater to an appropriate level); and checking my toilet tank to make sure there wasn’t a leak.

I can’t forget everyone I spoke with on the phone at the Schuler Service office - they were all SO NICE!  I never felt like I was being a pest (these days, some places make you feel like … unless something has exploded or someone needs open heart surgery, you are wasting their time, so they can’t get you off the phone fast enough).  Everyone I spoke with at Schuler was warm and friendly, yet professional.  Thank you!

This review is too long and I doubt anyone has read it all, so I’ll stop now.  Do not hesitate to call Schuler; ask for Chuck Bell!

reviews.author: S. Miller
reviews.text: Excellent services. Appointments were easy to made and they arrived within specified time. Jason Price was the team member who fixed  my shower faucets and kitchen. He took the time to assess, provided explanations of plausible options with their pros and cons, and took the time to teach me how to best care for the plumbing integrity. He was tidy, professional, friendly, and attentive to his work. I trust Schuler for over 3 years now, and that trust has not changed. Thank you very much, Jason, for an excellent work. We appreciate you!

reviews.author: John Edmonds
reviews.text: I would like to thank both Jim and Noah for the timely and quality workmanship performed on the waterline work done at my home. Professional from the get go, I would give these guys a 10+ if possible.Schuler Service is the go to place for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: greg
reviews.text: I called Schuler, not in an emergency, but in need to address an issue with water pressure and air in the pipes.   They scheduled promptly for the next day.   The technician who arrived was very friendly, professional, courteous, but most importantly, knowledgeable!   After throughly diagnosing the plumbing, and explaining that there were several issues at play, Chuck outlined everything and made clear what options we had and the potential risk/reward of each.   After a decision was made, and a few phone calls later, parts were delivered and the work was completed.     The service was excellent and in the future I will not hesitate to call Shuler and ask for Chuck when plumbing issues arise.

plumbers.name: Vines Heating & Air, Plumbing, Restoration
plumbers.address: 489 Myrtle Ridge Dr, Conway, SC 29526, USA

reviews.author: Jennifer Dittbenner
reviews.text: Vines did an excellent job helping us to locate and fix a water leak issue at our house. They were proactive with confirming appointment times and gave plenty of notice when technicians were on the way. Their communication with us was excellent. They went over all the options with us and answered all of our questions. When deciding whether to only fix the repair or to re pipe the entire home, the technicians were very patient. They did as little demolition as possible until they could determine if re piping or a repair was the best option. The technicians gave me the time and space I needed to make a decision. When the job was done, the home was left extremely clean. I am very impressed with the customer service and the professionalism of all the technicians that came to our home.

reviews.author: Georgia Cullinane
reviews.text: Craig was very professional and knowledgeable. He helped me go through the procedures of what happens with hot water tanks. He explained why there was rust on the bottom. I'm glad that he's coming back to do the actual installation. I would highly recommend him.

reviews.author: jim loiselle
reviews.text:
I could not be happier with the guys from Vines. AC unit was not cooling the house. Brand new house we just moved in. A different vendor installed it and the Trane unit had a Freon leak. I called yesterday morning and Sean came out to the house a couple hours later and found the Freon leak. He filled the system back up with Freon and told me they had to order the parts from the manufacturer.  Because of the weekend it might not be until next week. Me and the dogs were getting kinda hot we just moved from New Hampshire.  Well, I got a call this morning from the office at Vines and they had the parts in stock and wanted to come right over to fix it. Just like that CJ and Austin showed up, climbed into the attic and three hours later they were all done. It was all fixed and the house is already cooling down.
The guys were wonderful. They were pleasant. They answered all my questions. They even played with the dogs for a minute and the golden retrievers love that.  I am new to Conway and I made the best choice in choosing these guys to fix my problem I could not be any more happy. Thanx everyone at Vines.

reviews.author: Tony Jenzano
reviews.text:
Hello there,
Thank you for your expedient services. You have done a LOT of work for us and we appreciate it.  My only criticism would be that Michael, your representative, told me  that the 'hydro-irrigation machine' would be an extra $600.  Bit of a difference from $836. Know that I signed my name but will be honest to say that I did not see an itemized bill. I was handed a cell phone and asked to sign on a 'signature page.'  Please know I'm not making a big gripe. Michael was great, cordial and informative.  You guys are always prompt and get the job done.  Of course, this was more expensive than I wanted it to be but, isn't it always? Thanks again for all you guys do.
Best,
Tony Jenzano

reviews.author: Katie Lowrey
reviews.text: My technicians Nick Ryan and Ruben Aguirre were amazing. Best men for the job they could have sent. Very professional, kind, expert knowledge, and kept a clean work place. They were able to install a new water heater for my family after ours died a few days ago. As they worked they were also kind enough to pet our dog and play with my 2 year old little boy. He enjoyed watching them work and interrupt them with sword fighting. They did a job well done and we appreciate their hard work! Thank you Ruben and Nick!

plumbers.name: All Comfort Services
plumbers.address: 5245 Voges Rd, Madison, WI 53718, USA

reviews.author: Allison J Milley
reviews.text:
I hired All Comfort to perform a furnace tune-up. The technician spent over an hour in the basement and then informed me that my heat exchanger was cracked, causing high CO levels, and that I would need a new furnace. I was scheduled for a follow-up appointment with a salesperson.

When the paperwork arrived by email, there was no mention of a cracked heat exchanger, which immediately raised a red flag. To be sure, I contacted another HVAC company for a second opinion. Within minutes, the second technician discovered that my heat exchanger was not cracked at all.The real issue was that the gas pressure valve had been turned up, leading to the high CO readings.

Not only was the initial diagnosis completely false, but I also doubt that All Comfort actually performed the tune-up I paid for. The condensate drain and pump, which were supposed to be cleaned, were clearly untouched (see photo).

When I called to report what happened, All Comfort quickly refunded my money — which I appreciated — but I’m still out the cost of the second company’s visit. Had I not trusted my instincts and gotten a second opinion, I could have spent $5,000 unnecessarily on a new furnace I didn’t need.

Hiring them for a “tune-up” turned into a very unnecessarily stressful experience

reviews.author: Daniel H
reviews.text:
All Comfort Services was amazing!

After scheduling with a different company, that took 10 days for their "project manager" to come out and provide no help or information about my situation, I contacted All Comfort Services. They had a knowledgeable technician at my house less than 24 hours later. The technician explained my situation thoroughly and provided me options to resolve it. When we decided to replace our water softener, the technician started immediately on the work and completed the work within 2 hours. The pricing was transparent. The technician explained everything to me before leaving and provided clean work leaving behind no mess.

Thank you to Ariana and Rich at All Comfort Services for taking care of my problems so quickly!

reviews.author: D Barker
reviews.text: We have used All Comfort Services since we purchased our home in 2014.  The maintenance and service provided were always top notch.  We had a technician, David out on the coldest night of the year and he was able to get us a couple of days, but we ultimately needed a new furnace.  Will came out to show us our options, and got us set up with a new furnace and AC.  In just a couple of days, two incredible technicians, Mike and Dylan, came to install.  They were so professional and respectful of our home.  We had contractors in to work on a different issue and they were very respectful.  While needing to replace your furnace is never the best news, All Comfort Services made it completely painless.  We cannot thank them enough for their time and excellent service!  Would highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Mary Linklater
reviews.text: Great service and quick installation. We were happy to hire a local company with many years of service to our community. I took away 1 star only because there were a lot of screws left on the basement floor and some in the driveway. If we had gotten a screw in a tire that would have been an expensive fix. I would ask that the team do a more thorough cleanup when finished. But we are very happy with our new furnace.

reviews.author: Margaret Jankowski
reviews.text: We had questions about the operation of the humidifier that's built into our furnace. TJ did an excellent job of diagnosing the issue (needed to increase water flow) and explaining the system. As a member of All Comfort's Comfort Club, I was surprised at the cost. I thought it would be included in my membership, since no parts were needed and the visit was short. But service was great.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing of Tampa
plumbers.address: 5020 Tampa W Blvd, Tampa, FL 33634, USA

reviews.author: Carolann Loosvelt
reviews.text:
I always trust ROTO-Rooter. They get to the bottom of the problem and they fix it - one and done. I’m done with messing around with “cheap plumbers” and cheap Mr. fix it’s
This time around, I had more than one problem with a bathroom, shower faucet tub, drain etc but William has a lot of patience. More than anyone I know. He got to the bottom of it. It took him a while, but he got it.  I had two other people look at this problem and didn’t fix it…. Always always trust ROTO-Rooter

reviews.author: Shirley Fisher
reviews.text: Our service tech Scott Bowers was great. Willing to complete the services needed. Very polite and left with a good experience. Assured us if the problems continued, that he or someone would be right out to solve the issues. The dispatch was so quick, I was totaly surprised they someone came out so quick.

reviews.author: Cathy Lefkowits
reviews.text: Emergency at dinner time!!! Thank goodness for Marcus! Marcus was so kind and patient! He unclogged our drain and made sure everything was flowing and flushing properly before he left. It was a 💩 situation but Marcus made us feel incredibly calm because he was so calm. We highly recommend Marcus!

reviews.author: Annastasia Sarkisian
reviews.text: Marcus came in to fix an issue we were having with our reverse osmosis system. He identified and clearly explained an error that was made by a previous electrician and fixed the issue. Would recommend Marcus again. Great service and price!!

reviews.author: Margie Pulido
reviews.text:
I’m giving Vincent 7121 a 5 star for quality service. He’s very honest and knowledgeable. He replaced my kitchen faucet, the cartridge in the shower and fixed my water softener system and checked my bathroom sink drains.
Prices are affordable and no hidden fees.
The only issue I had was the wait time. I think it’s the company cause they overbook the techs. If you’re willing to wait at least you won’t have to pay an arm and leg.
Unlike cornerstone they could not figure out any of my issues, Vincent was spot on .

plumbers.name: Fort Collins Heating & Air Conditioning
plumbers.address: 208 Commerce Dr #4, Fort Collins, CO 80524, USA

reviews.author: Diane
reviews.text: I had Fort Collins Heating & Air Conditioning come out and install a Bryant Heat Pump, 90% condensing furnace. I highly recommend this company for any of your HVAC needs. Chris came out to give me estimate. It was directly down to business no games, no sales job. I had 4 companies come to give me estimates to replace my 27 year old single stage goodman furnace, no air conditioning. Chris advised me that there was this (income based) HEAR program through the Colorado Energy Office. This helped me immensely to make my decision to choose the Bryant Heat Pump System. Chris kept me advised throughout the application process to install. He setup, coordinated and scheduled (along with the office staff, I believe was Lisa, my apologies can't recall) A-Z to do a weekend install. I was sent notifications who was arriving along with picture and background info. Arron and Adam arrived introduced themselves very professional and friendly, laid down tarps, put on booties and advised me to the steps of the install. Arron informed, advised and educated me throughout the install. He would explain to me the system breaking it down and it's capabilities. The install as you can see from the photos was so professionally and esthetically done, great job! Had electrician Kanner arrived day 1 of install introduced himself and got right work, he was here and gone. Luke arrived I believe it was day 2 of install introduced himself and got right to work. Fabian was here on day 2 to assist Aaron with the install. He was professional, personable and friendly. He arrived introduced himself and went right to work. On the last day of install Aaron patched up and (Arron and Fabian) assisted with making the system mouse proof outside, cleaned up and closed up windows. See photo. This was a non-stressful, pleasant and professional experience. Thank you! Already loving the new system can't wait till it hits 100 to 105 to check out my new cooling this summer!

reviews.author: Linda Sweeney
reviews.text: The crew that came to install our new unit was on time very professional. They explained what they would doing. They covered our wooden with protective pads. They let us know everything they were doing and asked if we had questions. They cleaned up every day when they were done. Once the unit was installed they went through everything that we would need to know. We were very pleased with everything thing that they did. We would highly recommend this crew and company to anyone looking to purchase a new furnace heat pump unit.

reviews.author: Francisco Africano
reviews.text:
I’m new to working with Fort Collins Heating and Air and so far I’m impressed.

We needed to get our 12 year old furnace replaced as it was giving us issues and the last thing I wanted to do was limp into winter with a furnace that was on the fritz.

I had been working with another HVAC company for regular maintenance and they gave me a quote but I wanted to keep them honest is I called around for a few other quotes.

I worked with Derek and he was a pleasure to work with. He told me about the company (which no other company did) and why he’s been with FC H&A for so long. The pricing was competitive and he educated me on some local rebates.

After moving forward with their proposal they were quick to get us scheduled. The installation took two days. Arron and Adam came out to rip out the old system and begin installing the new system. They were both very professional and knowledgeable. The cool thing about working with FC H&A was that they were able to get custom sheet metal designed and delivered quickly to make the system look cleaner than the previous system.

After day 1 they made sure I had heat in my home, as it was getting colder, and came back the next day to finish the job. Arron came back on day two, finished the installation, cleaned up, and did a walkthrough with my wife and I.

So far I’m impressed with FC H&A and I look forward to working with them more.

reviews.author: Curt Lipkie
reviews.text: I am very satisfied with our new heat-pump furnace and air conditioning system from Fort Collins Heating & Air Conditioning.  Lucas and Evan did an excellent job installing the new system.  They we on-time and professional during the installation, always keeping us informed during the process.  They were clean and respectful of our home.  They even worked extra time the first of two days to make sure we had heat from the new furnace during the night.  Lucas was especially helpful in explaining the system and safety features to us, as well as helping us set up the new smart thermostat.  Overall, it was a positive experience to have a professional team installing our new system.

reviews.author: Seam Ripper
reviews.text:
Joe and Damian were great. They were efficient, clean, professional, and friendly. They did a ton of work and were able to get it done in a single day!
They made sure I understood everything they did, the next steps that would happen, such as the city inspector and their scheduling, and also how to to get the most out of all the new equipment.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 2085 W 114th St, Cleveland, OH 44102, USA

reviews.author: Kendra Vander Weit
reviews.text: Rene was wonderful! I'm grateful to him for coming out on such short notice and so late in the evening! He was patient and kind and very knowledgeable. He explained everything to me and educated me on plumbing! If I could request him everytime I need help I would! Thank you Rene and Roto Rooter for hiring good quality staff.

reviews.author: Angela Green
reviews.text: Rene did excellent work. He was clear on the scope of the repair and went above and beyond with keeping us updated on any issues that cropped up.  Very professional and knowledgeable.  Great work and would request him again for any future needs.

reviews.author: Nat Mouncey
reviews.text: I’d give Aidon and Aaron 10 Stars if I could. They were friendly, professional and gave me great recommendations throughout the whole process. When the project became more complex than I’d anticipated, they offered multiple options, best practices advice, and clearly put real thought into each step. They made sure I understood what they were doing and took pride in their work. They clearly treat their customers home like they were working on their own homes. They were here when they said they would be. Not only will I call Roto-Rooter in the future, but I’ll specify that I’d like these guys.

reviews.author: Bryant Troupe
reviews.text: We had a leak at a rental property out of state, which as Murphy's Law would have it, was on a Friday.  Roto-Rooter was one of the few options that not only provided free estimates but also scheduled weekend appointments.  After calling and confirming information about their services, booking the appointment online was easy.  They followed all my instructions which involved coordinating with our tenant.  They confirmed the appointment by phone and keep me informed during the whole process.  They showed up on time during the 2 hour window.  They provided a written estimate for approval and they resolved my issue.  The plumber was communicative during the process.

reviews.author: Sandra Meister
reviews.text: Our basement flooded with several inches of pure sewage. Roto Rooter was there within an hour and handled everything. Renee, Rick, and Matt were all fantastic. I don’t know what we would have done without them.

plumbers.name: Plumbing 911
plumbers.address: 1103 Wooster Road North, Barberton, OH 44203, USA

reviews.author: Jean Kindry
reviews.text:
As a first time caller to Plumbing 911, I was pleased to book next day service for repair of 2 toilets with different problems. What seemed like a straight forward solution was anything but.
Shane Duncan  came up with an ingenious solution and gave us a perfect result.  He is very knowledgeable and goes the extra mile to give the customer satisfaction.

reviews.author: Chris Foster
reviews.text: Rob was excellent. He was highly experienced, on-time, gave clear communication, did quality work, and took time to explain a few things to me along the way. I would highly recommend Rob and Plumbing 911.

reviews.author: Nicole Osborne
reviews.text: I had a slow leak of my hot water heater and called for an estimate to repair. Shane came to the house (no fee just to show up for an estimate) and provided a thorough estimate. He scheduled the repair. Unfortunately, the repair did not work so I had to have a new water heater installed. They actually gave me partial credit towards the new install from the repair effort. Shane did a WONDERFUL job. He was friendly, personable, courteous and most of all efficient. I would highly recommend if you needed repair work or new installs to call Plumbing 911 and specifically ask for Shane! My experience could not have gone any better.

reviews.author: Teagan Busby
reviews.text: After dealing with repeat flooding and a previous “fix” that didn’t hold, this company was a lifesaver. They were professional, kind, and extremely thorough. Communication was great, the technician was efficient and knowledgeable, and they went above and beyond by scoping the entire line to ensure there were no other problems. I finally feel confident the issue was handled correctly. Highly recommend and they have a customer for life now!

reviews.author: Chris Miller
reviews.text: Scott from Plumbing911 was very helpful arriving promptly, diagnosing the repair, and getting the job done in an hour.  I appreciate the call ahead service, which was great so I could meet Scott at building from work.  Thank you for supporting your Christian community at Solon United Methodist church.  Chris

plumbers.name: Eco Plumbers, Electricians, and HVAC Technicians
plumbers.address: 9114 Cincinnati Columbus Rd, West Chester Township, OH 45069, USA

reviews.author: Karen
reviews.text: Phillip and the three other crew members are awesome!! They worked every minute and were so personable and respectful of our property and wanting our yard to look as good as possible after having the underground drainage system replaced!  They will return in a few days to finish up some loose ends. They gave 110% and I am so impressed with them, their work ethic, and the end result of this project. Very happy and satisfied!!  Would also like to recognize Kevin Walters and Ryan Montgomery. Also thanks to Jordan and Evin who handled installing a new water heater!  Thumbs up to them all!

reviews.author: Sean Carnes
reviews.text: Elijah was great. Came in and got the job done in about 2 hours. Didn’t push anything additional and let me make a call. There was expected, but minimal removal of a current DIY project and I won’t have to do much to fix and be back on track. Elijah also tested and cleaned up before leaving which was better than how it looked when he got there. I would def recommend ECO and call them again if I have an issue

reviews.author: Allen
reviews.text:
ECO quickly scheduled the work and their pricing was in the middle of the quotes for my repair. Repair went well, although I questioned the techs use of putting old rags in the hole as backfill, including a 2x4. The original jetter quoted didn't work for our application, so we're waiting for a larger jetter (at an increased expense).  Hopefully that's completed early next week so we can safely use our kitchen sink. Also found the new cleanout is leaking and pooling water at the base of the pipe after a couple of days. Hopefully everything is corrected and I'll adjust the review.
Edit 12/22 (from 1 star to 3 stars): ECO attempted on a couple of occasions to jet the line, but were unsuccessful. They quoted additional work to dig another section of the pipe up. They also replaced the new cleanout that was leaking. Not ECO's fault there was so much rock in there, but I feel like maybe the other quotes I had received may had included removing the rocks for the same price, even it involved digging up the other end of the run.

reviews.author: Amy Kreamelmeyer
reviews.text: Wyatt was amazing to deal with. We had no idea what to expect  and were silently worried about the cost of our electrical issue. Wyatt put us at ease. He quickly assessed and then explained what was wrong. There was no up selling, just here are your options . He talked each option over with us and was patient and understanding through the entire process. We decided to sign up for the yearly service knowing that we need more work done. Wyatt was friendly and down to earth. Made us feel at ease and like we could trust him. He completed  the job on the spot with quickness and efficacy. He was clean around his work space, polite and best yet resolved our issue. Highly recommend (and Im a hard judge of these types of issues). Thank you Wyatt!

reviews.author: Julia Deck-Russell
reviews.text:
Even though they were hours late and yes, really messed up my day schedule wise- the tech that came was great !  Kevin W was my technician (which he didn’t exist as one of the options to leave feedback about) but he was very thorough. Listened to all our concerns, and ran 100’ snake from an outdoor Cleanout to the road.
I had preferred the snake to be ran from my inside cleanout due to what was happening in my interior plumbing, but the exterior was easier access and less messy, I guess.   And he did get the large blob with some roots in it out of the main.
My understanding was the $93 special included it being cameraed which it wasn’t. I asked if they would clean it out from two locations -which would be pulling the toilet in the furthest bathroom where the original problem was. And it was going to be more than $500 To pull the toilet and run a basic snake/no rotator/cutting.
I think that amount is crazy especially since the hours late arrival cost me a few hundred dollars in other domino effect scheduling problems where I was supposed to meet someone an hour away and I couldn’t make while waiting for this appointment -and that cost me $$$.
Overall Regarding the specific service I received while Kevin was here though, he was kind, professional, and definitely removed a large clog from my main about 25 feet from the Cleanout, toward road.

plumbers.name: WyattWorks Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1372 Lloyd Rd, Wickliffe, OH 44092, USA

reviews.author: Brian Rolinc
reviews.text: Whole team from calling, scheduling, service, to follow up is always so pleasant and helpful. Xander was my tech this time and he was patient and insightful in explaining everything that was going on and answering questions, in a way that made me feel like I was an expert by the time he left. What I liked best was that after Xander unclogged the drain, he was meticulous in double in triple checking for no new drips or leaks, and ensuring that the clog really was clear and not just temporarily before backing up again.

reviews.author: Nikole Wakeling
reviews.text:
Alex was knowledgeable, efficient, and truly focused on solving my problem while helping me save money. I really appreciated that there was no pressure to complete repairs that weren’t actually needed.

They have definitely become my go-to for plumbing and electrical issues for both myself and my clients. As a realtor, recommending quality professionals is essential in my business, and I feel confident referring them knowing my clients will be well taken care of.

reviews.author: Jim Piscioneri
reviews.text:
Alex and his co-worker did an excellent job of explaining the various options available to us. We had a clogged kitchen sink drain and needed to replace an old secondary shutoff valve.
All work was done in a timely manner and the guys were very pleasant to communicate with. We are very pleased with the entire experience. The communications via text were OUTSTANDING ! Thank you WyattWorks Plumbing !  We have a new plumber to contact for our needs !

reviews.author: Mike Brady
reviews.text: I scheduled an appointment with them because my mother's basement was flooded with sever water. I made an appointment in the morning and they promised to have someone that morning. They latered called and they said they would not come out for another 4 days. I knew a family member of there's so I went out on a limb. I got my mother to go with them instead of someone else. I really advocated for them. And they let me down! Unfortunately, I can't see a way to hold them accountable at this moment.

reviews.author: Linda Weitzel
reviews.text: Jesse and Indrek answered all our questions and were very very knowledgeable,  efficient and friendly! They explained what to expect and went out of their way to accommodate our needs. We will definitely have WyattWorks help us in the future!  I also appreciate the follow up calls from James regarding the service performed.

plumbers.name: Rooter Hero Plumbing & Air of San Jose
plumbers.address: 2827 Aiello Dr, San Jose, CA 95111, USA

reviews.author: Osama Qazi
reviews.text: Delightful experience from start to finish. I booked online late on a Saturday and Luis Segura picked up my appointment immediately. He was en route quickly and arrived on time. Luis was very respectful of my space and went above and beyond to ensure that no dirty water ever got on the floor. He explained every step of the process and set expectations. He did the job with great care and patience. In the end he got the job completed and got me a working kitchen sink and unclogged drain. Rooter Hero and Luis Segura provided a comprehensive and affordable service that left me very satisfied and happy. I highly recommend this company and Luis.

reviews.author: Stephanie Palmieri
reviews.text: Easily requested a same day appointment online. Their response came in a timely manner and they communicated who would be arriving and when I could expect them. Eli arrived and was friendly, courteous, and efficient. Not only did he fix my sink issue, he clearly explained the situation, so now I’ll know what to look for should I need to call for help again. I highly recommend and would be happy to have Eli’s services again. Thank you!

reviews.author: Valeria Baker
reviews.text: Cody provided excellent service and explained my options to me when he came for his initial inspection. He gave me a quote for the service. I agreed to and he went to Home Depot to grab the parts. He was back fairly quickly and was very considerate of the noise level because my children were asleep. He was very friendly and put me at ease about having to call an emergency plumber at night. 10/10 would recommend this company based off his level of service alone.

reviews.author: Darren McGee
reviews.text:
Cody was awesome!

He came out to unplug our bathtub drain. He was in the middle of snaking it when the snake broke (could've happened to anyone). Instead of making me wait for a trip back to the office or another truck, he ran around the corner to the hardware store, grabbed what he needed and got the job done quick.

Also, the customer service was great! Cody was super personable and he even cleaned up the area afterwards.

Bathtub is back to normal and the price was super reasonable. I would definitely recommend these folks. Not all heroes wear capes!

reviews.author: Lynn Stanton
reviews.text:
Thank you Rooter Hero team!  After attempting to and being unsuccessful in scheduling a visit with one of several plumbing companies to unclog my kitchen sink, I thought I would have to endure even more gross backed up water and gunk for who knows how much longer. I was so discouraged.  Then I stumbled upon Rooter Hero!

My first contact was Marielyn who was able to schedule a consult that same day. She patiently answered my questions in a manner to give me hope that her company understood my frustration and and would do their best to meet my needs. Thank you so much for your attentiveness.

How happy I was to open my door at the scheduled time to meet my Hero, Cody, standing there  with the widest of smiles. Cody took the time to  educate me regarding his diagnosis and plan. And, he listened and was respectful in explaining in layman’s terms what I needed to know.

Thank you, Cody, for expertly repairing my plumbing in an hour and at a very fair price. My kitchen is fully functioning once again. As I told you, I will definitely be calling again to address future projects! Thank you very much for being easy to work with and for being My Hero!

plumbers.name: Albert Nahman Plumbing, Heating, and Cooling
plumbers.address: 3333 Martin Luther King Jr Way, Berkeley, CA 94703, USA

reviews.author: Judy Sarmiento
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Albert Nahman Plumbing!  The customer service was excellent from start to finish—from the receptionist who handled my initial call to the knowledgeable technician, Deandre P., who arrived within two hours.

Unlike several other plumbing companies I contacted, Albert Nahman did not charge for travel time.  They were also offering a February promotion for free diagnostics, which was greatly appreciated.

Deandre P. was professional, thorough, and patient. He carefully inspected the pipes and water lines and clearly explained his findings. Although no plumbing leak was identified and the issue appears to be related to a large rainwater stream under the house, I valued the honest assessment and the time he took to investigate the problem. I was not charged for the visit.

Overall, Albert Nahman Plumbing demonstrated integrity and outstanding customer service.

reviews.author: Linda Hagerty
reviews.text: Sal Garrido was absolutely spectacular in restoring my peace of mind when he stopped the running water in 2 of my 3 toilets. He expertly repaired them by needed replacement of parts that caused the problems. And he clearly explained and priced the job before starting. Given that my husband who recently passed away used to handle all of our home maintenance issues, I was particularly relieved to have such knowledgeable and gracious assistance from Mr. Garrido. He’s a true asset to your company and deserves special recognition for his excellent service. I have been a customer of Albert Nahman in the past and was again impressed.

reviews.author: Kathleen Matias
reviews.text:
We were so disappointed with this company. I made the appointment in November for 1/14/26.
We traveled from Colorado for this appointment. We told them in November that we wanted our heater checked and our thermostat changed, since it wasn’t functioning and our house was 50 degrees.
The day before the appointment I called to get a time window when we could expect the technician to arrive. They could only tell me 8am-4pm. We woke up and waited and waited. I called in at 10:45 to get a better idea of when they were coming. At that time they told me that one of their employees called out sick and that they would have to reschedule the appointment. At that point we asked to speak to a Supervisor and lodged our complaint. After some time in our explanation, she guaranteed that we would have service today 1/15 and that we would be the first appointment.
No one was here at 9am so I called again.
The receptionist gave me the same explanation of an employee calling off. I asked to speak to a supervisor again but she couldn’t transfer me and had no phone number to call directly to a supervisor again.
At that point I was livid!!! They did send an employee after noon today and when he got here he didn’t have a thermostat, which I originally requested to help me. At that point we cancelled our appointment. I will never do business with them again and nd I hope people reading this review will stay away!!!
This was so unprofessional of them!!!

reviews.author: Patt Petrovich
reviews.text: This was my first time using Albert Nahman Plumbing and they were fabulous.  The Technician, Christopher was truly an expert. Very knowledgeable and very clean in his work.  He completely replaced my kitchen faucet unit and it looks beautiful and works great.  He totally went out of his way to buy a new unit and it matched perfectly to the one that had to be replaced. I will be referring my neighbors to this firm and of course Chris. Thank you so much for making this job a complete success.

reviews.author: v rivard
reviews.text: Plunged parent’s toilet $189.  Five stars. Replaced parent’s broken single hole lav faucet with “like” faucet with no change to fittings  $1010.95. ZERO stars. I was the contact person and they had the person with disabilities sign the contract. I would NEVER have approved that. I called Thursday. No return call yet.

plumbers.name: Ravinia Plumbing, Sewer, Heating & Electric
plumbers.address: 575 Bond St suite a, Lincolnshire, IL 60069, USA

reviews.author: Matthew Berry
reviews.text: Ravinia always makes problematic situations a little more manageable. Available in an emergency, always leave my house cleaner than they found it, and the techs work hard to fix each issue completely. Tonight, Holly at the switchboard and Adan on site went above and beyond. On a Saturday. Thanks to the whole team. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Al Aronow
reviews.text: We have used Ravinia for several plumbing issues in the past. Chasen was on time with the appointment, gave us an accurate estimate for the work and completed it in a very professional, timely and clean manner. We would highly recommend both Chasen and Ravinia.

reviews.author: Slim the bodyguard
reviews.text: Jason was great. He was professional nice and very informative. He also told me I needed some more work done. What an existing job that was done wrong that had nothing to do with the visit.I really appreciated I will definitely be using Ravinia again soon

reviews.author: Meg Lurie
reviews.text: We've had a great experience with Ravinia Plumbing. Service was extremely prompt, efficient, and the technicians made a stressful situation feel surprisingly easy. Our issue was resolved quickly with thorough, respectful care and clear communication. Very grateful and highly recommend!

reviews.author: Lizi Mathew

reviews.author: Matt Riopelle
reviews.text:
Roto-Rooter is performing the fix and remediation for water damage from a pipe leak behind the shower.

On-site, the technicians are great. It's fast and quality work and they know how to communicate with customers.

The low star rating is for scheduling communication and not following through on promised time-frames.

After first assessment of the issue, which occurred in the afternoon, they promised to be back first thing in the morning to begin work. Well, morning came and went without a call or update. I began calling, and was promised three different times that someone would call me back right away. Those calls also never happend.

Finally, at 4:30pm, someone called and said a tech had an unexpected injury and nobody couldn't make it out that day. They did promise to start at 9:30am the next morning. I was promised this time by both a supervisor and a dispatcher.

That time again came and went without a call or update. At 11:30am, the tech called and said they'd be there about 2:30pm. This time, they actually did show, though it wasn't until later.

In addition, they needed to come back and check moisture levels every day. I would receive a call about 30 minutes beforehand and if I wasn't available, they wouldn't do the reading for that day.

I don't know how a business runs this way. How disrespectful to your customer's time and plans. I understand things happen. And that's when you update the customer so they aren't left in the dark. A few timely phone calls and I wouldn't be writing this negative review.

I can't recommend Roto-Rooter to anyone who expects a service provider to show up when they say they will.

Update: It’s been eight weeks since they started and the work is still not finished. Not once have they showed up when they said they would. They ordered the wrong carpet, so as of today, there’s still exposed subfloor.

reviews.author: Michael Touhy
reviews.text:
We had sewage coming up from our basement laundry drain and called Roto Rooter to help us. They did anything but. Eddie arrived on site and called in his supervisor, Max Corner. Max said that he was unable to open up the main basement clean out so they had to run equipment from the main floor bathroom. This added 8-10’ to how far they attempted to rod which apparently weakened their equipment enough that they were not able to properly determine where the actual damage was. Max drew up a proposal and told me once I signed they would be able to get a crew out the next day to begin work. I signed the contract trying to get my home back in order and Max then called to tell me they actually wouldn’t be able to start the next day because he had already left and did not map out the yard (never received an explanation as to why this was not done when he was on site). He returned the next day and due to the cold weather he could not get his equipment or spray paint to work leading him to pace my yard yelling curse words for 20+ minutes getting to the point where a neighbor had to call and ask if everything was ok at the house. Max then came back in to do the same inside because he was not able to get the toilet back on (photo attached). He left it like this and said it was fine because it wasn’t actively leaking.
The next day a crew was supposed to arrive by 10am and they showed up around 2pm. They dug a hole and cracked my line and despite this area not being the issue, put in a clean out and left. Public Works actually told them that that do not appear to be the issue spot and they told him that that was the spot they were contracted to dig. They sent in a jetter who said that the issue was actually 8-10’ farther down the line and max would have to come back. The jetter also would not hook up his equipment to the main line because it was only accessible under my porch and he would not go under there. So he cut a hole in my basement window screen and hooked up to a near 100 year old laundry tub which is now leaking.
Max came back and confirmed that the issue was actually 10’ farther down the line and immediately quoted me an additional $7000 even though I was already out $8500 FOR WORK THAT DID NOT HAVE TO BE DONE!
I told him that I was not going to use them and called a local plumber who said that the job was actually $3500.
I’m getting in touch with an attorney as I now have more damage than when I called in Roto Rooter and they did unnecessary work for which they overcharged.
