reviews.author: Tomas Neill
reviews.text:
Great service! Fast, reliable, good communication, and professional.
Highly recommend Dustin Taylor and the Air Tech of Conroe team.
Had a service performed by Joel Castaneda today, professional and on time.

reviews.author: Shannon Felder
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I had a fantastic experience with Air Tech of Conroe, thanks to Joel Castaneda Jr.! Joel came out to my home, diagnosed the issue with my AC, got it cleaned up, and had it running like new in no time. He was professional, knowledgeable, and kind throughout the entire visit. What really impressed me was that he took the time to explain everything and made sure I was completely comfortable with the service. And to top it all off, they even waived the dispatch fee — such a generous gesture!

Joel truly went above and beyond. It’s not every day you get service this good. I highly recommend both Joel and the team at Air Tech of Conroe. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Maurice Liddell
reviews.text: Dana was very professional and knowledgeable. I never felt like he was trying to upsell me on his services. I ended up paying nothing for the repair as I bought an annual maintenance pa page that was extremely reasonable and included this service call. In the end I received a much better solution that will give me piece of mind at a very reasonable price. I highly recommend Dana and Air Tech of Conroe.

reviews.author: Ted Vickey
reviews.text:
Everything was supposedly fine with our system while we were paying for the membership, and we were told no extra work was needed.

Right after we canceled, a new “issue” appeared: we were told the drain pipe is too small.

It feels very questionable that this wasn’t caught and fixed the first time we had trouble, and it raises concerns about how our account was handled

reviews.author: Jon Zibilske
reviews.text:
Scheduled a technician to come check out our furnace for short-cycling and intermittent no heat.  I had looked the system over beforehand and noticed I was getting no voltage to inducer motor.  When he arrived, the furnace was running, and he stated he had not done anything to it.  During the visit, he did not check any voltage, components, or make any attempts to reproduce the short-cycling or the inducer motor not turning on.

After, he did take the time to have a conversation about how the installation of our unit by the builder was trash, that the only fix for my 7-year-old system was to rip it completely out, and replace a working AC and serviceable furnace with a $30,000 Trane Unit and install.

I've since replaced the control board myself, updated the thermostats, and the furnace is running fine.  I'm sure I may need to service other components on it in the future, but I won't be coming back to Air Tech for that.  They only seem interested in big-ticket install sales.

plumbers.name: Legacy Plumbing
plumbers.address: 8765 Stockard Dr STE 104, Frisco, TX 75034, USA

reviews.author: Jim Boykin
reviews.text: I wanted to give a big shout-out to Wayne and Cameron for their fantastic work installing our new tankless water heater! They showed such professionalism and care in their work that I’m a huge supporter of Legacy Plumbing. The best part was Wayne calling the next day to check in and make sure everything was going smoothly with the new water heater. That’s a fantastic example of customer service! I’ve used Legacy Plumbing many times, both personally and professionally, and they’ve never let me or my clients down! Thanks, Wayne, Cameron, and Legacy Plumbing!

reviews.author: A C
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Legacy Plumbing. I’ve relied on them for years, and they are consistently honest and trustworthy — which is hard to find. Wayne and Cameron are true professionals: efficient, thorough, and excellent communicators who explain the issue and options clearly. The work is always top quality and the pricing is fair and transparent. I recommend them without hesitation.

reviews.author: Justin Barton
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Legacy Plumbing. Johnny and Bryan were absolutely fantastic from start to finish. They handled both a bathtub repair and a bathtub shower repair, and the quality of their work was top-notch.

They were professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain what was going on and how they were fixing it. Everything was done efficiently, cleanly, and with great attention to detail. You can tell they genuinely care about doing the job right.

If you’re looking for reliable plumbing work and great customer service, I highly recommend Legacy Plumbing, especially Johnny and Bryan. I wouldn’t hesitate to call them again.

reviews.author: yusuf rizvi
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Legacy Plumbing. They were able to come out the same day, on very short notice, and the pricing was very fair with an awesome warranty, which gave me a lot of confidence.

Ramone, the technician, was outstanding. He took the time to explain everything clearly while working and made sure I understood what was being done and why. On top of that, he went above and beyond by fixing an electrical breaker issue, which technically wasn’t even his job.

That kind of honesty, knowledge, and extra effort is rare. I’m extremely happy with their service and would 100% recommend Legacy Plumbing to anyone looking for reliable, professional, and trustworthy work.

reviews.author: Ryan V.
reviews.text: Exceptional service by Legacy.  My outdoor faucet had a leak from the winter freeze.  The pipe was broken near the faucet.  Sean and his partner from Legacy came out and told me upfront about the pricing and potential issue.  I agreed and they replaced the faucet within 30 minutes.  Price was reasonable. It was quick and professional.  Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Plumbing Express
plumbers.address: 3050 Presidential Dr #202, Atlanta, GA 30340, USA

reviews.author: Carrie
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with Plumbing Express. They repiped my entire home and also handled all of the drywall repair and repainting afterward. When they were finished, it honestly looked like they had never been there—everything was spotless and perfectly restored.

Ed Torres, the estimator, was wonderful to work with: extremely knowledgeable, professional, and thorough in explaining the process.

Ivan Del Campo was my office contact, and he was fantastic at keeping me informed every step of the way, which I really appreciated.

The team of four plumbers who removed the old piping and completed the actual repipe did an outstanding job. They were professional, hardworking, and efficient, and it was clear they took pride in their work. They answered questions when needed and were respectful of my home throughout the entire process.

Kenny and Waldy, did a great job on the painting and drywall. They took a house that looked like swiss cheese and now you'd never know!

From start to finish, the entire team was professional, communicative, and detail-oriented. I highly recommend Plumbing Express to anyone needing major plumbing work done right. It's not fun money to spend, but if you're in need-these are the guys to call.

reviews.author: Debbie North Realtor
reviews.text: Dylan did a great job fixing our Rinnai hybrid water heater. He didn’t try to do the typical “oh it’s over 5 years old you need a new one” that so many companies do. We really appreciated that! He did need to order parts, but they came in quickly and he was very efficient.

reviews.author: Diondra Peck
reviews.text:
I would recommend Plumbing Express to anyone for repiping services.

I got initial quotes from 4 different plumbers for replacing PB pipe, and Ed was by far the most knowledgable, informative, and personable that I interacted with. Price was also hard to beat, especially considering the drywall repair was included.

The crews that came out to work were on-time and worked quickly. The drywall repair was seamless; as many others have said, it is impossible to know there were ever any holes in the walls. Throughout the entire process, Ivan stayed in contact and communicated proactively and clearly. Any issues or concerns we had were addressed promptly.

The only complaint we had was that some of the workers didn’t clean up thoroughly after themselves and left behind debris/trash. One piece left was a metal piece from a pipe that could’ve damaged our lawnmower if it hadn’t been found. In general though, the work spaces were left clean.

Overall, we’re very happy with the quality of work done and customer service experience. These guys know what they’re doing.

reviews.author: Chris Pacitti
reviews.text:
TOTAL HOME RE-PLUMB.  Our neighborhood has had so many homes experiencing water leaks (hundreds) that many of us have chosen to re-plumb before it happens.  Based on my own experience speaking with four different plumbing companies, and speaking with several of our neighbors, I decided on Plumbing Express.  They are knowledgeable, professional and very responsive to any questions along the way.  Their price was fair and it’s one price for the whole job.  You won’t have to find someone to repair and paint drywall.  They have their own people or contractors to do that so your house looks perfect when they finish.  I would highly recommend Plumbing Express to anyone needing to have their house re-plumbed.
EDIT: Ed was the initial person I spoke to. His experience, knowledge and easygoing (non-salesman like) demeanor was greatly appreciated.
Ivan was my point of contact for any questions and he was friendly and as I said, very responsive.  He also installed a Moen smart valve in our home.
Dylan plumbed the exterior of our home to the street while another crew did the interior re-plumbing.  I’m very pleased with all of them.

reviews.author: Katie Moss
reviews.text: Many thanks to Dylan for all of the work he put in yesterday to replace my hot water heater. It was an absolute pleasure to meet such a kind man who completed such a laborious task in such a short timeline, both skillfully and efficiently. Great communication all around, from the office updates on arrival timelines to expected finish time. Will absolutely recommend you in the future. Thanks again for your hard work! Happy New Year!

plumbers.name: Spot On Plumbing of Tulsa Plumbers
plumbers.address: 1911 W Reno St, Broken Arrow, OK 74012, USA

reviews.author: Nikki Cook
reviews.text: We called Spot On Plumbing because they have a 4.9 out of five reviews.  We are so glad and thankful to have chosen them!! If we could give a higher review we would.  From start to finish was a great experience.  Preston and Tato came out the same day that we called.  Both were very professional, respectful and kept us updated throughout the process. They both provided excellent customer service!!!!!  They made us feel completely comfortable with their transparency and respectful demeanor! The lady that answered the phone was great and very helpful and friendly, and their customer portal is great!!!  Great job!!! We will be highly recommending this company!!!  Thank you all so much!!!

reviews.author: wendy robertson
reviews.text:
Spot On Plumbing Company is truly excellent! We had a wonderful, top-quality experience with Hayden and Easton, who did an outstanding job installing our new tankless water heater and repiping our entire home with high-quality PEX. From start to finish, their professionalism, skill, and attention to detail were impressive.

If you’re looking for reliable plumbers in Tulsa and the surrounding towns and cities residents can trust, Spot On Plumbing absolutely delivers. Their 100% happiness guarantee really shows how confident they are in their work; if anything isn’t right, they’ll come back and make it right at no extra cost. Their goal is clearly to exceed expectations, and they succeeded with our plumbing needs. Spot On Plumbing is Veteran owned and operated, too.

Service was prompt, friendly, and genuinely thoughtful. We couldn’t be happier with the work and the service. Spot On Plumbing went above and beyond, and we highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Alisa Norris
reviews.text:
Mitchell, Easton, Aiden and Brandon were at my house today looking for a leak on the slab. It was found and all debris was cleaned up nicely.  Thanks for responding to my call so quickly.  I will retain Spot On because you now know the history of my house.  Thanks again.

Another day. New water pressure valve.  Feel safe to get it replaced and upgraded.  Thanks Mitchell.

reviews.author: Greg Hulett
reviews.text: Preston and Tato were very helpful and informative. They walked me through every estimate and every step of the process. They presented me with my current and future options when assessing the issue. Both of them were incredibly thoughtful, friendly and communicative throughout the process. Spot On worked with me to get my issue resolved the same day and for a price I was happy with.

reviews.author: Natasha Johnson
reviews.text: We are thoroughly impressed with the customer service and the attentiveness given to us. Our drains needed cleaning and we had questions about our initial appointment and we had plumbers at our house almost immediately to address our concerns. Preston and Brandon were both kind, thorough, and professional in tackling our kitchen drain which was our main concern. We appreciated that they had our backs as far as homeowners and explained thoroughly what was going on with the plumbing in our home. I would highly recommend this place and it’s really the best you could want when you are having plumbing issues and wanting assurance on how your drains are functioning / what can be done to improve them. Thank you so much Spot on Plumbing for treating us like people more than just another customer.

plumbers.name: DB's Plumbing and Drain®
plumbers.address: 2609 Morse Ln, Woodbridge, VA 22192, USA

reviews.author: Lisseth Palacios
reviews.text: This company took my call and assigned someone to my home promptly. I was stressed and they were friendly over the phone.  The plumber that came to my home, Michael, was amazing.  He was kind and courteous. He explained everything thoroughly and was patient with my questions.  He was very professional and his work is neat and thorough. I highly recommend Michael from DB’s Plumbing & Drain!

reviews.author: Jennifer Hargis
reviews.text: Marv J installed a pressure regulator valve which we did not have and main water shut off valve.  It was a very small, tight space and he was able to do the work without cutting into the drywall.  He also replaced an old hose bib shut off for the outside water spigot and repaired a section of bent piping in the ceiling.  He did the work at a fair price and was very diligent and friendly.  He also cleaned up the area after he completed the job.  I would not hesitate to have him work on any other plumbing issues that we may have in the future.

reviews.author: Sherry P
reviews.text: We can’t speak highly enough of DB’s and particularly Aaron F. When we had a plumbing emergency late in the day, DB’s was the only company able to get someone out that evening.  Aaron F. Came out early in the promised window, diagnosed our problem, and got us all set up. He was courteous, incredibly knowledgeable, and did a great job of communicating with us what our issue was and how to address it in the future. The next time we call a plumber, DB’s will be the first call…and we’ll ask for Aaron F.

reviews.author: Adam Kerr
reviews.text: I did not have a good experience with this company. They don’t charge for a service call but then charge a very high price to do the work, in my opinion. The technician was friendly and seemed knowledgeable. However, the price to do the work was very high to me. He was in the house for not more than an hour and fixed the pipe to my shower diverter that I improperly installed. Part of that hour included a delay b/c he needed to charge the battery for his tool, which is understandable due to the cold weather. I’m all about paying for quality work but the price seemed very high. They gave me a military discount which was nice of them but the price was still $350 for 1 hour of work (which required very few parts). I should have politely thanked them for their time and gotten a second quote from a different company. But, I was pressed for time and just had them do the work. I went with this company b/c they had an extremely high rating. I am providing this review so other customers are aware of potential challenges that they may face when requesting similar services.

reviews.author: Jessica Gutierrez
reviews.text: I experienced the worst of the worst  plumbing disaster you can imagine. I had sewage back up on multiple floors and it was a hazmat. Aaron from DB Cooper showed up and we worked as a team to rid the biohazard immediately and had the plumbing working again temporarily until they could get a crew out the very next day. Aaron wrote up the invoice and report which was extremely easy for my insurance to read and dispense insurance funds to pay for most services. Not only did Aaron resolve and repair the issue he recommended me to a phenomenal clean up crew (Semper Dry) who came immediately and resolved the aftermath. I couldn’t recommend DB Cooper more, and I have dealt with other local plumbers who were not anywhere as near as proficient as Aaron.

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing of Cincinnati

reviews.author: Pat Garifalos
reviews.text: Cole did an excellent job troubleshooting our garbage disposal problem and installing a new one.  He checked everything carefully and explained what he did and why.   We would definitely like to have him come for any future repairs or installs.

reviews.author: Michelle Fletcher
reviews.text: Casey and Jack came out two days in a row for a frozen ditch line pipe and sump pump issue. They worked diligently and quickly. They were respectful, explaining every step; oftentimes, repeating what they were doing so my elderly mother understood. In addition to their customer service and work ethic, they have been to our home on previous service calls and have a relationship with my mother which keeps down her anxiety. Those two fellas should be commended on superb service!

reviews.author: Brandon Roberts
reviews.text: Bill is fantastic. I will not work with another plumber unless it is Bill. I was quoted 2 guys 1200 for 6 hours. They got the job done in less than 4. Installed the new heat tape and insulation on the pipes. He even sat down with me at my original appointment to show me what I needed, where to buy it, what a good price was etc. He is amazing

reviews.author: david fewell
reviews.text: Joseph was awesome. He did a fabulous job in getting the sink working again. He worked quickly and was very friendly. I highly recommend Benjamin Franklin for any of your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: James Duncanson
reviews.text: Our tech Ethan Tolliver was exceptional from start to finish. He didn’t just treat us like a customer he treated us like family. He was very knowledgeable and thorough in explaining the repairs needed. He made the whole process enjoyable. We look forward to working with Ethan and his company in the future if anything is needed. William Owens came out and replaced the power vent on our water heater. He knew his job of the repair very well. He was genuinely concerned about our lack of hot water and replaced the part in less than 30 minutes. We are very pleased by the overall service we have received so far. We had a new tankless water heater installed after the repair and the whole process was great from start to finish. Chris and Jordan were the two install techs on the tankless eater heater. They also extended our natural gas line so we could put a gas stove in. This is honestly the best experience we’ve ever had from a company. I would highly recommend them for your next service.

plumbers.name: Baker Brothers Plumbing, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: 7315 Commercial Blvd E, Arlington, TX 76001, USA

reviews.author: Candi CooCoo
reviews.text: M. Bell's review for Jesse with Baker Brothers.  I called Baker Brothers to get a 2nd opinion and price for a supposed broken sewer line under my house caused by tree roots. The cost estimate from the first plumber that I called out had quoted a price for repair to be upwards of $10,000.  After careful and extensive examination of my ENTIRE sewer system by Jesse with Baker Bros, it was determined there was no need for ANY repairs AT ALL to be made. Jesse was very thorough and had ME watch the screen as the camera went the entire length of my sewer line. With his equipment, Jesse was able to show me exactly from INSIDE of my house where his camera was UNDER my house at any given moment. I was very impressed with his knowledge of the situation and my mind was finally put to rest. I highly recommend Jesse with Baker Brothers.  He not only saved me $10,000 I was quoted by the first plumber, but saved the construction mess and cleanup I would have had to endure. I will recommend this company to my friends and family for certain. Thank you Jesse and Baker Brothers! I appreciate you so much!

reviews.author: L M
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Bryant from Baker Bros. He replaced my kitchen faucet and three bad valves under the sink quickly and professionally. The work was neat, efficient, and done right the first time. He showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and left the area spotless. It’s such a relief to have everything working perfectly again! I highly recommend Baker Bros and Bryant for anyone needing reliable, high-quality plumbing work.

reviews.author: Sandra Williams
reviews.text: The technician relaced my ceiling fan which was not working very well. He inspected the area to assure that there were no problems.  He installed the new ceiling fan perfectly. He was very professional,  knowledgeable, and respectful. He explained the steps he made to me. His work was flawless. I was very pleased with the outcome of the service.

reviews.author: Kenny Horning
reviews.text: Definitely was not a great experience, but Baker Brothers plumbing department hooked me up and handle the problems at hand. The team was real, honest and straightforward with me, which I greatly appreciated. Now if they would only have a bundle package to offer across all there platforms or even customer rewards.

reviews.author: Mercie Gonzalez
reviews.text: I just want to say thank you to our technician, Jonathan and to the team at Baker Brothers. He came in last night and helped us get our AC going. From the initial call and to the upcoming work we’re having to set up on our unit, everyone has been super helpful and transparent. We’re so grateful to have found your team to work with and we’ll definitely be continuing service for as long as possible.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1691 Town Center St Ste 104, Aurora, IL 60504, USA

reviews.author: nancy anderson
reviews.text:
Our old (and only) toilet had not been working right for a couple months (partial flushes, tank running, etc). It finally got completely stopped up and started overflowing and we couldn't plunge it out! Roto- Rooter to the rescue!

Our Technician, Marc, was great! He arrived within 3-4 hours of my call, diagnosed the problem quickly, and gave me possible solutions and estimates for the work before starting.

Marc augered toilet and replaced some old parts in a timely fashion. He got our old potty working better than it had before. Plus, he left the bathroom clean and tidy too -- Hooray!

It was expensive but worth it for the quick, friendly service.

reviews.author: Chuck Damore
reviews.text: We had a catastrophic failure of the cast iron sewer pipe exiting the house on a late Friday night.  None of the toilets or sinks would drain.  The salesperson from Roto Rooter came quickly after I phoned them on Saturday to assess the problem and give me a repair price.  The issue was a broken cast iron sewer line exiting the house at the foundation.  It sheared in two pieces and became clogged.  Monday morning, Roto Rooter arrived on site.  They needed to dig an 8 foot deep X 4 foot wide X 8 foot long hole under the porch to access the failed cast iron pipe.  They had to cut out concrete stoop as well.  They removed the failed pipe and replaced it with a new PVC pipe.  They pulled all permits and arranged for a city inspection.  We were able to use our water Monday afternoon.  Tuesday morning, they filled in the hole and cleaned up.  The cleanup was fantastic.  If you didn't know what happened the day before, you would have never known they were there.  It was a big job that required a large backhoe and many service techs to make the repair.  The supervisor Brandon M. did a fantastic job along with the sales associate Kyle and the rest of the crew.  The finished site was professionally cleaned.  My neighbors commented on how well the guys cleaned up.

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Melanie Stewart
reviews.text:
Our experience with Andrew Mares from Elkhorn Electric was five stars from start to finish!

We had a light post made of wood that was rotting out of the ground, and our options were to either ditch it or upgrade. Because we used it for holidays and loved tying a balloon to it for the kid's birthdays, we decided to redo it with a brick post.

Now something they don't tell you about building a brick light post is that it's insanely expensive and stressful, but Andrew made sure that the electricity part went as smooth as possible. To start, I unknowingly bought a post light which didn't include the mount needed for the stone cap of the post that I bought. I also got a tapered cap (slants diagonal up instead of flat) because I liked the look of it, but the masons did not let me know that it might be difficult to mount a light to a tapered cap and it was something that never crossed my mind. Andrew explained all of this to us and let us know that he would have to reschedule us so that he could get the appropriate parts to make our light work on our post.

Naturally I fretted about this all week. Was it going to have a pole sticking up? Was it going to be able to mount flush? Why hadn't the masons warned me about a tapered post? My husband assured me that Andrew did not seem concerned, so I shouldn't be, either. Sure enough when he arrived he was able to get the light put in no problem, looking amazing, and he added an electrical panel to the back for us, which we had originally requested, so that we have an additional power source for all of our Halloween/Christmas decorations we like to do (if you can't tell from the photos, ha). If that looks slightly off center in the photos it is because the masons cut it that way, versus anything Andrew did.

We also incurred NO additional cost for him to have to get a different mount for us, come back a second time, and the additional work it took for him to mount the post light versus mount light. He said "What we quote is what you pay", which is the opposite experience I had with the brick part of the post (as the final bill ran $1k over the quoted price). I also called my cousin, who is an electrician, with our original quote from Andrew to make sure it was fair and he said "I would have charged you more".

All of that to say that Andrew was so easy to work with and did such an exceptional job, it was the easiest and most pleasant part of the post being built. And the work is amazing and looks fantastic. My husband is already talking about having him come out to install outlets throughout the yard to make decorating easier, as well as discussing putting some lights in on our porch overhang. We would ABSOLUTELY recommend Elkhorn and look forward to working with them again!

What really stood out was his attention to detail and the pride he takes in his work. He left everything clean and made sure everything was functioning perfectly before leaving.

It’s hard to find reliable, honest service these days, and this was truly a 5-star experience. Highly recommend to anyone needing plumbing work done right the first time.

reviews.author: Arnab “Ari” Sinha
reviews.text: Alex (Alejandro) was amazing to work with. He was patient, answered all of our questions, and did a thorough, high-quality job installing our first tankless water heater. The pricing was fair, and the overall experience exceeded our expectations. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sanjay Anavekar
reviews.text:
Mitko did a wonderful job installing new Navien NPE240A2
water heater. He made sure everything works as expected and did a detailed walk-through post installation.

Martin the owner, has built a very professional team of plumbers over the years. I highly recommend them as they always deliver good quality service.

reviews.author: Alex Kalpin
reviews.text:
Hristo Ivanov from Plumbing Care INC is absolutely outstanding. From start to finish, he was professional, punctual, and incredibly knowledgeable. He took the time to explain the issue clearly, offered practical solutions, and completed the job efficiently with great attention to detail.

What really sets Hristo apart is his honesty and workmanship — no shortcuts, no upselling, just quality work done right the first time. Everything was left clean and working perfectly.

If you’re looking for a reliable, skilled plumber you can actually trust, Hristo is the one. Highly recommended!

plumbers.name: Flow Pros Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2770 25th St N, St. Petersburg, FL 33713, USA

reviews.author: Carina Baker
reviews.text: Elijah was professional and thorough. I am pleased with the communication, friendliness, transparency, and effectiveness that came with this job. I had my main water shutoff valve replaced (kind of a big deal) and I appreciate Flow Pros working with me despite the preexisting material. The price was fair, scheduling prompt, and warranty great. They will not disappoint!

reviews.author: Chris Nesci
reviews.text:
Flo Pro Plumbing was fantastic from start to finish. We recently had a water softener installed, and our technician, Kahlil, did an outstanding job. He was punctual, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. Kahlil took the time to explain the system, answer all our questions, and make sure everything was installed perfectly. The quality of his work and his attention to detail were clear.
We’re extremely happy with the service and highly recommend Flo Pro Plumbing—and especially Kahlil—for anyone needing plumbing work done. Great experience all around!

reviews.author: Christopher Hudson
reviews.text: Fantastic response!  Had a complicated issue with an iron pipe.  I called, got an immediate response, got a window for the next morning, and the problem was completely resolved by the middle of the afternoon.  Jeffrey was efficient, explain the quote and what the work was going to entail, and kept his time estimate! He cleaned up nicely the area.  Very pleased.

reviews.author: Kristen Tompkins
reviews.text:
Alex came out. He was kind and friendly and reassuring.

Alex is an amazing job to show up. Get the work done within integrity and commitment.

I had a New water softener installed And I can’t wait to see how amazing my curly hair looks after today.

Hands-down would hire them again for all plumbing needs. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Kevin Palcsak
reviews.text:
Bradley found the issue and provided a clear quote for the work, and Alex took the lead in fixing it. They were both friendly and knowledgeable throughout the entire process. It turned out to be a larger project with some unexpected challenges thanks to our older home, but Alex always had solutions and still managed to stay within the original estimate.
He was consistently respectful of our space and offered helpful tips as we navigate being new homeowners. It’s never enjoyable having to spend a significant amount of money just to get your home working the way it should, so I hope I don’t need to see Alex or Brad again anytime soon—but if you do need work done, I would definitely recommend them.

plumbers.name: Upfront Plumbing Drains Heating and Air
plumbers.address: 8496 Harrison St STE 102, Sandy, UT 84047, USA

reviews.author: Keri
reviews.text: We called Upfront to install a microwave that vented to the outside.   They came first to see if what we were asking was feasible.  With a green light,  we went ahead and purchased a microwave that had convertible venting.  Then Jose and his assistant showed up the next day and installed our microwave.  They were professional and completed the job in a timely manner.  They answered questions I had about installation. They cleaned up afterwards and then showed me the work they had completed.  We felt that the price was great considering they would need to drill through stucco.  They also hauled away our old microwave.

reviews.author: Mariah Morris
reviews.text: I've worked with Mason a couple times and he's been amazing. This time, we had mold and had to completely demo our bathroom to remediate. Mason came and was very thorough when looking at everything which was really nice because he understood everything that needed to be done to help avoid any surprises that he could. He even offered 2 different options based on my budget and what needed done, and made sure I was aware of what each entailed and potential consequences and benefits for each option. I've really respected and appreciated the full disclosure and time he's taken with me each time he looks over everything and goes over options and estimates. Two other employees came and did the work to replace my main drain stack and some other piping. They even noticed that my ABS had a recall on it, which I had no idea about. They've all done great work, been very respectful, friendly, and kept me engaged throughout the whole process so nothing came as a surprise. I've had other companies try to tell me I need products that I don't really need and Upfront has never done that. The office employees are also very nice and it's super easy to schedule appointments and make payments, they'll even text you a link for you to pay. I feel like Upfront is very trustworthy and would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Bryan A
reviews.text:
I had a really good experience getting my furnace replaced by Upfront! Their estimate was fair, and they were extremely responsive, and they accommodated the replacement within 3 days.

My furnace was condemned on Friday morning. With temperatures beginning to drop next week and it being Christmas week, I scrambled to get my warranty company to take the job but their contractor was unresponsive during the weekend. Jakob coordinated with me throughout Saturday on getting the furnace replaced Monday. On Monday Justin and Austin finished the furnace replacement in less than 4 hours. Everything looks great and we don't have to worry about using space heaters to survive the cold that's coming. Thank you for doing a great job, being responsive, and working diligently to resolve a habitability issue quickly!

reviews.author: Tonia Eidson
reviews.text: Mark came out to give us a price to replace a 14 year old water heater for my in-laws after we woke up with no hot water. My husband and I come from the industry, but are from out of state and the company I would normally use was booked so I looked around for other local companies with good reviews and Upfront seemed like a great place. We were not disappointed! Mark was able to get the water heater temporarily fixed so that we would have hot water over night and then came back the following morning to replace it. He did an amazing job on the install! Everything was done to code and looks great! You can tell Mark really cares about his customers and takes pride in his work. The price was better than we expected! If you are looking for a local company that does great work at a decent price, these guys are great! Ask for Mark!

reviews.author: Austin Heywood
reviews.text: This is the best run company in utah - fair Price fantastic employees amazing management took such good care of my mom’s place and she’s 88 years old. I would use them all day and twice on Sunday. Thanks Ryan for your team.

plumbers.name: Plumbline Services
plumbers.address: 5980 W 59th Ave, Arvada, CO 80003, USA

reviews.author: Gray Cat
reviews.text: I believe I've left a sterling review for Plumbline in the past but here's another. I called them again for a mainline snake as a precaution as I do a few times a year. Again, great service and best price. The techs represent the company well. Sam who came out this time was no exception. He's a star! If you need their services don't hesitate to give them a call.

reviews.author: Kurt Raven
reviews.text: Couldn't be more happier with Plumbline services! We had a sewer line backup and Plumbline quickly assessed and mitigated the backup. Because our line is notorious for tree-root invasion and because our line is too long (132ft from toilet snake access) for the mechanical snake, we also had them put in an outdoor sewer line access and water jet the line thereafter. With this access in the future the mechanical snake can reach the end of the line. Everything about the experience was top notch: Communications before, during, and after each step, the quality and care of the work by those involved, the explanation of the sewer-line issues, mitigation, and the reason for each mitigation step - all spot on and reassuring! Prices are comparably reasonable and the service and explanations absolutely the best!

reviews.author: Anais Bovagnet
reviews.text: Plumbline Services was fantastic to work with. They connected my refrigerator to the water line quickly and efficiently, and the whole experience was smooth from start to finish. The team was incredibly kind and professional, and I was pleasantly surprised with the total cost. It’s rare to find a company that does great work and shows that level of honesty and care. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jeff Hinkle
reviews.text: Plumbline installed my HVAC system in my 30yo home a year and a half ago. Part of the program I signed up for was a yearly inspection, free for 4 years, to make sure the system will remain in top running order (you do know how much dust goes through the system, right?). Kelsey was my technician, and she was thorough, taking pics of the inside of the system, where dust begins to accumulate, and taking pressure readings of the air flow (I put filters over the cold air returns which did decrease the airflow somewhat, but not enough to damage the system). Kelsey will come back same time next year, and I like the service Plumbline offers.

reviews.author: Rhonda Slade
reviews.text: Dominique came to our house to fix our leaking toilet. We even showed up early which is awesome. VERY professional but very easy to talk to. He was able to fix our toilet, and when he was done, he asked if we needed anything else.

plumbers.name: Ernie's Plumbing Service, Inc.
plumbers.address: 1809 W Pioneer Pkwy, Arlington, TX 76013, USA

reviews.author: Mayan Boricua • 9 years ago
reviews.text: Austin was great. He was extremely knowledgeable and explained everything well. He stopped the leak under my sink. He replaced my clogged old faucet with a new modern design. I couldn't be happier; would reccomend to anybody!

reviews.author: Baxter Mullins
reviews.text:
After 25 years living in my phone, I found in December 2025 that both showers were plugged. I called Ernie’s, our long time plumbing company, to correct the problems. Ernie’s sent Anthony to check the issues with the plumbing. What was found can be classified as a “Nightmare before Christmas”. Scenario. Both sides of the plumbing had moved where the back of the house, the plumbing was much lower than the exit to the city system. Anthony allowed me to sit with him as we moved the camera from front to back showing up and down holding waste and several breaks plus tree root blockage. Another adventure!  Ernie’s replaced 115 ft of sewer lines on both major branches. Three 4’x4’ foot tunnels had to be excavated to do the job.  New sewer pipes were hung from the foundation to assure stability. The team did a good job, cleaning up the property. Anthony and the team did a great job.

Photos show new sewer pipes compared to original and the second shows front yard after the work is completed.

reviews.author: Nora Flores
reviews.text: Anthony did a great job in replacing our gas line.everything was as he said it would be . Very communicative in details. I definitely recommend him to everyone who is needing plumbing work .

reviews.author: T V
reviews.text:
Feb. 27, 2026 EDIT

Thank you Ernie for responding very quickly to my review and graciously offering to make things right. Someone was indeed sent out the very next day after we called to schedule. The entire process was very pleasant, from our scheduler to our plumber. Our Plumber was Scott and he informed us that the first person did not do the job correctly and used the wrong pipe for our hot & cold water line leaking in our ceiling space which is an enclosed area (he used something meant for an open area such as under the sink instead). He removed the sharkbite fittings and installed a new correct pex fitting for a more permanent repair solution, and soldered it together - which the other person also did not do, and fixed up everything for us during the same visit. He was very pleasant to deal with, educated us, and checked out a few other spots for us while here. We are thoroughly satisfied and will definitely recommend and continue to use Ernie's in the future. Thank you Scott and Ernie! :)

----------------------------------------------------
During 'Snowmageddon' we had a pipe burst through our ceiling and Ernie's came to give us an estimate and repair. The estimate was free as they advertised, repair seemed well, and the technician seemed nice and timely. It was suggested that we get the pipe repaired with PVC(?) I believe, which is a more flexible material and will expand better instead of repairing the pipe with a metal pipe, which our original pipe is. Since he was the expert, we went with what he suggested. All seemed well until the next Winter when we noticed a leak in the same exact spot which required us to open up our ceiling again. We called Ernie's again to come and give us another free estimate. This time, the person that came (different person) said that he'd have to charge us $200 just to go into the attic to even look. That seemed weird so we tried to go without and tried to patch it up. That spot has given us problems every Winter since. We will be doing a full repair with metal soon but the thought and trauma of that ill-repaired pipe during Winter every year sucks. It's completely fine throughout the year but during Winter is when it starts leaking again. Not enough to notice right away but eventually a stain appears in the same spot on our ceiling and every time, I'm reminded of what our expert recommended which turned out to not be a wise choice for our house. That and the random charge to go into the attic left a sour taste in our mouths. Thoroughly disappointed.

reviews.author: Larry Whitaker
reviews.text:
" Buyer Beware!! "
We had Ernie's Plumbing do  scan of the sewage pipes because of a recurring clog.
After the video scan that gave use the estimate here attached.
It was VERY expensive (as you can see) so I asked for a copy of the video we paid for and they said "we do not supply copies of our scans."
That was an immediate red flag!
I called another plumbing company (LD Plumbing) and they said they could do a scan of the system and would provide a video with an explanation of what was found.
They cane out and did the complete scan and said there was a MINOR problem, showed us the scan and said they could fix it for $450!!
They did fix it for $450 not $3000 OR MORE!!
(2) Response to the owner's (Ernie) reply.
(A) I spoke at length to Michael the plumber who did the scan and he said they do not supply copies of the scan to customers, I called the office number and they confirmed to me that they do not supply copies of the scan to customers.
(B) Justin did NOT stand over Michael and watch the scan.
(C) Michael the plumber went into a long description of how laborious the repair would be to fix the dual clean out and even sent me a picture of what they would use to do the repair (see the picture). That is what we were quoted $3000 to replace!
(D) LD Plumbing came out and did a full scan of the entire pipe system inside the home and outside. Came back and said there is only one minor problem which was that the dual clean out had slipped off  the pipe and provided us with a picture (see the picture) and the repair would be quick and they would do it for $450!
(E) They did the complete repair (NO BANDAID) using exactly the same item that Michael showed me in the picture he sent. (See the picture of the FULL REPAIR!)
Once again I say BUYER BEWARE!

plumbers.name: ACE Home Services (formerly Yavapai Plumbing & Heating)
plumbers.address: 1302 Rhinestone Dr, Prescott, AZ 86301, USA

reviews.author: C M
reviews.text:
HIRE THIS GUY FOR WORK - he’s gifted in the HVAC field.  Derek came in and tackled a serious issue we’ve had for about 6 years with our HVAC system. We had incorrect roof PVC pipe drainage (too long to get to the gutter) and an HVAC unit  leaning 1 1/2”  the wrong direction which caused water to back up towards the blower motor i.e towards the expensive pieces not away - then rust, corrode, and likely create something flowing thru the air that made me sick/congested from contaminated HVAC condensation.  He fixed the problem in a really creative way and didn’t give up until he had the HVAC system exactly balanced to a centered bubble. No one has even tried to tackle this before so we are super grateful that he came up with a simple solution.  Now our unit drains condensation correctly with a new, direct path to the gutter.  This now prevents mold growth.  The guy literally saved our unit from probably dying in a year to living a much longer life.

Hire him because he just removed six years of frustration that other technicians had no desire to tackle.  The pics are after showing his finished work on PVC pipes. The precious version ran to the far right along the wall then down to the gutter.

You’ll appreciate his easy-going personality, kindness, and attentiveness . When you find a good one like Derek, you’ll be a repeat customer who is confident in his work.  He didn’t just “do his job”. He cared, fixed the real problem and then sealed it so no rusty water anymore could enter the house.

Derek, a big thank you for being a hero to this family. 🇺🇸 Cecelia

reviews.author: Chase Rumfola
reviews.text:
Marcus and Danny with Ace home service services. Aka The dream team🫡🫡🫡

These guys came out, gave an estimate, then got the work done same day. Replaced an aging instant hot water heater with a slick new one and were professional with communication throughout the process.

reviews.author: Joe Ellerbrock
reviews.text: Highly professional, prompt, LICENSED. The person who scheduled my job was very nice. Mr. Pereira (plumber) was very knowledgeable and explained all my questions, with good recommendations. Very polite and respectful. However, these guys are not cheap. But you get what you pay for and and maybe more in the long run. I would recommend them as a reliable go-to shop when you're not real sure of your problem or solution.

reviews.author: luke hart
reviews.text: The whole process start to finish was great. I requested information from Home Depot and within 5 minutes I received a call back to schedule a free home estimate.  I had a sales rep at my house the next day and they didn’t try and over sell me. They installed everything very quickly and when they ran into problems they stayed with the job.  They were friendly, professional and proficient. I would highly recommend ACR home service to anyone.

reviews.author: Doreen Bender
reviews.text: Joe, Brad and Tom were at our house yesterday and installed a new heating/air conditioning unit and also cleaned out our ducts.  They worked in a very professional and friendly manner.  They cleaned up after themselves and explained how the new thermostat worked.  We are very happy with their expertise and getting the job done in a timely matter.  They cleaned up after themselves and left everything in order.  Thanks again, Don and Doreen Bender

plumbers.name: Blue Star Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 1185 Wheelis Rd, Wylie, TX 75098, USA

reviews.author: Keeley Walker
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Luis Diaz and Caleb came out to check on a leak and took preventative measures to make sure it wouldn’t turn into a bigger issue. They were super friendly, very polite, and easy to talk to. The work was done efficiently, everything was left very clean, and they explained what they were doing along the way. On top of that, the pricing was very reasonable. Great experience overall — I’d definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Cat Mobile
reviews.text: I wish I had the words to extol the virtues Blue Star Plumbing. As we know, the weather hasn’t been great for the last week. Our water heater decided it was having none of it. We called a few plumbing co and the earliest they could come is Saturday (today is Thursday and we’d been w/o hot water since Monday night / Tuesday). A friend of ours recommended Blue Star Plumbing and what wonderful and kind people! I am so grateful to them. They were nice, understanding and very professional… called yesterday evening and they were here first thing this morning with the correct parts and fixed us right up! I just took the longest, hottest shower of my life thanks to them 😁 We will definitely use them again and I highly recommend them to everyone.

reviews.author: Rob R
reviews.text:
Called a few plumbers and these guys. Blue Star was one of the few that didn't have a stupid "pay up front" and "sorry, I can't quote prices over the phone".
I needed some quarter turns put in and it's pretty simple (my body doesn't let me do stuff like that anymore so I needed someone to do it.)
These guys were great on every front!
Casual and professional, courteous and fair.
I would absolutely use them again!

reviews.author: Tina Tallant
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Blue Star plumbing service repairing my leak in the yard. From the start, Shannon was sweet and scheduled me right away. The technician Ski and Justin arrived right on time and was very polite and professional throughout the visit. It’s refreshing to deal with a company that values both quality and customer service.  Highly recommend Blue Star and Ski as your tech.

reviews.author: Wyld Gypsy
reviews.text:
Josh from Blue Star Plumbing was absolutely outstanding! He came out for my yearly inspection and took the time to check everything thoroughly. He made me feel incredibly comfortable and confident going into the winter season. He also shared helpful tips on how to prepare even better.

Josh was friendly, professional, and genuinely kind. His attention to detail and care truly stood out, and even my pups adored him! I couldn’t recommend him or Blue Star Plumbing more highly.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing, Drain, Septic, & Water Restoration Service
plumbers.address: 7001 Wooster Pike, Medina, OH 44256, USA

reviews.author: Ato kad
reviews.text:
I needed a gas valve, about 3 inches of line, a line cap, a T, and a union replaced to get our heat turned back on. I explained that money was tight, but I was still quoted nearly $1,000 for about $60 worth of parts, plus almost $500 for a leak test just to verify the work.

Afterward, I called another company, and they only charge $50 for the leak test and $150 for the entire repair. There was nowhere near 10 feet of repairs needed—the plumber who actually fixed it used penetrating spray and removed the old parts easily.

*Update*
After speaking with the manager at Roto-Rooter, I was told they plan to adjust their leak-testing prices. They also assured me that the estimate I received represented the absolute worst-case scenario, and that the actual price could end up being lower.

reviews.author: audin1027
reviews.text:
I had John M come out and replaced a plastic hot water line from the basement to the dishwasher that had broken, spewing water everywhere at 5am!!. Found their 24hr service. Called at 7am and he was here around 10:10. Called to let me know he was on his way, quoted a price before doing the work, polite professional, awesome plumbing experience. (he just made me feel he cared and put me at ease) Guess who is coming out to replace my dishwasher next week?!?! I scheduled him immediately. Highly recommend their services. Job well done!!

12/1/26 Had John back out and installed a new dish washer. Another great job. Reasonably priced and I got an additional $25 off with a coupon he left me the last time. Job well done!! I'd give a 10 star if I could!!

reviews.author: Timothy Slama
reviews.text: Chris came out and did an excellent job. Very nice guy. Very nice to my mom. He was able to joke around a little bit. And definitely did a good job and made us feel very comfortable. I was going to call anyhow and let you know. I'm in the trades and it's always nice when someone lets you know they do a good job. And he did. Thanks chris + Merry Christmas to Roto-Rooter LOL 🙂 happy New Year!

reviews.author: Tyler Hardy
reviews.text: I had an old sump pump that needed replaced and Joe was fantastic. He explained everything, showed me how everything works, and ensured the job was done right. Now I have peace of mind that my basement will continue to be protected and fine!

reviews.author: Michelle Bridenthal
reviews.text: Thank you to the team deployed to repair  a main water leak in my home, they were awesome in communicating the problem and had it diagnosed and repaired quickly.  they were very knowledgeable and caring through the process.  would highly recommend them.  Thank you team Roto!!

plumbers.name: High 5 Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric
plumbers.address: 15710 W Colfax Ave, Golden, CO 80401, USA

reviews.author: D C
reviews.text: Leo and Daniel were great! They did a great job replacing my pipes and fixing some issues with my hot water heater. They were in and out, but made sure everything was corrected before leaving. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Bryan McBride
reviews.text: I recently had my water heater replaced by High 5 Plumbing, And I couldn’t be more impressed with their professional service from beginning to end. This marks, my second experience with the company, and they’ve consistently exceeded my expectations. José Cuevas Arrived promptly for the initial inspection and immediately demonstrated the friendly professionalism that sets this company apart. While delivering the unfortunate news that I needed a complete unit replacement, Jose. Took the time to thoroughly explain all available options and walked me through the entire process. His clear communication made what could have been a stressful situation more manageable. That same afternoon,Jesus Pacheco And his trainee arrived for the installation. Their technical expertise was evident as they Master fully removed the old water heater and installed the new unit with remarkable efficiency. The quality of their workmanship was impressive, and they maintained a clean, organized workspace throughout the process. Haven’t used High 5 Twice now, I can confidently say that their consistent reliability keeps me coming back. Every team member I’ve encountered has been professional, competent, and genuinely friendly. The quality of service is so dependable that I’ve decided to use them exclusively for all future, plumbing and electric I was so satisfied with their service that I purchased their membership program. The included services provide excellent value and peace of mind, making the investment completely worthwhile for ongoing home maintenance needs. And for any baseball fans out there, the fact that their business cards are baseball cards is both hilarious and genius!

reviews.author: Rachel Choe
reviews.text: High Five Plumbing is always the first company I contact when I have plumbing issues. They respond quickly and do their best to accommodate my schedule. They are professional and know exactly what needs to be done. I will continue to use them for any future plumbing needs. They installed a water softener system and a sump pump in our home, and everything is working great.

reviews.author: Harvey Newman
reviews.text:
Had a weird short in our electrical gfi. The technicians came out immediately. They were patient, thorough and found the short in a reasonable period of time. Tested everything.
Very professional and fair in the pricing for their time. We highly recommend High 5 for electrical and plumbing.

reviews.author: Curt Frisch
reviews.text: Came back from a walk at noon today to no hot water and a leaky, busted water heater. My first call was to High 5. After experiencing a pretty impressive AI call center, they reached out right away to confirm my appt. Jose arrived around 330 and quickly diagnosed the issue and Daniel showed up about 30-40 min later to start the work. He ran into issues with my gas pipes and called in Evan for backup, they had the water heater replacement job wrapped up in a few hours. Thanks to Jose, Daniel, and Evan,  we have hot water going into a bitter cold weekend. Everyone I've ever interacted with at High 5 has been so kind and helpful. Great company who does great work. I will absolutely be calling them anytime I need plumbing/hvac services. Great job, team. Keep it up!

plumbers.name: Plumb Works Inc.
plumbers.address: 3116 Chestnut Dr #101, Atlanta, GA 30340, USA

reviews.author: Sadie B
reviews.text:
Krum is the best! He came out for my home inspection during due diligence and came back out to provide the service. This was a full days of work with a partner. They moved my water shut off out of crawl space, reworked my pipes for crawl space access, reworked pipes of of a leaking sink with missing parts, and switched my water temp faucet things (because it’s hot on left and cold on right), and definitely more. (The hole was mistakenly patched up by a separate handy man, thus their removal.)

AND Krum got my Dekalb plumbing certificate delivered to my email within a few hours. While I don’t know much about plumbing, I can see the new pipes have been installed sooo cleanly, very satisfying.

I mostly appreciate their empathy and kindness, because I was kinda *losing my mind* this morning with the general cost of homeownership. 🤣

reviews.author: CK Tan
reviews.text: I was really impressed with Spencer service. He sent the quote right after the visit and offer competitive and reasonable price. We have decided to go with Plumb Works. I was also surprised that he was able to start work after couple day. Well done and will do business again. Thank you again for the great work.

reviews.author: Aaron Ezell
reviews.text: Just bought a house that needed a new sewer line, and went with Plumb Works after getting a few quotes because of their attention to detail, friendly customer service, willingness to work within our budget, and extended warranty. The work included running a trench and cutting out part of the driveway, which they returned to good condition when finished. I would recommend them for any job.

reviews.author: Dina Molaison
reviews.text: From the initial call to schedule a repair to the actual service, the entire experience was top-notch. We had a plumbing emergency, and Ray got a plumber out to our home in about an hour and a half. Mr. Krum did an excellent job, was very detailed and explained the entire problem and process. The price was fair and work was high-quality. I appreciate the after-service emails documenting the repair process, faulty parts and replacement parts. Well done!

reviews.author: Justin Schaeffer
reviews.text: Wow. I'm not joking...I told my wife I had goosebumps after I got off the phone with Andrew, the technician that fixed several gas leaks and an improperly vented water heater for a blind, senior neighbor here in Kirkwood. It's SO nice to deal with a friendly, confident, competent, technician who genuinely cares and is trying to help you get the best value for your (non-profit's) money while doing the highest quality work. I LOVED my experience from calling to schedule the appointment to the quickly resolved gas leak for my senior neighbor. Great company, great customers service, great technicians.

plumbers.name: Torch Plumbing, Heating, and Cooling
plumbers.address: 107 W 4th Ave, Owasso, OK 74055, USA

reviews.author: Daniel & Stephen Harrell
reviews.text: We had Torch come out and replace a shower valve assembly for one of our projects. They did a fabulous job. I’m a general contractor and they worked with me no problem. Trey was super friendly and professional, his work was done very quickly and properly. We will definitely use them again and I refer them to everyone!

reviews.author: Renata Jump
reviews.text: Torch is the best!!! I have used them over the past three years and could not ask for a better service company for my plumbing and heating/cooling needs. What makes them so special is their personnel. I have never called Torch and got an answering machine. reviews.author: Rachel Lane
reviews.text:
After our water heater unexpectedly failed, we spent an entire weekend trying to fix it ourselves, only to realize it was beyond repair. By Monday, after three days without water and a broken cold water inlet on top of it, we were completely overwhelmed. The plumber we’d used before couldn’t come until the next day, and we simply couldn’t go another day without water.

We called at least 10 plumbing companies, and that’s when Tony with Public Service Plumbers came to the rescue. He made an after-hours visit, showed up promptly, and immediately put us at ease. Tony was professional, courteous, and communicated everything clearly. He explained exactly what needed to be done, didn’t try to upsell anything unnecessary, and the pricing felt completely fair.

In less than two hours, we had water again.

Tony truly turned a stressful situation into a great experience. We highly recommend him and Public Service Plumbers, they’ve earned our business for life.

reviews.author: Peter Grant
reviews.text:
I called Roto-Rooter on a recent Sunday as a main sewer line backup was going to wreck our Monday morning, getting everyone out of the house for school and work. No additional fee for a Sunday, no diagnostic fee, no roll charge. Awesome!

Good communication from dispatch and the truck arrived in the designated window. Marcus and Kaiden were amazing. They gave me the price up front and got right to work. There were some challenges clearing the line, which is always a worry when your house is nearly 100 years old with the original clay main line.

A field manager with a camera was summoned and he arrived promptly. With some additional info on the clog from the camera, they got back after it, working it from two separate exterior clean outs. When the clog cleared they were as excited as I was!

The team was thorough and stayed until the job was done right, including cleaning up after themselves. They even ran my kitchen drain for no additional charge because they wanted me to be happy and satisfied. I already was, but that was the cherry on top. I paid the originally quoted price.

I will definitely use Rotor-Rooter again when the need arises. I highly recommend them.
