reviews.author: Joseph Lee
reviews.text:
Honestly, I’d give 10 stars.
I had been without water since yesterday, and at first, I brushed it off, thinking the nearby construction was the cause. But when the faucets were still dry this morning, worry started to creep in. After calling the water utility and hearing that the problem was on our end, I spent a long time searching for the leak—finally finding water seeping out near the meter.
I reached out to Roto-Rooter, and that’s when Riley arrived. He stepped out of the truck with a warm, genuine smile that immediately eased my stress. In the freezing cold, he knelt down and dug through the ground with his hands, determined to find the source of the problem. He went out of his way to get rust‑resistant parts so the repair would last, and he worked with such care and integrity that it honestly moved me.
He didn’t leave until everything was fully restored, checking and rechecking to make sure the water was flowing properly again. He even gave us a discount—something he didn’t have to do but did anyway. Before he left, he wished us a blessed day, and it felt sincere.
Thanks to Riley, we finally have water again. After a stressful, uncomfortable day, his kindness and professionalism turned everything around. If five stars is the limit, then he deserves double.

reviews.author: verna rizvi
reviews.text: Great service! When I called Roto Rooter I was told they had someone close by and they would contact him and send him over.   Cole arrived quickly and went right to work figuring out what was causing the backup in my sink. He did a great job getting to the cause of my problem and cleaning out the pipes. Very pleased with the professionalism shown by the service man Cole and the quality of his work.

reviews.author: D.T.
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Roto Rooter today. Technician Markues Montalvo was friendly, knowledgeable, and right on time. He was honest about the situation, very thorough with the inspection, and explained everything clearly. I really appreciated that there was no charge just to come out and inspect. It’s hard to find service like this anymore — highly recommend!

reviews.author: Emily Pauli
reviews.text: Roto Rooter did an excellent job!  They were professional and took time to explain their findings and recommendations. The were timely, worked efficiently, and cleaned up when finished.   I’ve used them in the past and will do so again if needed.

reviews.author: Kristie Scheuer
reviews.text: Roto Rooter responded to our request for service, septic tank service, in a very timely and professional manner.  We called on Friday night and the service was performed on a Saturday which was extremely helpful for our situation.  The technician, Aye, was very knowledgeable, efficient and personable. I would definitely use Roto Rooter again for my plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Elie's Plumbing, Sewer & Drain
plumbers.address: 3541 Severn Rd, Cleveland Heights, OH 44118, USA

reviews.author: Sonya Thomas
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of meeting two plumbing professionals when my hot water tank was leaking. Alphonse and Chris. They were courteous, on-time and prepared for what was needed. I needed a new tank…and not long comes another technician with the tank!  They were all so pleasant and got that tank up quick too!  I would definitely recommend Elie’s Plumbing LLC. To the owner of the company Avi, you have some good guys working for you..I’m sure you appreciate all the hard work they do. Happy staff, Happy Life!

reviews.author: Julianne Kirby
reviews.text: Laurie in the office was great. She quickly got us in the schedule the same day for service after a miscommunication. She was able to get a tech on site within a few hours. The tech Colin was very personable, professional and took care of the clogged drains. Would recommend them for anyone that wants a professional experience from the point of phone call to the completion of the work.

reviews.author: Robert “Bob” Jones
reviews.text:
The crew from Elie’s was simply great.  Even with cold snowy day the arrived promptly and got to work replacing our hot water tank.  The installation was well done very in excellent professional manner.  Good price, good product selection.  Clean up was great.
Nice professional folks very friendly.

reviews.author: winifred weizer
reviews.text: Switched out the shower head to a hose and snaked the drain. Came out very next day after call (we requested, they could have done same day) and were informative, friendly and left the work area very clean. Our previous plumber retired, am grateful to have a new one I can trust. Rates good for the current going rates in the area.

reviews.author: Ron Katz
reviews.text: They came in with a two man crew ready to go to work. Extremely professional and very caring crew. They did a magnificent job, no problems whatsoever, whatever they did with their equipment work well as did they. I am more than just satisfied and would certainly refer and recommend them in the future for future work! I hope I don’t need anybody again, but if I did or do, I would certainly call Ellie Plumbing,.! Thank you again Ellie Plumbing for a job well done!😊

plumbers.name: ARS / Rescue Rooter
plumbers.address: 4505 Industrial Pkwy, Cleveland, OH 44135, USA

reviews.author: Hopeless Crusader
reviews.text: Company offered $75 mainline clear out, technician claimed it wasn’t the mainline but the kitchen line and it would be $300. I was experiencing water backup on my floor drain whenever I washed clothes, which is 3ft of straight pipe from the kitchen line, technician preformed no equipment diagnostic besides running my water. My floor drain continued to overflow until the tech snaked the line well past the 3ft from the access point and said floor drain. The obstruction was clearly beyond the 3ft of pipe in between and was a mainline issue.

reviews.author: linda toppins
reviews.text:
They gave me five star treatment. They were supposed to call before they came but they didn't! Shook me out of bed at 8:35 a.m!
They were done in two and a half hours. Professional and very pleased with the work. They were courteous, friendly informative. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Denny Walsh
reviews.text: Sam Yeaman was wonderful from start to finish.  He assessed the situation, explained everything, reached out to other ARS associates as needed.  Within a few hours, all systems were "go" again.  This was our 2nd experience with ARS and we would use them again and recommend them to family and friends.  Our thanks to Sam and your entire crew for their courtesy, expertise and professionalism.

reviews.author: Kimberly Williams
reviews.text:
First guy advised he could snake it but no one could flush it because of the temperature. We were desperate as we couldn't use water without it backing up.
First guy couldn't clear the clog so we had to have a crew come out to flush it. They made two trips in cold weather to make sure we could use water. What was advertised as $79 cost $1250.
Workers were friendly.

reviews.author: Derrick
reviews.text: I’m so happy to have finally found an honest and professional plumbing company. Jace and Mike did an awesome job. They went above and beyond all while explaining to me the details of the repairs. The work was completed quick and done right the first time. I’ve already discussed future install projects with them. I will be recommending them to my family and friends for any future work.

plumbers.name: Armstrong Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 2551 Albatross Wy, Sacramento, CA 95815, USA

reviews.author: Jateen Jivan
reviews.text: Mo, Fred and team did an excellent job on a spot repair of my sewer line. They were very courteous, straightforward and honest. Thanks again fellas, you were spot on and with the concrete work they took their time on it, leaving a very clean final product. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Tanya Scott
reviews.text:
I called Armstrong Plumbing after another company failed to resolve a main line backup in my home. Carlos arrived, listened carefully, and immediately understood the layout of my older 1954 home. He used the correct cleanout (the kitchen cleanout), cleared the clog quickly, and then ran a camera inspection to confirm everything was flowing properly.
He explained that my home was originally built with only one cleanout and that there was no second cleanout under the patio, which contradicted what I had been told earlier. He also confirmed there was no pipe damage and no tree root intrusion on my property. His knowledge of older homes was obvious, and he took the time to show me the camera footage and explain what I was seeing.
Carlos was professional, honest, and extremely thorough. I finally felt like I was getting accurate information. I highly recommend Armstrong Plumbing, especially for older homes.

reviews.author: Letisha Wilson
reviews.text: I called Armstrong this morning based on a referral from another client. When I called and explained my issue they were quick to respond and assure they could assist. A tech was here within the hour. He looked at my sewer backup at the main line and advised this would be easy fix. Just needed a few mins. Of course the prior day another company came and advised I would need an expensive two way clean out. Carlos was able to get everything cleared. Confirmed toilets were flushing. Not only did this save me a bunch of money but it as handled quickly. I needed working bathrooms with my elderly mother living with me. I’d highly recommend Armstrong to others and keeping them saved for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Paul VanderKlay
reviews.text: Carlos was outstanding! 4th guy to run a camera through my sewer line first guy to spot two cleanouts that no one knew about. Dug up one of them with his partner. This was all on a visit to give us a quote. Very impressed.

reviews.author: Gisele Geiger
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Armstrong. Peter was able to troubleshoot the issue with our shower diverter and order the part from Germany. He was promptly scheduled to perform the repairs as soon as the part came in and he quickly finished the installation. We’ll definitely use Armstrong in the future to support our plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Andersen Plumbing, Heating and AC Repair
plumbers.address: 700 Terry Ave, Aurora, IL 60506, USA

reviews.author: Anthony DiAngelo
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Joe and the Anderson team. Joe replaced our sump pump and was outstanding to work with. He took the time to educate us, clearly laid out all of our options, and explained the trade-offs so we could make an informed decision—no pressure, just solid guidance. The quality of the work was excellent.

We’ve had Anderson out to our house multiple times over the past few months for different issues, and each experience has been consistently superb. Professional, knowledgeable, and reliable service every time. We wouldn’t hesitate to call Joe or Anderson again.

reviews.author: Mariah Wright
reviews.text: Nate & Zach were great! They were on time, very polite and very knowledgeable. Immediately was able to identify the issue and provide a solution. Walked me through everything in a way I understood. Great service all around! “Im just a girl” lol and I was able to explain the issue no problem to my husband as well. 10/10!!

reviews.author: Jeanette Hoffman
reviews.text: Jon and Cesar came out to diagnose a noise I heard coming from the furnace. They arrived quickly, were polite and professional and did a thorough inspection of the entire furnace. They were able to figure out the issue and discussed with me the other things they saw that looked like they should be addressed to keep the furnace running smoothly. They offered me different options on what to repair urgently and what should be addressed but could wait a bit longer. They were not pushy at all and explained everything thoroughly while showing me pictures of what they were seeing. I continue to use Anderson because every time I’ve needed them this is the same reliable and professional service I receive.

reviews.author: Max
reviews.text:
I recently had a bathtub faucet installed by Andersen, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Evan and Michelle were professional, courteous, and clearly knew what they were doing. They took the time to make sure everything was installed properly and working perfectly before they left.

Their workmanship was clean and precise, and they made sure the area was spotless when the job was finished. It’s clear they take pride in the quality of their work. I would definitely recommend this company to anyone looking for reliable and professional plumbing services.

reviews.author: Andre Porche
reviews.text:
We had an outstanding experience working with Joe Harkins. From the moment he arrived, he demonstrated a high level of professionalism, knowledge, and attention to detail. He took the time to thoroughly assess our home and carefully identify the source of the leak, explaining each step of the process in a clear and reassuring manner.
Joe truly went above and beyond to ensure we felt confident that the issue was properly diagnosed and that our system was secure. His expertise and patience gave us peace of mind during what could have been a very stressful situation.
In addition, he provided thoughtful recommendations for trusted services that could assist with the necessary repairs. That extra level of guidance showed that he genuinely cares about his clients and the long-term well-being of their homes.
We highly recommend Joe Harkins to anyone in need of a knowledgeable, dependable, and customer-focused professional.

plumbers.name: Plumb Crazy Plumbing
plumbers.address: 308 W Britton Rd, Oklahoma City, OK 73114, USA

reviews.author: Dale C Courtney JR
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Plumb Crazy Plumbing. The technician, Tim, was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. He arrived on time, quickly diagnosed the issue, and completed the work without any unnecessary delays. Everything was explained clearly, and the quality of his work was excellent. It’s clear he takes pride in what he does. I really appreciated how smooth and stress-free the whole process was. I would absolutely recommend Plumb Crazy Plumbing and would be happy to have Tim back for any future work!

reviews.author: Ramona Campos
reviews.text: Happy with service from this company. Able to schedule estimate online and got a confirmation of appt within the hour. Day of appointment, I received a text 30 minutes prior to arrive and arrived within the requested time frame. Jesse did a great job of explaining the process, giving me the quote and told me it was good for 30 days. After speaking to my daughter, we decided to rescheduled for actual appointment. Again online and quick response from company to confirm. The same tech Jesse came out and quickly completed the job within the hour. Fair pricing, within what I was expecting for pay for the job. (Single Bibb Replacement- should cost anywhere from $300-400; paid $375 for service). Overall, very pleased with service and will call again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Dina
reviews.text: I had a pipe burst under my house when temperatures dropped below zero, and Plumb Crazy was amazing. They sent a plumber within two hours, and he was wonderful, efficient, thorough, and clearly knew what he was doing. There was no dragging out the job or padding the bill, which I truly appreciated. Great service, honest pricing, and fast response. I will 100% use them again and recommend them to anyone needing a plumber.

reviews.author: Miranda Mohi
reviews.text: We have used Plumb Crazy the last 20 years, since 2006. We have had some big and small jobs to complete and they do a great job for a fair price. They are always polite and prompt, and I feel they communicate with us well about appointments! Thank you!

reviews.author: Michael Stephanic
reviews.text:
ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC

The late January winter storm Fern wreaked havoc on plumbing in and around Oklahoma. Even while leaving our hot and cold water faucets dribble to prevent freezing, we ended up with a cracked hot water pipe underneath the house. I called Plumb Crazy Plumbing, figuring I wouldn’t get a tech out for days in this weather and with so many others dealing with broken pipes. Instead, Plumb Crazy had a technician at our house within the hour.

My tech, Kevin arrived with his assistant and they checked out the damage, gave me a quote, and had the problem fixed in less than an hour. They were extremely friendly, polite, professional and well-trained. The price was great. The service was prompt and efficient. The warranty was very reasonable and totally unexpected. And the follow-up from Plumb Crazy was above and beyond what I’ve had from other plumbers. I highly recommend Plumb Crazy Plumbing for all your plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Alco Air
plumbers.address: 4412 US-259, Longview, TX 75605, USA

reviews.author: Paula Cromwell
reviews.text:
Danny from Alco came out yesterday to perform our semi annual HVAC maintenance. He did a great job! He is courteous, knowledgeable and professional. He found a few items we need to address over the next few months to prepare for this summer’s heat.

He carefully explained what repairs need to be done showed us where these problems existed. He also gave us a couple of options for moving forward. The estimates were thoroughly explained. We feel more than comfortable with his recommendations.

reviews.author: Tasha Lewis
reviews.text: Had an issue with my unit and they came right out, blessed us to be back running same day. Justin was quick and helpful to our family. Highly recommend and will use in the future

reviews.author: Millie McWilliams
reviews.text: Professional, honest, and efficient. We couldn’t be happier with their work! They took time to find answers to all of the problems we were having due to another company’s improper installation. They had everything fixed the next day. The communication was excellent from start to finish and everyone was extremely nice! We would absolutely recommend Alco to anyone needing HVAC work.

reviews.author: Claude Hammond
reviews.text: The last three times I got an ALCO estimate to do work, I got a second opinion. EVERY TIME, the second opinion I got told me the problem was much less $$$ than what ALCO recommended. I went with the second opinion (different companies) every time. TOTAL SAVINGS BY NOT GOING WITH ALCO: $14,000. It seems that ever since this company's merger or acquisition with McWilliams went through, along with a name-change,  -- and then they changed their name back to ALCO again -- they give super-expensive estimates. The final straw for me came after ALCO serviced our AC. Shortly after, all the coolant drained out of the unit. I called someone else, and the new guy showed me that a bottle cap had been used to plug up the AC unit. So I called ALCO -- and it took them 3 weeks to get back with me -- and they said I couldn't prove it was their fault.  That's it. I'm not using ALCO.

reviews.author: Noah Deering
reviews.text:
Rats had destroyed our ducts, so Alco came out and replaced them and the vents, and added a new one in an unvented bathroom. Overall, they were pretty professional and efficient, but there were a couple of annoying things:
- The workers left multiple dirty work shirts laying around on my property.
- The workers used my rented dumpster to dump everything, which was fine, but had I not had it, would they have left the debris in my yard? They had no way of hauling anything away.
- The vents installed were mostly done horribly, leaving holes, scratches, debris and messy looks afterwards.
- We had to clean up a lot ourselves because a mess was left under vents and in the yard.

I appreciate their hard work, but for $11k, I expected not to have to patch vents myself, be in charge of removing debris and having to pick up dirty clothes. Pretty unprofessional of Alco, and I would only recommend them if you tell them upfront that's not acceptable.

plumbers.name: Catons Plumbing, Drains & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 801 Geipe Rd, Catonsville, MD 21228, USA

reviews.author: Javon Cooper
reviews.text:
Ramon is hands down one of the best plumbers I’ve dealt with. He came in and fixed a problem that multiple other plumbers couldn’t figure out. No hesitation, no guessing, he got right to work and handled it.

The service was fast, efficient, and professional from start to finish. You can tell he knows exactly what he’s doing. I’m beyond satisfied with the results and will definitely be calling him again if I ever need plumbing work done.

Highly recommend Ramon if you want the job done right the first time. 💯

reviews.author: K Brooks
reviews.text:
My initial call to Catons was great.  Very friendly scheduling.  They provided me an estimated time for the plumber to arrive.

Curtis, a field supervisor, arrived a short time later to preview the issue.  He was friendly and professional.

The plumber, Jason, arrived some time after.  He was very friendly.  He assessed the issue and exhibited problem solving on the spot since the house is old and he had to figure out the best way to perform the repair. He explained what he was doing.  Jason got the job done in a very acceptable period of time and he didn't seem to mind me hanging over his shoulder.  He removed the ancient inoperable water meter which is pretty cool to look at.  I was very pleased with the service and charge.

There was some residual water on the repair the next day even after wiping, but I gave it a couple days to insure I wouldn't need to call them back.  All is very good.

Having not had to ever call a plumber, this was a great first experience.  There was a lot of anxiety on my part leading up to the repair.  The entire process is very efficient and they will let you know when the plumber is on their way.   Thanks, Catons.

reviews.author: Courtney Moore
reviews.text: Highly recommended. When another plumbing company cancelled on me last minute, Caton’s was able to send someone same day. They arrived on time after calling to confirm they were on the way. Henry and his associate were very friendly, respectful and explained things in a way I was able to understand. Will definitely be my first call in the future when another plumbing issue arises.

reviews.author: Ryan Johnson
reviews.text: On incredibly short notice, Caton was able to schedule a call and come out later in the evening. I had a bad leak in the kitchen sink. Henry came out and assessed the problem instantly and gave me all available options. He thoroughly informed me. He was incredibly respectful, professional, and knowledgeable. Really glad they were able to assist me. He came out and followed up with the perfect install. Grateful to have had him!

reviews.author: Vicki Clifton
reviews.text: Catons Plumbing was the only emergency plumbing company that was able to immediately come address our problem late at night. From the initial plumbing professional, Derrick, to the field representative Curtis, Tuesday, and the excavation crew, everyone was extremely kind, professional, and talked us through each step and explained all pricing breakdowns. They provided all images/pics/documents needed for our insurance. At the end of our experience, it was as though we were all family. I will definitely call on Catons again for all of our plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Chen Plumbing
plumbers.address: 6399 Jimmy Carter Blvd Suite 100B, Norcross, GA 30071, USA

reviews.author: Darrell Short
reviews.text: Shane from Chen Plumbing was an absolute pleasure to work with. The work was A+ class quality and completed in a timely manner. Unlike some professionals, Shane had all the necessary supplies on the Van, gave the estimate and did all the work same day! Who can give deliverables better than that!🤯 Thank you again Shane, and thank you also Chen Plumbing

reviews.author: ShadowX57
reviews.text:
Tim and Oto from Chen Plumbing did a great job handling a leaking expansion tank and a high water pressure issue at my home. They clearly explained that my pressure was way too high (around 120 PSI), which caused the expansion tank to fail.

Instead of trying to upsell a new water heater, they focused on fixing the real problem by replacing the pressure reducing valve and the expansion tank, then setting everything to a safe pressure.

The work was professional, clean, and well explained. I appreciated that they took the time to answer questions and didn’t push unnecessary repairs.

If you’re looking for honest, knowledgeable plumbers who do the job right, Tim and Oto are a solid team. I’d definitely use Chen Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Collin Rooney
reviews.text:
Dawson from Chen Plumbing came out and gave us a free estimate for replacing our electric water heater and then came back out to handle the installation. The overall experience was great- the Chen team was communicative, friendly and thorough.

Dawson was friendly, welcomed questions and the installation was quick and easy. Highly recommend Dawson and Chen Plumbing.

reviews.author: Kate E
reviews.text:
We were introduced to Chen Plumbing last year after our water meter was damaged by a delivery truck. After working with them, we were very impressed and reached out again for additional services. From scheduling to the on-site team, everyone is courteous, hardworking, honest, and kind. Their pricing is fair and clearly explained, and they take the time to walk you through each line item. They also explain the work as they go and answer questions patiently and thoroughly.

We worked with Shawn and Shane, and they were outstanding. I felt completely at ease and confident in their work. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Dorothy Sheffield
reviews.text:
He explained everything thoroughly and helped us understand exactly what was going on and how he would repair it. Polite, friendly.

Update: I wanted to make sure I mentioned our plumber by name: Braulio and his apprentice (sorry, I forgot his name). They finished quickly and spent time afterwards basically helping me understand the bigger picture of how our plumbing worked. No man-spraining, just real talk. I will NEVER use anyone else.

reviews.author: JBA from South Carolina
reviews.text: Showed up on time. Did the inspection. Was very nice, and professional. I’d highly recommend! Note - Chisholm Heat and Air installed a new system in our house a couple years ago. They are FANTASTIC! Their prices were better, and they did a great job. Chisholm is still locally owned. Some of the other companies in the area (5*) are now owned by a big corp in FLA… beware of those out of state owned companies - keep it local. You’ll be better off.

reviews.author: Franklin Steele
reviews.text: Chisholm came out this afternoon for our spring heat pump maintenance. Bear, our technician, was very personable and professional. He was very attentive to my concerns. He presented all options from repair to replacement. If I could describe Bear in one word I would say honest. I highly recommend him and Chisholm.

reviews.author: Allan Forrest
reviews.text: Chris from Chisholm was on time and very knowledgeable. As a homeowner the hard part is the unknown of the scope of work. He laid it out plainly and in a way that I could understand. He then followed up with doing exactly what he said he was going to do (which is rare these days). He answered question after question with patience and the price he gave was the price we paid. There were no surprises! Overall my experience with everyone from Chisholm was professional and friendly. Call them if you need honesty and follow through. I will use them for all future needs.

reviews.author: Miquel Dingle Sr
reviews.text: Our technician Jordan Lee came in early in the morning with a smile that definitely helps. He was very detailed patient and answered all of our questions. Young man is smart and again, very detailed. I appreciate his honesty and willingness to help and give us a better understanding of what our situation was a pleasure to meet a pleasure to talk to.

reviews.author: Faye Dirton
reviews.text:
Excellent Experience!
Jonathan was very efficient.   Came out within an hour after service call.  Very polite and friendly. Answered questions pertaining to plumbing job.
Will use again.
Faye Dirton

plumbers.name: Michael & Son Services

reviews.author: Steve M
reviews.text:
Superb Service!
Roberto did an outstanding job installing my new water heater. He arrived on time, worked efficiently, and clearly explained everything along the way. His attention to detail and professionalism stood out—everything was done neatly, and he made sure the system was running perfectly before leaving. It’s rare to find someone this thorough and courteous. Highly recommend Roberto for any installation work!

reviews.author: Richard Smiechowski
reviews.text: George did an excellent job! He arrived promptly on time, and detailed, (very thoroughly), his objective for the day. His primary purpose was to advise us on the condition of our 15 year old sump pump. George systematically lined out good, better, best scenario’s, and we decided to go with the best option, as a replacement. George demonstrated excellent communication skills, by delegating necessary electrical wiring to his colleague, Rayyan who returned to complete the electrical connections needed to finish the sump pump project. Very impressive display of teamwork. Overall, we’re very happy with the professionaly done work performed today, and look forward to doing more business with Michael and Son.

reviews.author: Charly Camacho
reviews.text: Outstanding service from Michael & Sons technician Donald Monroe! Donald arrived on time, was professional, friendly, and extremely knowledgeable. He quickly diagnosed the issue and unclogged our drain efficiently, making sure everything was working perfectly before he left. He explained what caused the problem and gave helpful tips to prevent it from happening again. The entire process was smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend Michael & Sons for their excellent service and top-notch technicians — we will definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Stephanie Green
reviews.text: We recently had an outstanding experience with Roberto from the Sterling office. Our water heater needed servicing (and ultimately replacing). Roberto was knowledgeable, thorough, communicative and respectful of our home and pets. He went above and beyond to ensure that all issues were satisfactorily resolved. We would definitely recommend Roberto and give more than 5 stars if we could!

reviews.author: Friska Rubijono
reviews.text: It was a Big job.  Eric was simply outstanding. He was very technical and competent and provided the service top notch. We wish him all success. Thank you.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 11540 Walsingham Rd Ste D, Largo, FL 33778, USA

reviews.author: Uncle Ric
reviews.text: Joey came out on a Saturday to replace a toilet that was installed with the house.  Joey was very professional, work was done quickly and left the work site clean.  I highly recommend this business.

reviews.author: DigitalChainsaw
reviews.text:
Mike is everything a plumber should be; punctual, professional, courteous, and has great technical knowledge. It has been a long time since I have seen someone love their job this much. Whatever Roto Rooter is paying him, it isn't enough.

I had water filling up my hallway the night before and I did not know the source. Mike methodically narrowed it down and found out it was a main sewer line blockage, potentially saving me thousands. He cleared the blockage and had me assist in testing the line multiple times so I had peace of mind that the repair was solid and I would have no more flooding.

I actually tried to hire a local mom and pop plumber claiming to be a "24/7 emergency plumber." Called at 6:30 pm on a Friday night and the person who answered didn't even use the business's name, just "hello?" Said he would call me back in two seconds. Got a text a half hour later saying no one could come out until the next day. I told him to disregard and called the name I have known since childhood and I am so glad I did. Big box doesn't mean small heart, at least in this case. Go with the pros at Roto Rooter (ask for Mike and thank me later) and rest assured your plumbing issues will be handled quickly and correctly.

reviews.author: Patrick Hamlin
reviews.text: Michael from Roto-Rooter came to my home and immediately assessed what the issue was. Unfortunately, since the issue is with the half pipe on my roof and Roto-Rooter no longer offers this option as part of their services. Although, Michael was great and immediately diagnosed the issue after explaining the situation to him. He provided a great background on the issue and was able to point me in the right direction to getting it fixed. I appreciate Michael for his efforts!

reviews.author: George Farrell
reviews.text: Michael was top notch! Came in with an incredible attitude and myself being a maintenance supervisor he listened to what I had to say about the situation and took in my thoughts on his decision to addressing the issue. Most people don’t want to hear your opinion on what they do for a living. Your company has a special individual in this man. Treat him accordingly. Thanks again Michael!!

reviews.author: Michael Chase
reviews.text: Today my plumbing technicians were Jack and Koli. Both the gentleman were very professional and took the time to repair my issue of replacing the hot water cartridge in one of my showers. The service was great and I now have plenty of hot water flowing through the shower again. Both gentlemen walked me through all the different steps and kept me up to date throughout the service which I truly appreciate. Jack was also helpful in talking to me about a future water heater replacement and I am definitely going to give a call when I'm ready for it. Thank you very much and I will continue to use Roto-Rooter for all my plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Wizard Plumbing and Drain
plumbers.address: 2300 Palm Ave, San Mateo, CA 94403, USA

reviews.author: Mani Hashemi
reviews.text:
Exceptional service and an exceptional team!!!
I lost hot water pressure and right away I knew something was wrong with my water heater. Since it was Sunday I had to email a few places and one of them was Wizard plumbing. Monday morning I got a few responses but Wizard plumbing was the quickest of them all and could dispatch someone urgently. Kevin arrived and identified that the water heater was leaking and needed to be replaced, after answering my many questions and making calls around to find the model I wanted. Shortly after Dino arrived and the pair not only replaced the water heater but also fabricated a custom pan to adhere to the current drain that was in place. They also replaced the leaky hot water valve as well as an automatic shut off valve. Throughout the whole time, they were curious, attentive, and thorough. They got the job done wonderfully and quickly within a few hours; this was exceptionally important as we have little kids. As they say, you get what you pay for and with Wizard plumbing, you get every Penny's worth. Don't just look for the cheapest but look for quality and Dino and Kevin are a great example of why that is the case. Thank you very much. A rockstar team for sure.

reviews.author: P. O. Benito
reviews.text: Made an appointment three days prior, they took down all of my information and asked me a bunch of questions. The morning of the appointment, I get a text message saying they do not service my area and have to cancel. Why didn’t you tell me that three days ago when I made the appointment and gave you my address? Waste of time.

reviews.author: Todd S.
reviews.text: I’ve lived in a house that was built in 1947 for 10 years. So I’ve had more than a few plumbers come through for various issues during that time. A termite inspector found a leak, so I panic-called the first result on Yelp (I don’t usually do that). Wizard Plumbing came through, assessed the situation, and gave me a number of options, each with associated costs. Not one to mess around with plumbing, I went with the most extensive & labor intensive option (and I’m glad I did; see pix). Out of all the plumbers I’ve done business with over the years, Wizard Plumbing proved to be — by far — the most honest, fair, competent, experienced and thorough. In fact, if I made a Venn diagram with all of those attributes for each of the plumbers I’ve done business with, Wizard would be the only one that made a perfect circle. They’ve definitely made a customer for life.

reviews.author: Lawrence Lam
reviews.text: Ammar from Wizard plumbing came out same day to fix me emergency. I would not have been able to open my business the next day without his help. He had to perform a major hydrojetter procedure on my plumbing. Everything works great now. I will call Wizard Plumbing again if needed.

reviews.author: Venu
reviews.text: Todd and Kyle came out today and the whole experience was fantastic. The dispatch was super responsive to start. I had a 75 gallon water heater that flooded my utility room. They sent out the two techs within hours of opening of business hours. Our situation was a bit special. Water heater two stories down and in a weird framed in closet the tank did not fit out of. They moved the washer and sink for me and left to do another job while I sawed apart the frame. That was on me for obvious reasons. I had to move electrical wiring too. The 75 gallon did not fit through the frame. Once I was complete I called and they were back in an hour. The entire new 50 gallon water heater was installed by end of business and less than 24 hours after the first discovery. It fit better. Operated better. Both techs were courteous, professional, knew exactly what they were doing as they were specific to water heaters. I will definitely call them again in any emergency. The other company called me to schedule the estimate when wizard was almost done….

plumbers.name: Siemer Heating, Cooling & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 400 Kennedy Ave, Schererville, IN 46375, USA

reviews.author: Laura B
reviews.text: We just had a new boiler and hot water heater system installed. The crew (Kraig, Denis, Tyler, Anthony) was fantastic. They communicated daily with us about progress and paid attention to every detail. They made sure we understood the new system and left the work area cleaner than when they started. The whole process from original quote, to end, was simple. Great communication, workmanship, and a nice company to work with!

reviews.author: Julie Streeter
reviews.text: Called after hours on a Friday night after our furnace stopped working and the answering service was able to connect me with a tech in a timely manner. The tech arrived within 20 minutes and was able to troubleshoot the issue and get the furnace back working. I would like to thank Alejandro for his patience and kindness towards my mother and taking the time to explain things thoroughly. I was very happy with the service we received and would not hesitate to call Siemer's again.

reviews.author: Norma Glass
reviews.text: Chris is both knowledgeable and courteous. He found the issues with my furnace and  explained everything in detail and gave me options.  He arrived quickly and this was an emergency since the temps are below zero.  Thank you for your work and expertise.

reviews.author: Susan Young
reviews.text: Paul was very helpful when figuring out what I really needed to make my home more comfortable.  He explained differences in systems, how things worked and gave me different options so that I could make an informed decision.  I had had 2 other estimates and was  told very different things  by both.  Everyone that worked on this 3 day job was great.  They were totally respectful of my home and family, including the dog!  Had new furnace and a/c installed, along with ductless mini splits in the upper level of my home.  It seemed like a lot of money, but considering it was upgrading the existing systems, plus adding a totally new system to handle the second floor,  I'm totally happy with the price.  So far it seems like my home is more comfortable.  Can't wait to see how the efficiency effects my utility bill!

reviews.author: Christopher Scott
reviews.text: Our sump pump went out while it was raining. Jack was able to replace the bad pump with a new one before it caused flooding in our basement!! Friendly, informative and fairly priced! Would recommend Siemer Plumbing!

plumbers.address: 4250 Spring Valley Rd, Farmers Branch, TX 75244, USA

reviews.author: Vivian Li
reviews.text: Pascual came and did a speedy and wonderful job fixing our bathroom sink plumbing that was leaking.  He was patient to find the problem since it is a slow leak but definitely there, and was quick in fixing it in less than an hour.  He had a cheerful personality too and was considerate to take his shoes off when he came in.  Thanks Pascual!

reviews.author: Alejandro Suarez
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of being helped by Keyfer and Dillion. Outstanding experience. Keyfer was extremely thorough when explaining the possible solutions, stand out guy. He was also training Dillion at the time who was also very nice, Keyfer did a great job of describing the steps to Dillion and verifying his understanding. I hope to not have any further plumbing issued but if I do I will call Keyfer in the future, thanks gents.

reviews.author: Brian Bacher
reviews.text: Ian came out to assess a kitchen clog we couldn't fix. Not only was he personable, but he also figured it out quickly and uncloggd our pipes. He also provided great advice on how to avoid deep clogs in the future. We used Mr. Rooter before and will definately use them.again. Highly Recommended.

reviews.author: bryan wilson
reviews.text: Had an outdoor garden hose valve break in the evening and was leaking behind the wall/siding of our house. Called Mr. Rooster and they were able to send someone out right away. Very friendly, and helpful! Would use again!

reviews.author: Conner Atwell
reviews.text: Clint came in to fix a leak from our shower in our new home and was an absolute pleasure to work with. Kind, professional, and very knowledgeable. I would give him 6 stars if I could. Will definitely be asking for Clint again in the future, give this man a raise!

plumbers.name: All American Plumbing Inc.

reviews.author: Francis Ayson
reviews.text: Jo-Jo did the initial quote and gave me a lot of good information and suggestions for a whole house filtration system install and Moen flow install. He was very informative and recommended fixing replacing a few items while getting everything installed. Jo-Jo and his apprentice Joseph came on time, were professional, did very clean pipework and our family couldn't be happier with our new water softener system! reviews.author: Bob, Break, and BOOM DeGuzman
reviews.text: Dalton as Lead Tech and Cody provided quality customer service, professionalism, and craftsmanship as they changed our bathtub knobs to a single lever and replaced our angle stops to our bathroom sink.  I've had multiple interactions with Dalton and Cody and I would recommend them for any plumbing job.  There's a chance I'll be working with Dalton on another project and I know he'll do a great job.  I've dealt with All American Plumbing for three water damage issues and each time they've been great people to work with.  I highly recommend All American Plumbing for any plumbing work.

reviews.author: Christine Wong
reviews.text:
We had a great experience with All American Plumbing and wanted to give a special shoutout to Jonny and Cyrus. They installed our new kitchen sink and faucet, and we couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out. They really listened to what we wanted and made sure it worked the way we envisioned.

What stood out most was how efficient and professional they were. They kept us updated throughout the entire process and explained each step along the way, which we really appreciated as homeowners. They even took the time to show us a few quick troubleshooting tips in case we run into any issues in the future.

The whole installation was smooth, timely, and the quality of their work is excellent. It’s clear they take pride in what they do. We would absolutely recommend All American Plumbing, and if you can, ask for Jonny and Cyrus!

reviews.author: Juliet San Diego
reviews.text: Once again, All American Plumbing went above and beyond our expectations. Jojo did a fantastic job in installing our new outdoor utility sink. The quality of the work done was top-notch. Very friendly people, prompt and left the work area clean. I'll be using their services again in the future and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Jim Lawler
reviews.text: Jo Jo and Stephen were great.  I called around 8:30 am and they were at the house by about 10 am.  First thing to note:  Totally polite, professional and smart.  Second they worked quickly, cleaned up well and went off to save another customer. So I had two very separate plumbing jobs which together was $500.  Based on my experience with previous companies, I'd say they were half the price.  And they did not cut corners (I've done my fair share of plumbing when I was a younger man).  Very neat jobs.  What else  can I say, other than Jo Jo has a fantastic mustache ;=). Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Megan Williams
reviews.text: I Called Sunrise plumbing based off reviews. Happy I did. My outside faucet was leaking and had a tech, named Jeff, come out within two hours to fix. He was very polite and had it fixed in an hour. No problems since. I’m always terrified of calling plumbers bc they’re expensive but was very happy with what I paid with them. I will definitely be using them in the future!

reviews.author: Trisha Newman
reviews.text:
Overall, the installation was completed and I believe the plumber did a good job. However, the amount I was charged to install a toilet that was purchased before the company arrived was outrageous! I was charged $400+ to install a toilet.  Then another $200 for parts.
I am truly disappointed in Sunrise Plumbing in reference to the price I was charged. During Covid Sunrise Plumbing completed a repair and the plumber did a great job. It was because of him that I called the company again.
This time when I called the company and asked for just an estimate of what I might have to pay, I was told that I would have to wait until the plumber could fully assess what needed to be done and I had the option to decline if the price was unreasonable.
I was given the price and reluctantly agreed to the charges, not completely understanding just what exactly was being charged. After returning home that evening and seeing the part I was charged $200 for and the receipt was shocking. I could have purchased the parts myself for less than that if only I knew. Never will I ever.

reviews.author: Lilly A
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this plumber. They were responsive, knowledgeable, and made sure everything was repaired correctly. They walked me through what was wrong and gave honest recommendations without trying to upsell anything. I appreciate their professionalism and will absolutely call them again for future needs.

reviews.author: Deborah Chavez
reviews.text: I called Sunrise plumbing after realizing that our foundation repair company had referred us to a plumbing repair company that had 1.4 stars and multiple complaints from previous recent customers and after we had already paid that plumbing company $600 to do a diagnostic camera test after our post foundation repair sewer test failed.  I called Sunrise Plumbing for a second opinion and they sent out  Andrew Avalos.  I was so angry at already paying $600 for a diagnosis from a company there was no way I would use to do the repair work. Andrew’s demeanor was so calming and he was clearly very knowledgeable. He completed preliminary testing to confirm and isolate the location of the leaks for a very reasonable price and showed me everything he was doing and why.  Andrew confirmed the leaks and performed the diagnostic testing.  Then the crazy work started-jackhammering up our floor and digging down 10 feet and tunneling to the leaks-turn out there were two.  Dirt was everywhere.  But now everything is fixed and cleaned up.  We were treated very well by all the contractors and are grateful to Andrew for being so patient and meticulous and for taking such good care of us!

reviews.author: Carla Garza
reviews.text: Andrew was very helpful and professional. He came out for an estimate and gave me all the information I needed. Will be rescheduling and hoping he will be able to come back out. Thank you!

reviews.author: Brandy Cloud
reviews.text: My place of employment had Total Plumbing come out and I was impressed with the workers they sent out. We work in a quiet environment. Jubal and Bobby arrived and understood the atmosphere immediately. That is a nice surprise- to not have to explain how to behave in a professional environment. The communication was excellent. They were very respectful of the staff, office and clientele. They did a great job. The issue was resolved quickly. Great guys, would recommend!

reviews.author: Tex Hep
reviews.text:
I recently used Total Plumbing Service for some bathroom work at my home in Melissa, Texas, and I couldn't be happier with the entire experience. From start to finish, they were fast, friendly, and very reasonably priced—no surprises or upsells.
The technicians, Johnathan and Fabian, were absolutely outstanding. They arrived on time, took the time to explain everything clearly, and provided an exact estimate upfront with no hidden fees. They worked efficiently, completed the job swiftly, and did a thorough cleanup afterward. Honestly, the bathroom looked cleaner than it did before they started—attention to detail like that is rare!
I'm so impressed that I joined their maintenance program right away, and I've already scheduled them for a couple of smaller jobs coming up. If you're in the DFW area and need reliable plumbers who treat your home with respect, look no further. Total Plumbing Service is the real deal—highly recommend!
Thanks again to Johnathan, Fabian, and the whole team!

reviews.author: Don S

reviews.author: Jaime Garcia
reviews.text: Mr Rooter is consistently the best plumbing service I have had the pleasure of working with.  My technician today, John Dubose-MP  was an absolute delight to work with. reviews.author: robert wlodarczyk
reviews.text: Extremely happy with the work they did. I had my water main replaced. Michael the tech was awesome. Prompt and attentive. Great value!! Five stars!!

reviews.author: Vanessa Jones
reviews.text: My service guy, Arthur, was super customer-friendly and did a fast and fantastic job fixing my leaking pipe. He took time to explain in layman's terms how the pipe system works, from the part that reduces the pressure of the water coming to the house, to the water that flows through the water heater and from there throughout the house. It was eye-opening to see the big picture. He also told me about things I can do to further protect my pipes during winter. Would recommend company to a friend.

reviews.author: Melisa Fox
reviews.text:
Ziaire did an excellent job today. He was very attentive, detailed and knowledgeable. He also has great manners and cleaned up after himself.
Glad he was able to clean the blockage out on my water line.
Great job Mr. Rooter!

reviews.author: Julia N.
reviews.text:
For this review, I give Mr. Rooter (specifically Joe Ventimiglia and his team – Mitch and John) 5 stars for the QUALITY OF WORK that they did for us. It was excellent/outstanding.

Note: Unfortunately, at the same time I would give only 2 stars for the quality of communication and for the scheduling process for our project. The scheduling was not consistent and often left us wondering if/when they would show up. And it did not measure up to match the quality of workmanship which was excellent.

During his visit for the estimate, Joe was prompt, respectful, knowledgeable, asked questions, engaged with us and the design materials (drawings and descriptions) that we had prepared, was willing to enter the crawl space to assess the plumbing situation (a disaster left over from a previous plumber who could not finish the work) and listened to us. He let us know that he would work on getting us a written estimate as soon as possible. Within a day or so, Joe was able to send us an estimate. That was amazing in and of itself (most plumbers take 3-5 days to generate an estimate and some never follow up at all). After reviewing the estimate, we decided to go with Joe and his team (Mr. Rooter).

Within the same week, Joe and his team (Mitch and John) removed all of the faulty, partially installed mess of plumbing work that the previous plumber had “installed” for us. Joe and his team also brought all of the supplies to stage them for the next week’s work.

Before I share more of the job, let me just say that Joe and his team (Mitch and John) were professional, respectful and documented their work. Mitch was extremely personable, very respectful and conducted himself with dignity and excellence on the job. John was polite and answered questions when asked. Both Mitch and John added to the already high level of skillful excellence that Joe brought to the job.

The following week, Joe and his team worked on replacing all of the drains and supply lines under our home (in our crawl space) as well as roughing in all of the connections, drains and dry vents in our bathroom space (going from 1.5 baths to 2 baths in a complete gut with dry vents that had to be reconnected and tied into the whole system). Their work set the stage for the construction team that was doing our remodel.

Seeing Joe's (and Mitch and John) finished work has been amazing. The work is clean, precise, completed according to code, and has corrected all of the errors and sloppiness of the previous plumber’s work. Joe/Mitch/John's work is also going to allow us to prevent leaks in the future. At the start of this project, I said I wanted “pretty pipes” (meaning clean, well done, leak-proof, neat, organized, code-worthy, and otherwise excellently installed) and that is what we now have.

The only area that was not as excellent was the poor communication around scheduling. Often, we were told that Joe, or Joe and his team, would be at our house on a certain day or at a certain time and we often did not hear from anyone until late in the day/the end of the day when Joe would let us know that the schedule had shifted or that he would need to reschedule for the next day or the following day. Of course, we can understand and give grace when that happens once but when it becomes a pattern, it feels disrespectful. It happened several times and we tried to just be flexible. However, after the 3rd time, we ended up speaking to a supervisor about the situation. Thankfully, Mr. Rooter’s supervisor was helpful  and swift in resolving our concerns and the job was completed with the same skill and excellence that Joe and his team demonstrated throughout the job.

Overall, we are very glad that we worked with Joe, Mitch and John and we are grateful for their excellent skill and the high quality of their finished work. We are so thankful for the completed bathroom plumbing for our 2-bathroom remodel project.

We highly recommend Limelight Services  and plan to call them for future projects.

reviews.author: G S
reviews.text: I'm a returning limelight customer, and they continue to provide great service. Jeremiah cleared a really tough drain in my bathroom. He explained the issue, helped me figure out the best price option, talked me through what with he did and gave me advice to improve my maintenance in the future. He was also very thorough about cleaning up, and kind to my dog. I'd be happy to work with him again.

reviews.author: Kjersten Johnson
reviews.text: Limelight was fantastic! I actually called them after poor customer service and callback from another company—and I’m so glad! They were helpful on the phone and then even got me in much earlier than scheduled (thank you, Celeste!). Brayden was then our technician and he was amazing. He was communicative and explained what was happening while solving the problem as quickly as possible. And my cat and dog loved him! Prices were fair and service was great.

reviews.author: Leslie Krug
reviews.text: I am incredibly impressed and thankful for the work that Trevor did today from Limelight Services. He was professional, friendly, on time and very knowledgeable; He also taught me some valuable tips about electricity, which I love. Five stars definitely. We have plumbing needs and will reach out to Limelight for their plumbing expertise. I am impressed that limelight treats their employees really well, is family owned, has a five star rating, and is a suite of services. Try them you’ll like them.

reviews.author: Michael Grav
reviews.text: Dave from Roto-Rooter did an outstanding job fixing leaking pipes from my washing machine line, kitchen, and bathroom. With 26 years of experience, his expertise really showed. The whole experience was smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend Dave if you want the job done right.

reviews.author: Bruce Millard
reviews.text:
We had Taylor from Roto-Rooter to fix a leak in the main water line coming into the house (before the whole house shut-off). The pics I'm adding are the before and after shots.

reviews.author: Rick Collins
reviews.text: Had an issue with toilet on a Friday, Roto-Rooter quickly respond and came on-site within a few hours time. They were very courteous and completed the repair in short order.  The cost was higher than average for repairs but probably because of the fast response.

reviews.author: Andy McMillan
reviews.text: Service itself was great. Zero complaints with the gentleman who did the work. He was courteous and thorough. However, to have to pay $817 for a simple garbage disposal replacement was pretty steep. To charge $300 on top of what I felt was already overpriced to replace a 6 inch piece of PVC pipe was an extra kick in the teeth. In all honesty I should have shopped around but once he was already at my residence I didn't want to send him away and not get the work done. Lesson learned on my part. The only reason for the low score has NOTHING to do with the quality or work.

reviews.author: Lindsey Anders
reviews.text: Dave is the best! He arrived quickly and was kind and respectful. He also didn’t try to scam me like many other companies do. He was honest and explained things in a way that didn’t make me feel dumb. He fixed the repair quickly. Would DEFINITELY recommend Dave.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 5851 Pearl Rd #205A, Parma Heights, OH 44130, USA

reviews.author: C Beeowens

Not only did he fix my tub he also offered alot of great ideas and helpful tips to prevent our situation from happening again. I really appreciated our conversation, and would highly recommended using this company in the future.

reviews.author: Lisa Pizzurro
reviews.text: Doug was our technician and he was fantastic!! Very knowledgeable and did great work! He managed obstacles very well and explained them in thorough detail! He was super nice and very professional! We would definitely work with Doug again!!

reviews.author: Georgeanne Hancsak-Tag
reviews.text: Jake and Joe were polite, respectful, knowledgeable  and professional. They arrived on time, kept work area clean and communicated what needed to be done. Our job was completed without any issues. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sandra Morton
reviews.text: Trayvon #1067 from Roto Rooter was sent out to our home for a plugged tub repair.  Trayvon was super nice, friendly, and professional.  He explained everything he was going to do to fix the problem and fixed our issue just as he explained.  Trayvon worked neatly and cleaned up after himself.  I would highly recommend Roto Rooter for any of your plumbing needs.  If I need a Plumber in the future I will definitely call Roto Rooter and ask for Trayvon to be sent to my home again.  Very kind young Man, thank you Trayvon.

reviews.author: Mark Levigne
reviews.text: Reaching someone who is available is good.  Reaching someone who 'knows their stuff'?  Well that's the ticket these days.  I felt confident with Bill working on our issues from the moment we shook hands.  He kept me abreast of the progress and the estimated cost as we discovered, which one normally does, other issues that should be remedied while the issue called for is being resolved.  The quality result was high confidence that the issues we had would not return with advice on how to avoid potential ones down the road.  That's gold to me as a homeowner/ customer.  Thank you Roto Rooter and bigger thanks to Bill3811 for great service.  We always know that our home is in good hands when we call you.

plumbers.name: Western Rooter & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 136 E Santa Clara St #1, Arcadia, CA 91006, USA

reviews.author: Michael Khachadoorian
reviews.text: Art did an amazing job, front to back. I am SO grateful to him for figuring out our issue from the getgo, which wasn't easy. We hired two other companies to come try and figure out why our hot water kept going cold occasionally. They both assured us that it had to be the mixing valve or cartridge failure. I spent SO much unnecessary (wasted) time changing them out, doing some plumbing on my own.. it was all a waste.. because I didn't call Western Rooter first. The other guys kept saying our water heater checked out. All these tests, no problem. Finally we called Western Rooter as a last resort because my friend highly recommended them, and Thank God we did! Because they finally solved it! They said it's the water heater, and I was like, "are you sure?? The other guys tested it and both said it's fine!" apparently not all tests are equal or the other guys were just not as smart as Art at Western Rooter. I was astonished.. but this is the difference between true, I mean TRUE professionals, and somehow these hacks that get by somehow. Thank you for being available to me! You truly saved the day and allowed us to have nice hot showers again without worrying about them going cold. Highly recommend! PS, CJ was our billing guy, and was great to work with as well!

reviews.author: Gallagher Goodland
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Outstanding Service – Ask for James!

Western Rooter is an absolutely phenomenal plumbing company. They came out to fix a clogged sink, and the entire experience exceeded my expectations from start to finish.

James was the technician who handled the job, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for better service. He wasn’t just highly professional and clearly an expert in his field—he was also personable, respectful, and incredibly easy to work with. He took the time to explain what was going on, worked efficiently, and made sure everything was fully resolved before leaving.

Because of this experience, Western Rooter will be the only plumbing company I call going forward. And when I do, I’ll be requesting James specifically. It’s rare to find both a company and a technician operating at this level of quality and care.

I couldn’t speak more highly of Western Rooter or James. Truly exceptional service across the board. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Christine Byers
reviews.text: Plumber could not have been nicer and was very thorough in addressing the problem. Fee was reasonable given the time spent to fix the problem. Office staff were proactive and organized when I called to schedule service. Communication was adequate in terms of keeping me apprised of the timing of the service call.

reviews.author: Fred Mesbah
reviews.text: We have been using Western Rooter & Plumbing for our condominium complex. We had a kitchen drain clog this morning so I called Western. Joan at the office was very courteous and helpful. Albert came out a couple of hours later. He couldn't be more professional and courteous. He fixed the drain in no time and was very clean and organized. He is excellent! I highly recommend Western and Albert.

reviews.author: Derrick Lee
reviews.text:
Highly recommended plumbing company! I reached out to Western Rooter through Yelp and was impressed by their efficient communication. Jose and Shella were extremely responsive with scheduling, and I appreciated that they do not charge for an initial inspection, which is a huge plus. Other plumbing companies charge for the initial inspection.

Another standout is that they service apartments and condos, which can be surprisingly difficult to find in a plumbing company.

Shoutout to Kevin, who helped diagnose and fix my leaky toilet. He called ahead with his ETA, arrived on time, and quickly assessed the issue. Best of all, he didn’t try to upsell anything. While other plumbers told me I needed to replace the entire toilet, Kevin fixed the problem by replacing a gasket. They do honest work.

The entire team was professional and easy to work with. I would absolutely use Western Rooter again and highly recommend them to anyone in need of reliable plumbing services.

reviews.author: Jimmy Martin

I also had them replace all of the water lines going to each one of the toilets with all new handles and fixtures. Every time they come out is very professional, clean work. I would highly recommend Spartan plumbing to any and all of the people I know. Sincerely, Jack Tudor.

reviews.author: Mike Brunett

If you need plumbing work done, I’d absolutely call Spartan Plumbing again and request Tim.

reviews.author: Austin Lilly

Highly Recommend Kelly Malavasic

I wouldn’t hesitate to call Kelly again or recommend him to anyone needing a master plumber.

reviews.author: Masreya26

Never felt pressured or rushed from him to make a decision. Other companies just pressured me and  wanted me to sign quick after telling me my unit is finished and they can come out tomorrow and install  unit for 130$ for 15 years that’s over 23K?!?! A lot of red flags.  Lakeside prices are super competitive but above all this company cares about its customers and that’s why I chose them.  Met Don and Steven today to install my unit. Power duo! They were outstanding and really nice guys! The install looks great they did a really clean job. My garage was spotless when they left - they picked up any trash or old equipment.  They took the time to explain how to maintain my unit, work the new thermostat and answered any questions. Robert even stopped by during the day to make sure I was good and if I had any questions about the install. Can’t find better service than that. Thank you so much Lakeside - I’m ready for the blistering Florida heat this summer with my new unit.
