Between bailing out drainage water and panicking, Rescue Plumbing answered the phone in 2 rings and said we can help you right now.

Not only did Dex and his team show up AFTER HOURS in the SNOW, they were warm, kind and jumped right into action to save my kitchen. They knew exactly what to do, explained it all to me, told me the costs right up front and stuck to it. Within 30 minutes they fixed our building’s drainage issue, cleaned up the kitchen neat as a pin and were out the door with a quick joke.

I hope I don’t need to see them again but also if I need a plumber, they’re saved in my phone and getting every recommendation. 4 seasons and ABC told me I’d have to wait til tomorrow afternoon at the earliest and I think my floors would have been ruined from overflowing sink water if I didn’t have Rescue Plumbing. Thank you Dex and team!!!

reviews.author: Charles Hastings
reviews.text: Javier was fantastic, honest, and efficient! I got several quotes from other companies and this was by far the most cost effective. Not only did they provide a fair and up front quote, but they were friendly, and responsive. I will definitely be calling them again for any future plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 24W500 Maple Ave # 209, Naperville, IL 60540, USA

reviews.author: Fresh
reviews.text: Erlin was fantastic!  He actually took the time required to diagnose the issue (where previous plumbers did not) and address the true problem.  He was professional, respectful, and effectively communicated the details surrounding the problem and provided tips for future plumbing health.  I highly recommend Erlin and will definitely be using him again in the future!

reviews.author: Joseph Morisco
reviews.text:
I scheduled a plumber to come out and had a few questions after booking the appointment. I called back simply to understand what the technician planned to do since I had already had the line rodded a few months ago and didn’t want to just repeat the same service without understanding the approach.

Unfortunately, whoever answered the phone was extremely dismissive. She repeatedly cut me off while I was speaking and had a noticeable attitude. I wasn’t trying to be difficult — I was just asking basic questions about the service.

Instead of listening, she kept saying they couldn’t tell me anything over the phone and wouldn’t even let me finish my sentences. Because of that interaction, I immediately canceled my appointment.

Good customer service starts with listening to the customer. Losing business simply because someone won’t take a moment to hear a question is disappointing.

reviews.author: Burst Flames Entertainment
reviews.text: Kemal with Roto-Rooter was great! He explained everything that was recommended to be serviced and didn't try to upsale me on a service that wasn't needed. I highly recommend Kemal and I'll definitely be reaching out to him again when I need any plumbing service.

reviews.author: Charia Johnson
reviews.text: Roto rooter is a scam... they dont do any work... Im the president of a condo association... called them for a boiler issue the man didnt do a thing... looked at the hot water heater and told me it was old and probably out of warranty and it would be 15k to replace... I even asked like you didnt even look at it.. you arent telling me whats broken just that it old and broke... well I can see that... he made a call to the company about warranty... wrote his paper for the 75 dollar fee and left... did nothing for 75 bucks Nothing

reviews.author: Andrea Gomez
reviews.text: First service a few months ago left me happy, issue got taken care of right away. Appt was made and tech was there within the estimated time frame. The work was done quick and efficiently. Recently i had some plumbing issues and immediately thought to call them. Scheduled an appointment same day within the hour, the tech was dispatched- i waited 2 1/2 hours before calling for an update and being told there is issues with travel and they cant make it in, thats fine, i reschedule for next day, wait over an hour and a half before calling for an update, was told to hold on a bit more. An hour later they call to reschedule that the tech cannot come, made for next day in the AM this time instead of PM. Got a call this morning at 7am-(3 hours before my appointment time) to ask if my appointment can be moved up, the tech can be there in the next 30 minutes, i agree, wait, over an hour later, nothing- i call for an update, am told the technician is supposed to be on the way still but nothing. I cancelled the appointment. Ive had to rearange my schedule for 3 days now and ive been able to try things at home to help my plumbing issues. Crying in the club- send help

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 3817 Conflans Rd, Irving, TX 75061, USA

reviews.author: Tiffani Geisert
reviews.text: I had an emergency at one of my listings and Roto Rooter had Juan out within 2 hours.  He was great and corrected the issue!  Their follow up was great as well while I was waiting for Juan to arrive.  I even had a mold remediation contact (Jorge) called me to introduce himself to see if in the future we needed any assistance. Great customer service!! I will definitely use them in the future.

reviews.author: Jackie Perez
reviews.text: Andrew (Drew) was very helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable! He had us fixed up properly and was on time. Thanks Drew!

reviews.author: Quinn
reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on my outside spigot. I used the website scheduler around 3 and had a technician out by 5, with the problem being repaired by 5:45. Bry, our technician, was very knowledgeable and showed me the problem and what he did to fix it. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nancy Shelton
reviews.text: The experience with Roto Rooter today was amazing from start to finish. From the initiall call to the actual service I have no complaints. Drew is an amazing plumber. 35 years of experience!!! He took the time to not only identify the issue but found the parts and got them the same day and got the work done. He is incredibly knowledgeable and a great man. What a blessing to have some like Drew working for this company. Roto Rooter should be real proud! And let me tell you really professional and by the way nice hat he was wearing. He has some class!! Overall fantastic service and amazing quality!!!!

reviews.author: Dianne Crumpton
reviews.text:
They installed new PVC under the house and removed all corroded metal piping. Left dirt everywhere, including on outdoor AC unit.  After installing the new PVC, they did not modify or repair the shower drainpipe; pipe was forced inside the shower.
We asked them to extend PVC clean outs above ground; were to come in the morning, they arrived late evening.  They were going to return to install a concrete pad to protect the new extended PVC clean outs, but no one ever called and work never completed.  Jason M., Field Supervisor attempted to discuss our concerns over the phone but did not understand the issues. Never came to the house for us to physically show our concerns.  No follow-up or courtesy. Communication between the Field Supervisor, workers digging, and the plumbers not consistent and we as homeowners received conflicting information from all parties.

plumbers.name: Advanced Plumbing, AC & Furnace Repair
plumbers.address: 902 Davis St, Vacaville, CA 95687, USA

reviews.author: Trish Collier
reviews.text: The best experience ever.  The receptionist was wonderful and Ivan the gentleman who came to my house was exceptional.  The friendliest and most professional gentleman ever.  He even went to Home Depot with me to pick up the new toilet. The experience was second to none and I highly highly recommend this company for any of your plumbing needs.  Please recognize Ivan for his exceptional performance.  He installed a new toilet and unclogged the main area that almost flooded my house.

reviews.author: C D
reviews.text: I hired Advanced Plumbing Heating and Air to replace a shower head, and two bathroom sink faucets. Jamaul and his colleague arrived on time on the day they were scheduled to come (a weekend, which worked well with my schedule). They came right in and evaluated the bathroom fixtures. They went over all of the options I could choose from, and answered all my questions. I had initially inquired about also replacing two sinks, however, Jamaul let me know that changing my sinks could cause me to have to change many other things, like the mirror on my wall, dry-wall, and more plumbing. He let me know that the sinks were in good condition to keep-which saved me money. He also kept safety a priority. When evaluating the faucets, he and his colleague discovered that my emergency shut off valves were not working (which makes sense because they are over 20 years old). They were able to replace everything including the valves, and the price was great. Jamaul and his colleague worked hard from start to finish. They had excellent customer service and communication. I would highly recommend Advanced Heating and Air!

reviews.author: robert anderson
reviews.text: Overcharge me did only half of what they charged me for left me with sheet rock repairs a backed up system, which they had to come out and unplug the waste and vent work. They said they were gonna do. They didn’t do they trashed. My carpet would not recommend them to anyone and I paid $9500 for this work.

reviews.author: Joseph Klucarich
reviews.text:
I just wanted to express my appreciation for the Moen Roman Tub valve and trim replacement job that Ivan and Miguel and the entire team at Advanced Plumbing and Heating and Air completed for me last week.

Like most jobs it turned out to be a lot more difficult than we had planned. In order for the valve and trim to be replaced and access had to be cut through 2 inches of tile, concrete, and chicken wire not to mention having to deal with the extreme heat.

The initial appointment was fast and they had a plumber at my residence in only a couple hours. Getting the valve and trim for this tub had a couple twists and turns which resulted in having to reschedule the final installation appointment several times. This was not a problem for the scheduling staff, they were wonderful.

To help me determine the correct valve and trim for the job they put me in touch with a local expert that provided me with the information I needed.

As for the price, I thought it was a good value for the work performed. I’m not just paying them for their time but also for their expertise and they came prepared.

I felt that they cared about my situation at that time, and also their other customers I heard them talk about and that impressed me.

reviews.author: K C
reviews.text: From start to finish, it was a good experience. I had a 30 year old natural gas unit that was on its last legs. Daniel came out to inspect it and told me what I already knew was coming, I was on borrowed time. We were able to schedule Mark to come out the same day and go over new units with me. I had already known I wanted to upgrade to a heatpump system amd Mark was great at explaining the differences and patiently answering my questions. We were able to schedule the install within 3 days. Chris, Justin and another gentleman whose name I didnt get all were wonderful. They were fast, efficient and very polite. They also cleaned up and didn't leave a mess. Everything went great and I had a new unit within the week. Special shout out to Enrique who was also great at quickly answering my questions via email and helping me out as well. Thanks a bunch to the whole APHA team!

plumbers.name: Reliant Plumbing - Austin
plumbers.address: 12111 Menchaca Rd, Austin, TX 78748, USA

reviews.author: Christopher H
reviews.text: We had the need to do a whole house repiping and received multiple quotes. Alex from Reliant was here and walked the house and listened to all our requirements carefully. We wanted to switch from electric tank to gas tankless waterheater and get whole house water filter with hot back wash installed. We decided to go with Reliant due to the very professional advice and appearance. And we were not disappointed! Once the installation crew hit the ground lead by Roman everything unfolded nicely! It turned out our house was very solid built with lots of unforeseeable challenges in the walls but Roman mastered them swiftly and with great care. Also shout out to Patrick, Victor, David, Brant and Julian as supporting crew members keeping the site as clean as possible. VERY glad we decided to go with Reliant as everything turned out very nice! We have now a flight control system in the attic where I can mangage separate sections in the house which comes handy with the freeze coming in from time to time. Thanks Roman for all the brain work you put in!!!!!!

reviews.author: Montenegro Hector
reviews.text: I was most impressed with technician Alex. He was professional, friendly, and knowledgable. He immediately assessed our plumbing problem and explained what he needed to do to rectify it and the cost. We had sediment backing up into our dual bathroom sinks from the AC drainage pipe. He not only took care of the problem, he recommended what we needed to do to keep the algae from returning. He was very reassuring and we would call on Reliant again. My overall experience Reliant was very positive, efficient and informative. They answered when I called after hours and kept me informed as to when the repairman would be arriving. The best customer service overall.

reviews.author: Daina Huntington-Linkenhoger
reviews.text: Brett Williams is an incredible person to work with! He was prompt, probably spoke to me via phone & text 100+ times within a 3-4 day span (including a holiday), and was always patient & descriptive. His entire crew responded quickly & professionally- he even had his manager step in when he was unavailable one of the days. I cannot recommend Reliant Plumbing enough for folks in the Austin area. If I have one complaint it is that he would not share his venmo so I could "buy him a beer." Thank you again!

reviews.author: Caty Cope
reviews.text: I had a few things I needed a plumber for. Zach came over easily diagnosed the problem and provided a solution. He provided many options at different price points and was very efficient. Highly recommend him and the company!

reviews.author: Lisa Landry
reviews.text: Jose and Julian came out on a Saturday afternoon and were one time and provided very good service. They made sure to let me know everything that they were doing and got everything up and running. Would recommend these guys.

plumbers.name: Brian B. Quick Plumbing
plumbers.address: 10739 Tucker St Suite 100-B, Beltsville, MD 20705, USA

reviews.author: Kia Banks
reviews.text:
I ordered a new washer and dryer but couldn’t have them installed because the existing shut-off valves were corroded. Pierre came out to assess the situation and provided several options with clear pricing. He arrived on time, was professional, and extremely knowledgeable. He took the time to explain everything in detail—what he was doing, the updated plumbing codes, why larger commercial companies often charge much more, and why emergency services are usually scheduled on weekends.

By the time he left, I felt completely confident in the work and the service provided. Pierre installed new shut-off valves so the water to the entire home no longer needs to be turned off, and he properly secured the drainage pipe to the wall, including fixing issues hidden behind the drywall that hadn’t been secured by the previous homeowner.

He was also able to install both my washer and dryer, and they are running perfectly. He even followed up the next day to make sure everything was working smoothly. Sorry it took me so long to write this review—but the service was absolutely worth it.

reviews.author: Damien Begley
reviews.text: We could not be happier or more impressed with Brian B Quick and in particular their technician/plumber Jimmy Stewart. We were in a real jam on a Saturday. We called Brian B. Quick and much to our amazement they were able to provide service that day. When their technician Jimmy arrived, he gave us the news as to what needed to be done, and an estimate. He wasnt able to get to us until around 3 p.m. because he was at another job. As it turned out he had to a larger job and the thoughts were he would have to come back the following week especially because it was Labor Day weekend. But no he said I can start now. We followed him over to the home depot picked out the shower hardware with his guidance and he went to work not finishing until around 9:00. He had to work in really tight quarters to do the job and minimize later repairs. He was able to do it and while it would have been perfectly understandable for him to call it a day at any point and return later to finish the job; he stuck to it doing a fantastic job, demonstrating the work showing us all the details and providing follow up information should we need it. Could not be more pleased or impressed with the experience.

reviews.author: Gloria C
reviews.text: This is our second time calling on Brian B. Quick Plumbing for repairs in our home. In both instances, the service far exceeded expectations - prompt, courteous, professional, experienced, efficient. Today, Dan was the technician sent to our home to install a faucet in our backyard. Everything about the experience was exceptional. Dan quickly assessed the layout and condition of our piping, and offered several recommendations for installation. A very reasonable price estimate was provided, to which we agreed in the same visit. After a quick trip to obtain the needed supplies, Dan returned and completed the work in very short order.  Dan explained exactly what he did and the steps we should take to maintain the faucet in cold weather. We are very satisfied with the service and results we have received from Brian B. Quick Plumbing and will continue to call on them for any future needs.

reviews.author: Dina Nawas
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Dion from Brian B Quick Plumbing. His communication was excellent—he gave a 40-minute heads-up before arriving and provided clear, regular text updates throughout the job since I wasn’t onsite. He quickly diagnosed an issue with the garbage disposal, clearly walked me through my options, and was very honest—after unjamming it, he did not push an unnecessary drain cleaning. He even sent a video confirming everything was fixed. Dion also investigated a suspected leak affecting the unit below, coordinated thoughtfully with all parties, and once he confirmed the issue was isolated to the lower unit, he promptly sourced materials and completed the repair. Professional, transparent, and thorough. I highly recommend Brian B Quick Plumbing—and especially Dion.

reviews.author: Charmeda McCready
reviews.text:
This company was great. My tech Patrick came in and knocked it out in less than 30 minutes. Professional, polite, and knowledgeable. It’s hard to find qualified, trustworthy, experienced people. I’m grateful and thankful for the help.

My drain was blocked and now it works! I also appreciate not being taken advantage of as a female!

Thank you. I highly recommend this company and technician.

plumbers.name: Avanti Plumbing & Drains Inc
plumbers.address: 284 B W Ridge Pike, Royersford, PA 19468, USA

reviews.author: Joseph Manini
reviews.text: Eric was awesome, from the initial contact, you know Eric knows what he's talking about and what he's doing. My Sump Pump finally went after 38 years and Eric had one a new one installed in no time. Avanti is very easy to get in contact with and very quick to get out to you with the correct repairs needed. Two Thumbs up from us!!

reviews.author: Jennifer Grace Elizabeth Harris
reviews.text:
I am appreciative for the professional and thorough services that I received from Avanti Plumbing Drains company.   First, they responded to my call on Friday, January 30, 2026 immediately. Jennifer who answered my call was pleasant and reassured me that they could offer me quick service to address my hot water tank malfunctioning issue. It was making slow drips from a valve. Less than a hour later, Brandon W. confirmed by text that he was on his way. Brandon was professional and courteous. He inspected the hot water tank and determined that my issue was not an emergency. However, he advised me that I should consider replacing my old tank due to the fact that it was over eighteen years old and it would eventually develop more serious and costly problems.  Another reason why I am appreciative of the service that I received from Brandon is that I did not feel any coercion to make a decision right away about buying a new tank. He presented the facts on how much a new one would cost and he offered me options of brands that I could select from.  Because, he was honest and helpful, I agreed upon purchasing one from the Avanti company. Finally, I am appreciative of the fact that Brandon was prompted and he came with all of his equipment to service me on Monday, as scheduled As the day progressed, he addressed all equipment matters with accuracy and thoughtfulness. It is a miracle to be able to find a company today who is professional, kind, efficient and just thoughtful about providing good and reliable services. To the team at Avanti, I say thank you. I will be hiring you guys again to address other minor plumbing matters. Blessings and More Customers.

Appreciatively,
Jennifer

reviews.author: Dan King
reviews.text:
Terrific service.  We had an issue at the church and Avanti came out *fast* to take care of everything.  The guys were polite and friendly, and their work was professional and done with excellence.
Dylan also gave me a clear explanation of the issue, the cause behind it, and some good options moving forward.
If you’re looking for a skilled, honest plumbing service, you’ve found it.  We’re extremely satisfied and will be using Avanti again, no question.

reviews.author: Cindy Harrington
reviews.text: Avanti Plumbing saved us today! It’s a Friday afternoon. Our toilet overflowed on its own. Friends recommended Avanti. I called Avanti right away. They sent Bennett right out. He spent two hours at our home - fixed the clog deep in our plumbing and gave us an estimate and lots of info on the larger repair we’re going to need. We’re extremely grateful for your fast, kind, expert response to my initial call. We can live comfortably in our home this weekend thanks to Bennett and Avanti! Cheers!

reviews.author: William McGowan
reviews.text:
Excellent in all aspects.

I called at 9:30 PM and they were able to send someone out next morning for clearing a clog in my main line.

Dylan was my technician, and he was very friendly, explained everything clearly, and also gave advice on how to handle future repairs.

He was able to perform the video inspection and hydrojetting right there, and got my system running great.

plumbers.name: Len The Plumber Heating & Air, LLC
plumbers.address: 12000 Indian Creek Ct, Beltsville, MD 20705, USA

reviews.author: B Ale
reviews.text:
Mama did a fantastic job. He is very professional and knowledgeable. He fixed my issue quickly and efficiently. Very kind and easy going to work with. If I have any more issues I will definitely call Len the plumber.

I had a major sanitary drain line clog along with a garbage disposal issue, and I couldn’t be more impressed with the service I received. He arrived promptly, quickly diagnosed the problem, and explained everything clearly before getting started.

Professional, knowledgeable, and very reasonably priced. If you’re looking for a reliable plumber who gets the job done right the first time, I highly recommend him!

reviews.author: cine poole
reviews.text:
After a long Holiday weekend I experienced a major clog in upstairs bathrooms affecting shower and tub and toilets
Ro was just what we needed his performance was exceptional he definitely knows his job and talked to us about what was needed along the way
I’m completely satisfied and will definitely be using him again
Thanks Ro on a job well done just when I thought hope was gone you came our way !! We truly appreciate the great customer service you provided us to represent your company

reviews.author: Lydia Wainwright
reviews.text: Mr Yves was the technician that came out to repair a leak in my coat closet. Today was the day after the storm. The street was very icy and he had to park away from the house. He was very professional, knowledgeable and polite. Being of the older generation, I was a little unnerved. However, he took the time to explain the process, informed me of what he found and cost for the repair. He took little time to complete the work and I am a very satisfied customer. Thank you Mr. Yves for doing what you do.

reviews.author: Khadijah A.
reviews.text: Len The Plumber helped us during a heat emergency and worked an absolute miracle! In a few days we had a new system installed and working on the weekend. Excellent job and very professional. I recommend Len The Plumber for all your HVAC needs!

reviews.author: Bobby Richardson
reviews.text: Sadou Aboubakar was very Knowledgeable and displayed professionalism. He reassured me that everything would be okay because I had a bad experience previously, and he also cleaned up after himself. If we have any plumbing issues in the future, I will call Len the Plumber and request Sadou to service any plumbing issues in our home, because we were really pleased with how he protected our finishes and was very courteous! 🙏🏾💯

plumbers.name: Mullen Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 301 B St, South Charleston, WV 25303, USA

reviews.author: Apple Pie Embroidery & Crafts
reviews.text: Thank you for making a bad situation better. Thank you for installing a proper sump pump and fixing the make shift one a local contractor did and wouldn’t fix. Gale & Lucky at Mullen Plumbing did Excellent work and were extremely professional in all aspects. Will definitely be my go to in the future!

reviews.author: Aubrey Robinson
reviews.text:
I was completely satisfied with the entire service! The receptionist who answered the phone was kind and helpful. She listened to everything I said and explained every part of their company procedures to me. I was told up front how much the diagnostic fee was and an estimate of how much it would cost to get the job done that I needed. They have standard 4 hour windows of time when they can show up, but they call you 30 mins before they head your way. The workers were nice, respectful, and easy to talk to. They wore boot covers every time they came inside and cleaned up well after the job. They walked me through each problem they found and how they were going to fix it. I was given the choice to opt out of any repair they wanted to do, and told I could choose to do any of it myself if I wanted. They even offered to add a new access panel to the shower pipes to make future work easier. The invoice was shown to me before they even started the job and each line item was explained and priced. The bill was a lot but I had 4 different things done so it wasn't unreasonable. They worked fast and efficiently and it all looked nice by the end too; no sloppy caulking or uneven cutting.
Will definitely be my go-to plumbing service in the future!

reviews.author: JD Philyaw
reviews.text: The great service with a Mullen began with the scheduling of the appointment.  Very professional, helpful and courteous admin staff.  The service personnel were no different.  We had toilet snd bathtub issues with this appointment and the Mullen team was able to correct both very quickly and affordably. I also appreciated the knowledge share regarding the underlying problem and repairs.  It’s comfortable to know that a trusted team like Mullen is ready on standby for any future needs.  Thanks guys.

reviews.author: Ed Smith
reviews.text: Had a new Tankless Water Heater installed. Included running new gas lines & water lines. The process was seamless from start to finish. Harold was great doing the initial evaluation & quote (which was very competitive)  & explained everything involved. Once I called & told Mullens to proceed, they showed up in 2 days ready to go. The Tech Reps were very good & kept us informed throughout the project. Very satisfied with the entire process with Mullen & would recommend them to anyone planning a plumbing project.

reviews.author: Jason Cummings
reviews.text: Our heat went out on Saturday morning 1/24/26 around 5:00 AM and I contacted Mullens. They had  a service technician at our home at 9:00. Jason was very helpful and knowledgeable and got it running. Great service and knowledge. Highly recommended.

plumbers.name: Busy Bee Plumbing, Heating, & Air Conditioning
plumbers.address: 40 Burton Hills Blvd #200, Nashville, TN 37215, USA

reviews.author: Sierra Rodgers
reviews.text: I cannot say recommend enough! I had a pipe burst inside a wall in my house and water was flooding the floor. I called a couple of places and the earliest either one could see me was the next day in the afternoon. I called Busy Bee and immediately talked to a real person (means more than you think) and someone came out immediately! I was so shocked. The price was pretty high but the leak was inside the wall so it’s kind of understandable. My repair man was Daniel Adkins and he was phenomenal! So fast, efficient, and also very kind! You could tell he knew what he was doing. The poor guy even brought out a shovel trying to get in the crawl space to try and locate the leak. I’m not sure what he gets paid but it’s probably not enough for that! Great experience!

reviews.author: Mary M
reviews.text: Kevin came out to check on an issue with our Halo whole house water filtration system and I am very happy that he knew right away what needed to be done to correct it. He was very friendly and knowledgable. Thank you Busy Bee for your great service!

reviews.author: Raven S.
reviews.text: Brandon was very nice, helpful and knowledgeable. He took care of my home’s needs, and also informed of some structural issues with my sink that I was completely unaware of. I am glad I was referred to busy bee! I look forward to using their services again in the future!

reviews.author: Elaine Love
reviews.text: Chris was fantastic! He arrived right on time and was professional, courteous,  and clearly knowledgeable.  He quickly assessed the issue with the hot water heater which required to be replaced. He  completed the repair efficiency.  I really appreciated his expertise and the smooth experience from start to finish. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Michael Speight
reviews.text: I had a heat/air unit replacement install this week. Tyler and Dalton were complete pros with the work they did.  They were knowledgeable and answered any questions I had and provided all the details of what they were going to do during the complete course of the install.  They had a tight space to work with and did it with ease and perfection.  They made sure everything about my new unit was working as expected and made sure my duct work was good as well. Highly recommend Busy Bee and the work of these technicians.

plumbers.name: Plumber Near Me
plumbers.address: 13513 E Boundary Rd Suite C, Midlothian, VA 23112, USA

reviews.author: Ashley Rodriguez
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Plummer Near Me for the installation of my hot water tank. Craig and Nathan were professional, punctual, and extremely knowledgeable from start to finish. They took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all of my questions, and made sure the installation was done safely and correctly. They worked efficiently, cleaned up their work area, and ensured everything was working perfectly before they left. It’s clear they take pride in their work and truly care about customer satisfaction. They also expedited the work as I had family visiting for Christmas. I highly recommend Plummer Near Me, and especially Craig and Nathan, for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Nicole Gray
reviews.text:
As the Community Director, we have always had great experiences with Plumber Near Me at Vue at Westchester Commons. From scheduling to completion, everything is always smooth and professional. The technicians always arrive on time, clearly explained the issues, and completed the repairs efficiently.

They were respectful of the apartments, worked quickly without cutting corners, and made sure everything was functioning properly before leaving. Communication was excellent throughout the process, and the pricing was fair for the quality of service provided.

Highly recommend if you’re looking for a reliable, professional plumber in the area!

reviews.author: Brian Moore
reviews.text:
Craig communicated well and arrived on time.

We walked through what was needed and he offered recommendations.

He completed the work quickly and efficiently. Recommend yearly follow-up.

Great service and very professional.

Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Hannah Witopil
reviews.text:
Had a clogged sewer pipe out in my front yard due to roots growing into it.
Jesse came out within a couple of hours and cleared the clog as well as determined the needed work to get the pipe replaced. He quoted me right away and answered all my questions patiently, all late in the evening. Even noted to forgive the camera cost ($300) if I decided to move forward with the job, because I was concerned about overall cost.
I called the next morning to schedule the job and they were able to fit me in just a few days later. The project crew (Kevin, Chris & Nathan) were nice guys, they worked fast and left the dig site looking like nothing ever happened. Even put grass seed down.
Overall very happy with everything and can only recommend.

reviews.author: Joe Bareford
reviews.text: Kevin and his crew did a fantastic job switching our home from septic over to public sewer. They completed their scope in a single day, and even put down new grass seed over my entire front yard. I would highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Hill & Company Service, Inc.
plumbers.address: 5125 NW 5th Pl, Oklahoma City, OK 73127, USA

reviews.author: L Crymes
reviews.text: We have been shopping to replace our HVAC system for six months. By far the most professional quote process came from Jeff Holloway. He took the time to inspect each service and return vents to calculate a balance load (turns out we needed an additional 12"12" return vent). Then two days later technicians Ryan & Kasem arrived to install new system. They were polite, hard working, quite efficient, and very respectful of our property. Everyone at Hill&Co were willing to fully answer and explain any questions. Also. the financing terms were quite attractive. We are more than pleased. Eric, the manager of the installation crew, came and preformed a quality assurance inspection of all facets of the work. Have never had this level of service before and are quite happy, especially for such an expensive purchase.

reviews.author: Kathi Black
reviews.text:
Two months ago we had one of our two AC units replaced by another well-known AC company in the local metro area. That experience from start to finish was not good on many levels. I would not recommend that company to anyone.

So when our second AC unit decided to break last week we decided to call Hill & Company this time. I can positively say that the full experience from Paxton coming out to find the issue, to Jeff coming out later that same day to discuss options if we decided to purchase a new unit instead of a repair, to the next day having Zeus and his team out to do the new AC install - every single interaction was professional, their employees were very knowledgeable and personable, our property was treated with respect, they showed up on time and were done exactly when they said they would be. They cleaned up after themselves. The options of which unit to buy were presented to us in an easy-to-understand way and we felt we really got a lot of value for our money.  Overall, a very good experience with everyone at Hill & Company. I would definitely recommend them to my family, friends and neighbors. Thank you Hill & Company!!!

reviews.author: SkystormChargerVortex
reviews.text:
AC compressor went out. The outside unit was 23 years old, so we decided that we just needed to buy a completely new outside unit. The inside garage closet furnace heating unit was in perfect condition, so there wasn't a need to replace it, plus we didn't have the money to replace both.

Contacted multiple heat and air companies, several came out to give me a price on a new outside unit and a second price just in case the evaporator under the furnace needed to be replaced.

One company in particular, actually gave me a set price to replace both the outside unit and the evaporator under the furnace. That company thought it would be best.

They said the actual price shown was the actual price we would pay. We decided to go with them after they waited on us for 3 weeks while we gathered the amount of money WE ALL agreed upon!

On the day we were making the appointment for them to come out to install the new outside unit/evaporator coil (if it needed it)...The price changed, it had magically jumped up a $1,000!
(Interstate Heat & Air🤬)

I immediately went looking online again.

❗️❗️❗️❗️❗️❗️❗️❗️❗️❗️❗️❗️❗️
I saw Hill & Company (thinking Drabek & Hill at first.🤦‍♂️🤣) so I messaged them. Didn't think about it until after I had already hit send. I'm glad that my brain messed up like that though, because it was a SMART MESS UP!

Nick came out to diagnose. Checked everything out, even crawled up our broken later, into the poorly ventalated (I'll fix that later) heat filled attic to check our installation/vent ducts. He gave me 2 prices after he had finished up.

One for just the outside unit replacement and a second price just in case they needed to replace the evaporator. I liked the pricing, it was the lowest we had received, so I said; Let's do it!

Dalton & Zario came out to replace the outside unit. Everything was going good, they were quick and informative while working. They finished up with the outside unit, unfortunately the PXV valve was freezing up on the old evaporator (which means it's bad) so they had to go ahead and replace the evaporator by pulling out the entire furnace.

They got it out, replaced it and put everything back in.

Sorry again guys that the builders of this house made it so hard for ya'll to get it in/out of the closet.
(Way before we came here!🤣)

They vacuumed out any air/moisture from the system, charged the A/C up, cleaned everything up and within 30 minutes after turning it on, we could feel the cold, that we haven't felt for some time now.

Feels great to be back in it. I know that besides me, that the Wife, Dublin, Butterscotch, Garfield, Katniss and my cousin are all glad to have it back!🥶🥶🥶🥶

Great job boys! And thanks again to you Nick for dropping the price just a little bit more after the job was already finished!

We really appreciated that!

reviews.author: Pat
reviews.text:
Can I just say how *unimpressed* I am with my experience with the Hill & Co. group?!

I had a pair of guys come out & take a half-assed look around, then the older, chubbier journeyman sent the younger, skinnier apprentice under the house to poke around at the plumbing (he forgot his flashlight & had to be handed one).
They tried to convince me that I needed to upsize my whole gas line, "for code."
They even had me convinced & up-sold, until I asked the next 2 plumbers about it...
They were *absolutely* trying to take advantage of someone who didn't know better.

Anyway, they quoted me $9,2k for a simple Tankless Water Heater swap.

I though that was too much, so I called around. An outfit called Yarbrough & Sons sent a technician named Cole Hobson to come out & do an estimate for a Tankless Hot Water Heater swap for me, and not only did he do a *thorough* bathroom, utility closet & crawl-space inspection, he came out of the crawl space (looking like the undead 🧟‍♂️), went looking for a shovel, & then went *back* underneath the house to trench out access to allow him to get where he needed to go, to see what he needed to see! I should add that Cole & I are both bigger guys (like the Hill&Co Journeyman), & I would not have wanted to have to do what he just did. And he did it enthusiastically & professionally, all for just a free estimate! Very impressive!

Unfortunately, a guy from a "2 guys in a truck" outfit came in right behind them & immediately underbid their quote.

But I was so impressed by Cole, that I called Yarbrough & Sons, & I asked if they could match/beat the other offer?
And, guess what, they did!

So, we were pleased to get to book the project with them & are having it installed next Monday (So long as I can get my Electrician to come upgrade the power outlet box over the weekend 😅).

For the record, they beat out Hill & Co.'s (who was Angie.com's 1st recommendation) initial quoted price by >45%, coming in at just

reviews.author: Ahmad Latifzai
reviews.text:

I highly recommend these guys and will definitely use them again

reviews.author: Michael Hand
reviews.text: Denis and team did a great job.  Briefed me about their approach to the installation of a new water heater.  Called my attention to some differences between the install of my old unit and this new unit.  Kept me informed as to progress and walked me through the system once they finished.  Aside from a great new tankless water heater you would not have known they were here.  Very conscientious and tidy.   Also, just a super nice human being.

reviews.author: Kenneth Cook
reviews.text:
So this is an update to my last review from last month.   Let me first say that if I have a bad experience, like a 1 star experience, it will usually move me to write a review and I've never gone back and updated the review, because I've said what there is to say and I'm done with that company.   But in this case, Eco Plumbers called me several times regarding the  review, indicating that they wanted to make it right.   So I called and spoke with a couple very nice people.  They committed to sending someone out to rectify the issues.   Long story short Phil and John showed up today and not only adjusted the sore-thumb-looking wire repair from last month, but also addressed the dimmer switch needed on the chandelier.   They were very professional and did a great job, the kind of job I was hoping for originally.   Besides this, Eco Plumbers had them do this work at no charge (and they never cashed my original $332 check).   Now obviously, this was never my objective (to get free work done) and I even offered to pay for the dimmer switch fix, but they said, "no charge".  I've never in my life had a company bend over backwards to make a situation right like they did.  So this changes my review from a 1 star to a 5 star.  Never done that before.  May never do it again, but in this case it was fully warranted.  So I can say that I feel like in the case that something isn't done right, they make it right.  And in today's service world, that is a remarkable thing.

-----
Previous review from a month ago for context:
$700 per hour for electrical work.   No joke.

Fixed a wire (see picture), took 25 min.   $332.   That's my review.

reviews.author: Tyge Lopez
reviews.text: Austin was absolutely amazing, he came out to do a sewer inspection and ended up finding some major issues, he wrote up the options and covered them with us in great detail. The team is coming to make the necessary repairs and I’m sure they will be just as impressive!

reviews.author: tetsu shimizu
reviews.text: Denis' team did a great job to haul away the existing 40 gallon water heater and install a new tankless one. Two PVC pipes went all the way to the side of my house through the crawl space. They cleaned up everything within 6 hours. Excellent!

reviews.author: T.J. Hufstetler
reviews.text:
Based on your advertising, I expected a company that values my time as much as I value yours. The four-hour service window without an ETA was already challenging, but what was most disappointing was the lack of communication. About 15 minutes before the window closed, I had to reach out myself and was then informed the appointment might need to be rescheduled.

To be clear, the need to reschedule was not the issue—I understand that delays happen. What fell short was the absence of proactive communication. A simple message earlier in the day acknowledging the delay and the possibility of rescheduling would have made a significant difference.

I was open to becoming a new customer, but the experience didn’t reflect the level of service your advertising suggests. The multiple follow-up emails, calls, and texts after the fact reinforce my original concern that the response has been reactive rather than proactive.

I hope this feedback is helpful as you evaluate your customer experience going forward.

reviews.author: Shawna Bryant
reviews.text:
Harley was fantastic. He came out quickly, took the time to thoroughly investigate a complicated leak issue, and didn’t rush the process. He was patient, professional, and very knowledgeable. He identified the source of the problem when others hadn’t been able to, and clearly explained what was happening and what needed to be done.

He was also genuinely kind and easy to work with during a very stressful situation. We really appreciated his honesty and attention to detail.

Highly recommend Harley and JD Precision — we would absolutely use them again.

reviews.author: Patti Edens
reviews.text:
We were very happy with all aspects of working with JD Precision Plumbing Service from our initial phone call to the finished job. An underground leak from our water well to our house had lowered the water pressure in the house. This was the third time this fitting had leaked. We called Monday morning around 11 am. A very courteous and helpful person (sorry, can't remember name) answered the phone, quickly understood what we needed and set up an appointment for between 12 and 4.

Austin arrived at our place sometime between 12:30 and 1 pm. He was very kind to our over-enthusiastic Labrador retriever. :)
Austin assessed the problem and let us know what he recommended for a permanent fix. He installed an extra fitting and replaced the two leak-prone screw-on fittings with a better connection. He brought the lines up to the surface and set it up so that we could have options on which lines to turn off without shutting off the water to our entire system.

We think that Austin's solution was brilliant - very thoughtful, practical,  and well executed. It will last forever. JD Precision Plumbing Services and Austin are highly recommended.

reviews.author: James Martelon
reviews.text: Installed a new Moen kitchen sink faucet with sprayer head.  On time, did a super job and were gone in just over an hour.  Clean and neat.  Nice faucet with a lifetime warranty. Very poleased.

reviews.author: Kirstie Gibbens
reviews.text: Plumber Quin was great! He was within the time frame, found and resolved the issue quickly! Very thankful for him making it stress free!

David Muna was dispatched and was able to help us discover the source of the leak. They are always very respectful, professional, and do a great job. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Had an emergency leak causing water to come out of our floorboards.  Plumbing Outfitters was quick to respond. They gave us estimates for a few levels of service at a fair price.  We were able to schedule quickly for repairs and the work he did was top quality.  Never felt any pressure to upsell us or to force us to do anything that was immediate.  Will def be calling again if other plumbing issues arise.

reviews.text: I used Szabo plumbing to replace my water heater this week. Ryan & Luke came to do the install and were very professional & efficient. A little bit of extra work was needed (which I was aware of a head of time) to repipe but everything was explained and agreed upon before any work began. Even with the SMALL price difference from the initial quote (due to the additional work) the entire job still came in less than I was quoted by two other local companies. I’m very happy with the new water heater and the exceptional service I received. I would (and will) absolutely recommend Kevin Szabo plumbing to anyone who needs quality work done at affordable prices. You’ve earned a loyal customer!

reviews.author: Margie Gainer
reviews.text:
A week ago I asked Kevin Szabo Plumbing to come to my home to investigate a very large leak in my kitchen ceiling. Tony and Ed were sent to investigate and repair. They were both kind, thorough, personable and communicated upfront what the costs involved would entail. Both men were knowledgeable and thorough. It was evident from the beginning to the end that they were not only professional, but they are amazing representatives of their Employer and his business practices and culture!

Thank you, Tony and Ed… I appreciate you, both!

reviews.author: Lorraine Ryan
reviews.text: I was lucky to get a quick appointment and a plumber, John A., who knew exactly what needed to be done to solve my problem. I loved that they are a family-owned company that has been  passed through generations.     KUDOS!!

reviews.author: Casie Stewart
reviews.text: Thank you to KS Plumbing, and Ryan in particular for fixing our inconsistent hot water issues that had been plaguing us for a while.  KS Plumbing has done a lot of work for us in the past and found them to be knowledgeable and generally easy to work with (scheduling, availability of parts, no over-selling). Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lawrence Kargol

I highly recommend Szabo for your plumbing needs.

reviews.text:
I had a new water heater installed by Will. Brian did the diagnosis of old heater a month ago, and he was on target: old tank had a lot of debris, way too much to flush out. It was time to replace it.

reviews.author: RushTac
reviews.text: I run a tire shop in Golden called Gills Point S. We recently had some service done on our furnace unit that was over 45 years old by Marius and Jorge. They were wonderful to deal with and they eventually got me a quote for a new furnace which we had replaced by Erin and another employee this past Wednesday. I couldn't be more thankful and I absolutely recommend this company for all your heating needs. Hopefully I won't need them any time soon, but I'll happily be a return customer. Thank you to the entire Mac-Vik team for being so easy to work with and so fast in your service call, quote write up, and even getting me in a week early to do my furnace. We appreciate all of you and I'll happily give anyone who works at Mac-Vik discounts on any tires and service you need from us in the future.

reviews.author: Megan Boone
reviews.text: Jorge was fantastic to work with. He struck the perfect balance between professional and personable, making a stressful situation much easier. He clearly knows his craft and took the time to explain the diagnosis in detail. I especially appreciated his honesty—he laid out all my options without any high-pressure sales tactics for expensive repairs.

reviews.author: Dale Becker
reviews.text: Had great service on a recent project with Nate and Erin.  Super professional in all communications, showed up on time and finished the job in a timely manner.  Solutions oriented, no upselling.  Just great service and a professional process from start to finish.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Robert Scheinman
reviews.text: Camden came by to give me a quote. He was friendly, knowledgeable, and patient. He worked with me on the design of a home power system to get us through power outages as well as some other problems. He contributed great ideas and gently corrected my misconceptions. Perhaps most important , he freely communicated when we strayed away from his expertise. His price quote was reasonable. I’m excited to work with him on this project.

reviews.author: Andrew Zapp
reviews.text: Friendly and helpful staff. Service techs got here quickly and got right to work. Antonio and Nathan were very professional. They assessed the situation and gave us options and prices to let us choose what worked best for us. The job ended up being a little bigger than we thought and I needed to go pick up my daughter from preschool. Antonio and Nathan worked fast and got done quick so I could go get my daughter. Very happy with the service. Outdoor spigot repair.

reviews.author: Oliver Family
reviews.text: Service Squad did an amazing job replacing the entire sewer line under our house, that was original cast-iron from 1965. The initial technician who diagnosed our problem was Incredibly thorough in his evaluation, let me follow him around, explained what he found every step of the way, and was happy to answer all my questions and show me all the video from inside the sewer pipe. He could not have been more professional and detailed in his explanation. He provided me multiple options at different price points for repairing the damage. The technician who actually replaced the pipe was also just as thorough, taking photos every step of the way of what he was doing, and making the replacement process is easy on us as possible. The excavation team they brought in to dig the tunnel under the home was also excellent. The scheduling team was extremely accommodating and helpful. Overall, the The entire team was very professional, very responsive, very communicative, and and completed the project faster than I had hoped. The.price was extremely reasonable compared to other quotes I received and I couldn’t have been happier. I will happily use Service Squad again in the future and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Leigh Ann Turner
reviews.text: Outstanding service! I love that before the technician arrived they notified me with the time of arrival and a pic of who was coming. The technician was extremely kind, professional, and took the time to clearly walk me through everything he was doing as well as what may need to be done in the future. He answered all my questions, and made sure I understood everything. A great representative of the company!

reviews.author: Jeremiah Deluna
reviews.text: Technican Nathan was very nice and professional. He was very thorough and detailed explaining the root of the problem literally. He gave me a fair and reasonable estimate and future repair which was great compared to other companies. I would strongly recommend this company and Nathan if he is available.

reviews.author: Monica McCord
reviews.text: Looking for the right plumbing company can be frustrating. We had work done with Service Squad in 2021 and had no complaints. New plumbing issues arose so we called them back. They got me in same day. Nathan was great, answered every question we had and explained in detail so that we understood and the best part…their pricing was fair.

plumbers.name: Handy Plumbing Man, LLC
plumbers.address: 1011 American St, San Carlos, CA 94070, USA

reviews.author: Dana Ung
reviews.text:
12/5/25 - Handy Man Plumbing helped me identify a clog in my sewer line with a thorough inspection.  They gave me a competitive quote for installing a house clean out and cleaning the sewer line.  The installation was done quickly and avoided messing up the yard.  Highly recommended.

12/16/25 - Update.  I decided to have Handy Man Plumbing replace my very old sewer lines under my house.  Their quote was the most competitive.  They kept our place clean during their work, sealing off our rooms from dust and covering the floors.  They were very thorough, replacing all old GI pipes and even some old ABS pipes.  While the scope of work was for "horizontal" pipe replacement, they did their best to replace as many "vertical" pipes that they could without opening any drywall (shower drains, toilet flanges).  They also helped me repair some bad water supply pipes the noticed while doing their work.  They didn't try to upsell me on trying to replace all my water supply lines, and with these repairs, said it should be good for a while.  In all of this, they did not charge any additional fees for the extra work they did (i.e. needing to dig under two foundation walls, doing extra repairs, or needing an extra day of work).  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Christine McMillan
reviews.text: Mr Arturo Lopez was fantastic. He arrived on time with pre-arrival notification and tracking available. Arturo was knowledgeable, neat and efficient. He took the time to show me the repair and explain why it was needed. This was a two step process with technician Denis Orellana first diagnosing the issues and providing a quote. Once I accepted the quote and scheduled the service, Arturo Lopez arrived to make the necessary repairs. 100% trustworthy service by a two really nice guys. Thank you Denis, Arturo, and Handy Plumbing Man!

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.text: Jerry and Brayen were great - explained the issues clearly and compared short term vs long term options for the pipes in our home.  It is also very convenient that you can book online and we were able to book an appointment for the very next morning.  Will definitely use them again

reviews.author: Sioux Pavkovich
reviews.text: I needed the gas line for my old dryer moved to accommodate a new electric dryer. I called to schedule on Thursday and Jany came to do an estimate of the project the following Monday. He was able to complete the job during the same visit. He was kind and professional, and put booties on without me asking. He clearly explained what needed to be done and the job was completed within 30 minutes. I highly recommend Handy Plumbing Man, LLC! A few years ago, they were able to do a same day fix when I discovered that the disposal I was so proud of installing myself was leaking... 🤦🏼‍♀️

reviews.author: Dan Yao
reviews.text: Great experience with Handy Plumbing Man plumbers!  We had a toilet which needed to be replaced.  Contacted a number of plumbers and decided on Handy Plumbing Man plumbers.  They actually had someone come to my home to inspect and give an estimate for the work.  Their estimate was more expensive than some of the other quotes we received but they seemed the most professional and provided a warranty on the installation (and provided a flat rate as opposed to an hourly rate).  The scheduling process was seamless and the plumber, Denis Orellana and his assistant, arrived exactly on time.  They were very professional and pleasant and proceeded to remove our existing toilet and installed our new one.  The entire job was done very efficiently and smoothly.  They tested it to make sure it was working well and there were no leaks.  So far, toilet has been working very well.  Overall, from start to finish, great experience with Handy Plumbing Man plumbers!  Would highly recommend them and will plan on using them for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Danielle Cooper
reviews.text:
We are Teays Valley Service Experts advantage plan members and I truly can’t say enough good things about our experience—especially because of Ricky Johnson.
For the past year, Ricky has been the technician coming out to service our system, and he has been absolutely amazing. He is incredibly knowledgeable and thorough, and he always takes the time to explain what he’s checking and why. You can tell he genuinely knows his trade and cares about making sure everything is running safely and efficiently.
What really stands out, though, is how kind and professional he is. Having someone work inside your home can sometimes feel uncomfortable, but Ricky makes the whole experience easy. He’s respectful, patient, and never makes you feel rushed or like your questions are a bother. He truly makes you feel at ease.
It’s rare to find someone who combines technical skill with such genuine customer service. We are so thankful for the consistent care and professionalism he brings every visit. Highly recommend Teays Valley Service Experts—and if you can request Ricky Johnson, do it!

reviews.author: J J

reviews.author: Steven Cunningham

I have three units , and was very pleased with the service yesterday.
Theron was very knowledgeable, polite and did an amazing job.  He answered all my questions and explained everything. Would definitely be asking for him next time .

reviews.text: Intelligent Service was great! We ended up needing extensive work done and they made it as easy on us as possible. Their communication was top notch with us AND on our behalf with the insurance company.

reviews.author: Eric Pelz
reviews.text:
We had our hot water heater go out.  We picked Intelligent because they had working hours on the weekends and didn’t charge extra for weekend hours.   Trevor came out to look at the issue with the hot water heater.   I personally thought it was the Thermopile, so I ran to hardware store replaced and issue still existed.   Trevor diagnosed it with a bad gas valve and said he can replace the heater part for $850 or he’d recommend a brand new water heater.  He said if he replaces the part, he will most likely need a brand new water heater anyway in the next few months to at least a year.   He then went on to look at the boiler, which was about 40 years old. Now keep in mind this boiler does work, and I was not planning to have any service on it whatsoever.  Over the years when I’ve had the maintenance guys over to look at the boiler all companies would not even touch it scared that they were going to break it even more and then have to owe me a brand new boiler.  He then went on to say he could give us a deal. We can kind of throw in a hot water heater. If you get a new boiler, we can install it this week.  So we thought about it a little bit more and we wanted to go ahead and do it because not only the savings but what if the boiler went out in the middle of winner then we’re going to pay extra charges for the winner cause they’re gonna be busy and it’s probably Probably gonna be more expensive.

So we went on to replace the boiler and the hot water heater hot water heater heater was replaced that day which was perfect. It took about an hour and a half.  He then said someone from Intelligent would call me to set up the install of the new boiler.  Two guys came out to install the new boiler and they brought another guy Neal who helped me I’ll walk through the process of what’s gonna happen and what they’re gonna install what they’re going to leave in place Place and not touched due to the fact that I made damage didn’t even more. Install took about 78 hours they did not have to come back the next day except to change out the thermostat just because that was kind of them. We had a small issue with the damper, but luckily they replaced that within the next day or two and now going on 24 hours to 48 without any issues.

Overall, I was very happy with their service very happy with their service service man. They were very polite and they explained what they were doing. They were in and out. They kept the place clean so I was very Happy with them overall.

reviews.author: Jeremy Gregory
reviews.text:
We had a sewer back up into the house at 10pm on October 29, 2025.  I called 3 plumbing companies and Rooter Hero responded within a 45 minutes.  Matt from Rooter Hero showed up and said they have an all day price of $79 for snaking a clean out.  This several hundred dollars cheaper than their competitors.  As he snaked the sewage line he hit a snag that choked up the snake, but was able to free up the blockage.  He said the snag was either a tree roots or broken pipe.  I decided to have them come back the next day with a camera check the line.   The price increased m to a little more than $300 with the clean cost included, but was still significantly lower than the clean out charge alone from their competitors.

The next day Matt returned with his project manager Braeden.  They ran a camera down the line.  First thing problem they noticed was the clean out.  It was recently replaced by Gilmore Heating, Air and Plumbing back in March of 2025, but inspected, not up to code.  Gilmore removed the original design and put in a 3” ABS “T”, they had told me the bull horn clean out wasn’t possible in that tight space.  Rooter Hero’s said that it must to be changed to bull horn clean out or it not California compliant and would fail inspection.  The second thing Rooter Hero’s camera revealed was a broken sewer line in the yard under the grass.  This also had be recently been replaced by Gilmore heating air and plumbing in March of 2025.  Rooter Hero’s camera showed a complete separation in the pipe.  At this time, I decided to move forward with Rooter Hero fixing both problems.  Braden wrote up the contract and they started the repair that same day.  Matt was present during entire project.  They were very thorough and communicated the whole process with me before they started and as they went through the process.  They had a team from Rooter Hero out in my yard fixing everything.

Matt, Francis and Evgenii dug out the pipes. They took pictures before and after and made sure these pictures were attached to the contract once completed. They found a coupler on a 45° angle that had separated and dropped about 1.5” from its connection.  Evgenii repaired all the lines.
The city came out in the morning of Tuesday, November 4th, 2025 to check the permitted work.  Passed without any problems.  Jesse and Marcelino back filled the yard hole yesterday.  Kon came today to back fill the driveway and fill it with concrete.  Everything looks great.  All these guys were professional and did an outstanding job.  I appreciate Rooter Hero’s dedication to immediately correcting work previously done by a non reputable plumbing company.  Then completely walking me through the process.  I feel their customer is commendable and should be recognized.  I am beyond grateful to this team of plumbing professionals.  I highly recommend them.
