reviews.author: Pa Houa Her
reviews.text: I'm a first time home owner and had a CO problem due to a leak somewhere. WPS advised us to call someone who does HVAC. I ended up Calling PGA and the lady who answered the phone was amazing. She didnt judge me as I didn't know what I was looking for and listened to what I needed. she got a technician (Mark) got to our house the same day. He assessed our furnace and everything else related and gave us multiple options for our furnace. We did ended up getting a new furnace. Mark was very professional and amazing. He explained everything so I can understand. Today a couple technicians came to install the new furnace. they're also very professional and courteous. PGA, Thank you for the amazing people you sent out.

reviews.author: kao xiong
reviews.text:
TLDR:
Got service for caulking bathtub.
Bad job and would not refix.
Issued refund but took a LONG time to receive.
End of day, TERRRIBLE communication from PGA.

My parent's got service at their home for a few things.
This was all done and paid for on 09/15/2025.
Everything was done fine with exception of caulking around the bathtub.

1) The caulking was not done well
2) There was no communication as to not use the the bathtub for a given period of time

I reached out to PGA and spoke with the scheduler.
He told me any disputes would have to go thru his boss, Rob.
He forwarded me to Rob's number, and I left a message.
This was on 09/16/2025.

I did not hear anything back so I reached back out on 09/24/2025 and left another message for Rob.
Rob called me back on Thursday, 09/25/2025, and I explained to him what the situation was.
I sent him pictures of the poor service and he said he would have to look into it and will let me know.

Monday, 09/29/2025, still nothing from Rob, so I texted him.
They responded and said Rob is out of the office this week at a conference in Colorado and will be back next Monday.
I responded with a bit of frustration as I talked to Rob on Thursday and he NEVER mentioned that he was going to be gone for a week.
I would think if he was going to be gone he would wrap up my situtation or pass it along to someone else in the organization.
But we were patient, we gave them the week.

Monday, 10/06/2025, still no call back or communication from Rob.
I reached back out to get a status update.
He finally respondeds saying he wasn't pleased with the appearance (from the pictures we provided) and that he can schedule another visit to correct the problem.
I told him that we would not expect to be billed again since we already paid for this service.
He said since we ran the shower too soon (reminder, the service tech never gave my parents any communication that they should wait any ceratin period before usage) he'd stil have to charge us labor.
I responseded if he cannot fix it free of charge, to refund our money and we'd take our business elsewhere.

No response for Rob.
Wednesday, 10/08/2025, I reached back out to him.
He responded that they could not redo the service free of charge and that he will issue a refund for $131.88 thru a check thru mail.
I said, ok, we'll look for the refund in the mail.

Wednesday, 10/22/2025, we've still have not received the refund so I reach back out.  We are pretty frustrated at this point.

No response again, so I reach out again on Thursday, 10/23/2025 and got a hold of someone.
This person told me, since Rob supposed issued the refund, any resolution has to go thru Rob.
And Rob is currently out all day in meetings and a message has been relayed to him.
I expressed my frustation saying, is there no other person that can help.  We've waited patiently already close to a MONTH.
All this person could offer was an apology.

Finally Friday, 10/24/2025, Rob responds and says check is in the mail.
Not apology, nothing.
I respond expressing more frustrations also saying I will leaving a bad review for them.
Ofcourse he responds quickly now when he hears he is going to get a bad reivew.

Thursday, 10/20/2025, my dad finally receives the refund check in the mail.

So yes, PGA does do good work.  But when it is not good work, good luck working with Rob on getting it resolved.
DO NOT expect any kind of reasonable customer service, communication from Rob.

Attached are the pictures of the serivce that was provided and my communication thread with Rob.

reviews.author: Lynette Weiler-Dehnke
reviews.text: Joey at PGA was amazing!  Very nice and courteous and incredibly knowledgeable! A true pleasure to work with.  He was able to diagnose the water problem we were having and quickly scheduled a team to be at our home the next day to repair it!  The repair team quickly repaired our problem and we are so grateful!  PGA will always be our first call for our needs!!

reviews.author: Ken M.
reviews.text: They did a great job replacing my water heater. Logan called bradford white for warranty on the water heater, installed new expansion tank, new pipes and valve handles. Made sure everything was running good and looking clean.

plumbers.name: Apex Pros Plumbing, Electrical, Heating and Air
plumbers.address: 4300 Tuller Rd, Dublin, OH 43017, USA

reviews.author: GUNS- USA
reviews.text: I was down with (NO HOT WATER) and no way to keep going for the day. After talking to Blake at Apex Pros.he assured me that the money I would spend to try to save this tank would not justify the money spent. It was better to replace it which at that time I agreed also, he assured me it would be painless also a good replacement. I would be back up running and running with little to no  downtime. that man was right!!  he went right to working on it explained the process, which to me seemed very complicated. You can tell this man’s a professional in his trade. He also advised me on a couple other things to keep in mind going forward. in case I needed to replace those as well in the future. Not only did Blake I feel go above and beyond his professionalism was superior like no other. As my youngest sons was trying to watch him work, he even made time to talk to them and share a few laughs and let my youngest son hold the flashlight for a short time. made him feel like he was important also that made his day!! My son felt like he accomplished something. he told me he helped me fix it Dad. We need more people like this in the world they go above and beyond for the customer, and even though they didn’t know us, it was almost like family when he left. He had very little to no cleanup left when the job was complete. Everything looked as good as it should. He did advise me. It would take a few minutes for the tank to warm up.  he knocked this one out out of the park. Thanks, Blake for a wonderful experience will be looking to your services in the future. PS my youngest son is now watching hot water tank videos on YouTube. I think he amazed himself and now he wants to become a plumber. Thanks again Blake and have a wonderful holiday can’t say thanks enough 👍🇺🇸

reviews.author: Jack Paul
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Apex Pros. I highly recommend them.  Salesman Chris gave great recommendations for upgrading electrical outlets, breaker box, kitchen light and thermostat. Electricians Eric and his heler were excellent at installing all the many devices in a timely manner.  The great HVAC team of Michael and Preston were excellent at installing the new smart home thermostat and furnace power surge breaker.  And the office team was great at keeping in touch through the whole process.

reviews.author: Tordeth Tordeth
reviews.text:
Eric completed the final 1/3 of the company's available services at my home.  I have used Apex for plumbing, HVAC, and now electric.
The service has been supreme in every aspect and Eric plus Levi were no exception.

Courteous, check.
Expert level knowledge, check.
Polite, check.
Great cable management, clean, on time, worked with my home and work schedule, plus a phenomenal 'work completed' write up for my insurance.

If you need any electric work completed, call Apex and ask for Eric by name

reviews.author: Terri Mcgaughey
reviews.text: From the first call I made on, it has been nothing but a pleasant experience. I don’t know much about this company as it my first experience with them, but I can say that they sent out one of their best representatives/technicians when they sent Colin French. At age 68, I can tell a man with good character when I see one, which is rare these days. He was polite and extremely respectful of my home and especially to myself. He explained everything that needed done to fix my water pressure problem in a way that I could easily understand. He also provided me with updates as the work was being done. He installed new plumbing throughout and re-routed it away from my electric panel, new pressure tank, gauges and valves in my almost 100 year old log cabin. Prior to his great job, I had practically zero water pressure and it would take at least 2 hours to fill up the bathtub and my washer couldn’t even detect H2O, so I couldn’t use it at all. I had 3 other companies come to my home prior to Apex. None of the other 3 impressed me at all. However, Apex (Colin) did from the get-go. I consider Colin a remarkable representative for the Apex company. He brought with him an apprentice (Mo). He was a fine representative of the company as well. I was within ear shot and was impressed with Colin’s teaching ability. The cost was fair considering the amount of work that was done and the professional, yet personal service that I received. To be honest, they came in as Plumbers, but left as what I consider friends, even if our paths never cross again. Based on my experience, I highly recommend Apex. Ask for Colin, you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Russell Bean
reviews.text: Last week my furnace died.  I had two companies come out and I was unable to get it fixed or replaced as my finances were tight and have a few credit issues.  I was at wits end, my wife has stage 4 cancer and it was freezing in the house.  I called Apex and they sent a project manager out named Darrell.  When he arrived he immediately showed interest in my hobby of building model plane, which made me feel at ease.  After discussing my issue and explains my wife’s health, he assured me that he would find a solution.  He contacted a lender that was able to help us if we were able to open a checking account.  Of course we don’t have a car, so he took me to the bank to get the account open.  After everything was approved he called his office to have my new furnace install expedited.  The personal service from Darrell was something I’ve never experienced and the Apex came through immediately and installed my furnace.  This company deserves 5 stars and I will recommend them to anyone!

plumbers.name: Beyond Wow Plumbing & Drains
plumbers.address: 421 Talbot St, Taylor, TX 76574, USA

reviews.author: Jake Green
reviews.text: Talmage located and repaired the leak in a pipe outdoors quickly and professionaly. His price was very reasonable and he did the work with no problems.  Talmage and Beyond Wow will now be our choice for ALL our future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Ramon Uson
reviews.text: Beyond Wow Plumbing is exactly what they are. I had a major leak at my meter and Sean and Micah came out to repair it.  They were super prompt and called and came out early this morning.  They called and updated me with what had to be done. Sean was a super great rep for Beyond Wow. He was forthright and caring about my current situation.  They had it all repaired in just a couple of hours. This is the best experience I've ever had with a plumber. I definitely recommend Beyond Wow and will surely use them again. Thanks a million!!!

reviews.author: Marie Pavlovsky
reviews.text:
August 27, 2025
Our service provider, Jason Radford arrived promptly and was very professional and friendly. He provided the camera test to find out if any other blockages existed. Before he began to work, He explained everything thoroughly. Several times he asked if we had any questions or concerns. Jason had us watch as he used the camera in the pipes. This allowed Jason to give us real-time feedback and allow questions from us. Being able to watch the camera footage during the test was very informative, educational and invaluable. Jason's camera test found some issues with our pipes, so we have scheduled a static test. Great job, Jason!

August 26, 2025
Our service provider, Andrew Coyle arrived promptly and was very professional and friendly. We needed to have our kitchen sink drain cleaned out. Before he began to work, He explained everything thoroughly. Several times he asked if we had any questions or concerns. As a follow-up, he scheduled to have coworker, Jason Radford come the next day to do a camera test, to make sure that there are no other blockages. We asked for additional services that were not in the original request, to replace 3 outside faucets. He gladly agreed to our request and he had all the equipment needed in his vehicle. Great job, Andrew!

reviews.author: Andrew P
reviews.text: We had S&D replace our two water heaters with a tankless system and were having issues with hot water getting to various points in the house. I spoke to their Field Manager about the issues and they promptly sent out a Technician who fixed the issues and tuned the system to our needs. S&D Plumbing is a very professional group of folks that I'd recommend to anyone for their plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Stephen Bohls
reviews.text:
I called S & D plumbing today Thursday 1/26/23 and was helped by friendly sales staff, who quickly set up my appointment for today.

My service technician, Nicholas S. came out to my house and did tests to locate my water leak and changed out the outside faucets.

S&D Plumbing is a company, I will use again for my plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: The Scottish Plumber
plumbers.address: 135 W Home Ave, Villa Park, IL 60181, USA

reviews.author: Marc Sallette
reviews.text: we had an amazing repair experience today in our basement fixing a broken pipe below the concrete slab which was leaking sewer gas.   terrific crew came on a Saturday and did incredible job including the cleanup and an extra small item that was outside the scope of what we paid for.   highly recommend and thanks for Google Gemini who recommended we contact them.

reviews.author: ES.
reviews.text:
Elliot is a thorough, professional, and proactive plumber. He went above and beyond while he was at our home, found the core issue after detailed troubleshooting, and made sure our pump worked properly. We really appreciated his attention to detail and willingness to ensure everything worked as it should.
After calling 4 plumbers and getting ghosted (not sure why), it was a huge relief to speak with someone over the phone to schedule Elliot to come by and help us out. Scottish Plumber has an excellent system and brought a great plumber!

Update: we had Carlos come to install a new back up sump pump and check valve and he was prompt, kind, and careful! We are so grateful for the team at Scottish plumbing.

reviews.author: Patrick Olson
reviews.text: Jack Simonson was great! Had 5 different companies for quotes in my sewer line. He was the most honest and transparent of the plumbers. He gave me a estimate onsite and did not try to upsell me like the others. Scottish Plumber made sure the hydro jet and stent was done timely and show me the before and after.

reviews.author: Madiha Qureshi
reviews.text: Elliot, the plumber, was awesome! He arrived early, quickly diagnosed the issue, and fixed the problem. He was super patient in answering all of my questions and was wonderful to work with. The Scottish Plumber was also great. They scheduled me for same-day estimate and repair and their quote was fair and better than other competitors.

reviews.author: Kelly Krahn
reviews.text: Very grateful for the fast response and professionalism.  We had a discontinued system and Scottish Plumber's got us upgraded and back to running properly.  Truly appreciate this company after having so many others not willing to help us.

plumbers.name: Elite Rooter
plumbers.address: 245 Kinney Dr, San Jose, CA 95112, USA

reviews.author: Hector Pesqueda
reviews.text:
Agustin & Reece arrived before the apoointed time this morning (2/24/2026); introduced themselves; and asked for details about my kitchen sink clog..

In my case, the sink was successfull unclogged but they had to snake the roof vent, the cleanout on exterior wall; and then from under the sink Cabinet!

Agustin  & Reece work well together and make a good team   I feel I could trust them to keep  my house clean and perform an honest plumbing service/ repair for anyone!

reviews.author: ryan florendo
reviews.text: Had a leak coming from the base of my toilet. Needed to have it checked ASAP before my vacation. Made an appointment the night before. Ruben came the next morning. He checked for causes and determined that the toilet was cracked. He replaced the wax ring, toilet and even snaked the main line. Did it all in a day.  Great and very professional work. Reasonable price for the time crunch I needed it done by.  Will update if there are leaks.

reviews.author: Steven Blechman
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Elite Rooter Plumbing – Outstanding Service!
We recently had a major plumbing issue at Trudys Brides and Special Occasions, and Elite Rooter Plumbing truly saved the day. The scope of work was massive, and the situation required immediate attention to keep our business running smoothly during a very busy season.

A huge shoutout to our senior technician Zac Ritchey, who was incredibly professional, efficient, and dedicated from start to finish. Zac worked nights, weekends—whatever it took—to get us fully operational again as quickly as possible. His expertise and commitment made all the difference, and we are genuinely grateful.

Elite Rooter delivered exceptional service, clear communication, and fast results during a stressful situation. I would highly recommend their team to anyone in need of reliable, top‑tier plumbing support.

reviews.author: jeffrey sturges
reviews.text: Tech showed up on time and did an excellent job. The price was fair and they delivered what they promised… A +  for the service and honesty. They have earned my business for the future. Highly recommended company and they fit their name : Elite !

reviews.author: Audree T
reviews.text: We had a leak underneath our bathroom sink, the appointment I scheduled the day before no show and no communication. I looked for another company and found Elite Rooter - best decision!! I texted and had someone call me back seconds later and within 30mins Zach came in. He evaluates the problem - gave the best options. He went to get the parts for the sink - within less than 1hr everything was fixed. We’re so happy with the level of professionalism, punctuality and knowledge. We’ll definitely use Elite Rooter services again for the future. I would recommend them as we appreciate top notch service!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1225 Belt Line Rd Ste 103A, Garland, TX 75040, USA

reviews.author: mannan burhan
reviews.text:
Amazing service. Kelvin was thorough,professional and friendly. I had issues with my sewage pipe backed up. He help us and also priced matched the invoice.

He was very patient with the me, we kept going back and forth on getting it done. He gave us space and time to get to him. He also was very friendly with both my boys. My younger one kept disturbing him during his work. He was very accommodating and in fact took time to explain things to him.

Great guy, I highly highly recommend him.

Thank you Kelvin, God bless you and your family

reviews.author: Phillip Hoover
reviews.text: I chose Roto-Rooter services because I’ve trusted their brand for many years with other different issues. This time it was my home and the drains were stopped somewhere between the house and the street. And water was backing up into the house whenever used. The technician STEVEN came out and did a fantastic job and was extremely professional in all aspects of the service. Thank you very much STEVEN for your diligent hard work. They also sent another gentleman out and they ran on a camera through the drainage at no extra or additional charges. It’s approved that there wasn’t an underlying issue that needed to be taken care of. Thank you very much.

reviews.author: Chris Stringer
reviews.text: We tried to do a DIY installment of a kitchen faucet that ended with us breaking the supply line valve and on a Saturday night we called for an emergency visit and Roto-Rooter came out within the hour and fixed our problem and installed our new faucet. The technician was very friendly and did a great job. I would recommend this company.

reviews.author: Mary Jo Mimlitch
reviews.text: Excellent emergency responsiveness to our plumbing backup!  Steve was great and kept me up to speed on what he was doing. He also had us do a thorough stress test.

reviews.author: Sonia T
reviews.text: Our technician Steve was very quick & resourceful. He not only detected the problem,  but very quickly cleared the drain backup.  He was clean.  Did not leave any mess. And was really courteous. Would definitely recommend him anytime there is a drain issue.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Drain Service
plumbers.address: 500 McGee Rd, Anderson, SC 29625, USA

reviews.author: Nelson Walsh
reviews.text: There was a significant leak that wasn’t completely delt with. That happened a few weeks ago as well and I now have a lot of black mold in the drywall. Hopefully I don’t get more in my stairwell where it flooded.

reviews.author: sherrer eberhart
reviews.text:
The service was fast and awesome!!!  Micheal and Austin were quick and effective. Thank you guys so much!!!! They came out on the same day after a panicked afternoon call around 3:30 and fixed it. I had a next day issue that was promptly fixed by Bobby! Wasn’t techs’ fault, it was oddly built plumbing. Great service both times!!

Had to get more service done for fixing toilet. Goose was my technician and he explained everything in detail and showed me issues as he came across them. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Darrian & Dedra Magee-Pennant
reviews.text:
We were blessed to have Rich J. come by and help us with our plumbing needs! He was  honest, respectful, and kind. Got us up and running normally rather quickly. He also picked up that our child had a rubber duck collection and when he closed out his work he went out to his truck and brought back a rubber duck for our little one.

Good service and good people.

Thank you Rich!

reviews.author: Paul Bishop
reviews.text: I called to have my septic pumped. We just bought the house and it’s been 5 years since the last pump out.  The service from my initial phone call to the technician, Tyler was outstanding.  Tyler is fantastic.  Answered my questions, offered insight and then had a separate personal come do a free camera inspection of the pipes.  They don’t always offer that, but I had just purchased the house so wasn’t sure where the pipes ran in the yard, if I had other issues, like roots, etc or even knew where the septic was in the yard.  From start to finish, they did a great job. (I had a different company the day before and they “couldn’t locate the tank” and wanted to charge $300+ to run the camera to find the tank).

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Bobby Zeuke. He was polite, professional and very knowledgeable. He gave us honest advice and even saved us some money on repairs. We’ll be using Roto-Rooter for all plumbing repairs moving forward.

plumbers.name: Milestone Electric, A/C, & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4651 W John Carpenter Fwy Suite 170, Irving, TX 75063, USA

reviews.author: Alicia Spencer
reviews.text: Scott is very conscientious troubleshooting the issues.  He offered various options and was very respectful with regards to price points.  He offered his suggestions, explained his reasons behind his suggestions and did not heavily push to upsale. He simply offered all options and respected the decisions made.  I am going to use him again, first because of the quality work and a close second because of his respect for decisions and not being pushy.

reviews.author: Doris Miller
reviews.text: Justin did a great job!  He was here right on time, explained things in an easy to understand manner. He was very patient and informative when going over the checklist for my service.  Justin represented Milestone in a way for which the company should be proud!

reviews.author: Krishna Dhanam
reviews.text: Have been a customer of Milestone for many years and the professionalism, before, the proficiency during and the politeness after the service have always stood out to me. Gary Strange was no exception and did a remarkable job in explaining the work and stayed with me to assist in a recommendation so that it was all handled on the same call. Kudos

reviews.author: Gary Davis
reviews.text: Professional Master Plumber helped me out.  Very good explaining everything to me. Processed the transaction to be installed today. Had a Master Electrician on the job site the same day. Very good turnaround time. Job was completed in agreed time. Explained maintenance required of homeowner. I rate the job a 5+. Keep up the professional work.

reviews.author: Annamarie Barron
reviews.text: Zane came and did my ac maintenance today. He was very professional, courteous and friendly. I have always had exceptional customer service from Milestone. Thank you !! And a special thanks to Zane for taking the time to listen and talk.

plumbers.name: JT Plumbing Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 193 E 71st St, Loveland, CO 80538, USA

reviews.author: Asal Vojdani
reviews.text:
We have been working with JT Plumbing for some time now. They has always been very helpful and quick to provide excellent services.  Brandon was our service technician last visit and he took all the time needed to ensure we had the heat back on.
Big shout out to the office team as well, Alex has gone above and beyond to provide top notch customer service 👌

reviews.author: Nate Gazdik
reviews.text: JT Team has been fantastic!  Brandon was extremely thorough ensuring we were taken care of and our HVAC system was running in optimal shape. Thanks Brandon and Justin…appreciate you taking care of my family during this crazy cold snap!

reviews.author: CeeGee
reviews.text: I highly recommend JT Plumbing service. Very easy to schedule quick service. Levi helped me sum up my problem and found a solution.  Front desk staff and Levi very courteous and professional.  Much appreciated.

reviews.author: Steve Jarrad
reviews.text: Levi and Brian did an amazing job. Had the main drain to septic tank collapse and needed replaced. Original estimate was for a two day job. They started around 9:30 AM and were done and left by 3:30 same day. Never stopped for lunch just wanted to get it done and our drain working. Travis was very reasonable with pricing. Second time I have used JT Plumbing both times I was more than pleased with the response time and quality of work.

reviews.author: Emma Howard-Young
reviews.text: Incredibly responsive and efficient. When our water heater suddenly broke, they were able to replace it the same day! Everyone I've worked with at JT has been so helpful, kind, and good at explaining issues and how things work. They made sure I understood the issue and the options.

plumbers.name: EVERYDAYPLUMBER.com
plumbers.address: 3912 W South Ave, Tampa, FL 33614, USA

reviews.author: jennifer metzger
reviews.text: Everyday Plumber is the best!  When we noticed a leak in our hot water heater we thought we would be in for a long wait for someone to get out.  We called in the morning and were told someone would be able to get there at 2:00!  "Ryan" showed up on time and we couldn't have asked for anyone better!  Ryan was very professional, knowledgeable, helpful and perhaps one of the nicest people we have met.  He was very thorough and explained everything to us in detail.  He was able to replace our hot water heater in less than a few hours and we had hot water almost immediately!  He left the area cleaner than when he arrived which we were very thankful for (we had just painted the walls and door the previous day).  He even cleaned out the area with a wet/dry vac before he installed the new one!  Again, one of the kindest, efficient and professional plumbers we have dealt with and will definitely be referring them to everyone in our neighborhood.  Thank you again for everything!

reviews.author: Andrew C. Tsunis
reviews.text: I have dealt with many plumbing companies over the years and nobody beats Everyday Plumber.  These guys know what they are doing and are super professional.  I have several homes and have referred them to several friends and everybody raves about them.  They are super polite, super knowledgeable, and very courteous and professional.  I have to give a shout out to these outstanding technicians: Dylan, Evan, Chase and Camaren and Aaron.  Every single one of these technicians knew exactly what they were doing, and worked very diligently with care and caution to my property and at the end of every job they always cleaned up after themselves-  I can’t say enough good things about this company and I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Richelle Brown
reviews.text:
I had a small leak in my outdoor sprinkler system and called everyday plumber for a non-emergency repair. They were able to get someone out the next day, which I really appreciated. Ryan provided a two- hour arrival window and called to let me know he was on his way. He quickly assed the issue and gave me three repair options, clearly explaining the pros and cons of each solution so I could make an informed decision. Ryan was friendly, professional, and efficient. He also went above and beyond noticing an error light on my water softener, helping me address that, and even testing my water purifier while he was there.
Great service, great communication, and a very positive experience overall. I would recommend Ryan and Everyday Plumber.

reviews.author: brandi karr
reviews.text: My hot water heater went on the fritz and started leaking water everywhere. Everyday plumber got plumber James Curry out to me as soon as they could. James was extremely knowledgeable, professional and kind. He got me a new hot water heater installed with new piping same day and also removed and discarded the damaged ceiling above the hot water heater for me. Would recommend this company and James

reviews.author: John Ferlita
reviews.text: Cole was very professional  both  in his work and attitude. His  work was very well done . He cleaned  up  all work area. Will definitely  recommend  and hire him in the future

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing of North Austin
plumbers.address: 2000 Windy Terrace BLDG 7 STE A BLDG 7 STE A, Cedar Park, TX 78613, USA

reviews.author: Danae Kozelsky
reviews.text: I called the office at 7:30am with no hot water. They answered and Mickey came to assess my heater by 10am. It was 27 years old Hot water heater from 1998 😳 It was time. He was very professional and  helpful. He gave me the quote, I paid 50% and then Scott and Dave came later  and installed it in the afternoon. They worked hard since it was an attic unit. The new unit got a dent but should not effect it’s functions. I was glad Benjamin Franklin plumbing were prompt and professional.

reviews.author: Roberto Sanchez
reviews.text: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing is the best I’ve used in Austin over the 25 years I’ve owned a home here. I’ve used them several times now and they are courteous, communicative, punctual and do the job correctly at a fair price. Recently, Timothy was fantastic. He diagnosed a complex issue, explained it and made recommendations providing options, then promptly made the repair. Would use again and again.

reviews.author: Justin Denman
reviews.text: We were in a tight situation and needed a plumbing repair on the same day. Fred was exemplary at understanding my need and working to secure me a same day appointment. My plumber, David G, completely exceeded my expectations. His communication, his patience with explaining what is needed and his quick thinking at answering the endless, “Yeah, but what if -”. Although the repair couldn’t be fixed the same day, they are going to be able to fix it the following day after securing a hard-to-find part. I called them at 10:00 am this morning and it’s 3:22 pm and my problem will be rectified fully by tomorrow. I’m an extremely happy customer.

reviews.author: Elena McGinnis

reviews.author: W Z
reviews.text:
This company seems much more focused on making money than meeting customer needs. I contacted them to have a licensed plumber check the gas connections for my water heater and HVAC, just to confirm there were no leaks. I didn’t suspect a leak, but wanted professional verification.

When scheduling the appointment, I clearly explained my request. However, they refused to provide a quote for the gas leak check. Instead, they said there would be a minimum $99 fee, and that the actual cost couldn’t be determined until the technician assessed the situation onsite. OK, fine.

When the plumber arrived, I again explained that I was looking for a simple gas leak check and verification. After a quick 10-minute look at the appliances, he told me the only test he can offer is a pressure test — priced at $1,000. I was shocked. There are many standard, less expensive methods for detecting gas leaks (e.g., visual inspection, soapy water test, electronic gas detectors, gas sniffers), yet they only offered the most expensive option.

I asked how long the pressure test would take and was told less than an hour. So essentially, I paid $99 just to get a quote for a $1,000 test that involves no repairs — just using their tools and a plumber's time for an hour. That’s effectively $1,000/hour.

Later, I contacted another plumbing company. Their pricing was less than half of Benjamin Franklin’s, and their service included more comprehensive checks and other items.

Given this horrible experience, I will not be using Benjamin Franklin Plumbing again.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[Comment after reading “Response from the owner”]

The owner’s response only reinforces my original impression — that this company prioritizes making money over addressing customer needs. They seem to exaggerate every situation to justify selling more expensive services.

In my case, I simply wanted a basic gas leak check and verification, with no known issues or suspected leaks. Yet, they offered only one option — a $1,000 pressure test — while dismissing other standard and legitimate methods used across the industry. Their reasoning was, “$1000 would be a small price to pay if it prevented a fire or worse yet the loss of someone’s life.”

If that logic applies to everything, then perhaps they should set a $1,000 minimum for all services. For example, if a customer only needs to install a gas shutoff valve, they could insist on a $1,000 pressure test, because, “$1000 would be a small price to pay if it prevented a fire or worse yet the loss of someone’s life." Or if someone wants to install a water shutoff valve, they might recommend a $1,000 water pressure test — since, by their reasoning, “it could prevent water damage that costs tens of thousands to repair.”

This kind of approach doesn’t demonstrate care for customer safety — it shows a business model focused on upselling and inflating costs under the guise of safety.

reviews.text:
I strongly recommend ASAP Drain Guys & Plumbing, especially technician Mathew, for their outstanding service.
I contacted ASAP yesterday afternoon after my tenant reported a toilet drainage issue. The company informed me that a technician would be on the way within two hours and confirmed that no emergency or urgency fee would be charged. (I had contacted several other plumbing companies before deciding on ASAP.)
Mathew demonstrated excellent plumbing expertise and strong communication skills. Upon arrival, he quickly identified that tree roots were the primary cause of the blockage in the drainage line. He clearly explained the issue and provided several repair options.
After 2–3 hours of dedicated work cutting and clearing the roots from the drainage system, the toilet was fully restored and flushing smoothly again. My tenant is extremely satisfied with the results.
ASAP charged exactly as quoted — with no hidden fees or emergency charges — and even provided a $75 discount.
I truly appreciate their professionalism, transparency, and quality workmanship, and I would highly recommend them to anyone.

reviews.text:
I have completed  a number of reviews for Action because ours has been a challenging phased approach of replumbing our home and renovating our main bathroom. Anyone who owns a home over 100 years old knows that the home promises surprises.  For us, our fear regarding the  plumbing that would be found once the bathroom floor was removed was justified. It became obvious that our current configuration did not meet code. Plumber Dan worked with the building inspector to discuss acceptable alternatives. Both included us in the discussion. Ultimately, we purchased a more tradition Moen system. Dan once again demonstrated patience as he worked with us on placing our shower fixtures. I am 5' 10.5", my partner is 5'4".

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Yavapai, Coconino and Maricopa Counties
plumbers.address: 248 W General Crook Trail, Camp Verde, AZ 86322, USA

reviews.author: Elijah Poulos
reviews.text:
James from Mr. Rooter was excellent! He came out, accurately diagnosed our septic system's issues, and fixed everything the same day (the day after Christmas too). So happy with everything we even signed up for their advantage plan the same day for regular service. Great job!

Update: So, maybe not so great after all. So, the 1st time James came out, the problem was that power had accidentally been cut to the septic system, and it became clogged. Turns out, my ststem has an aerator/agitator and a pump which all require electricity.  Ok fine. James pumped the effluent tank (into my yard) and unclogged the pump/system, and it worked for about 2 days. I still think James was good, not a reflection on him, he did his best. But, turns out I have an "aerobic alternative" septic system (fyi I'm new to septic, as in just bought the house and it's my first) and even though Mr. Rooter installed the thing new in 2017 (at a price tag of nearly $60K as the install receipt was included in the home purchase) they really don't currently have anyone with experience working on these systems. Over the next couple weeks they had to send out several more techs, and even a "supervisor" to troubleshoot my system. I honestly got the feeling they'd never really worked on an alternative system much, and one of the techs flat out told me he "hated" these alternative systems and had no idea what he was doing! He said "I'm just going to try and figure it out because I'm the only tech available today" but of course he couldn't. But that didn't stop them from charging me!! Turns out after all the drama, and over $4 thousand dollars!!!!!, my pump/emitters were just gummed up- again (see below) and then the leach field just became saturated because I didn't know anything about these, and I exceeded the gallon/day flow capacity 2 days in a row (which i had to look up myself). Mr. Rooter nickle and dime'd me at every turn, even when they were just "trying to figure it out". What a waste of time and money. At one point they told me they'd have to dig up the whole thing and replace the lines/emitters bc they "might be clogged". They didn't even have the install schematics, despite them installing it just 7.5 years ago, because they "upgraded their computers" a few years ago. I found the schematics from the inspection report and gave to them myself! On the last day I asked what I needed to do to keep everything running smoothly going forward, and wasn't provided any real guidance. For example, I asked why the original install had a notation about "Chlorine tablets" and the supervisor actually said "yeah, sometimes people have to do that" seriously!?! I ended up having to research all this myself!! I found a label on a cylinder near the system and called the number on it, in Clearwater TX, and turns out it's an automatic Chlorine tablet feeder!! And the manufacturer told me it's "absolutely necessary" for my alternate system to function properly! No mention of this whatsoever from Mr. Rooter! In fact, that company told me Mr. Rooter wasn't even certified to work on alternate septic systems anymore!!! Would have been nice to know! To top it off, it takes a special Chlorine tablet I ended up having to order online (not the pool Chlorine tablets Lowe's tried to sell me) which took 3 weeks to arrive.  Needless to say, since becoming a self-educated "expert" now on alternate systems, and putting in those special Chlorine tablets (and not overloading my system anymore) it's been working perfectly now. Just a terrible overall experience, and I feel like I was taken advantage of and mislead by Mr. Rooter, which was very costly in both my time and money. Maybe they do a good job on "normal" septic systems, but definitely don't use them for "aerobic alternate" septic systems, at least not until they get someone who's actually certified in working on them!! I hope this helps someone else avoid my mistakes. And, if anyone knows who I can/should call to service my aerobic alternative septic system in the future, please comment on this review!!!

I would have been out over $11,000 and left with a torn apart driveway and a problem that was unsolved.  I am so angry, I feel as though my money was stolen in addition to an unresolved problem.  I will never ever recommend your company.  In fairness, the people were nice but I feel as though they had no idea what they were doing.  I feel as though they basically were grateful and had manners as my money was sucked out of my wallet and I was left with no clear picture of the problem or solution. reviews.text:
Great experience with YES! so far. Our furnace went out, they came the next morning (Saturday) and it’s now working great.

I also really appreciated the time that Sawyer spent explaining things to us. Very informative and helpful in helping us make a good decision about what we may need in the future. He was great!

We will use them again.

reviews.author: Frank Tello
reviews.text: Sterling came out to do a tune-up on our HVAC system and did an excellent job. He was friendly, had a great attitude, and took the time to keep me informed throughout the entire process. He explained what he was checking, answered questions clearly, and was professional from start to finish. I’d gladly have him back and would recommend him to anyone needing HVAC service.

reviews.author: Tom Williams
reviews.text: I’m installing a new oven and found that the electrical needs for the new oven exceed what I had available. I called Yes! And had an electrician at my house within the hour. Kayden Dooley, who has done electrical work at my house before, arrived and knew both my needs and the house. He got right to work and he was joined by George Webb. Together, they ran a new electrical line, upgraded my circuits and made quick work of it so there is no delay in my moving quickly ahead with my project. I felt great seeing Kayden again.  It’s like having my own personal electrician on call.

reviews.author: Shauna Mayer
reviews.text: Sterling was professional, kind and informative. He worked fast and was very helpful. He made clear the issues with my furnace and gave me great options. I definitely recommend Yes.

plumbers.name: Dial One Johnson Plumbing, Cooling & Heating
plumbers.address: 158 Hood St, Cedar Hill, TX 75104, USA

reviews.author: Morgan F Bilbo
reviews.text:
Came out. Inspected furnace. Did nothing. Gave 2 estimates. One for repair, one for new thermostat. Both way, way overpriced. Charged $89 for coming out.
Today, got someone else. Fixed furnace, charged total of $75. Said I don't need a new thermostat, don't need any parts for repair.
So apparently you are just sharks. Charging too much and trying to snow me!
You are not the only ones to try to do this. I hope you enjoy the $89. Because that's the last you'll hear from me.

reviews.author: Melinda Alcorn
reviews.text: Friendly and personable. Did the work right away. fixed our leaking pipe under our house in a jiffy!

reviews.author: Texaspete
reviews.text: We had several plumbing issues in our kitchen. Michael was great, was very efficient, knew exactly what we needed and performed flawlessly. Afterwards he answered all our questions and even gave us some helpful tips. We had work done by other companies but Dial One is now our favorite for any future jobs. Signing up for service plan, we also got discount on this job so at the end we paid fair price for the job. Thank you Michael for job well done. Katie C, Duncanville

reviews.author: Jeremy Reddinger
reviews.text: Great business and an amazing technician. Polite , knowledgeable, efficient, professional, and great communication are all traits that describe Emmett who serviced or central air unit. I would highly recommend getting any work needed based off of this one interaction with Emmett and this company.

reviews.author: Bionca Arradondo
reviews.text: Jose was amazing.   He explained things concisely and it was easy to understand what my options were. He was considerate of my time and patient.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter
plumbers.address: 3717 Huckleberry Rd, Allentown, PA 18104, USA

reviews.author: Michael Palmer
reviews.text: Our experience with Roto-Rooter was exceptional.  The service technician, Kevin, went above and beyond. We called, everything was professional, on time, quality work, and a reasonable price.  Recommend this company.

reviews.author: Tawnie R.
reviews.text: I manage a mid rise senior building and Vince has been out here a handful of times now and my residents love him. He's polite, explains what's happening and he's very knowledgeable. So very grateful for you guys.

reviews.author: Shana Kay
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Roto-Rooter. The service was professional, timely, and exceeded my expectations from start to finish. The team was knowledgeable, courteous, and took the time to explain everything clearly, which I really appreciated. It’s not easy to find a business that delivers this level of quality and reliability. I’m very satisfied with the service I received and would absolutely recommend them to other businesses looking for dependable and efficient service.

reviews.author: Javier Aviles
reviews.text: Carlos my technician came pretty much an hour after I called which is super fast. He was professional, informative , and friendly. The issue with my sewage was solved rather quickly. So yes I am extremely happy with my results and will definitely recommend this company to my friends and family for sure.

reviews.author: Megan Konrath
reviews.text: Our techs were absolutely amazing. They came in, made sure the job was done RIGHT, and cleaned up the entire area and looked like no one was ever even there. I had been trying to get this garbage disposal and dishwasher installed properly since November with different companies, and finally decided to call Roto-Rooter and that was the best decision we could’ve made. Everything works perfectly and I have ease of mind knowing the plumbing is in good condition.

plumbers.name: Smart Plumbers Inc. DBA Smart Plumbers & Rooters
plumbers.address: 2175 Ronald St, Santa Clara, CA 95050, USA

reviews.author: Art
reviews.text: I have hired Smart Plumbers over the past 10 years for a rental and my residence. My experiences have always been positive. Relative to the costs associated with plumbing, I believe Smart Plumbers has been affordable and I can depend on them for a quality job.  For this specific job, Joe and Victor removed a water treatment unit and reconnected the main line in my home. In doing so they also installed a cutoff valve in the line accessible from inside my garage.

reviews.author: Brian Fogarty
reviews.text:
The first appointment I made the workmen did not show up, or call with an update if they were still coming/not coming. The second appointment I made went smoothly. The workmen arrived within the given time frame and completed the work in less than 20 minutes.

The workmen seemed to be knowledgeable about their field of service and what the issue I was having could be. My toilet issue appears to be solved for now (turned out I had a faulty and/or plugged-up filter system). They replaced the entire part and installed the new one.

I would seek their assistance in the future and I would recommend them to anyone looking for a solid plumber.

reviews.author: mark brady
reviews.text:
Professional staff from the start sent two expert plumbers, one a manager, who performed the work quickly right before a holiday.  Fantastic service, great work.
The already low price was even discounted for the elderly owner of the property. Amazing company, they are now our plumbers hands down.

reviews.author: Mike R
reviews.text: Long time customer.  They just came out to replace a water heater they installed 15yrs ago.  I did no maintenance on this water heater at all for 15yrs and I'm surprised it lasted this long.  They recommended a Bradford & White 55gal 15yrs ago and I replaced with a 50g Bradford & White, I'm going to be better about draining it every few years and hopefully get 20yrs out of this one!  They are probably not the lowest price but definitely  not the highest price and they will not take advantage of you.  Everyone I've dealt with over the years at Smart Plumbing is super nice, courteous & friendly.  This is why I keep calling them for all my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Chris Goodfellow
reviews.text: Called them after 10:15 am. Technician was here by 11:05 am. Very thorough. Snaked sewer line in several places. Clog is gone! Great service. Have used this company for years. Highly recommend.

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing & Drain Services of Duncanville
plumbers.address: 1019 Explorer St, Duncanville, TX 75137, USA

reviews.author: Mark Laird
reviews.text: Hunter Hinz was an incredible plumber and technician. He solved my issues fast and was considerate in explaining the problems while proposing solutions. I would definitely work with him again.

reviews.author: mindi goegg
reviews.text:
They were able to schedule my appointment the same day and gave me 2 hour window.  Which they called to make sure I was available and then also texted me and let me know my technician Athens was on his way.
Athens was there within 15 minutes.  He was very nice and professional.  He was also very honest with what had to be done.  Which I
Appreciate that.

reviews.author: Micaela Ikner
reviews.text: Johnathan was my plumber. He was very friendly, professional, and let me know about my different options. He gave the pricing information upfront. He worked quickly and efficiently, and installed my new garbage disposal with no problems. Satisfied with my service.

reviews.author: David Davis
reviews.text: Chris with Benjamin Franklin Plumbing came to our home in Midlothian to diagnose and clear a drain stoppage under our slab foundation. He was professional and courteous in addition to his technical skills. Chris diagnosed the problem quickly, provided insight to the issue, and explained how to avoid problems in the future. Lastly, the fee was very reasonable. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: ASHOK PATEL
reviews.text:
Jonathan from Ben Franklin was very professional and thoroughly explained all the steps which made very easy for deciding the type of work that I need him to carry out. He took care of the whole situation in timely fashion and left the area very clean and functional.
A.G. Patel MD

reviews.author: Shane Sanford
reviews.text: I recently purchased the whole house filtration along with the reverse osmosis system and couldn't be more pleased! The whole processes was seamless and quick. The team that installed it did a wonderful job with customizing where we wanted it placed and how the finished product looked. They explained all the processes and left us great tips on how to make it work the best.  Support has also been very friendly! Thank you!

reviews.author: Jesse
reviews.text: Purchased our whole house water filtration system with Plumline and they came out super fast, installed the whole system, their technicians walked me through everything and how it functions. The Technicians were respectful of my house, cleaned up after themselves and were a pleasure to work with. I would highly recommend Plumline , so happy with my purchase

reviews.author: Rob Bagford
reviews.text: I had a great experience. Everybody from one is very nice and direct the service guy Nando get an excellent job. He was quite efficient. He didn’t take very long at all   I read this man as a 10 out of a 10 very personable. Very nice to the point got the job done. I hope all your technicians are as good as Nando.

reviews.author: Mark Heyner
reviews.text: We called Plumbline to help us diagnose and repair a couple of significant, lingering issues from a recent, badly-flawed HVAC installation.  The work involved two separate Bryant systems.  It seems the work that Plumbline - specifically Peyton - did for us has finally resolved these issues.  Further, Peyton was respectful, knowledgeable, informative and communicative throughout the process, and cleaned up thoroughly afterwards - going above and beyond, really.  The company was very good about coordinating and communicating regarding scheduling.  We've found that none of these things can be taken for granted, up to and including successful execution of the work.  It's no secret that Plumbline tends to be more expensive than other service providers, but we value their predictability, courtesy, cleanliness and good communication as much as we value their good work.  Well done.

reviews.author: Braden Hellewell
reviews.text: Plumbline installed new wiring for a Level 2 EV charger, and provided the charger and installation as well. It went very smoothly! The initial consultation appointment was scheduled for a Saturday, a quote was given while they were here and the work was done by Tuesday afternoon. Overall, very pleasant experience and the charger is working like a charm!

plumbers.name: Rooter-Man Plumbing Austin TX
plumbers.address: 15503 Patrica St, Austin, TX 78728, USA

reviews.author: William Stewart
reviews.text: All I can say is it feels really good to know a good plumber. We had replaced the grease seal on our toilet at work and a couple of months later the odor came back and the guys came and saw the degree seal we had and failed and so they put in a better one. Contacting ruderman was easy having the guys come as scheduled was easy. I will use them in the future.

reviews.author: Nam Hoang
reviews.text: Eddie is a good man. I appreciate when people take time to take off/cover their shoes when entering my home. He examined the situation, he took steps to find the problem in the least intrusive way. When he determined the leak was coming from the water lines against the side wall, he tried his best to minimize the damage of just ripping apart the wall (which I greatly appreciate).  Found the source of the leak, fixed it and cleaned up. A+++ Thank you Eddie

reviews.author: Vladimir L
reviews.text: Jay and Matthew provided great service at a good price. Came out on short notice and got my drain unclogged. Would highly recommend for plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Melissa L
reviews.text:
Eddie with Rooterman Plumbing went above and beyond today! He came out the very same day I placed the call and provided outstanding service. Not only did he replace all of the piping under my kitchen sink, install a brand-new garbage disposal, and add a new basket strainer, but he also replaced the wall switch for the disposal that went out — at no extra charge! Eddie worked efficiently, explained everything clearly, and left the area clean and dry. I’m very impressed with his excellent work and Rooterman’s customer service. Everything was handled in one visit, and I now have total peace of mind knowing the job was done right. He even offered to check on any other plumbing needs while he was here, which I really appreciated.
Highly recommend Rooterman Plumbing!

reviews.author: Charlie Jones
reviews.text: Eddie has been performing plumbing related services at my residence for years and I cannot say enough good things about him and the entire team at Rooterman. I consider them extended family and would recommend them to everyone. ~ Charlie

Thanks

reviews.author: victor ramirez

Admiral was able to get Justin here within a couple hours to help with a fountain we have in the backyard that was broken leaking out water. Justin helped shut off the water and provide useful information on the water system in our home. We appreciate all of the information that Justin provided and the quickness of him getting here/the service.

reviews.author: A.J. Rounds
reviews.text: We love using Admireal at Keyrenter Provo.  They've been a great partner for years.  Thanks for helping out with our HVAC needs.  Prompt, professional, and Economical.   You guys are awesome!

reviews.author: Blake and Laurissa Jones Bills
reviews.text:
We just had Nick come out and fix a water heater that was under warranty. The pilot light went out and it was having issues. He figured it out fast and got it up and running smoothly in no time and the warranty covered it all.
He was so nice and professional and explained their annual service plans. Knowledgeable, professional, and kind. Thank you for getting our hot water back Nick!

reviews.author: Jeffrey J
reviews.text:
Competitive price, good HVAC work. I trust they aren’t trying to over charge.

Gavin installed my new heat pump and furnace. He’s also the guy who comes to service it. This “installer is also servicer” method lets installers see any issues so they can improve their craft. Haven’t had any issues.

reviews.author: Nadine Ford
reviews.text: We called Roto-Rooter because our toilet was flushing very slow. We had Khup come and do our service of removing the toilet and finding a toy my toddler and flushed down. He did an excellent job of getting the toy unstuck without damaging the toilet. Thanks to him it saved us from having to also buy a whole new one!!

reviews.author: Batgirl 1118
reviews.text:
John was hands down the best contractor I’ve worked with. He showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and fixed the issue the right way — not the quick way. No upselling, no pressure, just honest advice and solid work.
You can tell he takes pride in what he does. The job was clean, efficient, and done to a higher standard than I expected. If you want someone who actually knows their stuff and stands behind their work, he’s your guy.
Wouldn’t call anyone else.

reviews.author: Kia Morning Flower
reviews.text: I can’t believe that a plumber/technician came to me and my family’s rescue on Christmas Eve! He was so positive and respectful. He did an excellent job and even explained what the problem was with my clogged drain. It wasn’t just the garage disposal but an air admittance vent!

reviews.author: David Fites
reviews.text:
Angel did a
tremendous job. He went above and beyond the call for us . He was very pleasant and a joy to work with.
Very professional.

reviews.author: Alaina Nance
reviews.text: Was lucky to have my workplace serviced by Angel. He had such a great personality and made the time he was servicing feel like it went by fast. Also was consistent in updating me and my team on updates regarding our plumbing issues. 10/10 service, will definitely be requesting Angel if any other issues may arise regarding plumbing

reviews.author: Amy Andresh
reviews.text: They came promptly on a Sunday, and had my issue fixed, professionally and neatly. Majic and Jack were very personable and knowledgeable. I wouldn't hesitate to use them again and highly recommend The Plumbing Source.

reviews.author: Larry Sarjeant
reviews.text: I have had The Plumbing Source work on numerous issues in both my home and business.  They are very professional have been prompt in responding to emergencies.  When there have been less expensive options to solve an issue, they have given me all the pros and cons to each issue.  I highly recommend their services for your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Kathleen Sloe
reviews.text: Mack and Casey were very professional, prompt and attentive to our needs.  Mack explained issues and possible solutions before starting any work.  Once they started working, they worked diligently and finished in a timely manner.  We are happy we chose Plumbing Source for our well storage tank (& parts) replacement.  We would recommend them.

reviews.author: Ed Allen
reviews.text:
Tyler and his apprentice arrived on schedule and were professional in both appearance and demeanor. They efficiently addressed two issues, provided excellent customer service, and repaired the problems thoroughly. They also cleaned up the work area before leaving, which we greatly appreciated.

From the initial call to schedule service through paying Plumbing Source’s reasonable fee, the entire experience was smooth and positive.

We will call on them for future plumbing matters.

reviews.author: Chris S
reviews.text:
Needed a faucet repaired and water heater replaced.
Was very happy with the response time for repairs; Was also very happy with the explanation for what was wrong and why I needed a replacement versus a repair. Plumbers were very professional, work  was done quickly.  Everything cleaned up very well!
Felt the price was reasonable as well.

plumbers.name: JT Services

reviews.author: Tiffany Ridenour
reviews.text: We noticed our septic tank backing up. We called JT services and they sent Keeton out to pump it for us. He was very professional and answered all our questions. He gladly explained how our septic system worked. Highly recommend Keeton at JT services.

reviews.author: Andy Romsa
reviews.text: The folks from JT Services were the best. They dealt with rock, soil and terrain issues. They worked out solutions to each problem and accomplished the job in an exemplary and professional manner. The finished project is great and they went above and beyond to get us back to a fully functional treatment system. Thanks so much, y’all are the best, from the staff at headquarters to the installers in the field.

reviews.author: Eldon Riley
reviews.text:
Had an emergency backup and they were there within hours.  Jake went above and beyond to clear the blockage which turned out to be caused by a previous plumber's broken snake in the line.  Jake used critical thinking and ingenuity in devising a method to retrieve it.
Also a shoutout to Quincy who came and pumped the septic tank during all of this.
Office people were very pleasant to talk to and everyone was professional and friendly.  Thanks for saving the day!!!

reviews.author: Aaron Peters
reviews.text: We are highly impressed with JT services. From the moment we called and spoke to customer services and had an appointment made everything went smoothly. Keaton came to our house. Was extremely thorough and knowledgeable. He gave us multiple options that we can do he helped us out tremendously. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Chad Costes
reviews.text: Great company with wonderful staff. Everyone is friendly, professional and knowledgeable. Was very thorough throughout the entire process and explained everything that was going on. Definitely recommended!

plumbers.name: Halpin Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 5177 Fishwick Dr, Cincinnati, OH 45216, USA

reviews.author: Rebecca Keating
reviews.text: Christian did an exceptional job with his partner today. They were both very professional. Christian knew exactly what to do, he did it with perfection, and he pulled me in on every decision which needed to he made. This is always important so there aren't any surprises at the end! The vanity with new plumbing looks great! He had to make a hole in the drywall to remove the old faucet which came straight out of the wall, but we can fix that with no problem.

reviews.author: Nyonu Lewis
reviews.text:
I recently had some extensive plumbing work done and I’m so glad I chose Halpin Plumbing. Charlie and Caleb were absolutely great to work with. They showed up on time, were professional, and were very thorough in their work.

What I appreciated most was how clearly they explained everything they were doing and took the time to answer my questions. They were also upfront with their pricing, so no surprises at the end, which I appreciated.

If you’re looking for a reliable plumbing company, I highly recommend Halpin Plumbing. Be sure to ask for Charlie and Caleb!

reviews.author: Brett Bick
reviews.text: Halpin is our go-to for any plumbing needs. Very competitive pricing, great work, and an awesome personnel team.  Shout out to Alecia and Christian for helping us immensely during inspection period while selling our home, as well!  We've had nothing but consistently positive experiences with Halpin... Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Douglas Jose
reviews.text: Luke and Joe came back less than a week after installing a water heater that was now leaking. They quickly figured out that the water pressure was way too high, and were able to quickly replace the pressure regulator to fix the problem, very affordably. They were able to come on two hours notice, since they got a cancellation that day.

reviews.author: Alex Long
reviews.text: Christian and Mason did an excellent job fixing my hot water heater.  They were on time to the appointment, professional, explained the issues well, and they had the necessary spare part in their van and were able to fix the issue within 30 min.  Most importantly, Halpin Plumbing is honest with their quotes.  Specifically, they charged $200 for a job that Apollo Home wanted $1,700 for (predatory pricing).  I will always be recommending Halpin to friends & neighbors.  Thank you!

plumbers.name: Locklear Plumbing
plumbers.address: 409 S Wall St, Calhoun, GA 30701, USA

reviews.author: Lex Newsome
reviews.text: The team showed up in a timely manner. They were very efficient. In 2 hrs or less, we were good to go with a new water heater. They did what they said they would do and got us out of a predicament. As far as pricing I am not exactly sure what others may charge for the same service. But convenience and efficiency is worth something. And they were certainly great in those areas. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Siri
reviews.text: Absolutely a company I trust and will (and have) recommend to anyone who prioritizes trust, safety, and transparency. You know from a photo who's coming. They're professional punctual, and in my budget and they will need in yours too. Give them a go and you too will know. The professionalism and standards they hold to are getting more scarce but it's good to know some still stand tall. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Janet Wilson
reviews.text: During the coldest winter ever one of my pipes cracked. I didn’t know what to expect the girl at the office was so helpful and gave me an appointment the next day. The technician was there right on time he was so courteous and helpful. I was pleasantly surprised at his honesty and knowledge. I thought that this kind of service was gone but from the beginning it was a pleasure to do business with Locklear Plumbing

reviews.author: Catherine Stevens
reviews.text: Locklear Plumbing replaced my natural gas water heater with a Bradford White model at a reasonable price. Alden and crew did an excellent job with the installation. It passed inspection on the first pass. It was a pleasure to do business with everyone I encountered at Locklear. All were polite, pleasant, and professional. I will definitely contact them again for my future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Matthew Bello
reviews.text: Locklear has been one of the best plumbing companies that I have ever worked with in my life. The gentleman who visited our home, Cobey was unbelievably helpful and kind. He explained every step of the process that he took and after everything, I felt nothing but satisfaction in regard to the job that he did. Would highly recommend Locklear plumbing and if you decide to give them a call, ask for Cobey.

plumbers.name: American Rooter Services
plumbers.address: 2629 Sandy Plains Rd #201, Marietta, GA 30066, USA

reviews.author: Ans
reviews.text: My expansion water tank went bad so I went online to Thumbtack and hired American (Georgia) Rooter Services to get it replaced. The contractor (Jay) did amazing work on the replacement tank and pex piping. He encountered a rough time accessing my main water shut off valve due to the city but handled it like the pro he is and conquered the job. Im very happy with the outcome and the customer service. Im very sure the water pressure in the house and bill will reflect that happiness as well! Thank you for your professionalism and expertise.

reviews.author: LaDonna Jones
reviews.text: George from American Rooter was very professional and knowledgeable. He took the time to clearly explain the entire water heater installation process and answered all of my questions. I truly appreciated his patience and expertise. Excellent customer service!

reviews.author: Ashanti Hughes
reviews.text: There was a new leak from my water heater. I was out of warranty and nervous. I contacted Thumbtack and was connected to George of American Rooter Services. He was amazing! He explain the issues and what needed to be done. The level of eduction and the ability to easily explain an issue I had no knowledge of made the experience more pleasurable than the worry I originally felt. Thank you George! I appreciate you!

reviews.author: Anne Ashworth
reviews.text: I contacted American Rooter Service for my failed sump pump and was scheduled the next morning (at my convenience) for a 10am -12pm window.  Angel and Chris arrived promptly at 10, diagnosed and clearly explained the issue, and had it repaired for a fair price in a timely manner. They were courteous and professional and wonderful to work with and were finished long before the 12pm window closed.  Happy to have reliable plumbers in my address book to refer to friends!

reviews.author: Aron P.
reviews.text: Showed up on time and did the job for my in wall pinhole leak which already have am insurance claim. Assured me that I will get reimbursed the total I paid this company by the insurance with the way they make their invoices. The person who said also said they will refund me the difference if I don't get the money from the insurance company.  Took me more than a week just to get a legible invoice from this company that can be accepted by the insurance. Guess what? Insurance company only reimbursed me for 63% of the total invoice. I contacted the same person who came and said about reimbursement to ask the refund. He will not honor what he said. They can do the job but beware of what they say to hook you to do the job. I told him to keep the money and live with the dishonesty. Why is it so difficult to find an honest company these days?

plumbers.name: All Aloha Plumbing and Drain Cleaning Oahu

reviews.author: Ray Kakuda
reviews.text:
I selected All Aloha Plumbing because their response time to my request was faster than the competition.

I am pleased with the work because of the quality and professionalism displayed by the service technician, Ray and the follow up communication from the staff.

I would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Cindy Ikehara
reviews.text:
I started a review,, but my phone froze. So I’m starting again. I’m extremely happy with the service I received from All Aloha Plumbing. A routine underground pipe cleaning resulted in finding out that the pipes were deteriorating and needed attention.
Joseph, the head plumber who is certified in pipe lining is very professional, respectful and spoke in terms that I could understand. His partners Josiah Cody and Al were great too.
I was very happy with a professionalism of the office staff Lani and Hailey. They kept in contact with me throughout the whole procedure..
I was also amazed at the forward technology this company uses. They showed me videos of the underground pipes during their
progress.
Be sure to join their club, even though there’s a yearly fee … they will come out and do a yearly inspection of your pipes, give you priority appointments and you receive a discount as well.
As you can see, Joseph explained everything to me clearly and precisely.
As you can see, Joseph explained everything to me clearly and precisely.
It was an expensive job, but I am confident that I made the right choice with All Aloha Plumbing.

reviews.author: Rie Luangkhoth
reviews.text: Joseph came to replace our sanitary tee pipes in the grease trap. It was not attached correctly when we got a lease this location. He did excellent job! We will call All Aloha Plumbing next time again. Thank you!!

I am so appreciative of how professional this company treats their customers.  Follow up was awesome too to ensure we were ok.  Mahalo nui!!!! I would highly recommend this company for your emergency plumbing and construction plumbing needs.
