reviews.author: Vanessa Holley
reviews.text:
Plumbing technician Raven H. was very professional & outstanding.  Raven was assigned to arrive at my home to replace a water pipe which erupted due to unstable weather conditions.

Due to his craft, Raven replaced the water pipe with accuracy and diligence.

Raven H., Thank you for your support & service.  May you continue making a difference.

reviews.author: Pam Pecku
reviews.text:
We had a plumbing emergency in the evening. I contacted Roto-Rooter to see if we could get a technician to come that same day. The staff got us on the schedule that evening and kept us updated on when the technician would arrive.

Earl, our technician, was efficient and quickly completed the work to our satisfaction. Hopefully we don’t have another emergency 😅 but if we do, we know who to call!

reviews.author: Richard Beall
reviews.text: Vicente was very quick, courteous, and professional. The work he did was also clean and looks better than when he arrived. Would recommend 100%. Now only if his employer would correct his name tag. 😊

reviews.author: Shreyas Viratia
reviews.text: Earl was quick and honest with his free review and went to make a run at the local Home Depot to make sure his part of the job got done the same day once I confirmed the work.  Gave me some good advice and was thorough with his work. Thanks again Earl and hopefully this fixes any potential leaks.

reviews.author: Bailey Doyle
reviews.text: We had Michael Kress come today to inspect our pipes following multiple/reoccurring issues. He was personable, professional, and a joy to work with! We are so grateful for his patience & dedication to helping our family!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 650 E Terra Cotta Ave #110, Crystal Lake, IL 60014, USA

reviews.author: Esther O
reviews.text: Jonathan was super helpful with my plumbing issue and made sure there were no leaks after the job was done. He was very kind and worked quickly and professionally. I would recommend him to anyone who needs an understanding plumber.

reviews.author: Mary Hawkins
reviews.text: Bruno & Steve were very helpful not only at talking me through what caused our main line slowness/backup, but also daily preventative measures. We were also able to talk through bigger picture needs down the line. Our home is an investment, and they were easy to talk to about protecting it. Never felt like I was getting upsold.

reviews.author: Epic Battle Reenactments
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was swift to respond to my request. The technician they sent, Azzi, arrived promptly on site and demonstrated his skill and expertise at handling the fixes and installation required. He was dedicated to completing the task on my behalf and overall was a pleasant interaction. I am very satsified with his work and the experience given!

reviews.author: Eric Ohlrich
reviews.text:
Our house has had issues with roots clogging drainage pipes for years so we have had a few different companies come and resolve the issue, Roto-Rooter was very thorough, Israel and Mike were very professional, kind, and patient. They explained everything they were doing and why, even giving us information about our pipes and issues that could arise later on. Israel and Mike didn’t just stop once the clog was cleared, they went through the pipes multiple times in order to guarantee the pipes were completely clear and told us the further steps to take.

The price was a bit steep, it was around 720$ for them to do this service which hurt, but unfortunately it wasn’t too surprising.

Overall, overpriced, but they were very knowledgeable and took the job seriously and worked through it thoroughly. Will be using Roto-Rooter again, after our wallet recovers 😅

reviews.author: Sagar Mehta
reviews.text: This is from Saturday morning. Bruno, Steven & Kyle came to check in the drainage issue. After going to the root cleaning in the pipeline process they were able to pull the roots and waste. The pipeline has got some real issue that merges into the city sewer. All them tried really hard and put in 5+ hours of work. They are helpful and I recommend them for your services

plumbers.name: Black Plumbing Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 4402 S Danville Dr, Abilene, TX 79605, USA

reviews.author: Missy Pu
reviews.text:
On 4 Dec, my home warranty insurance notified Black Plumbing about a leaky faucet.  Black Plumbing called the same day and made appointment for 5 Dec.  Josh (the attending tech) called to inform me he would be later.  That was GREATLY appreciated, respectful and just good customer service.  Josh came over diagnosed the problem (which had to be rectified the following business day).  Mind you, this faucet was not for daily use so the Monday appt was ok.  Josh discussed the issue and gave me options.  He left but the faucet was leaking , I called Josh and he had to come back to make pipe adjustments.  The leaking was ceased.
He returned Monday to replaced the faucet.
The faucet was pretty much identical to the original one.
I am very satisfied with the service I received from Josh.
He was very professional, courteous and showed no signs of disgust because he had to return.
Thanks Josh

reviews.author: courtney dodd
reviews.text: Black Plumbing Heat & Air has been excellent to work with! Thanks to Chad L., we got our master shower fixed! It was a new construction mistake and our worst nightmare. He knew exactly what we needed and how to get it done! We were so pleased with the service and attention to detail that we hired them for the plumbing (another fix) and mini splint in our mother-in-law addition. Everything has ran smoothly thanks to Chad staying on top of it all! Thanks for the great service! Don’t hesitate to call Black Plumbing Heating and Air!

reviews.author: Cesar Rodriguez jr
reviews.text:
Huge thank you to the team at Black Plumbing for coming out and fixing our drain so quickly and professionally. Everything is running smooth now!

Also, shoutout to the very friendly dispatcher — I believe her name was Lilly she was extremely helpful and made the whole process easy from the start.

We truly appreciate the great service and would highly recommend Black Plumbing to any business needing reliable plumbing work. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Brent Brazell
reviews.text: I’ve been doing business with Black Plumbing in commercial and residential for years, and they’ve consistently gone above and beyond to deliver top-quality work at the exact price they quote—no surprises. Everyone I’ve dealt with there is friendly, personable, and incredibly knowledgeable. I can’t recommend them highly enough. If you’re looking for a reliable plumber who’s fair on pricing, shows up on time as promised, and truly knows their craft, Black Plumbing is the company to call.

reviews.author: Kim New
reviews.text: We've had Black Plumbing out3 different times, the most recent was Friday, February 20th. 1st fix a pipe that was causing my washing machine to overflow(had a different company come out but never told us this was an issue), 2nd- run a camera to check on what was causing toilet to not flush correctly, 3 rd -  fix the issue that was found with toilets. We've always given a quote of the cost of repairs. If they finish the job sooner, the price is adjusted. Amazing young men came each time. Sweet and explained everything to us.

plumbers.name: Mr. Drain
plumbers.address: 6217 Ross Ave, Carmichael, CA 95608, USA

reviews.author: Christine Alves
reviews.text:
I was referred to Dr. Drain Plumbing when I tried to wash my hands and had no water to the house. After calling Dr. Drain Plumbing, I schedule an appointment for them to come as soon as possible. I received a text message that the technician Gregory Bray was on his way. Gregory dug up the area and found the large break in the pipe. One of the reasons was the pipe was never installed correctly when the house was built. The pipe was to close to the surface and then the snow came and low temps.
The repairs took two days due to some issues with the glue. The new pipe was installed lowered, covered with installation and the dirt put back in the area.
The crew was extremely friendly, efficient and knew exactly what they were doing.
I so appreciate the amazing service!

The only thing I wished is I would have asked for a senior discount (10%) which would have helped a lot with the cost.  I always forget about this discount.

reviews.author: Manuel Navedo
reviews.text:
I called them when my water heater started leaking, and they were able to come out the very next day. Upon arrival, Greg thoroughly explained what was happening and walked me through several options, including replacing the existing tank with a similar model or upgrading to a tankless system.
I’ll be candid — the quotes were not inexpensive. I didn’t have the luxury of shopping around extensively because I needed the issue resolved quickly. A brief comparison suggested the pricing may have been somewhat higher than average. That said, when I asked whether they could complete the work the same day, Greg immediately confirmed they could. Within minutes, he coordinated with his team, arranged for the selected equipment, and within about an hour they were removing the old unit and installing a brand-new tankless system. What truly stood out was their attention to detail and respect for my property. The installation area is surrounded by white carpet, and they took extra precautions to fully protect the space and keep everything clean. While the cost may be on the higher side, the same-day resolution, efficiency, professionalism, and care they demonstrated fully justified the price. Overall, I’m very satisfied with the service and the outcome.

reviews.author: Anthony Lockhart
reviews.text: Good morning Mr. Plumber Mgmt: Grayson Crowley and Robert were outstanding professionally oriented and customer focused technicians.  They were extremely committed to attempting completion of the project within one day. However, due to the necessary layers of compacting required for backfill the project ran into two days, and they relentlessly completed the job with the same vigor they demonstrated on the first day. My compliments to Mr. Plumber for employing such dedicated technicians as I emphatically state JOB WELL DONE!

reviews.author: J. FANNING
reviews.text: If you ever need anything to do with  plumbing, Mr Drain are the people to call, they're Technicians that did the work for me, Grayson Crowley and Ceaser, made the job of changing out my sewer line look easy and they did a complete re-plumb and re-pipe in a 7 day's time well 1 day was for inspection which it past with flying colors. Grayson made sure that the job was done to his own strict standards, my house is old and he made sure that their work would probably outlast the house or it's occupants it definitely added value to the house, where it was lacking before, the greatest thing about these people they told you up front what the cost was going to be and there was no additional add on fees for problematic situations that arose, when you look at the work after it's done and the water pressure you  have you smile  and think that was money well spent. A great investment to an old home. I thank Mr Drain and Grayson Crowley and Cesar Loya for the great job they did.

reviews.author: Hal Anderson
reviews.text: The home PRV (Pressure Relief Valve) failed causing far too much water pressure in our home. This could have caused damage to anything related to plumbing including copper pipes, pipe seals, water heater, toilets, dishwasher etc. Also the pipes were improperly installed when the house was built. Joseph had to replace the whole system correctly. All work was exemplary. Completed above expectations.

plumbers.name: 615 Plumbing
plumbers.address: 475 Metroplex Dr #108, Nashville, TN 37211, USA

reviews.author: jenny Cruse
reviews.text: We were able to get a quote and same day service. Chris was an awesome technician and ran a whole new water line for our new Refrigerator in just a couple of hours. Excellent work and service. Highly recommend 👌

reviews.author: Candace
reviews.text: 615 Plumbing did a great job for us. They came out quickly, fixed our plumbing issue, and installed a new faucet. The technician was professional, friendly, and made sure everything was working perfectly before leaving. We really appreciated the quick response and quality work. I would definitely recommend them and will call them again if we need plumbing help.

reviews.author: Marina Barisic
reviews.text: Caleb came out to service my home and I am beyond grateful for him! He first started with a full diagnosis of the quality of my pipes which was amazing! I love that now I am fully aware of the integrity of my plumbing system. Next, he got down to the root issue of the call: a clog in my main line! Within an hour, Caleb had resolved the issue. I never once felt like I was being pushed to buy… Caleb showed professionalism and patience with me during the whole process. While I decided what to do, he patiently waited for me and never once pushed me to make a decision. Seriously can not say enough good things about this technician. He could have rushed our appointment as it was his last call of the day but no, he literally addressed every issue with pure knowledge and interest. I am truly shocked at how lucky I got to have Caleb as my tech. Thank you 615 plumbing and Caleb for taking a huge weight off my shoulders.

reviews.author: Tinà Clàrk
reviews.text:
Called because I need a flange for my toilet. They set an appointment that same day. The sent Caleb, he was very informative,  pleasant and very professional. He gave me more than one option of what needed to be done to fix the problem. He answered any question I asked him. He did an excellent. Thank You Caleb!
I would recommend 615 Plumbing!

reviews.author: Mallory Day
reviews.text: We had a great experience with 615 plumbing. We had a leak and were able to get someone to come out the same day, which was amazing! Max was extremely helpful and kind. The service was fast, efficient, and friendly. We would definitely recommend this company, and will use them again.

plumbers.name: Just In Time Electrical & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2200 E 104th Ave # 205, Thornton, CO 80233, USA

reviews.author: Ethan Carter
reviews.text: We had Just In Time Electrical upgrade our service from 150 amps to 200 amps, as well as install a generator connection with interlock.  Our home was built in 1964.  Not only were they cheaper than 3 other bids, but their service & quality was A+, 5 stars.  Austen did an excellent bid & scope of service, and was able to schedule the 2-day project weeks ahead of other bids.  On site, John & John were incredibly professional, detail oriented, code experts, extremely hard working.....and NICE and PLEASANT.  Finish work was great, even all screws on covers aligned.  Chose Just In Time with confidence.

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.text:
They did such a great job.  These smart switches were too smart for me and the house was a mess with wires everywhere (I did that).

They came in and were very personable and professional. I would highly recommend. They had a good price and got everything working correctly.  A++

reviews.author: Mary Blanton
reviews.text: Jay did a fantastic job! He was great with communication, arrived on time, and took the time to walk me through everything that was going on. He’s a really kind person with great energy, which made the whole experience even better. I was dealing with a plumbing issue, and he handled it professionally from start to finish. I would definitely use this company again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Ben
reviews.text: Excellent overall experience…got a fair price for replacement of three light fixtures. Austin was very prompt, knowledgeable, and courteous. Also received estimates for several other jobs. We would definitely recommend this company.

reviews.author: Craig Ruvere
reviews.text:
I've had my share of mixed experiences with electricians in the past, but Just In Time truly stands out. I recently needed several outlets installed and repaired in my basement, and I was impressed by the professionalism of John, John, and Dante. They were not only courteous and honest, but also incredibly hardworking, clean, and meticulous in their work.

The pricing was transparent and fair, with no hidden fees or surprises. I can confidently say that I will choose them for all my future electrical needs, and I strongly encourage you to reach out to them for yours. You won’t be disappointed—this team delivers exceptional results. Thank you for a fantastic job!

plumbers.name: ARS / Rescue Rooter
plumbers.address: 3620 N Frazier Industrial Park Dr Bldg 6, Conroe, TX 77303, USA

reviews.author: LeJon Stanley
reviews.text:
EXCELLENT Service!  I had a yearly check up on the heating system.  Justin showed up right on time!!  He immediately got his equipment and was prepared to work.
Yet I asked, if he could hand me the Christmas ornaments that were in the attic.
No problem he responded!!
He preformed the check up, replenished a fluid and brought something to my attention that would need to be accomplished in the future. He completed the job within an half hour or less.
Justin was courteous, informative,  confident and very knowledgeable of his assignment.         Thank you ARS, especially Justin, for a job well done!
PS I also want to thank Joshua from last year,
he put the boxes up there for me. And had the same work ethics as Justin 😊
Excellent Job guys!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: R D
reviews.text: Worst customer service, my first appointment no one showed up to install a hot water heater, never got a courtesy call about it either.  Second appointment was rescheduled last minute and again no courtesy call.  The third appointment magically disappeared from the schedule.  The only pleasant part of the experience was Tyler who came and looked at my old system and advised us on what we needed in a new system for the house.

reviews.author: Eva Fletcher
reviews.text: ARS did a great job scheduling our leaky plumbing repairs during the holidays. Gives us a peace of mind that they cover 24/7 emergencies as well if needed. Plumber Victor addressed our repairs masterfully. He inspected our newly purchased home with his professional eye. He immediately recognized all plumbing needs that needed attention to get our home in working condition. Victor is very professional, knowledgeable, courteous, and mindful. Will definitely call again for any future needs Recommend A++ service.

reviews.author: Treesha Burright
reviews.text: They offered a very reasonable deal for a tune up and the technician was extremely thorough. He showed pictures and explained everything to us as well as giving us recommendations for upkeep. We didn’t feel any pressure to buy anything and felt like they were very honest.

reviews.author: Kiley Fisher
reviews.text: Cory was informative, respectful of our needs, and willing to go the extra mile to help with a plumbing issue we had. I was very comfortable having him in my home. Also, communication was excellent! Great service all around!

plumbers.name: Doyle Plumbing
plumbers.address: 18860 Clarke Rd Ste 113, Parker, CO 80134, USA

reviews.author: Matt Turpen
reviews.text: I had to call Doyle for water leaking out of the wall from a unknown location. It was easy to schedule, they gave me a reasonable time frame and notified me in a reasonable amount of time when on the way. We had Christian come out to help and he was great. Very personable and explained what he was seeing, going to do and why. He talked to me like we were long time friends already. It turned out we had more of an issue than what I thought but I appreciated that Christian first took the least invasive route before having to eventually make holes in the wall. I was very comfortable with him in my home and with my family. I have used other bigger brand plumbing companies, who I'll never call again. I would highly recommend calling Doyle Plumbing if you need their services.

reviews.author: Kate Eitelman
reviews.text: We had maintenance performed on our tankless water heater. Christian did a great job, explained everything very thoroughly and was prompt and courteous. Price was more competitive than other companies we have used in the past for the service. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Jeff Carson
reviews.text: I’ve had two great experiences with Doyle now, one for a smelly toilet, another for a leaking water heater. They are kind, attentive, and do great work, and give a sense that they are charging fairly, rather than trying to get you to sign up for some lifelong payment membership b.s. coupled with overcharging like other companies. They are interested in doing great work and gaining repeat customers the old fashioned way. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Mary Eyers
reviews.text: A neighbor referred us to Doyle Plumbing.  We are SO happy with the ability to send someone out quickly. Dustin was super nice and walked us through with how to reattach the tube to the water valve for the toilet.  He then walked us through the installation of a new fill valve. He gave us tips and suggestions on how to replace the fill valve in our other toilets. We highly recommend Dustin with Doyle Plumbing. Super great guy, who is very knowledgeable of his work!!

reviews.author: Deepak
reviews.text: Plumbing work for dialysis machine required inlet and outlet in one of our rooms going to the unfinished basement. Dave and Robert did better than what i could have wanted. Folks were very kind, thorough and cleaned up after drilling the floors for the connections. Without doubts, i will always think of then when i need plumbing.  Old fashioned very honest folks, difficult to find anyone like Doyle. Call them if you need plumbing, and then thank me later… for recommending them. One of the best in the plumbing industry.

plumbers.name: Action Plumbing, Heating, Air Conditioning and Electric, Inc.
plumbers.address: 1338 S Midvale Blvd, Madison, WI 53711, USA

reviews.author: Jenny Roblero
reviews.text: My family has been using Action Plumbing and Heating for years, and they've always provided great service. This year, we needed a new heating system, and Action Plumbing and Heating took care of everything from start to finish! They guided us through the selection process, helping us choose the perfect system for our needs. The installation was smooth!  Matt Sc. and everyone I talked with was professional and efficient. What really stood out was their commitment to customer satisfaction. They promptly returned to address any questions and resolve minor issues we had after the installation. Their ongoing support and expertise have kept us loyal customers. I highly recommend Action Plumbing and Heating for any plumbing and heating needs!

reviews.author: Vaughn Creamer
reviews.text: Got quotes from a handful of plumbers. Action's wasn't the lowest, but it was competitive. Ended up choosing them because of the places I called, they did the best job of connecting me to someone who could answer some questions I had about the project, and they were able to schedule it for the next day. The plumber, Trey, did a great job with the install, and also went above and beyond to answer a few other plumbing questions I had (and was spot on with his advice). Would recommend.

reviews.author: Massitan Coumare
reviews.text: I will recommend Rodney’s service for his professional skills, expertise and friendliness. He was able to narrow our issue down to the exact location. His expertise and knowledge allowed us to solve an eight weeks on going issue in less than 2 hours. We paid a fraction of the projected price based on phone calls to similar businesses in our area. We were satisfied beyond our expectations. Thank you Rodney.

reviews.author: Tim Annear
reviews.text: Reid with Action was great! Highly recommend. I had an issue with my kitchen faucet’s hot water pressure. He initially suspected a filter cartridge issue, so he bought and replaced it. Unfortunately that didn’t solve the problem and the whole unit needed replacement. He didn’t charge me for the filter replacement, only the standard service fee which I would’ve paid anyway. Very honest and professional business practice, and I’ll definitely call them again for future needs. He also mentioned that Moen offers a lifetime warranty and gave me the info for that. Overall, excellent service!

reviews.author: Cathy Pearson
reviews.text: Troy was fantastic! Not only did he come early, ready to work, but he gave me specific action steps regarding my water bill. His price was VERY reasonable. Thanks so much! I’ll definitely be calling on you guys again!

plumbers.name: Tidy Tank Plumbing, Sewer, and Septic
plumbers.address: 740 McArdle Dr, Crystal Lake, IL 60014, USA

reviews.author: Kevin Morrison
reviews.text: Great experience with Tidy Tank Septic! Brad handled my septic pumping and was incredibly helpful. Not only did he get the job done smoothly, but he also took the time to explain my whole setup and what to watch for over time. I left the visit knowing a lot more about my system and confident about when I’ll need service next. I’ll absolutely be calling them again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Hyung J. Kim, MD
reviews.text: They performed residential septic tank service at my house. They did a wonderful job. They were professional and courteous. I highly recommend Ron's Tidy Septic Tank Service!!

reviews.author: Sabine Vosters
reviews.text: Was contacted by Tidy Tank Septic reminding me that the last service had been almost three years ago, and did I want to schedule a service. Set up an appointment for the very next day. They arrived at the scheduled time and got the job done thoroughly and efficiently. They explained what they were doing and documented everything in pictures and on the invoice. Their prices have gone up quite a bit since our last appointment, but I guess it's on par with every other price increase in the country. A very professional experience all around, I would definitely recommend this business to anyone looking for septic tank maintenance.

reviews.author: Terry A
reviews.text: I called Tidy Tank plumbing because my sump pump line broke. Dan was here within 45 minutes. He looked at the obvious issue but then investigated further to make sure that there were no other related issues such as frozen drain lines, etc. He went through all of the options from doing a simple repair to replace it with a top quality sump pump and backup system. He did not push me in any direction nor try to upsell me. Once the choice was made he had all of the equipment on the truck, completed the work, tested the system, and cleaned up. I've always had very good luck with their septic service and now I can add their plumbing service to that.

reviews.author: angelique archos solhi
reviews.text: TJ was polite and very professional.  He was even better at his job!  He replaced a disposal and faucet as well as reconfiguring the entire pipe system. He explained everything that needed to be done and was quick and efficient.  I will recommend him to my friends and family. I will also use his services in my new home going forward. Excellent!

plumbers.name: Griffin Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 3389 Orcutt Rd, Santa Maria, CA 93455, USA

reviews.author: Korinne Leal
reviews.text: James was sent to my home for a leaking valve and he replaced it quickly and efficiently. Thank you James, we appreciate you!! Elizabeth was also amazing!! Elizabeth provided great customer service from start to finish over the phone. Both James and Elizabeth are great representatives of Griffin! Thank you again, have a blessed day! ☀️😃

reviews.author: Ray Hallenbeck
reviews.text: Only one call and I had Noah out to install a shutoff valve required by my insurance company.  Noah also replaced two faulty ball valves on the line.  His work is impeccable, neat and clean.  All work also comes with a warranty which I appreciate.  He was polite, on time and efficient.  The admin staff at the office was also top notch.  Thank you

reviews.author: Rob Tesdahl
reviews.text:
Cris from Griffin Plumbing was amazing. He was very thorough when investigating our issue, making certain to provide a fully informed plan and estimate. He was also very patient with our questions about our options.

Elizabeth was very professional yet friendly while working with us to schedule the work, making an honest effort to work with our schedule. And when there was an unexpected conflict, she contacted us immediately with a sincere apology and options for rescheduling.

The whole team at Griffin has been wonderful

reviews.author: Dennis Hennessy
reviews.text: Exceptional service. The workmanship was first-rate, the job was done right the first time, and the level of professionalism was impressive. Obviously, Noah takes great pride in his work. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Christina Jaramillo
reviews.text: I have not had service like this in decades. The Griffin Plumbing team quickly responded with a normal team of people who actually coordinated with each other and me to provide a friendly & knowledgeable solution to my two plumbing problems. The house now has an unclogged sink that another plumbing company failed to resolve after two visits and a brand new beautiful touchless faucet that I didn’t even need to shop for. This company gave me hope in the failing service industry. Thank you.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 30 Courthouse Sq # 301, Rockville, MD 20850, USA

reviews.author: Hartridge William
reviews.text: Vicente thanks for a Job well done! Arrived as promised. Completed repair efficiently. Definitely will recommend Roto Rotor to family and friends.

reviews.author: Marissa Brienza
reviews.text: Vicente was an excellent technician! He gave a thorough explanation of the issue (defective P-trap under our bathroom sink) and was transparent with the quote. The work was performed efficiently and effectively. I would definitely recommend Roto-Rooter and specifically Vicente for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Roseann Richardson
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter was there for our family when we needed it most, our repairman Vincente was professional and patient.  He was straightforward and knowledgeable with any questions that I had during his service visit!  He completed the tasks and reaffirmed that everything was working fine!

reviews.author: Robert Fontana
reviews.text:
Absolutely terrible experience.  Wanted to repair a single clogged drain pipe in the front of the house.  Roto-Router told me the cost was $841!  I said that the job could not possibly cost that much -- I estimated at most 1-1/2 hrs labor and perhaps a bit for PVC parts.  The repair person said "OK, how much do you think it's worth?"!!!  I suggested $200 and we finally agreed on $300 -- $541 less than what he wanted to gouge me for!!  After about 1-1/2 hours, he destroyed one section of pipe with his heavy machinery, leaving the problem worse than before.  I called our local landscape company, and they found that the problem was simply a 3 foot bad section.  They replaced it, tested for leaks, and everything is like new.  Cost ... $195.  (Interesting that this was my own estimate!). If I could leave 0 stars, I would have done so.  Use this company at your own risk!

UPDATE 20 November 2025:  After posting my review, I received an email from Roto-Rooter's Customer Service Manager who told me he had sent my complaint to their General Manager.  The GM called me the same day, only to tell me that I did not understand how difficult the job was and also that Rotor-Rooter always provides high estimates since they EXPECT THE CUSTOMER TO NEGOTIATE DOWNWARDS!  After explaining to this gentleman that I had another company fix the problem and the damage done by Roto-Rooter, he reluctantly said that he would refund my $300.  Guess what?  Never heard again from them, and never received my refund.

I once again contacted Customer Service, and within a day received a nasty email from one of their service guys.  He told me that I should be happy to have paid $500 less than the going rate, and that I should have known that I signed a waiver that any damage done by them was just too bad.  Of course, no mention of the $300 that they promised to return to me, but rather another snarky email.

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY unless you really enjoy being fleeced and ending up with bigger problems than what you started with.

reviews.author: Robbie Shanley
reviews.text: Victor Lyan was awesome. We had a big clog and he went above and beyond to help us out. He spent more time than we had anticipated trying to get the job done right. Highly recommended!

plumbers.name: Emergency Plumbing Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 3354 U.S. Hwy 23 N Suite A, Delaware, OH 43015, USA

reviews.author: Tiffany Emrich
reviews.text: Best Plumbing Company in Ohio! Thank you for assisting my tenants when they had no hot water. Great communication from the office and technician. Got a new hot water heater installed same day for a very fair price in a world where everything is so expensive. Will refer Emergency to all my friends and family and will only use them for my rentals!

reviews.author: Chris Martin
reviews.text: 10pm at night, we discovered our main sewer line had clogged and started backing up into our basement.  Thankfully, we caught it immediately and limited it to only a small puddle.  I Googled for an emergency plumber and to be honest... Emergency Plumbing Heating & Air was not at the top of the list, therefore not my first choice.  However, they were the first to answer the phone for being a 24/7 service.  Seth had appeared at our door within an hour of speaking to someone and was very quick to diagnose and quote a cost.  Within another hour, the clog had been cleared and everything was back to normal.  Seth was very professional in explaining everything as he was working, and given the late hour, his efforts were greatly appreciated.  I highly recommend Emergency Plumbing Heating & Air as a first choice for any emergency needs.  I know who I will NOT be calling next time as the first 24/7 service didn't return my call until 8am the following morning.  Thank you!  and thank you Seth!!

reviews.author: B R
reviews.text: I had had multiple jobs that needed done 5 days after closing on my home and a dishwasher problem from a Home Depot dishwasher “installation” gone wrong. One call did it all! I called and was able to schedule an appointment next day. Rob and Corey came out. They were on time, wore shoe covers, were uniformed,  polite, professional, personable and got 4 sinks, 1 toilet, 1 shower and 1 dishwasher all fixed  in one day. THEY WERE GREAT!! Will recommend their service to anyone needing fast fixes done by friendly faces!! Thanks so much for such a great experience!!!

reviews.author: Don Gardner
reviews.text:
Apex Pros (the pros that blows) came out to "clear my sewer line." They failed miserably. I suspect they didn't try. The technician "couldn't get the auger into the pipe." They were pushing a huge repair project saying the pipe could be collapsed. I told them I would like a second opinion and all of a sudden the technician was able to get enough augering done to let water flow. APEX quit at that point and left without saying a word. Despite their ineptitude I was forced to pay an outrageous fee for their failure.
Fortunately I called Emergency Plumbing Heating and Air for a second opinion. I informed them of the situation and they went about their work. Jimmy Davis and Kobe Gurley were outstanding. They immediately found the partial blockage APEX left intact. The cleared it with their auger out to 56 feet without any problems that couldn't be fixed with elbow grease and professionalism. They fixed the problem and recommended a further course of action which would be accomplished the very next day weather-permitting.
On their second visit, Cory Wilson and, again, Coby Gurley, came out in freezing temps and jetted the whole line out to the sewer tap.
Outstanding job.
On both days, the Emergency Plumbing Heating & Air crews were professional, personable, informative and let me know each step along the way what was going on. If there was a need to change pricing for extra service, I was told upfront and not pressured into making a decision.
I know this is a long review, but these guys did a great job!!!!!
If you need sewer line work, don't call Apex -- the Pros that Blows.
Call EMERGENCY PLUMBING HEATING & AIR first.

reviews.author: Maximilian Ekey
reviews.text: Family friend referred me when my heat was broken and my pipes were frozen. Brody, the plumbing expert, reassured me that my pex pipes wouldn’t burst and that it would be safe to wait for Tim, the HVAC expert, to come from another job. He saved me the trouble of opening the walls to find the frozen pipe. Tim was able to get the furnace running better than when it went out, which quickly unfroze the pipes. All around excellent professional service and thank you to Doug and Owie for getting everything scheduled so quick. I will definitely be using these guys again.

reviews.text: Tony was excellent. He gave great customer service, he was personable, and got the job done quick. I am extremely appreciative of the work that was done in my home. I also had 2 toilets which is difficult to rod and Tony got it on the first try. Amazing work. 10/10 would highly recommend. Please REQUEST TONY

reviews.author: Bobby Lowstetter
reviews.text:
Hussein did the work for me. I cannot express how awesome he did. I had a flood happen due to my sump pump failing and not only did he replace it for me, he taught me how it worked and showed me what different parts were for. He also took the time to diagnose another quick issue for me and teach me a few more plumbing things.

The service was overpriced but, they worked with me on it.

I cannot express how thankful I am for Hussein and his work. Thank you so much Hussein!

reviews.author: Miles Heck
reviews.text: I repeatedly confirmed (four separate times) that they would be able to inspect my house and identify what needed repair. Despite those assurances, they gave me a window of time they would arrived. Five hours after the window concluded without anyone showing up. They then called to say they couldn’t perform the service at all without offering any explanation. Completely unprofessional and shockingly disorganized. Total waste of time. Would never recommend to anyone

reviews.author: Adam Woodburn
reviews.text: This company ruthlessly stripped us of our savings. We called them to unplug a drain and run abatment on our basement after 2 inches of groundwater got in. We were under the impression insurance would cover it. When we were denied coverage, Roto Rooter demanded $24,000 from our pockets and threatened to put a lien on our home if it was not paid with in 2 months. There are far more sketchy details here. But the bottom line is this billion dollar company represents everything that's wrong with a capitalistic society. Don't trust them. They are awful.

reviews.author: Paul Wisowaty
reviews.text: I had the drain rodded and it worked fine for three days and was plugged up again. I ordered a Jet Snake 100ft Sewer Jetter on Amazon based off of the reviews and it cleaned the pipe for a fraction of the cost. Employees at RR were great, just won't be needing them anymore since I have a new little green friend.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 505 Progress Dr #119, Linthicum Heights, MD 21090, USA

reviews.author: Aldo Peralta
reviews.text:
TL;DR I would not recommend for big projects as they will try to bill the max amount to the insurance company. Also you will need to be coordinating for company since the internal teams do not speak to each other when working with them for multiple jobs since I needed to text them daily to keep the work flowing.
Work started on Feb 03 2026, at first everything was going well fast response and solution giving. Proceeded to work with them since time to repair and cleanup was going to be short. Insurance would cover the cleanup but not the pipe repair which I was okay with. They quoted me around 3k for cleanup to disinfect and remove carpet. The disinfect happened fairly quickly and they needed to wait for the chemicals to dry for a couple of days. On the 5th they said everything looked good and they will begin carpet removal but I told them the issue has not been fix so they decide to wait, bad idea since the 2 machines were being rented per day. They decided to leave the machines even though the carpet was dry and they would come back later to remove the carpet after the excavation team will dig up the old drain pipes (I still have not received the invoice for that project but I needed to finance the work through a bank not sure what they charge me for, they gave me an estimate only.) It took a while to schedule the excavation team and they finally came out on the 9th to do the work which they completed in a day (awesome by the way) but they left a mess since the sanitization crew would clean up afterwards. The excavation team also had trouble finding the metal drain pipe which led them to break more of the basement foundation. I though they had a metal detector or something since I asked them if they had something to find the metal pipe and they said yes. They also made a mess of the walk way but cleaned it after I complain since they were only going to remove the carpet that the sewage water contaminated. Also the excavation team broke one of the machines which was probably a good thing since my energy bill kept racking up. The following day on the 10th they were suppose to come to remove the carpet and machines but the employee got lock of there van and couldn't come out until the following  day. As of Feb 23 they have still not come out to remove the carpet. I have sent responses asking them about the charges on the machines that I was renting for 9 days which they only needed to be out there until the carpet was dried which was the 5th. They proceeded to ignore me and pass the bill to the insurance company. I hope this reaches someone in the company that actually cares and resolves my issue.

reviews.author: Brent Lambert
reviews.text:
I hired Roto-Rooter for what was sold and financed as a complete sewer line replacement from the house to the street, with a five-year warranty. That is not what was delivered.

During the work, a section of the original pipe (approximately 75 years old) was left in place, despite the job being sold as a full replacement. A clean-out was installed in the sidewalk even after I raised concerns during construction. The yard was excavated and left in poor condition, and two sidewalk slabs were cracked completely through by vehicle weight, in addition to scrapes and damage to other concrete and the driveway. During the backfill they cracked one of the new cleanouts and they had to be called back out to replace it.

Shortly afterward, the water service line in the same excavation area failed, resulting in a major underground leak. The County confirmed the leak was between the meter and the house — directly impacted by the area of Roto-Rooter’s work.

I have spent multiple days off work trying to coordinate follow-up because of missed or unconfirmed service windows and lack of communication. A branch manager later acknowledged issues with the work, but the proposed resolution was a partial refund rather than completing the job as originally sold, leaving me with damaged property and ongoing risk.

I also contacted Roto-Rooter again for a separate branch-line issue and paid a diagnostic fee, only for the technician to confirm what I had already identified and leave without performing a repair.

This has been an exhausting and costly experience involving incomplete work, property damage, and poor follow-through. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend Roto-Rooter.

UPDATE: Pat thank you for the response. I have already been in contact via email regarding this matter and have provided detailed documentation. I’m happy to continue working toward a resolution and look forward to corporate review and follow-up.

reviews.author: Moshe Broder
reviews.text: Israel was very helpful, knowledgeable, efficient, and kept the house clean while working.  He resolved the issue and gave some helpful pointers for the next time it could happen. There was a longer wait for service than estimated but to be fair it was a Sunday in the middle of a snowstorm and the technicians were busy throughout Maryland, and Roto-Rooter did fit me in the same day when other plumbers couldn't do it.  Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Angela Ritchie
reviews.text: 2 yrs ago we had a clog len the plumber came  cleared it out then next day told us with their video our sewer line needed replaced, for the entire job line inside and out it was quoted 14k we had multiple companies come out give quotes and no one ever verified with their own camera it was a true break, finally got someone and they told us to leave it alone.. after all that I completely mistrust plumbers as all those companies would have taken our money with out blinking twice.  Fast forward to this week we had another issue we could not get a drain line clean, only plumber to answer was Roto Rooter. They came could not clear the line, sent their video he could not access the line to view past a few feet. We understand probably needs replaced/fixed right at the joint under the clean out. I'm even more disgusted with Roto Rooter then the other companies we dealt with in the past. For 1 they quoted us 10k for up to 15ft..   the highest of previous quotes was 14k for 65 feet inside outside, digging outside permits and back fill. 10k for a fraction of the work is just astronomical. Your camera rep also pushed on my husband to fill out credit check applications about 6 times before he finally left. I then received multiple calls and a DocuSign without having confirmed we wanted roto rooter to take the job. We did it ourselves for less than 1000. In my opinion (and through both experiences I have had quotes from 7 companies) plumbing is a sharky business and please people do NOT freak out and go with the first quote. Had I replaced the entire line the first time we could have re routed for 5k and not spent 14k. Don't let the aggressive sales pitch also sway you, don't rush to make a homeowners claim, don't rush to fill out credit apps. Please get quotes from various companies.

reviews.author: Lulu Kun
reviews.text:
I recently used Roto-Rooter Baltimore for a toilet drain clog.
Technician was professional, clearly diagnosed the clog location, explained the issue, and successfully removed it. I appreciate his thorough and courteous work.
However, Roto-Rooter’s pricing is concerning. The charge for running a 6-ft snake was $450, and the only alternative option presented next was over $1,000. For a simple toilet clog, within 15 ft, this felt excessive. It would be fairer if Roto-Rooter clearly presented all available options and full pricing upfront before 'any' work.Greater pricing transparency would improve the overall experience. I see online that such a service should have costed at most $600.

plumbers.name: Progressive Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3870 Peachtree Industrial Blvd, Duluth, GA 30096, USA

reviews.author: Donald White
reviews.text:
Michael did an absolutely amazing job fixing the shower head drip in our master bathroom! From the moment he arrived, he was professional, punctual, and extremely knowledgeable. He quickly diagnosed the issue, explained what was causing the drip, and fixed it efficiently without any hassle.

Not only did he solve the problem, but he also made sure everything was cleaned up perfectly before he left. The shower is working flawlessly now , no more annoying drip!

If you’re looking for someone reliable, skilled, and trustworthy, Michael is your guy. Highly recommend his services and will definitely be calling him again for any future needs!

reviews.author: M D
reviews.text:
We woke up this morning to our master shower upstairs leaking into the office downstairs again! We had the issue repaired a few months ago by another company, but unfortunately the problem came back. Since we didn’t want to use them again, we called Progressive Plumbing.
They told us the plumber wouldn’t arrive until 12pm at the earliest, but by 11:30am the job was already finished and he was on his way out the door!
Daniel did an incredible job!! He was professional, kind, and explained everything clearly. Best of all, he fixed the issue in a way that should prevent it from happening again by replacing the previous PVC repair with copper piping.
We couldn’t be more thankful for the fast response and excellent work. Thank you, Daniel, for your kindness and outstanding service! We will definitely be using Progressive Plumbing again and recommending you to everyone we know.

Professional company from the return phone call to coming out as promised to speaking with the owner and getting the job done quickly in less than a day. So far I am plessed with there work. I will use them again in the future and definitely will refer to friends and family.

reviews.author: Barrett Madrigal
reviews.text: I've had Michael H. do several largish jobs at the house and I am very pleased with his technical skills, work ethic, and professionalism. Always explains his diagnosis, the options and related costs. Responses quickly and answers question competently. He also will point out other related potential issues or concerns without any pressure. Not the cheapest, nor the most expensive...but reliable, efficient and trustworthy. I high recommend Michael H. at Progressive Plumbing.

reviews.author: Greg Gross
reviews.text:
Awesome job. They had a cancellation and came a day early. Replaced my kitchen sink faucet quickly without issue.
Cleaned up as if nothing happened.
We will use them again.

I wanted to add that Michael was awesome. Pleasant and professional. Very easy to work with and did an amazing job.

Got some quotes for some projects down the road, will definitely be using Towne Plumber again.

reviews.text: Had a great experience with Towne Plumber.  We needed a lot of plumbing work for our renovation, and Brett did a great job getting everything done in a professional way.  He also kept me informed of apparent code issues so they could be addressed.

reviews.author: Greg Faber
reviews.text: I called with a leaking pipe in the kitchen. Towne Plumber diverted Matt after he finished another job nearby to solve our issue ( we had turned the water off). Matt addressed the problem immediately and quickly had us “up and running” with the leak fixed, up to date valves and the area where he was working cleaner and neater than before he started. Matt’s work was excellent, the price was very reasonable and the issues were resolved more quickly than we hoped for!  Towne Plumber is #1 in our book, and we recommend them highly!

reviews.author: Ivie Collins
reviews.text: I called and Towne Plumber took care of me same day. Tate was the one who came out and he was extremely knowledgeable on what I needed, and got everything taken care of right way. He was extremely nice and very professional. I absolutely recommend this company!

reviews.author: Erika Ellison
reviews.text: Brett was great! He was professional, friendly, and took the time to explain everything clearly. The service was efficient, and he was able to provide a quote for our repairs in a timely manner. Brett also made sure everything was cleaned up before he left and that is very much appreciated. Towne Plumber is a reliable company you can trust, and I would absolutely recommend them to anyone needing quality plumbing service.

reviews.author: Elisha Bean
reviews.text: Tyler and Brandon were amazing. The company had availability to send some one out almost immediately. Tyler assessed the situation and knew that my problem was going to require more than he was able to correct at the moment but he gave me options and ensured that I understood what next steps would be. Brandon came out the next morning and was able to resolve my problem within a couple of hours. Both were very professional, informative and knowledgeable. The work was completed expeditiously and within the budget that I expected. I will definitely refer Roto-Rooter Plumbing and Water Cleanup to my family and friends.

reviews.author: SPICY
reviews.text:
Nothing cheap this day if it is good.
I reached out at the beginning of the year. Company send out Technician (Josh). He did clean out the main sewer and seemed to work. I paid quite a lot of money for this. Water back in again in about two weeks after first attempt. Technician Josh came back, and he did clean out the main sewer and seemed to work again.  Water back in again in about one week after the second attempt. The third time, Josh came back with the supervisor (Jonathan) because it required a camera to see what exactly happened in the pipe. All these three attempts and camera service in the six months warranty and NO charge. Nothing works at this time because of the main pipe to the city full of tree roots and water. We can't see anything.  We have to do hydro jet cleaning, which is very expensive. Hydro jet tech ( Edgar) came to the next day and completely cleaned out and camera to check the entire main sewer in about two hours. The hydro jet really works. It's cut and clean out entire of main sewer. I saw all the videos.
He is actually located where the cracks are. Finally, the problem was solved and I'm very happy with the service.  All three technicians are very professional and very polite and helpful. Every time I call the main company back, they pick up the phone, no waiting time, and try to solve the problem right away.

reviews.author: Jade Guth
reviews.text: The first person who was supposed to come out didn’t show up and at 2+ hours past my window I called to figure out what was going on. The guy said he would be here in 30 minutes and 30 minutes later another guy showed up. That guy did fantastic. I appreciate him being up front how the cost and being efficient.

reviews.author: Michael Keeton
reviews.text: The crew arrived an hour after I called, they clean my sewer drain and showed me the blockage and what caused it. Also gave me a reasonable estimate. Thank you Roto Rooter for your service

reviews.author: W Richard
reviews.text: I want to thank Mayes and Sons Plumbing for the excellent handling of our plumbing issue and in particular Ryan in dispatch and Preston the technician.  Briefly we have a home warranty with a company that caused our situation to turn into a nightmare for my wife and I.  Being out of hot water in our home for three days, the home warranty decided they could get a tank cheaper and didn't want to let the technician from Mayes install the tank he had come to our home with. This being Friday and the thought of going through a weekend two more days without hot water jubilation turned into panic.  Ryan was able  to figure out a way to get the new tank in as I dealt with the warranty company, and Preston the technician was respectful, professional, and certainly knew his craft as he had us back in hot water quickly.  I can only say home warranty companies can be good and bad, but this company is A+++++ and I will recommend them to family and friends with confidence.  Thank you again, Ryan and Preston.  God Bless

She found the problems and while on FaceTime, clearly explained everything to me along with solutions.  Some relatively simple fixes and others a bit more time consuming.  Both the toilet, bathroom sink and kitchen sink have had off and on problems for at least 18 years with quick fixes by other companies that did not last.  Finally Jody solved the mystery!  Knowing my situation (needing to use a walker and cane)she suggested a comfort height toilet (which I’ve never heard of), and to replace my non-working garbage disposal which was a big reason my kitchen sink drain never fully drained.  Jody was patient with me and helped me to choose the toilet and disposal from afar.  Within days she was back to install the toilet (it arrived from a big box store cracked) so she took care of that calmly and went and got another toilet from Elek’s warehouse with the same specs the same day! reviews.author: Shaban El Helou
reviews.text:
Gave Monaco a call after my bathtub water started backing up and I knew I had a clog somewhere. I tried to fix it myself and ran a 25‑foot snake through the toilet, but it came back clean. At that point, I knew the issue was bigger and needed professionals.

They arrived within an hour of my call. The technician quickly located a clog outside, cleared out a bunch of tree roots, and even ran an underground camera to show me exactly what was going on. He was able to fully unclog the line and recommended replacing the outside piping in the future.

Thank you for the fast response and great service. Definitely a 10/10 recommendation.

reviews.author: Brad Kaley
reviews.text:
I’m giving 2 stars instead of 1 only because the company came out quickly both times, and the second field tech was professional and easy to work with. Unfortunately, the overall experience was frustrating.

I had a blockage in my sewer line from the house to the street that caused my yard vent to overflow. On the first visit, they snaked the drain and restored flow. However, the tech told me in person that he did not clear the line all the way to the street — only about 10 feet past the clog. He assumed the blockage was wipes based on what had overflowed, though he wasn’t able to pull anything out of the line. We have not used wipes in the three years we’ve lived here. It’s possible prior owners did, but that’s speculation. He did not document that the line wasn’t cleared to the street, but since they advertise a 30-day warranty, I didn’t push the issue.

For reference, I was charged about $800 for that initial visit, which feels high for a straightforward snaking with no camera inspection or confirmation that the line was fully cleared. They also would not provide even a ballpark price before coming out, which should have been a red flag.

About 10 days later, the line backed up again — still within the warranty window. When I called to schedule a follow-up, the person on the phone was extremely confrontational. He said that if they found wipes again, I would automatically be charged. He insisted the wipes previously found were “fresh,” despite having no proof and despite me explaining we do not use wipes. It felt like I was being accused of lying. When I referenced that their own tech told me the line wasn’t cleared to the street the first time — and that the clog may have simply been pushed downstream — I was told, “Why do customers tell us we don’t do our job properly?” The tone was unprofessional and unnecessary. I remained calm and simply explained I didn’t want to pay again for something that may not have been fully resolved the first time, especially SINCE IT WAS WITHIN WARRANTY.

Ultimately, they did return and clear the line at no charge, though they voided the remainder of the warranty. Honestly, I’m not sure if he legally could void my warranty, but I was so happy to just be done with them that I didn’t care. While I appreciated the second technician’s work, the hostile communication, lack of transparency on pricing, and accusatory tone mean I won’t be using them again. Quick response times don’t make up for terrible customer service and unclear pricing. I hope this helps others.
