Esteban is an absolute lifesaver! I was terrified at what the leak in my ceiling was going to entail. He helped me every step of the way in finding the problem, and quickly
repairing it. For a very reasonable price, I might add. Felt so good to be in good hands. Highly, highly recommended! Call this company, they are the ones you want.

reviews.author: Robert Rankin
reviews.text: Esteban did a phenomenal job! I want him to handle ALL of my plumbing needs! He was very personable, professional, and performed excellent work! Couldn’t recommend it more!

plumbers.name: Johnny Doan Plumbing
plumbers.address: 301 US-92, Seffner, FL 33584, USA

reviews.author: LA
reviews.text: Lance did a a fantastic job installing my new dishwasher. The installer from the big box store wouldn’t install it and said if he did, it would stick out 5 to 7 inches into my kitchen. Lance was able to reroute the drain line and install with no problem. This is third time I have used Johnny Doan Plumbing, and each time I have been impressed with their timelines, professionalism, communication, and pricing. They recently re-plumbed my entire home. It took Jake and team less than 6 hours and everything turned out great. The city inspector was extremely happy with their work. There estimate also included patching the drywall, which Conner did an awesome job. I couldn’t be happier with the services provided by them.

reviews.author: Amber LaHue
reviews.text: We have used Johnny Doan several times over the past year for plumbing issues we've had at two separate properties. We've had very good service on each occasion. Their communication over the phone and via email is professional, yet friendly and helpful. They always let you know ahead of time who your plumber will be so you know who to expect. Most recently, Jesse was our plumber. He showed up on time, was able to diagnose the issue, and then repair it in a reasonable amount of time. Based on our experiences with them, I would recommend Johnny Doan Plumbing.

reviews.author: Nicolle Meeke
reviews.text:
We had an incredible experience with Lance from Johnny Doan Plumbing during what was easily the coldest weekend in Tampa. After dealing with a stressful, weekend‑long main valve leak, Lance truly saved the day. Even though we were exhausted and frantic, Lance’s professionalism and calm, understanding demeanor immediately put us at ease.
He clearly explained the repairs needed, broke down the costs with complete transparency, and worked through the cold without hesitation to make sure the fix would last for decades. He showed up quickly on
Monday—and his service was not only reliable but also affordable.
Thanks to Lance, we now have peace of mind and a new go‑to plumber. Absolutely 5 stars!

reviews.author: 2015 Stronger
reviews.text:
Another good repair today by Sam, he was able to take care of a leak in the main line and now I don't have to worry about it.

Jordan, Jesse, Jake and Emily are all awesome and they take care of issues fast. Just got another irrigation meter connected today. Can't wait to use it.

I have so many great experiences, everyone is great at what they do! Water meter connection, water softener, clogging, etc. They do it all

Very professional and highly recommended! Jake was great and professional, this is the best experience I've ever had!

Awesome service again!

reviews.author: Deborah Bunton
reviews.text:
Johnny Doan Plumbing had Jesse Brown to come to our house this morning for a service call. Mr.Brown was very professional and took care of our issue in a timely manner. I highly recommend Johnny Doan Plumbing for all of your plumbing needs.

We also had the company do a repipe several months ago and their service was excellent!!

plumbers.name: 1-Tom-Plumber
plumbers.address: 36300 Lakeland Blvd unit 7, Eastlake, OH 44095, USA

reviews.author: DeWayne Jackson
reviews.text: I have three small children, one of which decided to play hide and seek with her toys and our family toilet yesterday. No matter what I did I couldn’t get the clog out. Heard great things about 1-Tom-Plumbing so I had them a call. Kevin was great to talk to and deal with and he sent out Daryl Looney to take care of me. What we thought was going to be a quick fix turned into a 3 hour adventure but Daryl didn’t stop until we finished the job. He was great.

reviews.author: Cassandra Kowalski
reviews.text: Jay was a huge help for me! I had a bad water backup in my basement (due to overgrown roots in my main lines clay pipes), and the timing was terrible with it being the holiday week - thankfully, I was able to get an appointment quickly scheduled that worked well for my availability. Jay was knowledgeable and respectful, communicated well, and worked hard (as the clear out of the external pipes required more time to jet through than planned). The price was great and fit within my budget, and the issue has been solved completely! I’m so thankful for Jay and this company, and can’t wait to take a bath soon (without worry)!!

reviews.author: Nathan Lynn
reviews.text: Jay with 1-tom completed a job working on my kitchen sink and did remarkable and professional work. He showed up on time, I received fantastic communication throughout the whole booking and invoicing process. Now my family can sleep well at night knowing our kitchen drain line won't ever flood our home again. Thank you Jay, and thank you 1-tom-plumber!!

reviews.author: Zenobia Magic
reviews.text: This is my go to plumber Kevin Zilke and his crew. Jay Hagar came and quickly found the burst pipe and went to work repairing it and gave me some tips on why the pipes burst and ways to try to prevent it. He took the time to check the whole line and afterwards he checked the water pressure in all of my bathrooms and shower after he restored my water. Great company, great workers and excellent price even in an emergency!!!! Posting before and after repair!!! First photo is before, second is after

reviews.author: Tom Yuras
reviews.text:
The night before moving into our new home, both of our toilets suddenly started leaking sewage water into the basement. Jay came out in the middle of the night and immediately put us at ease. He quickly identified the issues, explained everything clearly, and got to work right away.

He was able to fully repair one of the toilets that night, and he scheduled the second repair for later that week. His professionalism, calm demeanor, and willingness to show up during an emergency made an incredibly stressful situation so much more manageable.

We’re extremely grateful for his quick response and quality work. Highly recommend this company, especially if you need someone reliable during an emergency.

plumbers.name: Benjamin Franklin Plumbing of Prescott
plumbers.address: 6741 Corsair Ave, Prescott, AZ 86301, USA

reviews.author: The Pupp
reviews.text: Aaron was friendly and did most of the work in a short period of time.  He forgot to return to finish the job so I had to call four times. He came out and apologized as he forgot to finish the small job.  No biggie to me. What I was upset was the cost of $2K. It was excessive for the job.  I had surgery on right hand so I couldn’t do it. Aaron dug a few feet down reattach the flipper and install a new tube. Being retired with limited income the price was too high for the job. the only new parts was the 40 gage tube and cap which was about $25. The flipper was not replaced but reattached. I feel you folks could do better by not charging a high price for the type of job. The $538 to come out would have been the price to pay. The back up problem was the back flow flipper came off and cause the stop of the flow. Once it was moved the water flowed away. Other suggestions came with a price tag of $4K the back flow value was already installed. Like I said the cost was way too much.  Aaron was good doing his job.  I’m just angry at the price.

reviews.author: Paula McCoy
reviews.text:
Aaron arrived on time, he is very courteous and respectful of my home.
He worked quickly and efficiently.
He went the extra mile to assure I was taken care of.
I plan to have another ADA toilet installed after the first of the year.

I will ask that Aaron is my service technician.

reviews.author: Sydney Harrington
reviews.text:
Tom came back to check on previous employees failure to clean out tree roots. Previous employee used an electric snake, like the one we own, it got out of hand and he broke sewer line and water line, all he did was punch a hole thru toilet paper which it allowed to flush thru 2 guests in my Airbnb. When Tom came  you could tell he did not want to deal with the situation as telling my husband and I if he used his tool it would break our pipes. He never took a camera to look at the issue,  as we explained my husband and I had separated the pipes and had taken our camera to look into the issue, we had previously taken off the toilet( we are in our 70’s and my husband had a stroke wheelchair bound) Tom told us to get someone who does hydro jetting( which can breaks pipes too
Tom went back to office stated I wouldn’t let him cut pipes or take off the toilet never said such a thing. I am currently waiting for supervisor to call as I want a full refund($754).

reviews.author: Louis Ingutti
reviews.text:
The Plumber/Technician, Andrew Korland,  was friendly and professional. He listened well and added his thoughts & experience to what our plumbing situation was. He also was creative in his approach on what direction we should go in order to save money and be more efficient therefore satisfied with the job overall. Bottomline, a good ambassador for your Company!
The 2nd visit to do the install when OK but we had a few unexpected glitches that took place. It wasn’t a good experience but Andrew tried to his best to make amends to make it right. A few things could have been improved but sometimes unforeseen issues do come up. Andrew will make a follow-up visit on 3/2 to check everything out to make sure it’s to our satisfaction. Thank you!

reviews.author: Chris Mattson
reviews.text: Had an emergency. My septic tank drain from the house was clogged. Tom was great. Very professional and thorough. He diagnosed the problem quickly. Unfortunately it was more involved than just a simple unclogging and he explained the next steps to take for me to get the ball rolling on fixing it. I was impressed with Tom and the Benjamin Franklin company and will recommend you guys in the future

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 14100 Cedar Rd Ste 280-8, Cleveland Heights, OH 44118, USA

reviews.author: Jennifer Fruscella
reviews.text: Carlos was a pleasure to work with. He was professional, trustworthy, and he really went out of his way to make sure the job was done well. He was knowledgeable and explained everything to me every step of the way and I really felt comfortable with him in my home. I was lucky to get one of the best plumbers out there working on my hot water tank I also felt that the price was competitive and fair. I should also had a very good experience with the water restoration team. Matt was very helpful with explaining the entire process to me and once again I felt very comfortable with everybody in my home.

reviews.author: Shine Bright
reviews.text: Allen did a wonderful job fixing my hot water tank. He was knowledgeable and patient with all the questions we had. He skillfully fixed the issue for a decent price! Thank you!

reviews.author: Ashley Todaro
reviews.text: Matt was wonderful, very informative and let me know what was happening step by step. I’ve had issues with my plumbing for a few years and had other companies out to snake my drains and then would leave. With roto rooter they took the time to figure out my bigger issue and gave me helpful tips to fix it.

reviews.author: Angela Bolton
reviews.text: I had a frozen burst pipe that resulted in the loss of water to my whole house. Matt S 8106 showed up right on time and fixed everything quicker than I could have imagined. Not only is he prompt and professional but a friendly and personable guy that made me feel at ease with the project from start to finish. I cannot recommend him enough.

reviews.author: Richard Sanders
reviews.text: Matt S did a amazing job installing my toilet. Very knowledgeable with the situation I had. Obstacles he had to indour but was able to adjust and fixed it. I totally recommend his work and very professional.. Great Job!

plumbers.name: Goodman Plumbing
plumbers.address: 8015 Castor Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19152, USA

reviews.author: Shawn Nickelson
reviews.text: I initially called about fixing a toilet that kept running. The one piece toilet I had wasn't a quick fix nor is it something I could attempt to change the parts on. Zac (the plumber) showed up and had an answer for every question. He had a solution for every problem I had. He warned me before touching anything what could happen once we started touching things. Exactly what he said could happen, happened. Went to shut off the valve for the toilet, didn't work. Went to pull the toilet, the flange was completely disintegrated. Zac worked promptly and by himself. He installed a new toilet, a valve, and a new cast iron flange. I'm really happy with the entire situation and who Goodman sent out to to the job. I will be asking for zac specifically in the future as I know what I'm getting from him. 10/10, 5 stars, will call again and recommend. I do not ever leave reviews and literally went out of my way to leave this one because I think it's important for people to know they will be taken care of if Goodman sends out zac the plumber to their home.

reviews.author: Jennifer Rice
reviews.text: I needed a major job done and they came in significantly lower on their quote than another company.  The job was well staffed and arrived before 8am.  They had 2 teams working simultaneously in the basement and outside to replace my entire sewer line.  They restored my water the same day and cleaned up well.  They came back the next day and cemented the entire length of my basement.  They didn’t have to, but were super kind in hooking my utility sink and washer back up and made sure it worked.  They were pleasant and worked well with each other and it felt like they wanted to be there which makes the whole experience a lot easier.  Additional plus is they accept credit card payments.

reviews.author: J Ames
reviews.text: Goodman is my go to plumber. They ran new water and sewer to my subdivided carriage house 3 years ago. A big job that was done well. Today they at no charge repaired a bad washer in the meter pit(which really was the responsibility of the water company but would have been garden to get them out timely). I appreciate them. With it getting cold now the water running down the driveway would have caused a safety hazard if I waited for the water dept. I am a realtor and often refer them to clients who have plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kyler Storms
reviews.text: I had some work done to my stack pipe today. Zac and his helper Brandon were able to get the job done quickly and efficient. We were really happy with how they communicated from start to finish and took pride in their work. Overall, I was happy with the price and the work. Had multiple estimates and goodman was smack dab in the middle as far as pricing. We will be calling them back to do some work to our shower too! Thanks Zac, Brandon, and Goodman!

reviews.author: JP Flexner
reviews.text:
Nick is the best! Our hot water heater needed replaced. I sent a service request on Saturday night, and by Sunday morning Nick was here working. He did a fantastic job, clearly a has a ton of experience. Even let me hang out and bug him while he worked.

Fair price, lightning fast service, and a knowledgeable friendly expert.

THANK YOU.

plumbers.name: Paul The Plumber LLC
plumbers.address: 14543 Hwy 105 W Unit 605, Conroe, TX 77304, USA

reviews.author: Jeannette Kentch
reviews.text: Had a sink and faucet installation. Booking appointment was easy and was able to have work done within a few days. The company texted the name and photo of the plumber, which was great. Our plumber was on time, respectful, and knowledgeable. The plumbing and counter adjustments to accommodate the new sink were expertly completed. The new sink installed along with a faucet and garbage disposal, water purifier, and dishwasher were reconnected. The plumber took all the old materials out and left the area clean. I recommend this company.

reviews.author: Carla Thomas
reviews.text:
Needed a service call for
evaluation of a small drip, possible leak under a master bathroom sink…was able to receive same day service and repair. Darling call center receptionist who was so helpful scheduling me. Andrew R. ended up coming out earlier than the scheduled assigned plumber and our issue was handled quickly and neatly.

Will definitely be using Paul the Plumber for my plumbing issues moving forward!

reviews.author: Chandra Dagel
reviews.text:
Such a great experience!
We had a gas line debacle and Paul made our job a priority. He made his initial visit on Christmas Eve because we were expecting some cold weather. Although we had to wait for the City to reopen Paul and his team worked hard to complete our job on the same day they were able to start and for a fraction of other price quotes we got!
Thank you so much Paul. 💛 we will definitely use your services in the future and recommend you to friends in the area!

reviews.author: Ben Rzonca
reviews.text: Called in the morning for a service tech to come out that day and they were able accommodate us while several other plumbers stated we would have to wait several days. Andrew showed up and evaluated the issue and called their office to get us a quote. After approving their quote, Andrew proceeded with the repair. The work was done quickly and of high quality. We would recommend Paul’s for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: liyahsmommy11
reviews.text: I called Paul the Plumber early on a Sunday morning a nervous wreck about my leaking hot water heater in my attic. Deborah was very helpful and reassuring by explaining the process. Paul came to my house and had the issue fixed in less than two hours tops the very same day. His prompt service helped save us thousands in damage.  Will continue to support the business and recommend to friends nearby.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Drain Service
plumbers.address: 3350 Phillis Blvd Unit 104, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577, USA

reviews.author: Ray's G Mail
reviews.text: I was simply going to replace a toilet that wasn't emptying very well. I discovered the cause was a tree root. It looked like an Alien. I called my plumber, he said better call Roto Rooter. Glen and Drew came right out the next morning to remove the root, a couple feet long and the full diameter of the pipe, checked my system by video camera and found the entry point of the root and a bad section of pipe all the way out under my garage. They fixed both and added a 2 way cleanout, the builder hadn't done that back in 2000. Glen did a wonderful job carefully removing tile without breaking any, did the repair like a brain surgeon, put the tile back as it was and installed the toilet. Brilliant work. They cut a section of garage floor, replaced the bellied section of pipe and added the 2 way cleanout. All good now. Thank you. Oh..Kathy in the office, great communication skills..,nothing happens without that.

reviews.author: Corie Pritchard
reviews.text: Paul did an outstanding job taking care of the work I needed done in my primary bathroom. He went above and beyond to resolve a few preexisting issues with the plumbing and everything came out perfect!! Will definitely use again and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Renee Cortez
reviews.text:
I Had an issue with my plumbing. I wasn’t sure if it was plumbing or septic related. Called the office and they were very understanding and able to come out to the house the following day. My service pro Eric Walker Arrived on a timely manner   He was very respectful and professional. I asked many questions. Eric answered each of my questions with a pleasant smile and an explanation that made me feel at ease. Another service pro arrived at the house for possible video of the septic/ litch field area.
They were both very professional and found the problem right away.
I would definitely recommend this company for any plumbing issues. Cannot thank them enough for their services.

reviews.author: Deelovesher8
reviews.text: Eric Walker was our technician and did a fantastic job! He was on time, polite, friendly, thorough in his explanation of the work he was going to do, completely cleaned up the work site, and worked tirelessly most of a day. We would happily recommend Roto-Rooter and will certainly use them to complete a future project that we discussed with their engineer and may have done. Thank you, Eric!

reviews.author: John Petrill
reviews.text: Called in the morning to schedule a tankless water heater service. Was given an appointment for the same day. Glenwood arrived within an hour and when was able to flush out my hot water heater. He was very thorough and explained what he did , and showed me all of the pictures. A+

plumbers.name: Flood Brothers Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3940 Laurel Canyon Blvd Suite #568, Studio City, CA 91604, USA

reviews.author: Xavier Veales
reviews.text: Flood Brothers Plumbing provides outstanding service with quick response times and professional workmanship. The team is knowledgeable, courteous, and takes the time to ensure everything is done right. They handle issues efficiently and offer fair, transparent pricing. I’m very satisfied with their work and highly recommend them for reliable plumbing services!

reviews.author: Martina Sarzo
reviews.text:
I recently had Flood Brothers Plumbing come out and address a clogged drain in my shower, and I couldn't be happier with the service they provided. Giovanni and other plumber arrived fairly quickly and were incredibly professional, even wearing booties to protect my wood floors. They quickly assessed the situation and identified significant buildup in my drain.
Not only did the resolve the efficiently and affordably, but they left my shower spotless. They took the time to look at a few other concerns my husband and I had. Any concern we had he took the time to check out and let us know if it was a problem or not.
i absolutely loved their service and will definitely be using them again. They are truly amazing, and I cant recommend them highly enough.

reviews.author: robert sarzo jr
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough great things about Flood Brother’s Plumbing. Before finding them, I had called three other companies—each one either quoted outrageously high prices or told me they were too booked to help, especially on a Sunday night. Meanwhile, I had a broken pipe and no idea what to do.

Then I came across an ad for Flood Brother’s offering true 24-hour service. After my wife called, Giovanni—the owner himself—was at our door within 45 minutes, fully prepared to tackle a job that every other company had brushed off. Not only did he fix the immediate issue on the spot, but he returned the very next day with his team to complete the full repair.

Their workmanship was exceptional, their professionalism unmatched, and to my surprise, the final cost came in about 20% lower than the other quotes I received. They even cleaned up so thoroughly that our kitchen and bathroom were left in better condition than before the incident.

Giovanni and his team exceeded every expectation. If I could give them 10 stars, I genuinely would. Flood Brother’s Plumbing has earned a customer for life.

reviews.author: Dulce Navarro
reviews.text: Exceptional service every time. This plumbing company consistently goes above and beyond in every aspect of their work. They are extremely professional, reliable, and detail-oriented, and they always take the time to explain everything clearly. The quality of their work is outstanding, and they leave everything clean and perfectly done. It’s rare to find a team that is this dependable and committed to excellence. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jill Shields
reviews.text:
I am writing to provide feedback regarding a recent service visit from Giovanni to address a leaking shower at my home. I appreciated Giovanni's professionalism and his help in identifying the solution. We had already planned to replace the original shower hardware, and he kindly waived the $150 service fee, understanding that this would likely lead to a larger job for your company.

I requested two quotes: one for the entire job, including parts, and another for labor only. I was disappointed to find the first quote was for $4,995.00 and the second was for $2,995.00. The $2,000 difference for hardware was particularly concerning, as I could purchase the exact same parts online for approximately $1,000.

Regarding the labor-only quote of $2,995.00 for one plumber and an assistant for an estimated four hours of work, I found this to be excessive. An average plumber rate is $150 per hour, it was obvious that the quote was disproportionate. When I inquired, I was informed that your company charges a full eight hours of labor for a plumber, regardless of the actual time spent on the job.

While I understand your company has a strong reputation, I do not believe it is ethical to charge for eight hours of labor when only four are required. Due to these pricing concerns, I ultimately declined your offer and explained my reasoning.

plumbers.name: Valdel Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2431 Potshop Ln, Norristown, PA 19403, USA

reviews.author: Sarah Popek
reviews.text: Needed an emergency plumber - the intake was extremely simple and the receptionist was kind and made me feel at ease. The plumber was dispatched within an hour and was able to fix my shower quickly and easily. Very professional, very painless! I was so grateful for how easy this was when I was so stressed. Would absolutely call Valdel again!

reviews.author: Hannah Le
reviews.text:
Outstanding Service and Communication – Highly Recommend!

From start to finish, my experience with Valdel for a sewer pipe replacement using the pipe burst method was absolutely excellent. Communication was prompt, professional, and consistent every step of the way. The reception team was always courteous and quick to respond, making scheduling and coordination effortless.

A HUGE thank you to Stephen Bready, the drain specialist, who truly went above and beyond. Stephen took the time to thoroughly explain every step of the process — from the initial inspection to the materials and technology used in the pipe bursting procedure. His depth of knowledge and willingness to share it gave me great confidence in the work being done for me and my parents.

Stephen’s attention to detail, transparency, and proactive communication made what could have been a stressful repair feel smooth and straightforward. The entire process was handled efficiently and the on-site work was done within 2 days.
A reliable contractor with good communication & without price-gauging charges can be so hard to come by. They've gained a long-term customer now for all of my properties moving forward.

I can’t recommend this team enough for their professionalism, expertise, and top-tier customer service. I really appreciated how well everything was communicated from the start. Highly recommend this company and especially Stephen for anyone needing sewer line repair/replacement!

reviews.author: Mark Butler
reviews.text: Steve and the entire staff from Valdel were awesome. No strong arm sales pitch. Told me both what we needed and what we didn't need. Install of water treatment system took about 4 hours and took us through the entire process for its upkeep.

reviews.author: Katelyn Mathe
reviews.text:
We’ve used Valdel Plumbing for several of our properties and they have been nothing short of excellent every single time. Their communication is top-notch—they always text when they’re on the way, which is huge when coordinating schedules. They’re incredibly respectful of the home, wear booties inside, and leave absolutely no trace that they were even there once the job is done.
They’re knowledgeable, professional, and efficient, which is exactly what you want when dealing with plumbing issues. I’ve referred Valdel Plumbing to many of my clients and will continue to do so with complete confidence. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nick Miller
reviews.text: Writing this review for Steve. Steve was awesome, super nice and helpful. Came out and gave an estimate, came back the next day and got it done. Steve’s help kept us on our kitchen remodel timeline and moving forward. Really appreciate his time and work.

reviews.author: Catherine Ortiz

Great service. Respectful to our property and cleaned up after work was completed.

They send us pics of the completed job and accommodated a service latch.
Shawn did a great job. This is our second time using their services and they do not disappoint. I recommend Fly Plumbing.

reviews.author: Michael Hansen
reviews.text: A very positive experience with Fly Plumbing. The company is always very responsive and goes above & beyond. I had a back up in my basement on a Sunday evening. I was able to easily reach them and set up a next day appointment (they had offered same day service, but the water had gone down). I requested Adrian (he had been out before) and they accommodated my request without issue. Adrian and Ben came out and addressed the issue. They were communicative, knowledgeable, kind and attentive. They remedied my issue & left my home clean. I highly recommend Adrian, Ben & Fly Plumbing!

reviews.author: Courtney Biewald
reviews.text: Miguel and Adrian were amazing. They really helped explain the process of everything they did and tips for the future. I will 100% be a returning customer and will be recommending them to everyone in the area! Thank you again! Excellent service.

reviews.author: yaakov sugarman
reviews.text: Adrian was amazing! He was very thorough and a pleasure to work with. He explained everything clearly, and I would definitely use him again.

reviews.author: Manny Arenivas
reviews.text: Got some work done on a few drains in my basement that were overflowing. Mikhail and Mickey did a great job getting everything sealed and cleaned. Very polite, friendly, and efficient. I will only go with this crew for any job moving forward. 5 stars.

plumbers.name: Rex's Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 1829 E Mulberry St, Fort Collins, CO 80524, USA

reviews.author: MtnGirl
reviews.text:
The hot water heater in our home has a dual purpose. It heats our domestic water and also heats the water for our in-floor radiant heat system. In the fall, it had begun to leak. After doing research, we decided to replace it with an efficient and money saving, tankless hot water system, and contacted Rex’s Plumbing & Heating, upon the recommendation of a customer.
Kevin came to our home, a very knowledgeable and experienced technician,  who assessed our system and recommended a Navien Tankless Water Heater that would serve the purpose well for both our domestic water and our heating system. He then scheduled an installation time that was convenient for us.
He and Shane removed the old hot water tank and completed the installatioin one day, (a very cold day), but he did come back one morning to fine tune everything. We couldn’t be happier with their expedient service and  their professional work. And our radiant system works better than it ever has in the 23 years we have lived here. We can’t recommend Rex’s enough—give them a call for any of your heating and plumbing needs.
Our experience with Rex’s was their attention to detail, expediency, and their expert work, are rare in today’s service world. And the cost estimate was less than what we found from other companies.

reviews.author: Ray French
reviews.text: Rex’s Plumbing did a fantastic job. We were a little bit of a nightmare customer and they provided exceptional service. I could not recommend them more. Kevin our service agent was fantastic, he was conscious of our budget and did not over sell us. He was able to repair our old water heaters and extend the life. Thanks a lot.

reviews.author: Natalie R
reviews.text:
I recently had an issue that required a service call, and I cannot recommend Rex’s Plumbing enough—specifically Terra.

From the moment she arrived, the experience was top-tier. As a woman, it was such a breath of fresh air and a huge relief to see a female plumber walk through the door. It created an immediate sense of safety and comfort that you don’t always get with home service calls.

Terra was incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. She took the time to explain the issue clearly without being condescending, and her workmanship was flawless. She left the workspace spotless and made sure everything was functioning perfectly before she left.

If you’re looking for a plumbing service that is skilled, respectful, and inclusive, ask for Terra at Rex’s. It’s so empowering to see women excelling in the trades, and she is a fantastic representative for the company!

reviews.author: Jer/ Eberhard

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Reliable Heating — Blake Made All the Difference
I recently replaced my tankless water heater and explored multiple options and companies before choosing Reliable. Blake's visit sealed the deal — and his expertise likely saved me from a costly mistake.

Blake arrived within two days with a comprehensive quote. He walked me through three solid options: an eighty gallon hybrid, a non-hybrid model, and a smaller hybrid. His recommendation was straightforward and backed by real measurement — the eighty gallon hybrid would fit, and the price difference was justified. He knew his product line inside and out, and he spoke with absolute confidence about everything. He never once said "let me check with the manufacturer" or "I need to verify that" — he simply knew these systems like the back of his hand.

What really stood out: another company (TE Certified) had suggested I'd need to tear down walls to install the unit. Blake immediately recognized that was wrong — this is a zero clearance model. That kind of knowledge protected my home and my wallet.

The pricing was competitive, and Reliable was willing to match other quotes. Once I committed, the water heater arrived and was installed within forty-eight hours. The installation itself was seamless — immense preparation, care for my home, and professionalism throughout. Corey, the electrician, was exceptional as well, rewiring the old connections with the same attention to detail.

The bonus: the unit runs cool enough that it's also keeping my garage significantly cooler. Blake did warn me about that — another example of his proactive, thorough approach.

This was a significant investment, but it's already paying dividends. I also discovered that my previous water heater was causing issues with my electrical panel. Upgrading averted what could have been a real crisis down the road.

Blake is courteous, punctual, knowledgeable, and genuinely invested in getting it right. I cannot recommend him and Reliable highly enough.

reviews.author: Sean York
reviews.text:
I have nothing but good things to say about MAS plumbing. My initial call was after work, for a slow drain on my kitchen sink, I had a little bit of a slow drain throughout the week, and I thought I had time before things totally clogged up, so I scheduled my visit for the weekend (WEEKEND AVAILABILITY IS SUCH A HARD THING TO FIND). I was told that MAS could have someone come out and perform an inspection and I signed up. I tried to see if I could fix the issue myself using a hand crank drain snake, and I wasn't getting anywhere. Low and behold, later that night my sink and dishwasher totally backed up, and I knew I needed help ASAP.

I called MAS the same day at 9 p.m. and got a hold of their afterhours answering service, who let me know they would forward my call to the office to be addressed the next day. To my surprise, Carl called me back the same night! He offered to come out at 9 p.m. but let me know that since it wasn't really an emergency, he'd recommend that I just wait until the next day. He let me know that they could definitely get me in for the next day, and that he would probably be the one to come out and assist.

Without Carl I wouldn't have been able to sleep, just getting a call back from Carl letting me know that MAS plumbing could be out the next day helped me rest easy.

Carl came out the next day, and KILLED IT. Super kind, professional, skilled and also charismatic. He got the pro-sized snake out and got the job done in less than a couple hours. I could tell he really cared about the client experience, and he was super focused on getting the job done. Carl also went above and beyond and took a look at my drain line set-up so that I could ensure that it was pitched correctly.

I can't recommend MAS enough. The customer service was excellent from start to slightly panicked late-night moment, all the way to when Carl came and won me over as a client for likely the rest of my time in this house.

I'm so happy I found this Company, and Carl made me a client of MAS for life!

Thanks again, Carl and MAS!

Overall, the installation was relatively easy, except for one camera that Korey was determined to hardwire to avoid using a WiFi camera.  He got the job done and the install was clean with the more reliable wired camera. I appreciated his hard work and would recommend Amped to others looking for security systems.

reviews.author: Ashley Burns
reviews.text:
Thank you to Amped pluming for all of their help. Thank you to Zeke for coming out and giving us an accurate estimate that Amped stuck to. Thank you to Dakota Elmore and Dakota Boyd for coming and doing the work. They worked very clean and did minimal damage to our walls to get in and repair the leak. They also were very polite and explained everything that was going on as they did the fix.
When Zeke gave us our quote he also gave us a quote for getting our whole house plumbing done and once we get to a point that we can do that. We will definitely be going with them for that process.

reviews.author: Alan Wattenbarger
reviews.text: The crew at AMPED replaced my old cast iron sewer lines with PVC. They replaced the main sewer line under the slab and did a kitchen and laundry drain reroute. They did an amazing job!  They were very careful and methodical through the whole process!  It was a lengthy repair and pretty invasive to say the least but there is no way around that.  If you have cast iron sewer pipes, do not take shortcuts that other companies offer.  DO NOT do CIP pipe lining!  Just do old fashioned replacement.  You will sleep better at night knowing you have brand new sewer pipes and not a bandaid.  AMPED did a very pfofessional job and I am very happy with the work they did.  They are honest and dependable.  They keep you in the loop the entire way and the financing options they offer make the repair less scary.  Take a bow AMPED, you guys are awesome!

reviews.author: Joe Meyer
reviews.text:
Totally recommend this company! They had a technician at my house within 30 minutes after my initial call. Technician Byron is the best! He is so respectful and knowledgeable.  Byron diagnosed the problems quickly and fixed it right the first time. Not only did he fix our problems, but he also took the time to walk me through preventative measures for the future.

The service was professional, courteous, and transparent regarding pricing. If you want great work done right, call this company!

plumbers.name: Roger’s Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7696 183A Toll Rd #4B, Leander, TX 78641, USA

reviews.author: Rick RRTEXAS
reviews.text:
We had a water leak somewhere as our bill kept getting higher till it  tripled and we called Roger's plumbing.  They were very thorough in finding it I n slab. NOT what we wanted for a quick fix, but the quoted a fair price to repair and backed it up with a good warranty.
They had to replumb the whole house so floors didn't have to be jackhammered and flooring ripped up and replaced. Very good job by Eddie and apprentice Sean. They covered holes needed to access plumbing nightly.
So far we are happy, no leaks and inspection passed.

reviews.author: Michael Landry
reviews.text:
My daughter recently purchased a house with a possible slab leak that was noticed during the inspection. We called Roger's Plumbing and Marc came out to assess and give us a possible budget to work from. We negotiated the price and after purchased, contacted Marc for repair. He and his helper came out and found the leak was in the slab within 2 hours. A reroute plan for the waterline was initiated and all work completed that afternoon. They were very thorough in their work and kept the job site orderly while working. When they left you could barely tell they had dug 22 ft of new line for the reroute of the line.
I would highly recommend Roger's Plumbing for any future Plumbing repairs you may have.

reviews.author: Lou Sigety
reviews.text: Third time using Roger's Plumbing and all experiences were very good although a bit pricey. However sometimes more work is required than one would think and that seemingly pricey quote covers the unexpected.  This last time Orlando did a fantastic job installing a seemingly simple RO system and ran into some unexpected issues. He spent the time to get the correct parts and did a great job with the install. He was prompt and very professional - highly recommended.

reviews.author: Marcia Rhodes-Tyler
reviews.text: Orlando was amazing from the moment he arrived until the moment he left. He was kind, patient, and incredibly informative the entire time. It’s rare to experience this level of service these days. Thank you for genuinely caring and for taking the time to walk us through the whole process. We highly recommend using Roger’s Plumbing!

reviews.author: Sherry Todd
reviews.text: Jaskson was great!  He was polite and respectful.  He told me what he was doing each step of the way, asked my opinion and gave me options.  He left my bathroom really clean, much better than he found it.  He even brought in packages that were sitting on my front porch.  She went above and beyond.  I will definitely call Roger’s Plumbing next time, like I have for many years.

plumbers.name: DNA Plumbing Heating and Air
plumbers.address: 542 Haggard St #512, Plano, TX 75074, USA

reviews.author: Ron Sutter
reviews.text:
D-N-A plumbing was a great experience, they showed up on time. Miguel was very polite, and understood the issue, explained it to me in detail. They made the repairs quickly and the cost was reasonable. It was nice to find a company these days that that actually have great customer service, with a smile. Thank you for your assistance to resolve our issue.
PS: They each left with a homemade cookie that my wife gave them. 🤗😄

reviews.author: Cheryl Teakell
reviews.text: I called DNA this morning to see if they could fix our outdoor faucet that was dripping. The phone was answered right away. I was given a time for 4-6 pm today, but was told if they had a cancellation they would call and come earlier. I received a call around 12:30 stating they had a cancellation and could they come now. Miguel was here within 20 minutes. He gave me a quote upfront. He was very knowledgeable, professional, and did excellent work. I now have a new faucet and happy it was fixed before the weather gets bad. I will definitely call DNA again for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Thom Pettigrew
reviews.text: Called them on a Saturday evening for work. The offered to come out that evening but I was fine waiting until Monday. They showed up exactly on time, were very courteous, and did a great job… very quickly.  Zane and his assistant were very professional and friendly.  I would highly recommend this business and definitely will be using them for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Gloria Smith
reviews.text: DNA professionals repaired our septic system quickly and efficiently.  This isn't the first time we have used them.  Their honesty and quality work the last time they were out made us loyal customers and they will be the only ones we call with plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Aaron Covert
reviews.text:
Had a leaky wall in the kitchen where I called DNA Plumbing; they were able to get me on the schedule quickly. Notifications and communication were letting me know when the team would get to my house. Check the pipe pressure, opened up walls to make sure  there was no pooling of water and found that the dishwasher had a hole return hose.
Had the team make sure the kitchen was up to code and replaced the disposal system to make sure everything was properly warrantied.

Overall long day but atleast the house is dry now.

plumbers.name: Black Diamond Experts, Electric, Plumbing, HVAC
plumbers.address: 1525 W 400 S, Orem, UT 84058, USA

reviews.author: Bob McCann
reviews.text:
Great experience all around. The initial technician they sent out was outstanding. Your the best, Jose!

He not only diagnosed our immediate issue, he also advised us about the condition/potential issues with all of the components (it's an old furnace).

He took the time to lay out several repair options, from just fixing our immediate problem through several different price options to repair/replace some or all of the other issues.

We ultimately decided to have Black Diamond install a whole new furnace due to age/overall condition, but the detailed breakdown of *all* of the options and their (very reasonable) prices was very much appreciated in helping us make the best decision for our home.

reviews.author: Melanie Christensen
reviews.text:
Bryan and Zack came over first and evaluated our problem with many plugs in the attic area that needed a safer solution. They returned two days later with extra safety plug in areas with GFI.  They also gave it their own master switch in the box.
Thx guy!! Y’all are awesome!
Melanie C

reviews.author: William Martin
reviews.text:
We have had a great experience from Kris who came out to clean out backed up line then Alan who came back with Kris to run ecamera and show us the problem and quote what it would take cost and time wise to our Lead installer with Matt and Riley as his helpers. Mike keep us informed and their scheduler keep us informed and we got the job done in 3 days. Just waiting for asphalt to be patched and we will be done. Great job Black Diamond, we used them on an electrical project before and everything went just as smooth
Thanks Bill Martin

reviews.author: Michael Johnson
reviews.text: Todd and Joe repaired a shorted neutral and added a 220v circuit in our garage. They were thorough, careful, and kept me in the loop throughout the work. Joe did the diagnostic work on the fist visit, and Todd and Joe wrapped everything up in an afternoon just a few days after my first call.

reviews.author: Carissa Dib
reviews.text: This company has the best employees!  Brad was on time, professional, kind, answered my questions, explained everything well, and gave price quotes for possible changes.  The membership is well worth it.

reviews.author: Justin Garza
reviews.text: This was hands down the best plumbing experience I have had. I was reluctant to call and hire someone to do it. After I read online all the reviews I made the choice to call. From the young lady I spoke to on the phone to set up the appointment was really friendly. I got Tiffany today. Tiffany was amazing. She was 2 hours early, she was very friendly and professional. She told me everything she was doing and keeping me informed on the status. She did a wonderful job from what I thought would be maybe 30 minutes to taking a few hours. She was amazing and could not have asked for a more pleasant experience and person. She worked her butt off.  Even though I had to pay I absolutely will call again for any service. I will recommend highly to anyone who needs any type of plumbing service. Thank you.

reviews.author: Michelle Pryor
reviews.text: I own a small business in North County. Mr Rogers plumbing came and gave my facility a second opinion on a water issue that we had been having. Their knowledge was CORRECT, their work was quick and well done, their technician was skilled and communicative. They saved me tons of money on a correct diagnosis and were wonderful to work with. Cannot recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Ryan Palmes
reviews.text: Mr. Roger's Neighborhood Plumbing is amazing! As a property management company, We need vendors we can rely on. They respond quickly, complete work orders efficiently, and their plumbers are professional and friendly. Tenants always have great things to say. Excited to keep working with this fantastic team!

reviews.author: Katy Bartlett
reviews.text:
Mister Roger's' Neighborhood plumbing was awesome. They were very friendly. They took care of all my needs. I asked questions, they answered them thoroughly. And I really appreciated their service. I am elderly, and I appreciated the way they helped me through all of this period I recommend this to all my friends that are my age or even older.
Thank you so much for a bad experience that turned into a great experience.

Kathy

reviews.author: Christian H
reviews.text: Beyond thrilled with the work that Tiffany did with installing new spigots and a water pressure regulator. She was on time and provided a very fair price. Very very happy with the work completed and will be using Mr. Rodger's if we have any further plumbing needs!

Eric takes the time to explain things clearly and treats customers with genuine respect. Total kudos to Eric!

From the start, the crew members were polite and responsive, always taking the time to address any questions I had along the way. They demonstrated a great deal of thoroughness in their work, ensuring everything was completed to the highest standard.
What stood out to me the most was how committed they were to my satisfaction. At every step, they made sure I was happy with their progress, which I really appreciated. His leadership was evident in the professionalism and confidence displayed by the entire team.
Overall, the crew exuded a sense of expertise and professionalism that gave me complete confidence in the work being done. It’s clear they take pride in their craft, and I would highly recommend Tioga's services to anyone in need of plumbing work.

reviews.author: LonnieL
reviews.text: Very responsive and checked out our leaking water heater the day we called.  Knowledgeable & gave us some alternatives.  We elected to go with a new unit given age of our existing hot water heater & they had the new one installed the next day.  Kept us informed at each step of the process.

reviews.author: Samille Stovall
reviews.text: Tioga has been servicing my home now for almost 5 years. I can rest easy knowing it's in such capable hands. They come yearly to inspect both electric and plumbing. I appreciate knowing my house is up to date. All of the technicians do such high quality service and are so polite. Thank you, Tioga! Eric came out to install new disposal todzy and found a problem under sink. He got in touch with restoration company and they are on their way to look at damage. I am so thankful for the thoroughness of Eric. It gives me peace of mind.

reviews.author: Dave Fassett
reviews.text: Another flawless experience with the best plumbing and electrical company in Texas. Sam, the electrician that did the work on our home, is a hard working go getter. He is very knowledgeable, friendly, and loves what he does. He showed up proptly and did not hesitate to get after it. He explained everything he was doing and answered every question we had. This interaction and service just solidifies why I will use no one else but Tioga for my plumbing and electrical needs. As I have said in my past reviews everyone over at Tioga is top tier, from the front desk all the way to the technicians. Family owner and operated and they treat you like family. DO NOT hesitate to call them, you will not regret it.

reviews.author: Jan Hall
reviews.text:
My hot water heater was giving up and leaking called for service and they were able to squeeze me in early!  Eric was AMAZING. He was kind, knowledgeable, and trustworthy.
He even educated me as he was fixing my hot water tank issue - excellent customer service and care!
Eric was great! Can’t say enough about this company!!!

reviews.author: Michael Lietz
reviews.text: Levi and Eric were knights in shinning armor. They were both respectful and very knowledgeable. They took the time to show us the issue,  discuss options and kept everything in the truth. We will need the work fixed and will recommend them specifically.

reviews.author: Susie Johnson
reviews.text:
When I called Priority Plumbing, I spoke with a lady by the name of Candice. She was wonderful, so kind, asked many quesions surrounding my issue to help direct what the next steps ought to be. Jahziel came out to our home and he was fabulous!
We had a sewer issue and because he thought outside of the box Jahziel was able to determine the problem. No other plumbing comany could figure it out. I was so thankful.
He came with a smile on his face, very polite and took the time to explain what had happened. His service was top knotch!
I really appreciated both Candice and Jahziel. Excellent customer service!
Thank you so much
Susie

reviews.text: 5 Stars, what can I say? Clyde showed within an hour, had everything he needed to make the repair on the broken water pipe, and was done in less than 2 hours. Happy with the work and Clyde’s professionalism! Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Andy Vaughn
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Joseph Quintana on a job with a mutual client. He was very easy to work with, highly communicative, and a consummate professional! Thank you for setting the standard, Priority Home Services!!

reviews.author: Brianna Clouse
reviews.text:
**Edit to company response 5/30/24 I am partial homeowner, I took ownership in 2021 through the existing mortgage, so please add more detail.
My mother also the owner and policy holder - whom you guys have avoided and who is at a communication disadvantage due to english being her second language, I have had to step in.
We, the client of HomeServe a Home Warranty company - would never had to pay for your services. Exactly why we pay for home warranty and have full coverage for our mainline.

The issues I have as a homeowner and an unfortunate customer of Priority and Plumbing due to them being contracted by HomeServe:
- Said they would fix our sprinkler lines and electrical in Nov 2023 they destroyed.
- Got avoided by this company for 6 months UNTIL it was discovered they didn't replace 4ft of the original pipe that had SEVERE root intrusion (the entire reason we got our mainline replaced.)
- 05/01/2024 Sean Farris said they would fix the sprinklers and make this right and has continued to avoid us.

This company absolutely did not go above and beyond. Priority Plumbing and Heating HAD to come back to fix a problem they were legally contracted to fix in Nov 2023 and did NOT complete.

Above and beyond for what, adding some soil?
The stress and financial burden this has caused has been significant.

Original post 5/29/24 **Another bad Sean Farris (VP/ Owner) review on a mainline replacement (Estimated $18,000+ Insurance job.) On November 9, 2023 Priority Plumbing and Heating Littleton was hired to replace and install a new mainline on our property by my home warranty company (HomeServe.) They acted in several negligent ways, did not complete the job they were paid to perform, destroyed my front yard, sprinkler lines and electrical.
When we raised the concerns to Sean - Sean Farris, told us to kick rocks and that our concerns were not his issue. We were persistent and knew this job was not done correctly. He continues to give us the run around for 6 months, he was conveniently always in a "meeting." After paying a 3rd party to scope out and make note of all the things Priority Plumbing and Heating did wrong, they told me it would be $18k+ to fix their mistakes. I had a demand letter written up to get them to pay attention to the issues that I had complained about for 6 months.
Things they did wrong:
- Did not backfill our soil causing a sinking trench.
- Cut all of our sprinkler lines/ electrical and buried them.
- Failed to replace our mainline in its entirely, left with severe root intrusion.
-  Failed to clean up -  left old clay pipe strung along our front yard.
- Clean out caps were below ground level, improperly glued and secured.

Fast forward May 2024 - Priority Plumbing and heating said they would replace the rest of the line that they failed to replace the first time, clean up the trash they left, back fill our soil that was sinking into a trench, and get someone to fix our sprinkler lines/ electrical.
Once Sean and his crew came to fix their original issues - his crew member showed us that our mainline was leaking sewage into our front yard for six months from. Sean never mentioned anything to us other than everything looks great.

Now its a month later - Sean Farris wont return my phone calls about getting our sprinkler lines/ electrical fixed, he continues to be in "meetings"

Seans' motto is - we were paid to replace the line and thats it. If we break it, its not our issue.

Spent over $4,000 to get my sprinkler lines and electrical fixed + had to pay to get my line scoped by a third party. Spent 6 months trying to get them to fix their mistakes. Avoid at all costs this has been a horrible situation and horrible company to deal with.

I believe the only reason they came back was because HomeServe was made aware Priority Plumbing and Heating did not perform the job in its entirety that they were paid to do. IF not for that, I would still have sewage leaking into my yard, a sinking trench etc.
AVOID at all costs and do your research.

plumbers.name: Gold Star Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 8737 Florentine Rd, Prescott Valley, AZ 86314, USA

reviews.author: Aadam Lamb
reviews.text: Clay Komos did an amazing job at diagnosing and repairing our circulator pump for our home water system. Once we received the parts needed for the repair, Clay was able to able to schedule the installation within two business days. He was knowledgeable and explained what the issues were with our old circulator pump. He was also very friendly with me and my kiddos! Would highly recommend Gold Star Plumbing!

reviews.author: J Ferris
reviews.text:
Great experience all the way around. The guys that came out were fantastic; professional, friendly and knowledgeable. The job entailed cutting into our foundation slab and repairing a leaking waterline. Price was reasonable and they started the very next day. Very pleased and will use this company for any future plumbing needs I can’t handle myself.
Great job Gold Star Plumbing!

reviews.author: Angie D in AZ
reviews.text:
Outstanding Service from Start to Finish!

This was my first time needing to call a plumber in many, many years, and I was pretty panicked after my pest control company found standing water in my crawl space. I contacted Gold Star, and they were able to come out the very next day (yesterday).

Michael and Andrew arrived and were absolutely incredible—thorough, polite, informative, and truly ROCK STARS. They walked me through everything, explained what they were seeing, and shared tips I know I’ll appreciate if anything ever comes up again.

They completed a full inspection, offered clear recommendations, and thankfully confirmed that the issue was minor and completely fixable. They genuinely put my mind at ease, and I slept peacefully last night because of them.

I’ve already told my family about Gold Star and will gladly recommend them to anyone who needs plumbing help. Their number is now saved in my phone, and they will be my first call if I ever need service again.

THANK YOU SO MUCH, Gold Star! 🌟

reviews.author: Fred Kennedy
reviews.text:
After an experience with a local plumber who couldn’t resolve an emergency that stopped us from using water or sewer in our apartment complex, inconveniencing, both, us and our tenants…we went without water and sewer from seven o’clock that morning until the following day!!! We called Gold Star the evening of the first day and immediately spoke with Ann who understood our issues completely! She scheduled us for an assessment the following morning, with actual repairs scheduled for that afternoon. On the morning of the assessment, Clay, the technician, called me before eight o’clock an said he would see me shortly, he was expedient and reflected a high level of professionalism, warmth (especially on an extremely cold an wet day), and understanding!!! From the moment he introduced himself, explained the process, provided an estimate for the possible repair, and product knowledge, we were amazingly impressed! Upon his initial inspection, Clay, also, answered all of our questions intelligently, helping us understand a variety of issues we had been dealing with. At that point, we decided to do a more thorough investigation and repair, which he said he could start immediately!!! We were ecstatic!!! Upon approval of the new estimate, he began an extremely detailed assessment using a camera and an iPad to reflect the condition of our downline, the exact location of the blockage, and the condition of our sewer-line. We were impressed by Clay’s explanation of what needed to be done, both, short-term and long term! After the explanation, he began hydro-jetting our downline, our upline, and all seven roof vents on our property, including our waste-line on our kitchen sink!!! He cleared all invasive roots, cleaned and flushed all lines, removed all blockages and then videoed the mainline. He went on to show us how thorough his expertise and equipment had left our system in pristine condition!!! He then inspected the property, put away his tools, secured all of his equipment, cleaned up all work areas completely, and walked the area with us explaining the work that had been completed. He discussed future issues needing attention, and the level and quality of repair that could be done!!! Again, we were impressed and extremely comfortable with the absolute quality and outcome Clay exhibited throughout the day until the job was done!!!
We anyone could leap tall buildings, walk on water, and be faster than a speeding bullet, both, Clay and Gold Star would fit the description!!!
Thank you Clay and thank you Gold Star!!!
Humbly,
Fred & Joann

reviews.author: Suzy Kitchukova
reviews.text: I cannot even begin to explain how much Clay went above and beyond. He was so professional and easy to work with. It truly is refreshing communicating with such a stand-up guy. He had all of our issues resolved quickly. I absolutely recommend Gold Star Plumbing!!!

plumbers.name: Leak Geeks Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4708 Keller Hicks Rd, Fort Worth, TX 76244, USA

reviews.author: Jaime Mincher
reviews.text: We’ve used Leak Geeks for over 6 years and have had nothing but the best service. Always on time, always cleans up after their work and listens to all concerns and answers all our questions. We have been very happy with Leak Geeks.

reviews.author: Bryan Blackwell
reviews.text: Leak Geeks did a fantastic job installing our 2 gas water heaters.  They matched the bid from another company and still installed the Bradford White industrial heaters.  They installed them in the same footprint and met code with no additional charges.  They went above and beyond to meet all of our requests.  This is the second major plumbing installation that Leak Geeks have done for us and both were excellent work.  I highly recommend Leak Geeks.

reviews.author: Al M
reviews.text: We have used Leak Geeks as our go-to plumber for well over a decade. They are always prompt, friendly and professional, and stand behind the work they do.  They have generally been a good value for the high quality of work, tho this most recent call I was astonished at the price I was charged.  The exact part is readily available and inexpensive elsewhere, so I am not quite sure why the significant upcharge for what turned out to be a quick (and easy) install on the water line. I’ll take the blame for not requesting the estimate first before the repair was made, but will in the future.  As always, no issues with the actual work and no leaks.

reviews.author: barb55
reviews.text:
We had a leak from a past repair that was performed by the leak geeks a few years back. I called their office and explained the problem and they had a tech at my home in 20 min.
A very professional young man named Brad.
He diagnosed the problem quickly and said yes the leak was caused by faulty material and he would talk to their office boss about a warranty repair. It was approved and the repair was quickly performed by Brad.
I am very very happy with this company for standing behind their product.
I will definitely use them again for any of my plumbing needs I have a hot water heater that is pretty old but is still heating. But they will get my business when the time comes.

reviews.author: Susan Solis
reviews.text: I like the whole process. I like being able to book online. My technician Erick listen to me and gave me valuable information. He was a very professional and nice person. This was my second Leak Geek experience and I’ll definitely use them again.

reviews.author: goose goose

I couldn’t have asked for a better team, and I highly recommend The Clean Plumbers to anyone who wants the job done right the first time

reviews.author: susan massey

This was impressive. So today I signed up for The Clean Club Membership for priority scheduling for any other plumbing services I will have in the future.

reviews.author: Stella ventucci
reviews.text:
Nothing gives me more pleasure than to speak positively about someone who truly deserves it. Erick Young of Clean Plumbers arrived early in the morning and left around noon time.

When it came time for my options ,He was eager to speak jointly with my son via telephone, so I would have another input for my final decision. I am so satisfied with Erick and Clean Plumbers that my best interest came first, and I would not hesitate to recommend them as a trustworthy and honest dealership.

reviews.author: Bertha

reviews.author: Bobby Mathis

reviews.author: diane choi
reviews.text: I’m a property manager, and Allen’s Plumbing is my go to plumbing company. They are consistently responsive, quick, and friendly. When I call in a repair early in the morning, they are often able to send someone out the same day. I’ve worked with many plumbing companies, and Allen’s pricing is hard to beat. Most recently, Davin assisted with a plumbing repair and was extremely professional. He clearly explained the issue, walked me through my options, and answered all of my questions with patience and care. Thank you Allen’s plumbing for making my job easier by being amazing!

reviews.author: Russell Nakamura
reviews.text: Technician - Karl R. - did an outstanding job. Arrived on time, was extremely competent and professional. Karl explained his plan and kept me informed of the progress. He was very thorough and I was very satisfied. He was very good and would love to have him on any of my jobs again.

reviews.author: Colin Higa
reviews.text: Great work by plumber Bennett.  Bennett arrived on time and did a great job in a timely manner. I learned a few things watching him work and he gave me some advice to keep my drain clean and clear on a daily basis.  Highly recommend using Allen’s Plumbing.

reviews.author: Wayne Ajimine (Waji)
reviews.text:
We noticed indications of clogged drain pipe on Monday night, 11/24.  Called Allens Plumbing on Tue. morning and they managed to get tech to me in late afternoon.  He confirmed a drain issue and removed the master toilet to run a snake from there.  He managed to get the flow going and also checked the pipe with a camera.  Show me a section in the pipe water was still present, which indicated that section was not straight and had dip.  This would be an expensive repair if we decided to get it done.  In the meantime we will occasionally run some extra water through the drain to try and keep that section clear of debris (like toilet paper).  We could have run the snake from a shower stall drain but I wanted the wax ring seal on the toilet replaced anyway.

Our tech, Jesse, was very courteous.  He did the work very efficiently and explained everything clearly and completely.  He kept everything nice and clean.  You could not tell any such work had occurred in the bathroom.   I was very satisfied with the service and it was well worth the money spent.  I will use Allens Plumbing again if the need arises and recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work done.

plumbers.name: CR Plumbing, Air & Electric
plumbers.address: 2231 Berniece Jones Rd #103, Argyle, TX 76226, USA

reviews.author: Won Chung
reviews.text:
I’m really glad I listened to Chris and Larry’s recommendations. They were extremely professional, knowledgeable, and went above and beyond during the service. They checked all the major systems — water pressure, the pressure-reducing valve, both expansion tanks, and more — and took the time to explain how everything works and how to properly maintain the water heater.

The anode rods were definitely at the end of their life and truly needed replacement. I wouldn’t have known to take care of that if it weren’t for Chris and Larry’s advice. They recommended upgrading to power anode rods, which is a much better option than the standard ones, and I really appreciate their honesty and expertise.

They also replaced both expansion tanks. Even though the second one wasn’t completely full, they proactively swapped it out for peace of mind, which I really valued.

Overall, I now feel confident that I won’t have to worry about my water heaters for a long time, aside from routine annual maintenance. Huge peace of mind thanks to Chris and Larry.

reviews.author: Bill Wetherbee
reviews.text:
​I still recommend CR plumbing!  Their technicians do an excellent job; they are always honest with me and the price is fair.  I was especially impressed this time with Caleb and Andrew because they ran into several issues with the original plumbing install (details below), they did things the right way and it did not increase the price.

I called CR Plumbing this time because we had a problem with the water pressure in the house​.  The first thing they did was to measure the pressure with no water running and again with several fixtures turned on and we​ definitely had a pressure valve problem.  They also looked at the water heaters (since they are affected by the pressure) and found that we needed a new expansion tank.  The old one was full of water and had been making noises when we ran hot water.   Caleb and Andrew gave me a price; I agreed and they got started.

One of the issues they had to deal with was a bad ​(acute) angle of the pipe in the ground.  Rather than forcing another bad angle, They built a clever connection (see picture).  When replacing the water heater expansion tank they used a bigger one that was up to code and anchored to ​a stud in the wall.  The old one was just attached loosely.

Caleb and Andrew stayed and did the job right even though it got a bit late and dark. The price did not change from the original estimate and the maintenance plan saved us money.​  As long as CR keeps doing a good job like this, we will be calling and recommending them.

Electrical Service
I had a problem with an outlet and GFI.  I tried replacing them but kept having an issue.  I had good results with CR's plumbing and A/C services, so I tried their electrical service.  Timing was very fortunate since the technicians just finished another job and were heading back. Andrew and Olaf are trained techs that CR just acquired from a company that recently shut down.  They determined that not only was one of the CFIs bad, but I had two CFIs on the same circuit.  I'm guessing that a lot of CR's work is from builders who don't do things the right way.  The net is that they did a great job, tested everything, made sure all the plugs and plates matched and kept me posted along the way.  I hate when I have to call CR, but I know they will get things fixed right.

Heating System
I had CR come out to test the heating system.  It felt like the temp was not warm enough coming out of the upstairs unit.  I wanted to get ahead of this if it was a problem.  Ian measured the temp coming out and checked for leaks.  Turns out that there was not a heating problem, but the air was blowing directly on my visiting daughter and will just get a different vent to change the air direction.  CR called this routine maintenance and it was no charge.  I will definitely be using them again for any HVAC, plumbing or electrical work.

reviews.author: Chloe Saltarelli
reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with this plumbing team.  Chris & Jeff were prompt, professional, and extremely knowledgeable. They took the time to explain the issue and the solution, and the work was completed efficiently and with great attention to detail. It’s hard to find service providers you can truly trust, and these guys exceeded our expectations. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Fred Rivera

On this most recent job, Kaleb and Pascal worked together and completed the repair efficiently.  From conversation with them, I learned that they have years of experience. reviews.text: Outstanding new water heater purchase, removal and installation, all in one afternoon. Tom Kessinger is one heck of a professional. Tom did not over promise or under deliver. reviews.author: Lisa Wildenhaus
reviews.text: Never a convenient time when water pipe breakages happen!  Monday evening on a holiday. I called Benjamin Franklin at 9:20 pm with an emergency call. We decided on the least costly option knowing that after he opened a small hole in the drywall would determine whether I would have a larger problem or not. Fortunately for me it was not the worse case scenario and it was something Tom could fix. He was finished within a couple hours and I had water again.  I cannot express enough, my gratitude for Tom K. and Benjamin Franklin.  I will not hesitate to contact them for any future plumbing repairs and/or new installations.

They made a very reasonable adjustment to their bid staying competitive and their knowledge and professionalism made the decision easy for us. They also came prepared to immediately do the replacement of our water heater. Very happy. Thank you

reviews.text: Austin was fairly quick to come out and asses the problem. I had a water pipe leaking under ground. reviews.author: Nancy Charlton
reviews.text: Had water leak, but didn’t know where it was at. I looked and a friend looked underneath the house and out in the yard and we could not find anything. Chad from Benjamin Franklin came out and he looked. We couldn’t find anything, but we finally decided it had to be in the area where the septic tank was. Chad dug down around the area and actually found where the water was running loose underneath around the septic tank. The electrical pipe was forcing pressure down on the water pipe. He fixed the pipe to go up and over the electrical pipe so I wouldn’t have that problem again. The septic had probably settled some because of that problem. Thanks to Chad for doing all the digging and getting the problem fixed. He was very courteous, prompt, and a very good worker.

Avid Plumbing deserves every bit of this 5-star review. Avid was able to arrive the same day, quickly diagnose the problem, and clearly walk me through all of my options. The owner took extra time — even after hours — to explain how everything worked and answer every question I had without rushing me.

They understood the urgency of our situation and had the needed parts ready and installed first thing the next morning. Colton, who handled most of the service, was professional, courteous, and easy to talk to. He explained things in a way that wasn’t intimidating, especially since I don’t have much plumbing knowledge.

In less than 24 hours, we went from having no hot water to being fully operational again. Their responsiveness, communication, and professionalism were outstanding. I highly recommend Avid Plumbing.

reviews.author: Mark Estes
reviews.text: We had some pipes freeze up in her house with an urgency to be fixed so I searched Google and found Mr. Rooter. I called them up and they had somebody out within the next day which I was really surprised. Craig showed up right on time and was very professional and upfront about the cost and things that it would need going forward he went above and beyond explaining everything to me that was needed to get the water going again he had to crawl into a very small crawlspace underneath the house Which most plumbers would not even do considering the technicality in it he went under there and videotaped everything for me to show me the problems that were going on and then gave me a fair price to have everything done correctly. He spent probably over two days there working on this to get it done correctly. He went above and beyond and stayed late to get the job done and subzero temperatures. He was more concerned about me and my kids that himself. He finally got everything unfroze and new pipe was added. The price was exactly where I needed to be at when I thought it was going to be thousands. I can’t say enough about Craig in the job that he did. He is very thorough professional, and on point with his company. Communication was excellent as well with Missy. You can’t go wrong with this company. You will not be disappointed, thank you so much. This house is over 200 years old so he had really troubleshoot to fix it!

reviews.text: My garbage disposal had gone bad.  I called James Plumbing.  I got the answering machine at first, but the lady in the office (Linda) called me back in a very timely manner.  She was very friendly and scheduled an appointment for me right then. My appointment was set for this morning between 8:30-10a.m. Johnathan, the plumber, was very prompt and was here at 8:30. Thank you Linda and Johnathan for taking care of me in a very timely fashion!

reviews.text: I’ve worked with Drain Doctors Plumbing on many residential and commercial projects, and they consistently deliver exceptional results.
