They’re punctual, communicative, and always maintain a clean, safe worksites. Whether it’s new construction, remodels, or emergency repairs, Drain Doctors brings a level of expertise and reliability. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a skilled and dependable plumber.

reviews.author: John Al-Samarrie
reviews.text:
OK, this is overdue.  Last month I noticed water on the garage cement floor and thought it was just moisture.  After careful review I noticed that the water heater was leaking.  I called four different plumbers to get estimates with Drain Doctor being the first one I called.  A little history of my previous water heater is in order.  in 2019 I was overseas, and the heater broke and leaked all over the garage damaging some important personal items.  My girlfriend at the time called a plumber who installed a new heater and what a mess it was.  That plumber used galvanized steel for the inlet and outlet of the heater lines.  Routed the pressure relief pipe into the water heater pan rather than outside of the pan and installed my recirculating pump facing the side wall where I could not gain access.  Additionally, the gas line reservoir was installed by the water heater rather than near the gas line valve coming out of the wall.  There were no 2x4 boards in the back of the heater for earth quake bracing and the water lines were not earth grounded, all of which are city compliance requirement.  To say the least it was a cluster F.  When Bobby from Drain doctor showed up, he immediately pointed out the nonconformance of the water heater and gave me a bottom-line price from his standard pricing book which no other plumbers could beat.  Some quotes were almost double and after negotiating with those plumbers they got close to Bobby's price which didn't sit well with me.  So, I decided to go with Bobby and that proved to be fortuitist based on his efficient and compliant work.  Bobby is a plethora of plumbing information or more like a Wikipedia of plumbing.  He does have a laid back and straight forward attitude but don't let that fool you.  He's the top gun in his industry.  Anyway, I've read some of the negative reviews and in each case, there has been a unique set circumstance that all of us experienced in our daily life but over 99%+ of Drain Doctor reviews are very positive.  I can't tell you how happy we are with his work and in fact our outside main water line inlet valve was broken, unbeknown to us and we had him come back the next day to fix that as well.  I didn't bother getting other quotes because I knew Bobby would give us a competitive price but more importantly do the job right.
Anyway, you can't go wrong with Drain Doctor and ask for Bobby.  Bobby is your man.
Lastley, I don’t usually write reviews, but I was so impressed with the work I was compelled to write about our experience.
Thank you,
John A.

reviews.author: Janelle Leppink
reviews.text:
TLDR; Call these guys, they’ll take good care of you and your home 🙏 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟

We had a pretty stressful situation this morning when a toilet supply line randomly burst and sprayed water everywhere in our third floor bathroom. Before we knew it, water leaked down three floors through the walls, the ceiling, everywhere. Total nightmare.

We called Monkey Wrench Plumbing and they were able to get someone out the same day, which saved us. Kyle was our technician and he was great. Super down-to-earth, easy to talk to, and clearly knew what he was doing. He explained that the old builder-grade plastic supply line had failed (which apparently happens more than you’d think) and walked us through what he was going to replace it with.

He swapped out the cheap plastic line and valve for a braided metal one that’s much more durable and built to last. It feels good knowing we won’t have to worry about that happening again.

What really stood out was that they also helped get a restoration company out that same day to start dealing with the water damage. When you’re standing in a house with water coming through ceilings, that kind of quick coordination means everything.

Overall, just a really solid local company that shows up when you need them. Hopefully we don’t have another plumbing emergency anytime soon, but if we do, we’re calling them again without hesitation. Highly recommend.

Big shoutout to them for the great work done!

These guys have done a number of jobs for us, from running new hot lines, to installing a toilet and dishwasher... and each interaction has been great. reviews.author: Nathan Linder
reviews.text:
I trusted this company to install a new HVAC system a little over a year ago. I've gotten quite an education on systems since their install.

Essentially, they installed a VERY expensive communicating air handler to work with a base-level NON-communicating Heat Pump. ALL I knew at the time of install was that I was getting a new system. I had no idea how poor their choice of product was for my home until it was too late. I felt I had no choice but to act quickly because I was told my old oil furnace system was "red tagged" or unsafe to use. Truthfully, they offered 3 options: repair the current system, replace the current system, or go with a "highly-efficient, ultra modern" heat pump. They really pushed this system saying it was a certain seer level and that I would qualify for ALL sorts of rebates and incentives from the government - none of which happened.

Here are some more bullet points to help you make your decision on whether or not to use this company:

- left trash from the install in my yard
- had to come back the very next day after install because they installed the wrong type of thermostat
- had to come back a month after install to install a mysterious "box" under the air handler. I have no record of this work being done because they refuse to let me see the paperwork / invoice for it. This was Feb. 19th of 2025
- system formed a LITERAL block of ice in it after only a few days of using it to cool my home in the summer. Tech tried to chalk it up to some nonsense about difficulty shipping parts during covid (it was 2025 ... ) - ? They actually had to turn the system OFF in the middle of summer to let it melt while I slept in my attic that has separate AC. They added a small amount of coolant to the unit to "fix" the problem. See the photo.
- thermostat is off / wrong and always has been - they blame my old house, etc. - shouldn't these factors have been taken into consideration prior to the install? When I asked specific questions about the thermostat, the tech responded, "Well, we'd have to consult an expert for that". Aren't YOU supposed to be the expert!?!?
- NOTHING in my set up qualifies for any tax rebates or cash incentives from PPL.

After giving up and consulting a reputable company, we found:

- Heat pump had a leak and was pretty much running on VERY little coolant. This discovery was a stark contrast to the "all is good" seasonal maintenance updates that Curtis performed
- This was the result of a broken part that needed to be replaced. I also had to pay to have the unit flushed and restocked with coolant.
- New company was taking pics because they were in total and complete disbelief of how unprofessional and shoddy the installation was.

Final notes: Curtis Total Service is currently dealing with an ongoing lawsuit for taking advantage of customers not fluent in HVAC tech or that are elderly. My last conversation with their General Manager ended with him calling me "Stupid" because:, "You could have gone with ANY other company but us, did research, etc., but you chose us. You're stupid"

This company is an absolute fraud. If this review costs them even a dime, I'll be happy.

reviews.author: Therese Dominguez
reviews.text:
First of all, I really appreciate that Leo and Nick arrived right on time. From the moment they walked into our home, they were friendly, polite, and courteous. Leo took the time to answer all of my questions and clearly explained what they were going to do, which gave me a lot of confidence in the process.
Our toilet drain had roots growing alongside it and even starting to come through the flange. Leo and Nick jackhammered the tile, addressed the root issue thoroughly, and completed the repair much faster than I expected. The work looked excellent—solid, professional, and done with care. Even better, they left the area spotless, which I truly appreciated.
Thank you so much, Leo and Nick! I couldn’t be happier with the service—absolutely 110% satisfied

Part 2 of my review:
After Leo and Nick completed their work and my husband re-tiled the area, Zach came out to install our toilet. He arrived right on time and was an absolute pleasure to work with—friendly, courteous, and easy to talk to. He took great care with the installation, and the toilet works perfectly. Thank you, Zach!

Overall, Drain Time Plumbing has provided excellent customer service from start to finish. Mark and his team are not only professional but genuinely friendly and easy to communicate with. Out of the four plumbers I contacted on Yelp, they were the very first to respond, and they had James out the next day to inspect the issue and give me a quote. Their price came in $400 lower than a competitor’s, and they were flexible in scheduling the installation to fit my availability.
I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Drain Time Plumbing has earned my trust, and I’ll definitely be calling them for all of our future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Lin Pevny
reviews.text:

Mark was quick to respond to our ordeal, gave solutions and his crew was out to get things removed, replaced and running/fixed. Communication, customer service and the work done was on point.

We had an issue with the clean out, toilet backup. The building was built in the 80s. cast iron gets old and needed replacement. It was replaced with a two way clean out. They got the permit, did a clean job cutting the concrete, keeping the work area clear and secure (no trip hazard) and finishing up the work within the time frame. The job came with a 10 year warranty.

If you’re looking for an honest, plumber who follows code and does the job well, I highly recommend Drain Time Plumbing. They listen to your needs, explains what’s going on and what can be done and why and the price is right.

Thank you Drain Time Plumbing!

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Karinne Claire
reviews.text:
When we experienced a blockage in our storm drainage pipe, we called our trusted plumber.  He advised us that this was something he did not handle and highly recommended Plunger Plumber for the job. Excellent recommendation!  We HIGHLY recommend Plunger Plumber as well.  The entire process of our experience dealing with Plunger Plumber was exceptional.

Communication and customer service were superb.  Joe was quick to respond to our inquiry.  He promptly came to our house to assess the damage.  As it turned out, we had excessive damage with 2 blockages.  The repair that was needed included excavation from our house to the street.  The overall work was extensive and complex.  Joe was honest and transparent about what needed to be done and the cost involved.  He explained everything thoroughly and answered all our questions.

Despite the frigid temperatures the last week of January 2026, the repair work began when promised.  The crew, Trevor, Frank and Brennan, were the BEST!  They arrived at 8:00 AM when temps were -6 degrees and finished the job at 9:00 PM with the temperature at -10 degrees.  This amazing crew remained pleasant, upbeat and so positive despite the harsh weather.  The frozen ground and the deep frost line were no obstacle for them.  They worked diligently throughout the day and evening.  Trevor kept us informed throughout the whole process.  When the weather finally allowed, a crew returned to our house and expertly back-filled the dirt in the trench, being very respectful of our property and landscaping.

We personally can verify that Plunger Plumber is a reputable plumbing company for your plumbing needs.  Plunger Plumber is professional, knowledgeable, trustworthy and has exceptional customer service.  Without hesitation, we wholeheartedly give Plunger Plumber a 5+ Star recommendation.

reviews.author: Dr. Bly
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Plunger Plumber--the team is quick to respond and very professional. They worked with me to make a new bathroom in my basement, undated sink and vanity in kitchen and upstairs bath, and did some drain clearing along the way. For this work, my technician was primarily Matty, but I also worked with Nick a lot. Both were friendly and professional and I got to know Matty since he was at the house almost everyday for two weeks.
One recommendation: assume that every home you enter is "shoe free." I have a sign on my front door; for my household it's less about cleanliness and all about keeping the house free of lead dust and pesticides, both contaminants are very toxic. In greater CLE, much of the housing stock was built before laws prohibiting lead in paint were passed (1977), so it's in the soil and in the walls of homes and buildings we're working on now.
Thanks, team!

reviews.author: Lynn Vining
reviews.text: Oh my goodness, how thankful I am for JB Plumbing! My 22-yr old hot water heater went out on a Sunday evening (not a surprise; had already gotten a quote from another company a few months earlier & was saving up money for this purchase). However, after putting in a call to the "other company" TWICE, and not hearing back from them, I searched for a reputable plumber in my area and found JB Plumbing. Not only did the owner, Jean, call me back personally after I had spoken with his office, but he came out the same day to give me an estimate. While he was here, I inquired about the pipe/valve next to the water heater, wandering if that should also be replaced. His answer was "NO". He said I did not need to waste $400 fixing something until it actually needed to be fixed. What a delight to find a company that values PEOPLE more than money. Jean was so kind, completely trustworthy, and clearly values quality craftsmanship—thank you, Jean! And his quote was far better than the one from the "other company", forget the fact that they still haven't called me back. When he scheduled my installation, he expressed that he wanted me to get to know the rest of his team, so he set up my installation with Kerry. Kerry was so personable & professional that I readily knew I was dealing with a top-notch master plumber for sure! He took such care to make sure that everything was done precisely and TOP-NOTCH! Kerry even did things that were not part of the original estimate, like drill a hole through the wall to the outside, so that a proper drainpipe could be installed (he did beautiful work on that too). reviews.author: Angela
reviews.text: It was an awful experience. Had them inspect a water tank leak. He knew what was wrong, but pretended he did not and started to criticize everything you could think of. He talked for about 30 minutes about how everything had been done wrong and was just really letting me know how stupid I was for hiring the guy who had installed my water tank. Started to talk about how I might need to get a new water tank and a new furnace when it was only 5 years old, and redo everything like re-plumb and replace everything. Went on and on about this needing to be fixed and that needing to be fixed, and pretended he couldn't tell how many gallons of water the tank held. He spent a few hours wasting my time away from work, just to empty out the entire water tank and fix absolutely nothing. I ended up having to miss work that day altogether. He told me he can now fix it after the tank is empty, but it will cost a lot of money. Made the entire situation sound much worse than it was, when it was a simple fix, while trying to charge me more than it was, which he had already done for just showing up and emptying my water tank, fixing nothing. I let him go and said I needed to think about the quote since it was very high. Additionally, the quote kept changing throughout his criticism of the water tank, the plumbing, and various other aspects. He started to say things to scare me about the kind of damage, and he might not be able to come back later if I changed my mind about having him fix the leak. About how I will not have hot water to shower if I don't make a decision now. Almost a threat to get a little lady homeowner to spend so much money on a fix that was not what he said. I think he purposely emptied the water tank to get ready to "replace" the tank that did not need to be replaced. I discovered all of that when I found someone else to come look, and it took 10 minutes and was free. The reviews about Roto-Rooter were true, in that they overcharge and upsell more than necessary, except that the reviews also missed how they create issues that do not exist. Stay away from this one. Incredibly dishonest business. Forced to give one star, but wish it could be a negative 5 stars.

reviews.author: Taylor Andrews
reviews.text:
UPDATE: Approximately 30 minutes after Shawn and Darian left, we were without hot water, yet again. I called them back out the next day, and I was informed it was a cartridge in the single-handle shower upstairs causing our entire house to be without hot water. I informed the technician I would not accept that answer, and we called another company out two days later. Upon telling the new company what was happening, he immediately diagnosed it as the recirculating pump, which we had mentioned both times 1 Tom had been out.

After running diagnostic testing, it was confirmed to be the recirculating pump. Fast forward to the next day, and we had discovered a significant gas leak at our water heater. There were missing and loose screws, allowing gas to flow freely into our garage instead of properly venting out into the exhaust. I’d like to think that 1 Tom would have noticed this since they “watched the flame rod for 30 minutes,” but nothing was ever mentioned about it (the second company did not have to “open” our water heater for the recirculation pump diagnostic). Our family’s health was severely jeopardized by this oversight. I highly recommend spending your money elsewhere.

Shawn and Darian were quick and efficient with their service! Having no hot water isn’t any fun, but they fixed the problem quickly, and they made sure to thoroughly explain the problem they found. 10/10 recommend these guys!!

reviews.author: John R
reviews.text:
Monday and Tuesday I had guys out to encapsulate my crawl space.In that process one of the workers cracked one of my pipes under my house in which they said they would handle getting repairs. Rota-Rooter is the company they finally were able to get to come out. I was told they would be here at 6:30pm, but the plumber didnt show up until 8:45pm.
The plumber asked me if I had the water turned off not realizing he was talking about at the meter. As far as I knew the pipe that got cracked wasnt leaking no one told me anything as far as that. I told him it is. He noticeable got mad when he discovered the water wasnt turned off and spent the next 10 minutes scolding me.
After he got done scolding me I took him to the water meter. He then proceeded to ask me if I had a T handle to turn the water off. Since when did I become to the plumber having to supply equipment?Isnt that something all should have in the business? I told him no and then the curse words starting flying out his mouth in the middle of the night.
He told me to call my neighbor and ask them if they have one. I know darn well she doesnt plus she had already gone to bed. Here we sat at the meter with him trying to turn the water off with a wrench. He finally got it turned off.
I went back in at this point because it’s not my job to do his job. I remained respectful through this time of interaction, but I can tell you for any plumbing needs that arise in the future on my dime I will not ever call Roto Rooter. If I ever have a company do anything under my house and they mess something up I will tell them to never call Roto Rooter.
I know they have been around for decades but rudeness wont get customers

reviews.text:
UPDATE!  They finished the first phase of repairs which means I can get my appliances delivered soon.  I'm incredibly grateful for their help, but also for their thoughtfulness.  They moved the laundry taps up to make them more accessible, installed valves that are easy to use, and even put caps on to prevent accidents until my washer can be hooked up.  The mess that was under the kitchen sink has been tamed and the sink itself is no longer hella clogged.  It's a huge relief knowing that at least one thing was done right and should last a very long time.  On to the next thing the former owners neglected for far too long!

Check out the before and after pictures!  Hint: the before pictures are the ones where there's more corrosion than metal.

===Original Review===
I bought a new condo and had them do a plumbing inspection before I moved in.

Bad news:  The former owners did nothing to maintain it, the plumbing is a disaster, and the home inspector missed it.

Good news:  Rob checked everything thoroughly, gave me a detailed explanation of what was wrong, prioritized the most important fixes, gave me quotes on each phase that would need to be done, and discussed financing since he knew I just gave all my money to the bank.

It was frightening and disheartening to hear about all the problems, but by the time he left, I felt so much better because I have a plan and a way to afford it.  I can't thank you enough and look forward to updating this review with the after pictures!

reviews.author: Matt Neiber
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this plumbing, heating, and air conditioning company. Andrew serviced my furnace after discovering a leak, fixed the issue promptly, flushed all the lines, and thoroughly cleaned out the furnace. The technicians were friendly, professional, and worked quickly without cutting corners. Everything was explained clearly, and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. I would definitely recommend them and will absolutely use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Dan Bice
reviews.text:
Update:21Jul2025 Andrew came out to take a look at my hvac and did a great job. Very respectful of my house and the property outside. Very nice person. Would use again.

1st time.
I am handy but know my limitations. I put on 2 shutoff valves myself to try and fix the shower. Went to remove the shower seats and they were rotten. So it was a long time trying to find the right thing and everything had horrible reviews online. With my wife due in less than a week, i was out of time to take on the project. Made the call. Rob came out next day and completed work 2 days later. Had the three way system converted into one shower handle. The three holes from it got covered by the eschution plate and theres no leaks. Had the drain looked at too. Rob said it looked shot so I had him replace that too. Thankfully he did. It has a few pin holes in it that we're going to end up being a larger problem. I installed a new vanity in the bathroom and used crappy plumbing accordion tubes. Those aren't to code. So Rob hooked up a new drain that is to code. Exceeded my expectations. Pricing was extremely reasonable from what I have researched. Quality work and was done in a day. All before the baby was here. I will be using them again.

reviews.text: Excellent customer service! If you get Lucy when you call you're guaranteed top notch service. She knows her stuff and outstanding phone skills! I had them add a clean out to my home. The team they sent out (Apolonio/Freilyn) were also fabulous, friendly, and answered all my paranoid questions. They took care of the first part of the dig and remove around a 3x3ish square, and cut the pipe and put in the new pipe for the clean out, and filled the hole with dirt. There was rain in the forecast, so a different team (Rick/Shawn) came back and filled the hole with the concrete and they also answered all my new home owner questions. Both teams were very knowledgeable and personable. From a new homeowner who had called several companies regarding my sewer pipes this was the most super stupendous all around best company I have encountered. I have also worked over 30 years in customer service, and I know most people are quick on the negative, so I wanted to give a really good positive about my whole experience. I will be using them to re-pipe my sewer once I can save up for it. I hope this group of people get the acknowledgement they deserve!

reviews.author: Francine Scott
reviews.text: There was a lack in communication. The Documentation signing   I had to reach out to the company with a phone call to expedite signing papers and pay them to get my project completed. 2,500.00 dollars to dig a hole find the small leak and cut pipe to replace coupling. The plumber who installed the coupling was conscientious and completed the project in a timely manner matter.

reviews.author: david worley
reviews.text:
While buying our new home, our agent arranged for The Trenchless Co. to inspect the sewer line and clear a blockage that had been found by a previous company. We were told that for just over $1,000 they would jet the line, clear the blockage, and fully clean out the system. This was a challenging job, as two other companies had been unable to even locate the sewer clean-out. The technician from The Trenchless Co. did find it and performed the work professionally—he was knowledgeable, helpful, and respectful throughout the visit.

However, after receiving the inspection results and jetting report, we were advised to pay an additional $500 for “more jetting” to clean the remainder of the line. This recommendation came after being told the original $1,000 service would clear and clean the line completely. Being asked for another $500 to finish work we believed was already included felt unreasonable and came across as an unnecessary upsell. The clean-out had already been located and the additional work would have required minimal extra effort, making the added charge seem more like a money grab than a genuine recommendation.

Update:

Max, the owner of The Trenchless Co., reached out personally and went above and beyond to make things right. He is sending a technician back out to complete the remaining work at no additional cost. Max was extremely professional and transparent, explaining that the crew had gone beyond the original scope of the call but agreeing that the job should have been fully completed—or at the very least, I should have been informed and given options before the technician left.

His willingness to take responsibility and ensure the job is done correctly truly stands out. Because of Max’s efforts, I’m now a loyal customer and a big supporter of The Trenchless Co. They’ve shown that they genuinely care about their customers and their community, and I sincerely appreciate the way they handled this situation.

reviews.author: Michael Salac

reviews.text: I've been using Martin for nearly 20 years. I called a different company because they recently serviced my AC for free as a promotion. It's important to do business with people you trust, and he has always taken care of us. Thank you!

reviews.author: Ker Yang
reviews.text: I noticed some watermark on my ceiling and have some concern that I may have a pipe leakage going on. I contact low-cost plumbing service and they came out and did a free inspection. Steven took his time and went through all the pipeline and found out that there was no leakage in the pipeline which was a good thing. He was able to pinpoint that the water was probably seeping through the roof vent, base on the evidence of watermarks along the vent pipe. After inspecting the roof, the vent did have breakage/cracks noted in the vent sealing that was allowing water to seep into the pipe which flow into the ceiling. He was able to reseal all of the roof vents to prevent any water from entering. Everything was done the same day, which was really fast and quick. Steven was very professional. He kept open communication and kept me in the loop of what’s going on during the whole entire process. I highly recommend them for any plumbing issues. I feel that the price was reasonable and doable.
