We will continue to use R & A Plumbing and recommending them to family and friends.

plumbers.name: True Plumbers & AC
plumbers.address: 4000 N Frontage Rd, Plant City, FL 33565, USA

reviews.author: John
reviews.text: True Plumbers & AC recently installed a new AC unit at my house. The old AC was 21 years old and was the install was definitely needed. TJ and John “Book” came out to install and did a fantastic job. They were both professional and friendly and I never doubted their expertise. Brian was also there to oversee the project and was first class with his friendliness and was great at keeping us up to date with the progress. Would 100% recommend this company!

reviews.author: Mary Lewis
reviews.text: I called around 7pm on a Sunday night because our backyard spiket broke.  We have well water so we had to shut off water to our entire house.  Initially, there was some communication issues but Kayle contacted me and addressed my concerns.  The service technician was very professional and fixed the problem quickly.  I would definitely use True plummers in Plant City again

reviews.author: Dannyl Risk
reviews.text:
Will be our go-to plumbers from this day forward!

We had a death in the family yesterday. Within an hour of that happening, mom's water heater began flooding the Florida room.

Three calls to our home warranty left us even more distraught. I found True Plumbers online. From my first contact with Erica, to Chris and Paul coming out they treated is with kindness, respect, and grace.

Chris and Paul found the issue quickly and were able to fix it easily.

What could have been a total disaster for our family ended up making our day just a bit brighter for their kindness dedication and service.

reviews.author: Dee
reviews.text:
Based on an exceptionally positive experience with True Builders on my kitchen rebuild three years ago, I didn’t hesitate to contact True Plumbers when I needed a new water heater. Although we had a bit of a bumpy start (which, I admit, was primarily my doing), Chris persevered to find a solution that would ensure my complete satisfaction. I really appreciated his patience and efforts. Randall and Charles installed the tank with expertise and tenacity in a timely manner. When installation was concluded, Randall was resolute in not leaving the property until the water had reached the maximum temperature and he was assured  that I was happy with it. I was very impressed and appreciative of that. All three of these men were friendly, respectful (of both me and my property), and considerate. In addition, they all seemed to share the common goal of leaving the customer happy - and they did that. I would be remiss if I didn’t mention Erica who went above and beyond in overseeing the whole process, and in her constant reassurances. She is a gem and an excellent representative of the company.

Thank you, True… you hire good people!

reviews.author: Devon Coleman
reviews.text: Awesome experience with Mr.Alex Cheek today. Woke up to no water gave you guys a call and the lady on the phone(sorry I didn't catch her name) was very helpful and quick to get things moving for me. Mr. Alex got here in just a couple hours and had my place back up and running again in about 45 minutes. Also pretty good pricing. Was worried I'd have to cash in the savings but it ended up being a fraction of what I thought it would be. If I ever need a plumber again you guys will have my business without a doubt. Thank you so much for your help!!!

plumbers.name: Kwik Serv Plumbing, Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 1047 E High St, Mundelein, IL 60060, USA

reviews.author: Char Oslund
reviews.text:
I used this company on recommendation of my home owners ins. However, I am very pleased on so many levels... with the quick schedualing, the service was beyond  professional as well as accurate!  The service man was so sweet and courteous, on time. My toilet wasn't really even broken, he showed me how to fix it if it happens again. Over all... a really great experience!  And to think if I wasn't for my ins company, I may not have known to call them.  I am 65 and have had my fair share of service calls. Firstly, you worry as you don't want to get "taken", and then there is the lateness along with the attitude and rudeness... none of that!  I am telling you... so refreshing! I will us them even when its not a insurance issue. I feel  confident that I will have no issues.
Gina at the office is also great.

reviews.author: Hope Engels
reviews.text: Kwik Serv Plumbing is an amazing company. First, I would like thank Gina who works in the office. She was amazing. Very courteous and sweet. She assisted me with scheduling the installation and answered all of my questions. Gina also assisted me with scheduling the Village of Buffalo Grove for the final inspection. Alex A and Adrien were the technicians who installed the new hot water heater and they were amazing. They were courteous and professional. They were prompt and cleaned up completely after the installation was completed. They also gave me an explanation on what they did and how the new hot water heater works. I highly recommend this company. You will not be sorry.

reviews.author: Ben Stylez
reviews.text: Andy is hands-down the best HVAC technician I’ve worked with. He showed up on time, knew exactly what he was doing, and broke everything down in a way that actually made sense. No rushing, no guesswork—just pure professionalism and skill. He treated my home like it was his own and made sure everything was 100% before leaving. If Andy is on the job, you’re in great hands. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him to anyone.

reviews.author: Tammie Clarke
reviews.text:
Josh P. was absolutely outstanding! He was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly polite throughout the entire service. His customer service skills were top-notch—he brought back that old-school feeling of being truly valued as a customer. It’s rare to find someone who takes such pride in their work and treats clients with genuine respect. If I ever need plumbing help again, Josh will be my first request. Highly recommended!

Thanks,
Tammie

reviews.author: Nyronia Clark
reviews.text: Ulises was great! He explained the issues and why replacement parts were needed.  He took his time and properly installed faucets & pop up extension. He made sure to thoroughly test after installation.  He also found the source of the leak.  He was great with communicating as well as the work performed.  The job was just completed yesterday, so hopefully there will be no future issues related to this job.  I’d so I will leave another review.  However with the service he provided I belief that will be unlikely.  I will be sure to request Kwik Serv and Ulises for my plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Jones & Sons Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1201 Cedar St C, Safety Harbor, FL 34695, USA

reviews.author: Laura Zuppo
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Michelle and Will from Jones & Sons. I called the company because I wanted a second estimate. My parents referred me to them because they were happy with their work and service, as well. Michelle got me an appointment within 24 hours (Thankfully, since I had two bad leaks). She was very polite  and courteous. Will arrived at 9 am (8-10 window). He diagnosed my issues very quickly and proposed two solutions. While the Jones & Sons estimate was higher than the estimate from a larger company by several hundred dollars (the only negative),  I felt confident in Will and how he wanted to approach the issues. I chose Jones over a major market competitor who came in with a better price because of the technician-- quality service and trust always wins! He did a quality job and I would ask for him again if, and when, I need a plumber.

reviews.author: M.A.S HANDYMAN SERVICE
reviews.text: Mr. Uncle James is just a great guy. Very knowledgeable, very honest and straightforward about what's going on. And one of the best parts even though you know you're going to pay a Big Bill somehow he always makes it feel like it's nothing. And Jones and Sons Plumbing as a whole is just amazing they've helped out quite a bit. Ever need any kind of Plumbing from something small to something large they will help out.

reviews.author: Marvin Cluff
reviews.text: I called Jones & Son’s Plumbing early this morning because my sink was clogged. They came and left before noon and we are clog free. Justin was so friendly and knowledgeable and didn’t lie when he said clogs were his specialty. Price was great and I know the clog will never come back. Thanks Jennifer Jimenez for sending Justin out so quick. You were so nice and communicated with me by text all along the way.

reviews.author: Brian Herron
reviews.text: Will was amazing.  He treated our home with respect and transparent about some of the hidden issues while hooking up new plumbing during our remodel.  They were very fair with pricing and worked until the issues were resolved.

reviews.author: Michael Augustine
reviews.text: Jones & Sons always does a great job. I called them yesterday to snake a drain and "Uncle James" arrived at 8am today. Uncle James was fast, clean, and professional.  He explained everything and the situation was quickly resolved.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Austin
plumbers.address: 12201 Roxie Dr, Austin, TX 78729, USA

reviews.author: Roy Shalem
reviews.text:
We’ve had a great experience working with this vendor across our properties. Communication is clear, response times are fast, and the quality of work is consistently solid. They show up when they say they will, handle issues professionally, and take pride in what they do.
As the Maintenance Manager at Smart Egg Properties, having reliable vendors makes a huge difference, and this vendor has proven they can be trusted. I would absolutely recommend them to any property management company or home owner looking for dependable service.
— Roy
Maintenance Manager
Smart Egg Properties

reviews.author: Kitty Myth
reviews.text: Zachery was professional, courteous as they come and patient. My sink had a ridiculously stubborn leak. Zach identified instantly the issue just by looking at it! We’re so impressed and grateful to have met his kind gentleman. Thank you very much for your time, we appreciate y’all.

reviews.author: jeff pray
reviews.text: Juan and Jeremiah were incredible.  We discovered a water leak on the side of our house after 6:00 pm.  We contacted Mr Rooter at a time we considered “after hours.”  They came out promptly, diagnosed the issue, and make the repair.  They were both extremely courteous and friendly despite the late hour.  It was 9:45 pm by the time the repair was completed.  My wife and I are happy to have found Mr. Rooter in an emergency situation and super grateful for their awesome techs Juan and Jeremiah.  Thanks so much guys.

reviews.author: Lisa Moss
reviews.text: Mr Rooter Plumbing was a quick response (called night before arrived next day). Luis and his partner were very friendly and asked the questions they need to know. Toilet flush was repaired quickly this time. I don't know how reasonable the price was because I'm just a temporary tenant. The landlord seems to keep this company on hand as one of their plumbing service options.

reviews.author: Chase Rupe
reviews.text: Had a leak in the washer hookup line at a rental house. Mr. Rooter was out the next day and did the repair quickly and for a fair price. Very responsive, professional, and communicative.

plumbers.name: Pro-Rooter Plumbing & Drain Services
plumbers.address: 9501 Timberwind Ln, Yukon, OK 73099, USA

reviews.author: Lord Khang
reviews.text: Shelby and Trent came out and solved a challenge with my septic system that other veteran companies could not without wanting to charge ten or more thousand dollars.  Total professionals whose thoroughness is unmatched in the industry.  The results were exceptional. Their recommendation sound.  I spent far, far less to obtain the best possible result.  Thank you, so very much.  And that Angus guy on the phone, truly a pleasure to deal with sir, I salute all of you.

reviews.author: Kedrin Coleman
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Shelby. I’m very happy with the service he provided. He was timely, professional, & quick to diagnose/fix the issue I was having. I would highly recommend him and Pro-Rooter Plumbing and Drain Services to anyone in need of plumbing services.

reviews.author: Jason Thaxton
reviews.text: Angus and his team were the best plumbers I have dealt with. Quick, transparent, quote. Arrived right on time to replace our water heater. Communicated with me regarding every step of the way. The work was completed much faster than I could have imagined. The work was impeccable, and our garage was cleaner when they left than when they started. No doubt they will be my first and only call going forward. Can't recommend them strongly enough. It's great when you find a trustworthy and talented company.

reviews.author: Austin Johnston
reviews.text: Trent and Shelby came out to my house this afternoon. They explained to me through step by step of what our situation was looking like in a very professional manner. I would definitely recommend to anyone and definitely going to contact them for any future repairs I have going forward.

reviews.author: Julia Towe
reviews.text: Shelby was so kind and very helpful. He as Professional, quick , high quality work. Will definitely be using him again. Thank you Shelby!

plumbers.name: Excel Plumbing
plumbers.address: 661 Glenn Ave, Wheeling, IL 60090, USA

reviews.author: Bjoern Elsasser
reviews.text: Excel team provided great service for assessing my sewer line, rodding it and showing me the extent of root invasion into my sewer line. They also mapped out where the sewer line runs. Ivan recommended having the clay pipe hydro jetted to remove the roots and then seal the line with epoxy as no shift in the 4 foot clay pipe connections have shifted more than a quarter inch. One inch requires excavation/installing new sewer line.

reviews.author: Andy Thomas
reviews.text: I called Excel first thing in the morning after discovering a hot water tank leak. Kelly quickly provided me a quote that was reasonably priced and promptly answered all my questions. After accepting the quote they scheduled same day service and kept me in the loop as to next steps. The installation team, led by Yaryk, arrived shortly afterwards and did an awesome job removing the old water heater & installing the new one. They were clean, efficient, and professional.

reviews.author: Lenora Brown-Rodriguez
reviews.text: Excel Plumbing provided stellar and expedient service right when I needed it.  Had a frozen pipe issue during the arctic cold blast on Sunday, January 25, 2026.  The Plumber arrived at my house in under an hour and executed quality servicing as my pipes were unthawed in less than 8 minutes!  I recommend this company for sure!  I hope I never have to endure an issue like that again, but if I do, I will gladly call EXCEL PLUMBING again!

reviews.author: Shannon
reviews.text:
The name says it all….call them if you want a company that provides exceptional service with exceptional people!

I was in a pickle, it’s Sunday (10/19) at 245pm and another company just ditched me!  I only have 1 bathroom and it was out of service since (10/18) at 730pm!

I called this company and within minutes they confirm they can do an emergency service for me and me here today (10/19). Scheduling was easy, and honest and upfront about the time.  Luckily I had someone out to me in 1.5 hours!  Talk about emergency response time!

After setting up my appointment I get a text with my plumbers picture and name (Mike L). Mike arrived promptly, at the time that was agreed upon by the person who scheduled the appointment on the phone.

Prices were given to me up front by Mike and in the end that was exactly what I was charged.  (I love no surprises when it comes to money!) Mike was knowledgeable, very polite, conscious of my home.  He communicated well throughout the process.  Truly a pleasure to work with!

10/10 will be using this company for all future projects or issues!

Thank you for helping out a gal in an emergency, being so prompt, keeping your word, and completing my job to full satisfaction!!!

reviews.author: Lindsey Rose
reviews.text: We had a backup in our basement that lead to us having to basically get all new plumbing. Excel was quick to set up appointments, communicative, and we had 4 different gentleman service our home through the process and all were knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Pro Plumbing Plus Electric
plumbers.address: 302 S Spring St, Manchester, TN 37355, USA

reviews.author: Carrie Fierro
reviews.text: We tried to save some money and DIY the plumbing ourselves. After the second clog, we gave these guys a call and glad we did. They came out addressed/corrected the issue and ran new main sewer lines. Anthony, Matthew and Curtis were great! Answered my questions, explained the worked completed and left a clean workspace after. From the time you call and speak with sweet Brittany to the final walk-through with Anthony and Curtis you know you are in good hands.

reviews.author: Samra Thut
reviews.text:
Great experience so far! They thoroughly tested for a leak, clearly explained everything, and confirmed the issue. Very honest, professional, and helpful. Glad I chose them!

Update: Anthony & Andrew came out to perform leak detection and had to cut through the drywall, but they did minimal damage and were able to neatly cover it afterward, which I found really impressive. They quickly located the leak and  improvised on the spot to avoid having to jackhammer through my slab.

They truly went the extra mile to find the most cost-effective solution possible, and I really appreciated their effort and honesty throughout the process. I can’t recommend them enough and will definitely be using them exclusively going forward.

reviews.author: Susan Mundell
reviews.text: Chris and Todd were wonderful.  They told me exactly what was wrong (Old cast iron pipes) and cleared the clog as well as I willing me how much it will be to replace the old pipes.  They were very polite and helpful.  I will definitely be contacting Pro Plumbing Plus to get pipes replaced when I can get the money together.  But at least they cleared the blockage in the pipes so I am no longer getting a backwash into my tub and shower.

reviews.author: Doug B
reviews.text: Anthony and Matrhew were professional and courteous and  set my new propane tankless water heater up in one day.  It works great!  The guys even cleaned up the work area after they were done.  Brittany did a great job getting the job scheduled quick and calling to let me know when they were about 45 minutes out for the install.  Price was great too for high quality work and product. Great company that I will definitely be recommending to my friends and family!

reviews.author: Madeline Ritter
reviews.text: I would look somewhere else. This company is not worth the money they estimate. Paid close to 700 dollars for a sink to be reattach the countertop. First guy came he was on time and very polite told me the estimate 693.00 and that they are the cheapest around for a job like this. After "fixing" the sink told us not to use it for 24hrs we didnt. Having to do take out for the night. Couple days later it wasnt attached anymore. Called and told them with what happen same tech came out and "fixed" it again told us to not use it for 24hrs. We didnt use it for 48 hours so take out for 2 nights not cheap first all for a family of 6. After using it for a week the sink detached from the countertop again. Call and explain my frustration on this matter. They sent out a different person. When he came we told him what has happen. Seemed like he didnt believe us or something. He was kinda rude on the matter. Again we cant use our sink for 3 days this was over the weekend. Which was a big inconvenience but at this ponit we just want the sink fixed. After fixing the sink he tell my sister we can not use to the sink until the seal is dry and if it gets wet and they are called out again for it we will be charged. He was not clear on the 5 year warranty they offer. Is the warranty void because they can not fix the problem the first time. My sister sent pictures of the finished work it looks like there is still a gap from the sink to the countertop. I would not recommend this company to anyone.

plumbers.name: The Fair Plumber LLC
plumbers.address: 846 N York St, Elmhurst, IL 60126, USA

reviews.author: JH
reviews.text: I had to get the line routed out between the house and the street, once that was fixed he had to repair the wax ring.   Jose was my plumber,  he was awesome!  Polite and knowledgeable.   A great smile too!  I will definitely use him again. Thank you Jose!! 😊

reviews.author: Peggy Woloszyk
reviews.text:
Our house is 100 years old. Water was backing up into our basement shower. We called 3 companies and only Fair Plumbing sent someone out that same day.

Manny used the camera and found that some clay pipes had shifted and rodding out the pipes did not clear the build up.

The next day, Manny, Anthony and Gabriel arrived. A section of the basement concrete floor needed to be jackhammered to expose the pipe. Once exposed, they also found a hole in the sewer pipe and in the drain pipe.
The clay pipes were replaced with a 10 foot PVC pipe, a new drain and two clean out traps were also installed.
Anthony and Gabriel did a great job laying the new concrete and Manny made sure to keep us informed throughout the entire project.
The team came on time, plastic was hung around the work area, they mopped the floor and did a great job cleaning up. They told us what they needed to do and they got it done. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Ron & Yasha Talaga
reviews.text: Our toliet had been sprouting water from the tank, as well as leaking from around the bottom. Thomas and Rolando from The Fair Plumbers came out, and replaced the wax seal which was pretty much nonexistent, replaced the supply line and reconnected the valve. They were quick, thorough, and informative. The office also did a good job communicating when the plumbers were scheduled and on their way. Overall a great experience!

reviews.author: Orlando Santiago Jr
reviews.text:
Jose and Eric were INCREDIBLE!
Honest, upfront and super helpful with every option they had. They truly saved the day!  The laundry sink broke in the back and when I was unable to reach or see what the issue was i shut the main water valve off and began calling. No one was available, or they were too far away to be bothered until I reached out to The Fair Plumber. They came within an hour and handled it. Will use them again and highly recommend their services

reviews.author: Cruse Family
reviews.text: I called due to a malfunction with our pump. We had warranty with them. I called and they came out to replace it the same day at no charge. Jesus was super helpful at explaining what happened and over all we are very satisfied with the work.

plumbers.name: Brandenburg Plumbing, Heating, & Air
plumbers.address: 320 N Ridge Rd Ste 2B, Marble Falls, TX 78654, USA

reviews.author: Chris Cabiya
reviews.text:
Brandenburg Plumbing provided excellent service diagnosing and repairing a water leak for one of my trusted seller clients. The issue was identified quickly, clearly explained, and resolved properly by replacing the leaking valve. Efficient, professional, and done right the first time.

Lucas, the owner and master plumber, sets a high standard. His expertise, professionalism, and leadership are evident throughout the process. He takes a methodical, no-nonsense approach and prioritizes quality workmanship.

The entire team was professional and respectful, and communication was smooth from start to finish. An honorable mention to Nick McBride, an outstanding journeyman plumber whose skill, attention to detail, and professionalism stood out.

For context, I am Chris Cabiya, Founder and Principal Realtor® at Cabiya Realty Group and a local real estate investor serving the Highland Lakes area, including Marble Falls, Horseshoe Bay, and Granite Shoals. I hold service providers to very high standards on behalf of my clients. Brandenburg Plumbing met those standards without hesitation.

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Janet Bray
reviews.text: Brandenburg plumbing and all of its employees are excellent!! I have worked with them for nearly 30 years and they have come to my rescue time and time again. They are all very knowledgeable, helpful and courteous. This time it was Gabriel and Colton fixing my old plumbing issues. Gabriel goes above and beyond; and is very thorough. Thanks again guys!!

reviews.author: T E
reviews.text: It was easy to make an appointment and they addressed my leak the same day. Nick was amazing! A leak in a wall is never good news but he did everything he could to minimize the wall cut, worked quickly and was able to solve the problem without extensive repairs. This was a great experience and I’m so happy I was able to work with Nick. He was polite, friendly, explained everything along the way. He left the area super clean as well.

reviews.author: joan redbird
reviews.text: Great experience. Colt worked hard and got the job done. He was polite, friendly, and professional. Mr Brandenburg stopped by checked the job. He was also friendly and professional. Pleased with service. Would recommend! Thanks

reviews.author: Rami Segal
reviews.text: Highly professional service all around. House water filter canister cracked with the last freeze. We called after hours on Friday and Brandon came next day to evaluate. He made great recommendation for improvement of the system and provided an estimate. Work was done and Brandon sent pictures of the complete job. Great company, Great service , Highly recommended. I will use again when needed.

plumbers.name: ACE Home Services (formerly AZ Best Plumbing)
plumbers.address: 50 Stutz Bearcat Dr Ste 3, Sedona, AZ 86336, USA

reviews.author: Dianne Echazabal
reviews.text: These guys are the very best. I needed  to put a freeze free spigot in the paddocks behind my small barn.They came out together and had the difficult job completed in about 1.5  hours. They made the suggestion to put a "shut off " valve in the box should there be any problem with this spigot. Also suggested we diconnect all the hoses from their bibs during the winter. Friendly  knowlegable with good advice. Many thanks. You did a terrific job.

reviews.author: John Goodman
reviews.text:
Recently had two complete HVAC systems replaced at our home in Verde Santa Fe. First I appreciated the non pressure of the sales and management staff to make a decision and their patience with all our questions as well as concerns.
The three man crew that came to do the job were very polite, knowledgeable and efficient.
The total job was completed in two days, one system per day. Everything working perfectly.
They cleaned up nicely too.
I highly recommend ACE Home Services. (8/6/24)

Adding to my review, ACE was the only company I spoke with that would install and warranty their work for a Mini-Split AC unit I purchased independently.
Joshua Hogan, did an excellent job with the installation of the 24k BTU unit I purchased online.  Joshua was one of the 3 installers on the main house installation.  They all did excellent work and took any time needed to answer and questions, concerns or requests we had during the installations.

Before the main house was done we were having a problem with small particles and what looked like pink insulation coming down from one of duct lines.  After a duct cleaning the problem still continued, but slightly less.  Technician Marshall crawled around in the very hot attic inspecting the duct run looking for an obvious hole. No luck.  ACE offered to replace the whole duct run at a very reasonable cost and so they did. Upon inspection of the removed 50' of duct it was determined that the particles were actually particles of rust material flaking off the old A-coil.
Problem solved!  Thanks for pursuing the problem.

I would not hesitate to call or recommend ACE and use any of the service staff. Our job was big and it was a pleasant, unstressful experience.
We are very please.  (8/22/24)

reviews.author: Robert Ganem
reviews.text: I have used ACE Home Services a couple of times for my vacation rentals, but was very disappointed by my last experience.  They scheduled a plumber to come out on Saturday to unclog a toilet.  I informed my guest, but no one ever showed up, nor did anyone call to say they would not be showing up.  I called the next day and was again given an appointment window.  Again, no one showed up and no one even called!  I can understand that certain calls can take longer and needing to reschedule, but not even calling to let me know is really inexcusable.  The fact that it happened twice, unfortunately, lets me know that it's just how they operate. After the service, I received a standard survey request and had a chance to speak to a representative for the company. She was cordial, but I did not get the sense that any steps would be taken to avoid this type of poor service in the future.  Very sad.

reviews.author: Bridget
reviews.text: I had a new furnace and thermostat installed and the ducts cleaned out in a 1000 sq ft Flagstaff home. The entire process from start to finish was excellent. Sol did a great job with the quote and decisions on what to install. Lisa and Tom did fantastic assisting me to coordinate services and payment through my escrow company, Joe and Bradley did an amazing job with the installation and such cleaning (and the ducts were super gross from the previous long term tenants). I feel so fortunate to have had a great team making my new-to-me home safe and warm. Thank you ACE!

reviews.author: Helen Baker
reviews.text: Not reliable for non-emergency services. I waited in day after day, each time being rescheduled to the following day at the end of the service window. Finally got rescheduled to a weekend service window and the plumber called to say he “wasn’t driving that far unless it’s an active emergency”. So why schedule me? Wasted 3 days of my time and then ghosted. This isn’t AZ Best any more - do not recommend.

plumbers.name: Restore Plumbing and Drain
plumbers.address: 1401 Timber Dr, Elgin, IL 60123, USA

reviews.author: Barbara Diepenbrock
reviews.text: Quick in and out.  Half as much as a plumbing company I've been using for years with the same product and quality.  Friendly and fast.  I believe in paying fair wages and paying what for what you get but the other guys were ridiculous for what the job is.  If I wasn't old and fat now....I could do it myself but it would take me a whole day lol!  Thank you Restore Plumbing for being accessible and affordable without losing the fantastic service and quality.

reviews.author: Mike Dudek
reviews.text:
Absolute incredible experience from start to finish with the Restore team. From my very first phone call, everything was handled professionally, clearly, and with real care. The consultation with Dave was thorough and straightforward. He took the time to explain the system, answer questions, and make sure I was comfortable with every step before moving forward.

The installation work completed by John and CJ was equally impressive. They were punctual, respectful of my home, and clearly took pride in their work. The install was clean, efficient, and well explained, and they made sure everything was working properly before they left. It is obvious this team knows what they are doing and genuinely cares about delivering a great experience, not just finishing a job.

It is rare to work with a company where every touchpoint feels this well run and thoughtful. I would give this group 1000 stars if I could. Restore has absolutely earned my long term business, and I will confidently refer them to anyone I know who needs reverse osmosis or plumbing solutions. I truly appreciated the experience and could not recommend them more highly.

reviews.author: Ula Borodzinska
reviews.text: We had Kohler Veil "smart" toilet repair (still under warranty luckily).   Jonathan was on time, super polite and professional. He quickly determined issue and fixed it perfectly. Thank you Jonathan! If needed in a future I will be calling them and requesting Jonathan's services.

reviews.author: Pat Pornsakwiwat
reviews.text: The shower had no hot water. We called Restore plumbing and drain. The woman who answered the phone was very nice. John came the next day to inspect and explain the possibilities in detail. He was extremely patient and tried to fix the problem. Finally, we had hot water running. Very happy with the service we received from John.👍👍

reviews.author: Larry Wetzel
reviews.text: This is the second big job I have had in my house plumbing-wise.  Restore has done an outstanding job from start to finish. My technician, Virginio, was absolutely fantastic on explaining everything and performing the work.  Thanks again.  Will talk to you in the future.

plumbers.name: 1st American Plumbing, Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 4843 Emma Mine Dr, Herriman, UT 84096, USA

reviews.author: B A
reviews.text: I was very impressed with 1st American Plumbing.  Baeler was sent to my house for a drain cleaning and drain pipe repair.  They were able to come out that same day.  Baeler was very polite, great to work with, and he did an amazing job.  I was quoted a reasonable price up front and that was the price at the end.  Baeler managed to protect the area he had to work in and left it cleaner that it was before he arrived.

reviews.author: Chad Neilsen
reviews.text:
Be Careful with These Guys — Seriously!

I called for a quote to fix a small gas leak on my backyard fire pit. They sent a quote and said to sign it if I wanted the work done. I never signed it because I was still getting another quote.

Less than 24 hours later, they showed up unannounced while I wasn’t there and started doing the work without permission. When I called to sort it out, they came back—and left my yard wrecked, even leaving an uncapped gas line. That’s not just sloppy, it’s dangerous.

Super unprofessional, zero accountability, and honestly scary that they think this is acceptable. ⚠️ Watch out before hiring them!

reviews.author: Alexandra Shoemaker
reviews.text:
1st American plumbing is the best experience I’ve ever had with any vendor in Utah, and I will recommend them to everyone.
My pilot light went out on my water heater and I couldn’t get it back on.  After watching many “how to” YouTube videos I realized this was a job for a professional.  I called 1st American really early and Matt answered the phone (first good sign that an actual PERSON answered and not an automated answering machine!)  Matt talked with me about what I had already tried and scheduled a technician who arrived at my house at 9:00am on the dot.

I think it’s a very cool feature that they send you a text message with a photo of your repair person and a biography of their experience right when they arrive.

My technician Jon was so kind, polite and incredibly knowledgeable.  He had parts sent over for the repair, and had everything wrapped up promptly.  Pricing was fair and reasonable, and I am SO glad to have found a reliable local company. Their number is saved in my phone and they’re my new go-to for anything plumbing or hvac.

reviews.author: Colin
reviews.text: I recently had Jon from 1st American Plumbing, Heating & Air complete the install of my new water heater. Jon arrived on time and was extremely professional, respectful and highly skilled -  even going over and beyond to assist. I would highly recommend this company and especially Jon if you require a high-quality, reliable service.

reviews.author: Chris Shane
reviews.text: John was very punctual and communicative. He was friendly and good with my dog. John was educational and explained how things work. John went the extra mile. I had never used First American previously but they came recommended by a friend. I was impressed. They let me know all chargers and possible charges up front. Highly recommend.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Fort Worth
plumbers.address: 1200 Pennsylvania Ave, Fort Worth, TX 76104, USA

reviews.author: Kevin Young
reviews.text:
Clint came to my house and examed my problems like a plumbing physician. He gave me options of treatment and then educated me to prevent my issue from continuing.
Clint has an old school style, (friendly and professional), that gets the job done. He is trust worthy and the only Plumbing Doctor I want to cure my plumbing needs.
If your looking for a trustworthy and capable person, I highly recommend Clint!

reviews.author: Charles Rowe
reviews.text:
I am absolutely thrilled to share my experience with MR Rooter (Fort Worth) and the outstanding service provided by the technician (Tun) this past Sunday. From the moment he arrived, it was clear that Tun was not just skilled but also deeply committed to delivering exceptional customer service.

He took the time to thoroughly assess the issue, explaining each step of the process in a way that made me feel completely informed and confident in the work being done. What truly set him apart, however, was his attention to detail and the care he took to ensure everything was not just fixed, but working better than it ever had before. He went above and beyond, even offering helpful advice on maintenance to prevent future issues.

Not only was Tun incredibly professional, but he was also personable, making the entire experience much more enjoyable than I could have anticipated. He treated my home with the utmost respect, and his expertise was evident in every aspect of the job.

I cannot recommend MR Rooter and technician Tun highly enough. This is the level of service that restores faith in home service professionals. Thank you for such an outstanding experience!

reviews.author: Gregg Schmidt
reviews.text:
Ruben and his crew installed 2 Water Heaters and did a great job! Nice people! Great clean up and removal.
Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Andrew Nilsson
reviews.text:
I asked and tried to clarify that snaking a drain was free, the operator said it was as well as the diagnostic. I had a hard time believing that, but she insisted it was.
Of course turns out it wasn't. If she had told me the price I would have called someone else. I was desperate and after the technician arrived I had no choice but to continue. $550 to snake a toilet drain. $900 something if the technician removes the toilet. Took me 1 1/2 minutes to pull up the toilet. RIDICULOUS.

reviews.author: Shari Dickson
reviews.text: Jacky was amazing ! My upstairs water heater had a massive leak and I couldn't turn off the valve.  He was able to rearrange his list and was at my house within an hour. Very professional and I'd recommend him to anyone.

plumbers.name: Rocket Plumbing
plumbers.address: 5346 N Northwest Hwy, Chicago, IL 60630, USA

reviews.author: Ben Dieterich
reviews.text: We were experiencing water coming in on the ground floor, and had several plumbers with very expensive and intrusive recommendations. The plumbers from Rocket were the first ones to thoroughly explain the issue and ask enough questions to get to the best solution. They rodded the sewer line and showed that it is now clear, and recommended hydrojetting in the near future to take care of remaining root intrusion. Great communication: clear and thorough without all the smoke. I was impressed with the setup, putting down tarps and covering things with plastic, and cleaning up well when they left. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kim Kelly
reviews.text: Joel at Rocket Plumbing is amazing - we have used him for numerous services and always very pleased. He truly goes above and beyond to resolve a plumbing issue and is thoughtful, effecient, communicative and respectful when it comes to time, mess, etc. It is clear he truly takes pride in his work and cares about his customers. Highly recommend Rocket Plumbing & Joel!!

reviews.author: Chris Villegas
reviews.text: Absolutely top tier performance. Had a shower diverter and toilet installed along with a leaky hot water line replacement. All within the timeframe allowed and without issue. Straightforward pricing that didn’t change even after hitting a slight bump in the road. Very satisfied.

reviews.author: Barbara Steigerwald Cerceo
reviews.text: Eric did a great job. Quick and efficient. Kind and professional. Clean work. We having been using Rocket Plumbing for about a year now and are very satisfied with their service.

reviews.author: Jay Maupin
reviews.text: excellent service!  Prompt; thorough and no drama...just knocked everything out we needed done.  Rocket Plumbing really exceeded our expectations from scheduling to job completion.  Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Champion Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2524 N Broadway Suite #421, Edmond, OK 73034, USA

reviews.author: Tom Teasdale
reviews.text: Zack and Bennie spent parts of two days to get this repair made that included assessment, dust containment, jack hammering to expose failed pipe, repairs, concrete patching, and cleanup. We really appreciate their professional approach and plumbing expertise. Dr B (Brian) gave us an initial assessment at the front end that established confidence and a solid plan for the work. We are very happy to have the “slab leak” behind us and Champion Plumbing with us. (TT in OKC)

reviews.author: Rudy Navarro
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience with Thomas from Champion Plumbing! I purchased a water softener from Home Depot, and Thomas was incredibly responsive—he arrived the very next morning after it was delivered and had the entire installation completed before noon.
What really impressed me was his attention to detail. He didn't just "hook it up"; he cleaned up the existing plumbing, ensured all pipes were properly insulated, and positioned everything so that the parts are easily serviceable in the future. He even discovered some "builder-grade" issues with the original plumbing and made on-the-fly adjustments to ensure the entire house now has softened water.
Thomas is a true professional who clearly takes pride in his work. He took the time to show me exactly how to operate the system before he left. I can’t recommend him and Champion Plumbing highly enough!

reviews.author: Osvaldo Rodriguez
reviews.text: Ethan Patton technician came to fix at pipe leak urgent same day fix behind water heater in the wall and the service was fast, knowledgeable and expertly done. 5 stars thank you very much

reviews.author: Delaney Cooley
reviews.text: Fantastic experience from start to finish. Chase was punctual, clearly explained what was going on, and got the repair done quickly. Fair pricing, great workmanship, and we felt very well taken care of.

reviews.author: M
reviews.text: Very Disappointed had them come out for a estimate. Was told it would be $80 and be removed if we proceeded. We had 10-15 feet of pipe to be routed off of our gas meter and they want $4500-$5500 to do the job! Are you kidding lol.. So we decided we would pay the $80 fee and be on our way. Well it is $89 as a fee. Just buyer beware as you need to know that is highway robbery !

plumbers.name: Bulldog Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 580 S River St, Batavia, IL 60510, USA

reviews.author: Justin Clapper
reviews.text: Chris did phenomenal job. Knowledgeable and competent and worked efficiently. installed multiple redundancies to prevent the pipe from freezing, including a local water cut-off valve, a drain, and added necessary pitch to enable the pipe to drain properly. I was very impressed with his work. pro tip: have cash available if you plan to tip; i was not able to add a tip with my CC bc its not enabled with B'dogs transaction service.

reviews.author: N. Cavallaro
reviews.text: Had an excellent experience with Bulldog. Will recommend to all friends and neighbors. Quick to come out, very reasonable pricing! Plumber Chris was so great to work with. Fast and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Marina Hinton
reviews.text: I am so glad I came across Bulldog Plumbing! We own a house in Aurora and have been looking for a go-to plumbing company. They were very no frills about the estimate via phone, and were able to send someone out to do our repair same day! The pricing was right on-par to what they provided via phone and my plumber was friendly and knowledgeable. Will certainly be calling Bulldog for future repairs!

reviews.author: julie tokars
reviews.text: I was very happy with my experience with Bulldog Plumbing.  They were very responsive with my request and had a quote and appt set within an hour.  The plumber was prompt, courteous and showed me exactly what he was going to do.  Price seemed reasonable.  I would recommend them for any project.

reviews.author: Jessica Grace
reviews.text: I could not recommend Bulldog plumbing more! They were fast and efficient, clean and respectful. They explained the scope of work to me and had incredibly fair pricing. He was even kind to my cat who wanted to get under the sink with him. They will be my go to company for all my plumbing needs. As a single woman, it is great to know I have such a reliable and respectful option for help when I need it!

plumbers.name: Flow Masters Plumbing, Drain and Water Heater
plumbers.address: 6169 Mission St, Daly City, CA 94014, USA

reviews.author: Mark Mullin
reviews.text:
I want to write today and commend Flow Masters, and two technicians in particular (Jose & Miguel) - for their help, and hard work this past week.  First week with our lovely new tenants, and low & behold, the old furnace decided to kick the bucket - during a cold spell and on the day before Thanksgiving no less - not a great look at all.
I'm very grateful to the Flow Masters team for getting out to the home right away, diagnosing the issues, and most of all - then putting in the new furnace on Thanksgiving day.
While I feel guilty making the two gentlemen work on a family day, I'm incredibly grateful for their hard work, dedication, and excellent job getting the unit installed.  Very much appreciate the partnership with Flow Masters - they've been fantastic to work with - M

reviews.author: Russell Raiter
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the urgency FlowMasters took with the project. They always showed up early and equipped and ready to work. We had Kevin, who is really good at the trade and neatly completeld the drain project.

reviews.author: kenny jackson
reviews.text:
This is my first time using Flow Masters and overall they did an excellent job. Scheduling a repair was a little lengthy because they first had to send out a person to assess the situation and then I had schedule a separate appointment to execute the repair.
But, they (Alberto) were very knowledgeable about my heating system, even making me aware that the company that made the product is no longer in business and that there were some safety concerns about the particular unit that I have.
The repair was executed by a team including Roberto who were very thorough and did an excellent job of verifying the system after the repair (they didn’t rush out the door.) and cleaning up once they were done. I would highly recommend them for all your plumbing and heating needs.

reviews.author: raul areca
reviews.text: With so much rain I noticed a possibly unrelated leak in the area where they had been working. Tina was quick to send out the original crew to investigate. I was encouraged and amazed that they would respond so quickly and with the confidence and integrity to honor stand behind their work. Turns out it was an unrelated issue but I was impressed with the professionalism from Fernando and Chase and everyone at Flowmasters. Feel blessed that they are all trustworthy and professional.

reviews.author: Deborah Hoch
reviews.text:
Great service from Flow Masters. First Sebastian came out and assessed and diagnosed several issues, explaining each in detail and offering a range of solutions at a range of costs. Soon after, Kevin arrived to make repairs and install a fixture and fittings.

Both gentlemen were professional and handled service with friendliness, knowledge, respect for my home.

Midway through the work, another issue was discovered, Sebastian explained it, demonstrated the problem, and stayed late to repair it. All in all, great work.

plumbers.name: O & M Plumbing Services, Inc.
plumbers.address: 1406 Three Points Rd Ste B8, Pflugerville, TX 78660, USA

reviews.author: Shannon Markus
reviews.text: Chris was extremely helpful during the visit to our residence to fix our water heater. He was knowledgable and explained everything clearly and thoroughly. Extra points -- we actually got a different, very well known, plumbing company to come out 2 days before and they could NOT fix the issue. Chris fixed the issue in 1 hour after troubleshooting at least 5-6 different processes and explaining each one. I can not recommend O&M enough! We've used them a lot and will continue to do so. Thanks!

reviews.author: Eric H
reviews.text: My neighbor recommended Ben at O&M several years ago. They’ve been my go-to plumbers ever since. The technicians are reliable and well-trained. Great communication. Good recommendations when seeking cost-effective solutions. Reasonable pricing. And they honor their work.

reviews.author: Clinton Dobbs
reviews.text: Andrew was the most friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful professional that we’ve had out to our place. To the point, efficient, and clean work. I cannot recommend O & M Plumbing enough. There is a reason why they get so many great ratings!

reviews.author: Cyndi Nickel
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ O & M Plumbing – A True Gem!**

We recently purchased a beautiful mid-century home built in 1962, and while it had charm in spades, it also came with a few plumbing challenges. Enter **O & M Plumbing**, and more specifically, **Chris**—a master of his craft and hands-down the best plumber we've ever worked with!

From the start, Chris tackled every issue with precision, professionalism, and a genuine care for our home. He installed a **new main gas pipe** for our HVAC system, not only enabling the upgrade but also curing **slow gas leaks in the attic** that had been a lingering concern. That alone was a huge relief!

But Chris didn’t stop there. He **fixed a leaky toilet and its stubborn shut-off valve**—a problem that had stumped *three other plumbers*. His persistence and expertise were unmatched. He also installed a **new diverter tub spout** that seamlessly blended with our vintage fixtures, preserving the home’s original aesthetic while ensuring modern functionality.

And then there was the **outdoor spigot**, which had been virtually abandoned due to severe corrosion. Chris brought it back to life, solving a problem we thought was beyond repair.

Every step of the way, Chris was courteous, knowledgeable, and incredibly thorough. If you’re lucky enough to book him for your plumbing needs, you’re in excellent hands. **O & M Plumbing is a rare find, and Chris is a true plumbing hero.** Highly, *highly* recommended.

reviews.author: Marjan
reviews.text: I had a great experience with O & M Plumbing Services who visited our job site. He was very honest and took the time to explain everything in detail, ensuring I understood the situation clearly. His professionalism and transparency were much appreciated, and I feel confident in the work he recommended. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Flow Right Plumbing
plumbers.address: 13947 Kildare Ave, Crestwood, IL 60418, USA

reviews.author: Janet Cobb
reviews.text: Emilio was prompt, courteous and knowledgeable about what I needed done. The price was on target as well. I appreciate you guys so much.

reviews.author: Ivan Bolivar
reviews.text:
*Update*
I am adding a video and a couple photos. This is work they did. Spigot not anchored? Im pretty sure the pipes are not supposed to look like that after 1 year of barely being used.

I am writing this review because so far the owner has ghosted me. He set an appointment with me, and never showed up or had the decency to call me to let me know he wont be showing up. When I spoke to the office, i was informed that he had an emergency customer. So you guys ditch appointments for an emergency customer? Ive been calling the office and the receptionist (Michelle) can only pass on my message, which i understand. It is beyond her hands. I will change my review if anything changes but so far im very dissatisfied with their service.

I bought a house that has had complete new plumbing done by FlowRight, the 1st couple of months, the water pressure wasn't right. I couldn't have 2 showers on at the same time. Plumber came in, found the issue and told me they need to replace and  order the part off Amazon because they dont Install these parts and then gave me a quote for fixing it. When I informed him the work was done by FlowRight, he stated that it couldn't be true because they dont use these parts. He got on the phone and 10 minutes later said yes they did do the work for my house and that he can fix it. The issue was "fixed" free of charge but im confused as to why he said they had to order a new part. I left it alone. Its been a year later and Im having water pressure issues still. I called to have them check the water pressure issue and to check my water spigot because the water is shooting out of crawlspace area Instead of my spigot. I have not been able to use my spigot at all this summer and its supposed to be new plumbing. Plumber came in, and gave me a quote. 300$ for labor to take out a filter so they can identify what kind of filter, order it, and replace it. 600$ to fix the spigot because it apparantly ruptured in the winter. Im confused as to why they need to charge me 300$ in labor to figure out a filter THEY Installed. They should know what kind of filter they Installed. And 600$ to fix a spigot ive only used a couple times the summer prior.
I am writing this review because as of now I've missed a day of work to accommodate the owner Mark and for him to do a no call/no show while I missed work to meet him. He has not returned my calls. I've been calling the office and speaking with Michelle since I've gotten the quote on the 26th of June. It is now the 9th of August and Mark has yet to return a phone call.
I spoke with the manager Stephanie, nice lady. But upon speaking to her, she informed me that they had no record of their plumber going to my house last year. Very odd in my opinion especially when I explained how I needed " a new part", then the story changed to they can fix it the prior year.
I asked why would they need to charge me labor to figure out what kind of filter THEY Installed, order the filter and then install it back. She informed me that they dont always take notes in regards to the work that they do. Again, very odd. If I go do a job, and later on the customer calls me to replace something, I will know what needs to be replaced if I did the job myself but okay, fine lets move forward. I was informed that the warranty for FlowRight Plumbing is 90 days upon completion of job. As far as I know, in Illinois minimum is 2 years for plumbing warranties. I have not received a call back from FlowRight nor the owner.

I will update my review if the problem gets resolved.

reviews.author: Christina Lazauskas
reviews.text: Technician Frank was on time, friendly, and professional. We chatted briefly about the situation and he immediately went to work and quickly resolved the issue. He was respectful of my property and cleaned up everything to look like he was never even here. After the service he offered tips for sewer line maintenance, again in a friendly and professional manner. Overall I am very satisfied with the experience and the work provided and would absolutely recommend Flow Right Plumbing to anyone needing plumbing service.

reviews.author: jim zouras
reviews.text:
Matt and his partner were excellent! The job became a little bit of a challenge but they stayed calm and professional and patiently completed the repair. It was great to see the great and caring attitude they both portrayed.
I will definitely use Flow Right Plumbing as well as recommend them to anyone who is in need of Plumbing services.
Thank You.

reviews.author: Dawn Stevenson
reviews.text: I had a toilet that kept running after flushing.  I chose the best company I could imagine.  From beginning to end they showed kindness, care and professionalism.  I would recommend them to anyone who needs a great plumber.  Polite and caring they did the job quickly and efficiently.  Thank you so much!  I would use your revives again and again!!

plumbers.name: 535 Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 1130 N Nimitz Hwy Suite B-180, Honolulu, HI 96817, USA

reviews.author: Russell Inouye
reviews.text: Johnny did a great job fixing the leaks on my shut-off valves. He called to say that he can show up earlier than expected, so I was very happy about that. He worked quickly and he left the area neat and clean. I’m very satisfied with his quality of work and his work ethic.

reviews.author: Bryan Kawashige
reviews.text:
The installation service by Johnny and Aiden was outstanding. Very professional and detailed workmanship. Cost for this great service seems high though. $2330 plus an additional $300 for a part seems a lot for installing this high performance platinum hybrid heat pump/water heater. Many steps involved and installers did quality work, but installation cost $1000 more than the cost of my heater.. $2600 to install  $1600 heater seems very high to me even though the installation work was great.
Compliments to installers Johnny and Aiden

reviews.author: Melissa N
reviews.text:
I don’t normally take the time to write reviews, but 535 Plumbing LLC absolutely deserves to be recognized.

We noticed water leaking from under our stove in the kitchen, and there was obvious water damage starting to show. From the very first call, their customer service — especially Maurice — was professional, responsive, and straightforward. No runaround, no upselling, just clear communication and honest guidance.

Technicians Johnny and Ayden came out and were outstanding. They were professional, knowledgeable, and most importantly — no BS. They quickly detected the source of the leak and were able to repair it the same day, which gave us so much peace of mind.

Unfortunately, because of the water damage, restoration will be needed. However, they also have a trusted sister company they work with for restoration services, and we’re looking forward to working with them as well.

If you’re looking for a plumbing company that values professionalism, honesty, and getting the job done right — 535 Plumbing LLC is it. We will absolutely be using them for all future plumbing needs.

Mahalo 535 team!

reviews.author: Melanie Payanal
reviews.text:
I called 535 Plumbing based on a neighbor’s recommendation, and I could not have been more impressed. From start to finish, the experience was excellent.

We needed a shut-off valve installed and a shower faucet leak repaired. Johnny and Roy arrived on time, were extremely personable and professional, and demonstrated outstanding work ethic. They worked efficiently, completed everything flawlessly, and were meticulous about keeping the work area clean. They were also very respectful of our home, which I really appreciated.

What stood out most was how smooth and timely the entire process was—from my initial call to completion of the work, everything was handled within just a few weeks. The quality of the work, combined with the professionalism and reasonable pricing, made it an exceptional expedience.

I highly recommend 535 Plumbing without any hesitation or reservation. Exceptional service all around. Don’t hassle trying to get quotes from multiple companies, 535 Plumbing is the best you can get.

reviews.author: Kyla Ganote
reviews.text:
Roydenn and John were absolutely amazing. They were so attentive, quick, and efficient—no dilly-dallying at all. They got the job done incredibly fast, cleaned everything up, and genuinely made us feel like we were the only clients in the world.

Even though they’re based in town, they made it all the way out to Hawaii Kai super quickly and kept that same level of care and urgency the entire time. Professional, kind, and just overall such a great experience. Couldn’t recommend them more!

plumbers.name: Expert Services - Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electrical
plumbers.address: 2330 S Main St #7, Salt Lake City, UT 84115, USA

reviews.author: John Pfaff
reviews.text:
Mark and Jonathon were fantastic and extremely professional. The job ended up being more difficult than anticipated but they were extremely knowledgeable about how to proceed. For reference, they had to move water pipes and a gas line for us and it was a huge task they accomplished.

Would recommend them to anyone as they were fantastic to work with and the company is not Private Equity owned. You can tell they are committed to providing a great service for a fair price, unlike most other plumbing companies in SLC

reviews.author: Eric Newman
reviews.text: Mika was awesome! We had to get our sewer line replaced earlier this month and he did everything he could to get us the help we needed. The plumbing manager, Aaron, did great keeping us up to date on their communications with the city. The rest of the crew who came out to help (I think Lyric, Toni, and Brandon based on my texts, but there might have been more and I apologize if I missed anybody), were great as well--they were very polite and if they needed to discuss something with us they did a great job explaining it and making sure we were okay with everything. When they were done they spent a lot of time making sure our lawn was as good as they could make it before they left. I'm very happy with everything. Everything works great!

reviews.author: Chris Schaeffer
reviews.text:
When I want my plumbing fixed, I'd like it to be fixed in a way that the problem does not come back.  You get what you pay for and I'd rather pay a little extra up-front than pay twice when the first repair fails and it has to be done again.

We have had excellent experience with Expert Services for Plumbing.  Especially David and David, Chandler and Mika deserve shout-outs for the quality of their work, their explanation of what they were going to do and why and their recommendations.  We had a MASSIVE disaster when our connection with the main sewer system broke.  Mika rode to the rescue at short notice and the Expert team involved a disaster mitigation company and by the time I got back, everything was fixed and cleaned.  David gave us great recommendations for our plumbing system and implemented them.  Chandler replaced our water heaters and changed the configuration so that the chance of future water heater failure is much reduced.

They work clean and are very competent.  I will hire them again.

reviews.author: Lisa Lee
reviews.text: I have used this company for years- this is at least seven repairs on a 15-year-old house that has all the original appliances. They're always friendly, neat, and explain everything carefully so I understand. The work is always excellent and I recommend them to anyone

reviews.author: Luciana Fernandes
reviews.text:
The service was impeccable. I called the company yesterday afternoon with a serious plumbing issue at my house, and they scheduled me for the very next day. John Harvey arrived exactly on time with all the necessary equipment. He clearly explained what the problem was, the possible solutions, and the challenges. He arrived shortly after lunch and finished about 15 minutes ago. The issue was quite serious, but he handled everything from start to finish with professionalism and confidence.

John is extremely friendly, communicative, and such a pleasant person to have around. The whole experience was smooth and stress free. I do not usually write reviews, but finding a plumber and a power company that truly solve your problem is priceless. Highly recommended.

plumbers.name: PlumbCrazy
plumbers.address: 1302 Continental Dr, Abingdon, MD 21009, USA

reviews.author: Shaun Haberkam
reviews.text: Quick shout out to #PlumbCrazy for fixing me up over the long weekend. Working in real estate I come across a lot of service companies. PlumbCrazy is the only plumbing company I call. My home was built in the 80s and constantly needs plumbing updates. They have installed for me a new well pump, multiple hose bibs, faucets…you name it they have fixed it in my house. I called at 8 am Monday and they promised to get to me buy 2 pm as I had no water. They prioritized me and were there by 10:30 am the same day. Diagnosed the problem quickly and figured we had to dig out well cap down about 5 feet to access the part. They fixed me up the same day and had machinery there within the hour. It was also the first time in a long while where is saw the work that went in and was shocked by how affordable the repair was. When I saw that machinery digging I thought I was in big trouble with a huge bill coming my way. I can’t say enough great things about them over the 10 years I have been calling on them for service. Thanks to the PlumbCrazy team!

reviews.author: Timothy Chrockrem
reviews.text: Tom was friendly, professional and worked quickly. Work was done in less than 4 hrs. He removed the old water heater and installed a new one plus expansion tank. Even added shut off valves that i didnt have previously. I will definitely use Plumb Crazy in the future.

reviews.author: Mike Potter
reviews.text: Great company to deal with. I had them come out to replace a indoor water shut off and the plumber did a great job.  Showed up right on time and the price was reasonable for the work done.   They are now my go to for doing plumbing work as needed.

reviews.author: Elli Jones
reviews.text: Front lady there name Katie has a rude attitude and terrible customer service. Next time I go to ask for help I prefer not to talk to her a nice guy name Rodney helped me after speaking with him my experience got better as a older lady I thought it was extremely helpful talking with someone who didn’t disrespect me my daughter had to pick me up later that day due to not understanding what I was saying distracted the whole time on her cell phone with out any communication on why I couldn’t get a reply. The crew came and fixed my home thank you plum crazy better luck next time my son says she stinks anyway haha!

reviews.author: Erin Kelly
reviews.text: I had a pipe burst under my house. I was lost and I had an appointment with Plumb Crazy. Rodney came out,  assessed the issue, showed me everything that led to it and fixed it for me at a great price. Everyone that I had contact with from Admin to Rodney was so nice and professional. I have a fixed pipe and water now. Thank you Plumb Crazy! I'll definitely recommend you guys to anyone with a plumbing issue.

plumbers.name: Jim Wagner Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 51 Eisenhower Ln S, Lombard, IL 60148, USA

reviews.author: Julie Adams
reviews.text: We were really happy with the customer service at Jim Wagner. Someone came within the hour to look at our water heater. Our plumber Kevin was awesome!! He was honest, thorough, and friendly. He was able to get our new water heater installed that day and within 3 hours. The price seemed average too. We will definitely work with them again!

reviews.author: Mike Rodak
reviews.text: They came out the day I called to evaluate the situation and provide a quote immediately.  We wound up replacing my old concrete laundry tub and galvanized pipes with a new fiberglass tub and PVC pipes, new copper, new faucet and shut off valves.  They were fast, friendly, clean, and efficient!  Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Tim Abell
reviews.text: Had our kitchen faucet replaced.  We supplied the faucet and had Jim Wagner replace it.  Kevin was great.  Did a great job and was on his way in less than an hour.  Not knowing the cost of other plumbing services, I would say the price to replace the faucet was on the high end.

reviews.author: Rich Chiesa
reviews.text:
Kevin came out to repair a leak off our sump pump.  Not only did he fix the leak, he fixed the problem with the piping hammering when the sump pump stopped.  Kevin did a FANTASTIC job!

Kevin was transparent about pricing, he cleaned up after the job was done, and he was very courteous.  I HIGHLY recommend Jim Wagner Plumbing!

reviews.author: Kelly Toboja
reviews.text: I did a thorough review of 5 local plumbers, including taking time to read reviews/ratings, preferred local and family-owned business, quality and certifications. I plugged each into AI and selected 3 and reached out/put in a request for a call back on their website. First, Jim Wagner reached out same day (and it was a Saturday!), another one reached out 3 business days later, and the other one never reached out. I went with Jim Wagner, and I am so happy I did. They had a call off, and called to ask if I could move my appointment to a later time in the day - no problem. Christopher showed up promptly at the time promised, and he was friendly, explained everything in detail, was very transparent with cost, provided a coupon online I was not aware of, and spent a lot of time here ensuring the problem with our drain was fixed. For the record, the cost for them to come out was a little less than the others I researched, and second - I am a firm believer in you get what you pay for, but of course value has to accompany the cost, and I firmly believe it did. I would and will use them again, and will recommend them to friends and family. They have created a loyal customer in me.

plumbers.name: Residential Plumbing
plumbers.address: 155 Kirkland Cir #600, Oswego, IL 60543, USA

reviews.author: Stephanie Van Tieghem
reviews.text: If you need a plumber, call Residential Plumbing first. I had multiple plumbers out for a quote and Residential was by far the best price and did an amazing job. I had just moved into the house and the previous owner had done his own plumbing. Everything was out of code or not working. I have had Residential out 4 times in the past 2 weeks for new issues that pop up and every time they are great. I am a loyal client from now on.

reviews.author: Denise Murray
reviews.text: Residential Plumbing was recommended by a friend of mine. I called another plumber first and was very unhappy with the receptionist, who could not answer my questions and would not let me speak with a plumber. I was very pleased with Residential Plumbing. I spoke with Stacia. She answered my questions and relayed my information to the plumber. She was supposed to call me back after speaking with the plumber but perhaps forgot. I called her back the next morning. I received email confirmations and texts with a picture of the plumber prior to his arrival. When he arrived, he listened attentively and was very nice. So far, so good. Everything seems to be fixed and working great. I will definitely recommend Residential Plumbing to anyone I know.

reviews.author: Mary Anne Sorensen
reviews.text:
Residential Plumbing once again delivered outstanding service! We had a water leak in our living room ceiling, and Rob and Cade came out promptly today.  They were extremely professional, kind, and knowledgeable from start to finish.

They took the time to walk us through every step of the repair, explained what they were doing, and reassured us throughout the process. They even remembered being at our home last year when we had a leak in our laundry room ceiling—such a thoughtful touch that shows how much they care about their customers.

Rob and Cade were friendly, respectful, and truly went above and beyond. They also recommended a great company to help with the drywall repair and to work with our insurance, which was incredibly helpful.

We are very grateful for their excellent service and highly recommend Residential Plumbing to anyone needing trustworthy, professional, and dependable plumbing work!

reviews.author: Natasha Marriner
reviews.text: I discovered a back up (coming up laundry floor drain) to the house on a Sunday and left a message for Residential Plumbing.  They called me first thing Monday morning and had a team at my house within an hour.  The office texted me updates of their arrival.   The team was professional, friendly and helpful at explaining the issue and solution.  Overall fantastic experience.

reviews.author: Mark Taghap
reviews.text: Great experience from start to finish. Ken arrived on time, explained the issue clearly, and completed the work efficiently with high-quality results. Pricing was fair and transparent, with no surprises. I would definitely recommend this service to anyone needing reliable and professional plumbing work.

plumbers.name: 1-Tom-Plumber
plumbers.address: 1920 Jordan Ln NW, Huntsville, AL 35816, USA

reviews.author: Rob Narvaez
reviews.text: Heath and Kaden were very friendly and professional.  They worked quickly to find the leak and repaired it quickly.  They are a great team.  They were incredibly considerate of my house and property.   I would recommend 1 Tom to my friends and family. This team was at my house with 30 mins of calling Travis super fast

reviews.author: Paul Huske
reviews.text: I had a plumbing emergency. They were very prompt and were able to accommodate me and coordinate their team quickly. Easy to communicate with everyone from the dispatcher through the work crew. They did a good job and nothing else was damaged or affected. They had a backup ready in case of more flooding occurring when they pumped the stoppage. They gave me options and I did not feel pressured with an upsell which was nice. I had an emergency and I did not shop around for pricing so I cannot compare on price with anything else. I can saw the we’re prompt, professional, fixed it first try and took a bit of time after to verify that everything was flowing correctly and working before they left. I was glad to get a solution in under 24hrs. In hindsight, I would try everything I can to solve it myself, if I had another problem. I could have bought the professional grade snake, bought the same tier dry vac, put my family up in a hotel for a week, and still saved enough money for a weekend away vacation had I done it myself. It was shockingly expensive.

reviews.author: S Braz
reviews.text: I called 1 Tom Plumbing this morning at about 9:30.  by 11:00 their Service Technician Mark Waldrop was standing in my garage talking to me about the problem I was having with my whole house water filteration system. He really spent some time looking at where the leak was originating from and determined that the housing wasn’t cracked, instead the O-ring on the pressure release valve was basically disintegrating, and making it so you couldn’t take the pressure off the water filter to remove it and replace it. He had the part in his truck to fix it and had me back up and running by noon. The price they charged was very reasonable. He was wonderful. I can’t say enough nice things about Mark Waldrop. he is a GREAT representative for your company. this is the second time that I’ve had y’all out to do something for me and both times the technicians have just been wonderful and knowledgeable and fixed the problem quickly. I will definitely use you again and will recommend one time Plumbing to all of My friends

reviews.author: John Clark
reviews.text: I would use these guys again, Mark our tech was great, we had a gas leak under our house. He got it fixed made us feel real comfortable. Very nice guy. I would definitely use this company again for any of my plumbing needs. Mark went out of his way to make sure we were taken care of thank you again.

reviews.author: Joanna Deutsch

reviews.author: Aravindan Kolandaivelu

reviews.author: Priscilla F.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Sells
reviews.text:
They did show up. The simple problem was fixed. However I was charged excessively for the job. They saw a huge house & tried to take advantage of me. My father was a master contractor. He could have fixed this in less than an hour. I was charged $538. Because I have roommates I felt forced to pay this amount. But I do know I was overcharged. I was told by the plumber it was a flat rate. When I called the company, they said the charge was based on the hours needed, supplies etc. So they gave me two different reasons. Very frustrating.
My father would have never treated anyone like this.
The water was seen in the basement. The leak was from above the room. It was simple to find. Simple to fix. And because this is an actual plumbing company, they should keep basic supplies on them. Not need to go get them.
This was an hour job. By a younger licensed plumber. There is no way possible I should have been charged this amount. I work with contractors on a regular basis. Not to mention I grew up with a contractor father. At most this would be $150 job including supplies. I asked other plumbers & each said I was very much overcharged. Was the pipe made of gold & diamonds? No a regular copper pipe.

reviews.author: Kristina Clough
reviews.text:
Our toilet in our master bathroom was leaking. It went through the floor and was leaking to the bathroom on the floor below. I called Schleuter Plumbing and they got a tech out to us same day.

Craig was great! He was very professional, friendly and knowledgeable. He identified the issue and presented me with three options to resolve it. I ended up getting a new toilet. He installed it for me same day and now everything is nice and dry and good as new!

reviews.author: Josh Meyers

reviews.author: Gregory Yuh
reviews.text: Geoff from Holt is awesome. He came to fix and replace shower fixture and did the best job I've seen to date.
