Eventhough it was late in the day, Geoff was very through and did not rush any part of the job. Although he did not leave until 9 pm, Geoff made sure everything was working and cleaned up everything. Cannot compliment Geoff enough. I'll absolutely use Holt again and ask for Geoff.

reviews.author: John Darlington
reviews.text:
Geoff and Gabe showed up about 10 minutes early - it's certainly a nice start when we've all experienced having to wait until later in the window of time a company gives you.  I wasn't aware that this property's driveway was north facing after these ice storms.In nashville, the driveway was still completely frozen.  Not an issue for these guys.They took it in stride, had a shovel to chip a safe path for them to work and went about their business.  I'm so pleased with the work they did.  My tenant has been patient with these unexpected plumbing problems because I have been responsive.  This team helped me continue to deliver quickly considering a somewhat "delicate" plumbing issue.
I'm going to have to have additional plumbing done and I plan on using Holt/these guys to do it.
Professional, kind, polite. thorough and not hard selling. Educating me with the problem and offering options.  That's all one could hope for. All that in below freezing temperatures?  Thank you!!

Thank you!

reviews.author: Connor Cain
reviews.text: Had an emergency leak from my pressure reducing valve post ice-storm and Geoff and Gabe and Holt Plumbing were extremely quick, professional, and thorough. My crawl space is small and has some fragile wiring, but they navigated the space carefully and fixed the leak in about an hour and a half, in freezing temperatures. I even asked an unrelated question about water pressure as the call was wrapping up and they re-parked and stayed longer just to check a few more things and helped me get my water pressure a little stronger. Will absolutely be calling them again and I would recommend them to anyone that I liked.

reviews.author: Erik Manger
reviews.text: Worked with Holt Plumbing for the first time to have them take a look at a commercial property regarding an unknown plumbing related issue. The tech. was with us for probably 10 minutes and stated that they would have to come back once again with an additional individual to help perform some additional work at an additional cost, which I was perfectly fine with. Holt Plumbing sent me an estimate for that work as well as an invoice for the initial visit which included an egregious hourly rate and a "billing and administrative fee". I've never seen a company add a "billing and administrative fee" to their invoicing - extremely tacky. I'll find someone else to finish the job.

reviews.author: Nancy Laura Scott
reviews.text: My neighbors recommended Holt Plumbing for the quality of work and customer service. I knew I had a leak and some Home maintenance that needed attention. I did not understand what it really encompassed . Geoff Was the service man who came to assist me. He went out of his way to put me at ease and showed me so much courtesy and respect. He educated me through the process explaining what was needed and why. He was professional and thorough through the entire job. It is going to end up being a two day job and he explained why that was going to have to happen that way. I wholeheartedly recommend Holt Plumbing for any of your Plumbing needs,  and Geoff as of repairman who you will feel comfortable having in your home.

plumbers.name: Mullin Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2936 N Shields Blvd, Moore, OK 73160, USA

reviews.author: Delf Meek
reviews.text:
I used Mullin Plumbing a couple of years ago to repair a slab leak. Since I had good results with that repair I didn't hesitate to call them again when I had a leak in the wall of my shower.

They did come out in a timely manner. It was determined there was a leaking shower valve, which needed to be replaced, which included installing a new one, so we needed to replace the faucet. I supplied the faucet (A standard Delta Classic Shower Faucet from Home Depot).

The installation job of the faucet was the worst I've seen and looked like a 6 year old cobbled it together.  He removed the horizontal 2x4 wood brace for the shower valve mounting bracket and ended up using toggle bolt anchors for the front face plate and drove a screw from the backside of the bracket to hold the shower valve in place. After further investigation, this is because he managed to break one of the faceplate mounting holes off of the mounting bracket (How?!?!).  The broken piece was laying on the floor inside the wall.

I should have done a better job of inspecting this work before paying them and sending them out the door, but I'm not a plumber or a carpenter for that matter and put a lot of trust in this company to perform a repair correctly.  It wasn't until I started the drywall repair I discovered this dumpster fire of a repair.

I could call them back to repair this, but I don't want them back in my house. Ever. I ordered a new bracket from Delta ($15) as well as new faceplate screws.  I trimmed off about of 1/4 of inch of tile on the bottom.  Screwed the 2x4 wood brace back into place and mounted the shower valve bracket into place.  I'm not a carpenter.  This job took me 30 minutes to do.

The 1 star I'm giving this review is more than I want to give it.  I've made sure to tell everyone I know to not use these jokers.  While it was probably just the individual plumber that should be fired, this 100% gave this company a bad name.  Take a little bit more pride in your work.

reviews.author: Dustin Clark
reviews.text: MY REVIEW HAS NOTHING TO DO THEIR SERVICE RATHER AN EXPERIENCE WITH THEIR DRIVER ON THE ROAD. A MULLINS TRUCK CUT ME OFF ON THE INTERSTATE PULLING A TRAILER WITH NO WORKING LIGHTS AND SLINGING ROCKS OFF THE BACK ONE WHICH BROKE MY NEW WINDSHIELD. WHEN TRYING DRIVERS ATTENTION HE ROLLED THE WINDOW DOWN AND FLIPPED ME OFF, I WAQS GOING TO LET IT ALL GO BUT NO ONE WANTS TO ANSWER THE PHONE WHEN YOU CALL.

reviews.author: Jeff Middaugh
reviews.text:
Right before Christmas I was at my mom’s getting ready for our Christmas party.

We noticed water on the living room floor.

I checked the garage and water was flooding everywhere.

I looked and Mullin plumbing was on the install records so I called them as I got the water shut off. The living room and garage were already flooded.

One of their pex crimps failed and the hot water was shooting out full blast into the wall.

When I called I explained everything and asked about warranty since installed 3 years prior. They said they’d assess once they show up and no apology.

The repair person was the same as the installer my mom remembered and they didn’t take accountability or apologize.

My mom is 85 and I asked about warranty or discount for poor workmanship and was told no. Not even $1.

The repair cost over $250 for a simple crimp on what they failed to do correctly.

We won’t use Mullin Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Taylor Miller
reviews.text: We had Eddie out to fix our water heater. He was great. Communicated with us every step of the way and couldn’t have been more nice. He got it fixed and running great! We are very grateful that he was able to help us out in a pinch. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Brad Stevens

They called at 12:45 and canceled my appointment. I would recommend to never use this company. A zero star review is even too much for Mullin Plumbing.

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Dave Dorocke
reviews.text: Called MPT Plumbing (Mike) to address a minor leak after a water meter replacement late last week. Since the issue occurred due the meter replacement, he not only called the city to ask about having this fixed, they directed him to the company that replaced the meter. He called, they listened to his explanation of what happened and promptly scheduled to come out the day to fix this issue. Mike is a true honest business owner that genuinely cares about his customers and goes well beyond the norm in regards to typical customer service. I am incredibly grateful to have met this good man today. Thank you for your service and insight today.

reviews.author: Gina K
reviews.text: Mike saved me from a major disaster with a sink install. He came in and took over the situation and I’m grateful for his professionalism and direction. He even set me up with other contractors to help with other needed services. Great guy. Highly recommended MPT!

reviews.author: Carol Schacherer
reviews.text:
Mike and his partner were amazing!
Very professional, very kind.
I had a big difficult job that they had to do and now it’s fixed!
I would recommend this company to everyone.

reviews.author: Brian Seng
reviews.text: The gentlemen who did the job were perfectly reasonable and professional. Clean job and did exactly as needed for a little less than I expected to come in at. MPT came recommended by 2 acquaintances, will be happy to continue that recommendation.

plumbers.name: Merry Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1465 San Marino Ave, San Marino, CA 91108, USA

reviews.author: Thorn Koe
reviews.text:
Merry San Marino Plumbing does most of the work in our aging condo complex. Their office staff is super helpful and responsive.  The plumbers themselves are truly professional and do an excellent job.  They're not inexpensive but you get what you pay for.  Very happy to work with these folks over the
years.

reviews.author: Scott Lamensdorf
reviews.text: Hector did a great job repairing our bathroom  faucet. He came quickly as we had a slight leak and it was a tricky repair.  He also cleaned up when we was finished which was appreciated.

reviews.author: Ginny Onysko
reviews.text: Hector has come to many Plumbing crises at my home. He is always prompt, clear, and knowledgeable. He’s competent, acts quickly and gets the job done. Hector is a great role model, and you should be proud to have him representing Merry plumbing.

reviews.author: Drew Lage
reviews.text: Todd Hernandez and everyone at Merry Plumbing is always prompt, thorough and courteous. Feels like an old fashioned business that strives to serve it's community.

reviews.author: Ryan Jupiter
reviews.text:
Merry Plumbing were quick and efficient. I needed a toilet replacement and they came out within one day. Todd was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and installed our toilet in less than an hour!

I had previously used Merry Plumping to fix a leaking tub. Both times their services were top notch. Highly recommend for all your plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Anderson, SC
plumbers.address: 130 Powell Rd, Anderson, SC 29625, USA

reviews.author: Ellen Todia
reviews.text: Quick and efficient service! Contacted them on a Friday, they came out the following Tuesday and sent me confirming text messages. Our technician was professional, friendly and not only did he empty our septic tank, he also fixed a blockage in our plumbing. We are very pleased and highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Chad Caldwell
reviews.text: I've never used Mr. Rooter for my plumbing needs before, but they will be the first I call next time.  On Black Friday I had someone here within a few hours of calling about a leak to my water heater; he diagnosed the problem and quickly got the parts to fix it.  He explained the repair and even got additional parts if I needed to fix the other tube down the road.  I was very pleased with the speed of response, repair, and the price (especially considering it was a "holiday" for several other plumbers who would not come out at all).  Mr. Rooter is now my "plumber on call" when I need them!

reviews.author: Jill Robinson Beaver
reviews.text: I had a new set of tenants move in and they contacted me Friday night saying the hot water heater was not working. I called Mr. Rooter at 8 am the next morning (Saturday) and it was fixed by 11:30 am the same day. Our technician was Justin and he was very nice, informative and made our experience top tier. If you ever need a quick fix, I can’t recommend them more!

reviews.author: Chad McKenzie
reviews.text:
I decided to try Mr. Rotor after being recommended by a close friend who has done work for them. I normally use another company and usually pay under $400 to have my septic pumped. A friend of mine paid $380 with another company just days before my service.

Before they arrived, I personally dug up the tank and removed the lid to confirm it needed to be pumped. When they showed up, everything was already exposed. No digging, no lid removal.

The technician quoted my wife $500 because the tank was “really full,” which didn’t make much sense since people only call to have septic tanks pumped when they’re full. We agreed to the price to get it done.

We were later billed $888.21. When I called the office to speak with a manager, I was not allowed to. Instead, they said the technician would call me back. The explanation we received afterward was that the extra charges were for running a camera and for excess sludge. The invoice shows an $83 sludge charge billed twice and roughly $388 for a camera. If a camera was run, it would have gone only a few feet. The septic is less than six feet from the house, and the break was right at the entrance, which I had already pointed out.

The work itself seemed okay, but the pricing, billing, and lack of management involvement left us feeling overcharged and let down. Offering a small discount only if we agreed to nearly $2,000 in additional repairs didn’t help.

Buyer beware. I will not be using or recommending this company again.

reviews.author: Susan Feigin
reviews.text: Scheduled quickly, came in time, for the job done, reasonable charge, explained clearly. Nick was so nice and I was glad to meet him!  I could not be more pleased with your service!  Highly recommend calling Mr.Tooter! ( bad spell check but appropriate!  Mr. Rooter of course)

plumbers.name: H. Jack's Plumbing and Heating Akron
plumbers.address: 1055 Evans Ave, Akron, OH 44305, USA

reviews.author: Brian Plumb
reviews.text: Full master bath remodel including custom shower. Chip, Steve, and Blake were incredibly professional and knowledgeable. Kept a very clean work environment including cleaning up every day. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jeff Blackburn
reviews.text:
Love the attention to detail and the trouble shooting skills Chip and Adam gave us. We were dealing with low water pressure with a 24 year old pressure tank. These guys were amazing, had it knocked out in a morning and took on a couple of issues we had with an outside hose bib.

Truly Professional!
Thanks guys,
Jeff

reviews.author: Alex Harper
reviews.text:
Jay and his group came out to replace my furnace and air conditioner and were efficient and so nice to work with.
The work was done about 2 years ago and everything has held up nicely through the cold winters and hot summers!
I've had them come out for maintenance too during that time and the guy is nice everytime!

reviews.author: Amanda Lauer
reviews.text: I have used H. Jacks several times and they are always super friendly and helpful. Had to call on a weekend for an emergency plumbing situation. Ken came out within 30 minutes of my call and snaked my main drain line. He was very kind and knowledgeable. I know when I need them they will be there!

reviews.author: Dana Kroffke
reviews.text: Ron and Ben came out to look at and diagnose an issue I was having with my septic/sewer lines. They arrived quickly, diagnosed the issues, explained everything thoroughly to me and quickly got me on the schedule for a repair. They were incredibly nice; I highly recommend them!

plumbers.name: Ex-Stink Plumbing & Sewer
plumbers.address: 19 Hillcrest Ave, Fox Lake, IL 60020, USA

reviews.author: Joe Rodriguez
reviews.text: I’m a caregiver for my mom. Had a sewer line collapse and needed to get it fixed to make sure she had what she needed. Dave and his crew were great to work with. Very professional and efficient and kind. Easy to work with. They showed up when they said they would, kept me informed and when I thought there was another issue they were quick to address it. Enjoyed working with them. 👏

reviews.author: Ruth Wojak
reviews.text:
The owner Dave came out and assessed the situation. He realized that the plumber the day before didn't do their due diligence. He called them immediately and had them out again within 20 minutes to finish what they should have finished the day before.
The job that Dave was hired to do, he explained that it needed to be done, but was probably not an emergency.  He actually called me three times after he left, to make sure that I was doing good with my present situation (which was a rusted through kitchen stack, which was now full of mud).
The guys who came and did the work were fantastic. Arrived on time. I received a text with their location, so I knew when exactly they would arrive, should they be delayed. They were courteous, quick, clean, friendly.... Can't say enough good about them.
When they left, I went down to clean the path to the work zone. They literally left the area cleaner than when they arrived. I assumed they would make a mess, so I didn't vacuum up the dust that is frequently in a basement. I also didn't clean up the mess from the basement being flooded. All was cleaned up. True, they jack hammered part of the floor out, but they also cleaned more than just the area they jackhammered.
Top notch company. I would hire them again in an instant.

reviews.author: Lindsey Idle
reviews.text:
Dave is awesome… such a good guy. I own a home bakery, so my pipes are definitely used more often than others.

I had a pretty major blockage this morning and not only did Dave come out on time but he brought all the necessary equipment as well as some preventative care for me to hold onto. He gave me great advice on how to avoid blockages in the future and made sure I knew how to use the drain treatment product to get the best results.

Honest plumbers can be hard to come by but these guys are absolutely fantastic

reviews.author: Justin Richtmyre
reviews.text:
The crew as well as the staff at the office were extremely professional and extremely helpful. They helped us achieve a workable solution for our needs. All expenses were discussed upfront so that there were no unexpected financial surprises. They communicated their arrival times via text. Our experience was top notch and we would definitely reach out to them for any needs in the future.
They dug up our broken pipe, installed new pipe, installed a sump pump which we did not have before, and poured concrete. Great job.

reviews.author: Ricardo Cedillo
reviews.text: Superb performance by all of the crew at Ex-Stink Plumbing & Sewer! I give there professionalism and attention to detail an A+. Excellent job gentlemen! I will highly recommend and pass the word on. Thanks again!

plumbers.name: Red Beard Plumbing Heat & Air

reviews.author: Gil M Baez (Coqui84)
reviews.text: Exceptional experience with water heater troubleshooting and repair. Their attitude and professionalism clearly reflect strong leadership from the top down, and it shows in their work. Hands down some of the best service we’ve ever received. Thank you Red Beard Plumbing for exceptional service!!!!

reviews.author: James Guzak
reviews.text:
Redbeard has been my go to plumbing company for three years. They are responsive, do top quality work, and their staff technicians are knowledgeable and personable.

In this instance I had an after hours emergency leak with the tubing above my hot water heater. They were there promptly that same evening to stop the leak and make repairs. Jay Garcia was the tech on call and took great care of us.

reviews.author: The Goods
reviews.text: Quick, responsive, and fair. I have an older home and they were able not only to get someone dispatched same day, but they sent someone who was able to solve the root cause of the issue. I have used them multiple times around the house and have been really happy with their service. Their employees are very knowledgeable to good at explaining the issue even if you don't know much about plumbing.

reviews.author: Andrew Merrill
reviews.text: They did a great job replacing all the parts in our toilet. They spent extra time answering all our questions about other plumbing needs we will have to tackle in the future. They were on time and quick getting it fixed. They were kind and hard working men. We are very thankful to have found a trustworthy plumber.

reviews.author: Amy Key
reviews.text: Tyler and Taylor were amazing. Went above and beyond to locate and repair my leak. We have used Red Beard several times and have always been completely satisfied. Definitely recommend them!

reviews.text: Travis came out this morning to do a check up on our AC/Heat system. He is very courteous, polite and professional. He was very thorough and clear in his explanations of what he recommends for our system. Travis has a great personality and it was a pleasure having him to come out and do the inspection on our system. Dial One Johnson always sends the best people out. If you need AC, AC service of any kind, Johnson Dial One are the very best in the field! You can’t go wrong with them. Thank you again for sending Travis to us; he is truly a credit to his profession and represents his company magnificently!

reviews.author: Ben Hart
reviews.text: Jose called and let me know that he was available earlier than scheduled, which was excellent. Arrived, diagnosed and fixed my furnace problem within 10 minutes. Very pleasant and easy to work with. Top service.

reviews.author: Marianne R
reviews.text: Dial One was quick to book an appointment. Their friendly admin staff was very helpful. The call-out fee is mandatory, and they only come to assess, so the work wasn't done the same day.  But once the plumbers were there 2 days later, they did all they could to figure out and fix the problems.  A big shout-out to James & Will, who were excellent in their communication and work-ethic.  I will certainly call on these folks again.

reviews.author: CJ Johnson
reviews.text: Mold light install in vent system went well. Fast and clean! Other problem areas were identified and an intervention was to avoid future problems, of which was much appreciated. Very informative about what was done. Overall pleased with the service

reviews.author: Deidra Collins
reviews.text: The technician (James) was professional and efficient . I appreciate him remembering having serviced my home before. That goes a long way with me. The problem was  diagnosed and completed. I will continue to call Dial One for my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Charlie Perez
reviews.text: We had a leak in the main line from the water meter to our house.  These guys were referred to me by one of my neighbors so I felt good about calling them.  They came out the same day to assess the problem and returned the next day to fix it. It was  pretty big project that took the better part of the day. I’ll definitely reach out to them again next time I need plumbing work.

reviews.author: Sean McIntyre
reviews.text:
Plumb doctor was recommended to me many years ago.  I have contacted them on 4 different issues and they sent someone out immediately each time and once was a Sunday afternoon after I spoke with Brandon the owner directly.  Each time they were able to fix the problem and only charged me a service call.  Today I had a severe leak and because of their previous

They were able to send Fletcher over, who has helped me before, and it took more extensive work to fix but he did a fantastic job once again.  I highly recommend Plumb Doctor!

reviews.author: Aaron Reali
reviews.text: Plumb Doctor is a top-notch company with an outstanding team. reviews.author: Juanita Love
reviews.text: I had called another plumber before calling Plumb Doctor and I had some doubts about the repair he said I would need. I decided to call Plumb Doctor and I'm glad I did! Their pricing was very reasonable, and what impressed me most was the way they explained every step of the process before beginning any work. I felt informed, respected, and confident in the service I was receiving. The work was done efficiently, professionally, and with great care. I highly recommend Plumb Doctor and will definitely call them again in the future. Fletcher and Del were the absolute best!

reviews.author: Pablo Peñasco
reviews.text: My water service line in the front yard broke. Plumb Doctor had provided excellent service at my house before so I called them. They gave me a fair price and were back by 2PM with utilities getting marked before they started trenching. I am grateful to them to have plentiful clean water flowing again! I also told Cody about my pressure regulator had failed twice in the last 4 years and he immediately knew to check the expansion tank. It had failed. Cody replaced that for me while he was here. Thanks also to Tim for his expertise and hard work. Both times I have used Plumb Doctor they have provided a quick response and quality work the same day I called in. Thank you gentlemen.

Charlie oversaw the crew and he went above and beyond to make sure everything was done correctly and he gladly answered any questions in detail we had along the way.  He was very courteous and conscientious.  All cleanup was done properly when the job was complete.  I was extremely happy with the outcome.  Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Joe McGeehan
reviews.text: My wife was about to shower this morning, but no water despite the fact we had water everywhere else in the house. Highly recommend them and will use them in the future.

reviews.author: Jim Harbaugh
reviews.text: Joe, with Total Plumbing Solutions was at a neighbors house and I asked if he could look at a plumbing issue under my  bathroom sink. reviews.author: Sharon Markee

They didn't charge us just to bring the truck out either, as others do if you don't use their service. We will definitely use this company again and will refer them to our friends and neighbors. Thank you, Michael, at Total Plumbing Solutions!

reviews.author: Debbie
reviews.text: Joe and Doug are a great team.  They have done a lot of jobs for us including repairing a major water leak under the slab.  They are polite, clean and very respectful.  Their work is A+.

reviews.text:

I was happy with the time he spent to not only address what I called about, but answered additional plumbing questions as well. In this day you rarely get a salesperson, let alone the owner, willing to spend that kind of time.

I have more projects to come and Jeremy and his techs at JEM will be the first ones I call.

reviews.author: Nick Manos
reviews.text:
JEM plumbing was recommended by my neighbor. They were able to come out first appointment in the am. Joe was our technician. He was very kind and efficient. He was able to fix the problem within 1 hour.
Chad and the team will take care of you when in need of service.
Thanks for making it right!

reviews.author: Michael Tarr
reviews.text:
Jem Plumbing is literally a "gem"!  Jem installed a brand new hydronic heater (boiler/radiator) in our home for a great price just three days after we arrived home from being out of town in January and found our home ice cold because our boiler quit. All of the people, including Jeremy, the owner, are great.  We recommend JEM highly FIVE STARS and plan on JEM working on all of our plumbing needs going forward.

Michael
Hudson Ohio

reviews.author: Brian C
reviews.text: I’ve used JEM Plumbing several times for residential work. They have always been professional and helpful. Kevin and Caleb replaced a cartridge in the shower valve. They did everything in a timely manner and provided me with good information for future reference. I highly recommend Jem for any of your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Michael Burden
reviews.text: My first experience with Jem was awesome. From the friendly customer service on the phone to schedule them all the way until the job was completed. They got me scheduled the next day. My tech, Carson was great. He didn't do more than needed and didn't try to upsell me on anything. He got the job done quickly, was personable, did the job right, and answered all of my annoying questions along the way, as well as respected the cleanliness of our home. He also has great taste in music! Use them without hesitation if you need any work done. I will be using them for all future work we need at our house.

plumbers.name: GS Plumbing
plumbers.address: 55 Donkle Rd, Greenville, SC 29609, USA

reviews.author: Kevin Thomson
reviews.text:
GS Plumbing provided outstanding service from start to finish. My technician, Trevor, arrived on time and was professional, courteous, and attentive as I explained the drainage issue I was experiencing. After verifying the problem, he first attempted to clear the line with a snake. When it became apparent that the blockage was likely farther down the line or more severe than initially expected, Trevor didn’t hesitate to take the next step.

He went into the crawl space beneath the house, carefully traced the line, and isolated the approximate location of the problem. Throughout the entire process he worked diligently, explained what he was doing, and made sure I understood the situation and repair options. His communication and professionalism gave me a lot of confidence that the job was being handled correctly.

As a disabled veteran who is unable to access the crawl space to perform these types of repairs myself, I was especially grateful for Trevor’s thoroughness and respect. GS Plumbing also extended a veterans discount, which I truly appreciated.

Based on this experience, I will not hesitate to call GS Plumbing again for any future plumbing needs. Excellent service, knowledgeable technician, and great customer care.

Thanks again Trevor 👍

reviews.author: Daniel Hamersky
reviews.text: Kendall and GS plumbing did a great job! They were able to come out within a few hours of my call and had everything fixed the same day. Kendall was friendly and professional and was able to diagnose the problem quickly, provide a price to fix it right away, and get it fixed and working.

reviews.author: T b
reviews.text: I've had Andy with several jobs of my own. This time it was my dad's. He did a great job and as my dad put it-you couldn't even tell they had been there except he has no leaks now. Before and After photos. 100yr old galvanized pipes rusted thru.  More work was done but this sums it up.

reviews.author: Amarjit Pabla
reviews.text: Ben and his team did a great job diagnosing the plumbing leak source and were able to to replace the affected pipe section. The were timely and knowledgeable. I would definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Kent Smith
reviews.text: GS is a top-notch outfit, supported by great people. Was a pleasure working with Lee and Cody… Trevor was our technician who single-handedly performed our hot water heater replacement, plumbing, and additional faucet installation. Great guy and very solid technical expertise. All in all, very pleased with GS plumbing!

plumbers.name: Strittmatter Air Conditioning, Heating & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2340 Justin Rd Suite 204, Highland Village, TX 75077, USA

reviews.author: Nathan Scott
reviews.text:
Avoid at all costs….

We were looking for someone to flush our tankless water heater, address our water pressure drop, and install two shower heads.

We initially scheduled our appointment for 10AM-12PM, but we were later notified that someone would arrive a little after 12 PM. Fast-forward to 4:30 PM, and the sales associate/plumber arrived.

After listening to our concerns, he stated he would put together a quote for us. The quote itself took about an hour to provide.

At this point, I was prepared for the used car salesman tactics. Sure enough, the first quote was  $9,000 for primarily a water conditioner/softener and a few other items that had absolutely nothing to do with our request.

The price pyramid scam included five other options, all the way down to a roughly $2k quote that actually covered what we requested.

This was my only day off to meet with someone, and even though it was on the high side of things, the technician was kind, and I didn't mind providing him with our business. I don't hold him accountable for the pitch this company makes them go through.

The work was scheduled for the following day, and I had to be at work, but the technician did come and attempt to provide the services we paid for.

However, it was done so poorly that we now have to hire another company to straighten out and fix the mistakes. As you see in the photo below, the connection points on a high-pressure line are not aligned, the PRV has zero support to the point where it is bending the line below, and the water shut-off handle is barely accessible now.

And to top it off, we still have low water pressure in our kitchen, a hole in our wall that was much larger than necessary, and a mess of insulation/drywall dust to clean up in our garage from the cutout.

I would highly recommend that anyone looking for plumbing services look elsewhere.

reviews.author: sharon smith
reviews.text: Bernard was friendly and efficient in checking out my heating unit. I asked lots of questions and he was polite and patient in answering all of my questions. I am very impressed with your customer service and how I was kept in the loop in every way about the status of my appointment. Great customer service goes a long way to convincing me to sign up for the years service plan. I have confidence that I will be taken care with my HVAC needs.

reviews.author: Chuck G.
reviews.text: Builder used cheap push/pull shutoff valves on my toilet input water lines and one wasn’t working right. I wanted them both replaced with good quarter turns and choose Strittmatter based on great reviews and them being local. Cody came out and did fantastic work. He was professional, knowledgeable, efficient, personable and gave me a fair price. He also answered a few of my random plumbing questions and offered other good tips. The only downside of my overall experience, and a bad first-contact with a new-to-me company, was dealing with “Katie” the AI receptionist who was a little creepy and inefficient to work with.

reviews.author: Kelly Irwin
reviews.text: The Frymire team did quite a bit of pluming work in my home. Their works was quality and the service was professional. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nancy Stroud
reviews.text:
The experience with Frymire-Strittmatter was HORRIBLE.  Dave came, gave a bid of $1850 to install a hot water heater PAN.  Insisted it was same price for installing a hot water heater, and that it took two men.  I am desperate to have it installed as I am selling my home and this is an item on required repairs for sell of home.   He then gave me a discount of $200 since I was a repeat customer.  So the bill, including tax was to be $1622.  I paid a $250 deposit and scheduled an 8:00 AM appointment.   On the day of the appointment I received NO phone call ….Dave did not show up until 11:30…..I was on my way out the door for a scheduled medical procedure…..which he and I had discussed when scheduling and he assured me that the job would be completed well in advance of my required departure to the medical procedure with having scheduled an 8:00 AM appointment. Additionally when he arrived for the appointment he was by himself.  Now since the price was so HIGH because it was a 2 person job I was a little curious since I was paying the hourly rate of 2 plumbers     When I expressed concern about why he was 3.5 hours late he stated he was not responsible for scheduling.   Yet, when I booked the appointment he was on the phone with the scheduler and confirmed the 8:00 AM appointment.   After a very heated discussion about tardiness….paying for 2 people when only one was here I told him to get off my property.   Additionally all morning I had tried calling to inquire about no one showing up and all I could get on the phone was their AI Bot fielding phone calls.  Later in the afternoon I called, finally got a woman on the phone, told her my story and how furious I was and demanded that I wanted my $250 deposit back….my concern about being overcharged.    This woman promised a call back.  You guessed it…..Not one damn call back.   I can’t begin to express my dissatisfaction with Dave….Frymire-Strittmatter- and the entire experience. Clearly they have no conscience about over charging.  As far as I am concerned this company STOLE $250 from me, completely misrepresented their ability and what it took to get the job done.  And let me add, I was furnishing the pan not Frymire-Strittmatter.
I would NEVER NEVER recommend this company or anyone associated with it ever to anyone.    And, oh yes….i got the job done for $225 from their competitor.

plumbers.name: $15 Sewer & Drain Service
plumbers.address: 166 Graham Ave, San Jose, CA 95110, USA

reviews.author: Leonard Hantz

reviews.author: Joshua Cucci
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about my experience with Roto-Rooter, specifically with Howard. We were dealing with a major issue with our main sewer line, which is a stressful situation for any homeowner.

From the moment Howard arrived, he was incredibly professional and thorough. He didn't just guess at the problem; he took the time to properly diagnose exactly what was blocking the line. What I appreciated most was how he explained every step of the process to me. He walked me through the camera inspection, showed me exactly where the issue was on the monitor, and explained why it was happening, not just what needed to be done to fix it.

He was meticulous during the repair, ensuring that everything was cleared out completely rather than doing a "quick fix." He even double-checked everything before leaving to ensure the flow was perfect. It’s rare to find a tradesperson who is both technically skilled and a great communicator.

reviews.text: Howard at Roto Rooter was great to work with.  I called in a clogged kitchen sink around 8 pm on a Tuesday and he was at our house within the next hour or so.  He was able to quickly resolve the issue. He was great to work with and we were very happy with our service.

reviews.author: Artistically G
reviews.text: After an almost 12-hr work day, I arrived home to an intermittent gurgling sound coming from my bathroom. I immediately turned the shut-off valve to the off position and contacted Roto-Rooter. Brian took my call at roughly 7:35 pm and immediately scheduled a technician that would arrive within a 2-hour window. My technician, Howard, arrived within an hour of my call, ready to help. He tested the functions of the commode, flushing several times and checking the components of the tank, but was not able to replicate the problem. He was patient as I asked questions, and offered the possibility of replacing all of the elements in the tank and gave me an estimate. Additionally, he waited several minutes to see if the problem presented itself again, but it did not. Although no work was necessary, the customer service was top tier. Roto-Rooter provided excellent and dependable customer service - from scheduling to arrival. The best part of this experience is that Howard was genuinely kind and professional, and suggested a potential solution if it occurred again. If I have plumbing problems again, I will definitely contact Roto-Rooter.

reviews.author: Jeff Alderson
reviews.text:
UPDATED twice.

Too long, don’t read. Find someone else. Poor communication, wouldn’t stand by their work.

I'll give an honest review here, there have been some issues outside of their control, and some issues on their side.  But most of the major fault is theirs.

After posting my initial review I got a prompt call and an explanation of what went wrong.

Then I came home and found the whole setup spraying water and cycling on and off excessively. They said resubmit to the warranty company, but the warranty company said they are no longer working with this company.

We have a home warranty and had a sewer grinder pump fail  It's an older home which has complicated things.  We were without use of our home.  Initial call to them was on 2/3.  They couldn't come for 3 days, until 2/6.  Their reason was that was their contract with the home warranty company.

On 2/6 they worked on it for a few hours and spent quite a bit of time on the phone with the warranty company.  That's not their fault.  By the time the repair was authorized they couldn't drive to get the part because the place was closing.  They wouldn't come back until 2/11, even though the part was in stock and they could have picked it up the next morning.  The repair guy did patch it enough so I could run it manually as needed and showed me how to do that.

On 2/11 he returned with the part.  He comes while we're at work, leaves after a few hours.  Never hear anything.  I look at the side of the house and it's cleaned up, put back together.  I notice the switch is flipped to OFF, I assume it's done and he made a mistake, so I flip it to AUTO and forget about it.  Then I start getting emails from warranty company about the service not being complete.  On Sunday 2/15 I call to find out what's going on.  I'm told they don't know anything but will ask the technician tomorrow and call me back.  No call on Monday 2/16, so I call back on Tuesday 2/17, said technician will call me.  Someone from there calls twice on Tuesday but doesn't leave a message, I couldn't answer.  I call again on Wednesday, same thing, technician will call me.  Finally Thursday AM (2/19) I'm told the pump can still be run in manual mode, but a part is needed and they don't know when it will come in.

We wait until the next week and start calling again on Monday to find out when the part will be in.  Told we'd get a call back, don't get called back. Call again Tuesday, first time told someone will call right back, they don't, so call again at 5 and told the part just came in and they will fix it on Thursday (2/26).

Technician comes on time, calls me after and says he's done.  But the only part he could get requires a neutral wire in my electrical box so now I need an electrician to come rewire it.  Oh and by the way, it won't run in manual mode anymore.  So now we can't use the house again until I can get that fixed.

That evening I receive a bill for $950 from them.  I'm writing this review after receiving this bill after hours so I can't even call and find out why they are billing me when the home warranty company told me everything was covered.  I call the home warranty company and they said they contractor hasn't submitted the report to them yet so they have no idea either.

UPDATE.  After submitting the review I get a call from someone who is genuinely trying to figure out what happened.  He explains some challenges they had and agrees there's some things to fix.  He acknowledges the bill was sent in error and their communication wasn't up to his standards.

Update #2. See the attached video. Water spraying everywhere. They wouldn’t just come out to fix it. Said to call home warranty company. Home warranty company said they don’t work with them anymore. I’m actually glad to be done with them.

Wouldn’t call me for days on end, never tell me what's going on or if I can even use my house.  It took from 2/3 until 2/26 to do the repair, 6 days of that was waiting on a part.  I called them 9 times and my wife called 4 times.  After all that the repair was terrible quality.

reviews.author: NichtGuteFürSie Nimmer
reviews.text: Marlon and team came initially for a snake cam inspection due to sewer stoppage under the crawlspace and found major cast iron pipe under the house was severely corroded and leaking in the crawlspace. A whole section of cast iron pipe was taken out and replaced with modern ABS piping. However down the line there was clay pipe that was also flooded. This damn house was build in 1955 and perhaps older sewer pipes with pre-existing foundation on an older home prior. After a sewer clean-out built for further cleaning and inspection, multiple spots along the clay pipe had root intrusion causing sewer accumulation and stoppage. Since spot repairs will not solve a near-century old problem as earth movement and tree roots will further compromise the clay pipe, a trench-less repiping was deployed from under the house to the sewer main to get rid of any cast iron and clay pipe, as it's been at least 70 years since the sewer pipe had any service or upgrade. An 20-ft epoxy prepared line pulled with pressured air pump was done from the new clean-out outside to the section under the patio and house. Then a trench-less pipe bursting shoved a 50ft+ ABS pipe all the way to the sewer main. The team worked diligently everyday during the stormy days to get the job done, except one day during the epoxy curing followed by a mother of all storm when weather god had a bad Valentine's date. Empathy was practiced to make sure we had least inconvenience. Thanks to Marlon for his friendliness that came a long way. And George who took the time to explain the finer detail to make sure things were well taken cared of. I came to experience how the backyard soil became soft enough to dig holes on a few occasions but short of any Shawshank redemption escape experience along the sewer trench. Works Plumbing took care of the rest from the initial phone answering, organized communication, hard-work team effort, to reseating the toilet and caulking that was better than it was first installed. Great job to all. Well, it ain't cheap, but a clean sewer will save sanity for ages to come. Cast iron and clay pipe suck, don't let them ruin your shower, kitchen, and bathroom experience. Let Works Plumbing take care of them for you along the coastside from SF to Half Moon Bay.

reviews.author: Peyton Miller
reviews.text:
Over the last few months, my home has required major foundation and plumbing work, and the entire experience has been overwhelmingly stressful. Thankfully, our incredible Realtor, Jay Marks, put us in touch with CR Plumbing, and they were an absolute godsend throughout it all.

With plumbing, it often feels like a “we fixed this, but now we found something else” situation, and CR Plumbing stayed with us every step of the way. Chris was educational, kind, and deeply empathetic. The team was completely transparent about both the process and pricing, and they even went out of their way to be flexible when payment became a challenge for us. Communication was always clear and timely—Autumn was especially wonderful to speak with whenever we had questions or concerns.

Every person from CR Plumbing who stepped onto our property was professional, friendly, and genuinely kind (and occasionally a little goofy, in the best way): Chris, Larry, Olaf, Christian, and Jaden. Even Clayton, the owner, came by personally to check on the work. That level of care speaks volumes.

The reality of repairs like these is that they are expensive. CR Plumbing repaired a break in our laundry room, our washer box, our cleanouts, and eventually about 85% of our underground plumbing. It was a significant cost—but the quality of work, expertise, and peace of mind they provided made every cent worth it. They will be my first call for any future plumbing, electrical, or HVAC needs.

Thank you, Chris, Larry, Autumn, Olaf, Christian, Jaden, and Clayton. If I missed anyone, I truly appreciate you as well. I’m incredibly grateful for your service.

What a relief!! We have finally found a plumbing company that is reliable AND honest.
While one visit might not seem enough to come to this conclusion, in my in experience it is.

They quoted the very fair pricing and didn't try to indicate a need for any other add ons.
It so happened that the morning of their afternoon appointment we had gotten a call from the city water department regarding a possible leak in our pipes indicated by water running in the street gutter that emanated from our property.

I asked if that was something CR Plumbing handled and he said it was.
I will make the appointment for that service next week and will rest assured that the same professionalism will be demonstrated.

reviews.text: I was extremely pleased with Flatiron Plumbing. They were able to come out the same day that I called and Anthony the technician was very pleasant, knowledgeable and helpful. We have used them several times now and have always been very pleased.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.text:
The technician, Anthony, was great, professional, efficient, and did solid work after he had to go get parts.

The price was quoted upfront and I agreed, not knowing the job would take under 30 minutes or be as simple as capping two water lines and one gas line with easy access. The $575 final bill later felt well above market.

When I contacted the office, I did not ask for a specific price reduction. I intentionally left any adjustment to their judgment, in good faith, believing they would assess what was reasonable. Instead, I was told that because I accepted the quote, I needed to state what the job was “worth.” When I declined to name a number and asked them to determine a fair adjustment, the office manager became rude and refused any consideration.

That response reflects poor customer service. A small goodwill adjustment would have kept me a satisfied, repeat customer. Unfortunately, the office response overshadowed an otherwise positive experience with the technician.

reviews.author: Greg Boehme
reviews.text: I contacted Arvada Flatirons Plumbing for resolution on a water issue late in the afternoon.  They scheduled us for the first appointment the following day.   I received notification my  tech would  Anthony who arrived timely.  We discussed my issue with a leaking stack pipe as evidence by water in the basement.   Anthony said he would do an inspection to determine source of the leak. He quickly determined the source.  We were given several options for correcting the water leak on the cracked fitting.  Once we  selected the fix,  he quickly got to work.  It's was within the walls from the upper bathrooms.  During his work , a second tech , Paul show up to assist as the plumbing ran thru 3 Floors.   They completed the work on a timely fashion and  flush tested the new plumbing.  They thoroughly cleaned up the area when finished.   I highly recommend Flatirons plumbing Arvada for any work.  They are professional, courteous and prompt.   My neighbors had previously use them and were please with them as well.

reviews.author: Rob Watt
reviews.text: From my very first contact with Flatirons, I was impressed with their quick response to my plumbing issue, getting me on the schedule quickly, and then repairing my leak in a timely fashion. Steven was very professional and got the job done when he said he would. The only issue I had, I felt they over charged me for the work performed. But their work performed, was 5 star.

reviews.author: Ken M
reviews.text: A visit yesterday from Flatirons Plumbing was a pleasure.  Caesar arrived on time and immediately knew what our problem was.  After checking his truck for the part that he needed (he had one), the repair was quick and our leaking drain was fixed - I had tried to repair it but knew I did not have the right part and was hesitant to attempt buying, let alone installing, what was needed.  Caesar was a delight to work with, personable, knowledgeable, very focused on helping us resolve our problem, and should we have other plumbing problems in the future we shall always call Flatirons Plumbing. . . and ask for Caesar!

reviews.author: Lesvia Millican
reviews.text: Alexandro was very professional. I got the sense that he knew exactly what he was doing so that put me at ease right away.  Both of the technicians were really nice and very polite. They installed my wall heater in a really short time and took the time to explain how to operate the heater. I would highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: Vincent Alderete
reviews.text: Jerry and Jeremiah were 10 stars the best I have ever seen in my life. Mastery in performance, customer care and know what's best. I have never experienced the type of care and advising the best possible outcomes. Me and my family were suffering with out a functioning water heater taking a cold shower was a nightmare. Amanda dispatch sent the guys out they knew exactly what to do and diagnosed the issue quickly with precision. After explaining our budget the family like business at Earl's donated a water heater to us. I'm still pinching myself. Thank you King Jesus for Earl's Plumbing & Air. I pray everyone gets the service, love and good Christian business relations I have received. My heart goes out to the company. Bless you and your generations to come. If reading this you are truly in for one in a lifetime experience.

reviews.author: Lindsey Brown Synatschk
reviews.text: Earl's was so professional in their communication from start to finish. I usually spoke with Stephanie on the phone, and she was so kind and helpful. Our plumber was Zach N. and he was fantastic as well. Although we were outside of their normal service range, the supervisors at Earl's approved us during a terrible winter storm, and we are most appreciative. I especially appreciate that they texted a technician photo, bio, and ETA along with tracking. Would definitely use Earl's again and have already recommended them to others. Thank you!

reviews.author: Paul J Brooks
reviews.text: Earl‘s always does an amazing job! Fast, friendly, professional, and expert install installation and maintenance maintenance! We have our home warranty with them, and they have been really great to work with. They saved us a ton on our water heater expenses. I would definitely recommend buying a home warranty for girls and getting the premium package. It’s been a lifesaver.

reviews.author: Alyssa Mattheus
reviews.text: Tyler Anderson has come to fix our plumbing on a couple different occasions. He has been phenomenal each time. Tyler is kind, knowledgeable and professional. This is a small but big thing for me- We do not wear shoes in our house.. he must’ve noticed the subtle clues of how we leave shoes outside etc. Without me asking, he took his boots off and put them outside the front door. That is SO appreciative and excellent to observe something like that. Thanks Tyler for being an amazing plumber, but providing great customer service too!

plumbers.name: High Speed Rooter & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3831 Arden Dr, El Monte, CA 91731, USA

reviews.author: Trudy Guzman
reviews.text:
The house is at least 70 years old and most of the pipes are the original galvanized. We discovered an extremely bad water loss and we put in a call. They found the main issue and then showed us pictures of many more. As you can tell from the pictures, a nearly full plumbing replacement job took place. These guys were incredibly thorough and knowledgeable, being very forthright with sharing that knowledge. They made sure to keep us informed the entire job. They explained any and all questions we had.
Long story short, they worked long hours for a week to get this job done. Jovanny, and the entire crew were excellent! Especially with all the under the house work that had to be done. They had to crawl around for hours under the house like classic tunnel rats. I would definitely recommend their service to anyone needing any kind of plumbing work.

reviews.author: Kelley James
reviews.text:
Chris and the team were incredible with their work and repair. We had contacted a different company who came out first to do an evaluation and they were here for just 15 minutes.

When Chris arrived he spent nearly two hours evaluating the problem (even going under the houses crawl space) and identified the issue causing just our shower head to lose all pressure/output.

Would recommend Chris and High Speed Rooter & Plumbing, and I will definitely contact them again!

reviews.author: Ken Vail
reviews.text: They did a great Job pumping our septic tank. They arrived within an hour of talking with Frank on the phone. The job was completed within 30 minutes of the truck arriving. The final price was very reasonable and was slightly lower than what he had estimated on the phone. Frank followed up with a no cost evaluation of the tank. No high pressure sales just explaned the conditioni of the tank and some optionial modifications if they become necessary in the future. All in all very happy with the service, honesty, and professionalism.

reviews.author: Claudia C
reviews.text:
I had initially contacted Robert about a pipe burst for my sewer line, and after getting quotes from over a dozen different rooter companies, I have decided that Robert seemed the most helpful, easygoing, and willing to answer my various questions about the process. At the time, I wasn’t ready to proceed, so I kept in contact with Robert for 3 months, during this time, I’ve also called him about other questions I had, even questions my friends had, and he was always patient and willing to advise me on my concerns. This reaffirmed me that this company is the right choice.

Ultimately I was ready to proceed with the project and Frank became my main contact, he was professional, willing to work with my schedule, and took plenty of pictures during the process to reassure me.

I would overall recommend this company, as I felt that they will be people I can continue to reach out to if I had any future questions!

reviews.author: Carol Xu
reviews.text:
High Speed Rooter has been servicing our church for the past few years, and they have always provided excellent service. They are very professional, their pricing is fair, and they truly care about their customers.

In my opinion, true success in any business is not only about being skilled and professional, but also about having a genuine heart to serve people. High Speed Rooter definitely demonstrates that.

We really appreciate their help and highly recommend them.

Austin was pleasant to speak with, clean cut, and professional. I highly recommend this company and certify that they are trustworthy and provide quality service. The office lady - I think Lucy was her name - was also an excellent communicator.

reviews.author: Theresa E Carpinelli
reviews.text: It took them awhile to finally get out to my house for the installation, but once they got here, they couldn’t have been nicer and more professional.  Did a great job with the installation, and were very considerate.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: EA C
reviews.text: Austin was prompt and very helpful and informative!  The cost is very high only down side for me definitely seemed like a nice company to work with.  I will definitely give their info to a neighbor or friend.

reviews.author: Jennifer Pavlak
reviews.text: Rooter Man has been the best plumbing experience I’ve ever had. I was recommended them by Americon Restoration after a pipe started leaking through my kitchen ceiling. Heather from Rooter Man text me SAME DAY that Americon was here trying to set me up with an immediate appointment with a plumber. She got me booked for the very next day! My plumber, Evan, showed up promptly right as the two hour window began, and was so personable and kind. He assessed my issue and determined he needed to make a run to the hardware store first so he could do the job same day. He ended up replacing about 16 inches of my corroded supply line. He worked so diligently, and explained to me what he did to correct the issue. He spoke to me (a single mom) respectfully and concisely. His cleanup was if he was never here. What a wonderful and smooth process this was for me- I took their card to recommend them- and use them again!

reviews.author: Mary Morgan
reviews.text: Patrick was prompt and so nice. Very helpful, even when i couldn't get home to talk to him myself. My daughter called me & had him on speaker to explain what the problem was, how he fixed it & assured that we should be good for a long time now, also explained what would be done if they have to be called out again. Highly recommend & definitely will call if any other problems arise

reviews.author: Polly LaHue
reviews.text: Josh did a great job installing a much-needed garbage disposal. He was prompt, pleasant and professional! Tidy, too! What more could you ask for in a plumber?! I'll be using Mackin for all my plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Karen Elizabeth
reviews.text: Mackin & Sons provided excellent service when my water heater failed. My phone call was answered immediately--no automated voice system, no need to leave a message. They got me on the schedule the first day I was available, removed the water heater and gave me a written estimate that included options to repair or replace. I chose replacement, for which they helped me secure financing. There were issues with my subfloor and surrounding area that needed to be addressed before the new water heater was installed. Mike worked with my insurance company and recommended a company to do the remediation work. Mindy in the office was always pleasant and helpful, as was everyone else I spoke with. Once the floor repairs were done, they were available right away for the installation. Josh and Ethan did a fantastic job fitting a 40-gallon water heater and drain pan into a small opening that previously held only a 30-gallon. They even managed to fit a thermal expansion tank into the limited space. They explained what they were doing without my even asking, and the questions I did have were answered patiently and knowledgeably.  Turning the water back on caused my ancient faucet to give way, and Josh was able to repair it on the spot. The whole company was professional from start to finish, and it showed in the end result. I would recommend them anytime.

reviews.author: Rachel Latin
reviews.text: Hot water tank started leaking at 8 pm last night and called Mackin & Sons late to schedule an inspection. By 10:30 am today, we had a new tank professionally installed. Josh and Ethan were friendly and answered all our questions. Couldn't be happier with the quick response time and the great service. Thank you Mackin & Sons!!

reviews.author: Josh Brockman
reviews.text:
Mackin and Sons Plumbing was fantastic to work with. Kristian was great to work with and goes out of his way to help. They rushed to get our water running so we could move in on time, which meant a lot to us. Not only that, but they took the time to walk us through several water treatment options that fit both our needs and our budget.

When we later ran into a plumbing issue that they hadn’t previously worked on, he didn’t hesitate to help and took the time to talk us through how to fix it without even having to coming out. The problem was resolved immediately.

They are extremely professional, friendly, and very knowledgeable. We will absolutely be using Mackin and Sons again in the future and highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable plumbing solutions.

He has even went through insurance. Thank you for all your company has supported us through. Make a big difference knowing you have our backs.

plumbers.address: 208 Taylor Ave, Annapolis, MD 21401, USA

reviews.author: Georgia Powell
reviews.text:
Edit 2: Changed rating to 4 stars.  Heilder corrected all the issues from their initial water line installation.  The work this time around was done correctly and there are no issues.  It is unfortunate that they had to come out a second time to complete the job.  The last four pictures of this post show the completed work.
Edit 1: Company owner called me this morning to come up with a resolution.  It was a very good conversation.

I choose Heidler based off other customers who said they had an excellent experience.  I had the complete opposite experience. I called customer service within 10 minutes of the job being completed to explain my disappointment with the work.  I was told that I would receive a call back, but no one has called.
The project was to install a water line to the fridge.
Pic one shows how the plumber installed the line making the cabinet space unusable.  The 2nd, 7th and 8th pic shows the copper water line against the main electrical line.  The copper is being pushed in the wood due to tension from electrical line.  Does this even meet code and is this safe??   Pics 3 and 4 show behind the fridge.  The way the line was placed, it is unclear how to even fix the dry wall as the copper pulls when the fridge is pulled out.  Finally, somehow they damage and dented a lid that was on the counter and never said anything (pic 6, 7).  This looks like an amateur completed this, not a professional company.  It cost almost 800 dollars for this work.

reviews.author: Phyllis Scalettar
reviews.text: Heidler takes careof the plumbing and fireplace maintenance at our home. Their service and their staff are 150%…professional, , prompt and pleasant. They always have provided me with the highest quality and the greatest reliability. I actually use them as my standard when evaluating other vendors for other types of services. They have to meet my Heidler criteria to work for me. I recommend Heidler with no reservation and my highest endorsement.

reviews.author: Maria Fiaschetti
reviews.text: Phillip was excellent and explained everything thoroughly. We had an issue with our toilet that had a root cause more involved than a simple repair, but at each step of investigating the issue, Phillip explained what was going on and what would happen next. He showed me where things were broken, why they broke, and what that meant. He was very courteous and polite. Our toilet ended up needing a new flange in the concrete floor, but now it is sturdy and sealed and we feel really good about getting this service from Heidler.

reviews.author: Kyle MacQuilliam
reviews.text:
After weeks of a stubborn kitchen sink that refused to drain, even after I’d snaked it 25 feet myself, I finally called in the pros — and Heidler proved exactly why they have the reputation they do. Dave showed up on time, diagnosed the issue quickly, and fixed what I couldn’t in no time.

What really stood out was his honesty: even though the original quote was for a hydrojet service, he said confidently that a proper snaking would solve the problem — and it did, for about half the cost. The water now flows perfectly with no backing up, and he even installed a cleanout access for easier maintenance in the future.

It’s refreshing to find a company that values doing the right job over the most expensive one. Thank you, Dave and the team at Heidler — five stars and genuine appreciation.

reviews.author: Carl Gable
reviews.text: Heidler came out to evaluate an issue with our hot water heater. The technician (Tom) did a thorough investigation and found the likely culprit promptly followed by an estimate to address the problem. We have used this company to address almost al of the plumbing and/or heating/cooling issues in our home and we have never been disappointed  First rate company that we highly recommend.

They listened to the issue, found availability to assist, and was out at the property less than 24 hours later! The issue was identified, addressed, and my tenants were happy! I should've called them first! But, now I know and will definitely make sure they're at the top of my list. I commend them for their professionalism, caring demeanor, and being empathetic with the situation. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: I highly recommend Plumb Tite Plumbing. I was in need of a new hot water heater. Will Mairose was the technician assigned. He was very professional. He arrived during the window of time for the free estimate. He thoroughly explained my options for replacement and what the job would entail. He even took the time to make adjustments to a leaky toilet when i asked if he coukd take a look at it while he was there. He promptly sent me my three options with the estimated entire cost which was below a competitors estimate I had obtained months before. I was able to easily make an appointment on a convenient day for me. Will arrived promptly and explained to me the entire process for the day. He was able to install the replacement with minimal disruption to the household and ahead of schedule. When he was finished he explained everything that he did and how to operate my new hot water heater. He also imformed me of maintenace of the unit. He cleaned up the entire work space to the point where no one would know that I had just had the hot water heater replaced. I am very pleased with the functioning of the new hot water heater and I will be calling Plum Tite again in the future and asking for Will for future plumbing needs.

Whatever u do for an at a boy he deserves 3 of them. Can’t say enough about him.   GREAT asset to your company. Thank you Thank you Thank you

reviews.author: Keith Sharp
reviews.text:
2/25/2026--The installation of our new hot water heater was done perfectly — great service and no issues with the setup.
However, there is one area for improvement: during the removal of the old, broken hot water heater, no protective plastic sheeting was laid down over our finished basement carpet. When the old unit was tilted and moved, rusty/dirty water leaked from the bottom onto the carpeting. This created an unpleasant and preventable experience.
For future jobs in finished basements, it would be extremely helpful if technicians laid down plastic or protective material across the carpet before removing old equipment to avoid accidental water damage.

reviews.author: AJ Gatewood

reviews.text: I called because our toilet was acting up and when Walter got here it seemed ok. Walter cleaned it out with his auger just to be sure. He was a perfect gentleman and professional. reviews.author: Nick Kuhn
reviews.text: I can’t express how much of a positive experience it was to work with Homeservice Plumbers (Colorado) on our water heater replacement. The water heater we replaced was over 20 years old and we decided it was time to replace it, even though it hadn’t crapped out on us yet, but for the right price. We had a flexible budget but we knew we wanted to stick to it and not feel like we were overpaying for something we knew at the time was just precautionary. Justin came to our house and presented us with clear options but he went above and beyond talking with his supervisor, Ben, on not just bringing the cost down but bringing it down to meet our budget; and we got to be on the schedule the following day! We know as a business they didn’t have to negotiate at all so the fact they did blew us away. Huge thank you to Justin and Ben for that! The following day, Marcus G. arrived to do the work and he was done in about 4 hours (which even included a pause so he could run to the shop and back); it was a pleasant surprise to see how quickly he was able to get everything done including that pause and in the end everything looked great! Everyone involved was friendly and professional and we couldn’t appreciate you guys more for this entire experience from beginning to end. You guys have a customer for life for our future plumbing needs. Thank you so so much!

plumbers.address: 1604 W Main St, Franklin, TN 37064, USA

reviews.author: Bonnie Walker
reviews.text: Our hot water heater blew up after 5P on a Friday. We called The Hot Water Heater Pros since they had installed it 3 yrs ago, & it remained under warranty. They found our records, came by to confirm that repair was not possible, & scheduled the replacement installation for Monday. Cole, the technician arrived early for the appointment, efficiently installed the new tank with care & precision. We had to pay $600 for labor, which I disagree with but paid; you'd have to pay more to start fresh with a new vendor.    But out of warranty, I'll hire the company that truly honors the warranty and does not charge labor under warranty.  They do exist, so ask about this when replacing a heater that's not under warranty. Again, the technician was AWESOME!

reviews.author: Chris Lindsey
reviews.text: These guys are AMAZING! We lost our tankless water heater in the ice storm. They came out at 7 PM and put a new one in for us. They did an amazing job, gave us a great price, and got us going quick. Both of their installers were top-notch PROs and super nice guys. They care about their work and their customers and it shows. I literally could not recommend this company more.

reviews.author: Lisa Postell
reviews.text: I hired The Hot Water Pros to flush my tankless water heater. Communication was great. Great pricing. I don’t know if it is the placebo effect, but I feel like my water heater is working more efficiently now. I highly recommend. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Gary Lott
reviews.text:

Bailey Brothers said, “No problem,” and sent Larry Floyd to the rescue.
Larry was fantastic. Super professional, easy to work with, and honestly brought some serious Sherlock-level deduction skills to the job. This was not an easy issue to find, but he didn’t rush, didn’t make excuses, and didn’t quit because it was cold or getting late. He stayed with it until he figured it out—and fixed it—just in time before the great cold front of 2026 hit.
Huge thanks to Larry and the entire Bailey Brothers team for saying yes when others said no. That kind of service is rare, and it matters. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Taylor Moore
reviews.text: Highly recommend Bailey Brothers! Stephen came out within hours of calling. He was incredibly professional, transparent, and personable. reviews.author: James McMurphy
reviews.text:
I called Bailey Brothers and they showed up within the hour! Very prompt.
Unfortunately it was all downhill from there:
I was quoted $2,800 to fix a broken fitting on the bottom of a well pressure tank. They said the whole tank needed replaced along with other fittings and their labor. I questioned why the broken fitting couldn’t simply come out of the tank so that the entire tank didn’t need replaced. I insisted they try to remove the fitting and when they did, it came right out. So right there saved over $1,000 just because they were going to be lazy and not try to remove the broken fitting. When I tried to question, very nicely, why I was being charged so much for labor and a part ($1,200- $1,400) to resolve this issue, Larry got hostile and hung up on me after saying if I didn’t like the price I could call someone else. He left me and my customer high and dry with no water all night just because I was questioning some things and trying to figure out why labor was so high. He ignored calls and texts, which I could see he did in fact read. Unbelievably rude and unprofessional. Not to mention lazy. Do NOT waste your time calling them.

reviews.author: Kristin Duaime
reviews.text: I want to thanks Sal, Chris specially Sam from Plumming Pros. Monday morning we found sewage backed up in our basement. Unfortunately right after a major snow storm had blanketed NJ with 2 feet of snow. I thought there was no way someone would come out right away. So I got on my phone and googled searched for plumbers near me. I came across Plumbing pros and gave them a call. They answered right away and thankfully had a tech on call. Within a few mins I had a text from the tech. In the message was a picture of the tech and text letting me know he was on his way. Within the hour he was knocking at our door step. Well mannered, polite and friendly. Sam to got to work right away. First putting on booties to keep our floor clean. I showed him to the basement and he got set up. Laying out tarps and garbage bags to keep things neat and orderly. As he moved the camera down the pipe looking for the problem he took pictures along the way. He kept me informed the whole way and even let me look over his shoulder as he worked. When he knew what the problem was he called his owner and confirmed what he saw… broken pipe and tree roots blocking the pipe. He worked up an estimate and had financing available. Knowing the urgency, they got me scheduled right away. By Wednesday morning they started digging. I was impressed with the safety measures taken around and in the hole. Safety fencing around the hole site and metal boxes to hold the walls up. Thursday the new pipe was in and even got it inspected the same day. We were back up and running by Thursday night. I was impressed with how everything was handled start to finish. I know who I’ll be calling and recommending to everyone for their plumbing problems.  Thank you again!

Jim Fisher was soon to arrive and provide me a quote. Financing options were discussed, and my new Furnace was scheduled for installation within a couple of days.
My Installers showed up first thing Monday morning (can’t locate their names or profile emails right now) and were so prompt and professional. They were able to take out and remove my old Furnace, and install my new one. (even had to come through my storm cellar door to get into the house). They took the time to even explain my new control panel, and how to operate and set up all the functions.
Herschel came the next day, to inspect all the oil lines.  (I guess most furnaces that are installed are electric).
I can’t recommend this company enough! They have a 24 hour service line that you can call to report any issues or problems.  Communication is excellent! Any service is completed in a timely manner. I was worried about the cost of a new furnace, (single mom with an autistic child) but with Financing options fitting my budget, I am able to have peace of mind. I am confident that I will be good for another 17+ years.

I could not be more pleased with my experience. Every technical I have dealt with has been kind and has made me feel so comfortable in the process of selecting a new HVAC system for my home. If you are in the Cleveland or Chattanooga area, look no further than this company. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Jake & Leah Carroll
reviews.text: Technician Sam came to diagnose our unit (when he said he would) and was very knowledgeable, friendly, and patient with my many questions. Being parents of special needs kids and a kid that has trouble regulating his temperature, it put my mind at ease, how quickly they came and responded to our situation. Technician Daniel came and completed the repairs and we were thrilled when they informed us that our system was still under warranty, completing the necessary paperwork for us. The whole process from talking to the friendly receptionist, Jeanna, to scheduling a technician was very easy and seamless. I am very happy we chose them, and would use them again.

plumbers.name: TN Plumbing Solutions

reviews.author: Zakary Whisman

When I thought all hope was lost, and I was never going to get my sewage cleared. This company answered my prayers. This man is born to do this. I am a repeat customer.
