It's damn near impossible to find cheap and reliable. With  Mr. Tyler woods, you get both. If I could give him more than 5 stars, I would. So if you want fast responsive quality work. Then, you give this company a call and Mr. Tyler woods will sure take care of you.

reviews.author: Andy Wilson
reviews.text:
First - an actual person answered the phone and then quickly got me scheduled for my emergency issue

Second - Robert arrived promptly, and quickly assessed the situation. He was knowledgeable and an absolute professional all-around!

Third - Robert gave me great advice on caring for the old unit, and insight the inevitable future repairs.

I found my new plumbing company and cam easily recommend them to anyone I know.

reviews.author: Rick Williams
reviews.text: I called TN Plumbing Solutions at about 7:30AM and Robert and Connor arrived about 1PM and were very professional, efficient and courteous. After assessing the need to replace our water heater at 1:30PM they returned at 5PM (an hour earlier than promised!) and had hot water for us by 7:15PM. We are very happy with the new tankless unit and highly recommend TN Plumbing Solutions.

reviews.author: Maya Joelle
reviews.text:
Aaron is the best. He took his time when addressing my kitchen sink issue and he fixed it promptly.
He is super efficient as the diagnosis, the travel to get the faucet I wanted, and faucet replacement took less than 2 hours.

I would highly recommend this company!

reviews.author: Ellen Quertermous
reviews.text: Robert is very professional and personable. Scheduling our appointment was easy and he arrived promptly. He fixed our problem quickly and completely and cleaned up thoroughly. We will call R&M Plumbing Solutions for any future issues.

plumbers.name: Economy Plumbing Services, LLC
plumbers.address: 701 Tillery St, Austin, TX 78702, USA

reviews.author: Norma Rangel
reviews.text: We called Economy Plumbing Services, LLC for our church irrigation backflow annual inspection they were the most straightforward and offered a very fair price.  We were able to save $25.00 this year by "Saving last year's receipt and showing it  as they suggested on their email, "Show this to your service professional on your next service visit and save an extra $25! " Their technician,  Sean, arrived on time and gave us a call 30 minutes before. He was knowledgeable, friendly, and did an excellent job.  We are very satisfied with the work and the price."

reviews.author: N Allen
reviews.text:
Sean the Manager  from Welles Branch showed up to drain my water heater.  He didn't.  He said it was rusted and needed to be replaces.  He showed me water around the bottom of the heater in the pan on which the heater was sitting.  The water was not there the night before.  I removed the water.  There was no rust at the bottom of the heater.  There is no water there after two days.  He had a couple of minutes alone with the water heater so my conclusion is that he put  the water there to force replacing a functioning water heater and a couple of valves  a cost of over $3000.   When I priced what he was offering compared to what I could independently, I could do all of what he offered at around $1000. I didn't want to waste money to replace a fully functioning water heater.  I had one before that lasted more than 20 years.  Rheem water heaters interior is glass coated for a long life if they are maintained properly.
Be careful if you ever need anyone doing work in your house, make sure to ask around and get some decent people.  There are a lot of thieves skinning a lot of innocent people and there almost no regulation and no control.  We live in a strange time.

reviews.author: Nick Allen
reviews.text:
I needed to have a toilet replaced at my house. I was able to text the number on their website and they responded immediately, scheduling a visit later that same day.

Grant did great work on the install and was done in less than an hour and a half. The price seemed fair and I was happy with the result.

reviews.author: Ruben
reviews.text: had a four hour appointment window didn’t even show up on time in my option. That’s a bad start so I canceled my appointment.

reviews.author: Alexia Dauterive
reviews.text: They were fast to respond, but the company's name makes you think that they might be economical.  Nothing could be further from the truth.  Plumber charged $500 per toilet (2 toilets x $500 = $1,000) to tighten the screws on the toilet because they were slightly loose.  We were in a tight trunaround to get this work done because we were sellng out home and had no choice but to use them.  When I complained about the price, the plumber said he would throw in the sanitation loop for free, but then left without doing it.  When I called and complained and asked to speak with the plumber, I was told that he was too busy and that would not happen.  I tried for weeks to get a receipt and they never would send one even after calling multiple times.  I would definitely not call these guys ever again.

plumbers.name: Five Star Home Services Cincinnati
plumbers.address: 7374 Reading Rd Suite 118, Cincinnati, OH 45237, USA

reviews.author: Terry White
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable and professional. I had forgotten that I had another HVAC company coming the next day for a estimate. Since he was here I let him check over the work and he said Five Star did a great job. Here's a kicker Five Star was $1,100 dollars cheaper.

reviews.author: Tyler Botto
reviews.text:
Five Star Home Services has truly been a blessing for my family. Jason E. has been absolutely amazing and has gone above and beyond anything we could have expected. He helped my family more than anyone else in this industry ever has, and I am so incredibly grateful.
I also want to personally thank Bryan, Jennifer, and Sarah in the back office — their support, kindness, and professionalism made a stressful situation so much easier.
This is literally the best thing that could have happened for my family. Because of them, we have heat, and that means everything to us. I cannot recommend Five Star Home Services enough. Thank you all from the bottom of my heart.

reviews.author: Hari V
reviews.text: The technician was knowledgeable and able to troubleshoot the water heater quickly. Luckily did not require a major repair. They were honest about it and did what was necessary. Additionally we got a valve replaced that feeds into the humidifier. The quality of the part and workmanship is very good. Would definitely recommend this service

reviews.author: Zalina Husainova
reviews.text:
I want to say a huge thank you to the Five Star team for their excellent and very professional work.

We had a serious issue with our water heater, and they responded very quickly. The team arrived on the same day, worked efficiently, carefully, and handled everything from start to finish.

They replaced the water heater, checked everything thoroughly, and made sure the system was working properly before leaving. Everything was done neatly and with great attention to detail.

I truly appreciate how fast and organized they were, especially considering this was January 2nd.

I am very satisfied with the service and highly recommend Five Star to anyone looking for reliable and professional plumbing service.
Thank you so much for a great job!

reviews.author: Jesse Miller
reviews.text:
Kori and his partner were awesome. Solid craftsmanship on the exterior. Copper pipe and high-voltage line ran pretty level minus a few dog legs. I was a little underwhelmed that they did not pour a concrete pad for the new unit. The interior work on the new coil was crisp and tidy.

Overall these guys were professionals who took care of my house, cleaned up after themselves and did quality work.

Ben the salesman was very helpful and knowledgeable. He didn't try to sell me a unit that was overpriced and too big for the square footage of the house unlike other companies.

Five star and their team are fair, honest and professional.

Give em a call without the fear of getting taken for a ride.

reviews.author: Glenda Maiden
reviews.text: Wonderful service from Dunedin Plumbing. We had a main water line break at the front of our house and they were able to get us all fixed up within a couple hours of my phone call. Jessie and Cade were professional and quick. I highly recommend this company!!

reviews.author: David MacLaren
reviews.text: I had Dunedin Plumbing replace our Kitchen faucet and they did a great job.  We picked out a faucet in the nice showroom and they ordered from supplier.  They installed the faucet quickly and did a great job.  Dan was great, very professional, friendly and efficient in removing old faucet and installing new one.  I had Patrick out a few weeks ago and he did his best to address a leak issue but turned out to be leaking inside of the faucet.  Patrick was also great really friendly and professional.  I definitely recommend Dunedin Plumbing based on my experience.

reviews.author: Reba Whiteman

Without going into painful detail, we have finally found the best company in our area.  Great service (easy to schedule and prompt), very professional, thorough and fairly priced. Mark, the plumber who did the work, was experienced and very knowledgeable...and just an all around nice person to deal with.  We highly recommend Dunedin Plumbing and will call them for any future plumbing needs we may have.

reviews.author: Kim Bushe-Whiteman
reviews.text: Dan and Zach came to service my water heater and they arrived earlier than expected they were kind, friendly and professional. Dan evaluated the problem very quickly and was able to resolve the issue in a timely matter.  Thank you both for taking such great care of your customer and putting them first.  Thumbs 👍🏽 up to Dundein Plumbing. Job well done.

reviews.author: Amy Singleton
reviews.text: We had a water emergency on a Sunday. They were very responsive and came out quickly. Sawyer was very polite and friendly. reviews.author: Lurene Hunt

reviews.author: Ulysses Grant
reviews.text: From the moment Tun arrived, his professionalism was evident. This level of communication was incredibly valuable. More importantly, Tun efficiently and effectively fixed the plumbing problem, demonstrating his expertise and skill. His ability to diagnose and resolve the issue quickly saved me both time and potential further damage. Tun is an outstanding representative for Roto-Rooter, embodying the company's commitment to quality service and customer satisfaction. I would highly recommend his services to anyone in need of a reliable and knowledgeable plumber.

reviews.author: Michael Dow
reviews.text:

Tun did a fantastic job. The pipe repair and faucet work like a charm. Great quality work as well. I had my water back on in a couple of hours as well. Mr. Rooter is more expensive. However, they get the job done right and are great to call in emergencies. Thanks again, Tun!

My appointment was scheduled for noon and the company and Jeremiah and Sam kept me up to date on their ETA often.  I really appreciated that! Jeremiah G was polite when he arrived introduced himself.  Answered all my questions before we got started.
I would recommend Jeremiah to my family and friends.

reviews.author: Elida Gonzalez
reviews.text: Islom was awesome! He was kind and respectful. He explained what the issue was, how he would fix it, how long it would take and the estimate for the work. He was done in a little less than 2 hours on a Sunday and I couldn’t be more satisfied with him and AAA services. Thank you!

plumbers.name: Walk on Water Plumbing LLC

reviews.author: Joan Ferrill
reviews.text: Steve, Walk on Water Plumbing Services, was very quick to reply to my request for help with not having hot water.  He communicated by phone and text to arrange for a time for him to be by, after his very long workday.  We live in Roxborough Park and it was quite a drive for him.  He was able to diagnose water heater malfunction, and he continued to try to light the pilot for quite a while.  The pilot would not stay lit for longer than a minute.  I reviewed the inspection report for when we purchased the house in May of 2025, and the report pointed out that the water heater would need replacement soon, as it was already 17 years old.  We made arrangements for a new water heater to be installed the next day and Lucas was extremely efficient and personable.  I was not overcharged, as my husband had researched pricing on water heaters right after learning we needed a replacement. Labor/installation + cost of water heater was very reasonable.  I’ve texted Steve for resources on wiring for our thermostat and he was able to have an electrician, Anthony Mares, call me right away.  My wiring issues were taken care of very quickly and in a professional manner.  I would also recommend Anthony(Tony)Mares for any electrical wiring needs.

reviews.author: Gordon Smith
reviews.text: I was referred to Steve and his team by a colleague.  I'm glad I have them in our rolodex now as the price the quoted was very fair and when Rob who was assigned to our case came out to help with the repair he was on time (ahead of schedule which worked better for us that day) and quickly repaired the leak.  He was professional and very knowledgable.  He didn't pressure us for cross sales and try to upgrade us, etc. like the big firms in the area do- bottom line is Rob enjoys helping us customers and takes pride in his work.  It's impressive to see how Steve has grown his company through word of mouth and no marketing which helps keep the costs down and transfers to our own project fair pricing we customers see.  I highly recommend this group and will certainly use them in the future.

reviews.author: La Sc

I'll be honest...I called Walk On Water because A. They are located near me and B. Their business name tickled my funny bone.

It turns out they are also great at their work, prompt and honest.

And I think I just might.

reviews.author: sandra joll
reviews.text: The young man who fixed my toilet did a nice job. I appreciated the prompt text I received when I initially contacted them. They were able to take care of it right away. He does have to come back and replace the handle. Nice I didn’t have to replace the whole toilet.

reviews.author: Gerda Mohl
reviews.text: Steve and Rob were both very responsive and knowledgeable.  Rob showed up on time and finished the job as promised.  He was very organized and professional.  I would definitely use Walk on Water again.

reviews.author: Nina Fuller
reviews.text: I have used Clark Kent a few times now and have found them to be reliable, keeping me informed every step of the way. They have provided good service and patience in making sure I understand what is going on. The last service was complex but feel like my 2 problems have been solved.

reviews.author: Wing Commander
reviews.text: Andrew from Clarke Kent was excellent to deal with and did a high quality repair. He had to dig out the line from the meter but did so without hesitation or complaint. The job took about 3.5 hour's and he kept me updated as the work progressed. Worthy of the five star rating.

reviews.author: Pj Johnson
reviews.text: Had to replace floor bolt on my toilet and had a small leak under my sink. They did a great job. The price was good. Plumber was friendly. Been a while since I needed a plumbing company but the last one was over priced, tried to upsell me, and just seemed greedy. Clark Kent didn't feel like that at all. I was very happy and will definitely use them again. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: August Beverly
reviews.text: We had an issue with our kitchen sink not draining, and Daniel was fantastic. He was extremely knowledgeable, quickly and confidently identified the problem, and took the time to explain how we can care for our sink moving forward. I especially appreciated his holistic, health-conscious approach to prevention, no harsh chemicals and nothing that could compromise our health. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Angela Masciarelli
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Daniel Machuca! We’ve used Clarke Kent for a few years now and have always had good experiences. However Daniel was exceptional! He clearly explained the issue and problem areas to look out for in the future. We appreciated his diligence and honesty and would recommend him and Clarke Kent to any of our neighbors and friends.

plumbers.name: To the T Plumbing Heating and Air
plumbers.address: 12487 Syracuse St, Thornton, CO 80602, USA

reviews.author: Christine Balzano
reviews.text: Excellent service!!!! My furnace went out of course on a very cold day and it’s supposed to be a super cold weekend. I called. They picked up the phone when I called  and came out a few hours after I called. They diagnosed the problem. It was a gas valve and fixed. It saved us from freezing and my pipes are safe! I recommend this company to everyone because they had excellent service and an honest price.

reviews.author: Marie Jones
reviews.text: Mike and Lyndsey are an awesome team! They knew what they were doing and how to explain what we needed to know. Timely and very friendly!

reviews.author: Sonja Maher
reviews.text: This company was referred to me by a family member who said to ask for Justin or Anthony as they did a fantastic for them. I called and spoke to Sarah. She was very nice and patient. She set up an appointment on Oct 28th between 1-3pm. I specifically asked for Anthony or Justin to assist with my issue. Sarah said no problem and assured me Justin would be the plumber coming out to my home. Justin was not dispatched to my home. It was another tech by the name of Hector. Although he was 30 min late for my 1pm-3pm appt; I was given a heads up. No big deal. Hector and another HVAC person by the name of Mike showed up at 3:30pm. They told me it would be a cost of $250 to “diagnose” the hot water heater. Mind you my heater was replaced 4 years ago. The problem was diagnosed within two minutes upon removal of the two nuts on top of my water heater. They were completely clogged which explained why my water pressure was extremely low. They explained it would take an hours worth of work to fix at the cost of $459 per hour. With our hot water heater dismantled, we were asked if we wanted to go through with the repair. We felt we were being strong armed but didn’t want to go through the hassle of calling and waiting for another plumber as we would be without water and it was late in the afternoon. The bill for an hour and a half of work came to just under $800! I have yet to receive a copy of my bill which was supposed to be emailed to me that evening. Once Hector and Mike left, I went to my basement to make sure everything was in order. I was disappointed to find that a mess was left in the hot water heater space, water all over the floor in my bathroom (the water in the shower was being tested to make sure it worked) and that my toilet was used and not flushed. GROSS. In addition they turned off my furnace and forgot to turn it back on. We found out the hard way when we woke up the next morning  in a house that was 59 degrees! I do not recommend this company as they didn't send out who I wanted and felt the cost for the service provided was very high. I am deeply disappointed. I had to give one star to post this review. However, I give this company ZERO stars.

reviews.author: Zachary Munson
reviews.text:
Great local company with amazing attention to detail. We sent a request for a quote and within 24 hours we had an appointment that accommodated our work schedule.

Nate and Max were scheduled for our in home quote and we received confirmation over text prior to the appointment which provided great detail on how to make any changes if necessary. On the day of the appointment we were reminded of the time frame and again prompted to reach out if any changes were necessary.

Before we reached our scheduled time frame Nate provided a courtesy call to confirm the appointment and let me know he and Max would arrive shortly. On arrival I was already impressed with the level of professionalism and customer service provided. Nate and Max greeted me at the door they were both in company uniform, presentable and courteous of our home even wearing boot covers.  We briefly discussed work to be completed and they began a survey of our furnace, ducting and where to install an AC unit.

We determined there needed to be an update to our electrical panel to handle the AC unit and Nate provided great detail on that and offered help finding an electrician to complete that work as well.

After that we sat down to discuss our options for our new furnace and AC. Nate provided multiple options which included handouts detailing each system with all specifications. We decided on a few different packages that ranged in price and level of efficiency. We didn’t feel pressured into making a purchase but the honesty and transparency provided by To The T made us feel great about our options. Shortly after our appointment ended we received a quote with multiple options as discussed.

We chose to go with a quote provided by To The T and we could not be more happy with that decision.

On the day of our install the crew called with another courtesy call to confirm our appointment and showed up promptly. Not only did they provide exactly what they promised they were extremely pleasant. Second to none with customer service and professionalism. Big thanks to Nate Kam and Max for doing such a great job with everything!

Billing and scheduling was handled by Jen in their office and she was available to answer all of our questions also providing outstanding customer service.

Thank you,  To The T Plumbing and Heating!

Highly Recommended

reviews.author: Ryan Foshag
reviews.text: I called To the T Heating & Air to come look at our offices broken furnace. They responded with fast same day service. Mike was able to diagnose the problem, get me a quote, order the part, & repair our furnace all within a few hours. We will definitely be using them for all of our future HVAC & plumbing needs. 10 out of 10 & highly recommended!

reviews.author: Dre !
reviews.text:

They sent muh man, Josh, over and he was brilliant. Walked me through the diagnosis and required solution. reviews.author: Lisa Pritchard
reviews.text:
Beyond disappointing- said they would be out this morning. Around 11:30am I called to confirm they were still coming, and was told the technician would be here in about an hour.

Another hour went by, I called again- this time no one picked up and I was sent to a full mailbox. I even tried 2 more times in case that was a fluke- same message.

I wish I had searched reviews by “most recent” as it seems this place does not have any positive reviews in the last 7 months. Do not call!!

reviews.author: Jerrod Horton
reviews.text: Installed faulty shower pan, dodged calls for months, then provided inadequate response to resolve issue. Would recommend for basic work, but avoid them for any difficult / non-basic work.

reviews.author: Jeffrey & Tina
reviews.text:
We tracked down Plumb Doctors after a few plumbers recommended by friends turned us down because they didn't service tankless water heaters. We've since used them twice and I can highly recommend!

Marc came out last year because our water wouldn't stay hot during showers. He showed up promptly, immediately diagnosed the issue as a faulty check valve, and had it replaced within minutes. He took the time to explain to us what he was doing and even showed us how to replace it ourselves in the future (plus how to flush our system) so we wouldn't have to pay for the same service again.

We called Marc out again earlier this week because we thought we damaged our heater after we fumbled through some self-maintenance. He came out on time and quickly confirmed nothing was wrong. He then stayed another 20-30 minutes to answer all of our questions, even allowing us to record videos of him showing how to do some basic maintenance so we wouldn't always have to rely on a plumber.

I don't believe they're the cheapest but we found the pricing to be fair after getting comps from a few other places. More importantly, Plumb Doctor and Marc have always been reliable, professional, courteous, and friendly. I appreciate their transparency and willingness to explain and educate us on what they're doing. I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone who needs help.

reviews.author: Charles Michalk
reviews.text:
I recently had the opportunity to work with Plumb Doctors, and I am extremely satisfied with the service provided. After submitting an online request outside of normal business hours, I was impressed by the prompt response and confirmation of my appointment within just two hours.

Jami, the plumber assigned to my job, was punctual and professional. He ensured I was informed of his arrival time and kept me updated when he needed to leave and return for supplies. Jami managed his apprentice well, giving clear instructions and delegating tasks efficiently while handling other company needs. This not only demonstrated his leadership skills but also his ability to multitask effectively.

Jami's communication was excellent. He quickly identified the issue, explained the underlying problem in a way that was easy to understand, and kept me informed throughout the repair process. His commitment to customer service was evident as he took before, during, and after pictures of the repairs, which he later emailed to me for my personal records. This attention to detail and dedication to ensuring I had a complete record of the work done was greatly appreciated.

Overall, my experience with Jami and Plumb Doctors was outstanding. I highly recommend them for anyone in need of reliable and professional plumbing services. I will certainly be using their services again in the future.

plumbers.name: H.J. Pertzborn Plumbing and Fire Protection Corporation.
plumbers.address: 802 John Nolen Dr, Madison, WI 53713, USA

reviews.author: Keith Schlesinger
reviews.text: Justin is super awesome! We had a couple of plumbing jobs and he took care of everything very quickly and did a professional job at a reasonable price. He also was very good with our dog, Bosco. HJP is lucky to have him as an awesome employee!! We will ask for him with our next plumbing need.

reviews.author: Tim Fahlberg
reviews.text: Wow! Our tub/shower broke on a Friday just before a Monday holiday. I wasn't expecting a call until Tuesday, but first thing on Monday, I got a call from Ashley, who told me a plumber could come out today (MLK Day). A great plumber, Chuck, came out less than an hour later and got it fixed in just over an hour, which was fantastic! I previously had a great experience with Perzborn, and now I see again why they get such stellar reviews from so many people! It's clear why people are happy to refer Perzborn to others, and I will be doing this too.

reviews.author: Vicki Gentz
reviews.text: Great experience! We contacted HJ Pertzborn when our disposal stopped working and we were scheduled for service quickly. Jake was great and not only fixed the issue, but took the time to teach me how to troubleshoot any future issues and gave me some tips for maintaining & cleaning the disposal.

reviews.author: Renee Sinden
reviews.text: Had to have my very old water heater replaced. H.J. Pertzborn was great. They responded quickly and the technician was really knowledgeable and friendly. All for a fair price. I will definitely use them again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Lofgren Properties
reviews.text:
Amazing Company!  We had a main water pipe break the day before all new tenants moved into the house.  Jesse was amazing to work with!  He was professional and knowledgeable.  His response time was unbelievable!  The whole team was hard working and great on the site.
So lucky to have Pertzborn on our team.  I would definitely recommend them to solve your big or small plumbing issues.

plumbers.name: Catons Plumbing, Drains & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 616 Water St #316, Baltimore, MD 21202, USA

reviews.author: Rj
reviews.text:
Called them for a frozen pipe that burst. Sent out a plumber who did okay work. Have to redo the pipe he replaced because it's QPVC and his replacement piping is bent putting stress back on that area. Water remediation crew didn't check my flooring which had a lot of water on it, flooring is bowing in multiple areas after they finished. The crew also damaged my flooring when setting up a plastic tarp to isolate the area. Crew also didn't clean up any of the drywall dust from demoing, only did so after I asked them to. Going to have a GC tear up the floors to look for mold since they didn't even bother to.

Edit: Changing review from 2 to 1 stars. I called Catons with my compliants and asked how they would remediate it. Supervisor Dennis I spoke with told me they could only offer to spray anti-fungal when I had someone else pull up the floor. He also said the threshold wasn't their fault as it looked, based off my pictures, that the damage was caused by the flooring they failed to remediate per the contract I signed. Haven't heard back in multiple days, going to file a complaint with the city.

reviews.author: Just Jason
reviews.text:
We have used Catons for several different projects and each time the service is excellent and the team we have worked with is superb. They arrive when they say they will and the projects are done with perfection.

We will continue to use them for all our needs.

reviews.author: Ivan Celestial
reviews.text: Excellent service from Kevontay. He was able to quickly diagnose an issue at one of our properties, develop a solution, and perform repairs in a timely manner. We definitely prefer to use Caton Plumbing in the future — especially if they send Kevontay.

reviews.author: STUDIO MANAGER
reviews.text: This was the worst service call we have ever experienced. Complete lack of communication internally between technicians and management. Customer service was running interference and was misleading at best. I spent a total of three plus hours on the phone with them over this time period. We had 8 different people out here over the course of 7 days; some just left, some gave wildly different pricing scenarios and solutions. The first plumber cut the water line to our third floor and only made the leak worse - then left. That cost $400! It was a simple fix that was needed. Catons refused to apply a promised credit to our final bill until I made a loud and angry stink about it. I do not recommend them for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Frank Flamish
reviews.text: I was in a very bad place with a burst pipe.  I called on a Friday evening at 5:30.  Our technician "Jason" showed up quickly and immediately had the water shut off!  He is very skilled and totally professional.... the knowledgeable not fooling around type!  In and out like 45mins 👍👍

plumbers.name: H.R. Stewart Inc
plumbers.address: 52 Crystal St, Cary, IL 60013, USA

reviews.author: Mike Tate
reviews.text:
H.R. Stewart went out of their way to get a plumber to my home in less than 24hrs when my water main valves broke and needed replacing. Jimmy was great and a super nice guy! Jimmy replaced 2 old screw valves with new ball valves.
Would recommend H.R. Stewart to everyone and will definitely call them again if I need plumbing or HVAC work done.

reviews.author: Ryan Smid
reviews.text:
Eric from H.R. Stewart was incredible. My furnace stopped working in the middle of the night, and he spent nearly 30 minutes on the phone with me at 4 AM troubleshooting the issue. He was patient, thorough, and even followed up exactly at 8 AM like he promised.

We later found out Nicor had a frozen gas valve outside, so the furnace wasn’t actually faulty but Eric’s help and dedication at that hour really stood out. I’m extremely grateful and will definitely use HR Stewart for my other properties. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Judy Gitchell
reviews.text:
Cody is prompt knowledgeable and efficient. Fixed a leak under the bathroom sink. Cleaned up after the job. Bathroom looked better than before he started the job.
Have only been doing business with this company for 4 months but they are the best plumbers I’ve ever used

reviews.author: Arden Nelson
reviews.text:
He did excellent and I as a General Contractor am sincere.
I had guys onsite and we all worked together to determine best path and  Cody was key to that decision.
He walked the entire area and shared thoughts which all made sense.
Decision to put on semi hold made total sense and if needed for sure I will call you guys back and highly likely ask you to bid on future projects I may have.

Thank you

reviews.author: Dan Kennedy
reviews.text: I rely on HR S to be the reliable and professional experts for my home HVAC system and I am never disappointed.  They are very responsive on the phone and quick to be available and service my home systems issues.  All of the personnel that come to the house know my HVAC system and will install or resolve issues expertly and with professional customer service attitude.

plumbers.name: Plumbing Paramedics
plumbers.address: 1555 W Lincolnway #103, Valparaiso, IN 46385, USA

reviews.author: John Dough
reviews.text: Another company failed to show up, I  called Plumbing Paramedics at 9pm, Austin one of their plumbers came at 11pm. He was thorough and honest cleaned out sixty feet of my main sewer line when most would not show up at all! They are coming back tomorrow with a jetter as the clog was too much for a standard sewer auger. Best part is the charges for the rodding will be credited to the charge for getting. Once again they showed up! Austin came back today and finished the job as promised. He worked diligently untill my main sewer line was opened. He found a clog on the inside line after clearing the outside main, Austin removed the toilet and cleared that too! He is extremely knowledgeable about all aspects of his trade and professional in his demeanor. Plumbing Paramedics Great Job! Wish I could give you all 10 stars, The quality of an employee is indicative of a professional company. Thank you once again.

reviews.author: Pierson Vanderstar
reviews.text: We had Four seasons come out to root our sewer a couple months before calling the Plumbing Paramedics, the guy who came out didn’t really answer my questions or any really satisfactory information and seemed like he rushed the job, then quoted us 12k in work because he didn’t think he’d be able to make any difference with the rooter. Thankfully I found the Paramedics because after they sent Dakota out he pretty quickly figured to try rooting from the other end of the line (which the other company had neglected to do) and had it cleaned out in no time. I was very pleased to find a company with integrity and transparency in this day and age

reviews.author: Christine Gabel
reviews.text: Michelle, who answered the phone on Saturday morning was friendly, quick, and efficient. She dispatched Austin to my house who promptly texted to let me know he was on his way. He came in to my home and was Polite and quickly assessed the situation and made the necessary repair. I was so happy to pay a local business and not a large nationwide chain

reviews.author: Susie Engelage
reviews.text:
Donny and Austin, just a short note to say " Thank YOU " .. THANK YOU for your time and hard work . Watching Austin work in the cold that day was remarkable. His knowledge and skills that he showed was above and beyond what was required or expected of him. He has mastered the art of plumbing. Austin is a great asset to your company . Please give him a big pat on the back .
Thank You Donny for all your help and patience,  but most of all the time you took to sit down and explaine everything to me. Not many people or companies do that any more; so with a grateful heart   I thank you  !

reviews.author: Laurie Salmon
reviews.text:
Dakota was amazing.  Explained everything to me and he really is passionate about his work! Grateful for his knowledge!

I wrote the original review last Wednesday 1/7/26. I was told my Dakota that "his boss" would give me an estimate on replacing our sewer piping. I was told they would send me an estimate. Well no estimate, no phone call, even when I have tried to get in touch with them.  Disappointed

plumbers.name: Big Blue Plumbing
plumbers.address: 768 Stewart Ct, Alameda, CA 94501, USA

reviews.author: Terry O'Connor
reviews.text: Harris Giotas, our Big Blue plumber, was incredible. He is a real credit to the industry. Not only was he able to replace our aging (and old) Glacier Bay fixtures without tearing out the entire wall, he discovered and repaired a unknown major leak under the toilette. We are truly indebted to Harris for his complete professionalism. He was prompt, efficient, and courteous. He is highly recommended for any plumbing problem or issue.

reviews.author: Ralph Martinez
reviews.text: Enrique Luevanos, Technician with Big Blue installed our new thermal expansion tank. He was very professional, thorough and respectful during their entire process. The end result was great professional service by again, another great technician with Big Blue.

reviews.author: Jenn Lavelle
reviews.text: When our old hot water heater died and couldn’t be fixed, we called Big Blue. Javier V. was really helpful with explaining our options, and we decided to upgrade to a Sanco2 heat pump system instead of gas. Javier and Pardo were knowledgeable, kind and precise with the install, and navigated challenges like where to put the heat pump behind our house and ordering special parts. They also work with a great electrician and facilitated that work. The whole job was done in two days! They made sure we didn’t have to go a weekend without hot water. I highly recommend going with Big Blue and their expert staff.

reviews.author: Kate Loreaux
reviews.text: Called these guys with an emergency when a water heater flooded my condo in the evening. They confirmed they could make an appointment the next morning. Overnight they texted me that they were “canceling the appointment due to a scheduling change.” I can’t speak to the quality of the actual work they do, but I certainly wouldn’t depend on them in the case of an emergency. They might just decide they won’t be coming after all.

reviews.author: Angela Gregory
reviews.text:
Nate J at BBP was very professional and knowledgeable. He explained our options and when he left I felt good because he actually made sense at when he explained things.  My neighbor said that he had his plumbing done at Big Blue and was very happy with them.
So I would definitely recommend this company.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 336 S Main St Ste 2DE, Bel Air, MD 21014, USA

reviews.author: Benito Gomez
reviews.text: Dai Pau was my service person and ensured that all the repairs that were done were functioning properly in tip top shape. He was really fast detailed with his work with a great attitude. Thank you Dai Pau and Roto Rooter once again for great service.

reviews.author: Marc-Anthony Gray
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5-Star Review — Excellent Service!
I had a running toilet that was wasting water and driving me crazy, so I called Roto-Rooter for help. They were quick to respond and had a technician out the same day. The plumber was friendly, professional, and clearly knew his stuff—he diagnosed the issue right away and explained what needed to be done before fixing it efficiently.
Within a short time, my toilet was working perfectly again, and he even checked to make sure everything else was running smoothly before leaving. The whole experience was stress-free from start to finish. I really appreciate his honesty, punctuality, and quality of work. I’ll definitely call Roto-Rooter again for any future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Mark Mulligan
reviews.text: Jerry from Roto Rooter came out and did a camera inspection.  He was very professional and explained everything.  He was outstanding.  We have been very fortunate with every technician that has been sent out by Roto Rooter.  I highly recommend their service to anyone.

reviews.author: Isabella Wu
reviews.text: I called Roto Rooter thinking I needed a water plumber for a leak I was told that I had. When Jerry came out he informed me that it was a gas plumber that was needed for the job, as there was no water leak in the main line to the house. He was expeditious in calling dispatch to send someone else out to my house from a different department that would be able to assist me. He was lovely and provided amazing customer service. Daniel, the gas plumber, was able to come out the same day to fix the gas leak to the mainline in the house. I would definitely recommend them the next time I am in need of services such as these.

reviews.author: Lisa Macek
reviews.text: Tuan was super professional and got the job done very quickly! Roto-Rooter is a trusted name plumber and they even had Sunday hours, which was super appreciated. He arrived right on time and got to work right after assessing the repair, giving us an estimate in writing, and cleaning up everything afterwards! Thank you, Tuan! Exceptional job!

plumbers.name: Horsetooth Heating, Air & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1420 Riverside Ave #102, Fort Collins, CO 80524, USA

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience with Horsetooth Heating and Air! Last month, a different local company overlooked our blown furnace motor, which created a hazardous situation. After a recommendation from the fire department, we turned to Horsetooth Heating and Air, and they were incredibly helpful right from the first call—clearly explaining our options and accommodating the mistakes that were made from the other company.
Ben was fantastic to work with; he patiently helped us select the right equipment and made sure the whole plan fit our needs perfectly. The installation team—Damion, Roman, and Lars— worked very timely, professionally, and knowledgeably. The owner, Kyle, even stopped by on the final install day. They kept the work area inside and outside of the home clean throughout and even added helpful labels on the new units (like filter change instructions) so we’d know exactly what to do going forward.
We can’t recommend Horsetooth Heating and Air highly enough. We’re thrilled with the new units we have, and we have complete confidence in the quality of their work!

reviews.author: Linda S
reviews.text: We had Horsetooth Heating, Air and Plumbing come out for some more intensive cleaning for our HVAC before the winter weather starts.  We were happy to see that Josh, our last technician, was the one to come out again. He was on time, very efficient and communicated well.  He explained the process and what the results would be.  Very happy with his professionalism and expertise.  We are looking forward to seeing him again for our next maintenance!

reviews.author: Marilyn Wagner
reviews.text: Horsetooth HVAC is definitely a 5 star company in every way.  On examination our poorly functioning 20 year old system was near total failure.  My son is a 100% disabled Vet and heating and AC are vital to him.  Realizing total replacement was necessary but would be difficult in many ways- Horsetooth HVAC pursued a program for total system replacement.  They coordinated with Rheem, FOOTHILLS Electric and Wounded Warriors for the total replacement.  The team were so kind, professional and skilled as they carried out the miracle! The work was done to the highest standards and with such respect!  We totally recommend this company and my son is now in a safe and comfortable environment.  We recommend them highly and appreciate this company in every way!!

reviews.author: Craig Vollmer
reviews.text: I had Jacob & Lael come to my house to replace the 17 year-old water heater. They were on time Professional nice did an amazing job and made sure everything was in working order.  I really don’t know how much more you could ask. Just a fantastic experience. I would recommend Horsetooth heating and air and feel confident that they would make me look good thank you.!

reviews.author: Taco Cat
reviews.text:
1. Realistic & competitive estimate.
2. Professional courtesy for unexpected issues (on my side, not theirs)
3. Replaced 2 water heaters. 1st for slab floor. 2nd everything else.
4. Replaced a few other big ticket "plumbing" items as well.
5. These guys know what they're doing.

Thanks again Horsetooth Heating & Plumbing!!

plumbers.name: AZERPLUMB - Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 5145 Shiloh Rd Suite 111, Cumming, GA 30040, USA

reviews.author: Onur D.
reviews.text:
I found AzerPlumb online after reading the great reviews, and they absolutely lived up to them. When we recently had a water leak in our home, AzerPlumb did an exceptional job from start to finish. Nima was incredibly professional, responsive, and thorough. He took the time to explain the issue clearly, answered all my questions patiently and made sure every part of the repair was done to the highest quality.

The workmanship was excellent, the area was left spotless, and everything has been working perfectly since.

I truly appreciate the honesty, attention to detail, and commitment to doing the job right.  I highly recommend AzerPlumb to anyone looking for a reliable and skilled plumber.

reviews.author: Iman Aljaber
reviews.text:
An amazing place with an amazing owner! I very rarely write reviews, but after doing business with this company it's the least I could do. My family's finance is very tight, and we are going through difficult times with regards to medical issues.

Our water heater went out, and we couldn't find a place that could fix it within our budget. When I thought we would have to deal with cold water until next week, I came across this company, and I'm so happy I did.

The owner of this company, Nima, heard us out and made sure to take care of us. One of his plumbers, Gary, did a fantastic job and double checked everything. He explained every step he was doing and made sure we understood. He also gave us troubleshooting advice on our water heater.

If you want a company that not only does a good job but will do whatever it can to take care of your budget's needs, then you found the right place. If I could give this place 10 stars, I would.

reviews.author: Mason Harris
reviews.text:
I had six or seven companies come out for quotes on various work.  I have history in plumbing adjacent industries, and have an ok bs meter.   In general, most were nice enough but overpriced. Some were less nice, more pushy and still overpriced.  Azerplumb easily had the best people to deal with in every position(u know who u are), sales, service , and administrative.  Also, best pricing by far.
There's nothing like feeling good about choices made with your hard earned money, and I feel amazing after choosing them over their competitors.   They feel like a unicorn company these days... Reasonable pricing, quality work,  ethical business practice.

reviews.author: Gary Evonsion
reviews.text: Gary was excellent, efficient and willing to share his knowledge. Nami is the person I booked it with and he was also great. It was a change out of a kitchen sink and booked a couple hours earlier.  These will be my go to plumber services guys from now on and I recommend them highly!

reviews.author: Daniel Liptrott
reviews.text: A fantastic experience with Azer. We had an assessment from another plumber who I knew was overcharging me and so I decided to shop around. Azer were the very best - good pricing and very responsive. Nima is very knowledgeable and gave a clear, competitive price. Gary came and did the work that same day, staying until after 7pm to make sure everything was right. I will always use Azer from now on. Highly, highly recommend.

plumbers.address: 2430 Squire Pl, Farmers Branch, TX 75234, USA

reviews.author: Kim W.
reviews.text: I called My Local Plumber for help with determining a leak detection within my home.  Their plumbers quickly came over and found the leak!  They were friendly and knowledgeable!  The office staff were also very helpful and attentive.  Thanks for helping me in my time of need!  I'm so glad I found their service!  I highly recommend for leak detection!  I wish I could leave 10 stars for their service!

reviews.author: William Kitchens
reviews.text: I have and will always use My Local Plumber. 2 broken outside faucets from the ice storm. Pipes leaking in wall. I tried to fix it myself. Not a chance. Zac Cassel fixed it like a champ! You get live updates on the drivers arrival time, you get great pricing, and you get great service. What more can I ask for?

reviews.author: Matt Roberson
reviews.text: So great, I had a big clog in our main drainage line on the Saturday of this latest snow storm in Dallas and they were able to send out Zach and Marco to help me on a day where hardly anybody could get out and around town. They quickly resolved the issue which allowed me to drip my faucets and potentially save me from disaster! Zach and Marco were very knowledgeable and very kind. Much appreciated guys!

reviews.author: Rick Reid
reviews.text: I'm a repeat customer -- My Local Plumber had a super-quick response and turnaround time on snaking a drain, running a diagnostic camera, and fixing an annoying toilet mechanism that had gone south. They also helped me determine the cause of a new, leaky sink. Super pros -- a little spendy, but worth the peace of mind. I highly recommended My Local Plumber for caring customer service and outstanding quality workmanship.

reviews.author: Joanna C
reviews.text: We have used My Local Plumber for a couple of years now.  We will not use another plumbing company!  We got the recommendation from my realtor friend and I understand why they come highly recommended.  From scheduling to communication and expertise, everything is handled efficiently and professionally.  Trevor and Kevin just left after solving 2 separate issues.  Trevor explained methods and costs of everything before, during and after the process.  Thanks for a positive and reliable experience!

plumbers.name: Robinson Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1737 Neva St, Allentown, PA 18104, USA

reviews.author: pjm_21
reviews.text: I have used Robinson Plumbing twice within the last couple of weeks and their service is worthy of 5 stars. On time, and very thorough explanation of the service and process of the job. I had a whole water filtration system installed and the system is installed neatly and quickly. I was even luck enough to get same day service!!!  I will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Judy Thompson
reviews.text:
Ben was great. He did everything he could to help get the frozen pipe thawed. And he also checked in with me the next morning!  Finally, the cold water pipe thawed and was going strong (the hot water pipe
had been ok).

All the plumbers and their apprentices that have been to my home (for whatever plumbing reason) have been great….Always courteous, friendly, thorough and they all informed me of what’s going on. I highly recommend Robinson Plumbing and continue to do so with my friends and acquaintances.

reviews.author: Ken Martin
reviews.text: My experience with Robinson Plumbing was excellent. Ben was the plumber who did the work. He was able to get to my house earlier than expected and did a great job with removing my leaking water heater and replacing it with a new water heater. The work was completed in a professional manner in a reasonable amount of time. I now have a plumbing company that I can call if needed in the future and be assured that they will get the job done to a high standard at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Ty Schwab
reviews.text: We've had Robinson out a handful of times to improve our plumbing and each time I'm left extremely satisfied. We've had a new hot water heater and water softener + filter installed and have had a positive experience each time. We'll be continuing to use Robinson, though hopefully we won't need them!

reviews.author: Heidi Waltz
reviews.text: I called the 24/7 emergency # and was instantly connected to dispatch. Took all my information and within an hour I received the call from Dylan. He arrived at my house in 30 minutes. Very friendly and courteous right from walking in the front door. He told me the diagnosis and the cost before he did anything. Which I appreciated, he didn’t just fix the problem and then charge me some astronomical fee. I was happy with the price considering he had to come out on off hours. Dylan was very friendly and even checked another toilet for me. I will definitely recommend Robinsons to my friends and family.

plumbers.name: Wilson Plumbing, Heating, and Electric
plumbers.address: Sure, 30505 Bainbridge Rd, Solon, OH 44139, USA

reviews.author: Jackie Rushlow
reviews.text: Very happy with our sewer line repair at our house. Can’t say enough about our service from the whole team but especially David, Chuck, Jordon and Jake organizing the job. All of them went above beyond to help come up with a permanent, least invasive solution to our issue. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: westparkgirl
reviews.text: David was great! Explained everything well and was the epitome of customer service. Highly recommended technician who got things done efficiently!

reviews.author: Kris Hojdar
reviews.text:
Jacob, Michael and Casey were all
Amazing.  Jacob checked our furnace and made sure it was safe and running. ($50)
Michael came and was the real hero and unclogged both our shower drains. ($1200) Casey drained and checked our hot water tank and gave us an estimate for potential issues. ($50)

reviews.author: Paul Bonacuse
reviews.text: Brian E was a straight up "G".  Nice guy, knowledgeable and had our furnace back up and running during the coldest day of the year.  Furthermore, the AI bot had us scheduled 24 hours out.  I responded to the text reminder and Brian was dispatched within 2 hours.  Big ups to Wilson!

reviews.author: James Fitzgibbon
reviews.text:
A friendly word of caution to those considering Wilson - their general business model for the healthy home membership appears to be offering 'free' services as part of their package.  However, they will often then try to charge/recommend unnecessary service.

As example, we had plumber (Michael Dillree) come to our house flush our hot water tank. A free service then scheduled as a matter of convenience with our usual house maintenance, he decided on his own accord to try to sell us a new water softener. He told us our water was too hard (it is not- we have our own testing strip/chemicals).  We've been looking to remove our softener system (only needing a filter).  He refused to do this and provide us only very expensive quotes. He tried to soften this by saying he checked our sump pump that it wasn't working order (it is in fact not, and have known this), and our house water pressure was too high (indeed high, but not too the degree he reported).  We ultimately had our suspicions confirmed getting another plumber to come out (and also just disconnected our water softener for a very reasonable price).

In general, it is a similar experience for electric (we had a general contractor on another project point out and argue down some unusual costs/fees), as well as HVAC 'clean and checks' (where wiring 'problems' were then reviewed by others noting they're trying to charge for unnecessary service).

We only had signed up for a healthy home membership given a discount for one year, after calling for an electric project for our first experience with Wilson and receiving the offer.  Fortunately, we avoided too much headache with Wilson, as we had our suspicions early on.  But essentially every service call required us to double check every recommendation they made with another group we trusted more - defeating the purpose of using them in the first place.

Hopefully this is helpful to someone - We would strongly recommend finding more trustworthy service help elsewhere, and we wouldn't even take their healthy home membership for free if offered to us based on our previous experiences with them.

He also noticed that the venting tubing for the power vent was now out of code (it changed) and had to be pressure capable, so he brought that up to code too.  Very pleasant and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: jennifer weitzman
reviews.text:
I was happy with the repair overall, and the technician was polite and capable. My main concern is how pricing was communicated—or more accurately, not communicated.
I contacted them regarding an issue with a sump pump that required a replacement part. After some troubleshooting, the technician quickly diagnosed the issue and said the part would need to be ordered. I was told there would be no charge for that visit.

When I was later contacted, I was told the part was expensive—around $350—and that they would call once it arrived to schedule the follow-up visit. During that call, I also asked about the cost of the initial visit and was told there was a 30-minute minimum charge. While that differed from what I believed I had been told, I felt that was reasonable.

When the part came in, it was installed in just a few minutes. As the technician was leaving, he mentioned that my card on file would be charged. I later received a call only to verify my card number, at which point I was informed the total was $910.06.
This charge included a fee for the first visit—despite being told there would be no charge—and it exceeded the 30-minute minimum. The part itself was $452, not the $350 I had been quoted, leaving $458 in labor for a very brief installation. When I tried to discuss the discrepancy, there was no interest in addressing it.

I recognize that I should have requested written estimates, and that is a lesson learned. However, it’s unfortunate because everything else went well. The lack of transparency around invoicing is a serious issue. Had I been given accurate pricing upfront, I may have made a different decision about whether to repair or replace the system. Instead, I was given little information and blindsided by the final bill.

reviews.author: Matt Nape
reviews.text:
Excellent tech that came to house but I am extremely disappointed in the pricing structure and poor communication. While they communicate and charge a $150 emergency fee to you, they seem to only have a single after hours technician so be prepared to wait hours. I'll commend Angela from customer service for making an extra call to try to help me shut off the water. Where they've failed for me is in their $318 "leak finding" fee. They charge this if they have to cut into your drywall. This needs to be communicated during initial set up of appointment so that a customer can take the hours they are waiting and make their own decision; I very easily and safely could have made the same opening. Once a technician is standing in your home at 10:30 pm you're no longer in a position to have other options.

You are also charged the $150 just to reserve the appointment so you won't be able to find a faster service once you reserve a technician (I had an unknown ETA initially during an active water leak because they only had the one tech)

Overall I just felt undeserved and way overcharged. I waited over 2 hours for a technician to be in my house for 45 min and a total of $468 to tell me the AC  had condensation building up. So while I do appreciate them "identifying the problem" I can't say I'll be using or recommending their services.

I've dropped this to a 1 star as all I've gotten is the generic "please call us".
