reviews.author: Patti Ramsey
reviews.text: Excellent experience with H2O PROS Plumming! They returned my call right away and had my toilets installed within three days. The team was professional, efficient, and cleaned everything up before leaving. The installation was done quickly and correctly, and the price was very reasonable. I highly recommend them and will definitely use them again for future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Stuart Thompson
reviews.text: Spoke with Keith to set up appointment for 1:30 the next day. David showed up right at 1:30 and was able to quickly fix a leak that we had coming from our upstairs bathroom. The price was more than reasonable and David was awesome! I will be using them anytime I have a plumbing issue!

reviews.author: Joseph Livolsi
reviews.text: No hot water issue. H2O PROS plumbing responded quickly when called. Dave arrived and upon finding out the I was remodeling the guest bathroom, asked if he could check it out. He immediately noticed the cartridge was not installed when the shower valve was roughed in ( by different plumbing company). Once he installed the cartridge, problem solved. Dave proved to be quite knowledgeable, courteous and friendly. Call it a quick fix or the fact he had installed our hot water heater this past year, he did not charge me a dime. Needless to say they are responsible and professional, I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Connie Sieczkowski
reviews.text: Had my Rannai Hot Water Tank, ironizer rerouted inside the tank and insulated completely .  It was put on the outside by another company that did not know what they were doing. They do great work and H2O Pros is an excellent company to deal with.  Thank You!

reviews.author: Andrew Gardo
reviews.text: On time, professional, and solved all my issues. I asked if Keith could look at low pressure in a shower after he installed a new hot water heater which I hadn't scheduled and he fixed that to. Above and beyond great service. Highly recommend 👌

reviews.author: Rudy Galfi
reviews.text: Tom’s Plumbing did an absolutely amazing job relocating my water heater, adding a hot water recirculating pipe and motor, and installing a Moen Flo water protection system. The quality of workmanship was excellent—efficient, clean, and clearly skilled. Best of all, the estimate was very reasonable for the scope of work performed. Highly recommend Tom’s Plumbing for anyone looking for quality and reliability!

reviews.author: Diana

During the inspection, Bob was patient and took the time to thoroughly explain each concern I had, making sure I fully understood the work that needed to be done. I’m very pleased with the quality of service and the work completed at my home, and I would not hesitate to recommend him.

reviews.author: Joe Bayer
reviews.text: Bob from Tom’s plumbing helped replace galvanized pipe coming from my main that was starting rust and drip. Bob went above and beyond on the job, was quick, and was very respectful. The estimate from Tom’s plumbing was by far the best out of the 5 plumbers I asked estimates for. I will definitely contact them again in the future when I need something done.

Tom's is the BEST!!!!

reviews.author: Joseph Bajek
reviews.text: Tom's Plumbing sent out a professional to install my toilet within a few days. Bob was very professional and did a great job. Total time was about 2 hours. Would recommend service.

reviews.author: Jeff Nolte
reviews.text:
Copper Peaks did an outstanding job installing a new heating and air conditioning system for us. The price was fair and the install was top notch. Nick and Eric went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect before they left.
Five Stars!

reviews.author: Mike Stephen
reviews.text:
Was incredibly nervous and stressed about my floor drain “issue”. Expecting to cost thousands.

Zeke was great at talking to me like a human, but not talking down to me explained what he thought was the issue and went out to his truck to grab some “magic fairy dust“ and a bucket of hot water.

Not five minutes later the drain was flowing freely!

Thank you SO MUCH for taking that stress off Zeke and Copper Peaks Plumbing!

reviews.author: Sandra Barrus
reviews.text: Gentry was personable and very knowledgeable about what needed to be done to fix our issue.  He was polite and made sure everything looked good (and clean) before he left.  He patiently answered questions and made sure we felt comfortable calling him if we saw any issues later. Will definitely call Copper Peaks Plumbing if we need any other help!

reviews.author: Amberlyn Peterson
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Copper Peaks. My outside faucet started leaking. My tech, Gentry, was absolutely fabulous. He took the time to educate me and get the problem fixed. The price seemed very fair and was less than I was expecting. I would definitely use their services again.

reviews.author: Jeremy M.
reviews.text: They sent out their technician Jeremy. He fixed the toilet float and handle for us.  He was great discussed plan and gave price before we started. Showed up on time and finished in a timely manner. Will definitely use in the future

plumbers.name: bluefrog Plumbing and Drain of Denver
plumbers.address: 7310 S Alton Way STE 6I, Centennial, CO 80112, USA

reviews.author: Ally ao
reviews.text: They responded promptly, and although there was a little miscommunication, they didn’t make excuses. They sent a plumber to my house the same day, fixed the leak and even provided before-and-after pictures. They were not only polite but also took real action. On top of that, they offer a one-year labor warranty. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Vishak
reviews.text:
I had Blue Frog Plumbing & Drain come out to fix a simple leaking hose connection at my water heater. To be clear, this is not a water heater they installed. They were only performing a minor repair. The repair itself was completed and solved the issue, and I paid the plumber.

After the plumber left, I noticed that he had placed a large, obnoxious Blue Frog Plumbing marketing sticker directly on my water heater. He did not ask for permission. He did not mention it. He did not give me the sticker and ask if I wanted it applied. He simply put it on my property without consent.

I do not want ugly marketing stickers on my equipment. It looks cheap, it looks unprofessional, and frankly the giant frog logo is an eyesore. When I tried to remove the sticker, I discovered it is a very thin, low quality sticker that tears immediately when you try to peel it off. It rips into pieces and leaves residue behind, making it even more frustrating to remove.

This is not about the cost of the service or whether the repair worked. This is about basic respect for a customer’s property. You do not put permanent advertising on someone else’s equipment without asking. Period.

Even if Blue Frog Plumbing offered the lowest pricing in the area, I will never use them again. Respect for a customer’s home and property should be a baseline expectation, not an afterthought.

reviews.author: Matt Weeden
reviews.text:
When we discovered that our ground floor toilet was leaking from the base and hey, surprise, the previous owner didn't install a flange, and oh also the copper drain pipe from 1970 doesn't meet modern standards so there's not a good way to connect one anyway—it was time to call in the pros! We got several quotes from various plumbers, and estimates ranged from $1800 on the low end to over $8000 (!!!) with one place, where they wanted to replace ALL of the old drain pipes in the basement. Which, in an ideal world where money is no object, sure; but unfortunately reality is a thing.

Thank goodness I also called BlueFrog to get their take on it. We got the whole job quoted and even completed within less than 3 hours, and now we have a proper flange with a new ABS drain connection that's married onto the existing copper pipe, for under $1000 altogether. No jackhammering of tile and subfloor involved, no cutting holes in drywall, or any unnecessary additions sold via scare tactics. Will we need to replace all the pipes someday? Probably. But, a big shout-out here to our technician Jason Bandy: he has a very down-to-earth, no-nonsense approach and demeanor, and he's adamantly against recommending or charging for things that you just don't need right now. And he took the time to clue me in on signs to watch out for that's going to tell us that, hey, NOW we actually do need to replace some of these other pipes. He's approachable and personable, and you can tell you're talking to an actual human being rather than a corporate mouthpiece.

Also the online scheduler is super easy to use, both to book your appointment and to reschedule if needed.

In summary: SO glad that I contacted BlueFrog, and I anticipate calling them again the next time we have a repair we need help with! 5 stars++

reviews.author: Drew Chilton
reviews.text: 5-star service right here! Cody was super professional and does solid work. He replaced our hose bibb quickly (in and out in an hour) and even installed an extra shutoff valve, which was a great bonus (we didn't even ask for it). He even stayed after to answer extra plumbing questions I had. The price was solid, literally half of what the big names are charging. Plus, the front desk was super responsive and even called me earlier in the day to see if I wanted to have my appointment sooner. A+ service all around, I will definitely be using them from now on!

reviews.author: Pavel Chekhov
reviews.text: We received excellent professional service from bluefrog plumbing.  From customer service to the actual work done by Brennan Pramberg.  The price was moderately higher than average I expected, however I will accept based on the quality of service

plumbers.address: 231 E 400 S Unit 104B, Salt Lake City, UT 84111, USA

reviews.author: Tricia Bronson
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this heating service. Todd showed up with such good vibes - friendly, professional, and easy to talk to. He explained everything clearly so I understood what was going on. He also provided detailed photos of the work, which I really appreciated - it gave me confidence that everything was handled correctly. Excellent service from start to finish! I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Thomas Osimitz
reviews.text: Todd Petersen from Just Right came to our home recently to do annual service on our 3 gas furnaces. We appreciated that he called about 20 minutes before he arrived. When he showed up, he was polite and cheerful and very professional. While working on the furnaces in our basement, he was very patient with my questions and told me the kinds of measurements he was making and why they were important. He offered some suggestions for possible upgrades for us to consider, but never pressured us to make a decision. When he concluded with the 3 furnaces, he gave us a detailed written Tune-Up Inspection check list showing, among other things the various measurements and how they compared to what was desired. This is the first time that Todd has come to our house and he was just as professional and customer-oriented as the other people from Just Right that served us over the last three years since moving into our home. This speaks to the fine training program that Just Right must have and also to their ability to attract friendly and highly capable service professionals like Todd.

reviews.author: Maria Mumby
reviews.text: He was very nice and easy to talk to. He went through everything with us and made sure we were told all our options prior to the work starting. We appreciated this very much as new home owners trying to navigate our home, having it laid out so thoroughly was a huge help. The work he did looks great and we would love to have him come back in the future

reviews.author: Vladimir Tolstik
reviews.text:
DJ is great, knowledgeable and caring representative of company. Really thorough and dedicated. Presented my mom and I with choices, being considerate for what we can afford, and also will be happy in a years to come. I was absolutely impressed with how fast he got to our home. And even more impressed with immediate, next day service of full installation. Thank you Just Right for taking care of our needs as customers on maintenance program. And in time of worst case scenario, when furnace broke. To be at our house helping us to replace it with brand new, really affordable products.
P.S Thank you for lending us for free those portable heaters, so we would be warm through the night.

reviews.author: JAMES Guymon
reviews.text: Very satisfied with the service provided. Just Right HVAC was able to send out a service technician 2 hours after I contacted them. The technician was very professional and knowledgeable. He had my Heating System up and running which in 90 minutes. He also pointed out some issues with my 22 year old furnace. He performed a Carbon Monoxide test and reassured me the system is running safe and I had time to evaluate my next move for replacing the system. Thank you Just Right.

reviews.author: Moses Wasswa
reviews.text: They came and failed to unclog my toilet and charged me $275 for not fixing the issue… very horrible experience. It cost me $275 for them to just show up and leave without fixing the issue

Called Beyond and they (Lisa) were able to hook me up for later on that afternoon and they got it fixed.  Good customer service with call backs and letting you know how long it would be and a shout out to Bobby for coming out and fixing the issue. Good guys!!

reviews.author: bob elder
reviews.text: I’m very impressed! We had a clogged kitchen sink and Zen showed up to help less than 2 hours from the time we called.  Then Jason arrived, and they fixed everything quickly and even showed video proof of the pipes before and after the service. Wow!   I called 3 plumbers before I found WOW on line, and the next time I need someone, you better believe they’ll be the first place I call.

reviews.text: Claims to give exceptional service but refuses to give a ballpark estimate over the phone to replace a water heater.  They want to lock you in by charging you to visit your house to give an estimate.

reviews.author: Eiko Tsai
reviews.text: I have an old water heater and I’m not sure if it should be flushed or replaced. The technician Zen Gonzales came and shared his honest and professional opinions. He was patient and answered all my questions. He provided the estimate of replacing the water heater but he didn’t push me to make decisions which I highly appreciate. I would love to work with Zen in the future again.

plumbers.name: Plumb N Plumber Company, LLC

reviews.author: Julio M Barriga
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with this plumbing company. From the moment they arrived, they were very professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to clearly explain the issue I was having. They were extremely positive and confident about how the problem could be resolved, which gave me a lot of peace of mind.

What I appreciated the most was how they guided me through the entire process, especially explaining the steps needed so my insurance could help cover the repair. They were honest, patient, and made sure I understood everything before moving forward.

I highly recommend this company to anyone looking for reliable, skilled, and trustworthy plumbers. Outstanding service from start to finish.

reviews.author: Angiechris Angie
reviews.text:

Five stars 🌟

reviews.author: Mrs. Laura Susan Bamberg Gideon
reviews.text: JT and Parker were amazing! They found an issue other plumbers missed, which is why we kept having an intermittent leak. They fixed all our issues quickly and thoroughly. They were professional and friendly. Thank you Plumb N Plumber! Jobs well done!!

reviews.text: I am very happy with Plumb & Plumber.  They came out same day & removed a clog affecting 2 bathrooms.  Taylor & Eric were excellent professional technicians, answering our many questions and explaining our options clearly.   They didn't push for the most expensive solutions to our problems.  There was a minor issue with the original work.   I spoke with Jonathan the supervisor and he sent the guys back out the next day to resolve it.

reviews.author: Kristen Faust
reviews.text: First time customer and I am very pleased!  Gave them a few different projects including flushing the tankless water heater and all work was explained thoroughly and completed within no time!  Employees were friendly, prompt and seemed knowledgeable. Would definitely recommend!

plumbers.name: Towers Plumbing Heating & Cooling

reviews.author: G Booth
reviews.text: Kaiden was awesome, showed up on time and gave us the fair quote needed to get our broken pressurized system fixed. He was professional and had a great attitude, dedicated and really enjoyed his work. Would highly recommend this company to anyone needing plumbing needs. The gal that we set the appointment with was extremely helpful and friendly. They turned around in less than 24 hours and we were very happy with the service. We will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Patricia Fava
reviews.text: Eddie and Jacob were very  professional. They work well together.  I get important recommendations from Valley to improve my plumbing in my older home. I highly recommend Eddie, his experience is welcome!

reviews.author: Nolan Turner
reviews.text:
Thanks to Parker! We appreciate the help with our kitchen upgrade. It was appreciated! Especially after having the water off for over 24 hours!

All set for the new kitchen sink.

Parker was quick and courteous.

reviews.author: James Torrens
reviews.text: Jaxsen did a great job, quality workmanship. He came on short notice, provided a good, reasonable estimate. I accepted that and he did the work right then, immediately. Well done, my home is in excellent shape with all three sinks and faucets back in operation. Thank you.

reviews.author: S. Emery
reviews.text: If cost is not an issue, maybe this company is for you. $1350.00 for two hours of work plus a few miscellaneous parts from the truck. $700 AN HOUR FOR A PLUMBER THAT THE OWNER CONSIDERS A VALUE. Initially charged $1500 until I questioned the charges! Yes, I approved the estimate and the work seemed to be done properly, but was shocked at the price and in a bind. I should have said No. These large companies with fleets of vehicles have a lot of overhead and mouths to feed. Item codes are used to bid a job versus the actual parts/labor is really takes. My simple P-trap repair? $150.00 -- 20 minutes of time and the plumber was already here doing other work. The next time we need a plumber, we're supporting the small independent guys.

plumbers.name: Grassroots Plumbing
plumbers.address: 8477 GA-92 Suite 200, Woodstock, GA 30189, USA

reviews.author: Andrew Cuppia
reviews.text: First time using Grassroots Plumbing but will not be the last for sure.  From the initial call to the completion of the two projects, Grassroots Plumbing's staff and plumbers were outstanding.  We needed to move our grill's gas line from one side of the patio to the other side, involving trenching around the patio and having the new end to be able to be placed in a new concrete pad when poured.  Matthew and Taylor were so polite, friendly, meticulous and respectful of our property, down to the small stones that we had along the other side of the patio for improved drainage.  They removed all of the stones and when done with the trench work, they carefully put all of the stones back in place.  Our tankless water heater was also flushed out while they were here.  Grassroots Plumbing prices were very competitive on top of this great service.  Simply very impressed with the entire organization.  Their culture and service are world class.  I highly recommend that you give them a try for any plumbing need that you might have.

reviews.author: Patrick Bartlett
reviews.text:
This family-run company completely removed all the anxiety from plumbing. From the first interaction, the customer experience was outstanding—professional, responsive, and clear every step of the way. They showed up exactly when they said they would, communicated exceptionally well, and were upfront and fair with pricing.

They fixed our main drain line, quickly found the source of the clog, handled the concrete work flawlessly, and removed roots near the city tap. On top of that, they added preventative solutions to make sure this never happens again, which gave us real peace of mind.

Huge credit to Matt and Jason, along with Maddox, Logan, and Byron—every single person was knowledgeable, respectful, and clearly takes pride in their work. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Erika Wuerzner
reviews.text:
After going through many years of various faceless, Giant Corporate companies, we have found a gem.   The scheduling is responsive and reasonable and the work is neat as a pin.

The interactions with the scheduler were pleasant and efficient and the master plumber also reaches out ahead of the appointment to address any concerns and to get a better idea of the issues at hand.

Our plumber, Matt, was timely, professional, and his work was extremely neat.   He spoke to us as equals and we were able to talk through various options and what those price levels would look like.  We were given a choice of the recommendations and given sound advice - but zero pressure to choose one option over another.

We initially had Matt out to take care of corroded drain pipe that was leaking water from our tub,  he took out all the old galvanized pipe and replaced it - neatly - with new pvc.  he also did an inspection of our plumbing as part of the membership perks and even scoped out our sewer line - where he was the first plumber to do so!  After scoping the line he found root intrusion - which left un addressed could wreak havoc on the sewer line and cause sewage to back up into the home.

After running through our options, we ended up replacing the line.  The quote was fair for the amount of work that needed to be done - they even had to jack hammer through the bedrock in the yard to seat the new line - which they guarantee now - and even installed a pressure relief valve so if there is ever a backup or issue it will not enter the home, but release outside.

Great, local, and professional.  So glad to have found a quality small business to support that treats you right.

reviews.author: Krystal Ellis
reviews.text: I have hired Grassroots to help me with two projects and have been blown away by the craftsmanship and support of all. Byron and Maddox were the technicians who completed my most recent project. They ensured I felt comfortable with the work and provided a detailed walk thru of hat was needed, why, and a detailed recap at the end. Jacob was incredibly helpful with setting up the appointment and ensured that my project was addressed quickly and with incredible professionalism. Highly recommend hiring grassroots for all your plumbing needs and repairs!

reviews.author: Debbie Nack
reviews.text: I had a great experience with grassroots plumbing company. Landon arrived on time, was professional and courteous, and clearly explained what needed to be done. The work was completed efficiently and the issue was fixed properly. Everything was left clean and in good shape when he finished. I would definitely use them again and recommend them to anyone needing reliable plumbing services.

plumbers.name: Joe Lay & Sons Plumbing
plumbers.address: 110 Richwood Rd Suite A Suite A, Walton, KY 41094, USA

reviews.author: RM Bogard
reviews.text:
Our hot water heater went out Thanksgiving morning. We were happy with the work Joe Lay and Sons Plumbing did when it was installed, so they were our first call Friday morning 11/28.

After speaking with Daniel, he walked me through the steps to check to see if any warranty was left on the unit first. Unfortunately, there was not, but I appreciated the fact that he recommended doing that!

He gave me a price quote and got us scheduled for installation of the new unit on Monday 12/3. Billy and Brett arrived during the scheduled time period and got the unit installed promptly in a neat and clean manner.

(Fortunately) They discovered an issue with the flu not drafting gas fumes properly and we were not able to get the new unit in service. They referred us to a chimney company in the area to come out to assess the situation so we could take corrective action to get the unit safely in service.

The chimney company worked us into their schedule and were out on 12/3. Billy and Brett came by as well to make sure everything was getting addressed so we could get the new hot water heater in service safely. The problem was resolved and we were up running by the end of the day.

Our thanks to Billy, Brett, Daniel and the rest of the team at Joe Lay and Sons Plumbing for their patience, great customer service and excellent attention to detail that averted a tough situation from turning into a bad situation. Job well done!

reviews.author: Brandon Campbell
reviews.text: I started experiencing a leak underneath my 1st floor bathtub/shower into my basement last February. I went through my home warranty and got them scheduled to come out. Well after three visits - February, May & July, I'm still dealing with the same issue. Each time they were here I stressed not wanting a bandaid fix each time, but that's exactly what I got and why I'm still dealing with the issue today. Not sure if it's because I went through my home warranty or not, and that's why I received lackluster service, but I will definitely go through another service provider to get my issue fixed. And to top it off, I'm still being asked to pay a $150 deductible even though the issue still persists.

reviews.author: Bob Coppola
reviews.text: Joe Lay & Sons Plumbing was fantastic. They were easy to schedule quickly. They were on time and was able to fix our issues. There was a part they had to get, and was back the next day to complete the job. I will be using them for all of our plumbing needs, both at my business and at home.

reviews.author: Cathy Milner
reviews.text: I contacted Joe Lay & Sons to install a kitchen faucet. The guys were great-professional, friendly and very neat. They did a great job & even took the old faucet & packaging from new faucet to dispose of for me. I appreciated that.

reviews.author: Ben Lanich
reviews.text: Bill and Brett were out on 10/08 to replace our service line from our home to the street…a very big undertaking and investment for us. Bill and Brett showed up on time, worked very efficiently and clean…And they were done and gone within three hours! Great job! We will absolutely use Joe Lay and Sons for our future plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Ace Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning
plumbers.address: 3011 Academy Way, Sacramento, CA 95815, USA

reviews.author: Brogana M (Sunfrog)
reviews.text: We have a favorite plumber, but he's never available. We've used Ace Plumbing a few times now, & they have always gotten us on thier schedule super quick. This time we had a kitchen sink leak & then they quoted us such a good price for garbage disposal removal that we went ahead & had that done too. Job was done quickly with what seemed no problems or hassles-however, we had to have them come back out a few days later because the sink wasn't draining well. Upon closer inspection we found that 2 of the 5 holes of the sink strainer/basket grate (?) were blocked.Turns out the plastic/silicone (?) washer was mis-shapen (?) which resulted in it covering the drainage holes. They sent a (different) guy out & he fixed it in a few minutes.

reviews.author: andy kim
reviews.text:
Excellent service from technician Bee Xiong
during thermostat replacement and furnace maintenance. He was a lot of experience and knowledgeable and very efficient.
Everything that he inspected, necessary and
appropriate service. It was a pleasure dealing with him. I definitely next time call him again

reviews.author: Natascha Lee
reviews.text:
Yall, if YOU need any….I mean any HVAC service…call up ACE Heating & Plumbing and have COREY come out!!! This man is professional, EXTREMELY knowledgeable and SO very phenomenal at his job.

He educated me on maintenance that is needed. I had no idea about…honestly, you learn something new everyday!!! This is services you NEED….and honest GREAT professional service is what was provided and Corey did just that and even included my youngest son answering his questions too!!

You will be so grateful you booked & had ACE Plumbing service your home….doesnt your family deserve the BEST??? I know I am & will continue too!! Thank you ACE Plumbing, and a huge lovely thank you to Mr.Corey Lawson!!! Keep being AMAZING!!!!

reviews.author: Kyle Clark
reviews.text: Ace is a great company that I've used several times throughout the years. I found a leaky pipe today and called them at noon to get it scheduled and by 2:30 PM (same day) they came and the repair was completed! The Technicians Josh & Mario did a phenomenal job as usual!!! I wouldn't even consider a different contractor for my plumbing and HVAC needs.

reviews.author: Nick Lettini
reviews.text:
Nothing Like Starting a Work Week with a Plumbing Problem.
We had both our toilets back up this morning and went into panic mode.  Now to find someone to come out on an Emergancy Basis.  Ace Plumbing was recommended to me by my brother.
Ace Plumbing was able to get out this morning within an hour.
John Z came out and resolved the restriction in our pipes.
John Z was quick, efficient, and very clean.
Thank you Ace Plumbing & John.

plumbers.name: Prime Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 7000 Broadway Suite 205, Denver, CO 80221, USA

reviews.author: Mayra Nayeli Ballesteros
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Fernando. He was professional, respectful, and very knowledgeable. He took the time to explain everything clearly. You can tell he genuinely cares about his work and represents the company extremely well. It’s hard to find reliable service these days, but this experience definitely exceeded my expectations. I would highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing services.

reviews.author: Stella Fang
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Prime Plumbing and Heating! They were recommended to me when I was back home in Colorado. The Prime team was very professional in helping me troubleshoot, and diagnosed my issue quickly. I felt well taken care of!

reviews.author: Sarah Doris
reviews.text:
I work for a property management company downtown, and I'm not sure how we connected with Prime Plumbing, but I'm glad we did.

Each interaction has been nothing short of professional, urgent, and kind. Not only has Megan been great at being responsive, she's currently responding to be on the weekend, to a non-urgent situation (in the middle of the AFC championship game to add) and does a great job! Always so helpful!

Fernando came out this weekend to do a cast iron pipe replacement and he texted me when on the way, communicated with me in between, and told me when the job was completed. A skill many vendors lack, simple communication.

Then he found an additional crack in another pipe, which, if it wouldn't have been caught, it would have been more money out of the HOA's pocket and a possible insurance claim.

Thank you both for your outstanding service! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Z Z
reviews.text: I got their name from Tom Martino's referral list for a leak in my 5 year old water heater, so I expect to pay a premium for a vetted company. The initial communication was professional and good, and the work they did was was fine but here are my issues with this company: they quoted me $2,300 to fix it. I felt like they did not have my best interest in mind and were just trying to extract the most amount of money possible. I explained I was doing a renovation soon so wanted the most cost effective fix. The repairman said it was all recommended. I pushed back on at least installing a drain pan because I have no drain in my floor so a shallow pan would be useless for any major leak. That dropped it $500. I had an issue after he left with no hot water to my kitchen sink - due to him flushing the heater and it loosening corrosion. When it wasn't clear given an annoying text exchange with Prime after hours whether they were going to come back and help me, I called two other independent plumbers. Those plumbers told me I was overcharged and one said for only a little more, they could have given me a whole new heater with warranty. (Prime did end up coming out the next day to get my kitchen sink hot water working at no additional cost. Although I felt dismissed as when I was first discussing their initial quote, I asked whether the benefits of a flush outweighed the risk of galvanic flaking and was assured it was the recommended thing to do.) I did call Prime first before writing this review as they request you do for complaints. I spoke with a nice woman who listened empathetically but there wasn't any follow up after that.

reviews.author: Linda Sauer
reviews.text: Prime Plumbing and Heating exceeded my expectations when they sent Trevor to figure out what led to an alarming leak under our kitchen sink.  Trevor communicated professionally with my husband and I throughout the entire process, and so we felt very comfortable with his diagnosis, and the solution he provided was affordable as well. He fixed the problem same-day, and while he was very efficient, we could tell he was also providing top-quality care in everything he did.  We definitely will be calling them again if we have any future plumbing/heating needs!

plumbers.name: Killeen Plumbing Company
plumbers.address: 673 Dover Center Rd, Westlake, OH 44145, USA

reviews.author: Nicole Fuerst
reviews.text: HIGHLY recommend Killeen! If you are looking for a honest, hardworking and fair priced team to use definitely go with Killeen! The team we had was Andrew S and Matt. They kept us informed along the way because the work they did was a pretty large job and they were AWESOME! I can’t say enough good things about these guys and the ladies in the office as well! Thank you for helping our family during this stressful time and making it easier! We appreciate you guys!

reviews.author: Danielle Summers
reviews.text:
We had a great experience with this plumbing company! They came out to fix our garbage disposal, repair a leaking kitchen sink, and take care of a few other small issues around the house. Everything was handled efficiently and professionally.
Caleb was our technician, and he was absolutely wonderful. He explained everything clearly, walked us through what needed to be done, and patiently answered all of our questions. It’s such a relief to work with someone who is knowledgeable, honest, and takes the time to make sure you understand the process.
The work was completed thoroughly, and everything is running perfectly now. We truly appreciate the excellent service and will definitely be using them again in the future. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nick Verikakis
reviews.text:
Regarding our recent plumbing installation of a Backflow device, we are glad to report that we are extremely happy working with everyone at Killen Plumbing Company, especially with Patrick, Allice, Stephanie, Lilie and Kim.

As you know, this is our first time doing business with your company. So, on behalf of all of us here at the Edgecliff Apartments, (V-Brothers’ Properties LLC), I want to express our thanks to everyone at Killeen Plumbing Company, starting with receiving our initial quote from Patrick to a follow-up from your office representatives to your site technicians. You have all of you not only met but you have exceeded our expectations. We are extremely happy with your prompt response, efficiency, knowledge, professionalism and cleanliness for all work we have requested. Anytime we need help in the future, we now know who to call.

Also, if you ever need any recommendation, we would be glad to provide for anyone who asks

reviews.author: Susan Hemphill
reviews.text: I had a great experience using Killeen plumbing.  Cylis was wonderful.  He called ahead, was prompt with a fair estimate and arrived on time to do the work as planned.  He answered all my questions politely, put covers on his shoes when he came in the house and kept the work areas clean.  The jobs were done very well and I am happy my neighbor recommended them.  I will definitely call them again when I need any plumbing work done.  I had new faucets put in in the basement and bathroom that also needed new pipes and shutoff valves.

reviews.author: Sarah Wentz
reviews.text: We had our furnace go out and a pipe burst in our leased building. Killeen Plumbing was recommended by a friend and now I'm happy to say I finally have a reliable plumber! They were there within 2 hours on the coldest day we have had. Diagnosed the problem spot and had it repaired in less than 30 minutes. Very reasonably priced and the guys were really nice. Thank you again for the great customer service.

plumbers.name: Modern Heating & Plumbing Co.
plumbers.address: 1949 Swanson Ct, Gurnee, IL 60031, USA

reviews.author: David Galbo
reviews.text: Albert and Casey just finished installing the new Trane furnace and A/C unit that we purchased from Modern.  They both worked very hard to complete the job, were very professional, friendly and pleasant to work with.  They did a great job, cleaned up after themselves, and were considerate of our home and yard during the entire process. Great job guys and thank you Modern Heating & Plumbing!

reviews.author: Lois Hamann
reviews.text: Fast response to our needs, from the first call. Setting up schedule, having the technicians come out and assess the damages. They had to install a complete new boiler system, and hot water heater, (due to frozen pipes and flooded basement the old system was unable to be repaired.) It was a pleasure to do business with this entire group of employees and service staff. They made a difficult situation have a positive outcome.  Thankyou.

reviews.author: Ellen Lindal
reviews.text: Modern Heating came to my home within two hours of my initial call. Gela, the serviceman was terrific. He diagnosed the problem quickly. He provided a temporary fix while he went and got the needed replacement part. Part installed, he went on to provide maintenance for the furnace. Great service-I’ll be using them in the future.

reviews.author: Kathy Keating
reviews.text:
Herman is an outstanding technician. We had a service call because our air conditioner unit was blowing air but not cooling the house. After a thorough inspection of our 24-year-old unit he explained, in layman's terms, that it would take at least a $1,000, if not more, to repair it. He explained the life cycle of the unit and the continued expense it will take to maintain it. He gave us options to replace the unit and explained the differences in brands and gave his personal experience with these units.
We decided to buy a new A/C with Modern Heating and Plumbing. Herman returned to our house with a portable air conditioner to use while we wait for installation, which will be during the holiday weekend.
We cannot say enough wonderful and thoughtful things about Herman. He is truly an asset to this company.

reviews.author: Chris Lynch
reviews.text: Great experience from start to finish. I had an issue with the ignitor on my tankless water heater. Contacted Monday morning and received a fast response. Technician was scheduled to be my house between 12-4. Tech got to the house at 1220. The tech identified the problem in less than 15 min, and had it fixed in another 15 min. Fantastic service, would work with again.

plumbers.name: Nearby Plumbing
plumbers.address: 8204 Wilson St, Midvale, UT 84047, USA

reviews.author: Nichole L.S.
reviews.text: Outstanding customer service! Kris and Joe were absolutely phenomenal. They truly went above and beyond for our family, and it’s so rare to feel genuinely cared for these days. After doing a lot of research, we found their pricing to be extremely fair and affordable. We are so grateful we found them—they truly feel like family. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Steve Phillips
reviews.text: Nearby Plumbing provided excellent service when fixing my water heater. Khris, and the rest of the team who helped me out were professional, knowledgeable, and got the job done quickly. They also helped me navigate the manufacturer's warranty, making the entire replacement process smooth and stress-free. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Ronak Chauhan
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with Joey from Nearby Plumbing. My water heater failed right before Christmas, and I was worried about being without hot water for the holidays. Joey prioritized my job and managed to install a brand-new tankless water heater in a single day. Not only was he incredibly fast and professional, but he also gave me a very fair and competitive rate. It’s rare to find such reliable service during the busy holiday season. Highly recommend Joey for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Cristian Torres
reviews.text: Kris and Joe did a great job with the installation! Happy with the new water heater, way overdo! Highly suggest to enter their water heater giveaway. Will be reaching out to Nearby plumbing for any other plumbing issues I run into. Thanks again for your service!

reviews.author: Bryce Webb
reviews.text: Kris, from nearby plumbing, was extremely professional. He was the one that came out for my estimate, and was very thorough and easy to discuss things with. When he came back out for the service, he did an excellent job and I was very happy with his work.

plumbers.name: Fairway Plumbing, LLC
plumbers.address: 1320 Arrow Point Dr Surambirite 501 #TW137, Cedar Park, TX 78613, USA

reviews.author: Dale
reviews.text: My water heater was not functioning properly so I called Fairway. I have some past experience with water heaters so I had a pretty good idea that it was going to need to be replaced. They sent Tyler and Wyatt out to take care of my problem. They confirmed  my suspicions and told me exactly what they were going to do and exactly what it was going to cost. The guys were knowledgeable, professional, and efficient! They left the place exactly as they found it leaving no mess behind! Their price was $400 below my other quote as well. The company is honest and upfront about everything. I would highly recommend them to anyone who needs plumbing work!

reviews.author: Penny Hagen
reviews.text: They didn't get to my house until almost 4 p.m.  Needed additional materials they had to go and purchase.  Didn't get back until 5 p.m.  Then they proceeded to tell me that the pressure valve at the meter was running too high and would have to be replaced at the my cost of $1,175.00.  If I didn't allow them to replace it, no work would be guaranteed.  Being a widow, I had no idea if this was the truth so I had no choice but to pay the additional costs.  What started out as a quote of $2.650 ended up at nearly $4,000.00.  They still haven't finished installing some pipe that they have to come back for but since it was almost 11 p.m. I told them they would have to come back another day.

reviews.author: Ali & Franco Lorenzi
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Highly recommend Fairway Plumbing. We were referred by David Massad, and the service was exceptional. Wilma Huggins runs a great company, and her employee Tyler truly went above and beyond.

What started as one issue turned into three broken pipes causing a major leak. Tyler worked from 4 PM until 7 PM, even bringing out a large star light to finish the job after dark. He explained everything clearly to both my husband and me while literally elbow-deep in mud fixing the problem.

Professional, thorough, and honest—Fairway Plumbing is who we’ll call again.

reviews.author: John Deming
reviews.text: I’ve hired plumbers all over the word from New Zealand to Japan. Fairway guys are the best ever. Competent, efficient and responsive. Such a relief to know that a critical system we cannot live without is in their hands.

reviews.author: Michele McDermott
reviews.text: Cliff and Tyler replaced my old water heater with a tankless heater and installed a new gas line all in one day. Professional, efficient and exactly what I needed. Definitely recommend Fairway Plumbing.

plumbers.name: Chris's Plumbing Service
plumbers.address: 6404 US-301, Riverview, FL 33578, USA

reviews.author: Sandy Faris
reviews.text: We called Chris Plumbing to re-pipe our airbnb. Monty came out to look at the job and gave an estimate right away. We scheduled the work and the crew that came out was phenomenal. I didn't get their names but they really knew what they were doing. They were on time and worked efficiently. They cleaned up after the job and left everything as they found it. We had used them six months ago to run water and a septic line to a trailer and they also did a fantastic job then. It's nice to Find a company that is honest and does a good job.

reviews.author: Linay Sammarco
reviews.text: Chris’s plumbing is the best in the business. They are responsive and follow up quickly. Very clean and detailed oriented with great customer service, that went a long way. I will definitely refer anyone to Chris’s Plumbing because they go above and beyond their call of duty and have a high level of professionalism. Thank you.

reviews.author: Ginny Parsons
reviews.text: We called Chris's Plumbing Service to take care of two very clogged toilets in our home. Todd came out on a Saturday morning and quickly took care of the problem. In addition, he removed (without my asking) scratches on the porcelain in both bowls that I had made when trying to work on the clogs myself. Todd was prompt, professional, went above and beyond, and was very nice. The final cost was $175 less than we had been quoted in advance of the service call! I don't often need the services of a plumber, but, when I do in the future, I'll definitely call Chris's Plumbing Service. I highly recommend them. Give them a call the next time you need a plumber. You'll be so glad you did!

reviews.author: Bill Powell
reviews.text: Cameron Stone did an awesome job replacing the cartridge in our master shower.  It definitely wasn’t easy removing it but he got it out and the new one in.  Really knew his stuff and found a way to make it happen.  Thx Cameron for the great job and we can shower again.

reviews.author: Shawn Jones
reviews.text: Had some faint sewer gas smells in my home and thought I'd need a smoke test to determine the source. Carlos and his team mate suspected it was from the toilets because they were able to be moved slightly. To prevent incurring the extra expense of a smoke test, Carlos recommended reseating the toilets to see if this would solve the issue first. The repair was quick, clean and well done. Five stars honestly isn't enough for these guys. Carlos embodies what a skilled tradesman is. He was thorough, respectful, a great communicator and has the heart of a teacher. If you value being taught by professionals with high standards, you'll want Carlos on the job.

plumbers.name: Doctor Drips Plumbing - Nashville
plumbers.address: 1101 Davidson St, Nashville, TN 37206, USA

reviews.author: Korry Rahn
reviews.text:
Excellent Service from Doctor Drips – Highly Recommend!

Doctor Drips (Jance) did an outstanding job replacing my hot water heater. From start to finish, he was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly courteous. He quickly provided a fair and clear quote, offered great recommendations, and showed up right on time. The installation was done efficiently and with great attention to detail. It’s refreshing to work with someone who takes pride in their work and truly cares about customer satisfaction.

I highly recommend Jance and Doctor Drips for any plumbing needs – you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Amos Maley
reviews.text: When a 30 minute consultation and shower repair job turned into a 9.5 hour tankless water heater and gas line replacement job, Jance and his team kept us informed every step of the way and just kept working until the project was done.  I'll trust them to do all of our plumbing and related work from now on.  They were so easy to work with too!

reviews.author: Anna A Clinton
reviews.text:
We cannot say enough good things about everyone at Doctor Drips — especially Ronnie and Wyatt. Working on a historic home built in 1920 requires experience, patience, and problem-solving skills, and they brought all of that and more.

Ronnie was incredibly knowledgeable, punctual, and respectful of our home throughout our bathroom addition and bedroom renovation. The whole team took the challenging aspects of plumbing in an older house and navigated all of the quirks with confidence and care.

What really stood out, though, was how kind and thoughtful they were — always friendly to our family (and our dog!) and meticulous in their work. It’s rare to find tradespeople who combine technical expertise with such a great attitude. We felt completely confident having them in our home and would recommend Doctor Drips without hesitation.

reviews.author: Marty Yurjevich
reviews.text: Dr Drips (Jance and Robbie and Wyatt) did a great job fixing our toilet and Replumbing our entire house.  We had defective PEX by Nibco and they removed it with all new PEX-A.   They did an excellent job and worked to minute damage to our home.  They cleaned up very well and respected our home.  Jance and Robbie are outstanding plumbers.  Highly recommend if you have plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Valerie Cleaves
reviews.text:
Dr Drips provided excellent, efficient, and educational service! Robbie came prepared with shoe covers and took them off when he needed to go back and forth from inside to out.

Issue resolved in a transparent and non-complicated communication style.

I recommend Dr Drips to anyone needing efficient, thorough, and educational service! Refreshing!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 5493 E Olive Ave, Fresno, CA 93727, USA

reviews.author: Elizabeth Hall
reviews.text: I was very pleased with how quick they were able to come out and assess the situation. They took the time to explain everything in detail and go over pricing and gave me the opportunity to decide what to do. They handled everything in a timely and professional manner. Both Andrew and Jesus were very polite, and professional gentleman. I will certainly call Roto-Rooter again. Big thanks!

reviews.author: Stacey Martin
reviews.text:
It was an after hours emergency situation where we had no toilets or water use due to a tree root entanglement that resulted in a back up and blockage of our line. James F. showed up and quickly assessed the situation and cleared the line making it possible to use our water until they could fix everything a couple days later. He set everything in motion and was so comforting and so knowledgeable that I felt confident in his ability to efficiently do a quality repair. I’m so glad I chose to go with this company. It was a costly fix but it was so much less than the company I’d gone with previously and the most important part was it was done right and they stand by their work and James F. was reassuring, extremely helpful and never made me feel like he wasn’t 100% dedicated to taking care of my worries and addressing my endless questions. He provided me with a plan to execute solutions so that this could be resolved in the quickest, most cost effective way possible. He is the biggest asset this company and he was the most appreciated part of this process. He is also the reason they now have me as a customer for life. Thank you from the bottom of my heart to James A. And Silvestre P., for doing backbreaking work in record time!  And a big shout out to the entire crew for getting to the “root” of the problem quickly with a smile!  Thanks to:
James F., Silvestre P., Jonathan H., and James A. and their Service manager Brad. It was a pleasure guys and thanks again Roto-Rooter. Stacey Martin, Madera, CA.

reviews.author: Karen Gaetos
reviews.text: They responded to my appointment request quickly and got right on it. They also suggested different options which I am grateful for because I know nothing about plumbing. My technician Michael was very friendly and knowledgeable and did a quick and most of all clean job. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sandy Jackson
reviews.text: We had a Saturday emergency of a clogged toilet.  I contacted Roto Router and thier Tech Sammy was here within a hour.  Her was one of the best professionals we have had in our home, very efficient and did not give up because our fix was a little complicated.  He helped to make sure the costs did not get out of hand and cleaned up really well before he left.  Roto Rooter as a company appears to do well at hiring and retaining great employees.  His project Manager Loreto who came out to assist was also very courteous, professional and knowledgeable.  I have great confidence that this repair was done right.

reviews.author: S Q
reviews.text: I had a clogged toilet and called Roto-Rooter. Jahari and Jamie technicians came to my home. They are very professional. pleasant and accommodating. They have patience and are knowledgeable in their field.  They explained everything thoroughly.  They were also very thoughtful wearing booties in the house and cleaning up after their work.  They also have manners! I would recommend these technicians. Andrew the supervisor was also very thoughtful and accommodating.  If you have problem with pipes don't hesitate to call Roto Rooter Fresno.

plumbers.name: JCB Plumbing, LLC
plumbers.address: 1099 Brown St STE 201, Wauconda, IL 60084, USA

reviews.author: Judy Billings
reviews.text: Roger Tinajero made sure everything was working well—and gave us next steps, if there is more trouble with the sewer backup, and for peace of mind.  Great work.  He is thorough and personable.

reviews.author: Michael Dahlgren
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with JCB Plumbing. Our water heater went out, and they handled the replacement quickly and professionally.

Roger did an awesome job! He was efficient, knowledgeable, and made sure everything was running perfectly before he left.

reviews.author: Jennifer Gallien
reviews.text: Outstanding service from JCB Plumbing! I was super nervous calling a plumber for a sudden leak coming from our guest bathroom and falling through our kitchen ceiling.  I called JCB plumbing because of the many positive reviews that I found on Facebook and Google.  What a great decision! This company answered right away and scheduled a call within two hours that same day. Our service technician, Jake, was extremely knowledgeable, honest, and professional. Jake explained everything in detail so that I understood what was broken and what needed to be fixed.  He was truly kind and honest.  I felt that he was there to help, rather than worrying about being taken advantage of with quotes of unnecessary work.  Thank you, Jake!! Fair pricing and high-quality work. Highly recommend to anyone needing a reliable plumber! Thank you, JCB Plumbing.  We will make sure to spread the word!!!

reviews.author: Abigail Cornish
reviews.text: I greatly appreciated JCB Plumbing’s same day service.  The plumber was professional, thorough and friendly.  He took his time to explain everything before and after.  The hot water heater was fixed quickly with no disruptions, and the service charge was reasonable. I recommend them for their expertise, friendliness and quick response time.

reviews.author: Samantha Turzynski
reviews.text:
JCB Plumbing really did a quality job and they are totally a reputable company!  I had a problem with my plumbing not draining and Kyle spent hours assessing the issue.  It was unfortunately an outdoor drainage issue!  The entire team was respectful of my home, my landscaping and me!  I never felt uncomfortable or like I was being gouged.  I added the replacement of the water heater while they were there for the sewer and everything was done at the same time, by different plumbers!  The entire crew worked to finish the jobs, a real testament to the team work!  No detail was too small for the crew members to help each other with, including the resolution!

Thank you to the entire team for doing a fantastic job and for being so respectful of my home!

plumbers.name: Greer Plumbing & Water Heater Repair
plumbers.address: 3017 Mountain Rd, Pasadena, MD 21122, USA

reviews.author: Eric Armer
reviews.text: Alex and his team maintained a professional work relationship regardless of the obstacles they encountered during the entire Job. Them members were respectful during the entire job. Alex made sure that we always knew exactly what the goals for the day was. The team represented Greer Water works at all times. They went out of their way to do everything they could to minimize the impact of the work at hand especially safety first. Their tenacity paid off. The job was completed in a masterful professional way. We appreciate you arranging for the rebar and concrete pour.   Thank you for a grate repair.

reviews.author: Jeana Osborne
reviews.text: Dominic & the team at Greer were great! We were working with another contractor to finish our basement on a strict timeline and Dominic completed the plumbing for the bathroom so efficiently. We were able to tell him exactly where we wanted things to go and he delivered. Once the contractors were finished drywall, he came back to set the toilet & sink. We love the final look and are happy with the services provided by Greer!

reviews.author: Ron Schreiber
reviews.text: This is a review for the second job Greer plumbing and waterworks has done for me. This was a complicated, challenging project for a residential home. My cast steel main line drain ran directly under the mudroom floor. Which happened to be concrete.. Matt and his crews were very professional. The camera guy came and they scoped and checked the pipe to make sure it needed replacing. They also traced the pipe so they knew exactly were the pipe was. It took a 4 person crew 2 days to replace the old cast pipe which was about 5’ underground. They cleaned up when they were done, the price was reasonable, and the follow up was great. We found out one of the old connections had started leaking a few days after the job was completed. Matt had a technician here the following morning to fix that. I would say that if you have a plumbing issue, no matter how big or how small it is. Give Greer plumbing a call for a quote. Because of how great they handled 2 plumbing issues for me, I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Dustin Richardson
reviews.text:
Greer Water Works — Always Here for You
Imagine putting in the work day after day, but the calls never stop — and that’s okay, because helping our community is what they’re about. Today’s goal: get this family’s heater back up and running with no leaks and peace of mind restored. At Greer Water Works, we’re there for your needs anytime, any day — even if it means getting up at 6:30 on a Saturday. That’s what dedication looks like.Justin & Brian where the most professional trades  I work with in a while make sure they had carpet covered with hard cardboard, roll out paper and plastic not a drip of water got on our carpet Had water within two hours could not be more happier about our experience at Greer waterworks thanks to Justin and Brian!!

reviews.author: cha scott
reviews.text:
Horrible service. Came out to repair a toilet clog, which was not repaired. When I called them back to come back to fix it, they scheduled an appointment. They cancelled on the day of after advising a text would be there. We waited for almost 5 hours with zero communication. Keep in mind they sent me a $375 bill which I would pay, if the issue was corrected. Someone named Sean who refused to give me his last name, pretty much told me if they come out again, they are going to charge me again. Yes, I will be notifying BBB because who says the work is not under warranty when the issue comes back 2 days later? I could go on but I just had surgery on my heart and it’s not worth risking  my health.

Yes I told SEAN this info but he was extremely RUDE.

plumbers.name: Rooter Hero Plumbing & Air of Elk Grove
plumbers.address: 9245 Laguna Springs Dr Suite 200A, Elk Grove, CA 95758, USA

reviews.author: Elsa Rodriguez
reviews.text:
I’m not usually one to leave reviews, but this experience truly deserves recognition. There’s nothing I value more in a company than exceptional customer service, and my recent encounter reinforced that belief.

Devaun Welch came to my home on Saturday evening, even after his shift had officially ended. He arrived promptly and went straight to work on the toilet pipe issue I was experiencing. Devaun proved to be incredibly professional and efficient, treating the problem with the seriousness it warranted. His respectful demeanor and extensive knowledge were impressive and highlighted the high standards that Rooter Engineering upholds.

I'm genuinely thankful I found this service, and I feel compelled to share my experience for anyone out there seeking reliable help. Devaun conducted a thorough inspection of the plumbing system and was able to pinpoint the underlying issue quickly. He was attentive and took the time to listen to my concerns, ensuring that I felt heard and understood. Before he left, he made certain that everything was resolved to my satisfaction. I truly appreciate the care and effort he and the team put into making sure the situation was addressed properly. This level of dedication has not only solved my problem but also built a strong sense of trust in their services.
~ Thanks so much yal!!!

reviews.author: Jess Ward
reviews.text: The AI answering service asked if I was there 10 times. I hung up. Apparently there are no humans available to speak with.

reviews.author: Niko
reviews.text: Shane came on short notice, same day and did a great job! After the inspection he gave us a thorough explanation of the issues that needed to be fixed and additional reccomendations. We were able to pick which services we wanted based on the information he provided. After, he did an additional walk through to make sure everything was working properly again and to ensurr nothing was over looked. I would definitely request for his help again!

reviews.author: Kayla Walker
reviews.text: Jed Beltran is absolutely wonderful!! I would recommend him to anyone needing plumbing assistance!! We had a shower/bathtub clog, and though we are on a septic tank property he was able to assist us with our issue. He was very thorough and knowledgeable, and he is an extremely hard worker. He cleared our clog, and even educated us on our pipes and our issues! He informed us on how our cast iron pipes catch easier than most, and after clearing our issue he was even knowledgeable enough to know what was a recent clog, and what may be attributed to previous home owners. Thanks Jed! He is seriously the best! Your company should seriously reward this guys for absolutely exceptional service!!!

reviews.author: Dianne Castor
reviews.text: Jed from Rooter Hero Plumbing was very professional and pleasant.  For my scheduled appointment, he called early to let me know he would arrive in 15-20 minutes.   He arrived promptly and told me the cost for the work before  proceeding.  It was a bit pricey even with a coupon.  I agreed and  he quickly went to work.  I was pleased the with the service provided, water heater flushed.  Jed said there was quite a bit of sediment collected.  He recommended flushing be done every 1 to 2 years. Job well done but I recommend calling around for the price that is agreeable to you.  In the long run, regular flushing preserves the life of the water heater and spares the expense of buying a new one.

plumbers.name: Vessels Plumbing & Services Inc
plumbers.address: 1002 Flat Rock Rd, Louisville, KY 40245, USA

reviews.author: John Ervin
reviews.text: Another excellent job by Vessels. Have been a repeat customer for years. Latest project was updating plumbing for a first floor bath and remodeling the shower in the process. Results speak for themselves!

reviews.author: Tony Tricase
reviews.text: Wonderful service! Great follow up with me and our tenant. They have earned my business in the future because if their honesty and willingness to explain and help fit us in their busy schedule. I’d ad an extra star if I could for Shelly who was ready to answer any questions I had along the way.

reviews.author: ADRIANNE WRIGHT
reviews.text: I had a gas leak with my furnace and was referred to Vessels by a coworker; and I must say, I’m genuinely thankful for that recommendation.  Nick and Jaylen were kind, knowledgeable and informative in letting me know of the process step by step, until their job was done…and that’s important for someone like me.  I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ethel Bragg
reviews.text:
I really appreciate Leaha and Justin for working with me . They are really customer service excellence! They worked with me practically held my hands during this trying time of having my entire plumbing system underneath my home . There no dig process is highly impressive and saved my home from being...basically chopped in half just to replace the old pipes...this digless  process is a true home owners life saver.
Thanks again and GOD BLESS both of you made me feel like a true friend helping me and not some cold sales lead out to get some money...Tom Drexel can take a page from your customer care book!!! 😀 I wish you all at Vessels Plumbing and very merry Christmas and a Happy New Year 😊

reviews.author: Christina Chesnut
reviews.text: Originally gave a 3 star but after speaking with Tanya in scheduling, I changed to 4. Ultimately, it was more of a communication breakdown than lack of a quality inspection. I appreciated that they were willing to talk it through and would use them again in the future. I did also appreciate that they were able to get me in the same day I called.

reviews.author: Cincinnati Phung
reviews.text: They offered the best deal for the service  by value of pricing. $265 for drain cleaning only. I didn't want the camera service since it would cost $300 something more. The technician was really nice and could offer a detailed explanation of plausible causes of blockage. I would recommend and refer.

reviews.author: Willy Nix
reviews.text: I called for assistance with installing a new kitchen faucet. I called Rapid First Plumbing and spoke to kathy. she said she would send a technician. 20 minutes later Izaac arrived and took care of the problem. He had it done in less than thirty minutes. Great job. My wife and I are very happy. Great company.

reviews.author: Angel McLean
reviews.text: Travis was great!  He arrived and was respectful and efficient.  Very clear about what was causing my issue (kitchen sink backed up and not draining).  He provided the options and proceeded with my selection.  He also checked other items while he was doing the work and made some recommendations.  Highly recommend!  Thank you!

reviews.author: Darren DeAnda
reviews.text: Rapid First has been a great company to work with.  They have a great team and the best is Steven.  I highly recommend working with him.  I will go back to work with Steven for all my plumbing needs. I got 3 bids and they were the best price.  I was happy with them in all aspects.

reviews.author: Tammie Browning
reviews.text:
I manage an apartment community in Fair Oaks and we’ve been recently using Rapid First Plumbing and have been fortunate to have Jeremy, their very skilled plumber save us from a few issues. He is always professional, very knowledgeable and completes the job with a smile.
Their office staff when you call in for service is always pleasant and quick to respond!
And I like that they are very good at communicating on arrival times.
I would refer Rapid First Plumbing to anyone… And ask for Jeremy!

reviews.author: Billy Klercker
reviews.text: Working with Cooper Plumbing was by far the best expierience I’ve ever had dealing with any contractor. They’re communication was quick, the availability was amazing, from initial contact/estimate and work completions was less than 72 hours. I was very happy with the price as well. Work looks good and so far functions as it should. His crew was friendly and cleaned up after themselves. Couldn’t have hoped for better. Thank you cooper plumbing.

reviews.author: Samuel London
reviews.text: Absolutely Fantastic Company to do business with. Did a commercial sewer tap and line install for me at American Valor Realty. Tim called regularly to update me through the permitting and exactly what to expect; plus offered a great price. This is the kind of local business I want to work with for years to come. Quick, professional, reasonable, and produced a quality job in a super quick turnaround once on site. Thank you

reviews.author: Monica Harlow
reviews.text:
Justin and Logan were great!  we had both our toilets replaced, and they did a nice clean job, were super friendly and very efficient! I have called on Cooper Plumbing before, including getting our water heater up to code, adding an outdoor water faucet, and replacing the water valve behind the refrigerator.  Always consistent and very experienced!
We will definitely call them on our next project. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Dennis Cooper
reviews.text: Cooper Plumbing was on time. My plumber technician Dwayne was very nice to deal with. He probably could have got job done a little faster, but my old water heater refused to drain so we had to prod it a little. Removal & clean up when job was finished. Old water heater was just shy of 22 years.

reviews.author: Stephen
reviews.text: These guys did a great job!! They worked very hard, they were very knowledgeable, they took care of the demolition and pouring the concrete back and finishing it to match the rest. We will definitely be using Cooper Plumbing Company from here on out!!

plumbers.name: Drain Terrier
plumbers.address: 6515 S Allison St, Littleton, CO 80123, USA

reviews.author: Chaunamac R
reviews.text: I just had Drain Terrier replace my entire main line (65 feet) with two external washouts installed, and they were fantastic. Savannah (the owner) was absolutely wonderful—super honest, super knowledgeable, and the whole crew was just as great. Her dad Tracy and her brothers were all so professional and nice. They got everything done in just a couple of days, and even the city inspector said they did a top-notch job. On top of that, their quality and pricing can’t be beat—you really get the best of both. I highly, highly recommend them for any plumbing work, especially big projects like main line replacements. Thanks again, Savannah and team! 🙂

reviews.author: David Campagna
reviews.text: Tracy and Connor were on time with a call ahead. Really appreciate that. We reviewed options for the new water heater and they were back promptly with the new water heater. Installation was smooth and quick with the new water heater and surrounding area pristine when they were done. They were professional and polite and good with the dogs. Very happy with the experience.

reviews.author: Lucky Socks
reviews.text: They are just looking for a quick cash grab! They told me I needed to replace my almost new water heater. They are just looking for a quick cash grab from an unsuspecting homeowner who happens to be a woman. I went with a different company - a flush and a new thermostatic mixing valve later and everything is great. DON’T trust them!!!!!!!

reviews.author: D Wegelin
reviews.text:
We had a basement drain issue. House built in the 80's. Nice gentleman came out to address the issue. He attempted to remove the cleanout plug with a rather large set of channel locks?  Mind you that plug had probably never been removed from the cast iron pipe that it was in so it was pretty rusty. Then said he was afraid he would break it. Seeing that he was using a pair of channel locks I wanted him to stop using those. He tried to snake the line through the p-trap but said he couldn't get past the p-trap.

He called into the office and they recommended removing the appliances around it and ripping out the concrete, digging out the cast iron pipe and replacing it for a cost starting at over 5K. I told him I'll hold off on all that. The only problem we were having was we couldn't do a load of laundry without having that drain overflow. So he then presented me with a tablet that had pricing such as a Platinum, gold, & silver repair options which had technical jargon that I could not understand. He wanted me to choose anywhere from the $300+ option all the way to many thousands of dollars option. For just today's work??? What kind of pricing is that, and do they think people are that gullable? I picked the lowest option to pay and sent him on his way.

I bought a $9 - 3/4" drive socket and $30 drain auger at harbor freight, a $8 pipe socket off Amazon, grabbed my portable compressor and impact wrench and removed the plug in no time. Ran the drain auger and we are now good.

reviews.author: sheppards
reviews.text: My experience with Drain Terrier was amazing. They scheduled us quickly. The technician, Nick, was a great guy. Very friendly, thorough, explaining all the repairs needed and completed the repair in a timely fashion. ( my cats liked him alot too 😺)The prices were very reasonable as well. I'm very thankful that I reached out to them for our repair!!  I highly recommend Drain Terrier for any plumbing needs!!

plumbers.name: Reliant Plumbing - Georgetown
plumbers.address: 1616 Williams Dr Suite 101, Georgetown, TX 78628, USA

reviews.author: Anita T
reviews.text:
AVOID THIS COMPANY!!!

I want to give 0 stars but it makes me give 1 minimum  I paid a very high fee for an emergency repair.  The quality of the work was good, but after taking my credit card #, they asked my husband for payment and he gave them a check.  Then they proceeded to also charge my credit card twice TRIPLE charging us.  They notified me of the error, and said they would reverse the credit card charges but did not.  After over a DOZEN phone calls that were not returned, I finally gave up and contacted my credit card company who was able to reverse the charges.  I have never had anything like this happen in my decades of home ownership and I cannot emphasize enough NOT TO DO BUSINESS WITH THIS COMPANY!!!!

reviews.author: Fredy Valdez
reviews.text: They overcharged me for services. They came to check for a gas leak in my house. I thought they would have some expensive intricate way to find my leak, but no, they just used a bike pump and a diaphragm gauge and didn't even find the leak. Barely 2 hours of "work" and they charged me once 750$ then an additional 160$ the next day. For what, I have no clue. I never even received a quote or an invoice, and when I was told someone would call me to discuss pricing, no one ever did. I have tried calling several times, but it always sends me to an AI operator. When I called with a different phone number, I was able to reach an actual person who simply said I would get a call back, which I never did. Please rethink doing business with this company, as they will essentially scam you for your money. I will personally ensure those around me AVOID this company.

reviews.author: William
reviews.text: We had an emergency plumbing issue with no hot water with relatives coming to visit right before Christmas. Reliant put us on the schedule for the same day and determined that our 20yr old water heater was heavily calcified and needed replacement. Roman arrived in the late afternoon and worked hard for a few hours to uninstall our old unit and install a new 50gallon unit, replacing all the old fixtures and piping. He was detailed and thorough in walking us through the installation steps and even took a quick look at a few minor leaks in our house to make sure we didn't have any quiet money-sucking water leaks. Our hot water is back just in time for our holiday visitors.

reviews.author: Amber Thorp
reviews.text: Alan and Patrick arrived within two hours of us calling for an emergency with our sewer line on a Sunday.  They were quick, professional, and transparent about pricing. Would highly recommend Riliant and their team!

reviews.author: Mark and Irina Brn
reviews.text:
I didn't know if this is common or if they just didn't want my business. Only good part was they sent the scary quotes before coming out and charging me after hours fees for something they knew no reasonable person would pay. reviews.author: Lo
