They performed an excellent service, and I particularly appreciated that my presence was not required for them to complete the work. I received a comprehensive report and footage of my main drain line, which was thoroughly cleaned. I am very satisfied with their service and will certainly engage them again in the future.

reviews.author: elitemom77
reviews.text: We were very happy with Everflow plumbing. When we called with our problem, they had somebody out within an hour.  They made sure we knew prices before they even came out. Our technician was Jon and he was very polite and knew his stuff. He was very professional. While nobody wants to spend that kind of money, we were very appreciative of Everflow and Jon.  If we have another problem in the future, we will definitely call Everflow.

reviews.author: Emily Murphy
reviews.text: Jon was so great. City told me I had a leak that was costing me a huge water bill each month. Jon came in quickly found the leak and solved my problems.  Done at an affordable price. Thank you very much Jon and Everflow. Will recommend to friends and family.

reviews.author: Andrea Wohlever
reviews.text: While out of state for Thanksgiving I received a water leak detection from our City. When we got home we immediately contacted Everflow Plumbing as we used them a few months prior to install a water heater and, after a couple of other quotes, was extremely impressed with their pricing. Once again, we were met with a quick response, honest opinions, and very fair quote to fix a leak they found under my house. Jon was our plumber and he was very thorough, responsive, and explained every step along the way! I highly recommend Everflow for any plumbing issue! I promise you will be met with an amazing crew with honest and fair pricing!

reviews.author: Cathy Ecker
reviews.text: Steven took his time and installed the water filter perfectly. He Double checked his work every step of the way to make sure there were no leaks. Everflow is always our first choice whatever our plumbing needs might be.

plumbers.name: Drain Kings Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7517 John T White Rd, Fort Worth, TX 76120, USA

reviews.author: M Ryan Grandy
reviews.text:
If you are looking for the best plumber in Fort Worth, look no further than Desmond and the team at Drain Kings. We were facing a scary natural gas leak that wouldn't pass city inspection right before a major cold front. After a disappointing experience with another plumber, Drain Kings came in and completely outshined the competition.

They replaced our entire natural gas lines and got everything up to code so Atmos could restore our heat just in time. Huge thanks to Desmond, John, and Marcus for their professionalism and hard work. They are personable, respectful, and walk you through every step. For a fair price and top-tier quality, call Drain Kings. You won’t regret it!

reviews.author: Ryan Maxham
reviews.text: Desmond and DrainKings were the best. I should have started with him and probably would have saved myself the headache and some money. They helped me with my city citations, my water leak and fixed a year long break. I moved on to a gas project and they helped me there as well. All around great company!!

reviews.author: WonderFul Woman
reviews.text: I called Drain Kings for a leak under the kitchen sink and Desmond had availability within a couple of hours. Johnathan arrived early and assessed the problem and offered his expertise. Not only did Johnathan walk me through the process of the repair, he answered my questions and offered his professional opinion about leak detection devices. After he finished,  he doubled checked his work even showing how to use a device he recommended. I know I made the right call to Drain Kings and I wouldn't hesitate to call them again for my future needs.

reviews.author: Joy Laurice Johnson
reviews.text: Desmond and his entire team are amazing! My issue was identified and resolved immediately. Their knowledge, expertise and customer service is unmatched. At the sight of water or plumbing issue he should be the first call.

reviews.author: Tony Cube
reviews.text: Drain King is the best!!! Punctual, professional and meticulous!  I have used several plumbing companies in the past, but Drain King out performs all of them. They have my loyalty, and will use them exclusively. I have an older home that sometimes develops blockages in the pipe underneath due to its age and other issues. Drain King always does an amazing job!

reviews.author: alicia hyberger
reviews.text: I had the good fortune of winning a top of the line Toto toilet by entering a giveaway drawing I saw in an advertisement during the Super Bowl 2026! RHD Plumbing generously sent me a very expensive toilet complete with a bidet to my home and installed it today! I am impressed with their generosity to gift something so incredibly nice! I had the pleasure of working with the service manager, Lori and two friendly and professional technicians, Craig and Jason. I would highly recommend hiring RHD Plumbing and Remodeling! Absolutely stellar customer service. 5 stars all the way!!!

reviews.author: Aimee Granger Ziegahn
reviews.text: RHD did a fantastic job on our primary bathroom walk in shower. We needed to redo the plumbing and fixtures from a shower tower to a standard system. Other plumbers overcomplicated the process. Craig was extremely professional and knowledgeable,  and provided a fair quote. He worked with us on scheduling around other details, and Billy provided an efficient and clean install on time. Pricing was very fair, communication was excellent. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.text: Billy did an amazing job installing our new kitchen sink and faucet remodel! He was honest and upfront about the expectations if the sink would fit or not but he made it work with some creativity and it looks awesome! The cost was lower than I expected. Wait, when does that happen!? At RHD plumbing!

reviews.author: Leonardo Rodriguez
reviews.text: Had a plumber come out to replace my water softener and the experience was great from start to finish. Billy showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and did clean, professional work. The installation was done efficiently and everything was working perfectly before he left. Pricing was fair with no surprises. I’d definitely recommend Billy and will use this company again for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Rod Beadle
reviews.text: RHD has always been fast, courteous, responsive and efficient at diagnosing and fixing all of our plumbing issues. Lori is very friendly and ensures prompt call-backs. Most recently, Billy came to figure out why our soaking tub was leaking water. I thought it would be a major repair but he was able to find the issue and fix it quickly and at minimal cost!

plumbers.name: A&W Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 1420 E Algonquin Rd Box 385, Algonquin, IL 60102, USA

reviews.author: Tyler Sullivan
reviews.text: I highly recommend A&W Plumbing! Matt did a great job from start to finish! We were in need of a water softener and installation and Matt was able to come out on very short notice to help us determine the best solution for our home. With the limited space we had available, it was determined that our best option was to install the unit in the crawl space. He helped us choose a unit - making sure that it wouldn't be too tall while also fitting within our crawl space access point. Matt's attention to detail and craftsmanship was exactly what the job called for. I am extremely pleased with the results and look forward to working with him again for any and all of my future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: J Schmidt
reviews.text:
Called Matt on Saturday, found my water heater was leaking pretty bad.  He swung bye on Sunday and confirmed the tank was compromised and that we'd need to wait until Monday to replace.

Gave me a call at 7:30 am first thing with a quote, price was amazing, well under quotes I got from other larger plumbing companies.  He showed up around 10:30am with the new water heater and  left shortly after 1pm.

Matt is a great guy, great service, and even corrected issues the previous plumber had done like over tight fittings.  Matt does an amazing job, this is my second time having him over, the previous effort was to repair my Ejector pump that failed.

A++ job, Five stars all the way.

reviews.author: Sean Patrick
reviews.text: A&W is FANTASTIC AND Matt is great reliable owner. Very friendly and professional and at a very reasonable price. Takes pride in his work as he is the owner. Always on time, and communication is fantastic. He has replaced my water heater, replaced whole house shut off valve, as well as other plumbing issues. A&W is the only plumber I call these days. Great business.

reviews.author: Marie Beusse
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Matt he was very quick to respond to my call. He arrived on time and immediately diagnosed my problem. The repair was done efficiently and at a very fair price. It is hard to find such an honest and dependable service these days. I will definitely call him again for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Brendan Gillespie
reviews.text: I needed to have some shower/tub fixtures replaced so Matt from A&W came out to work on it. The new set looks good and works good with no leaks. He also inspected some of the other plumbing features of the house and took care of a pipe on the water heater that was not positioned right. Overall I am satisfied with the work. Thank you!

plumbers.address: 450 S Cemetery St, Norcross, GA 30071, USA

reviews.author: Lydia White
reviews.text: Pronto is an exceptional company. They are always pleasant and give you service. Joe roach is the one that has been coming to do repairs. He is very knowledgeable, pleasant, patient, and he does a 105% not just 100% I trust everything he does. This company is fantastic. I recommend them 100% now.

reviews.author: Richette Foster
reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience with Pronto Plumbing and felt compelled to leave this review. From start to finish their customer service was exceptional.

There were complications with the kitchen fixture that were completely outside of their control, yet they never stop advocating for me. They stayed in constant communication through calls and text, kept me informed every step of the way, and were genuinely apologetic throughout the process.

What truly set them apart is that they went above and beyond what was required. They made sure the issue was resolved properly – even when it meant doing more than they were obligated to do. That level of integrity, professionalism, and care is rare these days.

Pronto Plumbing did not treat me like just another service call. They treated me like a valued customer, and that matters. I am truly grateful for the effort and would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and customer focus plumbing service services.

Denise

reviews.author: Mercedes Moultrie
reviews.text: This company was referred through American Home Shield. The technician was scheduled promptly and arrived on time. He was very thorough and provide great customer service. We wanted to proceed with this company servicing our hot water heater, but they couldn't perform the work until a week later.  We decided to go with another company that could service our needs within the same week.

reviews.author: Rawanda Goode
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with this plumbing company. They responded quickly, arrived on time, and were extremely professional throughout the entire process. The technician clearly explained the issue. Everything was left clean and working perfectly.

reviews.author: Vallerie Wood

plumbers.name: Coast Plumbing Solutions
plumbers.address: 198 W Hwy 246, Buellton, CA 93427, USA

reviews.author: Jayraj Laxman
reviews.text:
I recently had a Rinnai tankless water heater installed by Coast Plumbing Solutions, and the service was excellent from start to finish.

After requesting quotes from several local companies, Coast was the first to respond—not with an automated text, but with a personal phone call. The owner, Katie, was incredibly polite and took the time to answer all my questions thoroughly. She quickly scheduled a site inspection to accurately assess the job. Their technician, Wallace, arrived for the inspection and was both respectful and thorough. Shortly after, they provided a very reasonable quote that clearly outlined the scope of work.

On the day of installation, Wallace arrived promptly after calling ahead. He was professional and did an immaculate job with the installation and the removal of our old unit. Before leaving, he tested the system and ensured I understood all of its features.

For the past two months, my family and I have had consistent hot water ever since the installation. We will definitely be contacting Coast Plumbing Solutions for any future needs and highly recommend them to friends and neighbors in the area!

reviews.author: Sandy Lincoln
reviews.text: I recently used this plumbing service and couldn’t be happier.   Charlene at the front desk listened and was so very thoughtful.  Julio came to my rescue!!!  He communicated with me every step of the way. The repair was completed efficiently and everything was left clean and tidy.  I feel so lucky that I contacted them.  Highly recommend for any plumbing needs!  Thank you again, Julio!  You're the best!

reviews.author: Kristen Gowing
reviews.text: We had such a great experience with Coast Plumbing. David was our technician and he was awesome. Also very reasonably priced and it is hard to find places that don’t juice you for basic services. We were so happy with their service we plan on calling them again to come look at a few more things around the house. Thanks David!

reviews.author: P S

Isaac, Julio, and David were able to quickly diagnose what would be necessary for the repair and provide a solution that integrated well with the existing architecture. Despite the rainy day, they were clean, polite, and courteous along the way. I'll be sure to use them again for my future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Jessica Simonson
reviews.text: We work with Coast Plumbing Solutions all the time at DMH Properties, and they are truly top-notch. Their team is friendly, knowledgeable, responsive, and consistently does great work. Katie, Char, Riley, Isaac, and everyone else there have been awesome to work with. Communication is excellent, scheduling is smooth, and we always know we’re in good hands. We will absolutely continue using Coast Plumbing Solutions for all of our plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chyloe Koch
reviews.text: Had a clogged pressure reducing valve. I was fearful that my pipes were frozen or busted as that is what the City of OKC kept telling me for a week. Thomas with Champion Plumbing came to my home and instantly put my mind at ease, he was informative about every step and started with the most logical and cost effective solution. Luckily, it was the exact issue and he was able to get it fixed in no time! No runaround or trying to squeeze me for every dollar in my bank account, just pure genuineness and professionalism. I cannot recommend enough. While he was here, I asked if he could flush the tankless water heater as well; not a problem!!! Just the best plumbing company by far! Not to mention Melissa who answered the phone when I called to set the appt. She was able to get Thomas out quickly so we could get water and answers, great teamwork! THANK YOU!

reviews.author: Rizz Adamz
reviews.text:
RAUL VASQUEZ serviced my plumbing issue. Unclogged my drain, fished a camera, and performed a plumbing inspection in our new home. His customer service and knowledge of the trade was impeccable. I will request him for all service calls in the future. Also the lady who took my call was so sweet and professional. She said "we are a real company" lol  I was sold.
Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Robert Keeley
reviews.text: Brian is my new super hero. He managed to dead lift the heavy tank into position and saved the cabinets from being pulled out. The entire team is great. Champion (Ethan, also super nice) came out on a Sunday to start working on it and had it fixed Monday morning. Everyone was friendly and worked quickly to replace my hot water tank.  Very pleased with the reasonable cost too. Thanks Champion and thanks again Brian.

reviews.author: Jerry Sinard
reviews.text: Bought our home new 30 years ago. Unfortunately, got a leak. Chase came out, checked, advised leaking near the meter. Would send a crew out in 2 days to repair. Right on time Dominique and Brian arrived. The repair was made. I even bought their lunch. Brian is a dog guy, treated my Fred like good dog people do. Dominique gave him some attention as well. Probably our FORTH time over the years to use Champion. One more thing. Brittney that took care of my calls was wonderful as well as Melissa who transferred me.  Thanks Champion, our yard will not be a swimming pool for Christmas.

reviews.author: Ryan Kizer
reviews.text: Had a washer drain that was bad and Steve and Eric came out and Repaired it . They were easy to work with explained everything  from the cause to the Repair. Will not find better people to repairs plumbing issues

plumbers.name: Planet Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 729 Walnut St suite d-4, Boulder, CO 80302, USA

reviews.author: David Hodges
reviews.text:
We had our counters and sink installed today and thought we wouldn't have time to have a plumber come and install our garbage disposal and faucet but the installers finished by 11 AM. I started calling plumbers to see if somone could quote us today. We had a plumbing quote in the early afternoon that I thought was too much and we were luck to get in touch with Planet Plumbing who quoted us half the previous quote at 5:00 PM. They were professional and did the quote in an informative way. We agreed and they started the work immediatly and finised with by 7:00 PM which was amazing they were willijng to go above and beyond on the evening before the 4th of July. Jessie and Ben were professional and did a great job installing our faucet and garbage disposal. We are grateful for their service and could not recommend them more.

Post Number 2. December 19, 2025. We had some molding installed 5 months ago. After getting some items for Christmas decorating out of the crawl space, I noticed that some of the items were wet. I looked up at the plumbing and found that water was coming down one of the pipes that seemed to increase when the upstairs shower was on. I called late at night and Planet Plumbing set up an appointment the next day. Chase and Collin came to the house, I told them that base on where the pipe went up, I thought it might be a nail from the molding. They looked around and said that it made sense but they wouldn't know until they opened the wall. They opended a small space in the dry wall above the pipe and sure enough a nail went through the molding to a pipe that was leaking. They cut and replaced the pierced pipe expediently and for a fair price and even found some other issues that they recommended we consider fixing. Thankful we have Planet Plumbing to call on them. We have used them 3 times this year and have been impressed with the professionalism and fair price each time.

reviews.author: Barry Jennings
reviews.text: I had the best experience with Planet plumbing.  They were open, honest, hardworking and had fair pricing after a thorough inspection was carried out to see what the problems we had were.  Saul was our tech and he is a spectacle of professionalism.  He was not satisfied unless he had it done the right way. He stayed late to make sure the job was done in a timely manner to allow for the use of the home while they tore up the concrete slab to fix the main drain in the older home.  The old cast iron pipes were extremely scaled up with buildup over the past 60 or 70 years.  They came quickly to evaluate and gave a fair quote didn’t change the price on us and scheduled right away to fix the problem.  I would use them again in a heartbeat.  If I have any plumbing problems in the future, I don’t even see a reason to call anyone else.  I will even ask for Saul by name when I call.

reviews.author: Brad Magill
reviews.text:
This is a reveiw for Michael Longwell who performed plumbing services for a rental porperty owned in Boulder, CO.

Our rental unit is located in a two-story condominium with an underground parking garage. In early January 2026 a leak was discerned in the garage. Numerous plumbers came to the property but were unable to figure out where the leak was coming from. The HOA of the property then called Planet Plumbing and Michael Longwell came out to inspect the problem. Within 30 minutes Michael figured out exactly where the leak was coming from and what unit in the property the leak emanating from. The leak was coming from the tub in the unit above our unit. Michael determined to locate the leak he would need to go into the bathroom wall of our unit, so we scheduled a time for Michael to go into our wall. Within 15 minutes Michael located the cause of the leak, which was an HOA pipe, and the leak was 100% fixed within an hour. All can say is Michael was a fantastic in every aspect of the work he performed as he was courteous professional and knowledgeable.  If we have a need for another plumber in the future, we will be reaching out to Planet Plumber and specifically requesting that  Michael be put on the job.

Thanks for the great work, Michael. You were a pleasure to work with.

Brad

reviews.author: Amy Zeiger
reviews.text: Our apartment supervisor recommended Planet Plumbing and we had an excellent experience. The tech, Ryan, was knowledgeable and thorough, our new faucet and garbage disposal work great. Highly satisfied.

reviews.author: Hanna R
reviews.text: I manage several properties, and Planet is always my first call for any plumbing repairs. Chase from Planet Plumbing has been outstanding—professional, responsive, and incredibly skilled. He recently resolved a long-standing plumbing issue at a property I had just taken over—an issue that had reportedly persisted for more than 10 years—and he managed to fix it within a week. I couldn’t recommend this company and (Chase) more highly.

reviews.author: David Lee
reviews.text: This review is for Andy Hernandez from Superior Plumbing who was fantastic to work with: professional, knowledgeable, and more importantly, honest. I had an issue with a clogged toilet that turned out to be on the city side. City arrived promptly to flush the main, and Andy took it upon himself to stick around to ensure all was good on my side before leaving. Didn’t end up using his service this go around, but really appreciated his transparency while on-site. Would use his service in the future as needed.

reviews.author: Timothy Spencer
reviews.text: Our kitchen sink backed up Christmas night (of course!) and when I called this morning I received professional help, a text when my tech was on the way, and an excellent repair when he arrived. Andy was super personable, and explained the process and the cost up front. The repair was fast and everything is working wonderfully. Thank you Andy!

reviews.author: Shane Bustle
reviews.text: Excellent experience. Andy was able to do a repair that the competition didn’t want to attempt, saving me thousands. Superior Plumbing is appropriately named. I will be calling the back, but hopefully no time soon.

reviews.author: Anurag Tomar
reviews.text:
This heater was installed by Jose at Superior Plumbing, 8 months back. Jose did a meticulous job, replacing pipe connectors, putting in new shut-off valves, securely strapping the tank to the wall studs.
However, last week unit shutdown with error code of "10 red flashes". Switching off, and restarting the pilot light resolves the issue, but as this was 2nd time in 6 weeks, Rocky from Superior Plumbing came out to inspect it. Rocky contacted the manufacturer, and by their suggestion, took the burner out and cleaned it, polished the sensor and cleaned the fire chamber, and blew some compressed air through the flute. It seems collected lint and dust can cause this issue. If it happens again, maybe the sensor needs replacing.
Anyway, no charge for this service. Rocky was professional, efficient and courteous. Took him a little over an hour to inspect, talk to manufacturer and finish the work.  Hopefully we will not need to replace the sensor.

reviews.author: vijaya venkatesh
reviews.text: The discharge tube of my water softener broke and the water was using out and spraying everywhere.  I had to shut off the main valve.   When I called Superior Kimberley immediately arranged for Andy to come and replace a new tube.  Andy did a great job and was very efficient too.  Thanks, Superior!

reviews.author: Georgetta Shiverdecker
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience with with Glenn and this furnace company. Glenn arrived in a timely manner. Diagnosed the issue quickly, and got our furnace up and running better than ever. Compared to the previous company we used, their service was on another level. And the price was right! Highly recommend Glenn and his team!

reviews.author: D Brookshire
reviews.text: Southtowne did a great job installing our furnace. Everyone I dealt with was kind, professional, and genuinely cared about my family’s safety. The service technician Hunter is who conducted the installation he  treated my family like his own by taking the time to explain what was going on, and made sure everything was done the right way. He was straight up and completed honest work. I really appreciated how smooth and stress-free the whole process was and how he reflected the company. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Southtowne to anyone needing HVAC work. Thank you guys for all the help !

reviews.author: loisjoann goldberg
reviews.text:
When  I asked my neighbor for a recommendation for a local HVAC company, he immediately recommended SouthTowne Plumbing, Heating, and Cooling. He added that another family member had work done by this company and was extremely pleased.

The first time you call a new company to have maintenance performed at your house, it can be stressful not knowing what to expect.

The day of my maintenance visit the temperature was about zero. When Scott came to my door, his cheerful, friendly and professional attitude laid to rest any fears I had about switching to a new company.

Scott explained the company was still family owned, and a local business. This was very important to me.

He took his time to inspect both the inside and outside HVAC components, as well as my mini split. He explained what he was doing and took pictures to show me the condition of the unit on the inside when the panel was taken off.

I had the new filter, and he replaced it for me. I feel that Scott gave both my systems a complete thorough inspection and maintenance checkup.

After the work was completed, Scott explained their maintenance plans that I could choose from if I decided to go with their family plan.He did a thorough job explaining the, differences and what I could expect from each one. Newer HVAC systems have more complex components in them which require maintenance that older units did not need.

Based on my experience with Scott, I will be calling them for my spring maintenance visit and look forward to joining their Family Plan at that time. The Family Plan will include two annual inspections, filters, and cleaning of interior components.

reviews.author: Marlin Jones
reviews.text:
The technician Mr. Shockley fixed the leak in the line & refilled the refrigerant and explained how the thermostat worked so hopefully the heat pump will keep working.
He said he would be back when the temperature is warmer to set the heat pump to run more efficient. Thanks for a good job done.

reviews.author: Julie Danna
reviews.text: Scott F was a joy to have in my home!  Courteous, kind and thorough. I appreciate his eagerness to explain and educate me about the HVAC. He documented with pictures, which he shared, and wadis not pressure me to make costly decisions. He provided the cleaning and PM with the utmost professionalism. He was also very friendly with my pets. Again, he was a welcome guest in my home!

reviews.author: Aaron Gamboa
reviews.text:
As a property manager, I have relied on John’s Plumbing for a wide variety of projects, ranging from emergency repairs to ongoing maintenance across multiple properties. They consistently provide outstanding service, and their pricing is always fair, transparent, and honest, which makes a huge difference when managing budgets and timelines.

Ana is wonderful to work with. She is friendly, attentive, and incredibly helpful in coordinating jobs and ensuring everything runs smoothly from start to finish. Every technician I have worked with has been professional, trustworthy, and highly skilled, completing work efficiently while maintaining excellent quality.

It is not easy to find a plumbing company that delivers reliability, integrity, and craftsmanship at this level, but John’s Plumbing truly does. They have become a trusted partner in maintaining my properties, and I confidently recommend them to anyone seeking dependable and honest plumbing services.

reviews.author: Tony Jung
reviews.text: I had a water leak coming from a second-floor toilet, and John’s Plumbing and Drain Services was able to send a technician out the same day. Aric was professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. He quickly diagnosed the issue as a failed wax ring and replaced it with a double wax ring to ensure it would last longer. The leak was resolved, and the whole process was smooth and stress-free. Pricing was fair for the quality of service and same-day response. Very satisfied and would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Dianne Craik
reviews.text: Great plumbers! So glad I found them. Very responsive, prompt and professional. Explained step by step the process of installing new water heater. I will only use them for all my future plumbing needs!

reviews.text: We called on a Saturday for a broken toilet and John’s plumbing was there within a few hours and  did a great job.  Then, two days later, our hot water heater failed and began leaking all over the floor. We called John’s again and they came right out within an hour and in just a couple of hours we had a brand new hot water heater installed. Their office manager/dispatcher, Anna kept me in the loop and was extremely helpful.  We are very impressed with this company and will use them for all our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Rosie
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with John’s Plumbing and Drain. From the moment I called, the team was professional, responsive, and courteous. They arrived on time, quickly diagnosed the problem, and explained everything clearly so I understood what needed to be done. The work was completed efficiently and with great attention to detail.

What impressed me most was their honesty and fair pricing—no hidden fees or surprises. It’s hard to find trustworthy plumbers these days, but John’s Plumbing and Drain truly delivered. I feel confident knowing I have a reliable company to call for any future plumbing needs.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for quality service and peace of mind!

reviews.author: Isaiah Elenes
reviews.text: Lee’s Roofing did an excellent job on our full roof replacement. The quality of work was great and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. Huge thanks to Elijah, Oscar, and Beto for keeping me informed every step of the way and sending updates while my family and I were out on a family vacation. That communication really gave us peace of mind. The crew was professional, efficient, and left everything clean when the job was done. I highly recommend Lee’s Roofing.

reviews.author: Pamela Dempsey
reviews.text: We made the hard decision to say goodbye to our aged clay roof tiles and to go ahead with a conversion to a new asphalt roof. The easy part of that decision was choosing Lee's Roofing for the project. We've always had wonderful service with Lee's which has included installing a new HVAC unit and all new ductwork and insulation, as well as semi- annual maintenance through the years. We knew we could expect A+ work on our roof. True enough, our new roof looks sooo good and the entire job of removal and installation went very fast. The installation crew was hardworking, and sales rep Dylan Kent did an excellent job going over the proposed work/costs and explained the whole process beforehand. Special shoutout to project manager Juan Celis for his great communication, awesomely friendly and helpful manner, and excellent oversight of the installation. Overall, a super great experience for us and we love our new roof! Thank you, Lee's!

reviews.author: Matthew Stancombe
reviews.text:
I had a great experience working with Brandon from Lee’s Roofing. He was professional, knowledgeable, and easy to work with from start to finish. Brandon took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I understood what was going on.

He showed up on time, was respectful, and gave an honest assessment without any pressure. It’s clear he takes pride in his work and truly cares about helping.

If you’re looking for someone trustworthy and dependable, I highly recommend Brandon. Excellent service and communication every step of the way.

reviews.author: Sally Valenzuela
reviews.text: Just wanted to say thank you to Lee's Air plumbing they came out. Did their service on one of our buildings at Central Valley auto glass. They did an amazing job  the guy was very helpful.He explain everything as he was doing job. I would totally recommend lee's for any job. Thank you again mister pancake you're an amazing person. After he was done with everything, he also cleaned up. So that was a plus we were very happy with the services, and again, thank you, Lee's Plumbing.

reviews.author: Will Ford
reviews.text: Writing this for my dad who isn't great with technology. I’m a retired home builder and have been pleased with Bernie’s. They are reliable and there workman ship is excellent!

reviews.author: Mark Coffey
reviews.text: Knowledgable local plumbers with a long track record that will take the time to do a repair correctly.   They also did an excellent job installing our new on-demand boiler system.

reviews.author: Beat Steiner
reviews.text: Bernie’s has been taking care of our somewhat elaborate heating system for many years. We’ve been pleased with their knowledge and careful attention to this work.

reviews.author: Ariel
reviews.text: I would absolutely give 10 stars if I could. Despite Mitch being harassed for no reason by my older mother, he added on so many things to a standard water heater replacement at no cost, that other companies surely would have gouged a customer for.  He added 2 shut off valves to the tank, replaced the lame flex metal connectors (another company had put on) with copper lines, replaced the thermal expansion tank and triple checked and changed the whole house pressure.   I am really sorry Mitch about my mother and I am so grateful people like you and companies like Bernie's still exist.

reviews.text: Dean Titus was super.  He and his apprentice were very knowledgeable , friendly, and efficient.  The entire team, Janet, office manager and Jacob Allen were great to work with.  Great service and reasonable pricing.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Raven Meredith
reviews.text: Golden Plumbing was very helpful after another company chose not to help repair a leak in my old weird house. Quick repones and scheduling, and very helpful and professional service from Dean! Will definitely use them again for future needs and will recommend to anyone who asks!

reviews.author: Drip Collins
reviews.text: Jacob has been great!!! He worked with me and explained everything that needed to be done. It’s been so nice to work with a company that wants to be fair in pricing and doing a great job!!!! Thank you will use again if ever needed.

reviews.author: Brittanie Steele
reviews.text:
I am absolutely going to use Golden Plumbing for our next job. The technician Jacob Allen was so sweet and extremely helpful. He and his helper not only repaired the water leak outside our home but also came in and did a quick diagnosis of another issue we are having.

We look forward to having them back to get that resolved as well.

Golden plumbing came right out. The price they gave us was extremely competitive and affordable. reviews.author: Amanda Gellhaus
reviews.text: Had a sink/dishwasher drain backing up; called Golden and spoke to a very nice lady (Janet, I believe) who got me set up with a same day appointment. The technician (Dean) was great; he explained his assessment and provided an estimate, and he got our drain fixed up quickly. I appreciated that he left the area very clean and explained everything/answered questions. Drain is working just fine now; would highly recommend!

We had a tankless water heater installed, a whole house sediment filtration system installed, shut off valve replaced, and reverse osmosis drinking water system installed.

reviews.author: Gitlin Law Firm
reviews.text: We have been very happy with ASAP Plumbing for all of our needs. We’ve used them for both general repairs and plumbing issues, and they have consistently delivered excellent service. They are always prompt, professional, and pleasant to deal with. We truly appreciate their reliability and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Steven McCarty
reviews.text: Lucas was very professional and installed the water heater within a couple of hours. He went over the install details and how long it would take. When finished with the install, he explained maintenance and warranty. He cleaned up everything including disposal of the old unit. His work was very clean and demonstrated there were no gas leaks to set me at ease. I am very happy with the process and the price. I highly recommend ASAP Plumbing.

reviews.author: Nicole Leconte
reviews.text:
ASAP has been wonderful to work with! From Alex, who I initially  cumminicated with regarding my hot water heater, getting a quote, and scheduling a plumber, Olivia after hours, and finally Max who installed the water heater. They were very efficient and got everything handled in a very short turnaround time (next day).
In addition, Max is extremely knowledgeable, helpful, and professional. I am pleased with the removal and installation he performed and he patiently answered all of my questions. Overall, they ALL are very friendly and empathetic which truly helps when dealing with plumbing emergencies that always seem to happen at the worst times. I would not hesitate to use them again. I
strongly recommend their services!

reviews.author: Bethany Bellavia
reviews.text: Jon came out and gave me an estimate and explained everything to me. He was accessible and personable through the entire process. Keifer & Bryce are the plumbers that completed the work and they did phenomenal! We had a transitional hot water heater replaced with a tankless in addition to repiping and moving our water softener. They did it all and were at my house ALL day. They were professional, kind, and answered my questions. I highly recommend ASAP!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1600 S Preston St, Louisville, KY 40217, USA

reviews.author: Jimi Hance
reviews.text: I had a valve break on my main water supply line to my house at 1 am. It flooded my kitchen, part of my living room and dining room. I called around 3 am in need of a plumber and Chris called me back by 8 am. By 1130 am he was at my door and finished up before 1230. Chris was absolutely great! He was knowledgeable and knew exactly what was done wrong with the prior work on the pipe. He was easy to chat with and was very informative on what he was doing and why. I do think the price was a little steep for a smaller job, but I understand that this was done after hours and on a Sunday. I do not hold Chris accountable for the price. I do hope that Roto Rooter is taking good care of Chris! Good knowledgeable employees are hard to come by these days. I will recommend him to anyone in the future! Chris gets 5 stars for his work but RR gets 3 stars for the steep price. This job should of been no more than $300 or $350 AT MOST.

reviews.author: John Martin
reviews.text: Dalton was conscientious and provided a quote for the work required. He cleaned our line and found and removed the cause of the blockage. He ran a camera through the drain line to insure the line would remain clear and there were no other problems. The total was exactly as quoted. Very satisfied. Great service by Roto-Rooter. This was an after hours job. Very grateful that they were able to solve our problem quickly when we needed them.

reviews.author: Suzy Mohr
reviews.text:
We recently needed the help from Roto Rooter for a backed up drain in our basement. Kyle was our technician and I want to compliment him on cleaning everything up when he was finished. I wasn’t home most of the time while he was here and was afraid when I got home, I would have lots of cleaning to do. It was nice to come home and find he had already taken care of it.
We are happy to report that our drains are working the way they should.
Thanks

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.text: Thanks Chris for being so thorough and efficient! I won't use anyone else besides Roto-Rooter from now on. From start to finish, it was an easy process and he arrived quick to resolve the issue. He explained what he was doing, and answered the questions I had. Overall, it was a quick and easy fix to a "crappy" situation.

reviews.author: Sony Steier
reviews.text: I recently used Rotor Rooter on a rental property of mine. We first tried two other plumbers who worked on this powder room toilet but they left and said it was better. However, The problem still existed and this toilet was Mount Vesuvius after those plumbers left! Somehow, they made it even worse. It was the Friday after Thanksgiving, and the only plumber who we could find was Rotor Rooter. They did not charge holiday hours and came within a few hours. It was roto Rooter who finally found the problem with our sewer line. They determined it was a pipe that tree roots had grown into, and gave us a price to fix it. I had this issue before on a different property, so I was familiar with the hefty cost. Their price was surprisingly  reasonable for this scope of work. When they got to the Area of Repair, they soon realize that the damage extended even further into the line toward the road. They at first quoted a price to fix, but I asked to talk to their supervisor James.  In discussions with him, he said, he believed Msd should be responsible for the rest of this line because it was poorly made and passed a section that typically is what Msd plumbs to.  James took the time to explain the problem more and how I could discuss this with Msd, which was a huge help. When they came out there, Roto Rooter met with Msd and helped convince them to fix the problem with the rest of the sewer pipe. I was extremely thankful at his help and diligence, which saved me over $5000 on this additional repair. I would always suggest asking lots of questions and understanding the problem, and with Rotor Rooter and James in particular, they were extremely courteous and helpful with the best communication I have had in a long time. I wish I had called Roto Rooter to come out and fix this problem before using any other plumber. Hats off to Rotor Rooter.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 133 Portage Trail Suite 102, Cuyahoga Falls, OH 44221, USA

reviews.author: Angie Best
reviews.text: My representative was Matt and he was wonderful!! He was quick and efficient and left everything clean and the way it was. He was a life saver! We had water backed up thru the whole house for a week straight. Thank you so much Matt!

reviews.author: Denis Carter
reviews.text: This company has outstanding technicians and equipment at a fair price.Our toilets were not flushing at all. The water was filling the bowl. Cory and Dante from Roto Rooter used a camera in our sewer line and discovered a blockage directly under a large pin oak in the middle of our front yard. They attempted jetting it with a super high psi jet head, but the blockage was due to large roots that had infiltrated the sewer pipe at the joints. Undaunted, they pulled that machine out and brought out a root cutter unit which did the job. They jetted it once more and it was perfect. These two technicians, Cory and Dante, were amazing. They knew exactly how to tackle a serious problem and were polite, hard working, and consummate professionals. I will use Roto-Rooter for all my plumbing needs from now on.

reviews.author: Lisa Rene' DeBenedictis
reviews.text: I called and left a message and they returned my call promptly.  I had water backing up in my basement and they sent Jesse to the rescue within an hour.  He was very responsive and respectful and explained every step of the process.  He cleaned everything up and fixed the issue with ease ( tree roots). I highly recommend this establishment.

reviews.author: Ryan Strauss
reviews.text:
I had a badly clogged kitchen sink and called this Roto-Rooter for help. Nick showed up on time, explained what was causing the blockage, and cleared it out quickly without any hassle. Super professional, reasonably priced, and made sure everything was running perfectly before leaving.
Highly recommend if you need someone reliable and skilled!

reviews.author: Valencia Walters
reviews.text: Roto Rooter provided an overall good experience. Quick scheduling appointments. The plumber James provided great customer service and quality work. I had a clogged toilet from a dislodged toy. James was knowledgeable about plumbing, provided details explaining the different options and process, and openly disclosed pricing. He work diligently and eventually was able to unclogged the toilet by removing the toilet and extracting the object. He was professional and worked efficiently. He cleaned up his work area when finished which was a plus.  I would recommend roto rooter and will definitely be using their services in the future.

reviews.author: Jessup Goldbergcook
reviews.text:
The owner, Caleb, is an outstanding guy. I had called to ask a few questions about relighting a water heater that was giving me some trouble. He patiently walked me through the steps over the phone, and I was able to get the water heater lit with no problems at all. It’s rare to find someone so willing to take the time to help.
I would highly recommend Miracle Man Plumbing to anyone in the area who wants to hire a company they can truly rely on. Their professionalism, honesty, and genuine customer care really set them apart. 5 Stars!!!

reviews.author: Rusty Brown
reviews.text: I contacted Miracle man on 2/25/26 and was immediately put on the books for a free estimate the next day. Ron came out and he was efficient and personable from the get go. He did a wonderful job and was able to fix our problem at the time of the estimate. The price was very reasonable. I would recommend Ron and Miracle Man to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Rick Ulmer
reviews.text: Caleb, Michael and Neil are a fantastic team. I would refer them to anyone and without a doubt Miracle Man Plumbing would give the task 110% effort.  Caleb was given a difficult task of finding a leak in the main sewage drain, dug down six feet in a small front yard.  His team had a “Can Do” attitude the three days they worked.  Pulled out boulders and huge roots to clear the drain.  This problem affected all water related appliances in the house.  Prior to leaving, the team ensured all appliances were cleared and the huge mess was cleaned up. I also need to give Stephanie a member of admin staff a positive shout out.  She kept us informed and ensured we were billed accurately.  Outstanding job!   If you need a miracle accomplished call Miracle Man Plumbing.

reviews.author: Michael Harrington
reviews.text:
We needed a gas plumber for our new gas stove.  We had an prior issue with the gas connection we had and needed it modified quickly due to kitchen renovations.  We called on a Saturday thinking we would leave a message, and were very surprised to have a very pleasant woman to answer the phone. She scheduled an appointment for us for the following Monday morning (Federal Holiday).

Ron arrived on time and was able to troubleshoot the problem and he gave us a reasonable estimate to repair it.  He went out, bought the necessary parts, and quickly solved our issue.  Ron was polite, professional, shows great pride in his work, and was excellent to work with.  The repair was done efficiently for a very reasonable price.  For any future plumbing needs (gas or water) we will DEFINITELY choose Miracle Man.  We highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Jake Eddy
reviews.text: Michael Mikey, Mike Caleb and Neil are superstars. I am overly impressed. I have some background in Plumbing and what they did how they did it how they priced it. I wouldn’t have it any other way top not true just 10 stars if I could.

reviews.author: Terri Marcantel
reviews.text: We HIGHLY recommend Don the Plumber!! Got to work, no BS, no trying to upsell us. The cost was fair and actually much less than my husband expected. Just did the job and took his time to get it right. That’s his process and his promise. We also love that it’s a family-owned business. We will for sure call on him again for any future needs.

reviews.text: I Had a main line clog. I initially called a different plumber because it was on a Sunday and also over the holiday weekend and Don the Plumber was closed. Don the Plumber is reasonably priced and not charging an arm and a leg. I felt very comfortable using them. You can tell they are not trying to take advantage of you and not over charging you. These people know what they are doing from answering the phone to getting the job done. Thanks Don the Plumber!!!

Would highly recommend both Steven and Sosa Plumbing and will call them with any furture plumbing needs I might have.

reviews.author: Juli Butler
reviews.text: Excellent service from Jason at Sosa Plumbing. He showed up on time, was professional and courteous, and clearly knew what he was doing. He replaced a kitchen faucet and an outdoor spigot efficiently, explained the work, and didn’t waste time. Everything was done right the first time, no mess, no surprises. This is how a plumber should operate. I wouldn’t hesitate to use Jason again or recommend him to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: Demian Saffer
reviews.text: Jason was out to my house twice - for two separate issues with clogs in cast iron pipe under the slab (once on Friday and again for a different line on Monday...when it rains, it pours, I guess). On both occasions, he was efficient, communicative about what he was seeing with the camera and in explaining what he was doing, and professional. In both cases, augering the lines was not sufficient to release the clogs, and camera work and hydro-jetting was needed to clear them. I especially appreciate that there was no attempt to upsell services or use scare tactics on the customer - it actually seemed like he was "on my team" here, and wanted to sort out the issues as quickly as possible as opposed to hoping to pad the work and hours on the job. All in all, I am very happy with Sosa and Jason's work. They'll be my go-to from here on out.

reviews.author: TJ
reviews.text: Sosa services has been amazing since I moved into my new home in Feb 2023. They came out quickly, within days of my inquiry and installed my softener and filter. reviews.text: Very professional and nice to deal with. They helped with getting the water shut off and did a great job with the installation. Joey was great to deal with as was everyone I spoke to at Devlin. High recommend these folks for any plumbing needs....  I'll use them again.

reviews.author: Mike Roman
reviews.text:
When my water heater went out and needed a replacement, I contacted 3 separate plumbing companies.  2 provided estimates by phone, but Devlin was the only one to come out and actually inspect it in person and provide me a detailed estimate.  It was $200 less than the others.

I called at 8:30am and spoke with the staff at Devlin.  They were very polite and easy to work with.  By noon, Preston showed up to inspect the unit and emailed me the estimate.  I made a decision late that afternoon to go with Devlin and they set me up with an appointment very quickly the following morning.

Preston showed up for the install right on time.  Very professional and knowledgeable.  In less than 2 hours, the work was complete and I had a brand new water heater.  The expenses that they originally quoted were right on.   Devlin made the process very easy.  From the staff in the office to the service team, everyone was great to work with.

This is my new go to company for anything plumbing. I'll definitely be using them again in the future.

Thank you Devlin's.

reviews.text:

What impressed me the most about him is his integrity. He did not try to upsell you but he recommended the most practical solution to your problem. Its a rare quality these days. I will recommend this company at any time if you have a plumbing issue

reviews.author: Kelli Quinn
reviews.text: I had a cook top installed and I smelled a faint smell of gas and called Atmos gas company (first mistake) they came out and said my cook top lines needed tightened but stated when they cut it off at the stove my gas was still going so they turned my gas off in my entire house stating that I had a leak without having me turn off my appliances including my heat. This was 12/23 right before Christmas and took my meter which meant I had to get a leak inspection from a licensed plumber and a city inspection which is very costly. I couldn’t get anyone to come out due to the holidays and the earliest I could get someone was 12/31 which was Swat plumbing (do not recommend) and they was trying to charge an ungodly amount and what they described needed to be done for a leak inspection was not what I googled and said it would take 4 to 6 hours(not true) but I prayed about it and called Benjamin Franklin plumbing the lady said she could get somebody out TODAY!! When I tell you ATHENS CLINKSCALE IS AN ANGEL I mean it, he not only fixed my issue he calls with me and spoke with Atmos (Gas company) and explained that the technician that came out did not diagnose the gas issue properly and that I should not be charged for a permit and convinced them to turn my gas back on that night within an hour I was up an running. In today’s society you don’t find honest companies like this or customer service. This was NEW YEARS EVE! and he did try to price gouge me or get over this company is definitely a HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!! and Athen is definitely a great asset to any company!

reviews.author: Anika Payne
reviews.text: So I used Benjamin Franklin plumbing when I first moved into my house years ago and they were great. But today the customer service was unreal. He walked me through everything step by step, gave wonderful insight, but didn't make me feel obligated to commit to anything right away like other plumbers/technicians I've worked with. He is clearly invested into doing what's best for the homeowner, but was also realistic about expectations and understanding of the realities people face when they suddenly have an unexpected large expense. 10/10 would work with Athens again.

I have NEVER dealt with a worse company in my life!!!!!!
I just needed a valve replacement under my sink for a new dishwasher to be installed.  I talked to J. Blanton Plumbing and scheduled the work to be done the following week on a Tuesday.  The dishwasher was being installed the next day.  On Tuesday, a plumber wearing a "pretty" J. Blanton sweatshirt shows up NOT to do the work but to upsell me on having more plumbing work done!!!!  I told him he just needs to get the valve replaced as I was promised and he responds that he just drives a shell of a truck and has no repair equipment!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  And that they would send a plumber out the next day which is when the dishwasher is coming!!!!!!!!!!!  After I pointed that out, I was promised a plumber at 8:00 a.m. Wednesday morning and got my delivery pushed back as much as they could on Wednesday.  The pretty sweatshirt knew that the work requirements were and I was promised the plumber would be here.  I even called 3x later on Tuesday to ensure they would stand behind their commitment.  Well, it's now Wednesday and no plumber showed at 8.  I called again at 8:50 and was told they would send someone over right away.  I called at 9:30 as no plumber yet and was told I was someone's next stop but they couldn't tell me when that would be!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  My dishwasher delivery window is 10 - 2!!!!!  And this worthless, lying company knew this.
BOTTOM LINE:  Do not do business with them as it will be greater headaches that your current plumbing issues.  There are many good, reliable plumbers out there - J. Blanton is NOT ONE OF THEM!!!!!!!

reviews.author: irish
reviews.text: Cameron our plumber was just Awesome!! He worked like a machine and was very organized in how he went about the repairs.(I’m a Union Carpenter so I can relate!)He also KNEW HIS STUFF! And he was very personable and polite! I’d use him again for sure!👍👍

reviews.author: Charlie Benson
reviews.text: Ronnie came to take a detailed look and give me estimates on preventative maintenance. He was polite and thorough, shared his observations, explained options, and answered questions. They have great service tech, and the whole process was quick and seamless.

plumbers.name: Quick Quality Plumbing
plumbers.address: 76 S Center St, American Fork, UT 84003, USA

reviews.author: Howard Wageman
reviews.text: Jared and his company Quick Quality Plumbing are awesome! They responded very promptly to my inquirey and with in 24 hrs I had my issue resolved. It’s great to have a number in your phone for a quick text and know you can get results !

reviews.author: Shaun Syphus
reviews.text: Dalton and Daeden were above-and-beyond fantastic. We had a plumbing emergency in our "new" 50 year old home and they were here diagnosing and fixing just a short bit after our phone call. They explained everything thoroughly and were very reasonably priced, especially considering how quick they arrived. Will absolutely be using again in the future!

reviews.author: zach jamir
reviews.text: Quick Quality Plumbing was amazing to work with! They were fast to respond, showed up on time, and were super professional from start to finish. They explained everything clearly, gave honest pricing, and made sure the job was done right the first time. You can tell they really care about their customers and the quality of their work. If you’re looking for a reliable local plumbing company in Utah, I highly recommend Quick Quality Plumbing!

reviews.author: Property Management
reviews.text: We had a maintenance emergency at one of our rental properties and Quick Quality Plumbing was able to take care of us the same day. Dalton was our technician and he did great work. Communication was excellent throughout the process, estimates were clear, and pricing was straightforward and easy to pay. While the cost was a little higher than what we’re used to, the quality of work and quick response made it well worth it.

reviews.author: Steve Rose
reviews.text:
This company truly provides personal service. Jared, the owner, went out of his way to make sure I had all the information I needed to get my pool up and running.
I contacted them on a Saturday night, and the woman who answered the phone was polite and extremely helpful. I explained what I needed and asked if they had a technician familiar with a Lochinvar heater. She took all my information and called me back within minutes to let me know that Jared would reach out to help me over the phone.
Jared called shortly after, gathered some details, and I sent him a few pictures. We even scheduled an appointment for Sunday morning at 7 a.m. Less than 10 minutes later, Jared called me back with information he had found (on a Saturday night around 7 p.m.!) and texted me step-by-step instructions to reset the system.
I followed his instructions, and by Sunday morning, everything was back up and running. Jared even followed up to make sure I didn’t still need him to come out.
This is what service is all about—making a difference. Friendly, professional, and he didn’t even charge me. He was genuinely happy that my business was back up and running. Highly recommend.

plumbers.name: Warrior Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 4123 Roland Ave, Baltimore, MD 21211, USA

reviews.author: Vonda Johnson
reviews.text: The came out on the weekend for just a little more to fix my water but my pipes were frozen and they did everything they could to help me. Dave opened my wall so I could insulate my pipes. They followed up and turned my water back on and came right back out to fix a little drip.  The best service ever. Brent and his plumbers were responsive, fast, friendly, professional  and on time. Dave also cleaned up after he was done. 🥰 I would definitely recommend this company.

reviews.author: dawn garner
reviews.text:
Excellent customer service.
Gave me tips on how to handle things before I might need to use them. Also, gave an estimate over the phone without having to come into the house. I didn’t have work done this time, but they did excellent work in the past:

reviews.author: Gabrielle Alper
reviews.text: So happy to have found a quality and reliable plumber right in my neighborhood!! I had a few plumbers come by to check out an odd issue with the showers in the house we just moved into. Prior to Warrior coming to visit, other plumbers just looked at it without taking it apart, and then said it would need to be replaced in full. Which was not only costly, but time consuming.  When Dave from Warrior came by, he took the time to diagnose the issue properly and he was able to do the repair with the existing hardware. They were also SUPER affordable and Brent was upfront about the cost and process. We will definitely use Warrior again when we need plumbing work.

reviews.author: Nancy Sherman
reviews.text: We are grateful beyond words for the consistently excellent work and high level of commitment to their customers that the  talented, knowledgeable and, very importantly, totally trustworthy team at Warrior Plumbing brings to each and every job. Most recently, just days before the snow and ice storm (Fern) would cover Baltimore, I was told by another plumbing company, after two expensive part replacements and days of no heat in the house in mid December, that they were going to "red tag" our boiler (more days of ho heat in the house just before the January storm), and that they would leave a contract for us to sign for the purchase and installation of a new boiler. If we wanted to move forward, a signature and partial payment would be expected - all on a job where little inspection of the existing unit happened and no reason for the red-tagging existed. I knew that I had to, at the least, get a second and maybe third estimate on the cost of a new boiler. I called Warrior initially for just this estimate. After speaking with Brent and letting him know what had transpired with the first plumbing company, he offered to have someone come out the next morning and take a look at what might be going on. Dave and a colleague arrived at my house - did a simple, but essential inspection of the unit - correctly observed the new pricey parts the other plumber had installed in December - and, saw one part that was in good shape but had two bolts missing that would keep it standing upright. A schematic of the inside of my boiler - pulled from Dave's back pocket - and, some very smart observational skills and knowledge of my boiler - allowed Dave to have the boiler up and running again with the installation of two bolts, which he had on hand in his truck. Our heat has worked better in the past two weeks than on any day in my recent memory. And, I was able to tear up an estimate from the former plumber for $11,400. Whether Dave is a super-smart professional or an angel dropped down from heaven, I don't know. I am inclined to believe he is both. I am deeply grateful every day for the professionals and people that I have met and have had the pleasure of working with at Warrior. Their work is more than solid; and, as individuals, they, too, are more than solid - really good people - genuinely proud of what they do - proud, especially, to do an honest day's work, and very proud when they can help you resolve your problems. Some companies say that you will be safer with them; but, Warrior really cares - about their work, about you, and about keeping the good reputation for excellence and honesty they have earned from grateful customers in Baltimore. Thank you so much, Brent and Dave! I've got you on "speed dial" - lol - the rest of Baltimore should, too!

reviews.author: Timothy Smith
reviews.text:
Above-and-beyond professionalism and guidance!!!

I was dealing with a complicated frozen pipe situation involving a well system, and Brent at Warrior Plumbing was outstanding. From the start, he was thoughtful, knowledgeable, and incredibly responsive. What really stood out was how willing he was to communicate and guide me through the situation—even when he wasn’t physically on site. Brent made it clear that he was available any time of day  to put my mind at ease .

Brent took the time to walk through the problem step by step, helped me understand what to look for, and gave clear, practical guidance to safely mitigate the issue and prevent further damage. In a stressful situation where timing and the right decisions mattered, having his expertise and steady communication made all the difference.

It’s rare to find a professional who is this invested in helping a customer do things the right way and protecting their home. Warrior Plumbing is exactly the kind of company you want to call when you need someone you can trust.

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jeannie Barry
reviews.text:
Matt was very knowledgeable and professional. He came over to assess my problem and went to get the equipment he needed. He stayed many hours until it was resolved. I am so impressed by his work ethic— especially on a Saturday!
Thank you Zippy Plumbing for a job well done!

reviews.author: You Donotneedit
reviews.text: Matt was awesome.  We had a water main and irrigation line leak caused by a provider installing fiber.  He addressed it promptly, walk us through the issue, and repaired it to a standard better than the original.  I would highly recommend Matt and Zippy plumber for any residential work that is required.  I look forward to working with him on future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Phil Collins
reviews.text:
Last week my daughter and son-in-law had a major backup at their home and called Zippy Plumber. Matt quickly diagnosed the exact problem and handled everything with professionalism, thoroughness, and genuine kindness. I was seriously impressed.

As a fellow veteran, I didn’t hesitate to call him this Sunday when I had an issue with a shower valve at my home. Matt came right over. He fixed the shower cartridge, scoped my waste line at my request, and even replaced two toilet fill valves while he was here. Same outstanding service — prompt, professional, and courteous.

I can confidently recommend Matt and his veteran-owned business for any plumbing needs — especially more serious slab, water supply, or waste line issues. If you’re in North Fulton, Alpharetta, Roswell, Johns Creek, Brookhaven, Peachtree Corners, South Forsyth, Duluth, or the greater Atlanta area, this is your guy.

reviews.author: Tony M
reviews.text: We had a significant grease clog in my kitchen drain at my home in Alpharetta.  We called Matt and his team. They were able to Hydro jet the blockage the same day. All work was completed timely and at a fair price. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Michael McCullar
reviews.text:
Matt, did an awesome job again. It’s the 3rd time we’ve had him help us. He came recommended by our neighbors.

We had a pressure valve issue, a water leak in our front yard, and a disposal leak among other things. He did an awesome job every time. He’s a great guy and clearly an expert.

Highly recommended!

They put everything back as soon as floor was installed. Would recomend these guys to anyone looking for Professional service, and courtesy at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Brittany Alosi
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with Millcreek Plumbing. They were able to fit me in immediately and resolved a really unpleasant issue with my sink and drain that had started to smell like sewage. Everything was fixed in one day. They were incredibly responsive, professional, and took the time to clearly explain what was causing the odor and what needed to be done to fix it. I really appreciated how thorough and informative they were. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Caroline Haskell
reviews.text: We've used Millcreek Plumbing for a number of jobs ranging from sewer scoping to drain removal and relocation.  They are always communicative, on time and very professional.  Their plumbers take the time to describe what they are doing throughout the job and leave a clean workspace when they are completed.  Would highly recommend and we will continue to use them for plumbing jobs moving forward!

reviews.author: Robert Heath
reviews.text: Nobody wants to deal with unexpected plumbing issues, but when we have had issues come up, Millcreek Plumbing has been there to help. Their team has always been quick to respond, patient, and professional. They communicate a thorough diagnosis of plumbing issues and talk through multiple solution options. We will definitely continue calling Millcreek Plumbing for all of our home plumbing needs. Preston, Jesse, and Jared have been lifesavers and perform excellent work!

Because I need to be able to tell my clients what time to come to my home and I've had to reschedule them already and he said he didn't know cuz he wasn't in the office. This doesn't constitute an emergency? The company's integrity sincerely sucks. All of their workers sincerely suck. I have begged my apartment complex to never do business with these people again. And this is how they've left my home for 8 days

reviews.text:
The Nichols Plumbing, Electrical, & HVAC plumbing specialist installed a water softener for my entire home. My experience with this business was positive. The plumber was informed and pleasant to work with. He was skilled and quickly resolved the hard water issue.
PLEASE READ EDIT: Though I previously had a great experience with Nichols Mechanical, at this point I'm not sure what to think about their integrity. After I paid quite a bit for the installation of a water pressure regulator, a service required for me to get homeowner's insurance, the technician left me with the electrical component of a Moen Smart Valve and a vague mention of someone coming to finish the job. It's been three weeks now and I've not heard from them. We shall see...
PLEASE READ NEW EDIT :) Today Nichols Mechanical came through in a wonderful way! Thank you so much for all of you expertise, communication, and the amazing way you all worked together to finish my high water pressure issue. Now my home warranty will cover claims on any plumbing issues in the future and I'm on my way to being able to get homeowner's insurance! Marvelous job!

reviews.author: Anne Davidson
reviews.text: Kenny did a great job. Very attentive to mechanical and servicing needs. Also, drained and disconnected the evap cooler for winter. We’ve used Nichols Mechanical for five years now, going on six and highly recommend them to anyone and everyone.

reviews.author: Tanya C
reviews.text: They were very professional and willing to work with me on getting a timely inspection completed on HVAC & Electrical. I had hoped the reports would support more negotiations and I would be hiring Nicolas to do the work. Sadly the homeowner didn’t want to negotiate. But I would come back and use Nicolas again.

reviews.author: Sharon Clarke
reviews.text: I recently had Nichols Mechanical install 3 minisplits in my mobile home in Cottonwood. From the minute Michael walked in the door, I knew I was getting someone who knew what he was doing. That made me feel very confident in choosing Nichols Mechanical to install my equipment. I have seldom seen someone so throughly knowledgeable about the mechanics of a product. Usually you get a sales rep of some kind, not a true technician. I really enjoyed dealing with the entire crew at Nichols Mechanical, and already have them scheduled to do another job for me.

reviews.author: deadrick Harris
reviews.text: Made’s Plumbing did an excellent job installing my new water heater. He arrived on time, completed the work efficiently, and made sure everything was done right. Professional service, fair pricing, and a clean job—highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jan Powers
reviews.text:
Mades Plumbing came out to repair a persistent leaking valve on our tub.
They did a wonderful job after three over providers had failed. I'm thrilled beyond words! While here they agreed to reset a toilet whose wax ring had disappeared into the ether!
No more rocking! We ALSO had a bar sink that was backed up and they were able to clear that too! They went way above and beyond to see that our needs were met! Will always use them in the future! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Sue Sappington
reviews.text: Mades Plumbing did a great job for us when they replaced the wax seals in two toilets and replaced our outside faucets front and back. They were professional, courteous and highly competent. Ben took special pains to make sure all work was done correctly. He also took the time to inspect our garbage disposal and water heater and assisted me in getting warranty service on the water heater. We will be calling them for future work and wholeheartedly recommend Mades Plumbing to anyone in need of quality plumbing services.

reviews.author: Bryan Panella
reviews.text: These guys were great. I have been screwed over by plumbers in the past and these guys were honest.  They explained everything they needed to do and discussed possible outcomes.  A+++ customer service.

reviews.author: Katrina Dorraj
reviews.text: My mom recommended Ben to us and he installed a water heater and garbage disposal for us almost 4 yrs ago. Everything has been working great. Had him back to fix some other issues recently and he was able to repair an existing faucet saving us hundreds. He’s courteous, efficient, and honest. Highly recommend him and his team.

reviews.author: Pat Garrett
reviews.text: Initially contacted Joe Castro Plumbing for an installation estimate on a whole house water filter I had previously purchased. Jason is extremely knowledgeable and a true professional. I was extremely impressed. Bottom-line... if you want the job done right and at a fair price... call Joe Castro Plumbing. Nice job guys... appreciate you!

reviews.author: James Powers
reviews.text: Great work n timely too! Very courteous and respectful young men did a fantastic job with R&R four 33 yr old toilets. Excellent clean up! Complete haul off also. If you need plumbing.....may I suggest you give Joe Castro Plumbing a call. You'll appreciate their professionalism.

reviews.author: Diane Lominac
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with Joe Castro Plumbing! Their response time was incredibly fast, which we really appreciated. The team quickly diagnosed our issue, answered all of our questions clearly, and resolved the problem efficiently. Our service required a return visit, and they kept us informed every step of the way—communicating the schedule and arriving exactly when they said they would. Reliable, professional, and easy to work with. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tracy Murphy
reviews.text: My neighbor recommended Joe Castro Plumbing and I am 100% satisfied. They worked quickly, left the area spotless, and were very pleasant. I look forward to working with them in the future.

reviews.author: Emmanuel Enriquez
reviews.text: Jason was able to come out on short notice to check out a possible gas leak and was very professional! He was super knowledgeable and extremely helpful. I would definitely call back.

reviews.author: John Fagan
reviews.text:
We had a great experience working with this Ribbs Plumbing while preparing a home for sale. Their pricing was very reasonable, the quality of work was excellent, and the entire job was completed professionally.

All of the work was exterior and required city permits. They handled the full permitting process, coordinated with the city, and kept us informed every step of the way. Communication was clear, timelines were met, and there were no surprises.

Highly recommend them if you’re looking for reliable, well-organized company who take ownership of the entire process.

reviews.author: Alim Karim
reviews.text: Professional, skilled and accommodating. Dave helped us replace a broken tankless heater, guiding us to the right model for us and installed it in an expedient manner. He's been performing maintenance on it every year for us and is always extremely efficient, cordial and accommodating on scheduling. Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Janice Wakimoto
reviews.text: Once again Ribbs Plumbing & Sewer came to the rescue for a backed-up toilet on a Friday afternoon and again (different toilet) on a Tuesday afternoon. Tim, CJ and Chris explained my options as they did not want to charge for extra work since the problems seemed resolved. I very much appreciated their being conservative but I chose the option (charge me) that hopefully insured no future problems.

reviews.author: Peggy Meng

I will recommend your business to anyone and everyone who is in need of plumbing services.

Just excellent!

reviews.author: Rob

reviews.author: C Perilloux

Richard and his helper were right on it for a propane gas water heater replacement, checked out everything, installed the same-fit/size replacement that we had lined up already right there,  and amazingly, they were done in exactly one hour!  That included re-soldering the hard-piped high-pressure relief pipe back together that needed to be removed just to do the install.  Quick work, and great workmanship!   Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Matthew Peirsel
reviews.text: I hired Excalibur to repair a shower faucet valve improperly installed by home flippers who didn’t know what they were doing. He explained the issue, fixed my shower so it is working correctly despite missing parts in the shower handle (flipper nonsense again) and showed me what missing parts I need and how to install them to make it fully right. He kept this work within the standard service call price. I am exceptionally happy with the service that Curtis provided and I recommend him for any plumbing needs you may have.

All of their plumbers that I have worked with are excellent. Kind, efficient, competent, and thorough. reviews.author: Blaire Hampton
