reviews.author: Gene Aizikovich
reviews.text: Andrew was fantastic. He was on time, repaired the water heater leak and also fixed the hvac problem. Very professional, honest, and efficient. I really appreciate his work and would definitely recommend him.

reviews.author: carmen catalina
reviews.text: I had just bought a house that needed a water softener system installed and FloRyte services was extremely responsive! Right away, they responded to my inquiry and gave me a quote. I was very pleased with the fast response and service, which was done on the weekend of the week I inquired about their services. While installing the water softener system, they identified a water pressure issue, indicating that my well pressure tank was not working optimally. I had tank specialists take a look, and FloRyte’s diagnosis was correct! I was very impressed. That instance, along with many others, was a testament of their expertise. Upon having the official diagnosis, they replaced my well pressure tank swiftly at a very reasonable price. Not only do they do plumbing services, they offer HVAC services as well! I had no heat on the second floor of my home, so I wanted to install a mini split system and they did so wonderfully, and now I have heat whenever! There were some issues with the unit, which was the manufacturers fault for sending a faulty system; however, when they heard there were issues with the unit, within the same week of checking it out, they ordered me a new one and installed it at no additional cost. Overall, FloRyte is an amazing company that offer swift solutions to big problems at very reasonable rates! I recommend them to everyone who is in need of fixing or improving their plumbing and/or HVAC. I am actually about to call them again to help fix the HVAC at my other property! Go with FloRyte, they’ll do your plumbing and HVAC right!

reviews.author: Scarlett Lee
reviews.text: Our house had a leaking pipe, and the FloRyte team was able to come out and fix it smoothly and very quickly. They were exceptionally polite and friendly, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone else experiencing the same issue!

reviews.author: Eddie
reviews.text: My water heater was leaking, the crew came out in a timely manner. Very professional and informative. Told me I needed a new water heater. They had me on the schedule in no time and brought the new water heater. The crew was polite, professional, knowledgeable and hard working. When they were done they went over everything they did and asked if I had questions. You can tell these guys took pride in their work. Price and quality was outstanding. Thanks again.

reviews.author: Kenneth Kennedy

We had a great experience with Roto-Rooter, we will definitely call them if we need help in the future!

reviews.author: Romie Rome
reviews.text: Well done job Armando and Hector! Super informative and helpful with guiding us through our questions. Great team! Drain hydro jet should take care of our reoccurring issues now.

reviews.author: Shelby Lawrence
reviews.text: Armando, an emergency plumber with Roto Rooter was called to my property yesterday evening. He was prompt, communicated well, very professional and knowledgable. He was able to resolve the urgent issue and with his in-depth evaluation was able to discover the root cause. I was very happy with his work and the company's offerings and transparency in the process. Thank you Armando and your team.

reviews.author: Michelle Martinez

Definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Erich Tompkins
reviews.text:
Stop searching for a plumber and use these
guys they are great!!!    I am a new customer
we searched online during the snow storm
b/c our water heater failed mid storm- they were out the next day after inspecting and were done with the full install after about 5 hrs, permits, electrical plumbing and they installed flood stops and sensors and hauled out the old one.   Jay build
an excellent plan and All don the guys who came out were clean friendly polite intelligent and professional.   Just a great efficient operation and my new go-to plumber!!!!!

reviews.author: Dayna Moser
reviews.text: During the most recent winter storm Our water heaters froze and broke causing water damage to the fist floor. Tribeca responded with a sense of urgency - they came over within hours to assess the situation and began researching our warranty. By the next morning they contacted us to confirm our order and a few hours later they were back for installation. Their team was courteous and respectful and got the job done quickly. They went above and beyond to lend us a space heater so the new water heater wouldn’t freeze overnight. We had hot water within 24 hours of reporting our issue. I would highly recommend them when you need help.

reviews.author: Chad Davis
reviews.text: I called on a Friday afternoon for a natural gas issue and they were able to squeeze me in last minute. Jay and AJ were great and solved my problem very quickly. Cost was less than I expected, which is always nice. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Adam Nonnenmacher
reviews.text: Jay did professional work and was quick to diagnose the problem with my frozen hot water tank inlet line in the attic. They added more insulation so it would thaw and eventually it came back. Quick response too.

reviews.author: Ian Wright
reviews.text: Had issues with water heaters and gas leaks, and Tribeca came out to the house and cleared up all the issues promptly. From friendly dispatch to timely arrivals to quality work, all around excellent experience. Special shout out to Jay for all his help!

plumbers.name: 1-Tom-Plumber
plumbers.address: 9200 Pyott Rd, Lake in the Hills, IL 60156, USA

reviews.author: Cordell Walker
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience with 1-Tom-Plumber from start to finish. They answered my call right away after I discovered my old water heater was leaking, which honestly caught me off guard since it was only about 8 years old. I had a big bulky 75-gallon Richmond power-vent water heater, and by the time I noticed the issue, water was leaking throughout my basement.

To make matters worse, some of my existing plumbing lines were already corroded and beginning to leak as well. I went a full week without hot water while trying to figure out the best long term solution, which was incredibly stressful.

When 1-Tom-Plumber came out, they were professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain all of my replacement options without pressure. After talking it through, I decided to upgrade to a tankless “endless hot water” system. I’m so glad I did.

The new system works amazingly well. I never run out of hot water, and unlike traditional systems, it doesn’t require a specific hard-water softener, so I didn’t have to invest in an additional water softening system. It also doesn’t require costly yearly flushes, which was a huge plus for me.

On top of that, the system comes with a 15-year manufacturer warranty and is made right here in America, which gave me even more confidence in my decision. The workmanship was truly top-notch, the installation was clean, and everything was explained clearly along the way.

I’m extremely happy with my experience and the upgrade. If you’re dealing with water heater issues or considering going tankless, I highly recommend 1-Tom-Plumber. They made a stressful situation so much easier and delivered excellent results.

reviews.author: Cy Nick
reviews.text: What I thought was a simple laundry clog turned out to be a much larger sewer job. Even though Justin was slotted for what was probably a fast job, he was still able to quickly adapt thanks to being incredibly prepared and having everything he could need in his truck, didn't have to run out for parts or tools even once. Got me back up and running quickly and expertly, highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kristina
reviews.text: I would absolutely recommend this company and its valuable employee Eric!  He was here within 2 hours (Sunday am at 7) for a leak in the garage ceiling.  Eric was professional and patient in answering our questions and very knowledgeable….for a cubs fan 😂.  He fixed the issue! I would absolutely recommend this company again

reviews.author: jose lopez
reviews.text: The place to call for sure , came home and my ceiling was about to cave in, called them and  they were here in the blink of an eye. Justin did an excellent job and was done in less than 20 minutes. Super friendly and professional.

reviews.author: Peter Bilik
reviews.text: Our tankless water heater froze during the recent subzero temperatures, causing the system to burst and we completely lost hot water. We have a 10 month old baby at home and it was a really tough spot to be in. 1-Tom-Plumber was recommended to us through a local community page and we gave them a shot. Eric was an absolute delight to work with, straightforward, and gave us multiple options not just equipment types but ways to pay. Moises, the owner was also very accommodating and they were all able to get us our hot water back in no time. The install looks clean and professional. They saved us during this big freeze. Thank you Eric!

plumbers.name: Plumbing Care Inc
plumbers.address: 3236 Fitzgerald Rd a, Rancho Cordova, CA 95742, USA

reviews.author: Marian
reviews.text:
I have used Plumbing Care Inc multiple times for plumbing and water heater issues at my multi-family apartment properties, and I consistently have a very positive experience—especially working with Technician Zhivko.

Zhivko always makes himself available to address urgent matters, often on the same day, which is extremely important in property management. He is professional, highly knowledgeable, honest, and patient. He takes the time to properly diagnose the issue and does whatever it takes to find the best and most practical solution for his clients.

It is truly a pleasure working with Plumbing Care Inc and Zhivko. Thank you very much, Zhivko, for your outstanding service.

reviews.author: Jang Kim
reviews.text: Plumbing Care sent two excellent technicians, Keith and Jesus, to repair a water leak at my home. They were very professional, careful, and did a thorough job. I really appreciated their attention to detail and the quality of their work. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Bernie Berke
reviews.text: Tech Alvictor Bradford III is very knowledgeable and professional with his work.  Especially enjoyed how personable he is. I highly recommend this company and if you are are lucky enough to get Alvictor as your repairman, you too will be pleased. Alvictor replaced a faulty pressure gauge, then installed a new Water Heater.

reviews.author: J. R.
reviews.text: Plumbing Care Inc. first came out to my home to confirm my suspicion that my A.O. Smith "industrial" size water heater, which was nine years old, was on its last legs. Lots of loud bangs were emanating from it. Alex confirmed it was, and taught me how to disable it and turn the gas off to the water heater while I was away for the holidays. We arranged for him to return and replace it with a tankless water heater, which has a 15-year warranty. Alex and Angel did a great job removing the old water heater and installing my new tankless water heater. They were efficient, cleaned up after themselves, and showed me the basics for operating the new water heater. The in-house staff were quick to respond to scheduling, send a quote, and finalize the invoice. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Jackie and Arthur Lee
reviews.text: Alan Altamirano of Plumbing Care Inc was very kind and professional. He fit the first flap in the toilet. When that didn’t work well, he went back to his supply store and got back to me within 20 minutes! He explained his steps and the reasoning. Got it all done expeditiously! He delivered completely and quickly.

reviews.author: Jason Pooler
reviews.text:
I had a leak in my kitchen faucet repaired by this company in August of last year. Less than a year later, I noticed another leak in the same place—the pipe connected to the sink was loose and barely staying in place. That same night it completely disconnected, which made it clear the original repair was not done properly.

I am very disappointed in this company. The quality of the work was poor, and I expected a lasting solution instead of dealing with the same problem again. This has been a frustrating and unprofessional experience, and I will not be using their services again

reviews.text:
I have had the unfortunate fate of dealing a lot with Cathedral Plumbing . They are the plumbers who did my New house and also respond to warranty calls . The other issue i had with them is my water meter box is not installed correctly . it does not sit flush in the grooves of the pipe like it needs to . reviews.text: Fantastic service. Got our water heater replaced with Dial One Johnson, and couldn’t be happier. Great deal on the price with the special they were running. reviews.author: Terry Stapleton
reviews.text: I have been very pleased  with Dial One Johnson. They have been to our home to assist us two times now. They’re always polite and perform excellent service.

reviews.author: Barbara Archibald
reviews.text: We had a leak at the floor on one of out toilets. Since we had been discussing replacing them for nearly a year, we decided this was the right time to do so. The tech came on Friday, gave us a quote for everything we wanted, and said he could deliver on Tuesday. On Tuesday he and another tech came and removed the old toilets and installed the new ones. Timeframe on Tuesday took about one and a half hours. Both techs were polite and worked diligently to get the job done (even though one dog kept barking at them the whole time). reviews.author: Alexis Lucia Oswald-Doering

reviews.author: A Vrtis
reviews.text: For starters, Maria handled my phone call to Atlanta Star Plumbing and was just incredible. She took down and processed my information quickly and was able to dispatch a crew same-day to stop a flooding issue in my home. Not only that but she was kind, caring, and helped brighten a frustrating day dealing with a plumbing issue! I would highly, highly recommend this company's services for any plumbing issues you might have in the Atlanta area!

reviews.author: Bernadette Tan
reviews.text: Stuart was very professional! He was quick to find out the cause of the flood and took the adequte measures for it not to happen it again. I am glad that he explained the reason of his acts such I can do better in the future as prevention.

plumbers.address: 1181 Revere Ave, San Francisco, CA 94124, USA

reviews.author: Maria Lydia Yanez de Paniagua
reviews.text: I had the pleasure to meet Joan Leyva a technician sent by Genteel Plumbers to do some needed work at my place. He was very kind, knowledgeable, well trained and he took time to explain all my options. At the end my family and I were very grateful for the outstanding service Joan provided. We would highly recommend him and his company for the professionalism and good quality work. Five Stars!!!

reviews.author: Colleen Howell
reviews.text:
Genteel Plumbers is committed to doing jobs right and to having satisfied customers.

I called them to fix some plumbing issues with our clothes washer (both the hot and cold lines were coming from the hot water heater). They sorted out the problem but when they went to turn the main back on, it wouldn’t come on. Turns out the main line under the driveway was deteriorating.

So they pulled all their available crew to come to our house to do an emergency main line replacement, which involved digging a trench in the driveway. Mind you it’s mid-day already and we are leaving for a vacation the next day. They worked as efficiently as they could to get everything finished and just before dark (probably 8pm since this was early July) they drove away.

I was incredibly impressed with their workmanship and dedication to getting the job done on our deadline, and they were so kind and respectful. However, the speed with which they had to work meant that they couldn’t put much time and attention to the driveway repair. So I mentioned a few months later that I wasn’t happy with the driveway and they agreed that it wasn’t their best work. I said it wasn’t urgent so anytime they could come repair it would be great.

Then early this week they called and said they would repair the driveway. Two days of work later it looks brand new. I will use Genteel Plumbers for all of my plumbing needs in the future.

I’ve never experienced a company so committed to customer satisfaction and all around they are incredibly kind, skilled, and quality people.

reviews.author: Laura Beaton
reviews.text:
One night, our bathtub faucet broke-- on. We could not turn it off. We shut off water to the house, and immediately called Genteel. Within a few minutes, we had an appointment booked for the next morning. The repair ended up being a pretty big one, but Genteel provided fantastic service: their work was prompt and the technicians were highly communicative, and helpful. The technicians were careful of our home, always wearing booties and cleaning up after themselves. They explained our options clearly, and helped us identify the best path forward, including helping pick new fixtures that were both high quality and high design. They quoted fair prices that reflected their high-quality work, and got the job done without surprises.

Big thanks to our expert technicians Daniel A. and Edgar C. for the excellent work.

My impression of Genteel is that they're not the cheapest option, but you get what you pay for --  their work and customer service is a step above.  Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jamie Rosenfield
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Genteel. We had a major water loss event at our home and Jo from Genteel was super helpful. He was diligent in locating the issue and resolving the leak, in addition to making some changes that would prevent further issues. He was patient with my questions, made recommendations without any pressure, and handled my home with care.

reviews.author: Christopher Van Dyke
reviews.text: Way overpriced. I needed earthquake valves and a water meter installed and it took a few hours, but was insanely expensive. I’ve stopped using Genteel after this experience. The work was fine, but I felt gouged enough to write this review and do more competitive bidding for all projects.

plumbers.name: Pike Plumbing
plumbers.address: 4341 Stilesboro Ln NW, Kennesaw, GA 30152, USA

reviews.author: Donald richardson
reviews.text: Pike Plumbing did a repiping of my home on November 25th due to a second slab leak since August that I experienced a week earlier. Zack had come out the previous Tuesday, Nov 18th, to give me a quote. That next Monday, Glen, who was coordinating everything, came out to check things out and to leave the supplies since the next day was going to be rainy. Glen was waiting outside when I woke up the next morning. The job started promptly around 9:30, and they finished around 3:30 that same day. The guys did a great job, and I was very satisfied with the outcome. I had contacted two other companies for a quote, and they missed the mark by a long shot. One of them even had me removing the vanity in the master bath. Pike was by far the best price. The price Zack quoted was the price I paid. A week later, I heard a strange thumping sound while using the hot water in the sink in the master bathroom, and they sent someone out to check it out and took care of it right away. I couldn't be happier with the job they did.

reviews.author: Kelly Busch
reviews.text: It is 3 days before Thanksgiving, I have elderly relatives arriving in a few hours, and our water pipe broke in the front yard right before the foundation. I explained my situation and he could hear the panic in my voice. This amazing company had a plumbing technician in my driveway within 2 hours. Thank you Pike Plumbing!! You saved the day and my entire holiday week.

reviews.author: Suzanne Purcell
reviews.text: This company can highly recommended to me and now I know why. I was able to get an appointment quickly and my service Technician Carson Weaver was fantastic and very knowledgeable. I know several people who have used this company for a variety of reasons and they have all been extremely satisfied with the service.

reviews.author: SRav

From my initial conversation where I was educated on all of my water heater options to the quick turn around in scheduling service and then the  exceptionally professional installation was by far a better experience on any/all services I have had on any repair in my house. Thank you Pike team

reviews.author: Alexis Shmookler
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Pike Plumbing today. They came recommended by several folks in my neighborhood. I called for some help to replace my tub drain and they were able to come out the very next day. Josh was extremely knowledgeable, friendly and honest. The price was reasonable - I will definitely be calling Pike again for any future plumbing needs. Thanks all!

reviews.author: Manoj Sachan
reviews.text: Great experience with this plumbing company. They replaced our ejector pump and basin and did a very clean and professional job. The team covered the carpets and walkways, completed the installation properly, and cleaned the area after finishing the work. Very happy with the service and would recommend them.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.text: Having to replace a water heater is never fun. From the start, this company communicated effectively and sent out a tech to inspect the issue. Gus, was very detail oriented and I appreciated that he explained things thoroughly. While their quote was not the cheapest, I felt confident that they would do the work right and they have a great warranty too! Day of installation, again, communication from the entire team was fantastic and everything went smoothly. Gus did an amazing job and I would highly recommend this company for any plumbing issues. I will definitely use them if a plumbing need arises. You get what you pay for, and this case it was excellent customer service and a smooth process to get a new water heater installed properly.

reviews.author: Clyde Miller
reviews.text:
Stellar Plumbing and Ken Saved Our Dream Home!
I had a serious plumbing emergency at my brand-new house—the dream home I was so excited about. Due to a high water table, the basement's sump pump setup, which was originally installed by a realtor that thinks he is a contractor (isn't good at either occupation), was running constantly (every 3.5 minutes!), destined to burn out and cause a major flood. I was incredibly nervous that I had bought a house that would constantly flood.

Fortunately, I know the owner of Stellar Plumbing, and they immediately sent out Ken. Ken has 16 years of experience in plumbing and even more in the trades, and his expertise was immediately apparent. He not only quickly assessed the faulty setup but also took the time to calm me down and walk me through the comprehensive solution.

This was a mini-construction project involving a deeper pit and a dual-pump solution with completely redone piping. While it was a significant investment, Ken assured me that his experience with similar projects meant this was the permanent fix I needed.

The results are astounding: our new system is robust, reliable, and the pumps now alternate, running only about every 15 minutes. I feel 100% more confident that my home is protected and has the right system in place. If you have any serious plumbing concerns, especially with water management, I can't recommend Ken and Stellar Plumbing highly enough. They are true professionals who deliver lasting peace of mind!

reviews.author: JOHN GROSS
reviews.text: I had Stellar out to give me a bid on a backup for our sump pump as well as a few other plumbing jobs.  They were very courteous, professional and knowledgable.  We are not planning to move forward with any projects at this time but I could tell that they were a very good company and would do a good job. I would recommend them.

reviews.author: Josh Stephens
reviews.text: They tried to say I had a broken sewer and wanted to dig up my yard and charge me $18500 for a full sewer line replacement. I have a warrenty for the sewer and water line I'd gotten through the village of Streamwood so I contacted them and they sent out another plumber (Center Gaurd Plumbing) to inspect the line. They cleared the blockage and revealed that Stellar didn't even map out the sewer line properly. When I brought these finding to Stellar they said that the plumber that came after didn't do a good job and that stellars efforts initially made it easier for the next guy to completely clear the line. Lol. So by that logic if their guy just stayed working at the clog he made (cause it wasn't backing up befor he meddle with it) they would have been able to clear it. I assume they gave up becuase they saw a way to make an easy $9k-18500. And I say that because the whole time this is happening Carlos was trying to sell me financing not realizing my warrenty would cover the cost of any and all repairs. Just really disappointing as the work they did was pricey but still adequate, I didn't mind paying extra if the job is done right but I do cross a line when you try to pull one over on me. Stellars guy didn't even map my sewer line out correctly if I had needed to use them they would have been poking holes in my yard like a geek squad installer trying to mount a TV on my wall. I thought this was a professional outfit but they couldn't even honor a partial refund when I called them out on them not finishing the job. At the end of the day it's just money I can make more but man I'd hate to have someone else pull a loan on something they don't need to.

reviews.text: They came out same day and installed a water heater tank. They were quiet, professional and arrived earlier than expected. reviews.author: AlanMZ Lee
reviews.text:

The work was done next day by Arturo and Denis - who were both professional and respectful! I needed to do this for house insurance purposes. But now have somebody I may call for a larger project. Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Jeronimo DeSenna
reviews.text:
I ran into a waterpipe situation on a Sunday and needed an urgent fix or I wouldnt have running water at my house. I called around with a few places on Google maps and they were either booked for the day or didnt answer.
I had ended up contacting Splashfix and during the middle of the call, the line disconnected. I was in a panic as I didnt know what to do.
Luckily, Isaac from SplashFix returned my call and I was able to explain my situation and how urgent it was and he advised me he would be able to stop by within the hour.
When he showed up, he listened and I was able to explain the situation. He was clear on what was going on, how it would be addressed and fixed, and what the cost would be (the cost was more than reasonable btw given the quality of work and also the friendly service).

reviews.author: Ryan See
reviews.text:
Updated Review:
While I wish we didn’t experience the situation described below… mistakes happen. How someone (or a company) responds to a mistake speaks volumes. ENCO quickly reached out, explained their side of the story and listened to my concerns. In the end, they addressed the situation and demonstrated character. In the future they will be my first call.

Original review:
While the plumber who visited was timely, worked efficiently, and was very polite, I cannot recommend this company due to their questionable billing practices.

After diagnosing our leak, the plumber provided us with a clear, agreed-upon quote for the repair. We accepted this price and the work was completed quickly and effectively.

However, when it came time to pay the bill, we were told, "Oh sorry, the price is $150 more." This last-minute, unquoted increase left an extremely bad taste in my mouth. A quote should be honored, and springing a substantial, unauthorized fee on a customer after the job is done is unacceptable and feels like a classic bait-and-switch.

For this reason, I would not recommend trusting this company. I will also be sharing this experience with our realtor who recommended them, as I would not want anyone else to face this kind of last-minute price gouging.

Avoid if you value transparent and trustworthy pricing.

It’s hard to find a company you can consistently count on, but Sugar Bear delivers every single time. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Masterpiece Plumbing & Drain, LLC
plumbers.address: 619 Huntover Ln, Frederick, MD 21703, USA

reviews.author: Emma Matuga
reviews.text: This is the best plumber ever. Sailo is knowledgeable at his work and quite friendly. My Sump pump stopped working and I had to buy a new one which he replaced for me. He arrived on time and talked me through as he installed the new one. I will recommend him anytime.

reviews.author: Amanda Graham
reviews.text: Top of the line service and a plumber with years of experience! I called another company to fix my clogged kitchen sink and they spent 2 hours and couldn't fix it. Sailo fixed it in 30 min! And was cheaper than the original company. He also has great customer service and cleaned up after he finished. I will be using Masterpiece for all my future plumbing!

reviews.author: Derek Ilopan
reviews.text:
Ask yourself one question: What do you want in a plumber? If your answer is honesty, integrity, reliability and professionalism - then hire Sailo (owner) of Masterpiece Plumbing & Drain.

Thought I was going to need an overhaul of the plumbing that comes in from the street into the house - turns out it was just a couple of joints that needed tightening due to age. Additionally, he educated me on all the valves and what each did. Very helpful.

Finally, I have another plumbing project I've put on hold for a few years and I will definitely be using Sailo when the time comes to do it.

Thanks again Sailo!

reviews.author: Lewis Barber
reviews.text: Awesome service. Fixed a busted spigot in my backyard (due to freezing weather), and charged half the price of a local plumber. Definitely got myself a new plumber!

reviews.author: Karen Klausmeyer
reviews.text: Sailo was fantastic. He installed my whole house water leak detector/shut off valve today! He really took the time to be sure it was in the best place and leveled! Affordable too!! I’d definitely use him again for any plumbing issues. He gets 10 stars because I just had water damage from a leaky kitchen faucet flooding my basement. I recommend this Frizzlife product and Sailo to install - worth every penny for peace of mind!!

plumbers.name: BMW Plumbing & Sewer
plumbers.address: 448 Lake Cook Rd Suite E, Deerfield, IL 60015, USA

reviews.author: Bex Row
reviews.text:
August 2025: I had an excellent experience with Fernando from BMW Plumbing. I called at 9am with a plumbing issue, and by noon, Fernando was at my door, ready to help. His professional, courteous, and confident approach reassured me right away.

By reviewing my service history beforehand, Fernando arrived fully prepared and aware of prior concerns. After completing the job, he walked me through what he had fixed and explained the follow-up steps needed for a lasting solution.

Fernando's professionalism and care turned a stressful situation into a manageable one. For anyone looking for reliable plumbing services, I can’t recommend BMW Plumbing and Fernando enough.

November 2024: I had a fantastic experience with Mario from BMW Plumbing. I called at 8 AM with a plumbing issue, and by noon, Mario was at my door ready to help. He is a very polite, professional, and knowledgeable young man who immediately put me at ease.

He took the time to explain exactly what he was going to do before starting the job, and kept me informed throughout the process. I really appreciated his thoroughness and attention to detail. After the job was completed, Mario gave me a detailed rundown of what was done, and also offered some valuable suggestions for future plumbing maintenance.

From the moment I greeted him, I knew I was in good hands. Mario’s professionalism and care made a stressful situation much easier to handle. I highly recommend BMW Plumbing, and especially Mario - to anyone in need of plumbing services.

reviews.author: Natalie Billig
reviews.text: Highly recommended. Great service and reasonable prices. When you need a new ejection pit, you need one asap.  Customer service on the phone was very pleasant and helpful. Our plumbing technician was knowledgeable and courteous. He kept us informed of his progress. I will definitely call BMW again when the inevitable plumbing crises arises.

reviews.author: JENNIFER Lang
reviews.text:
Great experience!  Plumbing problems are always cause for concern that you find the right professional!  From the start, BMW showed they are well organized and reliable.  David T came ready to solve the problem, offered advice on the best or worst of a complicated situation.
He made the repair efficiently, and thoroughly including clean up, and checked that everything was operating well.  We were very satisfied, and will become repeat customers as needed.

reviews.author: Sally Stone
reviews.text: I used  BMW for all my plumbing needs for over 20 years. They were always fair, professional, competent, and friendly.  Since Mike Dixon, the owner of BMW Plumbing retired, BMW is now 24/7 Plumbing. I was skeptical but hopeful that I would still get the same high quality service that Mike and his staff offered. For my most recent service, May 2025, I asked for a plumber (Conrad), who I've used for many years, who knows my house and all my equipment. I am very happy with the service and Conrad’s work. I’m glad they have kept their highly experienced plumbers and look forward to working with them for my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Susan Lewis
reviews.text: Conrad was very nice. That’s it. Not his fault, but the cost of a kitchen faucet and installation and 79.00 to walk in my door was $1,037. I knew he was talking about very high end faucet. Mine is American Standard, not high end. So I asked how much if I bought the faucet and he installed it. $495.00. I will never use you again. Before you bought this business from the previous owner I used them for a toilet problem and the cost was very reasonable.

plumbers.name: Blue Plumbing and Drain Cleaning LLC
plumbers.address: 8561 Florentine Rd F, Prescott Valley, AZ 86314, USA

reviews.author: Aims LL
reviews.text: This is an excellent business! They helped us with a part we were having trouble finding. They were extremely affordable, kind, easy to work with, communicated well and went above and beyond to help us. Very grateful to them!

reviews.author: Michelle Rush
reviews.text: Unfortunately, the place I rent has needed a lot of plumbing repairs the last couple months, but these Blue Plumbing was wonderful. Susie was quick to get us scheduled, and Robert did great work!

reviews.author: Debora Booth
reviews.text: My ex husband was a great plumber and I expect a lot. I am very satisfied and happy with Blue Plumbing. Their communication and follow up was extremely professional. I would definitely not call anyone else. I’m a customer for life.

reviews.author: Jessica Rose
reviews.text:
I wash shocked by the price, but that seems to be the cost of doing business these days. On the other hand they got here within 2 hrs and only took 50 mins, for that I am very pleased.
Jessica

reviews.author: doreen balansche
reviews.text: Brad and Susie were great.  It was early Sunday morning and I discovered a leak under my kitchen sink.  I called and they were out within a few hours.  Their professionalism was great and I will definitely recommend them to anyone with a plumbing issue.

plumbers.name: All Utah Plumbing, Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 4706 Lone View Ct, West Jordan, UT 84088, USA

reviews.author: Tamra Baca
reviews.text:
BLUF: Don’t hire these people—they’re the most incompetent, thieving "HVAC company" I've ever dealt with.

Full Story: Our fairly new furnace kept shutting off overnight, leaving us freezing. Before heading out of town, I called the first company I found on Google—THESE GUYS—since I couldn't remember our original installer.

They arrived promptly and seemed nice. They "claimed" to have cleaned the sensor but didn’t. How do I know? The problem wasn’t fixed. When I finally found my original HVAC guy, he checked the sensor and said if they cleaned it at all, they did a lousy job. Worse, they didn’t even check the FURNACE FILTER which was filthy and the likely culprit—all while charging me over $100.

While they were here, they quoted $1,200 for unnecessary work on my water heater, including cycling it (not needed), adding valves (also not needed), and cleaning sensors. They also wanted $50 PER BOLT to trim toilet bolts so the caps would stay on.

In the end, I only had them "clean" the furnace sensor—poorly—and they still charged me over $100. Then they slapped their stickers all over my furnace and water heater. They also left behind a broken screwdriver attachment and a pair of needle-nose pliers.

You know how you usually ignore those stickers? Not this time. I took the time to remove them—because that pile of trash is exactly what their work is worth.

reviews.author: Rachel Bex
reviews.text: Perez and Walter were amazing! They came same day to fix a broken sprinkler valve and made sure to educate on proper care and maintenance. Will definitely use them for future needs!

reviews.author: Jaclyn Nielson
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this company, specifically John. They were fast to arrive and provided me with great service. What I really appreciated is that John took the time to educate me about what was going on with my A/C system. Then he proceeded to give me the options of what he could do and gave me a pro/cons for all. I also appreciated that when I explained our specific housing situation he was able to tailor his recommendations. This company gave quality and costumer-specific service. Much appreciated and plan to use them for any similar needs in the future.

reviews.author: Jorge Saldivar
reviews.text:
The pilot on my water heater went out. I tried troubleshooting myself to no avail until I decided to call someone. I called another company first and they told me the first available appointment was next day. Called All Utah Plumbing, Heating & Air and they told me they would come to my house shortly after finishing another work they were doing.

They came to my house within an hour and got my water heater working almost instantly. Turns out it was an easy fix, but they explained the possible cause and gave me recommendations on what to do if it happens again. They also inspected my water softener and gave me tips to keep it working properly and prevent doing damage to my water heater and pipelines down the road. They were very knowledgeable, courteous, and I would definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Anastasia Taylor
reviews.text: I’m really happy with All Utah Plumbing, Heating & Air. The technician came to my house so quickly, right after I called the company. They were knowledgeable and ready to help right away. It’s the best customer service I have ever experienced. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for quick and efficient problem-solving. There were no extra fees, just fast and professional service, and everything they fixed works perfectly. I’m so grateful for my two technicians, Coy and Walt. They did the best job. Thank you. I will use them again!

plumbers.name: Plumbers Westminster | My Buddy
plumbers.address: 6981 Federal Blvd, Westminster, CO 80221, USA

reviews.author: Jessica Ngo
reviews.text:
I work for a plumbing company in California and my elderly grandmother lives in Colorado, she got taken advantage by other plumbers like blue sky and I called my buddy the plumber and they were professional, gave fair pricing, and quickly got a new water heater installed and fixed previous repairs that were not done up to code.

Wesley and his partner were great and very happy with service! Appreciate you taking care of my grandmothers home like it was your own !

reviews.author: Aaron Martinez
reviews.text: Quick and reliable. He came out and cleaned the roots in my main line. With honesty and talked me through why i didnt need to replace when the other guys said I need to spend the big bucks to replace main line.  If your looking for a trustworthy plumber My Buddy the Plumber is it!.

reviews.author: Menachem Bachayev
reviews.text:
I’ve used My Buddy The Plumber several times now and I would just like to take a moment to think them for their incredible service and response! Unlike many other plumbing companies in the industry, they are very honest truthful, and will always diagnose the problem with efficiency and ease!

Thank you, Johnny For coming out after hours to take a look at our sewer and fixing the problem right Then and there we really appreciate your help, and I definitely will be using you in the future!

reviews.author: Sandie P
reviews.text:
Well here it was Sunday night at 10 pm. My call was at 10 pm and by 1030 pm we're at my door. I had a major backup where sewage was in my bath tub and neither of my toilets flushed. I called two other well know companies and was told by one they could come out the following morning and the other only let me leave a message. No one called back. By 1230 AM the job was done. Paul snaked the line numerous times to be sure it was completely clear. Very professional and courtious. The cost was very reasonable.  I would not hesitate to use their service in the future. If you need a plumbing company My Buddy the Plumber is the one to call.
Thank you Paul for being here.

reviews.author: Jonathon Wyderko
reviews.text: I had a valve in my sprinkler box that was leaking and caused one of my sprinkler zones to continue running after the set sprinkler time. 2 techs came out to look at it and stated I had a crack in the top of a valve that was causing a leak and that I needed a new valve and new water lines which would cost $680+ with labor to fix. Due to the leak being on the top of the valve, I just bought a new valve from Ace Hardware for $34 and replaced the top my current valve and it has fixed the issue. I’m unsure what liability the company would carry doing a simple fix like this, but the quote I received seemed excessive for the job needed to fix it. The techs who showed up were very polite, professional, and able to diagnose my issue in a timely manner though.

plumbers.name: PLUMB GENIUS
plumbers.address: 25 N Fretz Ave, Edmond, OK 73003, USA

reviews.author: Michael Stewart
reviews.text:
I hired Plumb Genius/Trophy Plumbing to replace two sets of leaking shower valves on July 22nd, 2025. Simplest job ever. One shower valve set they replaced started leaking again on September 9th. I called them back to see if they would return and rectify the situation. They have a 30-day warranty on their work, but I was 17 days out of that window. These are shower valves...like I said, simplest job ever. Shower valves, in my experience, should last years (the ones they replaced were at least 10 years old...probably closer to 20). They were going to charge me $130 just to show up again. I would have happily paid them for the hourly work, but not a fee to show up (again) to fix (again) what they already proposed to have fixed, and what I paid over $500 to have them fix.

When they informed me the fee would apply in my case as I was out of their warranty window, I informed them I may as well pay someone else a service fee if Plumb Genius/Trophy Plumbing won't stand behind their work. But, they chose to let me move on to another vendor. Really bad business practice and questionable competence at basic plumbing work if you ask me. I will not use them again.

Integrity and character count for something in my opinion, and I can't support a business that doesn't stand behind their work. Especially only 47 days after they charged me $517 for basic, simple services.

reviews.author: Katie Tolbert
reviews.text: AHS sent this company out for a broken hot water tank. They wanted us to pay $1425 out of pocket. My husband took the hot water tank to Home Depot and got it exchanged for free and spent $18 on a new water line.  Total scam. Now called Trophy Plumbing. I’m guessing they changed the name due to terrible reviews.

reviews.author: Miranda Andrews
reviews.text: Jerred and Eric installed a new water heater after ours crapped out. They were 5 minutes early!  Amazing! They gave us a beautiful upgrade and were polite, detailed and professional. I would recommend them take care of you if you want things don’t correctly and up to code. Good job guys and thanks again for coming out on a Saturday.

reviews.author: Jack Washmon
reviews.text:
These people absolutely destroyed my girlfriend's yard, fixed the pipe, ripped up all her grass, and her bushes from the yard and just left them all laying there.
Use someone else, they don't care about the damage they do to your property.

reviews.author: Philip W
reviews.text:
I would give negative 5 stars if I could. Neither plumb, nor genius to be found. They came, "fixed" our water heater, which didn't make it 48 hours. We then initiate replacement through our home warranty.

Ask for an itemized estimate, if you dare, and it will be intentionally vague and riddled with charges that are inexplicable by their staff. I waited a full day for a call from a plumber to explain the items on the estimate and their alleged code violations. Never received a call.

As their supposed customer service representative said, "you can Google it" with regard to their alleged code violations. I did Google it and then got a second opinion. Turns out they coded the water heater to the wrong city, so the entire estimate was wrong. Still wondering what a $600 charge for "Water Modification" meant.

I call the home warranty company to initiate a correction of the incorrect estimate, and Plumb Genius' operations manager says the earliest they can call to correct the issue is Tuesday because of the holiday (it is Friday and we initiated the first service call the previous Friday).

So if you want a company that will do less than the bare minimum to fix their own mistakes, without the slightest sense of urgency, Plumb Genius will get it especially wrong for you. I got my money for the service call back from the home warranty company, and am going with the second opinion, whose estimate was correct the first time, and who thoroughly explained the work.

After this experience, I wouldn't trust them to work in my house, even if they were to correct the errors and perform decent customer service.

plumbers.name: Heil Plumbing & HVAC
plumbers.address: 9603 Deereco Rd Suite 304, Timonium, MD 21093, USA

reviews.author: Michael Kirks
reviews.text:
I would like to commend Heil Plumbing for the wonderful job they did completing our sewer plumbing project. From start to finish, the process was handled in an efficient, professional, and timely manner.
Thank you to Ashley in the office, who was very responsive to urgent requests, and to Jake, the first technician who came out to assess the issue.
We had a couple of plumbers come out to the house, but it was difficult getting a clear commitment from them regarding getting a cost estimate. After dealing with the back and forth, my wife decided to search online for a Howard County plumber and found Heil Plumbing’s phone number.
I called, and the very next day Jake came out to assess the problem. We truly appreciate Heil Plumbing’s prompt response. Jake quickly determined that the issue extended beyond what the previous plumbing companies had identified, which gave us much-needed clarity and direction.
A special thank you to Otto, the lead technician.  He was very knowledgeable and responsive, ensuring that everything was completed correctly and timely. The team worked diligently and kept me informed throughout the entire process.
It’s not always easy dealing with plumbing problems, but they made the experience smooth and stress-free. I truly appreciate their hard work and excellent customer service, and I highly recommend Heil Plumbing to anyone in need of reliable and efficient plumbing services.

reviews.author: Jen Seidel
reviews.text: We had a main line water pipe leak into our basement. This was a really scary and stressful situation for us. They needed to replace the whole entire pipe out to the sidewalk    It Sounded like a weeks worth of work at least and we really need our basement.   I called Heil Plumbing after posting something on Facebook. They came highly recommended immediately. From the time I called them  to the time they left was absolutely seamless and perfect. It was only 6 PM in the evening and no other companies were  open, but they were still in the office and answered the phone And it was not an answering service.    Whoever answered, the phone was as sweet as could be and very helpful.  And I instantly felt calmer    The sales tech that came out for the quote was friendly and very knowledgeable and made us feel very comfortable answering all our concerns . This was a Friday and they booked us for that Monday.  The crew came right on time and we cannot believe how efficient and fast they were. They started at 7:30 AM and finished by 1 PM.  A job like this is very messy, but as you can see from the photos, they kept all the dirt contained away from my neighbors yards. And then they hosed it off afterwards. They replaced our grass and seeded it, then covered it with plenty of hay, so there isn’t any mud anywhere. I am so grateful we used this company. We will definitely use them in the future if needed. And I highly recommend them.!

reviews.author: Harry Stello
reviews.text: I called today for an issue that I've been putting off for multiple months due to what I thought was a high priced fix ( my picket froze and cracked my water line outside). I called and talked to an Ai answering service who surprisingly got the everything correct without having to repeat anything. Chand and Ronaldo were dispatched about 30 minutes later and arrived about an hour after I placed my call. Chad was extremely professional and helpful. He methodically talked me through what and where he thought the problem was and where the break could have been. I signed the authorization for work, which gave me the price and detailed what work he was going to perform. About an hour later, they were done and they showed me where the break was in the water line (exactly where he thought the issue would be by the way). They turned the water on, verified they fixed the issue and the spicket worked as expected. I think Ronaldo has an excellent mentor! Thank you for the excellent customer service, you have a customer for life.

reviews.author: Mary Morgan
reviews.text:
Chad was great!  He was very knowledgeable. He outlined and explained the process of the new water heater installation.  He immediately recognized and addressed  my concern regarding the leak and possible damage to my floors. Colin was a great help in the process.
HEIL is the  company to call FIRST! They RESPOND quickly!!!  THANK YOU!

reviews.author: Sally DS
reviews.text: I have used Heil Plumbing for many years and they always do good work at a fair price. My technician,  Chad K., was professional, very thorough and explained everything to me. Highly recommend.

plumbers.address: 3820 Quay St, Wheat Ridge, CO 80033, USA

reviews.author: Michael Heffez
reviews.text: If you like working with a family-run business and want fair, competitive pricing I highly encourage reaching out to Drain Terrier. Savannah in the office is extremely responsive, either always available or returning calls same day. They were able to beat prices from a number of other companies, I think because they don’t hire out additional subs. Tracy is a great guy, extremely fair and trustworthy. He was even at our job site throughout the project, ensuring I was comfortable with the oversight and keeping things on time. Finally the team performing the work was high quality as well. Couldn’t recommend more.

reviews.author: Diane Jansson
reviews.text: Nate was so nice and knowledgeable. He was willing to hear our thoughts and requests. He did a fantastic job fixing our plumbing issues. We are so grateful! We only wish we had done this sooner!

reviews.author: Shannon Milliken
reviews.text: Well it's been a day... after son vomited in the sink,  the shower backed up.🤮   Never good to see floating carrots in your shower.   Drain Terrier responded promptly to my call and I benefited from a schedule change to have Nick at my house within 10 minutes. 🤯  He was pleasant to work with and very patient with my questions.   Quick and reasonably priced.    I live in a 1953 build and plan to use DT for all of my future plumbing work.

reviews.author: Micah P.
reviews.text: Drain Terriers are awesome! We’ve had them out for several urgent problems. Each time, their words matched their actions and they did great work at fair prices. The dispatchers are kind & helpful. So is our plumber Nick, who knows his stuff and is backed up by an equally skilled crew.

reviews.author: Christine
reviews.text: Our water heater stopped working & Jacob came out to replace it same day.  He was on time, knowledgeable & no pressure. He explained our options &  had a new water heater installed and old one hauled away in a couple of hours. Highly recommend Jacob with Drain Terrier!

plumbers.name: New Flow Plumbing
plumbers.address: 622 Whyte Ave, Roseville, CA 95661, USA

reviews.author: David Verhaag
reviews.text:
We replaced a twenty year old water heater and wanted to use a local plumber.
New Flow is in Roseville, and answered our call promptly sending their representative Vito the following day.
He proceeded to discuss extensively the needs, available replacement water heaters as well as their warranties and pros and cons. He was forthcoming, honest , and we felt he was really professional in his presentation.

Vito’s Installation was scheduled per our wishes, and today they arrived exactly as they said, installed in a remarkably professional manner, with post installation extensive discussion of use and if we had any further questions.

This expierience was clearly an OUTSTANDING, SATISFYING, purchase and installation of a home appliance as we have encountered in our 45 years of owning our home.

My wife and I can recommend NEW FLOW for any of your plumbing needs. Prompt, professional service by truly artisans of their profession.

reviews.author: Grant Scheurich
reviews.text: I had an emergency with my kitchen faucet. Pipes were leaking everywhere and there was no water pressure. Arman was able to come out quickly, get the parts replaced, fix the water pressure issue and explain to me exactly what caused the leak. No issues since. Customer service was excellent all the way around. I'd recommend anyone in the area needing plumbing work to go with New Flow!

reviews.author: Brenda Lacey
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about New Flow Plumbing ! The same day I reached out, they came and did an exceptional job at a very fair price! It is very rare these days to find a company that is honest, professional, and kind. For now on if I ever have any plumbing issues I will definitely call them and you should too! May God richly bless you and your company!!!

reviews.author: Troy Knotts
reviews.text: I have to thank my Landlord for hiring this company. To start with they are very likable guys ! From assessing the issue to fixing the problem was 3hours, start to finish. That means they figured out that the hot water heater was bad. They purchased and installed it in 3hrs. Absolutely flawless!

reviews.author: Ryan Nichols-Roy
reviews.text: I had a clogged shower drain that had gotten worse over a few weeks. I called New Flow and within an hour Arman was at my door and solved the issue for me quickly and cleanly. Terrific service - thank you!

plumbers.name: Whistle Plumbing
plumbers.address: 158 Dennis Dr, Daly City, CA 94015, USA

reviews.author: Mommy Amazon
reviews.text: Paul is always great! If you are a female who doesn’t want to be taken advantage of, call Whistle plumbing! Reasonable costs, a discount for being a loyal customer, always a clear explanation and honest answers.

reviews.author: Aldrich Banez
reviews.text:
Over the years, my wife and I have relied on Whistle Plumbing for our
household plumbing needs. We have called upon their services multiple
times and will continue to do so for plumbing issues that may arise.
Their professionalism and reliability have consistently impressed us.

Paul, the main point of contact at Whistle Plumbing, has always
demonstrated a high level of responsiveness, honesty, and diligence.
The first time we reached out to him was due to a leak in a pipe that
was connected to our water heater. The leak occurred over the weekend,
making it challenging to find someone available to help. Despite this,
Paul arrived shortly after our call and efficiently replaced the
faulty pipe, resolving the issue without delay.

On another occasion, we experienced an issue with one of our toilets.
Although Paul was unavailable at the time, he sent two of his team
members to handle the repair promptly. What stood out to us was Paul's
attention to customer satisfaction—he followed up with a phone call
after the repair to ensure everything was functioning properly and
that we were satisfied with the service.

Most recently, we discovered brown stains on the ceiling directly
beneath our upstairs bathroom, indicating a possible leak. Paul came
over to assess the situation and was able to determine what the issue
was after examining the first-floor ceiling and then the bathtub in
the bathroom upstairs. His expertise allowed him to identify and
provided us with options regarding fixing the issue.

Throughout all our experiences with Whistle Plumbing, we have found
their pricing to be very fair. We are consistently pleased with the
quality of service and the attention to detail they provide, which is
why we continue to trust them with our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Alexander Early
reviews.text:
The only plumber that wasn't trying to rip me off for a toilet replacement!  Also installed my bidet no questions asked.

Later, when I needed my on-demand water header replaced, he was the first I called. He did a great Navien install for a fair price. Would totally recommend!

reviews.author: True Training 101
reviews.text: Paul and his crew are the best! Punctual, friendly, professional and they go above and beyond. Paul gives honest estimates of the work and declines work that doesn't need to be done! He never upsells or finds additional issues to fix. I'll be a Whistle Plumbing customer for life!

reviews.author: Kenneth W
reviews.text:
I'm a laundromat owner and I've been use Whistle Plumbing for many years.  Paul and his team have been answering my calls whenever I was in emergency situations.  My last service call to him was at New Year's Eve and Paul and his team came to me rescue on my busiest day of the year.
I value Paul's professionalism and honesty that I never ask for a quote before his work begins because I trusted him, 100%.
He is my guy 👍
Thank you,
Ken / laundromat owner

plumbers.name: 2020 Drain Clean & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 14325 Willard Rd # D, Chantilly, VA 20151, USA

reviews.author: Eric C.
reviews.text: I highly recommend 2020 Drain Clean.  They were very quick to come to my house and fix the clogged drain and the technician was very professional and courteous.  I was particularly impressed with his diligence in finding the obstruction, which turned out being more than 50 feet down the pipe.  Don’t hesitate to call them.

reviews.author: S Akbar
reviews.text: Very professional. I had an under ground leak in the front yard and had to install a new pipe from a water meter to the inside the house. The guys took care of it quickly and very professionally. I was very impressed with the work they did. From beginning to end it went smoothly. I would hire them again in the future.

reviews.author: Khanh Huynh
reviews.text: We had our Tankless water heater fail at our shop and 2020 DC&P helped out tremendously with diagnosing and replacement of the unit as fast as they could. Josh was transparent and prompt with us so we are really happy with the service. Thanks!

reviews.author: daniel davis
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with 2020 Drain Clean & Plumbing for the replacement and installation of my water heater, and I couldn't be happier with the service! From start to finish, [he/she/they] demonstrated exceptional professionalism and expertise.

2020 Drain Clean & Plumbing arrived on time and took the time to assess my old unit before explaining the different options available. Their knowledge helped me select the best water heater that suited my needs and budget. The installation process was smooth and efficient.

What impressed me most was their attention to detail and commitment to customer satisfaction. After the installation, They walked me through how to operate the new unit and answered all my questions patiently.

Overall, I highly recommend 2020 Drain Clean & Plumbing for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: L. C.
reviews.text:
I've written reviews in the past about 20 20 Drain Clean and I am at it again. I cannot highly recommend them enough! When a significant leak cause serious damage in my home, they came to my rescue. Not only did they arrive promptly to assess the situation, but their team quickly got to work and effectively stopped the leak.
But what truly impressed me was their skillful ability to re-pipe my entire house at an incredible price. Lee and Abdul's expertise and skill were evident throughout the process. I called a couple of companies, but they could not come out until the following week. A co-worker recommended Kindred Plumbing and I called them right away!
Blessing 1. Anne answered, and took my info and answered my questions, her calm demeaner was infectious. She had me hold on and made a call.
Blessing 2. She got back to me and said these words: "God just blessed you today, because Caleb just finished a job and can be at your place next." I couldn't believe what I was hearing!!! I worked out things at work and was able to leave early, thanks to my fantastic co-workers taking over my duties, and my supervisor giving the ok for me to leave.
Blessing 3. I met Caleb, he got to the house a little before me and had already started assessing the problem, I/we were so relieved that over all the plumbing situation wasn't as bad as we thought, although it definitely needed some attention.
Blessing 4. Caleb got the job done all in the same day!!!! He also took care of another issue that we did not know was happening.
Blessing 5. IT WAS AFFORDABLE!!! YES!!!

Caleb told us that he was booked through March... Just let that sit for minute, booked through March, and I make one phone call and he is available to come on that day, and finish the job in the same day.... Anne said it, this was most definitely a blessing from God!

Thanks Kindred Plumbing, and Thanks to God!

It was a long day but I was so grateful that Spicewood had certified plumbing technicians to install new Naviens. I had a tutorial how to prevent future freezing of water lines within the tankless and Josh knows his business!!  I am 100% satisfied and they are my “go to” plumbers for help!!
Thanks again Spicewood.

He said he told the babysitter it was okay and left for the night. It may have been, but why not text us? He texted all other times, you know? So nit knowing we turned off our water. Then he finishes the job on the third day and EVERYTHING'S LOOSE! the shower head, the tub spout and the handle theb the water runs out of the shower hesd for a good 30 seconds agter shut off. This is where it gets truly terrible, when I had to call his customer service line.

His cusotmer service line dude UNHINGED! I tell him my issues and he says it is supposed to work like that, accuses me of lying to him and REPEATEDLY hangs up on me! It is the most outrageous situation I have ever been in. Smithy eventually call me apologizing, saying he fires the guy and that nit won't happen again.
