reviews.text:
Royal Flush is an extraordinary group of workers. At all levels I spoke with or talked with several employees and all good people. Shout out to Richard- who is humble, knowledgeable, has a true servant’s heart and treated us, our home and the work like he was family always willing to go the extra step, calm, just “get it done” and done “right” sort.

Ours is an older house built in the 50’ or 60s with cast iron sewer. We knew we had roots … and when they totally clogged half the house leading to the master bath and we accidentally snapped the cleaning cable off in the pipes trying to fix it ourselves we knew we needed professional help. However, who to trust such a large job?  We received estimates from six companies. Royal Flush had one of the most reasonable quotes! Hands down Richard’s willingness to answer all the crazy questions as we weighed our options and worked through all the brain trauma from what we were facing and he was patient with us… never pushing or causing us to feel any pressure. No hard sales pitch. It’s a lot talking about tunneling 40’ under two bathrooms to totally replace the sewer lines. We appreciate Kevin stopping by to determine alternatives to help us also be able to get the kitchen and laundry done so it was a complete replacement of all sewer lines. As well as his consideration for us on some slight changes to the quote. Those things were a positive tipping point for us. We felt like we were being treated fairly and respectfully.

After looking at the long cracks in the old cast iron that came out after 70 years of use and the massive infiltration of roots I know we made the right decision to replace it all and an even better decision on who to use to do the work. Royal Flush!

We were well taken care of. I can not say enough good things about our experience.

reviews.author: Sondra Herr
reviews.text: Royal flush came and worked on my old house.  I had a clogged pipe. They did an excellent job trying to get that clog undone. They went above and beyond to achieve that goal. You rock Royal Flush you saved my day!!

reviews.author: Neko Reed
reviews.text: Garrett, what can I say but what an amazing job he just did on our house! Leaking water in our guest bathroom to hour master bedroom and bathroom! Ha! No match! My kids and wife are soo happy now. Feel like a new bathroom! High quality representation, affordable prices and speedy work!!

plumbers.name: Matrix Plumbing
plumbers.address: 401 W Bedford Euless Rd suite D, Hurst, TX 76053, USA

reviews.author: Max Kjelin
reviews.text:
If you need a solid plumber in Fort Worth, look no further than Matrix Plumbing. They recently handled a difficult water heater replacement in my attic, and the quality of work was top-notch.
The office manager Veronica was fantastic—she made scheduling the service call incredibly easy and provided clear communication throughout. The technicians were professional, punctual, and experts at navigating the attic installation without any issues. For anyone looking for water heater repair or installation in Fort Worth, TX, I highly recommend this team!

reviews.author: Michael Quigley
reviews.text: If you’ve got a gas leak, call Matrix and ask for Eddie. He was onsite fast, handled the repairs in a day, and was incredibly easy to deal with. He took the 'scare' out of the situation and charged a very fair price. I’m a very satisfied homeowner with total peace of mind!

reviews.author: Hugh Harris
reviews.text: Huge thanks to Matrix Plumbing! Brad arrived exactly when he said he would, found that our “leak” was just a loose, corroded pipe connection, and fixed it fast, saving us from a costly repair. He also replaced two toilets for us later on. Super professional, honest, and friendly.  At no time did I think I was being up sold.   Great experience all around!

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with Matrix Plumbing! I noticed a water leak under my master bathroom sinks and called them for help. Jason arrived promptly and quickly identified the issue. He fixed it in under an hour, which was such a relief since I was worried it might be something major. I’m really happy with the service and highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Grace Bauer
reviews.text: Finding a gas leak is an immediate panic moment, but Eddie from Matrix Plumbing was a total lifesaver. He arrived fast, clearly knew his stuff, and had a way of calming my nerves instantly. He finished the entire job in just one day at a very fair price. I finally have my peace of mind back—thanks for being a pro, Eddie!

plumbers.name: Berks Plumbing & HVAC Specialist
plumbers.address: 201 E Bellevue Ave Building 1A, Reading, PA 19605, USA

reviews.author: Enrique Mentado Sosa
reviews.text: Mike, Ethan, Jose, and Bradley were a fantastic group of guys to work with. They made getting rid of a leaking water heater a breeze even though they had little to no room to work in. They also installed a brand new tankless water heater system. They were able to get the job done in a single day! 100% will be calling Berks for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Josh Keim
reviews.text: We had an exemplary experience overall, quick response time through the whole process, I felt like a valued customer through and through. After they helped with a tub remodel, they came back to help me with another issue the next day and free of charge. Jose and Ethan were professional and great with our dog as they came in and out of the home. They left no mess behind a big job.

reviews.author: Jeff Lange
reviews.text: Berks plumbing has our business for life, You can’t beat the timely response and care from them. Called at 8pm at night and Mike was there next morning EARLY, which is very rare nowadays. Assessed everything, had Blake and Jose come out within the hour and was done in under 2 hours. Calls berks plumbing they WILL take care of you. 🫡

reviews.author: Just Me
reviews.text:
Excellent service! We recently moved back to Berks and the plumber I used in the 70's has retired. After looking over the reviews, i chose Berks Plumbing and are so glad I did!! Immediate response, quick consultation and installation on the same day!
Everyone I dealt with was super friendly, polite and professional!
Blake and Travis did a wonderful job on the installation of my new kitchen faucet with no mess! Mike helped me pick out exactly what needed! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Kim Lechuga
reviews.text: Called after dinner time,  pleasantly surprised to have someone answer the phone!  Someone came the next morning and despite not getting the news I wanted,  which was a quick easy answer, they had the guys here fixing my plumbing almost right away.  Nice, non-intrusive,  clean, and professional work.  Can't ask for more than that.   Great experience minus actually needing the repair work!

plumbers.name: Home Love Plumbing
plumbers.address: 51 S Main Ave #301, Clearwater, FL 33765, USA

reviews.author: Bernadette Homan
reviews.text: Very responsive company, easy to work with.   Plumbers and office staff (Lisa) are all very helpful, respectful and courteous.   Highly recommend. 10.1.25  Julio and Cameron did an excellent job.  Replaced corroded plumbing under driveway to get me back up and running.   Dealt with issues for 2 months and apparently all is well.  Julio repaired the driveway very close to original.  He also added a cleanout on ground level so future they didn't need to climb on roof. I am happy.  If I need plumber again I will definitely ask for Julio.   He and Cameron were polite, respectful of me and my home.  I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Tran The man
reviews.text: The service we got with Adam was professional and effective. He didn't leave until the issue (clog) was resolved.  He took the Time to explain everything he was doing and gave us suggestions on how to maintain the drain lines.  Thanks again Adam!

reviews.author: Nancy R
reviews.text: The team at Home Love Plumbing did an excellent job replacing one of our water heater and flushing the other. Bri was great in scheduling the work and kept us up to date. Julio and Jared were very helpful, conscientious and professional. I would highly recommend them for any plumbing work!

reviews.author: Martin Morrison
reviews.text:
The pipe to our hose split near the wall.  Adam from Home Love Plumbing came over that same evening to prepare an estimate.  He returned the Nex day with a second plumber, Ivan.  They chipped open the wall to access the pipe, replaced the damaged section and hose shutoff.  The guys explained everything they were doing and asked if we had repair preferences.  Plus, they had a good sense of humor.  Additionally, Bree in the office was very helpful from start to finish.

I will certainly call for their help again if I need it and recommend others consider using them also.

reviews.author: Bud Haimbaugh
reviews.text: Employee showed up on time and addressed the problem and provided a reasonable quote and went to work fixing the issue! Cleaned up the area and took care of the problem and did some extra cleaning ofthe plugged up toilet! They are going to be our plumbers on file !

plumbers.name: Payless Water Heaters and Tankless Water Heaters
plumbers.address: 37370 Cedar Blvd, Newark, CA 94560, USA

reviews.author: Alpa Gandhi
reviews.text:
I had called Payless as there was some noise coming from our hot water system. They came on the same day after giving us lots of information about whom to expect and around what time. We were sent a photo id of the person coming. Donovan G arrived on time , had a thorough look and gave us advice on what our options were and based on that, we decided best option was to get the system changed. He very quickly gave us a quote and organized a time to come the next day in the morning so we could get hot water as soon as possible.
Joel and Eduardo had helped him on the two days. They arrived earlier than their time, fixed the system, explained in detail what work was carried out, what to do in case of an emergency. Also explained in detail what the cost was. They left as quietly as they arrived and left the place very clean.

reviews.author: Matt S.
reviews.text: Overall fantastic experience. Scheduling was fast and easy. They let me know exactly when Tristan would arrive and he arrived right on time. He discovered serious issues with my existing water heater and walked me through my options. The options were good and flexible to my needs. Tristan had everything he needed and installed everything same day within about 4-5 hours, which was awesome. I wasn’t bothered at all during the installation, no hiccups or flagging cumbersome issues. They cleaned everything up like they were never there. The water heaters they sell are incredibly quiet. My Navien sounded like BART leaving a station every time it started up. Good riddance! Thanks Tristan!

reviews.author: Matvey Farber
reviews.text: Great service. Water heater went out thanksgiving day, Tristan  came out first thing Friday morning. I was provided with a thorough and clear explanation of the status of my 20+year old water heater and my options on how to proceed. Tristan took extra time to answer all my questions thoroughly and did not push me on which path to go with. The work itself is immaculate and very well done. I feel good having a reliable, higher end,  and properly installed water heater.

reviews.author: Thomas De Arth
reviews.text:
Service call was fair ($59) and the technician was very nice and professional.    No complaints at all-Prompt and on time.

The 3 yrs old hot water heater needed parts (gas control valve and an attached sensor), which were under warranty but Payless wanted to charge $750 to install the replacement, which I have been told by 4 different local companies that it takes between 15 and 20 minutes.  Now I get there is a cost for knowledge but $2,250/hr ($750 /20 minutes x 3 = $2,250/hr).?  Seriously????

Whatever happened to fair and reasonable business practices?  Do we have to rip each other off like this?  I mean, I understand that there is travel time, equipment, and repair truck cost but $2,250/hr?

The repairman told me that everyone would be about the same but that in-fact was not the case. Called 4 other plumbing companies who quoted between $250 and $350 for the job.

Moral of the story, shop around and  WATCH out for these guys.  They draw you in by their rapid response.

“Payless” should be renamed as “Pay More - a LOT More!”

reviews.author: Kevin Yip
reviews.text: I was in desperate need to repair Bradford White hydraulic water heater because tenant has been without hot water and heat for several days. My plumber needs several days to get the parts. So I called Payless with the model and serial number asking if they have the parts. They replied later saying yes. However, the technician called me from the house next day saying that they don't repair hydraulic heater when I gave them the model already. A waste of one valuable day despite my due diligence. Other than that everything was good.

plumbers.name: Drainmen plumbing inc
plumbers.address: 21 N Hanover St, Pottstown, PA 19464, USA

reviews.author: marybeth krause
reviews.text: Called and John came out the next day to replace the dip tube and anode on my hot water heater. Very happy with the work done and the additional advice John gave me on replacing the heater elements (did it myself the next day with no issues), the limitations of the basement sump pump, and information on what various things cost. Will definitely call the next time I need plumbing work!

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.text: After a terrible experience with their virtual assistant,  I spoke to someone last night and they apologized for the issues with the VA.  They were very apologetic so I called them today after a ridiculously high quote from someone else.  They came out and diagnosed the problem and had it repaired, saved us from having to put in a new hot water heater and followed through until the end.  We appreciate that John came out even though he wasn't on weekend call.

reviews.author: Deb gill Gill
reviews.text: Discovered a leak early afternoon of January 2.  Called right away and the crew showed up before the time frame I was given.  Once again courtesy, professional and problem solved within a matter of minutes.  This was a call back and they honored it.

reviews.author: Sean Dolan
reviews.text: Called in the morning and they were able to be out by mid afternoon. John and Mike both diagnosed the blockage fairly quickly and John was able use the snake and camera to clear the blockage. They were friendly, professional and informative in their work. Hopefully I don’t have any plumbing issues for many years but when an issue arises I know who to call and I will be recommending them to any family and friends that experience plumbing issues.

reviews.author: nicole f
reviews.text: Mr. Mike Ammouri is awesome! He is a man of his word, he came and completed the repair on our sewer lateral line in one day. There was a complication with the project due to the township error. Mike resolved the issue and we are pleased with his work. Great job Mike and we appreciate your timely response. I highly recommend Drainmen Plumbing!!! He also did an awesome job putting my lawn back together.

plumbers.name: H2Flow Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2258 Walls Rd, Greer, SC 29651, USA

reviews.author: patti Kellems
reviews.text: Phillip Waters came to our home to what we diagnosed was a water heater element gone wrong.  He quickly diagnosed our issue to be a pressure regulating valve and thermal expansion tank.  He explained the problem to my husband completely, answered his questions and went to purchase the parts.  Phillip was courteous, friendly, and used his time efficiently.In the 20 years we have lived here this was by far the most professional plumber work on our home.

reviews.author: Warren Martin
reviews.text: Phillip was absolutely great! He does a super neat job and his prices are very reasonable. He replaced faucets and repaired toilets in both my bathrooms, and installed new faucets in my kitchen sink. This is the kind of work you wish all repair people would do for everything in your house. 😊

reviews.author: Kathryn Kylee
reviews.text: I have used Phillip a couple of times for various plumbing projects.  He is Professional, Knowledgeable, Friendly and very helpful.  I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Tressie S
reviews.text:
From start, came out to do estimate within two business days of calling, arrived on time, courteous and professional in the appraisal of the work that needed to be done.

Appointment for install three days later. Had estimates from two other companies, H2Flo was most knowledgeable in understanding what needed to be done at a vastly better price.

To finish, installed the new gas water into garage, removed old water heater from attic in just three hours. Their knowledge and expertise shows in their work. Very pleased.

reviews.author: Joann Shackelford
reviews.text: Reached out to H2 Flow with a drainage problem, They got back to me in a timely manner. Was very professional and reasonable. I definitely will be using them again.

plumbers.name: C. Lee Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 4315 Hudson Dr, Stow, OH 44224, USA

reviews.author: Jessica Rodriguez
reviews.text:
We had an outstanding experience with Jon and Jonny from C. Lee! They were incredibly professional, kind and committed to getting the job done right. Our natural gas pipes needed serious attention, and they worked tirelessly to make sure everything was fixed safely and efficiently. Their clear communication and friendly attitude made the whole process so much easier. We truly appreciate their hard work and dedication
- highly recommend Jon, Jonny, and the entire team at C. Lee!

reviews.author: Terri Brown
reviews.text: C Lee has been my go-to for plumbing in all the 23 years I’ve been in Stow.  Always great service from scheduling, to install, to clean-up…reliably fantastic.  They today replaced my 24 year-old water heater in a few hours on very short notice.  Easy to work with, fair prices, rock-solid workmanship.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Hannah Betsinger
reviews.text: Tim was great! Very professional, knowledgeable, and he did a fantastic job installing a new gas line and repairing a pipe. I would highly recommend them and look forward to using them for future projects.

reviews.author: Martin Frantz
reviews.text: John was knowledgeable, personable and patient. He answered all my questions and explained everything. I couldn’t be happier with the installation of my water softener system.

reviews.author: Marsha Olesky
reviews.text: Tim was very Experienced, explained what he was doing and why. Very appreciative of his knowledge and work would recommend him for another job and we definitely call if I have any more plumbing issues.

plumbers.name: Aqua Knight Plumbing, Sewer, HVAC Services & Protection
plumbers.address: 2815 Forbs Ave Suite 107 #141, Hoffman Estates, IL 60192, USA

reviews.author: Jeffrey Marinier
reviews.text: Deacon was the most trustworthy and caring contractor I have ever had in my home. He stayed at my house extremely late into the evening to ensure he didn’t leave my home in a bad spot. I felt the pricing was fair, and Deacon and the Aqua Knight team ensured the final solution was seen through. I would highly recommend Deacon and the whole Aqua Knight team. By the time Aqua Knight had resolved the situation, Deacon felt like an old friend.

reviews.author: Tony Bylina
reviews.text:
Lucas from Aqua Knight Plumbing did an excellent job from start to finish. He came out for an assessment and was extremely thorough in his explanations, taking the time to walk me through what was going on and what needed to be done—no rushing, no vague answers.

He successfully replaced our sump pump and also made a strong effort to remove as much of the root intrusion as possible from the clay portion of our plumbing line, explaining limitations clearly and honestly along the way. It was obvious he cared about doing the job right, not just doing it fast.

What really stood out was his follow-up service. When our sink later froze up, Lucas came back and used a smart, practical warm-water approach to safely melt the blockage and get everything flowing again—allowing us to use our dishwasher without further issues.

Professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful. Lucas is the kind of technician you hope shows up at your door, and Aqua Knight Plumbing is lucky to have him.

reviews.author: Donna Perez
reviews.text: Lucas did a great job. Put everything back when he was complete. Explained everything very well. Would definitely recommend him and Aqua Knight Plumbing.

reviews.author: CMA
reviews.text: I cannot recommend AquaKnight more strongly for any and all plumbing needs - this company is the absolute best there is, bar none!  We had a plumbing emergency this past summer, early on a Sunday morning and they seemingly raced to our home to come to our aid!  This company knew we have had some medical issues historically and they were on the job immediately.  Our beloved dog had died just prior to this incident, adding to the already stressful situation.  Daniel really listens to us as customers and has understood certain issues with regard to a medical issue that can be problematic within our home if we get water damage -  and handled it with such empathy and concern.  He explains things thoroughly and provides detail about why certain solutions are recommended.  He is a trusted resource for us and we never have to second guess or feel like we are being overcharged.  We have had the extreme pleasure of work done by Lucas and Matt, as well!  Such knowledgeable plumbers!  Exemplary work by all  of these men and phenomenal customer service.  Who knows their plumbers (plural) by name??!  Great guys!My parents also use this company religiously, too!  Recently, Daniel literally saved us from nearly being scammed by a “handyman” who started to do some work for us with an appliance repair - somehow my husband and I got our signals crossed and yadda yadda yadda, this “handyman” started working on replacing our sump pump.  The pump was completely insufficient in size and we were one storm away from flooding!  The initial part of the job was started by this handyman and tree roots were left in the pit of our crawlspace, which we might never have seen, had Daniel at AquaKnight not checked it out for us.  He discovered the insufficient pump and poor workmanship.  We knew the handyman was also overcharging us based on the product!  AquaKnight to the rescue, but of course!  We terminated the unfinished work by the handyman and had it all redone by AquaKnight!  Daniel spent after business hours and a Saturday night providing us with information on what the best solution actually was, as well as the reasons the other work could prove utterly disastrous and the likelihood of flooding!  The flood could have set off issues for us medically.  Daniel & Co truly care and are experts in the industry.  Caring plumbers?!  AquaKnight goes the extra mile for their customers, without question.  We cannot praise this company enough.  I always feel like a priority.  It feels like family, not a big, impersonal machine of a company.  Most importantly, we trust this company to provide a very important and integral service within our home, our refuge, our castle - and a castle ALWAYS needs a knight, especially an AquaKnight!

reviews.author: Y.S. Rhee
reviews.text: I want to thank Aqua Knight Plumbing, Lucas & Daniel for the amazing work they did for a broken sump pump & backup sump pump. The excellent communication, hard work & service is so appreciated. Lucas & Daniel did such great work & explained everything so well! We highly recommend Aqua Knight Plumbing for your sump pump or any other home service needs!

plumbers.name: The Plumbing Dr
plumbers.address: 1063B W Broad St, Falls Church, VA 22046, USA

reviews.author: Margo Zoian
reviews.text:
It is our privilege to write this commendation on the services received from the plumbing Dr in Arlington, Va. From the time we scheduled an appointment to have repair services on our toilet with Tracey, to the repair completed by Ture, the overall service that we received was more than exemplary!!
We were treated with the utmost humble respect and patience that any and all customers would expect. Tracey scheduled our appointment most efficiently as we had service the very next day. Her demeanor was very patient and detailed in outlining our needs and cost factors! True who provided us with his service was on time, very explanatory as to was needed and encouraged us to both ask any questions and even view the repairs that were needed. True provided us with answers and advice regarding our toilet issues presently and suggestions to avoid further issues in the future!! He was a great listener, had excellent communication skills and overall demeanor was extremely humanistic. As this was our very first time in calling upon the plumbing Dr for your issues we cannot be more appreciative with their outstanding service and professionalism!
Our sincere thanks!!!!
Samuel and Margaret Bozoian’s
Fairfax, VA

reviews.author: Bridget Baiss
reviews.text:
Exceptional! Skilled, honest plumbing companies are hard to come by. Bill (the owner), Turé, Ken, and Lloyd were all outstanding to work with. They took the time to understand a very mysterious leak in our home that required multiple technologies, experience, and real problem-solving know-how.

They were amazingly clean, polite, communicative, professional, and genuinely ingenious in how they approached such a difficult issue. Their patience and thoroughness gave us complete confidence throughout the process.

I’m very grateful for their expertise and highly recommend The Plumbing Dr. to anyone in Northern VA who needs a skilled, reliable team.

reviews.author: Robert Smith
reviews.text:
Outstanding service from start to finish!

From the moment I called, the experience was professional, friendly, and efficient. The staff answered right away, listened carefully to what I needed, and scheduled an appointment that worked perfectly with my schedule. The plumber arrived on time, introduced himself politely, and explained exactly what needed to be done before starting the job.

The work itself was done quickly, neatly, and with great attention to detail. They respected my home, cleaned up completely when finished, and made sure I understood everything before leaving. Pricing was fair and transparent — no hidden fees, no surprises, and worth every penny for the quality of work provided.

It’s rare to find a company these days that genuinely cares about their customers, but this team really stands out. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and skilled plumbers who take pride in what they do. I’ll definitely be using them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: J Ses
reviews.text: Incredible work by Turé. Walked me through what needed to happen after a pipe burst. Did the work at a much more reasonable price than a competitor. Will be using Plumbing Dr. for all future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Tyler Morson
reviews.text:
UPDATE: The technician who diagnosed my clogged kitchen sink drain was incorrect in their assessment. Upon further reflection, it's silly to think the technician could properly diagnose the issue considering they didn't even turn on the water. What ended up being a vapor lock caused by a clogged drain vent (diagnosed and fixed personally) was originally diagnosed as either a clogged drain pipe or improper drain design because of too sharp a turn in the piping. The MINIMUM estimate to fix what was improperly diagnosed was about $800-900 just to snake the drain. Other estimates for unnecessary work reached upwards of $2,500. Needless to say, I will not be using The Plumbing Dr again.

ORIGINAL POST: Very knowledgeable, and honest with their recommendations. I had an issue with my kitchen sink drain, and they assessed the issue, proposed solutions, and advised on potential alternatives. Not pushy in their sales either, which I appreciated.

plumbers.name: Quick-Pro Plumbing
plumbers.address: 333 Bell Park Dr Suite A, Woodstock, GA 30188, USA

reviews.author: Kelly Monroe
reviews.text:
We were pretty worried when we smelled natural gas in our garage where the water heater is located - Deshawn arrived an hour after we called and was very thorough! He was able to detect the natural gas leak and confirm it was coming from our 10 year old water heater.
We ended up going with Quick-Pro Plumbing to replace the water heater which Deshawn came back and completed the next day for us without issue! Everyone we spoke with was so helpful and knowledgeable throughout the process - knowing we have young kids in the house and were very concerned, they worked incredibly quickly and their pricing was on-par with other searches we conducted briefly online. Very happy with our decision to work with Quick-Pro!

reviews.author: Elise Norman
reviews.text: Whenever there is a plumbing issue at any of the properties I manage my first call is to Masterflo Plumbing. Today Cameron and Michael came out and spent an hour troubleshooting a problem. I always appreciate how thorough and reliable this company is.

reviews.author: Vincent Y
reviews.text: Excellent work.  Will use again.  Technician Dyshawn was courteous, knowledgeable, and efficient.  He explained all the work he planned to do in solving my problem and showed me what he was doing throughout the repair.  Fantastic job.  I was worried about going with a company I had not used before, but after experiencing the professionalism and workmanship exhibited by Dyshawn at Quick-Pro, I will use them and recommend them without hesitation in the future.

reviews.author: Terry Ivey
reviews.text: Quick Pro charged me $550 yesterday.  A neighbor had the same job done today for $150 by a licensed and insured plumber!  I will tell everyone I know to stay away from Quick Pro!!!

reviews.author: Vinchenzo Petti
reviews.text: This fella was outstanding.He was out within an hour.Their service charge was minimal.They fixed a broken line from my water meter into my house. He gave me estimates based on scenarios before he began.There were no hidden fees. He had the job done within four hours and I thought the price was more than fair. I could not more highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Mr McGee Plumbing
plumbers.address: 509 W Beam Ave, Yukon, OK 73099, USA

reviews.author: Anya Mashaney
reviews.text: Robbie is like if I had a cool uncle that is also a plumber! I've had to call Mr. McGee Plumbing out to my house for various repairs from fixing a toilet to finding (and replacing!) a crushed and corroded copper pipe. Robbie gives me the options, explains the logic, and gets it done. On top of that, scheduling is easy, his pricing is fair, and his disposition is comforting. He navigates my house with kids and dogs and mess with courtesy and kindness. He and his office are so friendly, communicative, and kind. Couldn't ask for a better plumber. Thanks, Robbie & Mr. McGee!!

reviews.author: Lauren Palmer
reviews.text: My parents are elderly and needed taller toilets because of mobility issues. Mr McGee Plumbing was efficient and made things work even in a tight space. He took care of their needs quickly and at a reasonable cost. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Whaley
reviews.text: Great customer service from the beginning of my phone call for booking an appointment to the end of getting my hot water tank installed.  Service was on time and I was impressed with how efficient he was. I will keep his number handy and highly recommend this company. We would give 10 stars if we could.

reviews.author: tracie c
reviews.text: Mr McGee plumbing has been our plumber for several years. Always a pleasure to talk to and he is truthful about issues he may come across.  He does an A-1 job and his prices  are very reasonable. We have never had to call him back for work he has done for us. I recommend Mr. McGee plumbing for all plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Laura Schuman
reviews.text: We've used Mr. McGee twice now and both times have been great! First time was a couple of months ago with new sink install. They redid the pipes under the sink. Today, they snaked the line. Fast, efficient, professional. Highly recommend.

plumbers.name: K-Tech Plumbing
plumbers.address: 450 S 1325 W St, Orem, UT 84058, USA

reviews.author: Sean Bergeson
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience with K-Tech. At my place of employment, we were in need of replacement of a farm hydrant for our equine facility. Kevin was very prompt to come the same day to give a free assessment and estimate.

Upon accepting the bid the same day, K-Tech had us on their schedule for the next available opening (only 2 days out). Kevin & Preston came, did a fantastic job of digging out the old hydrant, replacing it properly with a new functional one, and finished the entire process from 9am - 2pm.

I will be sure to use K-Tech Plumbing for any future needs and will suggest them to family, friends and others in the future.

Thanks again!

reviews.author: Jeff Ridge
reviews.text: Kevin came promptly and on time.  We had an non-emergency but urgent need.  Kevin came that morning and took care of us before noon.  Kevin replaced the frozen angle stops under our basement kitchen sink.  He was great.  I have used K-tech before but never wrote a review.  I am not a big review writer, but K-tech came to my house a son's house and my father-in-laws house all in one week and we had nothing but a great experience.  K-Tech will be the only plumber I call.

reviews.author: Sean Kamal Makhijani
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with K-tech plumbing! When my water heater broke, they responded promptly and efficiently. They scheduled an appointment that fit my availability and kept me informed every step of the way. The technicians were professional, thorough, and took the time to explain everything, ensuring that I understood what was being done. They also left the area spotless once the job was completed. I highly recommend them for their great communication, reliability, and quality service.

reviews.author: Kathryn Bolz
reviews.text:
We hired KTech to come and help do all the plumbing for our basement. Lots of visits between rough plumbing (added another bathroom in addition to what DRHorton already pre-plumbed and added a kitchen) and finish plumbing.

Joe and  Sawyer were both amazing throughout the process. Extremely professional, friendly, and great to work with.

Would 100% recommend them, and have already thrown their name out to neighbors and friends who are wanting similar work done.

reviews.author: Riley Reneer
reviews.text: Our company uses K-tech on every job we can get them. They have a great system. Super responsive, I know all the guys on the residential crew and they are all awesome. They know what they are doing and they are efficient and knowledgeable, they help us on our trickiest projects that have the most headaches and they are great problem solvers! Preston, Jesse, Sawyer, Kevin, Joe, and small Preston are good dudes, I highly recommend them.

plumbers.name: BMS Heating and Cooling
plumbers.address: 10 Davis Dr, Hurricane, WV 25526, USA

reviews.author: Greg Hutton
reviews.text: BMS installed a new Heating and Cooling system. They were here at 8:00 am in 9 degree temperature with tons of ice and snow on the ground. They did an excellent job. They were very reasonable priced. I would refer them to anyone that needs a new heating and cooling system.

reviews.author: Debra Hodges
reviews.text: BMS is always available to find a solution to heating, cooling, ventilation.  I bought my new HVAC unit from them in 2021.  I also have a service plan with them for two checkups on the systems twice yearly.  This past Sunday I changed the filter in my attic unit and noticed too much dust on the heating unit - there is never dust on it.  I texted Brian about the dryer ventilation and I believed it had come undone.  Sure enough early the next morning Brian and Andrew were in the attic checking it out and the dryer ventilation hose had come undone.  It was fixed in a more secure way and their prompt attention to a problem relieved my worries.   No charge for fixing the problem.  They are the best!

reviews.author: Brian Workman
reviews.text: Brian Breck and his team are fantastic!  This is the second time I have used them on short notice and the repair was completed promptly at a very fair price.  I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Randi Payne
reviews.text: I called, after hours,  with a question about an unusual sound my unit was making. Brock, I believe it was, took the time to talk me thru some things to check, and fixed the problem. I was very happy to actually talk to a person with some technologic background, who could answer some questions.

reviews.author: McKees
reviews.text: Technician Andrew was pleasant, professional, and willing to spend extra time to troubleshoot multiple addition issues. I will recommend BMS to all of my friends and family.

plumbers.name: Pando Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1763 Moose Hollow Cir, Draper, UT 84020, USA

reviews.author: Alexandrea Huefner
reviews.text: I love that I found Pando! They are one of the best companies I’ve ever worked with and appreciate how helpful, knowledgeable, and professional they are. They always do well by me and it’s nice to be able to trust a company! Recently had our very old water heater go out. They come over gave me some great options and patiently and kindly answered all my questions and concerns. Ultimately, we ended up getting a tankless water heater installed. The work they did was great and they left my home looking even better than before! 10/10 Will always recommend them!

reviews.author: christopher stuber
reviews.text:
These guys are amazing at what they do!
I’ve worked with them on quite a few jobs this year and they make my life much easier.
They’re responsive, on time, detailed, professional, creative, and experts in the industry. Highly recommend Pando Plumbing for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Melissa Rodriguez
reviews.text: We love Pando! They have helped us several times with our toilets and also our water heater. They come quickly and make sure the job is done right without over charging or even charging at all if the issue was very small.  All of their staff is so kind.

reviews.author: Jieun Reed
reviews.text: Everyone at Pando is very caring, competent people. Glad to have someone trustworthy when it comes to plumbing. They stand behind their work. Totally recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Audrey Moore
reviews.text:
KYLE Christiansen  from Pando Plumbing, did a great job listening to my concerns and problem solving my anticipated future issues with my system. He and his companion were great to work with, we're respectful, knowledgeable and thorough. I also needed assistance in a timely fashion due to Aurbnb bookings I have to honor in this space affected in my home. They worked to fit me in sooner so I would not have to cancel on guests coming from out of town.
Thank is very appreciated.
This is 2 times you have saved me Pando Plumming! So, I will keep calling.
Grateful,
-Audrey

plumbers.name: Evergreen Plumbing & Drains - Centerville & Dayton
plumbers.address: 991 Senate Dr, Dayton, OH 45459, USA

reviews.author: Jennie Guenther
reviews.text:
I have had a horrible experience with a reputable plumbing company. They were suppose to come to my house yesterday between 8-10 am. Something told me to call them at 9 this morning . The rep who answered the phone was the same person who made my appointment this past Friday. He pretended to act like he did not know who I was and that I did not have an appointment. He said he was going to call  the techs and then call me back. Needless to say, I am still waiting for the phone call.

I researched Evergreen. Adam even came out to my house the end of April to give me a quote. One of the reasons I did not use him was because I had a membership with the other company.

Well, I called Evergreen yesterday morning crying about what had happened and if they could kindly help me. Hailey the receptionist/secretary was WONDERFUL and very helpful. She got me an appointment first thing this morning. I received text messages and emails… excellent job communicating and assuring I had an actual upcoming appointment!
Evan came to the house within the first hour of my blocked time. I received a phone call, text messages and emails introducing himself so I knew who he was upon arrival. He listened to me. He surveyed the circumstances thoroughly and gave me options. He spent almost 2 hours at my house for a job that could have easily taken him an hour. He chose to talk with me and build a repoire with me! I am forever grateful! He did a beautiful job installing a new shower head and turn on/off lever. He had me look at it and see if I liked it. I loved it!! Beautiful work!
I did NOT hesitate to become a yearly member of Evergreen Plumbing! I called the business when Evan left to tell them how much I appreciated Evan and Hailey! They made me beyond happy and satisfied!
I highly recommend Evergreen to anyone who needs a plumber. They are very knowledgeable and do very nice work at a reasonable fee. I am beyond happy with this company!
(Thank you, God for directing me to them!)

reviews.author: Lisa Church
reviews.text: Ok, I know it sounds weird to think of a plumbing company as awesome, but Evergreen Plumbing is AWESOME. They are a small company that CARES about their customers. The owners are actual plumbers themselves, as opposed to a sales person just trying to maximize profits. To say they are knowledgeable and passionate about their trade is a humongous understatement. They are , like, water quality obsessed. And that is precisely who you want working on your plumbing! They didn’t just give me an estimate, they educated me on the differences between products and why they use the products they do. They replaced my water heater, installed a new water softener (with a carbon filter- it makes a big difference, look it up!), replaced faucets in the master bathroom, replaced an outside spigot, and installed a new main water shutoff valve. Yes, I got a lot done, but the price was very reasonable. They were not the cheapest quote I got, but once I did the research on the quality and warranties of Evergreen’s products verses what the other companies were going to install, it was a no brainer. When Noah was done installing my new water softener, the water was so silky smooth I did a happy dance. From now on I will only trust Evergreen with my home’s plumbing. Give them your business. You’ll be glad you did! Oh, and ask for Noah (journeyman level) or Evan (master level).

reviews.author: Jennifer Loreant
reviews.text:
We had an excellent experience from start to finish. They unclogged our bathroom sink, cleaned out our main pipe, and completed a full flush on our water heater—all done efficiently and professionally. Noah and Sean were great! Everything was explained clearly, and the work was done right the first time.

I also have to mention their CSR, Hailey who was absolutely amazing—prompt, friendly, and great at communicating every step of the way. It’s rare to find a company with both top-notch technicians and outstanding customer service. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Brian Mitchell
reviews.text: We noticed an alarm going off at 600am  on our sump pump after a deluge of rain. We had a master service protection agreement with Evergreen so we called and someone was there to take our call at that early hour which was great. This person was very helpful and dispatched a tech, Julius who had come in early and was at our house by 7am to investigate the issue. It was determined that our 9 year old sump pump needed to be replaced. Tech Kyle arrived at our house at 9am to install the new sump pump. He did a great professional job and our new sump pump was operational by 11am. This was a great service and we truly appreciate the Evergreen team. Thank you!

reviews.author: Mitchell Burton
reviews.text: I had a a gas line ran to my existing wood fireplace. They came in checked it over and gave a quote at a very reasonable price. I had previously received two quotes from other companies that were extremely high for the amount of line I needed ran. They then reached out to me the next day to ask if I had any questions, and what they could do to earn my business.They completed very good quality work in a timely manner. I am very happy with the experience and will use them going forward for any plumbing needs. Highly recommend!!

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup of El Cajon
plumbers.address: 1400 Hill St, El Cajon, CA 92020, USA

reviews.author: sean mcdermott
reviews.text:
One star is to much…
When do you actually call a plumber, in an emergency would be answer at least 90percent of the time. My commercial business had a major backup on the main line Saturday am, I called by 10, I choose Roto rooter as I looked up EMERGENCY PLUMBING SERVICE LA MESA, they came up second. I called them and made an appointment. They could not come until Sunday as they said they were very busy. We made an appointment for 11, I asked them to confirm they will actually come the next day as we have no restroom service and it’s important… the operator explained that of course they willl be there. Fast forward to Monday, they call at 11 to tell me they are going to be a little late now it will be one o’clock. I asked again, are you positive your coming, the lady kinda laughed and said I am not canceling I am just delaying as we are busy. (I had an appointment) so one o’clock comes and they call to bump me because they are busy… they will be there at 4….
They show up at 430, I speak to the guy on the phone. The line is 20’ long. He needs to pull the toilet. Tells me it’s going to be 980$…. It was late, he didn’t want to do the job so he gave me a high quote. I unfortunately have had this service completed three other times and it’s always been on the weekend (odds right) the most I have paid was 454$, I asked him how he could give me that price without even doing the work yet?? He said “that’s what the price is” after a short convo I told him to kick rocks!!
I would highly recommend to NOT USE THIS COMPANY EVER!! They are a complete scam!

reviews.author: Dale Dickerson
reviews.text: I made an appointment for today for a clogged drain. I stayed home all day and no one ever showed up! I see on Google maps there are plenty of other plumbers in El Cajon. I am sure they would like my business.

reviews.author: Nadine. Cyr
reviews.text: Chris gave a price way over the fair price 2 hrs job for $1,150.00  leak under my Manufactured Home 5yrs old and Walter did the job 2hrs ended 2 DAYS got wrong parts Iwill never use Roto rotter

reviews.author: M Wood
reviews.text: Esteban / Steven was great. He knew what he was doing and brought the equipment he needed to do the job. A big clog needs a big solution. Call these guys. Free estimate at the property. Excellent value considering how much effort was required to get me flowing...

reviews.author: Noreen Newmark
reviews.text:
I called on a Tuesday morning for a clogged toilet. Within a few hours someone was at my house.
Dennis was able to find and fix the problem right away, and took the time to explain to me possible scenarios before he proceeded. He was very professional. Prices were fair. I highly recommend Roto Rooter. Very good experience.

plumbers.name: JT Plumbing Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 1833 E Harmony Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80528, USA

reviews.author: Gary Jones
reviews.text: Their tech did my simple job well, and did it the same day I called. There was a bit of attempted upsell, which I was quick to reject (I hate attempts to upsell). But this $300 job (one I could have done myself if I’d have sourced the simple valve they replaced) cost me over $425, which I found very pricey. Two stars off for the cost and attempts at upselling. Three for work done well the same day.

reviews.author: Lia Carter
reviews.text: Brandon was one of the best service professionals I’ve ever worked with. He was exceptionally thorough and explained every step of his inspection. We have some issues with our furnace which he evaluated quickly and efficiently. He was flexible with plans to speak to us when we are available and gave us tons of options to discuss. We live very close to JT but haven’t had the pleasure of using them until now but now we are devoted customers. 10/10

reviews.author: S Coakley
reviews.text: My technician Levi today was fantastic. He was kind, respectful of my home, and very thorough in explaining what needed attention. He went above and beyond by helping with an additional small repair at no charge, which I appreciated so much. Excellent service and great customer care — highly recommend.”

reviews.author: Kayla McDaniel
reviews.text: Brandon and Tony did an amazing job, respectful, friendly and they care about their customers. They came to our house 3 days in a row. Got our furnace maintenance done and it is up and running and back to heating our house! I would recommend them and this company!

reviews.author: chantelle Wilson
reviews.text: Excellent service from start to finish. The receptionist was so helpful and sweet. The two guys who came out were honest and fixed our issues for now. We have some roots in our lines and they immediately sent me quotes for the fixes that need to be done. Overall very happy with this company and we will be using them again as well as referring them out to all of my Real Estate clients and friends. Thank you all for providing such great service.

plumbers.name: Domination Plumbing and Heating
plumbers.address: 3A Clement St #1, Worcester, MA 01603, USA

reviews.author: Carolyn Emberley
reviews.text: Domination Plumbing was able to replace my water heater in Auburn, MA as fast as possible and were able to get it replaced under Home Depot warranty where it was purchased! The owner is very responsive and quick to help out clients, very appreciative to have a plumbing company who shows up, communicates, and takes care in the work they do! Thank you again!

reviews.author: Brian Misner
reviews.text:
I’m 60 years old, I had no heat, and my granddaughter was coming over on Friday and this was Tuesday on Wednesday two plumbers showed up they were very courteous, very kind, found where my heating problem was, replaced the pipes in an area of my house that I won’t even let an animal go, even in a crawlspace under my kitchen, I wasn’t worried about the bill, the owner of the company told me that we would figure something out and the next day I woke up and I had heat in the house and it’s absolutely wonderful.

I would not only recommend Domination Plumbing for everything, But when I redo my house, I plan on only using them from now on!!!!!!

reviews.author: John Giery
reviews.text: Great work and extremely professional crew. We lost heat and hot water during a very cold week with a 1 year old baby at home. They arrived first thing in the morning once the parts arrived,  installed a completely new system and did not leave until 12:30am when the job was done.

reviews.author: Jason Maleski
reviews.text:
I recently hired Domination Plumbing based on a referral from a friend to convert a replacement oven from natural gas to propane and install it in my kitchen.

Before choosing them, I called two other plumbing companies. Domination’s pricing was a bit on the higher side, but the others were booked out 2–4 weeks. Domination was able to fit me in that same week, which made hiring them well worth it. Their large crew gave me peace of mind, knowing they have the staff to keep projects on schedule with minimal waiting.

Two employees came to do the work, and they were outstanding. They were very personal to talk to. They also arrived early—which I really appreciated, as most contractors tend to be late—and immediately assessed what was needed before getting right to work. They handled everything efficiently, from removing the old stove to bringing in the new one from the garage, discarding the old unit, and even cleaning up the packaging. Their attention to detail and consideration showed they truly care about their customers.

The installation went smoothly, and the stove worked perfectly. When it came time for inspection, one of their lead plumbers arrived early to meet the inspector, ensuring everything was in order. The inspector was completely satisfied, and the process couldn’t have gone better.

Overall, you get what you pay for. Domination Plumbing delivered professional, timely service with a flexible schedule and a crew that clearly takes pride in their work. I would 100% recommend them to anyone in need of plumbing services.

reviews.author: Audrey MacLean
reviews.text: Dominic and his team came highly recommended in our area from Facebook. When we contacted his business for an hvac concern, they came out within 24 hours! Dominic and his team were very friendly, helpful and answered all of my questions and addressed additional concerns I had with my old plumbing. Domination fixed all of hvac and plumbing issues at an affordable/reasonable price. Would use again.

plumbers.name: Champion Plumbing
plumbers.address: 330 W Gray St Suite 100-3, Norman, OK 73069, USA

reviews.author: Tiffany Nicole
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Brian Morrell and his son Brian Morrell, and I would absolutely recommend them. They were both extremely kind, professional, and knowledgeable, and they took the time to answer all of our questions honestly and thoroughly. The work was done quickly and efficiently, but what really stood out to me was how respectful they were in our home—they removed their shoes before coming inside without us even asking, which was very thoughtful and something you don’t see often. They treated us with genuine care and professionalism from start to finish, and that alone is a big reason I would definitely call this company again in the future. Overall, excellent service and a great experience.

reviews.author: Wild Littles Creations
reviews.text: I recently needed plumbing assistance and had the pleasure of working with two exceptional plumbers, Chase and Thomas. They were fantastic! They arrived on time and quickly diagnosed the issue. Their expertise was evident as he explained the repair process clearly. Not only did they fix the leak promptly, but they also cleaned up afterward, leaving the area spotless. Their friendly demeanor made the whole experience stress-free. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bridgette Clark
reviews.text:
Ethan seriously pulled through for me today. My water heater sprang a leak yesterday and I lost my hot water. The dreaded words "it has to be replaced" were told to me by a different technician for another company. The quote for cost concerned me because I wasn't informed as to the cost breakdown so I called Champion to see what they could quote me. They waived the consultation fee to send Ethan out and he explained to me all that needed to be replaced and why. Turns out my water heater was super not up to code and was very outdated, covering a large chunk of the cost. He made me feel confident in spending the money for a long term solution I would be happy with. He had the tank here and replaced with hot water running in just a few hours from his initial visit. Absolute king, thank you so much!

Everyone at Champion helped me out so quickly and efficiently. Can't communicate my appreciation enough!

reviews.author: Rosie Sharmer
reviews.text: I had an emergency with my water heater leaking, Champion was able to get someone to my house within 10 minutes. Brian Morrell was my plumber and he did a great job. He was able to get everything repaired and gave me an explanation on how everything worked. He was super helpful, would recommend. Thanks Brian!

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.text: I’ve got Dashcam of one of these clowns driving recklessly and aggressively tailgating all while my family and I were just minding our own business going the speed limit. Absolutely unacceptable.

plumbers.name: Monona Plumbing & Fire Protection
plumbers.address: 3126 Watford Way, Madison, WI 53713, USA

reviews.author: Macayla Schopp
reviews.text: We were having some plumbing issues to the point that our basement started flooding. After calling multiple places and them not being able to come out till the next day- it was such a relief when Monona Plumbing said they could come out within the hour. They were quick, efficient and very helpful. They came up with a plan to help us upgrade our plumbing system, at a VERY affordable rate (we were expecting at least a two figure number, but it was only one). Would highly recommend them as your first call. We will be using them again in the future.

reviews.author: Jay Schumacher
reviews.text: We've used Monona for multiple issues - some plumbing needs and then most recently a water softener replacement. They've been fantastic to work with every time. They've come out quickly in emergency situations, been pleasant to work with, explained everything they were doing, and did high quality work. Reasonable prices for the quality of experience you get.

reviews.author: P.J. Harper
reviews.text: We needed a toilet replaced and some work on our water softener. These ended up getting done in two separate visits. Both plumbers were polite and on-time. The one working on our water softener took time to explain the work and give me some tips about using the water softener. They wore shoe covers and were nice to our cat :-)

reviews.author: Trisha Vanatta
reviews.text: Brian and Luke are great! Good people you trust in your home and they do excellent work. Have had them out for an emergency late night as well as scheduled appointments and would definitely recommend Monona Plumbing.

reviews.author: Tom C
reviews.text: Monona Plumbing did an excellent job with the work needed for our bathroom remodel, including relocating plumbing lines and installing fixtures. They were always available when we needed to schedule them during the remodeling process.  Professional work on their part.  Highly recommended!

plumbers.name: Green Tech Plumbing Co.
plumbers.address: 1017 Graceland Ave, Des Plaines, IL 60016, USA

reviews.author: Michelle Zeid
reviews.text:
I was extremely impressed with my recent first-time experience using Green Tech Plumbing.

I worked separately with Bill, Jarrod, Declan, and Tim, all of whom were punctual, friendly, and provided honest feedback and did a great job.

As a female home owner, I often dread home repairs that require a technician since I am frequently met with exaggerated estimates along with aggressive attempts to upsell maintenance service programs.

Fortunately, this was not the case with Green Tech Plumbing.  They performed the necessary work at a fair price and were a pleasure to work with from start to finish.

I highly recommend their services and intend to make Green Tech Plumbing my go-to plumber for any future needs.

reviews.author: Mirza Baig
reviews.text:
Green Tech service is excellent. Their tech was very polite and quite knowledgeable. He gave me regular updates as some repairs took some additional work and took some time. But the work was completed to my complete satisfaction.
Also their rates are reasonable too.

Great service at a great price!

I would highly recommend Green Tech for any plumbing work in the Chicago area.

reviews.author: Ray Karenas
reviews.text: Woke up this morning with my sump pump alarm going off at 5am. Checked the power and pump were on but no water being ejected into the yard. Low and behold the above ground discharge pipe was frozen which caused the pump to alarm. Green Tech Plumbing was called at 6:30a, they arrived at 7:45a and proceeded to cut the existing pipe and installed a temporary line that I will reroute in the spring. Fast, efficient and resonably priced. By 9a they were gone and pump is discharging as designed.

reviews.author: Debby
reviews.text: We will never go to any other plumber. They are the best. They got here much faster than we thought we would be able to get a plumber out here. We were terrified what the cost would be, considering there was more involved than we originally thought. But the charge was incredibly reasonable and affordable. I accidentally wrote their check on an old checkbook which wasn’t the right account. They were very understanding and let us find the right account checkbook and bring in the correct check. They were patient and kind. When we are ready to put a new faucet in the kitchen, they are who we are going to. (And I will make sure I’m using the right checkbook) We feel we will always be able to trust them. My husband felt very comfortable and relaxed with Green Tech. If you need a plumber, go to them. Don’t mess around with anyone else.

reviews.author: Cyndi Greco
reviews.text:
Such a great experience!
Kylie was professional, on time, knew what he was doing & completely cleaned up when he was finished.
We had to change start date multiple times company was very understanding

plumbers.name: AAA Advanced Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 7277 Bessemer Ave, Cleveland, OH 44127, USA

reviews.author: Katie
reviews.text:
I would give 10 stars if I could. From the moment I called till the moment I paid for service. Hands down amazing customer service and support and QUICK!

Very empathetic and caring employee who took my call, I believe her name was Jay. She offered top notch customer service and listened to my situation with care. She addressed every detail about the tentative call. Amazing customer service.

Jeremy came quickly the next day and was also empathetic, caring and a great listener. He was able to quickly assess and fix our problem in less than an hour.

The pricing was absolutely fair, No charge on parts since parts were not needed. A qucki fix!

Thank you for your top notch quality of customer service and your technician service!

We really appreciate working with a company that valued us and our time and was able to quickly resolve our issue at a fair price without any hassle or headache.

Thank you.

reviews.author: Jordan Johnson
reviews.text: I had a pretty major tree root issue that was causing a stoppage in my basement. Although the scheduling was a bit more difficult than I feel it should have been (possibly partially due to my warranty, so not sure it was all to blame on this company), the rest of the job was smooth sailing due to the awesome job of the technicians. Nick and Nick (yep) were courteous, professional, communicative and knowledgeable. They were wonderful to work with and explained everything in depth, answered every question I had and got the job done and did it well. They certainly deserve more than 5 stars, maybe even a bonus. I appreciate them and am glad this company came out and got this job done for me.

reviews.author: Megan Johansen
reviews.text: AAA Advanced plumbing was amazing to work with. They were quick, priced fair, and extremely communicative. Evan, Dan, and their crew were very knowledgeable and professional. Would absolutely hire them again!

reviews.author: MuddPuppy
reviews.text: Our family is pleased to give Advanced Plumbing and Drain LLC a 10+stars review for their excellent service. In March, Mr. Steve provided plumbing repairs in our bathroom. The office staff was efficient and friendly, and Mr. Steve was knowledgeable, respectful, and explained every step of the process. We highly recommend Advanced Plumbing and Drain LLC to anyone seeking trustworthy and professional plumbing services.

reviews.author: Joe Zeitz
reviews.text: I started to get slow drain And toilet flushing and eventually I had a back up in my shower on my downstairs level.  I called Jeremy at AAA Advanced Plumbing and Drain and I got an immediate response.  During these situations, you’re looking for somebody that you can trust and somebody that will compassionately handle this situation. This is exactly what I got from Jeremy and his team. They did a very good job of communicating with me and got out to me in a timely manner. They worked efficiently snaked the drain and quickly got the blockage freed up. They were then were very concerned about clean up afterwards, I really appreciated that. It’s everything that you can ask for during a crisis. I would highly recommend Advanced Plumbing and Drain for all of your plumbing and waterproofing needs.

plumbers.name: Glenbrook Plumbing Co
plumbers.address: 1901 Pickwick Ln A, Glenview, IL 60026, USA

reviews.author: Trista Wood
reviews.text: Needed to have my main sump pump and backup pump replaced. Glenbrook Plumbing made it easy and stress-free. They were flexible with my schedule due to the holidays. My technician was super friendly, professional and made sure I had a full understanding of what work needed done and then educated me on my new system. Very thankful for the service provided. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Max Nicassio
reviews.text: Bill and Rob were excellent to work with on my sump pump backup installation. Straightforward communicators with recommendations AND reasons for those recommendations. Will continue to work with them going forward.

reviews.author: Paul Kanzer
reviews.text: We were very pleased with the Glenbrook Plumbing service that we received. Rob was knowledgeable and efficient installing a new kitchen faucet and new quarter turn stop valves on the faucet water lines and the dishwasher water line. Scheduling service went very smoothly when we called and spoke with Lyn and owner Bill M. Service costs were very fair.  We have hired Glenbrook Plumbing before and will do it again as needed.

reviews.author: Rebecca Lindholm
reviews.text: We have used Glenbrook Plumbing twice now. They have been great to work with. The communication was very efficient and pricing was reasonable. I would definitely recommend using them.

reviews.author: Stuart Kauffman
reviews.text: First time working with Glenbrook Plumbing and they were great. On time, did a great job with all our miscellaneous plumbing issues, at a fair price.  Thanks.

plumbers.name: Hicks Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 2740 Chain Bridge Rd #104, Vienna, VA 22181, USA

reviews.author: Scott G

reviews.author: Mil Ovan
reviews.text:
From the time our 8 unit condo building was opened in 2016, until 2023, we had zero problems with plumbing.  In late January 2023, after we had just gotten home from a trip to Tupelo, our main floor (we have a “duplex down”) kitchen sink water began rising on its own from drain water from upper floor units.  My wife and I were like an old-time bucket brigade, running gallons from the sink to the powder room toilet to keep the water from cascading over our cabinets and onto the floor.  We had a plumber come out and run a rod from under our kitchen sink into the main drain pipe, which started a drain flow of water again.  This problem unfortunately returned in October 2023 (when we were just about to leave for vacation), as well as July and September 2024, July 2025 and most recently on November 3rd.  Despite previously using two different large plumbing companies, none of them could locate where our building’s main 4” drain pipe was located (using metal detectors and cameras).  So effectively each time they rodded from our kitchen, they were punching a small hole into the grease blockage, with the hole slowly closing back up.

So we hired Suburban Chicago Plumbing Experts this time.  They not only identified the problem, but also identified where our main drain pipes were located, and then went on to create new external clean-out pipes for our building so that now any future blockages can be gotten to easily.  Suburban spent three hours using unique hydrojetting equipment which has a truck-based water heater furnace to melt away all of the grease which was clogging our line.  And unlike most other plumbing companies, they also have their own vacuum truck, and sucked all the grease out of our front yard’s underground catch basin.  I can’t recommend enough their expertise, their specialized equipment, and their attractive pricing.  A terrific combination and value.

There was a backed up sewage line and left easily a foot of waste on the floor that needed to be disposed of and sanitized. So, I initially gave a 5-star review because our service tech, Andrew immediately came into our home (before beginning any work) and stated that he and his colleagues were in competition to get the most “5-star” reviews. However, this was my grandmas house where he replaced the 30 year old faucet and this archaic faucet was better than what they installed! I had requested a service call because this thing has been leaking like  crazy since “Beyond Wow” installed the replacement faucet and mind you, we had a handheld shower head prior and apparently, they don’t also critically think about if it was a handheld shower before, maybe we want the same thing installed. I came back to my grandmas, to find a fixed shower head installed. Nevertheless, digressing back to my initial complaint (one of many with them and I’m not one to complain), we have never had a faucet leak and when Andrew came back to inspect the leak, he so condescending and curt and said that it’s an old faucet and he didn’t see anything leaking. Funny thing is, I put my sons bucket of toys under the faucet to show proof and furthermore, I conveyed to Andrew that my cats have never been so active in the bathtub since he installed the faucet. He fired back by saying that it is part of the territory on the age of the home and if we wanted to, they could start gutting into the walls, if that would make me happy!

At this point, what made me happy was him leaving our home, because this is another person that clearly doesn’t take pride in their work; nor do they care that he actually made matters worse with our faucet! It was just a ball-bearing that caused the faucet to need to be replaced and now, we can’t even regulate hot and cold water, because the whole faucet is “out of whack”! THIS COMPANY IS NOT WHAT THEIR NAME TRIES TO SUBSTANTIATE”!!!!!

reviews.text:
Had two leaks, asked them to come fix the leaks. The toilet gasket seal had rotted enough to form a small leak. The only quote offered was to replace the entire toilet with a several hundred dollar replacement "rebuild". This is despite them correctly identifying the leaking gasket. Simply replacing the gasket was never offered.

The kitchen faucet was also leaking at its base, slightly more complex issue that was going to require replacing the faucet. Similarly, the only quote offered was for a "full faucet rebuild", and specifically pushed a "nice delta faucet" for $350.

Between parts and labor, the quote for these fixes was over $1800, probably about $1600 too high. I asked for a customer-supplied parts quote (just paying for labor), and not too surprisingly this quote never came.

Additionally, my partner at home was asked alot of unnecessary questions about her and my occupation, and it seems quite clear based on the conversation that we were being evaluated as to whether we were someone who would just pay for higher prices than just the simple fix being requested. Pretty bad taste left here overall.

reviews.author: Josh Murner
reviews.text:
HVAC:

I've had a wonderful HVAC experience with Sean from Legendary.  Last winter, we had our heat go out and he showed up within the hour and made sure to work late in order for us to have heat overnight.  I was very appreciative that he had the problem solving skills to get everything working before the end of the day, especially because we have two small children.  They have a really good warranty on pretty much all of their products and I recommend becoming part of their annual maintenance agreement - it includes discounts on any plumbing and HVAC work needed.

Plumbing:

I also recently had the pleasure of spending a few days with Frank and Dylan from Legendary while they:

1. Hauled away an old tank water heater and replaced it with a new tankless water heater
2. Replaced a rocking toilet with a brand new one
3. Re-piped old galvanized steel pipes with new pex
4. Changed the shower fixture from two knobs to a single shower valve
5. Replaced an old wheel gate valve for the main shutoff with a new quarter turn ball valve
6. Replaced an outdoor hose spigot and kitchen drain basket

Everything was installed correctly and they worked hard to make sure the project was done in a timely manner.  Our water pressure is now incredible and everything works great!  I should also mention that while installing the new pex to our shower, they noticed and fixed a small leak with our tub drain which has likely been leaking behind our wall for awhile.

Since we had such a large plumbing project, Sean made sure to show up periodically throughout the couple of days to ensure everything was on schedule and the work being done was of the highest quality.  While Frank and Dylan did a great job, it also felt good to know that Sean was double checking everything was done well throughout the project.

I highly recommend Legendary Services for both plumbing and HVAC work!
