They were professional, knowledgeable, and respectful of my home, and they explained everything clearly along the way. I’m in the Mundelein area, and I’m beyond grateful to have heat again. Highly recommend their services. I attached a photo of my new device it’s pretty cool looking and you can control the temp from your app on the cell phone. Thank You again.

reviews.author: Alfonso Flores
reviews.text: Waking up the day before Christmas Eve to a boiler that is not working is not fun.  Fortunately, Legendary responded quickly and Frank Walsh had everything back in order by 2 pm. I called back 2 days later to discuss a minor issue after the install and Sean was attentive and forward our message to Frank.  One word, trustworthy.

reviews.author: Karen B
reviews.text:
Colin was my technician from Legendary and addressed problems with my furnace.
He knew his stuff, was transparent and honest. You could see the pride of ownership in his work and his company’s approach. I have cancelled my subscription with a different company. They were dishonest. Colin showed me my filters which supposedly got cleaned a couple of months ago by that company. They were filthy! What a scam.

I plan to use Legendary for future needs. Thank you!

reviews.author: Margaret Trempe
reviews.text: Colin at Legendary was GREAT! The whole experience with seamless especially for emergency service on a Saturday with freezing temperatures and no heat. Colin was professional communicative and extremely helpful for the entire process. I highly recommend Legendary and I'm happy to now be a preferred customer for yearly maintenance on my heating, air and plumbing.

plumbers.name: AE Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 5672 S Johnson St, Littleton, CO 80123, USA

reviews.author: Allie Schaber
reviews.text: I would recommend AE Plumbing to anyone in need of service. Juan was fast in his response time to my initial inquiry and helped plan for a technician to come out the very next day. Isaac was my tech; he was kind, professional and thorough with his work. When he asked if my water could be turned off via the bathtub water shutoff, I was unsure and told him I could go into my crawl space to turn off the main line, which he quickly offered himself to do. He checked that the drip from my bathtub faucet was fixed multiple times before having me confirm. 10/10 service and will absolutely be my preferred plumbing company moving forward.

reviews.author: Bob Cuculich
reviews.text: Highly recommend this company. Carlos came out, fixed my drainage problem, quickly and efficiently. Very personable. No effort to upsell. Price was as quoted and clearly explained. All in all, such a great experience! So much better than other plumbing companies I’ve used in the past. This company will be my go-to from now on.

reviews.author: Mitch Eckhout
reviews.text: Juan was very professional, the new water heater install turned out great and he was able to fix a floor drain as well! His price was lower than the other plumbers I called and he offered me a better brand than Home Depot offers. 10/10

reviews.author: sherk KDC
reviews.text: Carlos was very prompt.  He was very honest at diagnosing my plumbing issue and fixed it.  He  checked a couple of other things for me too!  Very knowledgeable.  Super nice guy.  Great prices.  Fair prices.  Would most definitely call them again.  Thank you A&E!

reviews.author: Mihir Chauhan
reviews.text: We worked with Juan for gas line installation. He did the job professionally and also coordinated with Xcel energy very well without any followup. I would highly recommend him for any plumbing work.

plumbers.name: Yogi's Plumbing & Drain Service
plumbers.address: 810 Bonita Dr, Encinitas, CA 92024, USA

reviews.author: Ken Lowe
reviews.text:
I had just completed an extensive tenant improvement of an OSHPD3 certified medical and dental clinic in Kearny Mesa with Justin Shane and the Yogis Plumbing crew. Now it was time for the important project…changing out a couple of aged faucets at my North County home.

I moved into this house almost a decade ago. The remodel, "for sale" job that was done to the house I purchased included some very low end faucets. Two of them reached in the point of corrosion that their metal bases at their connection were literally rotting away.

Tim, who also worked on the clinic project recognized my name from my design plans, although we had not met. He was more than respectful, courteous, conscientious and efficient. Tim worked quickly and most significantly did not leave a mess behind. (Please note, not even on a commercial job site did Yogi leave a mess!)

Since my wife and I are planning a kitchen remodel we did not go for a terribly extravagant faucet. BTW—Tim assured us the white grout you see in the image will be clear when it dries. However with the same thought in mind, after the installation of the en suite bathroom faucet, we may just reuse the one installed in the image. It looks pretty good.

We highly recommend Justin and his crew, Yogi Plumbing and Drain Service. We intend to utilize their services on a million dollar home remodel/addition project, that we have under design in Solana Beach.

reviews.author: Patricia Glinni
reviews.text:
Update: Justin came by today to check the damage his technician caused in my bathroom. When confronting he immediately started to get very defensive, telling me that  the damage was already there and that it is corrosion. We clean the drain every week and it was never like that and for fact did not look like that before his technician came. We are aware that underneath on the inside their was corrosion build up, but before his technician came the outside was clean and silver, now it looks like it has been dented and chewed up. They obviously don’t want or like to take responsibility. He tried claiming that the crack that the technician left from changing the bath tub spout was already there before and that it was hiding underneath the old spout. The old spout was the same size maybe a cm bigger and the crack left was between 1/2 to 1inch. When my son pointed that out he quickly changed his answer. You could tell with the way he responded that he was scared to take responsibility for what was caused by his technician. I had to have my handyman come this morning to properly fill the cracks. I will say that they are nice guys but be careful when you work with them they will not stand behind their work and take responsibility when damage has been caused.

So far I did not have a good experience with yogi’s pluming they have not reached out to resolve the problem mean while we cannot use the shower until the overflow is put in right , the technician replaced my faucet and caused some damages a crack around the spout and the overflow has a gap at the top we are afraid water will sip trough and my drain was perfectly shiny before he come to fix my faucet and is now damaged  all chewy up, when I ask the technician what he did to my drain he said he didn’t touched which he is clearly not taking responsibility for it. yogis claim they  are not responsible for that because he come to do the faucet not the overflow and the drain. well I don’t understand why he removed the overflow and didn’t replace right leaving a gap at the top, I  have photos of the faucet before was replaced but I don’t have the photo of the drain. Am very disappointed of their serviced they are really not standing by their work , I really hope they make this right. I Took this photo of my faucet before was fixed to take to Home Depot to see if I could find a match .Here is photos before and after we have paid $600 for this job it should be perfect.

reviews.author: Pete Murray
reviews.text: My go to plumber retired and I've had trouble replacing him until now. Yogis did a fantastic job on a sink I've had other plumbers charge me quite a bit to fix unsuccessfully. Aaron was very transparent about the work he was doing and did great job at a fair price.

reviews.author: Jan Kiehl
reviews.text: Yogi's office staff was quick to respond to our repair needs.  They took thorough notes on our issues, and they and their plumbers were polite and attentive to resolving our problems. The plumbers work was done in a timely manner.  They were respectful and quiet as they worked, and left everything neat and clean. Their work looks to be done well.  Time will tell if it is, but we feel fairly confident in their work.

reviews.author: John V
reviews.text: This is the third time we’ve used Yogi’s.  Eric and his partner did a fabulous job.  Eric is very knowledgeable and explained all of the work that was required.  The job was done professionally - with a fair price.  We highly recommend Yogi’s for your plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Marc Francis Plumbing, LLC
plumbers.address: 1019 Quality Cir, Johnson City, TN 37615, USA

reviews.author: JR Rizvi
reviews.text: The work done by Lawrence from Marc Francis plumbing was on time prepared to do the job and had all items stocked so no matter what I asked him to fix he did right away. I would recommend him and this company for your plumbing needs. They guarantee their work which is hard to find.  I had an expansion tank put in and pressure reducer valve and galvanized parts removed because of lead containment and they rust out quickly. He replaced the two I had. Did a really good job!

reviews.author: robert stykes
reviews.text: I called them on December 23 with a very slow washing machine drain.  They sent Lawrence to look at the job and give me an estimate.  Planned to install a service sink and pump to pump out into main sewer line on December 30.  He arrived promptly on time and Marc, the owner met him here with the sink and pump.  It was more work than he expected, so he stayed and help until he had to go meet an inspector on another job.  Lawrence finished the job and cleaned up everything afterwards.  They actually forgot to install the straps to anchor the piping, so I called them the next morning and they had completed the work before noon on the 31st.  I was very impressed with their work and professional service.  They have another satisfied customer !!   Thanks again Bob S

reviews.author: Heidi Nicole
reviews.text: Marc and his son are AMAZING! Best plumbing experience we have had by far. They are friendly and efficient and did their job professionally and with excellence! They fixed our sink drain perfectly!! Would highly recommend!!

reviews.author: James Ivey
reviews.text: 10 out of 10 would recommend. Lawrence showed up early, was kind & courteous, and very professional. The job was completed quickly and thoroughly with no mess. Will absolutely use again for our next plumbing service!

reviews.author: J A
reviews.text: Extremely professional and knowledgeable. Fair pricing as well! Was born and raised here and they are the best Ive dealt with..our go to for all plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: Esser Plumbing
plumbers.address: 830 Walnut St #1, Elyria, OH 44035, USA

reviews.author: Nima Arabi
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience with Esser Plumbing! They are incredibly punctual, super reasonable, and get the job DONE right the very first time. Seriously—don’t waste your time looking anywhere else. Thomas and Rob at Esser Plumbing went above and beyond for us, and they’ll take care of your plumbing needs just as perfectly as they did ours at Midway Pointe. Highly, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ed Oley
reviews.text: When calling to schedule an appointment to fix my Outdoor fireplaces gas valve the individual. I talk to was very courteous and worked with me on the time. Travis came out to my house and was able to fix the issue with the gas valve. He was very service oriented very kind And I was very happy with him and his work.

reviews.author: Karen Dano
reviews.text: Travis from ESSER Plumbing was here to fix a clogged drain and low water pressure in my kitchen sink. I am beyond happy and I have to say he was very polite and knowledgeable and did not make a mess! Travis has been a plumber for 17 years, and I trust him! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kevin Villa
reviews.text: Amazing service from Travis. My bathtub was leaking, and he was able to fix it in no time. He handled the job with professionalism and care, and he even arrived on time despite the extremely inclement weather. The price was very fair as well. I’ll be using this company for all my future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Katherine Ferchalk
reviews.text:
Ryan, Travis, Tony, and Charlie of Ray Esser & Sons did a spectacular job!  The closet in the garage is cleaner now than when they got here and the concrete slab they had to cut from the surrounding of our house looks almost like it did before (see pics)!  All four went above and beyond to clean up – even though it had rained and the mud stuck to everything.  They were courteous and conscientious in communication and while physically completing the job.  Far beyond what I had expected and I couldn’t be more impressed with the work they did.  True professionals!

When we bought our house we knew that the cistern had to go and we needed to hook up to rural water.  Finding a plumber, we thought, would be the most complicated part of this process.  Turns out that hiring Ray Esser & Sons has been the simplest and most pain free part of the process.  Ray Esser & Sons came highly recommended by word of mouth from the people my husband works with as well and I now understand why!

Within a week of contacting them they came out, gave us a quote and did two days’ worth of work.  The whole process had one contact person which made communication between me and my husband easy as he was the one who they explained everything to, but I was the one who stayed home to be at the house while the job was done.  I was nervous being here alone and about explaining what was done, but the men put me at ease, did a great job explaining, and even let me video tape the explanation so I didn’t have to remember it all.

Based on my dealings with them thus far I have no doubts that they did the job well and that if something goes wrong, they will stick to their promise to come out and fix it.  I would give them 5+ stars if I could.  It is nice to know that truly professional companies still exist who employ skilled tradesmen and that you can trust what they tell you.  If you had any doubts about hiring this company, I hope this review helps end those doubts.  My husband and I are very pleased with our decision and will call Ray Esser & Sons for any plumbing needs we have in the future – they’ve earned a customer for life.

plumbers.name: Top Notch Plumbing, LLC
plumbers.address: 1425 Amity Rd, Anderson, SC 29621, USA

reviews.author: Tish Dobbins
reviews.text:
Top Notch Plumbing truly lives up to their name! Reign and Trey came out and handled our plumbing issue quickly and accurately. They were professional, efficient, and clearly knew exactly what they were doing.

Not only did they get the job done fast, but they were also wonderful to talk to — respectful, friendly, and easy to communicate with. They listened to what we needed and delivered exactly that without any hassle.

If you’re looking for dependable, skilled plumbers who take pride in their work, I highly recommend Top Notch Plumbing. We’ll definitely be calling them again! 💧🔧

reviews.author: Marie Waters
reviews.text: Our water decided to stop running on Sunday morning during the weekend cold spell.  I left a voicemail for Top Notch describing the problem.  Cole came on Monday morning to assess the issue.  Turns out our water line wasn't buried and was just beneath the sod.  He gave us a quote for the job which we accepted.  Trey and Reign came Tuesday afternoon to begin the repairs.  They found more issues but our quote only slightly changed.  They found out lines to the house were improperly installed when it was built.  About two and a half hours later they had the job down.  We will have to do some resoding when the weather is right but having water was more important.  Also if you are a veteran, they will give you a discount.  They rescued us after two friends spent several hours on Sunday trying to thaw what they thought might be a frozen line but we also had a defective pressure relief valve.

reviews.author: Michele Lockaby
reviews.text: Trey was very knowledgeable and professional. Answered all of our questions and gave us the best option for repairing the outside pipe leak. Price was great and job was done in a timely manner. We will be using Top Notch for all of our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Joseph Moore
reviews.text:
I can’t recommend this company enough! When we started our bathroom remodel, we needed all new shower lines installed, and he absolutely knocked it out of the park. The work was clean, precise, and done with real attention to detail.

On top of that, I accidentally broke my shower drain (total homeowner moment), and he fixed it quickly. He also installed new plumbing lines for our new vanity, and everything works perfectly.

Cole and his team are very professional, reliable, honest, and clearly take pride in their work. It’s hard to find someone you can fully trust in your home, but he’s the real deal. If you need plumbing work done right the first time, this is your guy!

reviews.author: Patsy Bradley
reviews.text: This is the 1st time using them. They answered the call promptly and we were scheduled the next day. Trey and Ellison work well together and got the job done. We had a natural gas line capped off so we could use electric logs safely. We're very pleased with their work and would definitely recommend them.

plumbers.name: Harms Services
plumbers.address: 34 Alamos Dr, Cottonwood, AZ 86326, USA

reviews.author: Lavon Sargent
reviews.text: Jacob, my technician, was on time for the appointment, and met me with a smile, a handshake and introduction.  I like that!  I showed him the plumbing issue, and he immediately assessed the situation and discussed it with me... in language that a person, NOT in the plumbing business, can understand.  He was courteous, professional, friendly, funny, and very knowledgeable.  It has been a long time since I have had a plumbing contractor get above average marks on all of the above!!  However Jacob... AND the office representative, Renee (sp?) were exemplary!  I am extremely pleased with the service.    The visit today was an 'estimate price' for potential plumbing work, and based on the service I have received thus far, I expect that I will hire them to do the job.  I am confident that the quality of the work will be consistent with everything I have experienced.

reviews.author: Keith Woods
reviews.text: Needed a water heater repair work done. Called Harms Services on a Wednesday and was able to get a technician out the next day in the morning. The technician’s name was Jacob, and he was very friendly, courteous and finished the job quickly. He also shared insights on the repair and how it likely happens. I would recommend Harms Services if any plumbing work is needed.

reviews.author: Jon Elliott
reviews.text: Inspection services for a new (to me) home purchase in Verde Valley. Jason and Eric were awesome! They were prompt, professional, knowledgeable, and answered all my questions. I received itemized estimates and now I just have to prioritize the work I want done. I highly recommend you give them a call!

reviews.author: Gary Woods
reviews.text: Jacob arrived 15 minutes after our request for services.  He immediately understood the problem and what the repair would entail.   He quoted us a reasonable price and the work was completed within 2 hours.

reviews.author: Chris Drozdowski
reviews.text:
Needed two long leaking hose bibs replaced. Called on Monday and someone came the next day to evaluate the job. We agreed on the price and he was able to do the work the same day. I was kept informed every step of the way and the technician was neat and communicative. Couldn’t have had a better experience.

Update: James, the plumber working on our home, said that the pipe to one hose bib had been repaired before and had 2 couplers installed during those fixes. He said that wasn't good and was going to  cut those out and replace the full length (7-8") of copper pipe. Turns out he did not do that and hours after his added repair, one of those couplings started to leak and spray water in our wall - ended up with soaked sheetrock, insulation and carpeting.  Had to turn the water off to the house until they could come out the next morning and fix. THEN James replaced the full length of copper and didn't seem to even remember he said he was going to do that originally. Now this area smells musty and I worry about mold. So -- the fix was done quickly but should never have been needed and I may have mold growing in my wall/carpet and paid full price for the work. Had to turn a 5 star review to a 2 star.

plumbers.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of Clearwater
plumbers.address: 13790 Roosevelt Blvd Ste D, Clearwater, FL 33762, USA

reviews.author: Team Rio
reviews.text: Hey my name is nicole, I just want to say big shout out and thank you so much to Damien for coming out and giving five star service on our broken toilet tonight it is currently 11:00 p.m. at night and he's been here for several hours to make sure that we have our toilet working. He's the best plumber that I know who will get the job done he wore shoe covers inside of my house was very respectful and such a nice kid Mr rooter is very pleased to have him he has a heart of a champion way to go Damien and way to represent this company like you do thank you so much Mr rooter for getting the job done same day service was 10 out of 10

reviews.author: Peter Protopsaltis
reviews.text:
Josh and Quintin did an outstanding job during our recent service call. From the moment they arrived, they were professional, respectful, and extremely courteous. What initially seemed like a routine drain repair turned out to be a much more complicated issue due to hardened material from years of non-use, but they handled it with patience, skill, and a great attitude.

They took the time to explain the situation clearly, worked efficiently, and made sure everything was functioning properly before leaving. It’s rare to find technicians who are not only knowledgeable but also genuinely pleasant to work with. Josh and Quintin are true professionals, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them or request them again in the future.

reviews.author: Samantha Horvath
reviews.text: Omer was professional, knowledgeable, and willing to stay as long as it took to ensure the issue was solved. He went over and beyond to make sure my issue was taken care of and to prevent future issues. Highly recommend Mr. Rooter! They also text you the info of your appointment as well as info of your service agent, so you know exactly who will be showing up to your home.

reviews.author: Jovon Garvin
reviews.text: Damien did a great job in helping repair our broken toilet. His professionalism and customer service was next level. I would recommend him for any repair needs. Next level service 10 out of 10.

reviews.author: RMitch620
reviews.text: Great service and friendly staff. Very professional and prompt. Fixed the issue same day. They do use Annie (automated admin that pretends to be human). Only CON for me was I don't think they have weekend hours and I had to wait until Monday for service.

plumbers.name: Knockout Plumbing & Repipe Inc.
plumbers.address: 191 Dillon Ave, Campbell, CA 95008, USA

reviews.author: Theresa Paloma
reviews.text:
Our master bath tub was not draining and nothing seemed to help unclog it. We were referred to Knockout plumbing and they were immediately responsive. Martin came to the house, gave us a quote and his crew was available to do the job on the same day! They were professional, courteous and got the job done quickly. One of the most impressive things they did was to wear shoe covers while in our house to minimize any dirt and debris. After, they collected all their trash and hauled it away.
There was an issue after the job was complete and Martin was immediately available to assist us. He was able to provide a solution and send his crew to resolve it. Overall, they provided excellent customer service and focused on quality to get the job done right. Definitely highly recommended for plumbing needs and would use them again.

reviews.author: Jennifer Keenan
reviews.text: I loved Knockout Plumbing.  They exceeded expectations with communication and I really appreciate this! I would highly recommend them. They did a full replacement of piping under the house, which was built in the 50s.  Top Notch.  I love Martin and Axel - they were great!

reviews.author: Andrea Ai
reviews.text: Professional and knowledgeable crews. I had a project for a whole building repiping for a multi unit residential housing and contacted 6 plumbing companies around. Knockout is the most cost and time efficient repiping company among all of them. Their pricing is reasonable and they know what they are doing. Those guys kept their promises of the project timing despite of working late. They coordinated with the tenants and went above and beyond to ensure for a quality delivery. They take ownership of their responsibilities with the tenants and are very professional. We got all the repiping done with permit on time. Extremely grateful for their services!

reviews.author: 潔妮
reviews.text: Jason and his team worker came to have the free estimate for my crawl basement issues is rainwater seepage . He is professional, easy to communicate with. Best thing is Jason aimed for the root cause, not just the symptoms of current issues having a sincere and patient attitude. Thank you!

reviews.author: Susan Kontich
reviews.text:
Knockout did an excellent job for us and I highly recommend them. We started our journey with an estimate to replace all the vertical and horizontal waste water pipes under our home.  Our house is 70 years old and we noticed cast iron pipes that seem to be deteriorating.  We looked it up and their life rage is about 70 years so we bit the bullet and got estimates from 4 different companies.  They all seemed good but Knockout offered some things the others did not.  They offered a 25 year transferable warranty, they acquired and arranged for permits.  They also put back the dry wall that they had to removed to do the job.  The man that did the texturing did a great job.  He matched the 70 year old texturing style that was in our family room.  I was truly amazed. This sewer pipe replacement, grew to include all the water pipes, and then to replace the sewer line from the house to the street and unknown to use we had a second line that was leaking under our garage floor.  This turned into a really really big job.  It could have been a nightmare but it was not. Martin, Axil and the rest of the crew totally took care of us and our house. Every day I would receive an email telling me when they would be there to work or when an inspection was happening.  They were the most cautious and careful of our house.  They protected my floors, and carpet and walls.  THEY NEVER LEFT A MESS EVER.
I watched them clean, sweep and scrub down our driveway when they had used it as a work space.  They were absolutely incredible.  Clean, neat,  work that was approved by the city and sewer department and great communication with us the entire time. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THEM IF YOU HAVE ANY PLUMBING NEEDS BUT ESPECIALLY IF YOU HAVE A BIG JOB.
THANK KNOCKOUT,  YOUR WORK ETHIC KNOCKED ME OUT.
Susan and Mark Kontich

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1160 Brickyard Cove Rd Ste 200-11, Richmond, CA 94801, USA

reviews.author: Tina Denetclaw
reviews.text:
Clearing the drain cost more than twice what our local plumbing company would have charged based on cost of labor. Stated estimate for repairing just the broken y-pipe was $6,301;  we paid less than $600 to have our local plumbing company to repair both that pipe and the shower drain leak. Roto-Rooter supervisor told us we needed a $16,000 replacement of our iron plumbing and his technician told us they are required to inform us of the needed work. Our local plumbing company told us the iron piping is old but in good shape and does not need to be replaced.

Roto-Rooter estimated verbally $5,000 to $8,000 for a needed "lake of sewage" clean-up, then showed up the next day to do the work when we had not approved that work to be done. (Wife could hear from the bedroom above the conversation between husband and Roto-Rooter restoration person; husband made it very clear that wife must agree with estimate before any work is done.) Our local plumbing company said the leak was from the kitchen and laundry line of the plumbing and all that would be done is vacuum up about a gallon of water then put down kitty litter for the small and decreasing amount of fluid.

The younger tech had a stern attitude about the work his supervisor said needed to be done (said it was their responsibility to inform us) and expressed a conformational attitude toward wife when she questioned the overpricing. The supervisor was throwing around nonsense numbers. He told us he was already saving us $2,000 on the pipe repair when the discount stated was $671 ($6,301 down from $6,972, a $671 difference). Again, our local plumbing company did the repair for less than 10% of Roto-Rooter's estimate). The Roto-Rooter supervisor seemed friendly, but his words and demeanor felt like sleight-of-hand, high-pressure tactics.

In the past, a Roto-Rooter technician cleared plumbing for us at a reasonable price and was straight forward and respectful. This current experience was much, much different than that.

We won't be calling Roto-Rooter again.

reviews.author: Ramona Marks
reviews.text: I called Roto Rooter because our sewer line needed to be snaked. They arrived within an hour.  Upon arrival the technician agreed that the line needed to be snaked and said that it would cost $500.  I told him that I had a coupon that was offered on RR website for $100.  He went to his van and wrote up a receipt for $590. and said that he could not accept an online coupon, it must be printed. I pointed out that there was nothing stating this on the website.  He eventually offered a $75. coupon that he had with him.  Whatever, the initial $500. amount became $590. I paid $515.  The technician did a good job clearing the line.  I wasn't happy with the coupon discrepancy.  I won't call RR for any future problems.

reviews.author: Jane Chisaki
reviews.text: Excellent service, quality employees, more than satisfactory work!. My faucet was continually running (while shut off) on a Saturday...after making three other calls to plumbers who either do not or could not work on a Saturday of a long holiday weekend, Roto-Rooter came through and arrived within the hour. The plumber accessed the situation, found another major leak, wrote the estimate and with approval was off to fix my issues. It wasn't as easy a fix as anticipated as my fixtures were so old, extension pieces and more were require. Parts were not available at the local hardware store requiring a weeklong wait to special order.  Although the water was no longer continuously running, he overnighted the required parts and completed the repair the next day.  Thank you so much Roto-Rooter, you saved my day!

reviews.author: Douglas Gagle
reviews.text:
Excellent service as usual. Have been using local Roto-Rooter for years. Always pleasure to deal with their professional plumbing experts.
Carlos was amazing!!! Quickly fix the problem Which was a great relief, his many years of experience And expertise were greatly appreciated. Highly recommend. Thank you again for the great service 🙂

reviews.author: Prisma Leiva Moran
reviews.text: Yesterday I had a bad day with my washer and garage being flooded I called roto-rooter.let me tell you the two guys that came to help us with this issue great customer service very polite told us what the problem was and preventative care for future mess. Very knowledgeable and above and beyond with the cleaning. We just want to say these two guys are recommendable. Even after a challenge they still got the job done. Juan Moreno and his helper were 5 stars service. Thanks again.

plumbers.name: Affordable Plumbing and Heat
plumbers.address: 9275 N Elm Ct, Federal Heights, CO 80260, USA

reviews.author: Jake Korus
reviews.text: Quick, friendly, honest service. David M was our tech, came to my house when it was just my wife and kids and she said he was very polite and got things in working order quickly. Courtesy is very communicative with their scheduling and I would definitely hire them again!

reviews.author: Ian Alvarado
reviews.text: Had a leaking pipe behind my kitchen sink, and Alec did an amazing job coming to the rescue. Alec had great transparent communication throughout the entire process, and was able to troubleshoot/complete the repairs all in one visit. Would absolutely do business with Alec/Courtesy Plumbing again.

reviews.author: Ned Deakins
reviews.text: I highly recommend Courtesy Plumbing and Heating. Eddie and Drew helped us get back up and running after our furnace and hot water tank reached the end. They were efficient, timely, and the price was more than competitive. Great work. Really appreciate it.

reviews.author: Dillon Huselton
reviews.text: Had a plumbing issue on the 3rd of July and they sent someone out the next day. Dylan was very friendly and knowledgeable about his job. My bathroom has better flow than when we got the place. A must use for anyone with plumbing problems.

reviews.author: cee gee

reviews.author: Jacquelin Lloyde
reviews.text:
I am 94 years old and live by myself, and it can be very difficult for me to manage home repairs. I do not use the internet very much, but Joseph kindly showed me how to use speech-to-text on my phone so I could leave this review myself. I truly wanted people to know how wonderful he was.

For weeks, there was a loud humming noise every time I used the water, and it was driving me crazy. At my age, you appreciate peace and quiet, and the sound was very upsetting.

From the moment he arrived, he treated me with patience, kindness, and respect. I am hard of hearing and move slowly because of arthritis, and he never once rushed me. He took his time to listen carefully and explain everything in a way I could understand.

He didn’t just fix the problem — he checked my whole plumbing system to make sure everything was safe. No plumber has ever done that for me before.

He even had to cut into some of the stucco to do the repair properly, and I was worried the price might go up. It never did. He kept his word exactly. That meant a lot to me.

In my long life, I have met many contractors. Joseph stands out as one of the most honest, hardworking, and compassionate young men I have ever encountered. His workmanship is beautiful, and his character is even better.

If you want someone who truly cares, who does the job right, and who treats you like family, call Allstar Plumbing and ask for Joseph.

Thank you, Joseph. You really are an Allstar.

reviews.author: Gabriel Otte
reviews.text:
We first contacted Allstar to fix a water mixing issue. They came and charged us to diagnose the problem and said that it was a cartridge in one of the showers that had failed that was causing the cold and the hot water to cross over. They then charged us more to fix the problem. So far, so good. They installed the new cartridge and told us that it was fixed.

A few weeks later, we were still having the issue and so we had them come back. Another guy, Jose comes out and says our issue was that actually our recirculator was sending hot water into the cold and that they needed to install a stop valve so that the flow was unidirectional. I once again, double checked whether this was going to fix the problem and they assured me this was the problem. So they charged me another few thousand dollars to redo the piping.

After that, they said that that didn't fix the problem and that it was the cartridge after all and they had misdiagnosed which one of the showers had failed in the first place. So they came back and said it was this other shower that was the problem. So they took out the old cartridge but couldn't install the new one due to some build up. Now, this failed install is causing the shower head to leak constantly. Except, the owner, Sergio now doesn't want to do more work unless we pay more money on a problem they misdiagnosed and a leak they caused in the first place.

Now I have a leak that they are refusing to fix without more money and they still haven't fixed the initial mixing issue. Evidently Sergio has been complaining about how he has already lost a lot of money of this job as a reason for not doing the right thing here. FWIW, they seem like nice guys (at least when talking to them) but from a business and quality of work (not to mention value), I would steer clear from these guys. I'm really disappointed because generally you want to support local businesses. I think this is one of those cases where when pushed to the limit, they won't actually pony up to fix the problem.

reviews.author: Kimberly McCort Cooper
reviews.text:
Last July we hired ABC to scope the sewer main during a home inspection for our first home. They said that the line needed to be jetted so we hired them again to jet the line after we purchased the home a month later. They then claimed that they were unable to jet the line and said they would follow up with an estimate to dig up and replace the line. They charged us $500 for coming out to jet it but said that money would go towards the cost of replacing the line. A few weeks later I reached out regarding the estimate. They sent a guy over who stated the line would bet the city’s responsibility. He said he would get in touch with the city and get back to us. After waiting a few more weeks, I reached out again about the status of this repair. The employee that I spoke with said there was nothing on record about it but she would reach out to the estimator. I asked about having our $500 refunded since we would not be needing them to replace the line. She claimed they did jet the line. I explained to the employee that I have an invoice that states they tried to jet the line but could not because of too many fittings. She argued they did jet the line. I’ll admit it got a little heated. She was pretty rude. She said she would get ahold of the estimator and report back.

The next week our basement backed up with sewage. I got ahold of Roto-Rooter, explained the situation, they said they felt confident they would be able to jet it and that ABC just “didn’t know what they were doing”. He did indeed jet the line, resolving our issue.

To this day I have never received a call back about the estimate or had our $500 refunded. I don’t think they know what they’re doing either.

Me and my wife are on a budget. Tighten worked with us. He went over every job and how much it was gonna be. I appreciate that.

reviews.author: Michael Trejo
reviews.text: Out of the 4 places I called this morning they were the only ones that had a person actually pick up the phone. Schedule a service call for the afternoon but I was able to finally unclog my toilet. I called the cancel and it was smooth with no pressure for them to still come out. If I ever have a plumbing issue I will be coming to Titan.

reviews.author: Timo Lyons
reviews.text: Titan always delivers. I went down to my basement New Year’s Eve and found my hot water heater leaking. A quick call to Titan and they had a plumber out to my place within 2 hours and a new water heater installed shortly after. They were professional, tidy and skilled. I highly recommend these guy!!

reviews.author: matt trinidad
reviews.text: Worked with titan plumbing since we moved into the house and they have been amazing. Recently added a clean out since out house didn’t have one and it’s made fixing any plumbing problems a breeze. david was on site doing amazing work and thoroughly explained the issue and what the options are. Pam was great at coordinating any updates that would come up and wanted to make sure that my plumbing problems were no more. highly recommend.

reviews.author: Janice Holland
reviews.text: Titan came out quickly when our sump pump went out. Lou was very professional and answered all our questions. He gave us all our options and the prices so we could choose the sump pump we wanted. Many plumbers just give one option, and that’s what they install. That is what our old plumber did. Lou patiently trained an apprentice plumber that day, even though they were very busy. Lou came back again to install a new backup pump and used a special camera to check our drain tile which also needs work. It was backing up during the heavy rain. This is a really good plumbing company. I would definitely use them again. The company we always used told us to get someone else because they were too busy that day due to heavy rains. Titan is so helpful and cares about the quality of service they provide to their customers.

plumbers.name: Spartan Plumbing
plumbers.address: 5440 Marshall St, Arvada, CO 80002, USA

reviews.author: Henk M
reviews.text:
One morning we discovered our water heater was leaking badly. Through Yelp we came into contact with Spartan Plumbing and they told us they could send a technician within hours.
They sent José. José was very knowledgeable and pleasant to be around. He explained exactly what was going on and gave us a list with options on how he could fix things, together with price quotes. Again, he explained exactly what everything meant. After we made our choice he went out to buy materials and fixed up the place. After the work was done he told us how to best maintain the new stuff.
I feel comfortable to recommend Spartan Plumbing after this good experience.

reviews.author: Gary Fuller
reviews.text: Spartan (Christian with Abel) tackled and solved a large project at our home, which required expertise and skill (jackhammering, correcting improper connections, etc.). They arrived when they said, worked hard and politely kept me informed during the five days. They cleaned up the large mess remarkably well. I hope not to have future problems, but if I do, I'll call Spartan first.

reviews.author: Miracle Holloway
reviews.text: Vaughn did a great job on our water heater replacement. He showed up on time, was respectful in our home, and walked us through different options without pushing us in one direction. That stood out to us because a couple other plumbing companies we spoke with were more focused on selling than actually helping. The install came out clean and everything is working great

reviews.author: George Hatfield
reviews.text: Christian replaced our water heater and made the whole experience way easier than expected. He was professional, explained our options clearly, and never once made us feel pressured into spending more than we needed to. We had already talked to other companies and it honestly felt like they were trying to take advantage of the situation. Spartan Plumbing was the complete opposite. Very thankful for Christian and the work he did.

reviews.author: Eric Sheffey
reviews.text: Great experience working with Christian and Vaughn. They replaced a whole house water softener system for us, and added a hose bib to our outdoor gardening area. Vaughn worked hard all day to finish the project for us, and we are very happy with the work. We will definitely be keeping Spartan's number on hand for future plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Domco Plumbing

reviews.author: Al Saporito
reviews.text: Excellent Service, prompt, reasonably priced. My daughter referred Domco Plumbing after they repaired a main service line leak at her home. Sean and Isaac came out to inspect the site and located the leak. They quoted a fair price and stated they had the parts needed to complete the repair, so I approved the work on the spot. They completed the repair, tested their work, and were done within two hours. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Keith Martin
reviews.text: We had Justin replace our 40+yr.-old toilet with a new one. Not only was the old flange damaged but the waste pipe was not secured correctly within the slab. Justin had to correct all these issues on Friday before proceeding with the toilet installation on Monday. Every step and added cost was explained to me in detail before he proceeded. Justin was a true professional in every aspect. We will have him back in a few days to replace our other toilet.

reviews.author: Chuck

Dominick got the pipes and drain moved, upgraded the pipes and fixtures and left everything looking like new construction!  And he was fast!  In and out of the house in the time that he promised!  We will definitely use DomcoPlumbing again!!!

reviews.author: Gary Mengers
reviews.text: Major repair, sewer tank and pump failed and had to be replaced. Team worked fast to get us back online, completed within estimate, was careful with our landscape and cleaned up thoroughly. Technicians went above and beyond.

reviews.author: William Thompson

reviews.author: Londell Thomas

reviews.author: Joe Mark

reviews.author: Stefvanni Steans
reviews.text: Excellent service! They came out so fast and were very knowledgeable! Marco and Christian were very professional and didn’t mind when my dad wanted to help out! If you’re ever in a pinch give them a call! Very transparent with pricing and extremely helpful!

reviews.author: Wayne S
reviews.text:

To say im grateful and happy with the service and kindness they showed us is an understatement. Highly recommend!!!!

reviews.author: Dawn Murray
reviews.text: Sean and Ameth were top of the line plumbing professionals.   On time, courteous,  knowledgeable and friendly.  They know there stuff from start to finish. reviews.author: Carole Bellhorn

Very happy with everything.

reviews.author: Ahmed abu shawareb
reviews.text:
Excellent Service! Eli is My New Go-To Plumber
I highly recommend Eli! He is a fantastic plumber who provided quick service and exceptional work at a very fair price.
I first hired Eli to replace two toilets in my home. The installation was quick, clean, and perfectly done. The work was absolutely great, and I was impressed by his professionalism.
More recently, I had a much more stressful problem: a water leak under the house. I called him, and he was incredibly responsive. He showed up right away—it didn't take him a lot of time to arrive, which was a huge relief given the severity of the issue. He quickly diagnosed the leak and got it fixed properly.
Not only was the quality of his work great on both occasions, but his pricing was awesome. It's rare to find someone who is both highly skilled and offers such competitive rates.
If you need a reliable plumber who is fast, skilled, and reasonably priced, Eli is the one to call!

reviews.author: America Barajas
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Eli. I submitted a service request late last night, and he was at my home promptly at 8:00 AM the very next morning.
Eli was extremely professional, friendly, and communicative throughout the entire process. I had a major leak in my primary bedroom that completely soaked the carpet. He performed a thorough water test and discovered that the leak was coming from inside the wall behind the shower. He opened the wall, clearly showed me where the problem was, explained what caused it, and walked me through how it was repaired. Everything was fixed properly and with great care.
While he was there, I showed him a second issue in another bathroom that initially seemed minor. Eli took the time to investigate further and found underlying issues from previous work, including a loose toilet. He addressed everything the same day, came fully prepared with the necessary tools, and made sure the job was done right.
What really stood out was his attention to detail and respect for my home. He left the work area extremely clean — floors were mopped and everything was tidied up before he left.
Great pricing, excellent communication, and top-notch service. Eli was wonderful to work with, and I would absolutely recommend him to anyone looking for a reliable and honest plumber.

reviews.author: Alfonzo Gonzalez
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Monarch plumbing. Very good company quality work. Cruz came and helped me out at our house with two sinks that were clogged up. Not only did he unclog the sinks he changed out the P-trap that the last handyman installed incorrectly. Cruz does quality work and is also very respectful. He always contacted me when job was finished or if there was a little problem that he can still fix. I would highly recommend Monarch Plumbing Cruz is the man to go. I will definitely call Monarch Plumbing for future problems.

reviews.author: Noel Bautista
reviews.text: I had great experience with Monarch Plumber crew today with Eli and Herman. My kids restroom with 2 sinks was clogged up over the weekend, I was happy to able get an appointment next day through online. When Eli arrived he automatically ask if he needs to use shoe cover because kids restroom is upstairs and he noticed we leave slippers downstairs. They were able to change the sink pipe and declog the line in timely manner. This is the 1st time I used this company and I’m very happy to recommend their service. Great guy with so much knowledge. Thank you Monarch with fast service.

reviews.author: Mukta Wagh
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic experience with Jack and German from Monarch Plumbing.

Jack was very prompt, professional, and quickly diagnosed the issue that had been giving us trouble in his first visit. What really stood out was his patience in explaining the problem and the solution in a way that was easy to understand.

After diagnosing the problem, Jack returned promptly with German, and they both completed the repair fast and efficiently. Moreover, everything was left clean and tidy afterward. Both Jack and German were very polite, and the customer service offered by Monarch Plumbing was excellent.

Highly recommend Jack, German, and Monarch Plumbing if you’re looking for quality service!

plumbers.name: Super Brothers Plumbing Heating & Air
plumbers.address: 7475 Kanai Ave, Citrus Heights, CA 95621, USA

reviews.author: Wei-Chun Wang
reviews.text: Super Brothers Plumbing quickly replaced our broken gas water heater with an electric one on short notice. They were professional, responsive, and very affordable. The team explained everything clearly, did great work, and helped us get all the rebates we qualified for. Highly recommend them for fast, reliable service!

reviews.author: L.A. Kornell
reviews.text: We had a plumbing emergency on a weekend and Super Brothers sent a plumber out very quickly to help us out. He was able to repair a vintage faucet and stop a serious leak within 1/2 hour of arriving. Excellent!

reviews.author: Paul Chance
reviews.text:
Mike picked up the toilet at the plumbing supply store where we bought it and brought it to our house on time.
As I watched him remove the old toilet and clean up as he went, I knew that he is a man of integrity.
His workmanship was spot-on, as he leveled the toilet and made it rock-solid-a detail which the former installer completely missed-the old toilet rocked like grandma’s rocking chair.
After the toilet was installed and tested for leaks, he meticulously caulked it and made it look as beautiful as a toilet can look. Then he cleaned up the floor, loaded the old toilet in his van and left.
I am a lifetime customer of Super Brothers Plumbing. They have completed large and smaller jobs at our home-always with true professionalism and excellent workmanship.

reviews.author: Jim Notman
reviews.text:
I decided to get the water heater changed from a gas to electric heat pump. I contacted Super Brothers through their website. Kathy called me right back and told me about rebates and tax credit that are available. She took care of everything and scheduled an install.
Artem arrived when they said he would. He is a hard worker and did an excellent job on the install. I highly recommend Super Brothers and would not hesitate to use them again.

reviews.author: E Lovely
reviews.text: These Brothers Rock! Very professional job very well done in Sun Meadows! California will NOT have gas water heaters in 2030. They currently have rebates and your electric wiring is done INCLUDED in the price. Now is the time to act! But I stuck with gas while still available.

plumbers.name: C. Woods Company
plumbers.address: 315 N Spur 63 Suite 103, Longview, TX 75601, USA

reviews.author: Ray Thomas
reviews.text: The technicians arrived as scheduled and on time. They informed me of everything they did and gave me a copy of the work they performed. I have been using the C-Woods company over two years and have been happy with the quality of work and professionalism they offer. I would recommend them from installing to repairing your furnace, air conditioner units, ductwork etc. They do great work.

reviews.author: Daniel Wriggle
reviews.text:
Had them come rewire my remodel and explained IN DETAIL all what i wanted and the setup i was needing. They did a lot of good work, but i had to explain things over and over after already explaining them the day before each time. They refused to run the wiring for my outside AC compressors because they "werent on the blue prints" even though the inside air handlers were on the blueprints. Which i had to argue with them about running that wiring as well. They forgot to run several things and i had to point them out when the main manager came by to discuss payment. They didnt run the electical for my stove top or oven but ran the flex pipe it goes in. Tried to up charge me over double my original estimate to finish the job even tho my estimate was quoted to wire the entire house. There are wires hanging down everywhere and not finished or connected to anything. None of the wiring is ran to the breaker boxes and the meter box and main was never hooked up. They wouldnt return my calls for over a month. i have another company there now (Blazer electric of henderson, tx) and they have been the absolute best and i have zero complaints.
Would not recommend this company to anyone and i suggest anyone wanting work done to try elsewhere.

reviews.author: Lauren Ellis
reviews.text: Steven Cowan was by far the best electrician I have ever dealt with! The best company I have worked with for both electrician and plumbing. They go above and beyond and exceeded my expectations! Reasonable and just overall a great company to work with.

reviews.author: JAMES THOMAS
reviews.text: Rescued on the weekend and so grateful to C. Woods for their quick response and Sunday visit. The service technician, Garrett was so professional and experienced. I will definitely be calling them again for future work. I highly recommend. A+++

reviews.author: Ruben
reviews.text:
Out electricity went out in several areas of our house after I tried to install a dining room lamp. Called C. Woods and they were able to get me into their schedule and come see what the issue was. Alex and Bailey did a thorough diagnostics exam and found the problem to be an old fuse to have blown. I had them install the new lamp for us. Both were thorough and communicated very well with me. Very transparent. I recommend
C. Woods and ask for a Alex, great worker.

plumbers.address: 208 Greenfield Dr suite k, El Cajon, CA 92020, USA

reviews.author: denise duppee
reviews.text: We have used Remedy Rooter for many years. From toilet fixes to a HUGE job with our kitchen remodel in 2018. Our most recent job was replacing our water heater. Graham was able to get us on the schedule quickly which we appreciated because we had no hot water. Juan, the tech, was knowledgeable and professional. He came on time and left the area tidy when he was done. We have been happy and satisfied with every job RR has done for us.

reviews.author: Joy Mack
reviews.text: Eli has helped our office twice now and both experiences have been so excellent! We had a leaking toilet and a spraying faucet and he got them fixed like it was no big deal. He’s extremely professional, works quickly, and gets the job done right the first time. Communication was easy, and everything was handled efficiently. 10/10 — highly recommend!

reviews.author: Matt Dittsworth
reviews.text:
I am beyond impressed with the team at Remedy Rooter! From the moment they arrived, they were professional, attentive, and determined to help. I had been dealing with a total plumbing mystery—a 99% moisture reading behind my water heater and water randomly pooling on my kitchen floor—but I couldn't get any answers.

What set Remedy Rooter apart was their incredible attention to detail. I had two other plumbers out previously who didn’t even bother to look at the water heater! Remedy Rooter, on the other hand, did a thorough investigation and correctly identified the issue with the connecting water line.

It is such a relief to finally have this resolved. If you want a company that actually listens and does the work others won't, look no further than Remedy Rooter. They are absolute lifesavers!

reviews.author: Andrea Lorenze
reviews.text:
Excellent experience with Remedy Rooter!
When our hot water heater broke down over the weekend they were able to come out and assess immediately. We needed a replacement and they were able to put one in immediately, even though it was a weekend. Great price and friendly service. Would highly recommend. Thank you!

reviews.author: Wu Sun
reviews.text: Remedy rooter is the best. I had my gas leak and drain pipe fixed by Juan and Aiden, they are the best.  Juan came for a free estimate and he was very professional, friendly, and knowledgeable.  I communicated with Michelle, the coordinator for the company, and she is always friendly and responsive.  Their price is very reasonable compared to a few other companies I quoted.  I liked their fix of my gas leak so I decided to hire them to flush my tankless water heater too.  Michelle scheduled for me quickly and the technician came at the scheduled time and got it done nicely.  I will definitely use Remedy Rooter for my future plumbing projects.

plumbers.address: 500 E Main St, Lake Zurich, IL 60047, USA

reviews.author: Michael McCann
reviews.text:
Louie came out to connect our bathroom sink- he was knowledgeable, polite, and trustworthy. We asked about a project we are considering in our laundry room and he took the time to tell us what it would entail, and offered recommendations and suggestions. We will be calling to set up this install in the near future.
Lake Cook plumbing is top notch- great, honest guys and Gianna is the go to person who sets up appointments and communicates when techs are dispatched. Found our new favorite plumbing service! Thank you!

reviews.author: Kenneth Hunt
reviews.text: Our old water heater needed to be replaced. It was leaking and causing a minor flood in the basement. Searched up plumbers in the area and lake cook plumbing was first on the list. They said they could come out the next day, so I was excited! They had to remove the utility room doors, to not keep them longer I said I would put the doors back on myself. They installed a new water heater and the plumber was nice and up front. It cost me $3000. Things were good for about 3 months but the pressure relief valve started leaking. Then a guy named Mike came out, he wasn’t a pleasant person, but he swapped out the gas valve, and we haven’t had a huge problem yet. Today I went to finally reinstall the doors to the utility closet and the bottoms are ripped and torn to where they won’t stay in the tracks and the rail above the door is bent so the wheels pop out. While i am grateful for the initial quick “we can be there tomorrow urgency”, that is the only good thing I have to say and will not use them again.

reviews.author: John Harding
reviews.text:
This company did outstanding work for our family. They worked very hard and actually figured out a way to LOWER the cost after coming up with an innovative solution to our disaster.
Louis and Casey were smart and professional. I will recommend this company to everyone I know.
The owner, Jim Barrett, went above and beyond!  With his detailed explanation of what he found, and personally speaking to our insurance claim’s  person, we were approved to be covered with our home owners insurance!
I cannot say enough about this team of men and will also include Gianna who handles scheduling and was a delight to deal with.
Thank you Lake Cook Plumbing!!

reviews.author: Yiwei Yu
reviews.text: I had to have a water heater replaced a few months ago. When Casey came over to do the inspection and gave me the quotes, I was pleasantly surprised that he wasn't salesy at all. He laid out the options in a very clear way, set the right expectations, and gave me time to think them over. I was fed up with other plumbing companies trying to sell me upgrades I didn't need. One of them even tried to sell me a subscription plan! So I ended up going with one of Casey's recommendations and they were very professional with the work. They cleaned up the basement and I didn't have any concerns.

reviews.author: Professor Kurt DiClementi
reviews.text: I felt very fortunate to have Louie, a plumber with over 20 years in the business, come out to clear the pipes leading out of our kitchen sink. Louie is the gold standard of plumbing professionals. He was very meticulous in the service he provided, explaining everything he was doing. He also ran the bathroom sinks and tubs to make sure that while he cleared the blockage in the kitchen sinks, he didn't push the blockage to plumbing in another area of our home. Upon finishing the job, Louie also offered maintenance advice to ensure we would avoid the same problem in the future, and he let me know about discount coupons I could find if I needed any additional service in the future. I think Louie provided a great value for the service he performed. He was the consummate professional, yet he was very amiable. He made me feel like he was a trusted friend rather than just another customer he had to deal with.

reviews.author: Abi Vega

Doug is awesome!

plumbers.name: Advantage Plumbing & Rooter Inc
plumbers.address: 2361 Barton Ln, Montrose, CA 91020, USA

reviews.author: Rafi Sepanian
reviews.text:
Advantage Plumbing & Rooter! Truly Outstanding!

Huge thanks to Steve, Kyle, and Jose. Steve answered my call late at night around 10 PM and had me scheduled for 6:30 AM the very next morning. My main sewer line (under the house out to the city sewer) was clogged, and they showed up on a rainy morning without a single complaint and got right to work. Jose was part of the first-day crew and helped get everything started quickly and efficiently.

What really impressed me was how well-equipped and tech-savvy they were camera inspection and tracer on the spot. Kyle quickly found the root cause of the blockage, explained everything clearly, and provided a fair estimate for what turned out to be a major repair. The major job was scheduled for the next morning, and they returned with even more impressive excavation equipment. Oh boy, they were fast, organized, and highly professional you could tell this team knew exactly what they were doing.

They also saved me a lot of money by lining and protecting the clay pipe that goes out to the city sewer, which prevents roots from getting in. That smart solution alone saved me well over $15,000 in potential replacement costs.

The repair was done right the first time, the site was left clean and tidy, and the entire crew was courteous, careful, and hardworking from start to finish.

The job was done perfectly, the communication was excellent, and the whole team went above and beyond.

I highly recommend Advantage Plumbing & Rooter ask for Steve and Kyle!

reviews.author: Harper Haeun Lee
reviews.text: Jose and Mauricio came to replace our super old and dishwasher from who knows when our prior homeowners installed it. They did a phenomenal job, and we are so thankful because they worked with our old kitchen that was outdated and not even the standard dimensions. Showed up on time, consulted with us, tested the dishwasher, and cleaned up. Also gave us helpful tips on maintenance. Thank you Jose and Mauricio!

reviews.author: Monica Shaw
reviews.text: I texted owner Steve at 7:30am regarding my leaking toilet to see if they could come out the same day. He immediately replied with a yes, between 10-12pm. I got a text the Victor & Alonso would be coming out. I received text updates regarding their arrival time. They arrived, immediately assessed the issue, fixed it quickly- in less than an hour, and were on to their next call. As always, Victor and Alonso, were polite, professional, and efficient. Love Advantage!

reviews.author: Janice Holloway
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Advantage Plumbing & Rooter. The team was professional, punctual, and very knowledgeable. They quickly diagnosed the problem and fixed it efficiently at a fair price. Everything was explained clearly, and the work was done cleanly and with care. It’s hard to find reliable plumbing services, but this company truly stands out. Highly recommend them for anyone looking for honest and high-quality plumbing work!

reviews.author: Steve Moon
reviews.text: Great service by Mauricio and Jose! They came in for a water leak, assessed the situation and fixed properly. Everything under 2 hours and at a reasonable price. I was very frustrated but they took care of it profesaionally. Steve the owner was checking in with the team to make sure thinga are going smoothly. I will definitely call them again if I need a plumber.

plumbers.name: Integrity Plumbing of the Upstate LLC
plumbers.address: 1011 Old Stage Rd, Simpsonville, SC 29681, USA

reviews.author: John Yeary
reviews.text: We had a water heater blow out in our garage and flooded the new workshop I had just finished. We got a couple of quotes from various companies in the area. When we called Integrity, Russ (Owner), came to our house within 30 minutes. He provided a reasonable quote, and great explanation of our options for replacement. They offer a military/veteran discount. The team that came out later that afternoon included Stephen Libby who was fantastic. After they removed the damaged heater, it was discovered that there was additional damage. They worked with the water mitigation folks from USAA to clean and dry the area. When the general contractor that came to look at repairing the water damaged area would not be able to get someone out for another week, Integrity helped us again. Russ recommended a contractor that he worked with to come do the repairs. Once the walls were repaired and painted, Stephen came back and installed the new heater. He took the time to flush the lines, and make sure everything was in good order. He recommended heater settings and set them for us. The heater works great and the area looks great. I had a great experience from the owner to the technicians, and receptionist.

reviews.author: Laura Brand
reviews.text: I called Integrity Plumbing one afternoon to request a quote on a replacement tankless water heater. Russ, the owner of the company, showed up at our house less than 45 minutes later and gave us a competitive quote. I was very impressed with Russ who really seemed to know everything about Navien water heaters. Integrity Plumbing was able to start and finish the install that very afternoon so we had working hot water by the evening. The new water heater looks and works great, and they were very conscientious to leave the install area better than they found it. Highly recommend this locally owned company.

reviews.author: Brian Thomas
reviews.text:
Thought we might have a burst exterior water pipe so I called Integrity.  Their technician Cole arrived right on time and quickly assessed our situation. Fortunately pipes were in good shape-one was just partially frozen and he gave me tips on how to manage that situation moving forward. I asked about making a payment and Cole said there would be no charge as this was just information and knowledge that he shared on this visit. What other companies would do this? Probably none.
They really live up to their name Integrity in their business.  This was my 2nd experience with them and I can truly say their technicians are incredibly knowledgeable,
professional, and eager to share tips for the average homeowner so they can avoid future problems. They have definitely earned my business for any future plumbing needs.
When I called the day before to schedule the appointment, Beth provided excellent service and communication and even had their Technician Cole call me in advance of his visit to answer a question I had about my pipe situation. If you are looking for a plumbing company you know you can trust, call Integrity!

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Escher
reviews.text:
✨Very Grateful ✨
I had a great experience with Integrity Plumbing! Russ was professional, kind, and really went above and beyond. Not only did he take care of my water heater, but he also referred an electrician I needed, which made everything so much easier and less stressful. It’s hard to find people who are both skilled and genuinely helpful, and Russ is definitely one of them. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: John Rush
reviews.text: DJ and Clayton replaced a few old water heater tanks and replaced with a new Navien Tankless water heater for us.  Pricing was fair vs the other estimates we received. I felt DJ had the best handle on what needed to be done plus were recommended to us by friends who had some work done by Integrity with excellent results.  Had no issues with anything. They were in and out in less than a day and did a good clean install. Definitely recommend!

plumbers.name: Your 1 Plumber
plumbers.address: 13504 Jamieson Pl, Germantown, MD 20874, USA

reviews.author: Charlie Curd
reviews.text:
Pipe burst... Other companies didn't have availability for at least 4 days due to the weather. Your1Plumber had the issue fixed in under about an hour once they arrive which was amazing since we didn't have water access.

The gentlemen who did the work, Wilmer, explained everything well as far as the issue and repairs were concerned.  Prompt. Polite. He made sure to let us know what to expect during and after repair. Oh! I was home alone during the visit and dude wasn't creepy... so, that was kinda great- felt safe. He was pretty patient with my dog, who goes kinda 'Cujo' when company comes, and that was pretty nice since Dog was on my last nerve trying to eat the plumber person again... when will she learn that we don't eat our friends?

Not sure if the price was competitive since we never had this issue before- but according to my bff, chat, it was fair. Included 1 year warranty on work which was a bonus we didn't expect.

10 outta 10 would not want my pipe to break again during a winter snow, but I would call this company again if it did.

reviews.author: Marjorie Carter
reviews.text: We appreciate the prompt service we got  from #1 plumber. They installed our hot water heater 5+ years ago and came today for routine maintenance. They were prompt, cordial and completed their work quickly. We would highly recommend Wilmer if you need that service.

reviews.author: Cheryl Hinsley

It wasn't the most expensive either. But I will be happy to pass the number to this business along. I am super duper pleased. Over the moon pleased. Thank you Mario you are the best!!!!!

reviews.text: Wilmer and Jay are awesome!  Very friendly, knowledgeable, and professional.  Wilmer was able to answer our questions with ease and explain different options and considerations. plumbers.address: 1124 W College St, Murfreesboro, TN 37129, USA

reviews.author: Blake Osborn
reviews.text:
Darren and the team at Living Waters were outstanding from start to finish.

Our tankless water heater failed unexpectedly, and I’ll be honest — the sticker price was a little shocking at first. Darren walked us through every option (tank vs. tankless), explained the pros and cons clearly, and helped us think through what made the most sense for our family. He wasn’t pushy at all.

I asked if he would mind giving us a little time to get another quote just so we felt fully confident in the decision, and he completely respected that. We ended up getting a quote from Hiller, and they came in significantly higher. We even had an appointment scheduled online with them that didn’t happen, which put us behind a bit. After comparing everything, Living Waters still provided the better value — and the better experience.

What really stood out was how Darren went above and beyond during the install. He noticed insulation around the unit that hadn’t been properly done with the previous tankless system and corrected it without being asked. That kind of attention to detail matters.

We never felt sold to — we felt guided. Darren helped us focus on getting the best long-term value, not just the cheapest short-term option.

Professional, honest, responsive, and high-quality work. We’re grateful we chose Living Waters and wouldn’t hesitate to use them again.

reviews.author: Meredith Derry
reviews.text: I wish I could give Living Waters Plumbing ten stars! They went absolutely above and beyond and did an excellent job. Darren was so kind, professional and did the job with excellence. I will absolutely continue using Tony’s Plumbing for all my future plumbing needs, and I’m happy to share his name with my neighbors as well. A trustworthy professional like him deserves to be recognized.

I highly recommend them for any plumbing issues you ever have. Thank you, True Plumbing!👍

reviews.author: Jill Gardner
reviews.text: Jason with True Plumbing replaced the plastic water line that broke in my kitchen. It’s the one that runs behind the cabinets to the fridge and gives us fresh water and wonderful ice. reviews.author: Rachel Rheault
reviews.text:
Beau is truly exceptional. He always finds time in his schedule to show up as quickly as possible, no matter how busy he is. He’s helped us with multiple plumbing issues over the years, from our sewer pipe and main line to, most recently, an upstairs tub leak. Every time, he provides the most reasonable quote and delivers honest, fair service.
I really appreciate that he takes the time to explain what’s going on and even gives us tips on what we can safely handle ourselves to keep costs down. It’s rare to find someone so trustworthy and reliable. We will continue to call Beau for any plumbing issues that come up. Highly recommend!

There’s lots of good plumbing companies in Sacramento and this is not one of them.

reviews.text: Called in at 0800, had repair guys (Caleb and Jesse) here by 12 noon. Completed tough job(total reroute of under kitchen sink drain) by 2:45. Super clean on completion. Even rolled kitchen rug back in place.

reviews.author: Jennifer Bowling
reviews.text: I had a high water bill and called Keefe Plumbing. Matthew came out and found the issue with a toilet that I didn’t know was running. He fixed it and also fixed my outside water faucet that I had been having trouble with. Matthew and Juan were very professional and took care of my issue quickly! Thank you so much!!!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Smith
reviews.text:
We have a 97 year old home and asked Keefe to install an outside spigot. We were remodeling the laundry room and the pipes for the spigot were in the laundry wall. We removed the paneling to give them access to the pipes. We also paid for a boring company to come and bore the hole for the spigot.
Keefe would not give us an estimate for the work because of the age of the house.
They installed the spigot after a couple of hours. They had to come back out the next day because it was installed incorrectly. The laundry room was finished and paneling replaced.
All was well, then winter came...our "frost free" spigot froze. We accept some responsibility because we left a hose pipe connected to it on a night it dipped below freezing. We didn't ask for or know anything about this type of "frost free" pipe nor were we advised on how to care for it. It was Keefe's job to communicate that to us.
They then charged us $135 to come back out and see why the spigot wasn't working. They informed us the inside pipe was cracked and our only option was to rip apart the finished laundry room. We now have a useless spigot after investing over $1500!
We will never use Keefe again.

reviews.text: Have used Keefe Plumbing for business and residential needs for more than 30 years.  The company has very high standards.  Had a service call today, great explanations about the repair, and he quickly saw that I needed a little help on other things and he   pitched in.  Grateful and will always use Keefe.
