reviews.author: Maria LUSTER
reviews.text:
David did an excellent job fixing our plumbing issues. He came during after hours and rushed over as soon as he knew it was an emergency, which we really appreciated.

He went above and beyond what we expected. Not only did he take care of the problem, but he also spent extra time explaining everything to us so we understood what was going on and how it was fixed.

Before leaving, he made sure everything was working properly and double-checked that we didn’t have any more backup issues. It was clear he really cared about doing the job right and making sure we were satisfied.

I really appreciate his professionalism, patience, and attention to detail. I would definitely recommend David to anyone needing plumbing work done.

reviews.author: Shelly Taylor
reviews.text:
We were stood up 2 days in a row by bacon plumbing. We had a busted pipe and was without water. These guys made an appointment for the next day with us and showed up exactly when they said they would.
My husband really liked Tom and Scott. We were expecting to pay an arm and a leg but they were very affordable. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Lindsey Hopper
reviews.text:
Absolutely blown away by the great service. This is the second time we have used this company. Scott and David were both so professional, polite, and knowledgeable. We had a lot of issues we needed addressed and they explained things clearly and were so patient, but also worked quickly. In and out in about 45 minutes.

We had a hot water heater issue with water temp in our primary bathroom not maintaining temperature. It’s gas so we didn’t want to mess with it and they resolved that quickly. They also cleared a clogged sink, fixed water pressure in our kitchen sink and I asked them to look at the outdoor hose spigots.

After they finished everything Scott was thoughtful enough to ask if there was anything else I wanted him to look at. That’s when I mentioned the kitchen sink water pressure and he was happy to take a look at it. I am a female in my 30s and felt so comfortable with David and Scott in my home. I will continue to call them for all plumbing needs and will encourage our neighbors to do the same!

reviews.author: Dee Parker
reviews.text: Scott & David were amazing! Extremely nice and professional.  They were my Super Heroes for the day. They came in and fixed the problem in no time. So grateful!

reviews.author: Matthew Mccleary
reviews.text:
Scott and David did an amazing job!! I had another local plumbing company that was highly rated, come out on two different occasions and in fairly short order. Regardless, they still never fixed my problem.

Enter David and Scott- these guys did everything they could to keep the price as low as they could while still giving excellent quality.

They replaced a toilet, snaked a line and replaced a valve on my guest bathroom toilet and it cost me the same as the other company for their two visits that didn't fix anything.

These guys went above and beyond and even vacuumed the floor when I didn't see any reason to do it - but they did it just because it was the right thing to do! I chose them for their Google Ratings and I am extremely pleased because they gave the service that their reviews claimed!

I will absolutely use 1 Tom Plumbers from now on!

reviews.author: Shawna Kane
reviews.text: John at Local Plumber did a great job replacing the gas line on my water heater. He was well-informed and straight foward about the price and what he was going to do. I also appreciated talking to Gabby(?) when I called (rather than an automated service) to set up the appointment. I would recommend Local Plumber for their promptness and quality of service.

reviews.author: Francie Koch
reviews.text: John was on time, explained everything I needed done and went right to work installing a new sink and garbage disposal.  He was very pleasant and tolerated my puppy, so he will be the only plumber I will ever call!  Very professional and knowledgeable and cleaned up everything.  If you need a plumber, give this company a call - you will be very pleased with quality work.

reviews.author: Danielle Jeanty
reviews.text:
Rob was warm and friendly. He immediately gave me some options that made me feel comfortable with doing business with them!
The fact that he was a fellow New Yorker and Christ follower didn't hurt either! If we go with pros, you will definitely be hearing from us!

reviews.author: Keem Thompson
reviews.text: John came by and cleared up my leaking water heater with quick and efficient service. He gave me a fair price and let me know everything that was going on before he got started. Friendly service and excellent speed.

reviews.author: C R
reviews.text:
It is hard to accurately describe how grateful we are for Local Plumber and for the services they provided for our family.
We recently experienced a water leak that flooded two rooms on the first floor of our home. The water was coming from somewhere underneath a built-in jetted tub, so we demolished the wall around the tub to discover that the water appeared to be bubbling up from under the concrete slab. We had no idea where it could be coming from, but turning off the water to our home was the only way to stop it.
I called a couple of “leak detection” specialty companies that I located online, only to be told they could not come out for one to two weeks. I was almost in tears when I called Local Plumber, but from that very first call they were amazing! Krista was able to send someone to our home that same afternoon, and kept me informed the entire time as to their ETA.
The plumber that responded to our call was John B., and we could tell from the moment we met him that we were in expert hands. He was extremely professional, thorough and knowledgeable as he diagnosed the source of our issue, and he determined that we had a leak in the pipe that runs  underground from our water well to our house. After telling us how he could fix the issue, John B. answered all of our questions and addressed our concerns. He was able to give us a quote within a few minutes after leaving our house, and because we were living with no water, the job was scheduled to be done 48 hours later.
From start to finish their communication was top-notch, and John B. is an absolute perfectionist.
The cost of the job was very reasonable and they guarantee their work.
We are grateful to have found such an amazing company, and cannot recommend them highly enough. Do not hesitate to give them a call!

plumbers.address: 190 Crabtree Dr, Roswell, GA 30076, USA

reviews.author: Chad D
reviews.text: Sean was amazing! I had an emergency situation and they rushed out on a Saturday. Sean quickly found the issue. He provided excellent advice as a master plumber. He directed me to my HoA since they may be responsible. He ended up being correct. He was extremely helpful in an incredibly stressful situation.

reviews.author: Stewart and William Davis
reviews.text:
This is the second time we’ve used Sean and his team, and we cannot recommend them highly enough. They came out the same day we called with our issue and were extremely patient and thoughtful in walking us through the available solutions.

They completed a major sewer line replacement in just two days, cleaned up all debris, covered the work area with pine straw, and even repaired a broken irrigation pipe, despite it not being part of their responsibility.

It’s hard to feel confident with a large plumbing repair, but Sean and his team went above and beyond to earn our trust. From clear camera footage explaining the problem, to a warranty they stand behind, to an incredibly fair price, the entire experience was excellent.

reviews.author: Jake Mazzei
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Sean and his company. They are very professional and by far the best plumbing company I have ever used. We have used him multiple times and he has always been able to diagnose the problem and get it repaired quickly. Additionally he is always on time!!! I highly recommend using this company.

reviews.author: Michael Pardo
reviews.text:
I am writing this review of Specialty Plumbing and Drain as I am compelled to praise the professionalism and expertise of this company and its proprietor Sean Fagan ( Master Plumber Unrestricted).
On several occasions we called and utilized the services of Specialty Plumbing and Drain. Each time I was so impressed and amazed by the excellent service and expertise exhibited by the responding team.
This company’s support team and office staff are excellent as they are also personable, responsive and efficient.
Sean and staff were always punctual and immediately responded when necessary. They are courteous, professional and extremely knowledgeable and proficient at their trade.
Their vast and specialized array of tools and equipment is extremely impressive.
They have always been successful in diagnosing any problem and fixing it when other plumbing companies could not.
Their pricing is beyond reasonable for their accomplished and highly specialized plumbing services offered and provided.
I would only call Specialty Plumbing  and drain for any and all of my plumbing problems and issues.
I would strongly suggest you take advantage of this company’s highly specialized services and performance for all your plumbing needs.
Michael R. Pardo

reviews.text:

Sean did a phenomenal job explaining everything to us, coming up with a solution that was better than we expected, and quoted us reasonably for the work being done. They were able to complete the job in a day, left our property looking like nothing ever happened, and made us feel taken care of throughout the entire process.

His team is highly skilled and very passionate about what they do. We are forever customers! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Parker Goodfellow
reviews.text:
Thank you Thomas E Clark and DCDOE and their Lead Pipe Replacement Assistance Program (LPRAP).

With funding through DDOE LPRAP program we were finally able to get the last piece of lead out of our incoming water system.

Thomas E Clark answered our request for service promptly, sent out a project manager to confirm that we were in fact eligible for the LPRAP, received approval from DDOE to perform the work, applied for and received all permits, and performed the water line replacement all within the span of 3 weeks. From initial call to the water line being replaced.

Their crew was on time, courteous, and explain the process in exacting detail, giving us milestones for when we could expect the water to be turned off and turn back on as the line was replaced. Their house call Pro scheduling app made it very easy to communicate with the project manager as well as the technicians, and provided real-time tracking of their location and eta through the house call Pro app.

I'm very thankful to Thomas E Clark and the LPRAP program for providing this service to the District of Columbia residents.

I remember a time in DC when Department of Health came to houses that had young children and tested them for lead, I was one of those kids.

The water may taste a little less sweet after today! But at least my kids won't have to deal with this lead problem in the future. What a wonderful program.

reviews.author: Danial Mcghie
reviews.text:
Thomas Clark did a fantastic job on site. They were respectful, quick, cleaned up after their work, amd talked me through both the problem and the solution. They completed a lead service line replacement flawlessly, and changed a long section of galvanized pipe. They were affordable and quick.

Ill definitely be returning to this team with any future plumbing issues.

Best

They even installed a new water filter on the faucet of my kitchen sink because I knew I couldn't figure it out. The cost (with a special lead replacement program in DC was '0' to me.  I recommend this company highely and kudos to these three workers.

reviews.text: We have used Thomas E Clark for plumbing as well as HVAC services for over two years. We find their service to be of excellent quality, prompt and fairly priced. For emergency repairs, they can usually respond within the same day.

reviews.author: Jeremy Lyle
reviews.text:
* 10 STARS *
I’ve used Triple Crown multiple times now, and every single experience has been outstanding. They truly go above and beyond what you’d expect from a plumbing service.
The first time I called them for a clogged main drain line in my home and Gunner responded quickly, diagnosed the problem accurately, and fixed it efficiently with no surprises on the bill. But what really impressed me was how they’ve continued to step up, a few weeks later I called them back to see about getting some work done at a commercial space I rent and Gunner returned to give me the estimate for the work with the best price I could have asked for! He was able to fit me in his schedule the very next day and complete the job. They actually came back out (at no extra charge) specifically to double check everything and make sure there would be zero issues for the inspection. That kind of care and attention to detail is rare these days. Steele even did his absolute best to get the permits and inspections done in a timely manner to allow us to open on time!
The team is friendly, knowledgeable, respectful, and communicates clearly every step of the way. If you’re looking for a reliable plumber you can trust to do it right the first time and even better, to make sure it stays right look no further. Gunner and Triple crown plumbing have earned my highest recommendation and my repeat business for life. 10 out of 5 stars.

reviews.author: Heather Terry
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Triple Crown Plumbing. They replaced two toilets in my store, repaired a faucet, and installed a new water heater. Gunner arrived at 8 AM for a consultation and ended up coming back and completing the job in the same day! Their work was professional and high-quality, and Gunner was great to work with! I highly recommend them for reliable plumbing services.

reviews.author: Heather Mullins
reviews.text: Gunner was my technician, and he did a great job. He did the initial diagnosis, offered up two estimates; one with me supplying the equipment and one with them supplying. I would highly recommend Gunner and triple crown plumbing.

reviews.text: Fast response and direct/honest pricing. Mike was easy to work with and very helpful. Needed new pressure valve and shower valve in my home and Stoney's made it easy and affordable. Great service and excellent advice!

reviews.author: Richard Moody
reviews.text:
Mike professionally cleaned out my kitchen sink drain clog.
Have used Stoney's Plumbing several times.
Great service, easy scheduling.

reviews.author: Karin Dean (KayDee)
reviews.text: Mike Stone, the owner of Stoney’s Plumbing, was outstanding! He replaced my garbage disposal quickly and left everything neat and clean. I’ll definitely call him again and highly recommend his work.

reviews.author: ChrisTheSavage656 Plus

reviews.author: Will Smith
reviews.text: Chesapeake Plumbing did an outstanding job replacing my water heater. They were prompt, knowledgeable, and very professional. The installation went extremely smooth, and they took time to explain everything clearly. Great experience from start to finish. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jess Cardy
reviews.text:
We had the unfortunate event of our hot water heater breaking and partially flooding our basement. Luckily, Chesapeake Plumbing was able to send someone out to install a new hot water heater the next day. They sent a gentleman named David over who was professional, polite, and very knowledgeable. David took extra care to lay down a tarp so that our floors wouldn't get dirty during the removal of the old hot water heater and the installation of the new one. The installation went seamlessly and David gave us tips on how to maintain a hot water heater when using well water when we picked his brain.

We'd highly recommend Chesapeake Plumbing for your plumbing needs. They were easy to work with, are very knowledgeable in the field, and are very competitively priced. We couldn't be happier with the service that we received and will be sure to use them in the future!

reviews.author: Dianne Rogers
reviews.text:
I was very pleased with the work that David from Chesapeake Plumbing, Inc. did. The one toilet had been spraying a fine mist which I felt might be the beginning of a leak and the handle on the shower had been difficult for me to turn on; I had to put a good deal of pressure on it for the water to come out.
David replaced the toilet valve as it was indeed damaged and  replaced the cartridge in the shower handle which was a bit corroded as well as cracked a bit.

The one outstanding aspect of David was his ability to communicate well. He patiently answered all my questions and even explained in detail what he had done even though I did not ask him to do so. It was evident to me, as a retired educator, that he was very knowledgeable about his work and appeared appreciative that he had helped me when I thanked him for a job well done!

I have done business with Chesapeake Plumbing, Inc. for years and would highly recommend them to anyone who is looking for a company that does excellent work for reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Matthew Bulkley
reviews.text:
Truly excellent service!  Absolutely will be our go-to plumbing service going forward.

My mother's traditional water heater was failing and needed to be replaced.  Her appliance insurance company had provided her with company options that were charging an arm and a leg or that would take a few weeks to get to her.

I found Chesapeake Plumbing based on their high Google reviews and reached out.  They had an expert there in just a couple days, provided a fair quote for a new tankless water heater, and even did the installation THAT SAME DAY!

Thank you for taking such great care of my mother!

reviews.author: John

The price was beyond reasonable and the work impeccable. Besides the good work, I see Arrow Plumbing supporting non profits all over our community. Give them a call and be impressed like I was!

reviews.author: Eloy Cavazos
reviews.text: Called to get an estimate on a swimming pool gas line that was rusted. Had a technician at my house within the hour. I received a quote that I could not pass up and job was completed by close of day. Job well done and Excellent service. I will definitely use their services again.

reviews.author: Jun Ortega
reviews.text: Water heater broke Saturday afternoon.  Called and left a message at their business phone.. Got a call back within an hour. Can̈elo explained the costs of a weekend visit and his associate came in to assess the heater sunday.  We agreed to have the repairs the following day Monday at 8 am. The crew was on time and finished the job 2 hours tops. Made sure everything was working properly before they left. ARROW plumbing is great.

reviews.author: Lisa D.
reviews.text: I couldn't be more pleased with Arrow Plumbing and their employees. I have just recently had to take over this kind of thing for my mom and finding a plumber. It was stressful trying to choose the right one since it can be so expensive and she is on a budget. So grateful I chose them. They came that day, got on our roof in the rain and fixed our issue. The bill was so reasonable that everytime I think about it I almost cry, which I did when they told us. Such a relief. Some out there price gouge, especially for seniors, not these guys they are fair, upfront and reasonable. I will definitely be passing their name on to others. THANX SO MUCH!

reviews.author: Jennifer Korn
reviews.text: They were extremely kind, fast and work is beautiful and will last for years. We will definitely be calling them for any plumbing needs in the future

reviews.author: Ryan Lynn
reviews.text: Robert and Diondre did an amazing job on the install! Discord is a professional company through and through. Preston who did the inspection caught that we had CO gases being leaked. If it wasn’t for the financing the company offered, I may not have been able to replace it. When the unit was pulled out the heat exchange was burnt through. The wall was burned too. We are very blessed to have Preston catch that it needed to be replaced. Robert and Diondre had extra issues with getting out the old unit. They had great attitudes and were super respectful and thorough. My wife and child were at home during install and I felt safe knowing that all employees are background checked and professional. Robert and Diondre were super fun to have around. The company also makes sure to double check all their workers via video and pictures. They also do a follow up inspection. Would highly recommend them. You never know what you are getting with an ad in the mail, but it paid off. No complaints and really thankful to fiscor for making my house safe again.

reviews.author: Lauren Thagard
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with Fiscor and their HVAC installation team! From start to finish, the team was respectful, knowledgeable, and true professionals. They took great pride in the quality of their work, paid attention to every detail, and made sure everything was done right. Additionally, they had to repair several problems our previous HVAC installers left behind and is also likely why our last system had to be replaced well before its lifespan. They thoroughly explained how our new system works and answered all of our questions, which we really appreciated. They also cleaned up completely after the installation, leaving our home just as they found it. We couldn’t be happier with the service and highly recommend Fiscor to anyone looking for a reliable and professional HVAC company! Huge thank you to Robert and Diondre who spent a 12-hour day working at our house on the full unit install, the duct repair in our attic, and adding an additional return vent, all to ensure our new unit’s efficiency. Jason was also great, showing up early and checking in regularly. Overall, just a wonderful team that did an exceptional job, under less than ideal circumstances (previous work flaws). Thank you all for the great work!!!

reviews.author: Leisa Boyd
reviews.text: Robert and Alan came out to do some minor repairs and verify work that had previously been done by other techs. They were on time, very friendly, and completely through. They walked me though everything and took the time to inspect each vent and close off some vents that were not being used to maximize airflow in our most used rooms. It was a great experience and I highly recommend Fiscor for their amazing techs.

reviews.author: Ken Brown
reviews.text: Jason, Diondre, Logan and Ryan did an outstanding job installing new “lungs” or ducting for my intake and exhaust system on my HVAC system. They were very professional, knowledgable and explained things very well. My system is working great and I’m happy with the service.

reviews.author: Denise Rose
reviews.text: Robert and Diondrea were my installers on my new Bosch furnace and air conditioning unit! These guys are animals, they were very determined to make sure I had heat before they left, staying until 11:45 p.m., then returning at 7 a.m. the next day to complete the install. Jason, the Field Coordinator stopped in just to make sure I was satisfied. Since my old furnace had completely shut down, Tiffany and Wendy made sure I was on the top.of their schedule, that was phenomenal. I cannot say enough good things about the customer service provided by all Fiscor employees!!! Including Carlis, who was the first tech that helped me with a different concern. Thank you to all!!!

reviews.author: Michelle Reece
reviews.text: We needed plumbing work done soon and they were able to come to the house the same day and completely finish the work that needed to be done.  They came after 6:00 pm pumped the septic tank and made a baffle and was done properly around 8:30 pm. We are very pleased with them!!!!

reviews.author: dubbio55
reviews.text: We had an outside faucet break. Duckett was first to respond, which was appreciated. “We charge $75 to come out but discount it if you want us to do the job.”  Fine. They come out and look at the faucet and pipe and say $500. We needed it done so hesitant but OK. When paying I asked to have that broken down. One explanation was that Google charges them $180 for the search service when someone searches with Google online. We need to pay their overhead. I owned a business and know that’s not the way to cover overhead. Using AI to search for Google fees I find out that the usual fees range from $15 to $50 per lead!  The work was good, hence two stars. But charging me $180 for a $15-$50 charge to them is not right. We needed it done but won’t be using them again.

reviews.author: Daen Campbell
reviews.text:
My son recently inherited a 1945 mill home from his grandparents. The home needs a complete rehab, but we were looking to make it livable until the spring. It’s in a very small town and plumbers willing to take the job are limited.

From the very first phone call late on a Friday afternoon about a big water leak, to the completion of the job, Duckett Plumbing exceeded my expectations.

These guys are so knowledgeable. They provided me with solid options based on our needs and budget.

Wayne was the best! He completed all the work on our very necessary bathroom fixes. New toilet, new shower fixtures and new shower surround. He’s thoughtful of his work and provided the best customer experience. He went so far above and beyond what was requested.

We had some scheduling issues because we were out of town for several days to move, but they stayed in contact to let me know how they’d accommodate the crazy schedule.

Give Duckett plumbing a call. They are fantastic!

reviews.author: Eric Simmons
reviews.text: Highly recommend Duckett Plumbing. David the technician called notifying me he was on his way  and arrived on time. Understood the issue I was having and got promptly to work. Was even able to get me a discount since I had the necessary parts and was doing the same repair on separate faucets. Very professional and personable in his manor.

reviews.author: Kitty Lewis
reviews.text: I had a leak in my kitchen free standing ice maker, of course, on a Sunday night at 7:30pm. The leak was substantial and I was in a panic! I called Duckett Plumbing because their website said that they would respond to urgent situations. I called several places, and Duckett called me right back and service personnel were at my house within 45 minutes. (I live in Greenwood, SC and they were coming from Anderson SC.) William was the service provider and he was wonderful. He quickly got the water off and found the problem. He came even though no businesses were open to provide needed parts. He was able to turn off the water to the ice maker only, so that we still had water. Life saver!! He got the situation controlled last night and then came back this morning to replace the leaking hose in the ice maker and under the house. He was efficient and skilled and very kind. I could not ask for better service! The price was very reasonable considering the timing and how quickly he was able to address the issue. That leak could have ruined my entire kitchen flooring, not to mention that it was also leaking in the crawlspace under the house. I will rate them as many stars as possible!! Great response time!! Great service personnel!! I am so thankful!

reviews.author: Sandy Puccinelli
reviews.text: In my opinion, this company is excellent. My repair man, Rich, came on time and immediately he made me feel comfortable. He fixed the many  water breaks caused by the recent freeze. He was extremely personable and he knew his craft. I can’t explain my peace of mind knowing that everything would be fine and it was. The prices were reasonable and I’m one satisfied customer. Mr. David E. White, the owner, was personable and a pleasure to talk to. His answering machine was very interesting too. It has a most fascinating AI tape that takes messages. It was the smartest answering machine I’ve ever left a message on. So yes, I highly recommend this company.

Would definitely use them again.

reviews.text: We've been using One Call Plumbing for years and can't say enough nice things about them! Today's visit from Ethan (and initial call with David) was no exception. Thankful for them and highly recommend!

reviews.author: Clara Clark
reviews.text: Our toilets and tubs suddenly started simultaneously not draining well late one night.  Early the next morning we called around and it was clear that One Call Plumbing was the choice plumber.  We were faced with having to have a Main Water Line Blockage fixed, and they made it painless, and even offered financing as an option.  They were professional, kind, as accommodating as possible, and they were able to get someone out within just an hour or two of us calling.  In addition, in comparison to some plumbing companies, they were affordable, and even took into account one of us being a Veteran, and gave a military discount.  Our technician was one of the best dispatched techs I have ever had the pleasure of dealing with.  In a world so focused on instant gratification, and in business to just make a buck, this company did not disappoint.  Would not hesitate to use again and recommend.  I don't leave reviews but this one was worth leaving one for.  Thank you

reviews.author: Joc Davis
reviews.text: Neighbors told me I had a water leak, I called One Call Plumbing.  Very professional and serving from the first moments.  Response time was within 3 hours from first call. Price was very fair for the service that was provided. High recommended

reviews.author: Wayne Corlis
reviews.text: I tecently had U.S. Water Heating Solutions install a new hot water heater in my home, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! From the initial call, their team was responsive, professional, and transparent about options and pricing. The technician arrived on time, worked efficiently, and did a clean, high-quality installation. He even took the time to explain how the new unit works and gave tips for maintenance. Hot water was restored quickly with no mess left behind. Highly recommend them for anyone needing water heater replacement – great service from a reliable, company!

reviews.author: Eleonore Stoesser
reviews.text:
The technician Chris was very timely, polite, and helpful.
We had issues with our water heater putting it smelly sulfer/rotten egg scented water.
The technicians that did initial install left us high and dry.
Through Home Depot we were paired with US water heating solutions for the warranty repair.
As it turns out, we needed a powered anode rod to combat the minerals in the well water.
Chris came out and drained the tank, and bleached it to kill all the bacteria that was left behind.
He returned the following day, installed the anode rod, refilled the tank, and sure everything was in good working order.
Chris was very knowledgeable, proficient, and put our minds at ease.
10/10 will recommend US water heating solutions to anyone needing an install or repairs!!!!

reviews.author: Justin Skaggs
reviews.text: I had a very positive experience from the first phone call to the tankless water heater installation. The tech, Russ, was professional, knowledgeable, timely, courteous, and efficient. Thankful for his work. Based on my experience, I would highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Lisa Brooks
reviews.text: My water heater services 3 apartments. When it stopped working I heard all about it at volume 10. US Water Heating Solutions to the rescue! And he used data to determine the problem and confirm the solution - inspired confidence and relieved stress. I had them come back out on a weekday to upgrade one part that was giving the tech some weird readings. All is now well and I'm glad to have these folks on my team should future problems arise. Definitely recommend.

The 3 stars are for the price they charged me and the 4 days to get out here .

reviews.author: Patti Bearden
reviews.text: Justin and his crew provided superior services.  They went over and beyond to ensure every detail was taken care of within a tight deadline. Justin responded to messages in a timely manner and while working, he was kind, communicative and attentive to detail. He and his assistant interacted with a great balance of professionalism and humor making the project less overwhelming for me and providing me with the assurance the job would be done well.  I highly recommend Premier Plumbing.  I believe Justin is truly a man of integrity and skill.

reviews.author: Joey Pannell
reviews.text: “So glad we called Premium Plumbing for our Cullman home! Justin Barbee runs a top notch operation — friendly, efficient, and the work was done right the first time. Won’t use anyone else for our plumbing needs!” And I’m glad I didn’t have to get under there…!!

reviews.author: Jimmy Wells
reviews.text: I had a clogged toilet that I couldn't unstop with my auger. My wife was in the hospital and due to come home the next day. Two young men came out and managed (with great effort) to unclog it with their auger, clearing out an apparent piece of hard plastic dropped in by a grandchild. Exceptional service, professional work by the employees and much less expensive than I feared it would be.

reviews.text: Outstanding service.  They got me set up with a new regulator and expansion tank and I now have great water pressure.  Both guys did an excellent job at a great price.

reviews.author: Stephanie G.
reviews.text:
I wanted to take the time to send a shout out to the guys at Paramount Plumbing. We purchased our home when it was stripped down to the studs. While some plumbing was still in place, it was old black pipe with visible cracks, past leaks, and multiple patch repairs from prior owners. We received several estimates and ultimately chose Paramount Plumbing — and we’re so happy we did.

Paramount completely re-plumbed our entire home with 100% new plumbing. They also installed sinks, showers, drains, toilets, vanities, hose spickets...everything. We had changed the floor plan significantly, added multiple bathrooms, an additional kitchen, a pantry with a sink, a main-floor laundry room, and ended up with five bathrooms total. They also jetted our main sewer line, which helped us avoid having to jackhammer the slab — a huge win.

They recommended and replaced our water heater, repaired and replaced gas lines as needed, and even ran new gas lines to our 60-year-old fireplace. Their recommendations were greatly appreciated, and the quality of work was excellent. They also reccomended ways we could save on cost which is a really big deal when you have to do that much remodeling.

Out of every contractor involved in our remodel, Paramount Plumbing was the only one who showed up every day, on time, and completed their work efficiently, timely and correctly. They took the time to do things the right way, and it genuinely felt like they cared about the quality and long-term reliability of their work.

We built a large custom shower with four independent fixtures, and they executed it perfectly. I sleep better at night knowing the plumbing was done right.

They were also the only contractor on our entire project who passed county inspection quickly and without issues. After the challenges we faced with other trades, Eric, Aiden, and Ferman from Paramount were the best part of our remodel experience.

Highly recommend the guys at Paramount.

reviews.text:

Since that time, Nick has served as the primary building plumber, and I truly cannot say enough positive things about him.

Nick is consistently prompt, professional, and clear in his communication. He always takes the extra time—often an additional 5–10 minutes—to thoroughly explain issues and solutions in a way that is easy to understand, which is incredibly valuable when working with Boards and homeowners.

Most recently, the association experienced a significant pipe burst. I immediately contacted Paramount Plumbing, and Nick was on-site within an hour. Upon arriving around 9:00 PM, he quickly assessed the situation and took immediate action. He worked diligently until nearly 5:00 AM, without complaint, ensuring the repairs were completed properly.

Throughout the entire process, Nick kept both me and the Board President fully informed. His calm demeanor, professionalism, and exceptional communication were instrumental in managing a very stressful situation.
I highly recommend Nick and Paramount Plumbing and am extremely grateful for the level of service, dedication, and reliability they consistently provide.

My house is old and of course there were the “normal” amount of unexpected issues encountered when Midwest Plumbing was tying in the new plumbing to the existing plumbing. I’ve worked alongside a lot of plumbers - these guys are among the best I’ve encountered. True professionals.

I had a great experience with Drain and Plumbing Services. From scheduling the appointment to completing the work, everything was handled professionally and efficiently. They arrived on time, quickly identified the issue, and explained the solution in a way that was easy to understand.

The technician was courteous, knowledgeable, and worked efficiently. Pricing was fair and transparent, with no hidden fees or pressure to add unnecessary services. The work area was left clean, and everything has been working perfectly since.

If you’re looking for a reliable and honest plumbing company, I highly recommend Drain and Plumbing Services. Would absolutely use them again!

reviews.author: Michael Wlodek
reviews.text:
This was the first time using Drain & Plumbing Services and it will not be the last time.
From calling, setting up the appointment and the time frame they gave me for when the technician would be at the house was spot on. The next hurdle, would now be the technician himself.
The tech they send out was Dmytro and he was superb. From arrival,  setting up, carrying out the task of power rodding the main sewer line and cleaning up, I was very impressed.
Thank you Drain & Plumbing Services!
And thank you Dmytro for a job well done!

reviews.author: David Falla

reviews.author: Yulia Nosova
reviews.text: Great Service and quality of expertise. I have been using these guys more than 7 years. Done with them many different jobs: in the kitchen and bathroom. Sorry that did not review before. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Helene Verner
reviews.text:
Price’s Plumbing and Heating
Prompt, Thorough, and Excellent Communication
We use Price’s Plumbing and Heating for all our plumbing and HVAC needs. When our hot water heater suddenly stopped working, we placed a service request that evening. Impressively, Matt (owner) arrived promptly by 9:00 AM the very next day. He conducted a thorough assessment, carefully investigating all possible issues before determining the part that needed to be replaced. The required part was promptly ordered, and by the following day, our hot water heater was back up and running perfectly.
Throughout the process, communication was excellent. We were consistently kept up to date via both phone and email, which gave us peace of mind and confidence in the service provided. The professionalism, reliability, and attention to detail displayed were outstanding. The pricing is fair and they do not proceed without providing you with a written estimate. We highly recommend Price’s Plumbing and Heating for anyone in need of prompt and effective plumbing repairs.

reviews.author: Avi Rynderman
reviews.text: Chris did a phenomenal job diagnosing the issue with my furnace and fixed it within a day. We went from no heat to a fully functioning system within 24 hours of the diagnostic. Chris took the time to show me exactly what was wrong (an easily replaceable limit switch) and happily answered all my questions. I am saving Price’s Plumbing Heating and Air Conditioning in my contacts, and they will be my first call if I have an issue in the future. Thank you, Chris!

reviews.author: megatop412
reviews.text: Very high quality plumbing services for an appropriate price. Matt clearly knows his stuff and does not hesitate to inform you of what is best to fix a nasty plumbing situation. He has been over a couple times this past year to install a main water shutoff, a new water filter line for the fridge, has fixed the innards of both our toilets, and repaired a busted water line from the recent cold snap. 2 years ago we hired them to install a new HVAC system and water heater and Chris did an excellent job installing it. They're very easy to work with, let you know when they're on their way, and clean up after themselves. Can't recommend them highly enough

reviews.author: Donna Kuzma
reviews.text: We’ve worked with Price’s Plumbing multiple times over the past year and have been extremely happy with their service! We saw them recommended on local Facebook groups, and we just renewed our annual Comfort Plan for HVAC maintenance and discounts on service calls. Chris has been out to our house multiple times… he’s on time, friendly, communicative, and explains things clearly. He replaced our old heater last year, replaced a toilet and fixed other aging plumbing issues, and made some great suggestions regarding optimizing our HVAC efficiency. Happy to recommend and support this local business!

reviews.author: Stacey Orrio
reviews.text: Price’s is the best!! My family has used them for years. Fair pricing and excellent workmanship. Chris has been to our home for a variety of plumbing needs and to replace our AC. Everything is always explained in detail and options are given with different pricing when available. Can’t recommend them enough!!

reviews.author: Mark Erbes
reviews.text: We had a bsmt floor drain backup that was discovered on a Saturday morning (of course). I made a call to Roto Rooter (who I’ve not used for a long time). They had a gentleman out to our house within 2 hrs. He determined the problem to be the ejector pump. He was unable to repair the problem but was able to evacuate the tank. Very thankful for his help and involvement.

reviews.author: Sarah Forbes
reviews.text: I called 1st thing Monday morning and explained my frozen pipes and frustration of trying to get help quickly as our pipes had been frozen for a long time and we lost use of the bathroom Sunday. Although very busy they managed to get out by the afternoon and clear out all of our house pipes. They are amazing, Professional, knowledgeable, experienced guys who explained everything as they went along. They will always be who I contact. Thank you for all of your help.

reviews.author: Coach David
reviews.text: Excellent service!!! These people go above and beyond the call of duty to make sure you are up and going in no time!  From the response to your call to the superb work of the technician! Technician Joe Stremkowski was professional, polite, and exceptional in explaining and fixing our problem!  I would  encourage anyone and everyone to call these guys first before you call anyone else! Thank you! Thank you! Thank you, Roto-Rooter!

reviews.author: Corrine Ann
reviews.text: I just moved into my home two months ago, and after a disastrous attempt to fix a blockage on my own, Brandon and Mack truly saved the day. They were incredibly professional—scoping the pipe for any damage, clearing the blockage efficiently, and providing a thorough report afterward. They also explained when future maintenance should be done, which I really appreciated. I highly recommend their services!

reviews.author: Ela Hoffman

They were friendly, and when offering services they didn't put pressure on us to say yes. We would definitely recommend the team at J. Blanton!

I would recommend them without reservation and will use them again should another plumbing issue arise.

reviews.author: Honey Ahijevych
reviews.text: We had Homestead Plumbing install 2 new faucets in our house a month or so ago. We had our counter tops replaced and the contractor didn't install our faucets, as promised. After I hung up, they called me back in 15 minutes and said that their other job fell through due to the weather. They came to our house and installed 2 faucets. It turned out that the contractors had made a mess of our pipes so Homestead had to fix the pipes and install new connectors. They did this in 2 hours and with amazing ease, professionalism. They cleaned up and thank goodness..otherwise we would have had a minor flood and no faucet. I highly recommend them! they are amazing. Great communication and very efficient! Hire them!

Mother’s came out to assess a sewer drainage leak that we had. Colton and his team were extremely helpful, and very knowledgeable.

Calling them whenever we need a plumber in the Plano area. We also got our Water Heater replaced through them and that was a breeze.

reviews.author: Sue Roche
reviews.text:
We were in the midst of remodeling a bathroom when we ran into a problem which required some of the existing plumbing be replaced. We thought this might involve cutting out a piece of the wall behind the shower. Colton came and assessed the problem, got the required materials, and fixed it very quickly. He found a way to do it without cutting into the wall which we really liked!
Colton was professional, friendly, and did a great job!! We'll definitely call him again for our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: D Lystad
reviews.text:
Totally happy with Colton and the proposals he gave us to resolve our problems. He explained the options and guarantees.
The workers were punctual and hard working. The broken pipe was very deep but the excavation crew exposed the broken pipe so Mathew could replace it. Once replaced and tested the excavation crew was back on the job within a few hours and everything was neat as a pin. Very satisfied and appreciative. Thanks for everything guys. Job very well done. Excellent job

reviews.author: Ashley Jay
reviews.text:
The reason for three stars is the cost point.
Matt and his apprentice that came out today and did the work were professional, knowledgeable and very nice. I was disappointed that it took two trips on two separate days to get the work done. That meant me missing two half days at work. Colton came out yesterday and was also very nice , but said he didn’t have the necessary parts with him to fix the leak. The guys today had to leave and go to the hardware store to get parts before they could get started.
It took no more than 10’ of pipes and fittings. It cost me $1574 .04 to run two pipes from the water softener to the outside pipes to the main line. They did not have to plumb the actual softener. The only parts replaced were near the cutoff valves down. It’s was approximately 3.5’ to 4’ per line.  They did replace 3 cutoff valves, but I have bought them before and know they aren’t terribly expensive. Overall I am happy with the actual work, but not at all happy with the cost.  They do encourage a member ship that cost about $330.00 a year  and gives you a discount on the service and a few other perks, but that ended up only costing about $100.00 after the discount ($236.96) on the work. I usually get more than one bid, and it’s my fault I didn’t, but I can’t change that now. So did they do good work? Yes! Are they super expensive?  I feel like they are for the time it took and the minimal parts needed. Seems like it was way over $500.00 per hour when all was said and done. I might mention there was no digging involved to reach the pipes.
The company is good about telling you who your service person will be and gives you their tracking so you know when they will be there which is a plus.
My name is Angela. I’m not sure why it says Ashley.

reviews.author: Trent Artichoker
reviews.text:
Had simple leak in PEX tubing that needed repaired. Looked on Google maps, called McAdams Plumbing, Heating & Cooling, but yet the business that was actually doing the work was Mesa Plumbing, Heating & Cooling. They were able to come the same day, which is great. Cody showed up, we talked , agreed that 5' section of PEX needed replaced. Comes back with estimate, $14K for whole house plumbing, $1.4K to replace 5' PEX with copper, or third option, replace bad PEX section with updated PEX at $1.1K. I tell Cody that his estimate is overpriced and excessive that comes out to $400 plus per hour. He supports his estimate with rationalization. I agree because I'm helping a tenant, and they need water.

Cody spends 2.5 hours at the property and at the end takes $100 off because of the time. So, I pay $1,056.25.

I get a text after the visit wanting to know how they did. I complain about cost, their solution was $50 credit on file.

$422.50 per hour labor rate is ridiculous. Be wary of this business all

reviews.author: Kris
reviews.text: The folks at McAdams are so amazing! I had spent a month with a broken toilet trying to work with my home warranty and the terrible plumber from a different different company they sent out before I was able to break my contract. This this point and I was pretty skeptical of all plumbers but I saw that McAdams Plumbing had the best reviews in the area so I gave them a shot. The receptionist I talked to on the phone was so nice and incredibly helpful! I needed to replace my whole toilet (as a new homeowner this is my first time doing it) and she took the time to go over all the different models and gave me some great recommendation! They were then able to come out and install the new toilet the next day, the other plumber I had to work with took 5 days to come out and just look at the toilet.  Tim was my technician and, with a call a head of time, said he could be there earlier than the scheduled time. When Tim arrived he was extremely nice and very professional! We chatted a bit about why I was replacing the toilet and he listened to me rant about the awful experience I had trying to get it fixed before and he was very sympathetic to my situation. After I mentioned that I just moved in to this condo he asked if he could look at my water heater because he has had to replace a lot of them recently in this condominium complex, which was so considerate. He removed (and disposed) my old toilet and installed the new one and all its guts a lot faster than I thought and was really cleanly (he even put little booties over his shoes to avoid tracking anything on my carpet)! I cannot recommend McAdams enough and from now on they will always be the first people I call should I have any more plumbing issues.

They granted a 15% senior discount, which is always appreciated, and they didn't mind my looking over their shoulder and asking questions, which is also appreciated.  Price?  I don't know if I overpaid or not because they were the only contractor I talked to, so there's no one else to compare with.  Would I recommend this contractor?  Yes, with no doubt about the recommendation.

reviews.author: Latisse Taylor
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Elizabeth Kenney

reviews.author: Paul Gumpel
reviews.text: LJ Kruse service was great. Jordan serviced the furnace within 24 hours of requesting service. He was on time, professional, pleasant, knowledgeable, and efficient. The service fee was explained clearly by staff when I made the appointment and I was billed as expected. I strongly recommend LJ Kruse.

reviews.author: Stephen Aday
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Michael K from LJ Kruse.   He took care of a difficult drain clearance and fixed an airlock issue with my radiant heat.  Courteous, listened to my ideas, worked fast and clean.   I would request to have him back in the future.  5 Stars

reviews.author: Gerald Wayfer

reviews.author: Noelle Mietus

It was just above and beyond service (even on the phone setting up the appointment was beyond professional and thoughtful) So albeit premature for a review on products or work, it was just a great experience so far and we’re really grateful!

reviews.author: Mark Morris
reviews.text: I am extremely pleased with the visit by the L.J. Kruse technician, Matt Hopkins, who solved the problem with our in-floor radiant heating system, and patiently explained in detail what caused the system to shut down. reviews.author: Hemen Dattani
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ **Exceptional Service by Jay – Above ALL Plumbing & Design**

Jay from **Above ALL Plumbing & Design** delivered an absolutely outstanding experience during our recent water heater replacement through Choice Home Warranty. From the very first call, he handled everything with professionalism, efficiency, and genuine care.

He quickly coordinated all details with Choice Home Warranty, arranged for the replacement A.O. Smith unit, and kept us informed every step of the way. Jay explained the entire process clearly, answered every question patiently, and ensured we understood the new system’s features and safety details.

When the new heater arrived, Jay went above and beyond — working late hours to finish the installation the same day so we wouldn’t be without hot water. The workmanship was first-class: clean copper lines, a properly mounted expansion tank, secure venting, and an overall tidy, code-compliant setup.

Jay truly exemplifies the best in craftsmanship and customer service. His professionalism, communication, and pride in his work make **Above ALL Plumbing & Design** a company I would recommend without hesitation. Outstanding job, Jay — thank you for your dedication and for turning a stressful situation into a smooth, positive experience! Note: the price below is for out of pocket code upgrades. The rest was covered by the Home warranty
```

I actually signed up for the subscription because the service was so good.

He set an appointment time with no four hour window!  Yea! Fast, efficient, best prices in town. Call Rocket Plumbing, Heating, and Air and ask for Kyle!

reviews.author: Marie Sutton

I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a hardworking, trusting plumbing team.  They have helped me many times in the past.  I am more than happy with their services.

Fair pricing, excellent customer service. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Diane Dorman

They gave me a much needed referral for other work I need done. They will be my go to plumber for any future needs.

reviews.author: Maria Schindler
reviews.text: Mathew and Anson were great. They notified me that they would arrive within the hour. They were spot on. Humored me when I asked them to show me the process of draining my water heater. Professional and kind. Very reasonable price for the service.

reviews.author: Hawkin Saeger
reviews.text:
Had an unfortunate sewer backup a different plumber had helped me fix. That plumber cameraed the lines and told me I needed to tear out my pipes which would have cost over $8K.

I called Neighborly Plumbing for a second opinion. They took a look at the pipes, and hopped down in the manhole to take a closer look. There was a ton of gunk in my pipe and in the manhole causing me issues and they instead recommended I jetted the pipe and get the manhole area clear. I felt a lot more sure about this recommendation and that they had my best interest in mind. Their quote for jetting my pipe was also significantly cheaper than the other plumbing company.

I feel a lot more at ease now that my sewer pipes are clean, and I feel like the work was done for a very fair price. I can't thank Neighborly Plumbing enough for their assessment and work. The only thing that could have been better was faster scheduling. Other than that, they were awesome.

reviews.author: Michael Rogers
reviews.text: My mom’s sewer line backed up and had to be repaired and lined. Neighborly plumbing came out and took care of everything including some unrelated interior plumbing issues that needed to be addressed as well. They were honest, did great work and were amazing to deal with through the entire process. I would highly recommend them!

They aren't going to replace it until 24 plumbing pays them so my lawn is being held hostage because of that . The city is now involved and if that doesn't work then I'll have to get a lawyer. I paid 24 hour plumbing 15.000 to fix the problem  now it's their responsibility to make things right. Sorry that neighborly didn't get paid  but someone needs to hold people accountable for their word. Come on your not even going to try make this situation better there is no delay . From what I see it's not going to be resolved at any time soon. It took you this long to respond. It's now almost February. Wow , I guess there is no reason to continue this conversation. I know what they said before they left my yard. They lied to me. My word against theirs. You win .

reviews.author: Nina Scott
reviews.text:
I ‘m very impressed with Roto Rooter!

Their customer service, and plumber who provided the service are top notch!

Within 15 minutes I received a call from Katria. She confirmed an appointment and explained the assigned plumber would call me , and set up a time to come.

Jerry called, I described the issue, we were able to narrow down the problem (most likely).

He came out within a reasonable timeframe, told me the price after he checked it out externally , and I agreed.

After removing the toilet, he looked and found the issue as he had suspected:

The past contractor who upgraded our bathroom and installed the toilet had put in the wrong kind of seal.

The first photo is two small seals, that don’t seal to fill the gap.

Instead, as shown in photo 2, Jerry put in a 2” wax seal that would fix the problem of air gap, which also  caused a slightly unpleasant smell at times (no leakage of excrement thank goodness! 😅)

Jerry zoned right in on the problem with lazer focus, and did not do anything that was unnecessary.

Some people might say it’s pricey, but I would rather have peace of mind knowing that the plumber knows what they are doing and is fair in the dealings with unexpected add ons.

I also have had the unpleasant experience of witnessing all the problems caused by a  plumber that did not know what they were doing at my parent’s property. Believe me, years of leakage can cause HUGE problems and big $$$$!

I really appreciate the professionalism of these two employees, Katria and Jerry R. as well as  Roto Rooter as a company! Bravo! 👏

reviews.text: After a surprisingly large toilet leak, we gave Roto-Rooter a call and they sent Joe over right away. Joe was awesome. He was professional, thorough, and extremely helpful. reviews.author: David Klingelheber
reviews.text: Plumber sent was friendly, polite, and helpful with addressing our issue.   He was knowledgeable and provided a proper solution.   However, work quote was way overpriced but due to the nature of our issue, I didn’t have the flexibility to allow the issue not to be addressed.  However, while the plumber was a great person, his actual fixes do not represent the price we paid.   Issue 1, I was told not to ever take apart the P trap under a kitchen sink.   He struggled putting it back together with it not leaking.  There was nothing complex with the P trap as I had previously taken it apart and reassembled without any difficulty.   Issue 2, he had to replace a long section of PVC in an unfinished basement.  Rather than dry fitting then final assembly, he glued one end then worked towards the other end.  Since it was already glued at the one end he had to cut a section that was over his head between floor joists.   It was far from a square cut.   Issue 3, he left a pile of pipe waste on our basement floor.   Think this was honest mistake because by this point I think he was behind schedule and was in a hurry to get to the next appointment.  Based on the price alone, I will no longer be doing any further business with Roto Rooter.   Talked to several knowledgeable people, all felt the price seemed excessive.

reviews.text: I'm a client of Mauerhan Plumbing and have used them for the past 38 years. They do such good work that I can't imagine using any other plumbing company. Today 2/26/26 Devin Culver came over to do a whole house rooting job. He's amazing at what he does, is extremely pleasant and answered all my questions without laughing at any of my silly questions. He's a champ! I highly recommend Mauerhan Plumbing and if you're lucky enough to have Devin Culver as your tech, well life will be grand!

reviews.author: R A
reviews.text:
I contacted Mauerhan for a second opinion on my 9-year-old tankless water heater after it displayed an ignition failure error code and stopped producing hot water. Another plumber had already identified the issue as a leaking heat exchanger and showed me visible water leaking inside the unit.

When I called Mauerhan, I clearly explained on the phone that the unit had an error code and was leaking. When their technician arrived, I was not home, but I spoke to him by phone and told him I already knew the problem and that the leak was obvious. He did not attempt any repair and left, stating that the unit was too old, parts were unavailable, and the entire unit would need to be replaced. He said I would receive a quote for a new unit.

I never received a quote or any follow-up. I was left without hot water and had to find my own solution. I contacted a water heater supplier, got a list of installers, and had a brand-new unit installed the very next day by another company.

A week later, I received a bill from Mauerhan for $540 for “cleaning the unit.” This makes absolutely no sense—why clean a unit that is leaking, cannot be fixed, and was never repaired?

When I called to dispute the charge, the manager, James, told me it was my fault for calling them even though another plumber had already identified the leak, and then threatened to put a lien on my house if I didn’t pay.

This experience was extremely unprofessional: no repair, no quote, no follow-up, an unjustified bill, and a threat instead of customer service. I would strongly advise others to be cautious before using Mauerhan.

reviews.text: Richard was outstanding and did great work. Friendly, professional, easy to talk to, and went above and beyond to make sure all my plumbing issues were resolved the same day. Thank you so much! Definitely will recommend & utilize Mauerhan Plumbing again!!!

reviews.author: Terrie Munsey
reviews.text: Lieber Mechanical is now my GO TO COMPANY for HVAC and Plumbing. I was absolutely impressed by Lieber Mechanical's employees. They were honest, hard working and never gave up. Scott worked very hard to get my tankless water heater going. He had to replace the primary heat exchanger and several other parts. He had to order the heat exchanger from Navien which took a couple of days. The first day it took 3 hours, but they only charged a 1 time service fee of $99. I upgraded to a 1 year service contract. The service contract included the service fee, 15% off of services + flushing my tank again in the next 6 to 12 months. It paid for it self on this one repair and I still get a no cost tank flush. Scott returned 2 days later as soon as the recieved the primary heat exchanger. He removed & replaced it, but said he still needed an igniter. Unfortunately, it stopped working again before he could make it back out. I didn't have hot water for several days because of Thanksgiving holidays. No problem though I have a shower in my barn. So, I didn't call them to request an emergency visit. Scott returned for the 3rd time monday morning with the igniiter. It only took a few minutes, but it still would not ignite. After, Scott spent a long time diagnosing why it still would not ignite. He found a tube was blocked by a cap he accidently left in. He was very honest told me what happened. Immediately called his supervisor and told them what happend. He was so apologetic and asked what he could do the make things right. I told him I was just happy he fixed it. He was ready to go above and beyond to make up for a minor mistake. Unlike others who would have tried to cover up their mistake and probably added mored charges to my bill. There were no additional charges. His honesty was was surprising, but wonderful in a world where prices are high and honestly is not very forth coming. I also want to give a shout out to his assistants Brock and Stephen 2 super nice guys. And I want to thank Hillary who took my calls and quickly dispatched Scott the same day I called both times. Everyone I spoke with was super friendly and helpful. I highly recommend Lieber Mechanical.

reviews.author: Katie Jenks
reviews.text:
I had a small drip leak on a fitting connecting two pipes for my hot water supply together. I have galvanized pipes and know that those pipes may cause water pressure issues due to sediment. I asked the plumber if there would be any issues with the galvanized pipe or from the galvanized pipes due to this repair, and if I should consider completely replacing the pipes altogether. They assured me there was no need to do that and that this was an isolated drip leak that I should fix, there would be no impact to the broader system.

Once the repair was done and after they got the water back on, my water pressure was so low that there was only a drip out of the kitchen sink. I asked the plumber what to do and he said “your pipes are galvanized so you’ll have to replace them if you want better water pressure. I told you before I did the repair that this could happen” (which was not true, he said nothing before the repair) and then left us SOL with low water pressure. I found out the next day when I tried to use my dishwasher that it wouldn’t even start anymore because the water pressure was too low.

I called Apex to express my frustration about this since I had explicitly asked ahead of time if we should be considering replacing the galvanized pipes. They sent the same plumber back out to look at what’s going on. He was incredibly defensive and offered no solutions. When I called the office again, they said the owner’s son would call me to further discuss what can be done but I never got a call back.

Ironically, in the end, I (using ChatGPT with no prior DIY experience) was able to repair the low water pressure on my own by changing the T joint at the water supply line in my kitchen and flushing the lines to my sink and dishwasher, but Apex didn’t even suggest that. I would have even considered paying them to fix that but they jumped right to saying there was no solution other than replacing all the pipes and that we were SOL.

For a licensed plumber, I expect more. ChatGPT did a better job solving my water pressure issues than this plumber!!

reviews.author: Ben Isaacs
reviews.text:
We were in the process of having a bathroom remodeled, and just our luck, our water heater goes out. I was recommended to contact Helton Plumbing by our contractors. I spoke with the owner, Jeremy, who was very helpful in my time of panic. Jeremy was able to give me the information about upgrading to different types of water heaters: tankless, tanked and power vent. What I appreciated was the upfront tasks required to install each one, as well as the pros and cons of each unit. We ended up going with the Navian tankless water heater. I've included pictures of the before and after.

Carey was my technician for the project. I cannot say enough about how magnificent Carey was. Answered all my questions, explained the process, gave me insight on the new product (including gas use, electrical use, rebate possibilities, etc). Additionally, Carey completed this entire task by himself, wasting no time to get the project going - it was an all day task. Carey even recommended a type of recirculation valve in the primary bathroom that will help to heat the primary bathroom faster (it is the furthest away from the water heater, so historically the shower took 60+ seconds to get hot). The recirculation valve and new water heater have the primary bathroom hot in under 10 seconds. It is sorcery.

I am very pleased with the service. Words can't explain how much we are enjoying the new water heater and the constant hot water. Also, the floor space that it opened up is monumental too. I will say that to go from a tank to tankless, it is an investment. It is expensive to make the change. It is definitely worth it - high efficient appliance, lower gas bill and constant hot water. We have young children and always worried about those 'hot pockets' of water in a tank water heater burning one of our kids. The tankless is so consistent I wish our Chicago Bears would take note. Overall, couldn't be happier with how it turned out. If you are on the market for a new water heater, consider Helton Plumbing. They fixed my issue entirely in one day!
