reviews.text:
I was promised to call back from a plumber today about services that were on the bid that I accepted  to be performed at my house that were not completed. I also believe I was charged for the services.

No one has been in contact with me additionally, when the plumber came he left the lock box with the key to my home completely open for anyone to come up and take the key. So far, I am very displeased with my service and how I have been treated.

Update: The owners of this business went above and beyond to make sure that I was taken care of. I genuinely think the above was just a one off and you can trust this company with your business.

reviews.author: Chloe Chen
reviews.text: Huge shout-out to Gary and the team at Austin's Greatest Plumbing! They replaced our water heater, upgraded our system, and fixed a leak. Their communication was top-notch--they proactively called me with part updates and scheduled the repair immediately once they arrived. Professional, knowledgeable, and reliable. Our water system is working better than ever! (Now we can take hour long shower without worrying about running out of hot water 😃🚿)

reviews.author: D H
reviews.text:
We had a pretty complex multi-unit plumbing issue that involved several homeowners and a lot of coordination, and Austin’s Greatest Plumbing handled it perfectly. Star, the technician onsite, was outstanding - professional, thorough, and took the time to explain everything clearly not just to us, but to the other owners as well. He was knowledgeable, friendly, and really took pride in doing the job right.

Also want to mention Rachel, one of the co-owners, who took my initial call and was so easy to work with. She was flexible with scheduling and really helped us navigate the logistics of having multiple parties involved.

This is not your typical PE-owned plumbing shop - it’s a local, owner-run business that actually cares about doing things the right way. Great service, great people, and an all-around smooth experience. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ashley Council
reviews.text: We had a leaking toilet and Austin’s Greatest Plumbing had someone in the area finishing up a job so Gary was able to swing by within the hour to troubleshoot. He diagnosed the issue right away, explained everything in simple terms, and had the leak fixed in no time. Fortunately for us, it was a relatively easy repair, but we felt informed if it was something else and what our options were. He was professional, friendly, and clearly very skilled. He The whole experience was smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend Austin's Greatest Plumbing.

reviews.author: Pam Campbell
reviews.text: Sean did a fabulous job! We have had many plumbers come and go through our office over the years, these guys are the best so far. Scheduling was easy and the work was done quickly. Very pleased overall.

plumbers.name: Spartan Plumbing and Drains
plumbers.address: 1905 Woods Dr, Beavercreek, OH 45432, USA

reviews.author: Robin Adams
reviews.text: Absolutely awful company to work with. I hired them to come out and find a leak. They gave me an estimate of $18,000 (which I'm now finding is probably twice what I should have paid). They said it was a leaking pipe under my concrete. They jackhammered up my concrete without hanging any plastic up and so my entire house was covered in concrete dust. When they left, they left my front door not only unlocked but wide open (since I had left on their recommendation because of the noise and dust). They also began replacing fixtures and lines in the two toilets and the sinks. They did terrible jobs and had to keep coming back and redoing them. They took out fairly upgraded fixtures and brought in builder basic. In a week there were 16 technicians in my home. 16! And by the time they were finished I had a leaking outdoor spigot, no water to my dishwasher, and a leaking front bathroom toilet. Every time I try to get them out here they want to charge me more money to fix these things. I tried getting a lawyer involved and they refused to answer her calls for 3 weeks so she gave up and didn't bill me (bless her heart). Whatever you do, do not work with these people. They will overcharge you. They will send out incompetent technicians. And then they will refuse fix the work that they left a mess unless you pay them more money.

reviews.author: Dustin Olson
reviews.text:
Update: Initially rather than email, I called on Thursday, November 6 at 4:01 PM to speak to a manager for final resolution. I was told everyone was in a meeting.
I received a call back at 4:41 PM from Josh Ferguson. He was apologetic for the delay of contacting me and admitted he knew some of the situation, but not at all. I requested a refund but he said his financial person was gone for the day and he would check back with me.
Today is Tuesday, November 11 at 4:58 PM. It has now been 3 full business days and I have heard nothing.

I will give you short version(and yes, this is the short version)
TLDR: They try to upsell you, management/leadership are horrible, and customer service is beyond terrible. (Has not always been this way, so is 100% a leadership issue, not the employees).

-I have used this company several times, including the water heater I currently have.
-Techs are great. Very professional and very relatable and honest
-Leadership/Management is unprofessional and not customer service centered
-Even the operations manager (Brayden?) did not follow through with what he said he would do. Told me he was going to look into my warranty personally and then never contacted me back. I only received a random request for an appointment. When I followed up, he said he “wanted to talk to me” yet never actually made an effort to contact me
-Manager Nick tried to sell me a $20,000 water filter/softener system instead of addressing my warranty and tried to claim that was the only way my warranty for my water heater would be valid (I’ve had several techs out and I won’t say which ones, but they’ve mentioned what a terrible manager and person he is)
-Contacted the operations manager with concerns about the water heater repair to the point I had to call the fire department. Rather than send someone out he recommended I contact a chimney repair company.
-a month later it turns out it’s been leaking gas the whole time and only figures out after I bought a detector and inspected.
-several times I was told I’d get a call back and never did and I had to continue to follow up.
-yesterday I called around 9:00 am was told I would get a call back to try and get scheduled today. By 4:00 I hadn’t gotten a call so I(once again) had to call them. I was told everyone was in a meeting. Heard NOTHING back until this morning.
I would never use them again based on their lack of customer service, unprofessional leadership, and outright lack of concern of safety for their customers and only focusing on upsellling.

reviews.author: William Houchins
reviews.text:
We had a main plumbing line blockage at our property caused by tree roots that had damaged the piping. Spartan Plumbing answered my call late Sunday evening and sent a crew (Nick and Jared) out early Monday morning to take a look. From the start, both Jared and Nick were transparent and thorough in diagnosing the problem. They provided multiple quotes and clear options for moving forward with repairs, making a stressful situation much easier to navigate.

The excavation crew (Craig and others) worked quickly and kept us updated each day on their progress. From start to finish, the project took just a few days — Monday through midday Thursday — and now our plumbing is working perfectly again. We’re very grateful for the Spartan team’s professionalism and hard work, and we highly recommend them to anyone dealing with plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Zingo
reviews.text:
Something has changed with Spartan Plumbing in the last couple years. In 2022, we contracted them for a hydro-jet of our main line which was approximately $900. With this, we received prompt service, excellent communication, timeliness, and an overall feeling of good business. Around this time, we also had them install a new water condition and copper piping, which also went well.

In 2025... we had an issue with our sewer line and contacted Spartan. We had an appointment scheduled between 8 and 10 AM. That time came and went, no call, no text, no nothing.  I called, and received some reason about "things popping up" as to why no one showed. I was also told that they may not get to it that day. I explained that this was unacceptable as we had an appointment. They sent out some very young looking guys around noon, who I later found out were not equipped for drain maintenance so they "assessed" the situation, without actually running any water or doing any tests whatsoever and called back to Spartan HQ.

Around 4 PM, they say a team can make it out to our house. They send a team out who looks at our pipe and comes back with a few options. We received a quote for $3000 to perform a hydro-jet service. They agreed to "knock it down" to $2300.  They also offered a drain snake service for $450.  These prices are about three times higher than the local average. Needless to say, Spartan did not get our business nor will they in the future.

Spend your money elsewhere... it seems as though something has changed over in the Spartan back office.

reviews.author: Sir Yes
reviews.text: They charged me 900 dollars to do a simple gas line pressure test.  Were told no insurance.  I still have no gas and this was two months ago cause they took all my money.  Became rude and started huffing and puffing about there time when told I'd like to have another place take a look.  I got a quote just for fun for the twenty foot of gas pipe and water heater they quoted $8000 for both or $5300 for just the pipe.  Guess they want me to buy them nice sprinter vans for them myself it seems.  Just not good people keep scrolling find a company that cares more when somebody was murdered and burnt up next door causing your damage.  This one only cares about buying nice sprinter vans it seems.  It took me two months to write this cause I figured my anger would pass.  Nope I'm more angry as the cold is coming and that 900 would have done the job if I used better people.  Call somebody else. Spartan thinks they're in the movie 300 as they kick customers into the pit.

plumbers.name: The All Pipes INC.
plumbers.address: 255 Holly Ln, Elk Grove Village, IL 60007, USA

reviews.author: Ryan Rudolf
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend the all pipes inc enough. Major work was done on our house replacing a large portion of cask iron vent stack. The crew sent out was extremely friendly, hardworking, and thorough going above and beyond with their service. They stayed true to their quote and ensured the issue was fixed before leaving. Paying was quick and easy.

If you want a trustworthy plumber who will do things right the first time and go above and beyond what they say, these are the guys for you.

reviews.author: Stela Vasileva
reviews.text: All Pipes did a great job replacing my main shutoff valve and my shower. They did quality work for very reasonable price. I am very impressed with the owner Grigor who provided me with a quick quote and communicated with me timely and professionally through the entire process. I will definitely use them for any future projects.

reviews.author: Barbara Forest-Beriso
reviews.text: Coming into Christmas, our pipes were backing up in our ONLY bathroom. We have a sewer/septic system and tho the septic tank was filling up with a lot of ground water, that wasn't the problem. We tried rodding it ourselves, but we only had a 75 foot rodder and needed atleast 100 feet to reach from the bathroom to the tank. The Saturday after Christmas, we called All Pipes due to all the great recommendations we saw in our local towns Facebook page.  I spoke to Greg, who was super nice! He was able to get us taken care of on Monday morning. On Monday, we met Rey and Jessie. I believe it was Jessie who called on Monday to tell me he was on his way and gave me an ETA. From the moment they came into the house, we found them to be very professional and personable. they respected our home by wearing foot coverings on their boots, and they talked to us all the way thru the process. It turns out we had not one, but two different clogs - they even looked at our plumbing pipes through a camera.  They worked quickly, but they didn't rush.  Two days later we had another company come in and pump out our septic tank and he confirmed the clog.  When my husband told him what equipment All Pipes used, he says that was absolutely the right equipment for the job based off of the size of the clog that he saw when emptying the tank.  I can't say enough good things about Jessie and Rey!  We definitely recommend ALL PIPES and we'll be coming back for our plumbing needs.  Thanks Greg, Rey and Jessie!!!

reviews.author: Peggy Grubbs
reviews.text: Greg came the same day I called to replace my 2 sump pumps and backup pump and batteries that had stopped working. They did an incredible job! Very professional , quick, clean, and the price was the best I found!  Highly recommend The All Pipes Inc!!

reviews.author: Meg Collins
reviews.text: Great service and price. I had a couple of other plumbers come quote me for replacing a sump pump, and they all wanted to charge me extra for replacing the back up pump and the back up battery, too. Those items were working just fine. All Pipes came to my house and just installed what I needed; a nice good quality Zoeler pump at a reasonable price.  I was very happy with them and would recommend them!

plumbers.name: Alexander Plumbing
plumbers.address: 221 E Chicago St #9, Elgin, IL 60120, USA

reviews.author: Isidro Perez (Sid Perez)
reviews.text: Had them come out and repair a water washer inlet hose that had rusted together. They came out the same day I called, and repaired the issue in less than and hour. They were cheap and affordable and I would highly recommend Alexanders Plumbing for any of you plumbing needs. I've used them several times thru out the years and they never disappoint. The are professional, courteous, and very affordable in their prices.

reviews.author: Alicia Smith
reviews.text: The speedy response and work was amazing. Neil did an amazing job of explaining the work he was doing as well as explaining prevention of future issues. He kept his work area clean. I’m so happy I called them. I believe I found a lifetime plumber for my forever home.

reviews.author: Greg Bowman
reviews.text: We had a sewer back up into our laundry room. I called Alexander Plumbing and they were at our home within the hour! They had the line rodded out and were all done in two hours. AND, they cleaned the floor in the laundry room. Looked like nothing ever happened, all resolved by 11am. I am super thrilled with their work, their character and the decent people they are! Absolutely will call them again - and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Scott Hanssler
reviews.text: Pat is the man, he really came through for me when moving into my new home and had an immediate issue with the hot water heater. Went out of his way to help me over the phone and with a part out of kindness. Not many people/places nowadays would take the time to do this. If I ever have a plumbing issue in the future I’ll only call here.

reviews.author: Marty McGovern
reviews.text: They did a great job; handled all phases of the repair. Explained everything in detail and were prompt  and thorough. We would highly recommend them !

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 1111 Western St ste c, Fairfield, CA 94533, USA

reviews.author: Becca Large
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter Fairfield was extremely helpful, polite, courteous, clean, professional, and hard working. Chris and Marty are the best and did everything they could to fix the issue and keep the price down for us. Thank you very much for everything! They careful explained the problem to us and made sure we understand each step of the way. We have been customers for years and will continue to use this company for any future needs!

reviews.author: Carley Judson
reviews.text: We had some work done at our business, and the entire experience was outstanding. Shout out to Doug for his professionalism, communication, and deep knowledge—he walked us through every step and made the whole process stress-free. The team worked efficiently, kept the workspace clean, and did their absolute best to keep everything affordable without sacrificing quality. We truly appreciate the honesty and care. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: alberto delacruz
reviews.text: About 11pm my kid comes in and wakes me up to tell me bathroom is not flushing and water is in tub.. now! I tried small tricks I know to fix clogged pipes after an hour of that not working. Called Roto Rooter and about 30 minutes later tech Zach calls says he’s finishing a job and can be there in an hour. He gets to my house in about 30-45 min after conversation. Less than 30 minutes after arrival house is flushing like it should. Thank you Zach. Price was expensive but late night emergency callouts are to be expected at this price. Which when I asked around seemed reasonable with after hour plumbing.

reviews.author: John
reviews.text: Doug went above and beyond what anyone could expect. When no other company would even show up he did and cleared our drain. Me and my family will be forever grateful for the service we got from Doug and roto rooter. Thank you.

reviews.author: nick hugi
reviews.text: Doug and Chris were awesome! Helped me locate my sewer clean out and fixed my clogged line in short order. Walked me through the whole process.Great service & quality work!

plumbers.name: American Leak Detection of Eastern Oklahoma
plumbers.address: 123 N Birch St, Jenks, OK 74037, USA

reviews.author: Debbie Riedel
reviews.text: I had a leak that was super bad and when I came back because I would have been gone, I had called them up and secured an appointment for the very next day and they were able to come and they come early really early and we’re able to complete the work and it was really bad cause it was like 4 feet down in the ground, but Toby was able to call Shawn and the both of them did it in a couple hours it was amazing

reviews.author: Tim Odell
reviews.text: American Leak Detection was called to figure out why our water meter was running when no water was turned on in the house.  After much investigative work and with the use of some very cool equipment, they found a leak in the foundation slab of our home.  They were on time, super professional, competent and friendly.  Lastly, the prices were very reasonable for such an expert service.

reviews.author: dave
reviews.text: Called upon ALD for a second opinion on a suspicious leak and it was the best decision ever. Colby is an absolute rock star, finding and fixing our problem NOT diagnosed correctly the first time. He  is the epitome of customer service and standard by which all others should be measured. ALD is a true asset to Tulsa/BA.

reviews.author: Phillip Harizal
reviews.text: We contacted them for a fairly significant leak in our pool. You are always concerned when you have to pay by the hour what the service will look like. Our tech was a man on a mission .from the moment he got there to the minute he left. He did a very thorough job giving us confidence we had the problem identified. I would recommend them if you want to be absolutely sure.

reviews.author: Shirley Edwards
reviews.text: We had excellent, friendly service from Ishmael and he was spot on finding a leak. Turned out to be an easy fix for us. 😃

plumbers.name: Bills Plumbing & Sewer Inc.
plumbers.address: 1855 Holste Rd, Northbrook, IL 60062, USA

reviews.author: Peter Kitzhoefer
reviews.text: John O. from Bill's came out very quickly when our furnace broke. His quote beat the other 7 contractors bidding on the same job. We received exactly what we needed, no salesmanship, just good advice and service. The furnace install and removal of the old unit was fast, professional, clean and the new unit is working great. Couldn't have gone better and we're very glad we chose Bill's.

reviews.author: George
reviews.text:
Called and spoke to Kelly about a clogged basement laundry sink after painter had cleaned their painting tools in our Laundry sink. They came recommended by an appliance repairman Tom who had used Ed Dickson Bros Plumbing (he sold their company to Bill's Plumbjng in summer of 2024). I was able to get a next day afternoon service and was quoted a fair $195 for first 45 minutes ($90 visit fee plus 45 Min at $105 which is $35 for each 15 minutes) which very reasonable compared to other quotes I got.

Kurt and Luis arrived promptly on time after getting a text that they were on the way -- I called the office and Kelly confirmed where they were coming from which was nice. They efficiently took care of removing our old metal pipe, then rodded the line which had a tricky bend, and then replaced with PVC and even included an access cover upon my request.

Kurt was an expert and very courteous as well as Luis! They even took off their shoes since it was a little wet outside which was not expected but appreciated. Bill is very fortunate to employ such kind and professional plumbers!!

reviews.author: Adam Levin
reviews.text: We had a plumbing emergency. Bills had a quick response time and sent someone out within 2 hours of calling. Service was great and the installer also gave me some maintenance advice, thank you to Kurt O. and the rest of the team!

reviews.author: Ab Cde
reviews.text:
Great work by Kurt O.  We had a copper pipe blow out in the wall between the hose spigot and the shutoff valve in the basement ceiling.  He did a great job replacing the section of pipe and changing out the valves so it won't happen again.  The repair required opening up a living room wall, but he did so in a very minimal way, so that it can easily be repaired and repainted.

Very pleased with Bill's Plumbing.

reviews.author: Eddis Goodale
reviews.text: Kurt, our plumber, replaced a toilet and a faucet in our guest bath.  Very professional, polite, and more than cleaned up during and after the work.  Just one visit so far, but we'll use them for our service work again.

plumbers.name: Plumber Near Me
plumbers.address: 101 Petra's Way, Kyle, TX 78640, USA

reviews.author: Jim Snow
reviews.text: In one day, PNM removed our water tank and installed an inline water heater and softener in our condo. The work was done professionally and no mess left behind. We'll definitely contact them in the future for any plumbing work.

reviews.author: Tracy Rowan
reviews.text: Randi scheduled me 1st thing in the morning, and said if something opened up she would call sooner, which I thought was great! Casey came out and was very nice and professional! Job was done properly and a reasonable time.

reviews.author: Cole Pacak
reviews.text: Casey and Randi were great to work with. I was genuinely surprised at how quickly Casey resolved the issue and really appreciated his patient explanation. I would definitely recommend them and call them again.

reviews.author: SteveS
reviews.text:
Plumber Near Me has been consistently professional, communicative, on time and thorough. I called last week to order a preventive maintenance visit for my water heater.
It was installed to City Of Austin Code by Plumber Near Me two years ago. Randi Dodd dispatched the plumber whose name is Casey. Randi followed up the arrival time and answered my questions. Casey checked out the water heater for function, verified there were no leaks, and drained some of the water to remove any sediment buildup. He treated me and my wife with respect and explained everything to us. While he was here, he quoted a second project on the spot and we gave him the go ahead. He replaced two valves on the fill lines ahead of our washing machine. The necessary parts were on his truck. He was efficient and quite skilled in getting this job done. He also checked the pressure on our incoming water line and gave us some good advice about caring for our system. Casey was respectful of property, We were extremely pleased with his work ethic and high level of technical skill.

reviews.author: Judy Williams
reviews.text: Been a customer for 7+ years and they have always exceeded my expectation in response time. Big shout out to Dewy who remained very calm and pleasant during my meltdown over the apocalyptic crisis I created in my mind over a water heater leak.

plumbers.name: Allied Plumbing Service
plumbers.address: 1211 S Harvard Ave, Tulsa, OK 74112, USA

reviews.author: John Land
reviews.text: Gavin and AL did a great job repairing a problem with my septic junction box. Real friendly and explain the repair process well.

reviews.author: Nicole Allen
reviews.text: Earnest & Noah were absolutely wonderful! Replaced our leaking water heater and handled all issues that came along with doing so. Highly recommend these guys! Also, shoutout to Seth at the office for being super kind and setting this up for us super quick!

reviews.author: Jodi Puryear
reviews.text: Alex and Noah did such an amazing job! They got there so fast. And they are so professional and friendly! I highly recommend Allied Plumbing. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Janet Gibbons
reviews.text: Issac was wonderful. You are lucky to have him. He explained everything and methodically solved my problem in minutes. This was on the Friday before the big snow storm. I was lucky to get squeezed in. You now have a loyal fan!

reviews.author: HB Snow Kingsbury
reviews.text: I called Allied Plumbing this morning after discovering our water heater was leaking. The cut off valve did not completely stop the water sound, so I assumed the leak was more involved than just the hot water heater. Earnest and Brian arrived at 0930 and quickly assessed the situation; the leak was confined to the hot water heater, but the cutoff valve was only partially working. They explained what needed replaced, gave me time to get some water in containers before they cut off the water, and let me know when they were cutting off the gas, too. Before the work was started, Earnest gave me an estimate right down to what was going to be replaced and what needed to be brought up to code.  Then, both he and Brian got the necessary materials and worked steadily, keeping me informed the whole way. I always use Allied Plumbing Service, and this is why!  Oh, and the person who answered the phone, Seth, was extra helpful and patient, too.

plumbers.name: Paradise Plumbing Pros
plumbers.address: 4100 Wayside Ln # 100, Carmichael, CA 95608, USA

reviews.author: Cherry C
reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience with Jon from Paradise Plumbing. He replaced the tank lever set for my toilets, repaired the sink lift rod, and fixed couple leak from my bathroom sink handle. Jon was not only highly professional, detail-oriented, and knowledgeable but also incredibly friendly, making the entire process a pleasure. He explained everything clearly and ensured excellent cleanup after the job. His customer service was top-notch, with great follow-up, and the pricing was very reasonable for the quality of work. I highly recommend Jon and Paradise Plumbing for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Melody M
reviews.text: We had a leak in the pipe below the main shut off valve to our home and reached out to Paradise Plumbing. Jon was so nice as well as professional. He completed the job quickly, stayed in communication throughout and left the site clean. Sounds odd but the pipes he installed are gorgeous! I highly recommend reaching out to him if you have any plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Ric Hinson
reviews.text:
First and foremost, the technician Jon was extremely helpful, answered questions, showed me anything I asked to see. This particular clog was due to a Vape Pen (large) getting past the toilet and into the sewer line. Jon took the time to literally work the pen out of the house plumbing and not just short cut the process by clearing it and leaving it in the house line where it could have been possible to have further problems later.  I will always complain about prices as I've been a property mgr for 20 years and EVERYTHING has become crazy expensive.
This is a good company.

reviews.author: Thomas Candlish
reviews.text: I received an inspection and estimate for sewer repair and/or service. It was done in a timely and efficient manner. I am still comparing the quoted cost with other providers and considering all repair options. Some of which are not offered by Paradise Plumbing.

reviews.author: Lindsay C
reviews.text: Professional and quick service! Jon made it out within a few hours of my call, quickly cleared the main line and showed me the roots growing up into the pipe. Highly recommended!

plumbers.name: JG Water Heaters, Filtration and Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7933 Silverton Ave Suite# 712, San Diego, CA 92126, USA

reviews.author: Hector Medina
reviews.text:
Christian,  their head technician, was accessible, courteous, informative and honest. He made me feel confident that he was the right person for the service and water heater product I needed.
He was able to complete the project one day later within about a three hour time period. He was efficient and cleaned up completely with a minimum of inconvenience of no hot water during his work to my family. I cannot recommend him more highly and more emphatically.

reviews.author: Casey Baker
reviews.text: Our toilet was clogged and flooded our living room. We were unable to unclog it ourselves and called to have it snaked. They came out within a couple hours and had it fixed quickly. They made a stressful situation much easier. It was very easy to call and set up the appointment. They're reliable and affordable - highly recommend.

reviews.author: Alfredo Carrillo
reviews.text: J.P was amazing. Extremely profesional and knowledgeable. His work was outstanding and I couldn’t be any more satisfied. Very great professional work

reviews.author: Russell King
reviews.text: I am incredibly impressed with the service we received. The installation was fast, the technician was knowledgeable and courteous, and the workmanship was top notch. They went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect. Truly exceeded expectations.—five stars

reviews.author: Anselmo Delino
reviews.text: Steve at JG Water Heaters helped me from beginning to end with replacing my water heater.  The professionalism, transparency, and honesty is what I appreciate most.  I don't need a company that tries to upsell me with products and more warranty.  The installation was on time, quick, and clean.

plumbers.name: Westside Plumbing
plumbers.address: 8851 West Fwy Suite 113-114, Fort Worth, TX 76116, USA

reviews.author: Paul O'Neal
reviews.text: Preston was awesome! Professional, courteous, timely and honest. We will definitely call on Westside Plumbing again. Affordable prices, quick quote and next day install.

reviews.author: John Bloomer
reviews.text: I noticed I had water leaking out of my pressure valve drain line Thursday night.  Westside was out Friday morning to address the problem, and had a new water heater installed that afternoon.  Appreciate the prompt and professional service, and will continue to use them for future needs.  Thank you, and prayers for your technicians' safety over the next week as we deal with sub-freezing temps....

reviews.author: John Holt
reviews.text: Called Westside Plumbing to come out and replace my hotwater heater and garbage disposal. The crew did an awesome job! Very dependable, fast and courteous. Would recommend this company for any plumbing issues.

reviews.author: Tamie Wheat
reviews.text: Extremely nice and knowledgeable. Matt fixed my problems and made me his first call when I contacted them this morning. I will use Westside Plumbing for all my plumbing needs. Highly recommend Westside Plumbing.

reviews.author: John Berry
reviews.text: Matt did an outstanding job. He arrived promptly completed the job in a timely manner and was very personable. Highly recommend him for your plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Good Ol'Boys Plumbing
plumbers.address: 5975 Shiloh Rd suite 114 11, Alpharetta, GA 30005, USA

reviews.author: Puja McGriddle
reviews.text: Good People. Harry Homeowner (aka ME) doesn’t know what he’s doing but these guys sure do. Cut it to me straight. Probably could have pretended there is more wrong than there was but voluntarily told me things were stable and performing to expectation. Very much appreciated, exactly the type of help by gladly pay my money too. Don’t hope to have another plumbing problem, but will definitely reuse them if I do.

reviews.author: Casey Brock
reviews.text: Great experience with the Good Ol’Boys team! Chris was highly responsive, thorough, professional, and polite in helping us understand what options we had for a new water heater. David and Dylan assisted with the removal and install of the water heaters in a quick and clean fashion. We are very happy with the experience and price! Highly recommend for any plumbing services!

reviews.author: Mark Zoblotsky
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Good Ol' Boys Plumbing on our hot water heater install.  The owner Chris was very patient when answering all of our questions and helped provide good guidance on which model to choose. plumbers.name: Black Tie Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1121 Fountain Pkwy, Grand Prairie, TX 75050, USA

reviews.author: Nicole Delgado
reviews.text:
If you value clear communication and competence, avoid Black Tie Plumbing. Our experience was a catalog of errors, from deceptive pricing to a botched timeline.
After foundation work from their partner company resulted in four sewer leaks, we met with Ruben on December 22nd to verify the leaks and work needed. He explicitly confirmed twice that two quoted figures were for different levels of work. The next day, the quote arrived with the costs combined, effectively doubling the price by several thousand dollars. After we expressed our concern, Ruben was apologetic and said he misspoke.
We were told work could not start until after the holidays.
What was scheduled as an 8-day job turned into a multi-week ordeal:
1/16: Work began after Xavier scheduled with short notice calling wed 1/13 at 4:25 to schedule for Friday. We had to make many arrangements with work to be available but made it happen.
1/21: After supposedly fixing the leaks, the post-plumbing test failed. They had only fixed 3 out of 4 leaks. They stated they didn't have the correct supplies to finish and it was already afternoon.
1/22: Plumbers arrived with the supplies and realized a "miscommunication" meant excavation was a foot short, delaying work further on fixing the 4th leak. The excavation would have to come out again
1/23-1/30 Weather delays due to freezing temps and us exhausting the arrangements we made with work resulted in days of no work
1/31: Excavation was set to arrive from 830 to 9am. Showed up about an hour after. I reached out to Jessica, who had been a point of contact for updates, but no reponse after I asked when the crew would arrive. The excavation crew took an entire day with zero updates from the office or onsite plumbers. No work on sundays.
2/2: Work was finally completed—nearly two weeks past the original end date. Also apparently the city verifies work by FaceTime? That's odd. We had a leak fixed by a different company and someone came out that was 3rd party to verify the work.
Despite the constant errors, no supervisor ever reached out. Though a supervisor was seen onsite they stayed in their vehicles and when they went in the car they never introduced themselves. The supervisor was also late more than once causing the crew to just wait outside.
To top it off, the company charged the remaining balance to our card without authorization or communication, preventing us from using our preferred payment method.
For a company claiming 25 years of experience, this was "amateur hour." They are disorganized, not transparent about pricing, and lack basic accountability.

reviews.author: Keekly Molina
reviews.text: I am not The only one look at there reviews idk who is driving that suv but he drives crazy he almost hit me in the back please do better. I took a pic so you guys can see not making this up

reviews.author: Kati Z

reviews.author: Tyler King
reviews.text: I’m sorry, I have to be the one to rate a company based upon the driving habits of their employees, but I believe this shows a lot about how they view the people they serve. They choose to cut off a driver in front of my lane of traffic causing my inventory to shift dramatically. Later, as traffic was thinning out, they appeared to be in no hurry at all, likely not responding to an emergency, but rather not wanting to wait and just put people in danger for no reason. Unsafe driving, especially in a company vehicle, for no apparent reason really reflects poorly upon a company. If this company stands by their drivers for situations between service calls, I can only imagine they responsibility they will take on actual service inside others houses. My rating is purely based upon an experience with this company without receiving any plumbing services from them.

plumbers.name: Brandon Plumbing
plumbers.address: 235 W Brandon Blvd #187, Brandon, FL 33511, USA

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.text:
Positives: Tim had a professional demeanor and the work completed looks to be good. Being out of state, Tim made me feel comfortable with work done on multiple picture text message.

Negatives: Company has high prices compared to competitors. Didn’t carry parts (had to make multiple trips to store). All calculations for fees was done on a calculator on a cellphone with a verbal amount given. Never provided receipts nor has a professional layout of fees or documentation to provide to customer for work completed or to be done. Still not 100% convinced my water heater was bad with the main problem being a leaking pipe.

I recently had a water leak in my garage, laundry room, and bathroom.  I am in the military and out of the state so I had to rely on my girlfriend to take care of the issues. She found Brandon Plumbing online and decided to go with the company. We called during the weekend on a Sunday. We had a guy name Tim come to our house which I believe was the owner. Tim was professional and arrived a couple of hours after her phone call. Tim diagnosed the problem down to our water heater (with water leaking from the bottom of the heater) . Since we live next to Lowes Tim had my girlfriend/brother pick up a water heater from the store and agreed just to charge for the install.  He Initially gave us a set price but once the water heater was installed and the work was down the job costed $200 more than the initial agreed upon installation price due to “fees and parts” he never listed.  Once turning the water on to our house, he noticed we still had water leaking in the same areas and diagnosed the new problem from a patch in our wall and then boiled the issue down to a bad pipe that was once worked on before by my previous homeowner. It was around 7-8 at night so Tim instructed us to keep the water off and he will be at our house at 9AM the next morning to fix it.
The next morning my brother stayed home from work and waited until 1:30 Pm being instructed, “ a different plumber was coming but had to run a few errands first”.  After the different plumber arrived (Stacy) he found the leaking pipe and instructed he had to run to the store to grab parts.  Once he replaced a section of the copper pipe with PVC pipe he turned the water back on to my house and noticed the work he had just done was leaking. Stacy instructed us he had to run to a different job and then back to the store then back to our house.  After being away for 1-2 hours he finally arrived with a gator bite Stainless steel tube and completed the job. After asking for the pricing Stacy stated Tim deals with the prices and will get back to us. The next day Tim arrived at my house and gave us a verbal price for the work of the damaged pipe. The initial price was extremely high he gave us for pipe patch work and asked him to explain where he got his total from. Tim explained various fees, taxes, hourly labor, and also a fee for an initial house call. I instructed him I would not pay the fee for the initial house call when this was a continuation of the work from yesterday.
After everything was said and done Tim verbally told us his work is warrantied and call him if any problems arise. Overall the company seems to do good work just has high prices compared to other local plumbers. If I was home and not out of town I would have shopped around for better pricing but I didn’t want to leave the stress of that on my girlfriend.

reviews.author: N S
reviews.text:
AMAZING SERVICE! Had a random emergency issue in my home today (renter) and after contacting the company, a team of 3 arrived in less than an hour.

It was a big job - but the three workers came, listened, assessed thoroughly, and got right to work.

In the process, two toilets had to be taken out, sewage/water that flooded into two of the showers had to be vacuumed out, lines/pipes had to be cleared out, and all effected areas needed to the be cleaned up afterwards (which was a lot to clean up).

They worked their butts off for hours until everything was done, no complaints or breaks (even though I could tell it was very tiring).

They worked together without issue, communicated throughout (with me and my landlord both/they worked out payment etc with him over the phone for me) and were all super friendly and down to earth as well, which made the whole experience way less stressful.

The company will also be sending another team member out in a couple days to inspect and mar a plan to fix any potential damage as a result of today’s issue if needed.

****TERRENCE, AMAD, and MATT were the 3 workers who did the job today****
Y’all rock!

Thanks again!!

P.S - I do have one small suggestion for management though.

For emergency issues that happen to fall on weekends and that might require someone to come out and inspect for damage AFTER a situation like mine (from water damage) -

Having whatever general documents your company requires the customer/owner to sign before someone can be sent out to do a post inspection - readily available somewhere for them to access and get signed as soon as possible without having to wait until a weekday/when office opens again would be really helpful and avoid any delays.

In my case it’s Saturday, so I’ll wait until Monday, but would have liked that to be done today. It’s not a huge deal, Monday is okay too! But just a suggestion!

Again thank you for the amazing service!!!

reviews.author: Robert Bynum
reviews.text:
On Christmas Day, I had a sewer backup at my house and I was feeling panicked since I had to be some place that day for celebrations. I called Roto-Rooter not knowing if I could have someone come out on such short notice on a holiday. To my pleasant surprise, their dispatcher said they could send someone out In about 40 minutes. In a timely manner, a very nice gentleman named Rick arrived and immediately went to work. Rich was working under some difficult conditions. First of all it was cold, windy, and raining. Second, it was difficult to access the sewer cleanout. It was buried under some dirt and a bush made access challenging. In spite of this, Rich had a pleasant demeanor and when I asked if I could help he said he didn't need it. After an hour of work and some difficulty getting the plumber's snake to go towards the street, he cleared the blockage and the problem was solved.
As a result of this experience, I highly recommend Roto-Router and I want to give my highest commendation to Rick for coming out on Christmas Day.

I also want to add a commendation for Jose Leon who was a second employee of Roto-Rooter. Jose was called to my home by Rick because Jose had a fiber optic cable with a camera that he used to inspect the condition of my sewer line. He discovered that there were roots growing in the sewer line that had caused the backup and Rick returned to my home to with an additional tool to cut out the protruding roots. These two worked smoothly as a team to do the additional work.

reviews.author: Yungjin Kim
reviews.text:
We recently completed two projects with Five Star, including the replacement of the water line between the main shutoff valve and the house. The cost and quality of their service for that work were excellent, and we had no complaints. Based on that experience, I would recommend Five Star for main waterline leak repairs.

During the water line replacement, I also asked Chris about repairing a leaking bathtub faucet. He said they could send another technician the next day to replace the diverter cartridge. The following morning, the technician arrived and, after a quick inspection, provided an estimate of $471 for the repair. He explained that the work required replacing the shower diverter cartridge, consistent with what Chris had mentioned. Although the estimate was higher than I expected, I approved it, assuming the repair might be complex and because the technician was ready to proceed.

After I shut off the main water for him, I took a short break to have a cup of coffee. Before I even finished it, he had completed the replacement and asked me to turn the water back on for a leak test. The technician was very professional, and the repair was completed within about 20 minutes with good results.

However, I felt that $471 was excessive for the level of labor and complexity involved. I later checked the price of the T809206 shower diverter cartridge and found it sells for about $57 at Home Depot, meaning roughly $410 was charged for about 30 minutes of labor. Because Five Star had previously provided fair pricing and excellent service for the main waterline repair, I did not obtain multiple estimates for the bathtub repair—I relied on my loyalty and trust in them. Afterward, I checked with other plumbers and learned that comparable repairs typically range from $250 to $350, including parts.

This experience was a lesson learned: relying on a single provider, even one with whom you have had good experiences, may not always result in fair pricing. It is always best to obtain multiple estimates before making a decision, regardless of prior loyalty.

reviews.author: James Conley
reviews.text: I don’t write post often but feel compelled to share my experience with Five Star Plumbing.     I had a water line leak originating from the outside and leaking into my basement. reviews.author: Ayla Tomlin
reviews.text:
CDS Plumbing is a nightmare. Be ready to manage your own project, check their progress, and call many times wondering why they are destroying your house. While they replaced our sewage line and it works, everything else was disastrous.

I have much more to share and extensive video evidence showing their complete disregard for our home, but Google Reviews won’t accept videos and has a maximum character count which I clearly met.

What they did right:
- Replaced the entire sewage line at a fair price.
- Plumbing has worked so far.

What went wrong:
- Workers left doors/windows open with the A/C running.
- Trash and debris were left everywhere; we had to clean it ourselves.
- Cracked bathroom tiles.
- Dirt and debris from floor work piled onto living room floors with no protection.
- Concrete splattered on baseboards and flooring, causing permanent damage.

The concrete work after plumbing was done by a different company. It was so uneven that floors and laundry room couldn’t be finished. CDS “fixed” it by bringing the same company back, who sanded everything with zero protection. Our entire home was coated in concrete dust on ALL surfaces—furniture, vents, cabinets, clothes, dishes, pantry items, you name it.

Cleanup was brutal. Six family members spent four full days moving out our home, cleaning everything off-site, laundering clothes and bedding, and washing dishes elsewhere. CDS only sent 4–5 cleaners who were reluctant and limited; the cleaning company confirmed CDS minimized staff and refused additional help.

After moving back in, concrete dust continued to come through our air vents and settle on our belongings. Given that I have two children, I requested professional air duct cleaning due to health concerns. The owner was again rude and reluctant.

We never asked for reimbursement for housing, utility costs, or the extra week displaced. Even so, CDS resisted. Dust continued to come through vents, forcing professional air duct cleaning for health reasons. The owner was rude, dismissive, and at one point said he would “not spend another penny,” showing zero concern for our safety or family.

Additional issues:
- A worker failed to reconnect a pipe, flooding our laundry room.
- Bathroom vanity measured incorrectly and is off-center.
- Laundry room vanity installed at an angle; sink leans forward and won’t drain.
- I repeatedly had to inspect the home and property to find unfinished work and leftover debris, requiring multiple return visits.
- Workers smoked marijuana in our backyard twice.

Final thoughts:
Plumbing works, but everything else was handled with zero professionalism. Damage to our home, unsafe conditions, poor workmanship, and dismissive ownership made this extremely stressful. Avoid CDS Plumbing if you value your home, health, or peace of mind.

reviews.author: Aaron
reviews.text:
$35,000 DISASTER FROM A SIMPLE CLOGGED TOILET!!!

We called "Emergency Plumbing" with a clogged toilet in August 2024. After their plumber visited us, we ended up with THREE ROOMS DESTROYED BY WATER AND SEWAGE, costing $35,000 IN REPAIRS that took SEVERAL MONTHS, and then later getting dropped by our brand new homeowners insurance due to the claim!

"Emergency Plumbing" happily took my several hundred dollars in payment for "clearing the clogged toilet". They have offered no recompense for causing our massive loss. But, to their credit, they did say "sorry" a couple times.

THE FULL, DISGUSTING, DANGEROUS, SAD STORY:

In August 2024 I called about a clogged toilet I couldn't plunge clear. They were able to schedule a plumber for early in the morning.

He tried an auger to clear the clog, to no avail. So, he asked to see the sewer cleanout. We went to the basement, where things were about to go DANGEROUSLY BAD.

He opened up the cleanout and A FIRE HOSE RIVER OF SEWAGE immediately began to spray out onto him and our finished basement. He panicked and asked for garbage cans / bags to catch the sewage river.

My wife brought down some large utility garbage bags. The plumber and I held up and filled about 3-4 large bags of sewage over our heads during the next several minutes before the flow finally stopped and he could cap off the cleanout. He reassured me by saying, "sometimes stuff like this happens". We were both drenched in sewage from head to toe. Some had splashed in my eyes and mouth.

He started to hand mop up the large sewage puddle with some paper towels. I told him "don't bother, this all will need a mitigation company". He replied, "all you really need is some soap and water". Ummm no.

We dried off, shedded clothes and went back upstairs. The toilet still wouldn't drain, so he said he'd drive back to get the larger auger. He asked if I had any toilets upstairs, and I replied yes. He said "OK, you can use your upstairs toilet and shower, just don't use the clogged one down here". He left and I started to shower.

After showering I came back down to the main floor to discover that SHOWER WATER WAS GUSHING OUT OF THE TOILET INTO OUR BATHROOM AND HALLWAY!!! More fun!

In the second panic of the day, I tried my best to dam up the NEW RIVER OF WATER now FLOODING my main level hardwood floors. I ran downstairs to see even more water now soaking many ceiling tiles and raining onto the sauna and floor.

I called the plumber and the head plumber agreed to come join the fun. He arrived, I explain the scene, and he said "Oh no, he should never have told you to use the fixtures upstairs". Oh no!

The first plumber later returned with the larger auger. They managed to clear the clog with it. They did some hand mopping up of the now destroyed first floor powder room, hallway, hall closet, and living room. They asked for a check for several hundred dollars, said sorry for the problems, took my check and left.

The next day we opted for a water & sewage mitigation company, rather than the plumber's recommendation of "soap and water". We then watched much of our house get ripped apart and endured days of loud fans a dehumidifiers.

The insurance claim process and reconstruction took place over the next couple months. We had to cancel our Thanksgiving party, as we were still wrapping up the rebuild by then.In the weeks after the plumbing adventure, I texted and called the plumber, hoping to get some recompense for this disaster, maybe cover my insurance deductible, maybe even my money back? We talked on the phone once and I made my case. He didn't offer anything at all. Haven't heard from them since.

0 STARS - CANNOT RECOMMEND FOR ANY PLUMBING WORK. Maybe the head plumber is good? But whatever junior plumber they sent to unclog my toilet basically destroyed much of my new house. They were arrived on time and were friendly to talk to, though, tiny bonus points for that. ONE QUARTER OF A STAR

reviews.text:
I have been a loyal customer of Al Marino for over 10 years. I have had some issues with them in the past but let them go without complaining. The guy came out and spent maybe 40 minutes here if that and said there was water in something that he drained and it cost me $84.53. He said it was fixed for now and no explanation to why it happened. Not even an hour after he left, it was out again. I called again costing me $267.50 because it was an emergency call they said. The same guy came out and said a line was frozen. By this time my husband was home and said show me.  The line was not frozen and shot liquid out. The guy said well you need a pump to which my husband said there is one connected to the system. Which seemed like a surprise to the guy. The guy didn't do anything and then left. I didn't even get a receipt for payment for this visit. So $352.03 down the drain for nothing from Al Marino and my system was still out. So my husband cleaned out a trap after the guy leaves and the system worked for several days.
It went out again on 12-20-25. I called Al Marino out again costing me another $267.50 and I told them to send a different guy than the one who came out before. The guy comes out to check the system and says it needs another pump. After he had checked things out and said another pump needed to be installed I asked him if it was safe for me to continue resetting the limit switch to try to get it to work. He acted like he knew something else was wrong with the system other than needing a pump. But he told me that it was fine for me to do that just be careful because of the electricity. I say fine install another pump and he comes back the next day to install a pump we had purchased. Costing me $1066.09. Not 10 minutes after he leaves the system is out again. I called again and the guy comes back looks for a second and says you need a new furnace.
By this point I have spent $1685.62 for nothing and call out another company. They knew right away what the problem was and recommended a new furnace. They also informed me that it was unsafe to use the furnace and not to use it by resetting the limit switch. So I recommend you save yourself time, money and a headache by calling another company.

Darren delivered and installed a brand new ada compliant  toilet for my 90 year old mother. He even fixed a couple other minor issues she had. He was very personable and didn't make us feel like we were a nuisance on christmas eve. Thank you Darren and Rod for saving our christmas!  If we ever need a plumber I'll definitely call you.

reviews.author: Sarah Coombs
reviews.text:
If you're comparing Google reviews to find the best plumber then look no further, stop searching, just call Rod's Plumbing!

After a backed line caused flooding in my home bathroom I searched Google for plumbers with the best reviews and called around for a price comparison.  I knew the moment I called Rod's that they were the right people. The owner answered my call and talked with me me like he'd known me for years. He took the time to really take an interest in my plumbing issue and to tell me about the history of his business so I could rest easy knowing I'd be hiring people who knew their stuff! Gave me honest upfront info about what to expect with the issue I was facing, and provided a quote that was very reasonable. Less than 2 hours later Darren knocked on our door and was so friendly and knowledgeable. Despite the plumbing issue being a bigger job than he anticipated he stuck to his price quote and worked hard for almost 2 solid hours getting it fixed. Our bathtub now drains faster than it ever has since we bought our house! I couldn't be happier with the service I received and I see why Rods has so many great reviews. Thank you so much Darren for all your hard work. I hope my review brings you guys more customers because you really are the best.

I'd recommend Rod's Plumbing, and Darren, to anyone and if you need a plumber then I recommend them to YOU!

reviews.author: jonathan isaak
reviews.text: In times of stress and emergency situations Rod’s Plumbing is the place to call and trust. I had a water pipe leak in the middle of the night causing water flowing into my garage. One of the employees (Seth) responded immediately without hesitation after driving back into town returning from another call for service. He diagnosed the problem and was able to stop the bleeding from the water pipe. There is nothing more reassuring then being able to call a professional after hours and have them respond in a quick manner. Seth provided amazing customer service and gave an in-depth explanation of what was happen in and needed to be done. Seth was able to schedule a follow up appointment for the early next morning. Raul came out immediately the following morning. I could not be more thankful for Rod’s Plumbing and will be using their services down the line. Definitely recommend and can count on them. Seth’s expertise was reassuring and deserves a raise or promotion!

reviews.author: abrandnewleafwellness
reviews.text:
Rob’s Plumbing was excellent, timely, efficient, and truly reliable. I called first thing Monday morning and within a couple of hours they were at my place of business, quickly troubleshot the issue, and had it resolved within the hour.

They’ve become my go-to plumber, and I highly recommend them if you want efficient service and people who actually show up and get it done.

plumbers.address: 3100 B Leeman Ferry Rd SW, Huntsville, AL 35801, USA

reviews.author: Kris R
reviews.text: Called Sunday morning for a busted hot water heater. Evan was quick to respond to the dispatch call and showed right up. He assessed the problem, described what was wrong, explained the situation and solution. Then he wasted no time getting started. The whole situation took a lot less time than I expected. He was very polite and personable. His work was great. I have used Dean Plumbing in the past and they will always be my first choice. Happy I do not have to spend the weekend without hot water.

reviews.author: Steven Nelson
reviews.text: I appreciate the quick response of Dean Plumbing. Braxton did a great job. He communicated what he was going to do and kept me updated on his progress and on costs. All the work was completed in the 2 and a half days they quoted and it's so wonderful to have actual water flow again!  I couldn't ask for a more professional, responsive, and friendly experience.

reviews.author: Amy Harvey
reviews.text: This was my first time using Dean Plumbing. I called them and Evan showed up to my house within 30 minutes. He was professional and completed the job in a timely manner. I will definitely use them again for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Denise Patterson

Efficient work, fair price, came to repair the problem very quickly.  I am very thankful to have everything working safely again especially with a snow and ice storm of significant potential coming this weekend. reviews.author: Brian Dally
reviews.text: I had first called 2 other plumbers for a whole house stoppage to come diagnose the problem. The first was at night, charged me an emergency service call fee, arrived and took a quick look at it and then quoted me an extra large amount for the next step to  fully diagnose the issue. I decided to get a second opinion and called a another company who then came out the following morning, took my service call payment first, tried to diagnose the clog, then said they couldn’t tell what it was but would required a massive excavation in the front yard at an excessive amount of money to further diagnose. I couldn’t get a straight answer on some of my questions and just had a feeling something wasn’t right. After they left, and quite frustrated because I felt I was getting nowhere fast, I then called Direct Source Plumbing and spoke with Amie who was very helpful in taking my call, took detailed notes, and with a sense of urgency, relayed my message to the plumber. In a short time, I received a call from Tyler who gave me an good idea of what needed to be done to diagnose the issue. When he arrived he was extremely polite and knowledgeable about the situation, and took the time to explain to me what he was doing, so that I  fully understood each step, and ultimately ended up diagnosing and fixing the problem. He even called and had the master plumber, David, confirm and verify his diagnosis. This is how I wish all service calls could be! Tyler is the perfect example of how the ideal repairmen should be. I believe this company and religious-based group is in business for the right reasons, to truly help people when they need it. I can’t possibly recommend them enough! True professionals! Thank you again!

reviews.text: Donn, the owner,  is very proficient, knowledgeable, and always educates me on the repairs he does with my home. This time my water heater decided to go on the blink! reviews.author: Courtney Y
reviews.text: Donn was amazing. Professional and explained everything he was doing (I was confused, concerned and a bit nervous and nosy!). Very personable and did great work and clean up work.

reviews.author: Ernie Kelly
reviews.text:
Edit: After seeing the response below I requested photos of the work. I promptly received three pictures of my upstairs bathroom toilet. At this point I have to agree with the other 1-star review. I am thinking the receptionist, Juanita, completely ruined this job for everyone. She failed to cancel my appointment as requested. I don't see any evidence the plumber entered my basement where the described problem was most observable so I doubt the issue was taken down correctly. She recorded my email address completely incorrect so I received no correspondence for three weeks until I was called about non-payment to an invoice I never received. All-in-all I would just avoid this company. I had no idea any work was done or my house was entered for three weeks until I was called for non-payment of services.

This was the single worst home repair situation I have ever dealt with. In short:

1. I verbally cancelled the plumbing appointment at the end of my first phone call when I learned my house was further than they are accustomed to. I said I would call them back with more information at a later date.
2. I received no confirmation through email, phone, or text about the appointment but day of I was called and told their plumber was standing outside waiting.
3. I asked them to let me know about circling back later when the house was accessible. I received no information after this and learned today (three weeks later) a plumber entered my premises that day later on with no heads up.
4. The plumber "reseated my toilet" and the major basement leaks were assessed as fixed. I found later from a different company all cast iron pipes were rusted through and cracked. Water was leaking everywhere but pristine plumbing apparently did no checks anywhere. I am not a plumber but water was splashing everywhere when the toilet upstairs was flushed.
5. Weeks later I was asked why my invoice was not paid. They had recorded my email incorrectly while making the appointment. I had no idea my house was even entered without first informing me and assumed no work had been done.

I find it highly unlikely their plumber did anything to address the issue. The basement ceilings and open studs showed good amounts of moisture and water damage at a glance. Flushing the toilet upstairs sent a large amount of water all over the basement floor. Attached is a photo of my basement pipe completely rusted through. It had been leaking in the walls and ceiling continuously. The plumbers I called after I believed this appointment was cancelled found it immediately and showed me how a hand fit inside the pipe from the outside. To replace all cast iron rusted through pipes was a $10,000 job. I am baffled to pay $400 to pristine plumbing for potentially leaving my house leaking until the problem got even more out of control.

reviews.author: James Burrell
reviews.text: I've worked with Pristine Plumbing twice at my older Park Hill residence.  Donn had been recommended by my previous plumber and I couldn't be happier.  Since all 4 bathroom sinks were having issues, it took several hours to address everything.  Donn was pleasant and professional throughout, taking care of every item while ensuring that I was satisfied with the work at the end of the job. reviews.author: Allie
reviews.text:
This company installed our water softener and the system leaked resin beads into our entire home. They knew the damage this causes, never told us, and claimed it was ‘fixed.’ Over the next year we had failing appliances, pressure issues, leaks, and now potential mold. They refused to acknowledge any responsibility and even charged us full price for a premature water heater replacement caused by their mistake. This is unethical and dangerous service.

*** Thank you for the reply. I will not be calling. For documentation and transparency, I prefer all communication in writing.

To clarify the situation: we have time-stamped photos of the original installation because we were excited to show our family the “upgrade.” These photos clearly show that the water softener was installed incorrectly the first time. The two connection tubes were reversed. When resin beads began leaking into our plumbing, your team returned, swapped out the softener, and reconnected the lines the only other possible way… confirming that the original installation was backwards. We had to discover this ourselves after reviewing the photos.

At no point did anyone warn us of the long-term consequences of resin beads entering a home’s plumbing system. We were told the issue was “fixed,” yet over the next year we experienced repeated leaks, failing appliances, pressure issues, and now potential mold. I have time stamped documentation of all of the above. My boyfriend even had to take a full week of vacation from his night-shift job to deal with the water heater leak that developed almost a year later… damage that directly aligns with resin bead contamination your technician never disclosed.

Because of the MAJOR installation errors, the lack of warning, and the ongoing issues we’ve had to correct ourselves, I no longer feel I can trust your company to give accurate information or handle this responsibly. That is why I am insisting on written communication only.

At this point, I need clear written answers to the following:
1.	How resin beads entered our plumbing system
2.	Whether the original installation met manufacturer specifications
3.	Why we were not informed of risks, symptoms, or what to look for after bead discharge
4.	What corrective action your company is prepared to take

I will continue communication only by email so everything can be properly documented. I look forward to your written response.

reviews.author: Kristin Iyer
reviews.text:
Quoted $7,755. Final bill: $12,555 — a 60% increase.

We agreed to move forward with a sewer lining project based on a written quote for $7,755, which clearly described the scope, access points, and installation approach. After spending a half day attempting to place the liner, the company stated they could not proceed as quoted due to “too many twists and turns” in the pipe and required additional access.

They asked me to pay them $4,800 to install 3 new access points required to complete the job.  I'm not a sewer expert by any means but I have watched more plumbers than I can count on my fingers scope my sewer lines with extreme precision.  It was very hard for me to process their argument that this was "new scope" due to "unforeseen circumstances".

Pipe geometry and access constraints are fundamental to sewer lining, and nothing about the condition or placement of the pipe changed after the quote was issued. The contract did not include any change-order terms, yet we were presented with a significant price increase once the project was already underway.

I also suggested the company that we "split the difference" as this appeared to be their error in quoting the job rather than a true scope change, but they declined and also informed me that I should actually consider this a "good deal" since normally they would charge even more for the additional services they would be providing.  Oh - and they were also going to let me off the hook for paying for their wasted materials from their first day of work.  Very infuriating conversation....

While the work was ultimately completed, the pricing process felt misleading and left us with little practical choice but to approve a large, unplanned increase. I strongly recommend getting very explicit, written confirmation of all assumptions, access requirements, and pricing change policies before agreeing to proceed.

reviews.author: Lauren Long
reviews.text:
Terrible experience. The technician sent was unable to perform the job alone, yet I was billed for their inability to properly staff the service call. My private plumber confirmed their proposed solution to install another pressure valve at the other end was unnecessary, if they had been properly staffed with the appropriate amount of technicians for the job, the job could’ve been completed. I reached out after it was done on February 12, I got no response from the message. I left with Megan at the Cullman office and also no response from their website when I wrote to them as well. I received a bill on March 9 with no communication from them whatsoever, called again spoke with Megan again where she advised me she would get with a manager -  she did call me back this time and said there was nothing their manager can do because the technician had already spent the time. This customer service is unacceptable and I would not recommend this company.

After reviewing the contract with legal counsel, I am prepared to dispute the full leak detection charge based on the terms of the Standard Work Authorization and the circumstances of the service visit.

According to the agreement, the service being purchased was “Leak Detection” with an estimated charge of $424 for two hours of detection time. However, during the visit the technician informed me that he was unable to properly perform the detection process because the gas used to pressurize the line escaped before he could attempt to locate the leak. He further stated that a plumber would first need to install an additional pressure regulator at the opposite end of the line so the system could be filled and tested before the gas escaped. He also indicated that this situation effectively required additional assistance in order to properly conduct the test.

Because the line could not be adequately pressurized, the leak detection procedure described in the work authorization was never actually completed. The technician therefore did not perform the service outlined in the agreement, but instead determined that the system required additional preparation before leak detection could even occur.

The agreement also states that if service is cancelled at the time of arrival, a $150 service call fee will apply. Since the leak detection service itself was not able to be performed, my attorney has advised the appropriate charge would be limited to the service call rather than the full leak detection fee.

Shannon Long
205 NeSmith Road
