It’s rare to find a company that combines quality workmanship with such outstanding customer service. Frecka Plumbing has earned a customer for life. If you’re looking for a plumber you can trust, look no further. Ask for Matt, you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Paul Anderson
reviews.text:
Frecka Plumbing did a great job replacing our main shutoff valve at a reasonable price. Tim, our plumber, did wonderful work, coordinating everything with the water department and replacing the faulty valve. He also coached me in draining and flushing our water heater without any extra charge!
The job was done on time, the area was left clean, and the bill was less than estimated. Cannot recommend them more highly.

reviews.author: John MacWherter
reviews.text:
Tim was great!!  We had several jobs lined up for him--replace a  shower head, fix a leaky faucet, tighten a sink handle--and he did them all in an hour and a half and did them well.  We have been working with Frecka for more than 20 years and they have always been great to work with and reasonably priced.
A quality operation!

John MacWherter

reviews.author: Michele Messina
reviews.text: I love Frecka plumbing..we have used them multiple  times and they are amazing!  Tim the plumber also known as "Jim " per his business card  is absolutely  amazing!  His knowledge  is fantastic...he is friendly and so helpful!  I look forward to seeing him. I know thst he will find and fix the problems every time!  Thank you to Tim and Frecka for another  wonderful  experience!!!! You guys are amazing!!!!!  Same day service!  Absolutely amazing!!!!

reviews.author: Rachel Davis
reviews.text:
I will never let any other plumbing company work on my house! Tim swapped out a shower valve for me, very efficiently and cleaned up after. Five star service AND pricing. I was figuring it would be way, way more expensive and the possibility of extra holes for access.
Thank you guys for being so reliable and knowledgeable! Frecka is permanently on my speed dial when issues arise.

plumbers.name: NexAir Heating & AC Repair
plumbers.address: 971 WV-34 Suite 11, Hurricane, WV 25526, USA

reviews.author: Darlin Vasquez
reviews.text: Buffalo needed a furnace repair urgently, and NexAir responded immediately. They diagnosed the issue accurately, repaired it efficiently, and ensured the system was fully operational. The service was professional and reliable. We now have consistent, warm heating throughout our home.

reviews.author: Paxton Morales
reviews.text: Our furnace in Hurricane stopped working right before a cold evening, and NexAir Heating & AC Repair arrived promptly. They diagnosed the problem quickly, completed the repair efficiently, and tested everything carefully. The heating now works perfectly, and the team explained simple maintenance tips. Very professional and reliable service.

reviews.author: Blake Carrington
reviews.text: The team handled my heating problem quickly and professionally. They explained the repair in simple terms and made sure everything was working perfectly before leaving. I felt confident in their work and really appreciated the attention to detail. Highly recommend for anyone needing reliable heating service.

reviews.author: Cristino Pacquing
reviews.text: Teays Valley needed duct cleaning and furnace maintenance, and NexAir did an excellent job. They cleaned all vents, inspected components, and ensured peak heating efficiency. The service was punctual, professional, and friendly. Our home heating works perfectly now.

reviews.author: Ivory Brooks
reviews.text: In Winfield, our heat pump needed maintenance, and NexAir handled it expertly. They cleaned all components, checked efficiency, and ensured optimal heating performance. The process was smooth, professional, and stress-free. I feel confident our system will run perfectly all winter.

plumbers.name: Chaney Services
plumbers.address: 5353 Dixie Hwy A, Fairfield, OH 45014, USA

reviews.author: Jonathan Beer
reviews.text: This is the 3rd time we have had Chaney services assist in our home. Nate did a great job. Had to snake and unclog a sewer drain. Will use them again for sure.

reviews.author: Reed DeWinter
reviews.text:
Nate was a pleasure to work with. He was prompt, courteous, knowledgable, patient, informative, and conscientious. He took the time to listen to our rather complicated (and rambling) explanation of what we suspected the problem was, and then he got to work.

He fixed the drain issue (this is a complicated plumbing layout and he was outside, snaking an external downpipe) within about 5 minutes. He could have left then, seeing as how he solved the problem, but he continued to snake the drain deeper and more thoroughly, just to make sure there were no hidden issues within our pipes. He also checked on another downpipe, connected to the one he'd just fixed, to make sure there were no drainage issues there.

We've worked with Chaney plumbing on other projects/issues and they could not be more helpful, fair, and professional. I'd recommend them for anything.

reviews.author: Michele Whitehill
reviews.text: Nate came in, evaluated the situation, offered his solution and implemented. He was very professional and completed the job in a timely fashion. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: justin freeman
reviews.text:
We used Chaney Services for our sewer rebuild

Nate was on site everyday and had great communication. He explained things in a manner that I could understand. He also weighed the pros vs cons of some decisions I had to make. He was very honest and displayed great integrity.

I would out the customer service as above and beyond. And communication could not have been better. The price was very fair and reasonable. The value they bring along with the price I cannot see being beat by anyone.

Not even close.

I refer a lot of business and I cannot wait to refer Chaney Services to the next person I know needing any plumbing work.

reviews.author: Barrett Peterson
reviews.text:
I used Charlies services twice last year.  Once to install gas piping to my fireplace, and then to install a tankless water heater.
I quoted several plumbers for both jobs, and Charlie was competitive on both jobs.
But it was not only the price that made my decision to bring him back for the second job, but it was the way he treated me as a customer.  He was polite, thorough, and timely and cleaned up after the job was finished.  He kept in constant communication between quote and finishing the jobs and delivered what he said he was going to do.
I have had 0 issues with the work he performed, and would not hesitate to call him back.

plumbers.name: Coral Pelican Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7490 91st St N Unit B, Seminole, FL 33777, USA

reviews.author: Larry Henshaw
reviews.text: Having just recently purchased our home I didn't expect all the drains to clog up within a few months but they did. I called Coral Pelican Plumbing at 10:30pm on a Sunday Night and they were at my home before midnight. Davin and Jeremiah showed up and completely cleaned out the drains for 3 bathrooms, located the outside drain and replaced it completely, and reinstalled the three toilets. They were VERY knowledgeable, courteous, and hard workers. All my future plumbing business will go to Coral Pelican Plumbing for sure. Many thanks guys.

reviews.author: Chelsea Nicole
reviews.text: I honestly cannot say enough good things about Economy Rooter. I had a clogged sink and a clogged shower head, and as a single mom, that kind of stuff can be stressful to deal with. The owner, Davin, came out with his plumber Donny, and they were both so kind, respectful, and professional. They got the job done very quickly, explained everything clearly, and even made me laugh while they worked. It is rare to find people who are not only great at what they do but also genuinely nice and easy to be around. I felt completely comfortable having them in my home. I took a picture of them for this review because they truly deserve to be recognized. If you ever need a plumber, call Economy Rooter. You will not regret it.

reviews.author: Kristen Sutton
reviews.text: I am beyond happy with the services I received from Coral Pelican plumbing. The plumber, Jarrett Mathis, was courteous, extremely knowledge, and genuinely a really great guy, ie someone you are totally comfortable having in your home. Coral Pelican plumbing was one of 4 plumbing vendors giving me quotes to replace our 26 year-old water. Our kitchen water pressure was reduced. I assumed it was the water heater. Jarrett, in addition to providing me a fair quote for a new hater, also checked our house water pressure and the kitchen faucet for sediment, all as part of the quotation process, not an 'extra' service. None of the other vendors went the 'extra mile' to check if the issue was something besides the heater.  I highly recommend Jarrett Mathis at Coral Pelican plumbing.

reviews.author: Terry Nealy
reviews.text:
Mr. Jarrett Mathis came to my home TODAY, even though it was late yesterday afternoon when I called and asked a plumber to come out and give me some estimates.

First and foremost, Jarrett is extremely professional and knowledgeable. He’s also patient for customers who might not have all of the plumbing vocabulary and best practices committed to memory, but he does a GREAT JOB (1) diagnosing the problem he sees (2) he gives you different options you can choose to fix the problem and (3) he is upfront about which option will cost more so the customer can make an informed decision based on their individual budget.

I’m locked in to get work done after the
specific items I want are shipped from about-of-state vendor.

Jarrett does a great job making the client feel comfortable and has endless patience when answering questions.

He has the best customer service skill set that I have witnessed throughout a long renovation project I’m overseeing.  I look forward to working with him on several important plumbing projects and would 100% recommend you give him a call when you want a conscientious professional to help you with your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jenna O'Leary
reviews.text: Best move ever? No one likes moving but if I had to do it again for myself or family member I’d 100% book Xavion again. He and Trey were awesome. Courteous, helpful, friendly. Honestly the easiest move we’ve done. Efficient and outgoing as well, we booked them to move my mom from Sarasota to Tampa 10-1:30 it was done! They came highly recommended via the Moms of South Tampa Facebook group and for good reason. Would easily recommend them for any move.

plumbers.name: Plumbers 4 Real LLC
plumbers.address: 1540 Rosewood Cir SE, Marietta, GA 30067, USA

reviews.author: lisa washington
reviews.text: Plumbers 4 real came to my house to unclog my toilet, but instead, they broke the pipe. I have been trying to reach them every since. I paid $879.00 for them to break my pipe. I had to get another contractor to fix the broken pipe and reset the toilet. The cost for the job was $1000.00. I have called several times to get my money back, but there has been no response from the company. JAMARI was the technician who performed the job.

reviews.author: jacqueline aponte
reviews.text:
Jamari and his assistant were truly amazing. Replaced the water pressure tank in no time. Explained in detail and educated me as to the work that was done. Went above and beyond what I expected and for that I’m grateful. Told me what to look in preparation to correct the root of the problem which caused the leakage in the weakest part of this old unit. They were professionals in every sense of the word. An asset to the company they represent. I’ll certainly be requesting them by name in the near future. Punctual, respectful, kind and above all professional and knowledgeable. Thanks again for such a positive experience.
Sincerely
A Aponte
Japonte

reviews.author: Jacob Ellerbe
reviews.text: I have used Plumbers 4 Real for several commercial jobs, and their service and response time is excellent. They have come through for us on several occasions, and gotten the job done right. They are not the cheapest service, but if you want it done right, you will go with Plumbers 4 Real. Any time we have an emergency or large job, Jamary is just a phone call away.

reviews.author: John B.
reviews.text:
Jamari was absolutely awesome!  I appreciated his honesty from the jump!  He knew I was very frustrated because I had just spent money on a new water heater.  Jamari told me from the start that it would be best to get our water line re-routed to save money and time!   On the day of service, it was raining a lot so Jamari was willing to reschedule our appointment to help protect my yard if I wanted to.  I decided to keep the appointment and they did a great job of not making a mess of the yard.   Jamari also moved pieces of our furniture in the garage to get to the water shut off valve.  I appreciate great customer service!  It’s rare to find great service with good prices!  I highly recommend Plumbers 4 real because they are FO REAL!

Thanks Jamari!

reviews.author: Alicia Carlisle
reviews.text: Hands down, my absolute favorite plumbers in the Atlanta area! I have used them for so many work orders, and every time they’ve delivered top-notch service. Jamari, in particular, is outstanding—always punctual, professional, and incredibly efficient. Their pricing is very fair, especially considering the quality of work, honesty and attention to detail. I highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Joe's Family Plumbing Inc.
plumbers.address: 1715 N Hercules Ave, Clearwater, FL 33755, USA

reviews.author: Maria Nixon
reviews.text: Highly recommend Joe's Family Plumbing who was recommended to me by a friend. I got an appointment right away and was kept informed when   Connor was on his way. Connor was incredible. He was so knowledgeable, so friendly, honest and even allowed me to watch while he snaked and put a camera down the sewer pipe. He was able to fix my issue and the cost was reasonable. I would definitely use Joe's family plumbing again.

reviews.author: Todd Supplee
reviews.text:
My developer used joes for rough-in plumbing work and had a very poor experience. The initial work was incomplete and incorrect, requiring multiple return visits to fix missed items and errors.

The crew was polite but appeared inadequately trained, with little to no supervision by an experienced or licensed plumber. Basic plumbing details were missed, causing rework and delays.

Communication was also a problem. I was told one thing, then provided email documentation showing those statements were false. After that, the company stopped responding.

When I later called for warranty service during the holidays for a toilet leaking waste onto the floor in a full house, they refused to send anyone due to a dispute with the developer and said someone would call me a week later.

I would look elsewhere. I have been nothing but nice and even tried to assist with the developer dispute but was met with continued slander, confusion and missed opportunities to correct their work.

reviews.author: Ruby King
reviews.text:
Edwin came out and investigated the issue.  He has a great attitude and is knowledgeable in the plumbing field.  He even did a great job cleaning up before leaving!

I had suspected roots so my apartment manager called  C. Lacey Plumbing out twice in the past 3 weeks.  Even though they said to me personally that they did not find anything in the pipes, they reported to my apartment manager that they found flushable wipes and brown napkins!!

Joe's Plumbing was then called and Edwin showed up to handle the situation!  Roots are out and a plan to prevent them has been proposed.

Thank you Edwin!

reviews.author: Shannon Beckman
reviews.text:
Based on a recommendation from a neighbor in our condo building, I hired Joe’s Family Plumbing to replace my water heater. The whole process was very easy.  The woman I talked with to schedule the appointment was very friendly and explained all information, including an accurate price quote which was simplified after I text her 5 photos of my current tank.   The plumber, Carl, who installed it came on time and was very professional & friendly too. He completed the job in 2 hours and didn’t leave any mess at all.  I highly recommend Joe’s Family Plumbing  & would gladly do business with them again.

The old tank is the photo without the plastic drawers. The new tank is the photo with the plastic drawers.

reviews.author: Darlene Johnson
reviews.text: Service was efficient, fast, and accurate.  Damien did an outstanding job.  Alicia in the office was a pleasure to work with.   Thank you Joe and team!

reviews.author: Julia Nichols
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough good things about North Atlanta Plumbing! John, the owner, and Tyler are both incredible – professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful. They replaced my old, leaky copper plumbing with modern PEX and did a flawless job. They also guided me through upgrading to a tankless water heater, which they installed in my garage perfectly.

Their work is top quality, reliable, and reasonably priced, and they stand behind it with a guarantee. I feel so lucky to have such a skilled, trustworthy plumbing team on my side. If you need expert plumbers who truly care and get the job done right, North Atlanta Plumbing is the company to call!

reviews.author: Laureen Flynn
reviews.text: This is the absolutely best plumbing service I’ve ever used. They are invariably good well priced delightful to work with and responsive totally when needed. So grateful to have them on speed dial. they cleaned out my full exit pipe did a back flush and fix my sinks more than once

reviews.author: Mary Williamson
reviews.text: Good communication. No excessive charges. Knowledgeable. Installed whole house leak detection device and explained how to use app on phone . I bought Moen on Amazon and John installed

reviews.author: Chris Fraser
reviews.text: I’ve used John at North Atlanta Plumbing three times now, and every experience has been excellent. He’s professional, always on time, knowledgeable, and easy to work with. If you’re looking for a reliable plumber, John and his crew are the ones to call. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jenée Pombert
reviews.text: I unfortunately had my toilet and sink have major leaks at my business at the same time. I called the guys at North Atlanta plumbing and they were out the next morning! Super friendly and honest. They Gave me “band-aid” options and real fix it options. I greatly appreciate them willing to work with a budget if needed. They got me fixed up and back working without affecting how my business ran. They do great business and I will absolutely be saving their number for any future issues.

plumbers.name: All Service Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 14 Corporation Center, Broadview Heights, OH 44147, USA

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.text: Mike was awesome! You could just tell he gives all his jobs 100%.  Mike installed a new kitchen faucet for me — he did a great job,  And he was also quick to respond when I reached out today.  thanks to All service Plumbing. They’re fantastic!

reviews.author: kaitlin pierse
reviews.text: Unfortunately amending my original review… Ray and his team were friendly but unfortunately ended up being disappointed. Ray’s team came out to look at our kitchen sink that would not drain. We gave them the run down of the issue we were having and explained everything we had tried to fix the issue. The plumber decided to snake the drain. The snaking did not fix the draining issue. Initially the plumber stated all of the lines looked set up properly. The plumber called his boss (Ray) to discuss the issues. It was not until the plumber sent Ray pictures of the kitchen sink plumbing set up that it was stated to us that the set up was actually not up to code. They stated that they would need to come back out to redo all of the kitchen sink piping. They ensured us that they would assist with our home warranty plan to make sure it would be covered. Weeks went by with nobody reaching out to me. I sent a follow up email with no response. At this point I decided to consult another plumber. This plumber stated that the piping set up may not be how he would have done it but, it was still functional. The new plumber ran a snake and within 15 mins the sink was already started to drain very well. He then checked the leveling of the piping all the way to the main line. He stabilized a few sections that seemed a little bit off. (Something ASP did not do) he let the water continue to run and then snaked on last time to ensure all of the blockage cleared. I asked the new plumber how much it would be. He said typically they charge $275 for the service but he would only charge me $200 since he felt bad that ASP came out and did the same service with no success. So essentially ASP charged us $400 (which we were told was a great deal) to not fix anything and then never follow up on the additional service they said was needed. I even asked the new plumber how this wasn’t fixed initially by ASP he simply stated that it was a lack of knowing how to snake a drain properly. All and all very disappointing because I was charged $400 for them to not fix the issue at all.

reviews.author: Brooke Strumbel
reviews.text: Mike was amazing! Professional and very knowledgeable. I live in a condo with a HOA and he made the whole process easy. I got all the values replaced and new faucet and everything is working great! Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Terry Fischer
reviews.text: We have used All Service Plumbing twice and both times they have delivered top results. We are super appreciative of their fast response to replace our two water heaters at our residence and to come out for an urgent problem we were experiencing at our business. We will be repeat customers and will always recommend them to anyone needing a plumber.

reviews.author: Karen Combs
reviews.text: All Service Plumbing is the best. Quick response time. Staff is  knowledgeable and friendly. We can always count on them to handle our issues.

plumbers.name: Plumbers Near Me LLC
plumbers.address: 355 S Teller St STE 200, Lakewood, CO 80226, USA

reviews.author: Dana Shelayne Kroeger
reviews.text:
Isaac was amazing, smart and kind.

He fixed my issue in less than 5 minutes. And now I have a bigger issue that I discovered tonight that takes a lot more to fix.

Honestly I would have never found the other issue if it weren’t for Isaac problem-solving the first. Thank you Isaac.

But here is what I learned about ‘Plumbers Near Me’ today. I found them on Google. I was doing a broad search as most “Plumbing Companies” charge an and a leg for even the easiest of fixes that could simply advise a person on how to fix on their own.

If I didn’t have a Mom in hospice, a dog to take care of and a job - I probably could have figured it out on my own.

But I don’t have such time or luxury right now.

What stood out was that it was a family run company, which matters to me. I come from a family of farmers. It matters.

I know most plumbing prices and they are typically exorbitant when unnecessary to charge people such costs.

So that is what is going to insure Plumbers Near Me THRIVE!

Kind, caring and smart plumbers or associate plumbers because guess who I will always call in every scenario in the future? Inexpensive or expensive.

Plumbers Near Me LLC.

Good people. Smart people. Dependable people that actually care about the human they are helping.

I have to believe that there are many that feel the same as me. And if not they haven’t dealt with the monopolies.

Thank you.

reviews.author: Taylor Coghlan
reviews.text: I have hired them 3 times to do miscellaneous things for me, they fixed my shower once, installed toilets and just recently installed a water filter and a new kitchen faucet. They do great work, are efficient and have excellent quotes. Thank you again guys, I look forward to working with you again in the future.

reviews.author: Anna Rodriguez
reviews.text: We needed 2 quarter turn shutoff valves installed in a bathroom prior to installing a new vanity and faucet. Carlos took care of this quickly and efficiently. Tha price quoted was on par with 3 other quotes we had received. While he was here, we added on an additional service to a leaky toilet tank. We were very impressed with Carlos' knowledge and skills. We will be using Plumbers Near Me in the future for our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Tim Farrow
reviews.text: We had a different company out first and they misdiagnosed the issue with our toilet. Carlos quickly and correctly found our issue and was honest in telling us how to fix it ourselves. I would happily use them again, especially since I feel almost guilty they didn’t charge us for extremely helpful information!

reviews.author: Kaylee S
reviews.text: We highly recommend Plumbers Near Me . Carlos M has fixed two things in our house and each time he kindly answers all our questions (so we can be better homeowners)and always gives us sound advice. The office is also so helpful with scheduling and follow up questions. Always a job well done. We really appreciate them!

plumbers.name: SWAGS Plumbing and Rooter
plumbers.address: 3694 Lynx Dr, San Jose, CA 95136, USA

reviews.author: Jason Wu
reviews.text: Jaime came over to my house to check on our hot water heater that stopped working the night before. He was quick to answer my phone calls and text messages. He helped us relight our pilot and was very informative on hot water heaters and what to look for, how long hot water heaters last,  andwhere to check on the date of the hot water heater’s manufacture date.  I asked him how much he is charging for this service call, and he said “Don’t worry about it.” I was pleasantly surprised and I will call him back for any future service and/or replacement. Very happy with his service. A+++

reviews.author: Megan Ackerson
reviews.text: Swags and Christian Vazquez have helped me twice and they’ll be my go to from now on. When my laundry room flooded and the adjacent kitchen and bathroom were also affected, Chris cleared out the blockage in the main pipes and was really good about explaining and showing me the diagnosis, the steps he was taking and options to address our very old pipes. Prior to this Chris installed a new toilet for us. He’s done quality work and I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Selena Shi
reviews.text: I contacted SWAGS to inquire about replacing my shower systems (valves and adding handhelds). They sent out a technician right away for consultation and I got a text confirmation. The technician patiently walked me through my questions, possible options and what would be involved for each...He even volunteered to tighten all the valves and switch couple shower heads/arms to address my concerns and provide a temporary solution. He also pointed out things I didn't think of/realize, which probably would save both of us several trips if we were to go ahead with the project. (for me getting the wrong parts or missing parts etc) You can tell they want to do things right the first time and they are very knowledgable. Throughout the whole time, I was not rushed or pressured to use their service. The technician was very courteous, and the communication was very clear and honest. At the end, the consultation fee was waived entirely and I got estimates for a few other plumbing projects. I would definitely consider hiring them when it's time to do the job (unless I could get a significantly lower quote elsewhere =P I haven't got a chance to obtain other quotes, so their price may be very well reasonable. Also, from talking to the technician, I feel the company treats its employees fair and well.) Highly recommend to contact SWAGS first for your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Abraham Ren
reviews.text:
We recently had a great experience with SWAGS across the board! We had a leak in our walls going down into our crawlspace and SWAGS sent out a technician on the same day. Christian did a great job of assessing the problem, and making recommendations on our various options. Since the leak happened on a shower we were still under warranty for, he gave us a quote for their repair but also recommended we get it serviced by our contractor under the warranty and provided the details we should give them to identify and address the problem as easily as possible. All this for no charge because it was a quick trip that resulted in a quote!

We will definitely contact them for any plumbing needs we have in the future.

reviews.author: Yihe Yao
reviews.text: Very very professional and reliable, fantastic communication. I had an gas leak issue in the garage. They arrived in a day on time. They did professional diagnostics on multiple points. Clearly communicated the root cause. Their quote includes an full spectrum inspection that guarantees no further leaks. (As part of their warranty) . I didn't end up in the contract because I turned to the warranty of the original installer. I'll definitely go with them next time if there is other issue.

plumbers.name: Dandy Plumbing Solutions
plumbers.address: 13555 SW Hwy A, Orland Park, IL 60462, USA

reviews.author: Kelly Dorman
reviews.text: I was having an issue with my upstairs toilet and Bob came by and saved the day!! He did a thorough job and explained everything to the T. Very professional and trustworthy. I will keep Dandy Plumbing Solutions in mind for any future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Nicole
reviews.text: We had Dandy Plumbing out due to a pipe that had broken in our home.  It was a very large project, and they were extremely professional, explained everything going on, and were very reassuring during the process.  I could not recommend them more.  We have another project that they will be working on, and I wouldn’t trust another company to do the job.  Highly recommend them, and their prices are very reasonable!

reviews.author: Nicole Petkus
reviews.text: Called Dandy in an emergency and the owner Dan came out on a Saturday within 30min of my call.   He was great,  got it installed and answered all our questions.   Price was much less then I expected as well.   Will definitely call them if I need anything on the future

They were almost immediate in their service and we were beyond pleased with the service we received. Bob was amazing and very thorough about what he observed and what was needed. reviews.text: Justin L. did an excellent job installing my water heater. He was very professional, courteous, and friendly. Explained everything about the installation from start to finish. reviews.author: Chandler Elder
reviews.text:

A personal shoutout to the plumber Alex who serviced our hot water heater unit and leakage issue. Additionally, Justin, the office manager and co-founder who went above and beyond to make me feel like he truly appreciated me as a repeat customer. You don’t see that much these days but it’s made me a customer for life.

reviews.author: Kunal Teeda
reviews.text:
A completely unnecessary upsell — get a second opinion before using this company

I called Benjamin Franklin Plumbing to diagnose a leaking faucet. The technician took a quick look and immediately quoted me over $700 to replace the entire faucet. No real explanation, no attempt to troubleshoot, and not a single alternative option offered.

What actually fixed it? A $20 cartridge replacement. I confirmed the issue myself and repaired it in minutes. No full replacement needed. No $700 bill. Just a basic part the technician never bothered to check.

This wasn’t just a high quote. It was a wrong diagnosis that would’ve cost me hundreds of dollars for work that wasn’t necessary. That’s a serious trust problem.

If I hadn’t stopped to verify the issue on my own, I would’ve been charged more than 30 times the cost of the real fix.

I won’t be calling this company again, and I strongly recommend anyone reading this to always get a second opinion. A plumbing company should solve your problem—not create an expensive one.

reviews.text:
It takes a lot for me to be compelled to write a poor review. We hired Benjamin Franklin Plumbing (Columbia, MD) on August 29, 2025 to clear a clog in our kitchen sink. I called Benjamin Franklin Plumbing's office three separate times (Aug. 30, Sept. 3, and Sept. 5) asking to please speak with a manager or owner about the invoice. Each time I was promised a call back within 48–72 business hours. No one ever returned my calls. reviews.author: M K
reviews.text:
Paid $19,000.00

I normally do not write reviews, but what happened to Miss Tina, an 87-year-old handicapped homeowner, deserves to be publicly documented. This company took advantage of an elderly woman who could not read or understand the contract she was signing. She trusted them as licensed professionals, and instead she ended up with open holes left in her walls for two years.

Those openings allowed rats to enter her home and cause even more damage. When I finally discovered the problem a month ago, it was obvious the work had been rushed and done without any care. Wires were cut and taped together inside the walls, nothing was properly fastened, and some of the work was simply never completed. Parts of the home were left exposed long enough for pests to move in and out freely.

When we contacted the company for help, the prices they quoted were shocking. A one-day job started at $9,500 before dropping thousands of dollars in minutes. A larger job went from $22,000 to $19,000 with no real explanation. It became clear this wasn’t professional estimating—it was predatory pricing aimed at someone they assumed wouldn’t question it. Another plumber later completed one of these “$9,500 jobs” in a couple of hours.

When their representative finally came out, the solution offered was to simply “patch and paint” over everything. No addressing the rodents, no correcting the unsafe wiring, no accountability. Just a superficial cover-up of the damage their crew left behind. And then we never heard back from them.

Miss Tina relies on others to help her because she is largely blind. She had no way to catch what happened until I stepped in. What’s most painful is that she trusted them. She trusted the explanations, the pricing, and the work—and they took full advantage of that trust.

We have since had an independent assessment done, and multiple violations were confirmed. The entire job will need to be redone by a professional.

This experience has been devastating for her emotionally and financially. No elderly homeowner should ever be put through something like this. If you have vulnerable family members, please think twice before hiring this company.

The photos I uploaded point out that they covered a wall outlet with their hoses making it impossible to access as well as the holes that were left open interior and exterior, also no straps and organized
Code violations, several.

reviews.text:
Yesterday I had a major issue with my kitchen sink. It was completely backed up and not draining at all. I tried every DIY trick I could think of, but nothing worked. After reading all the great reviews on Yelp and Google, I decided to give I Love Sewers Rooter and Plumbing a call, and I’m really glad I did.

When I called, Brittany was very helpful and quickly scheduled a technician named Nico. He arrived within two hours, right on time. Nico was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to properly diagnose the issue. He ran a camera down the drain and found a heavy sludge buildup that was preventing the pipe from draining correctly.

He recommended hydro jetting to clear the line. After completing the service, he showed me the before and after camera footage. The difference was huge and the line looked significantly cleaner. My sink is now draining perfectly.

Their pricing was very reasonable and the quality of work was excellent. I will definitely be calling I Love Sewers Rooter and Plumbing again for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommend.

reviews.text: Salt Lake Plumbing is amazing! Chad and Colton are great to work with. Colton went above and beyond helping with our home plumbing installation, making sure everything was perfect. Chad took great care of us after Colton was on site as well. Thank you!

Thank you!

reviews.author: Monica Archibald
reviews.text: I was surprised to have a plumber arrive within an hour of my non-emergency call! Brenda was kind, efficient and helpful in scheduling. Justin diagnosed the leak in minutes and had everything fixed within 45 minutes. He was professional,  thorough, and fast. I'm definitely calling this company for all future plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Lee Anne Rice
reviews.text: We woke up Easter morning with an alert from our water company that we probably had a major leak based on water usage the last 48 hours. As it was a holiday, we called a company that offered holiday service at no extra charge. Big mistake! Two days later, we still did not have water or a solution. After viewing social media recommendations for plumbing services, we found Fuller Plumbing. Gary came out that day and diagnosed our problem. He had his crew out the next day, and within a couple of hours, we had a new water line and full service. Best of all, his charge was less than half what the other company was charging. We received photos of all the work and clearly saw the new lines and how deep they were laid. The crew was professional and respectful and even offered to carry my groceries while I was walking down our steep driveway in heels. Gary stayed after they left to make sure everything was working to our satisfaction. Two months later, everything is still great! Fuller Plumbing will be our FIRST call in the future when we need plumbing service. They are local and provide excellent, high quality service!

reviews.author: JoAnne Wirtz-Ryan
reviews.text: We have a very steep descent from the road to the house. Our water main line had a leak so we contacted Fuller plumbing to find the leak and repair it. Gary thoroughly evaluated our situation, pointed out to me that with 20 yo PVC it's getting brittle. He also said that with the steep slope it's under pressure from ground movement and vibrations from vehicles, both which are not compatible with PVC as it doesn't tolerate movement well. We knew our neighbor with the same situation  had recently spent 10's of thousands repairing their water main line. He gave me the prices for finding the leak as well as prices for running a new line with a PEX that is flexible and would withstand pressure, vibration and freezing issues. Even though more money than repairing, We chose to install a new line. His crew showed up on time and stayed until 7pm to get it done. He also hired a pressure washer to come the next day to clean the dirt off the driveway. Lastly he never asked me for money until the job was completed. They're very professional and I appreciate that he gave me options that will save me from repeated leaks in the future, unlike my neighbor who spent 3x what I spent with a different company, only to repair a line that has a short life expectancy. I definitely will use them again when I need a plumber.

reviews.author: Damon Outdoors
reviews.text: I called several plumbers before coming across Fuller. I got answering machines and no calls. I called Fuller on a Saturday and Gary answered and set me up for the following Monday. I received a text Monday AM letting me know he was on the way. Gary was very professional with a no BS install. Pricing was on par with the website and I felt it was fair. I would definitely use Fuller again.

reviews.author: Chris White
reviews.text:
We wanted to get a tankless water heater installed as well as needed our PRV valve replaced. We had a couple of the big guys come out to do quotes. We got a word of mouth recommendation to check with Fuller and I'm glad that I did. Gary not only saved us thousands he was friendly, knowledgeable and worked throughout the day to get the work done. You could tell he knew exactly what he was doing .

I would not hesitate to recommend or call Fuller again for plumbing work.

reviews.author: Jim Robinson
reviews.text: Had a really good experience with Gary from Fuller Plumbing.   Communicated well from the start.   Came out promptly and spent his time assessing the situation.   Had modern diagnostic tools and was able to rule out some costly and invasive repairs before recommending a fix.   Gary came back out the next day and installed the component.   Gary is very professional and personable.   Price was reasonable for the parts and time spent on the issue.   The job site was cleaned and the part well explained for future upkeep.   High recommend Fuller Plumbing.

reviews.author: Josephine Douglas
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about the service I received from Valdez Brothers Plumbing. Here’s what happened: my water heater completely stopped working—not just a pilot light issue, but fully out. Luckily, it was still covered by the manufacturer’s warranty, so I only needed to take care of the plumbing costs. At the time, money was very tight and I was worried I’d be without hot water for days. I reached out after seeing some local recommendations, and Douglas was the plumber who helped me. He was understanding about my situation and even picked up the replacement water heater from the manufacturer’s distribution center before coming out. Douglas explained the whole process to me step by step and gave me a very fair price for the work. Since we’re a military family living paycheck to paycheck, Douglas kindly agreed to wait a few days to deposit my check until payday. I’ve never heard of other plumbing companies in the area being that flexible or accommodating. Later, when I had a problem with leaking pipes due to faulty hardware, Douglas came back and replaced them with better quality parts at no extra charge. I really appreciate his honesty, hard work, and the way he stands by his repairs. If you’re looking for a trustworthy and reliable plumber, this is the company to call.

reviews.author: Bailey Erickson
reviews.text: After our hot water heater suddenly stopped working in the middle of the night, my wife and I woke up to a big mess and lots of water to clean up. We had about 20-30 gallons of water on the floor, which meant a lot of cleanup and extra laundry. We wanted a trustworthy plumber in Orem who was fully licensed, insured, and could help us out the same day. I called a few places, and this company picked up right away and was able to send someone out quickly. Douglas, the plumber who arrived, was on time and explained everything to us in a way we could understand. He found not only the problems we already knew about, but also pointed out some other issues that could have caused trouble down the line and weren’t up to code anymore. Even though I was a bit worried about extra work, I appreciated that Douglas found these issues so we could keep our home safe and up to standard. He gave us different repair and replacement options, and we decided to upgrade to a larger 50-gallon water heater with a great warranty. The next day, Douglas came back and did the installation. He was careful with our home, worked efficiently, and made sure everything was done right. He took the time to show me how to use the new water heater and any other equipment he installed. Douglas was knowledgeable and professional the entire time. Overall, I was really happy with how fast and reliable the service was. Both visits went smoothly, and I would gladly call this plumber again if we ever need help in the future.

reviews.author: Ariel22 M
reviews.text: Douglas installed a new kitchen sink and faucet for us in Orem. He showed up right on time and was very polite and professional throughout the job. Douglas carefully followed the instructions for both the sink and faucet, making sure everything was put together just right. He treated our project with care instead of just rushing through it. After finishing the installation, Douglas made sure the sink was perfectly level and the seal around it was neat and even. There were no leaks at all, and our new sink and faucet look fantastic. He also cleaned up the area and took away the old sink and faucet, leaving our kitchen spotless. We are very happy with the work, and we will call Valdez Brothers Plumbing for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

Douglas is reliable, punctual, honest, and very friendly. Highly recommend their plumbing services!

reviews.author: Laurie Dildine
reviews.text:
My master bathroom sink wasn’t draining, I tried everything I decided to take the pipe under the sink to see what was stuck.  NOTHING I went to the front bathroom water all over the floor and in the cabinet under the sink.  I inherited the house last year after losing my dad.  He was in charge of repairs, back in the day he did things himself.  This was my first big girl issue.  I didn’t know one plumber from the next, I googled plumbers near me Voyager Plumbing popped up with 4.9 stars.  I sent a message about 0700 by 0800 someone called to schedule a guy to
Come out to check out what is going on.  The guy (Arnold) got to the house about 1000.  He cut a little hole in the wall to see what was going on.  Cracked pipe in the wall.  Arnold called the boss (Thomas) to bring the camera over.  What I thought was a little issue was bigger than i could have imagined.  My house is older all the pipes are cast iron and rusty inside.  I told them about an issue that was taken care of in 2014, Thomas showed me what this fix looked like and what it should look like.  Thomas said they can take care of that and all the plumbing or just the the original issues.  He wasn’t pushy just letting me know what was going on which I appreciate.  I told him you’re here just take care of all the pipes.   All the employees who have been to the house have so polite and dealing with my dog barking at them each time they walked past her.  Thomas calls me to let me know the progress.  The guys who are at the house text me to let me know they are done for the day.  Francisco has been at the house majority of the time.  He’s so polite easy to talk and joke with.  If I had a package delivered he was so kind to bring it in the house.  Johnny and Josh have been there to help.   Both are very kind, friendly and they are all hard workers,  Thomas (owner) and Arnold (original guy who found the issue).  I truly wish I could give them a million stars.  They made this overwhelming situation not so overwhelming.  I highly recommend Voyager Plumbing you will NOT be disappointed.

reviews.author: Shaun Schofield
reviews.text:
PHENOMENAL EXPERTICE in plumbing. We had a slab leak caused by a burst in our cold water line the morning after Christmas 2024. By 14 Jan 2025 Voyager, guided by the leadership of Frank Arias, completed a TOTAL reinstall of all hot/cold water lines and drain lines for two bathrooms, kitchen, garage and ALL outdoor water/drain fixtures.
During the process Frank keep us informed of the progress and intent moving forward, further providing pictures.
I can not express how pleased we are with the total install. We took advantage of the opportunity and had Voyager install a tankless ready heater, 5 stage Halo 5 whole house water filtration system, a wash basin in the garage.
PHENOMINAL. The owner Thomas has a solid company that provides superior services.
The photos are small example of how they have perfected their craft!

UPDATE TO RESENT REVIEW:
Again I cannot express the professionalism and service to the customer that Voyager Plumbing exudes. While they had completed the plumbing noted in the pictures, they had one of our showers and kitchen area prepped to finish the “rough end” plumbing once the contractors completed their portion of the reconstruction. Fast forward over a month later and once the contractors have got to a point to allow Voyager plumbing to complete their portion rough end plumbing, the owner Thomas took it upon himself to come and complete the plumbing. Mind you , the Voyager plumbing contract had already been signed as complete.
From my prospective Voyager plumbing holds true to their word and puts the customers first while ensuring the job tasked is complete as specified.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED for your plumbing needs.

My plumber was on time, professional, friendly and efficient.
