reviews.author: Jamie E. Stehula
reviews.text: Great job Dimitrios! P & S Plumbing is always on the ball! Came to our rescue on a holiday to unplug our sewer line. All the toilets were backed up so we were so thankful to get the job done quickly. We highly recommend Dimitrios … He was very personable, knowledgeable, and efficient!

plumbers.name: All Star Plumbing Fresno
plumbers.address: 5639 W Barstow Ave, Fresno, CA 93722, USA

reviews.author: Heather Lee
reviews.text: This review is long overdue. Jondee, Lance, Jerry and the whole crew at All Star Plumbing are amazing! They always go above and beyond for me and my clients buying and selling homes. They’re on time, and professional for our sewer line inspections and pull strings to make repairs happen in timely manner. They do a great job explaining things well to might clients. Highly satisfied and will continue to use them like I always do.

reviews.author: Samuel Aguilar
reviews.text:
Big props to Lance and Sergio at All Star  Plumbing. Sergio came in for a scheduled jet cleaning due to a backup over the weekend, (mind you the price All Star quoted was roughly a third less than a quote from another plumbing service) but before just jumping in and jetting, he checked all of the drains and snaked a camera through - all the way to the main line.

Sergio said we’re all clear, no need to jet, and Lance said no charge, we appreciate your business. I insisted, since as a business operator I know there are costs associated with simply sending someone out; so I was expecting to at least compensate for time and prep. And, I will also expect to pay for time and prep should this occur again. But alas, to no avail.

So I’ll show my thanks by letting as many people know through this review and will continue to recommend for friends and family.

I have used Allstar in the past as well, they are very good with pricing across the board, hence my reaching out to them again.

reviews.author: Beverly Murphy
reviews.text: Wonderful, honest and professional! My hot water heater was not heating. I had an estimate from another plumbing company. They charged 49.95 to look at my hw heater and quoted me $3,500.00 to replace it. All Star called me and said they would give a free quote. Bobby came out immediately and discovered my husband had just turned a dial wrong. All Star didn't charge us at all. We're seniors citizens and they gave us faith in good people. From $3,500.00 from another company to a caring and honest company made a big difference to us! Thank you All Star. My friend, Katie will be calling you tomorrow for service!

reviews.author: Olivia Kahn
reviews.text: Excellent experience. Johnny evaluated my leaky bathtub faucet, provided me advice on how to take advantage of the cartridge warranty, and made the return and replacement process as smooth as possible. The issue was fixed completely in no time at all. Additionally, he was so kind when he realized that we are a military family in the middle of deployments. Due to his thoughtfulness and expertise, All Star Plumbing will be my go-to choice for all future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: John Zweifler
reviews.text:
We called All Star Plumbing to check out plugged up drains that were backing up our kitchen sink. They came out promptly and explained the options clearly. They started with the snake and were able to get the sinks draining easily. The technician Joe said that additional services such as the hydrojet were not needed in our case. He could have easily told us differently and we would have been none the wiser. He declined a tip and even suggested a home remedy for keeping the pipes clean. Great job and thanks Allstate Plumbing!
:)

plumbers.name: Plumb It Best, LLC
plumbers.address: 83 Hankes Ave, Aurora, IL 60505, USA

reviews.author: Andrew M
reviews.text: We had two toilets replaced on our second floor one included a bidet. They were actually able to come the day after I requested the service which was fantastic! Both toilets were installed with precision and look great. The guys cleaned up everything and even carried our old toilets outside for us. This is the second job we’ve had Plumb-It do and we’ve continued to have a wonderful experience. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: June McHale
reviews.text: James and Alex did a great job installing 3 bathroom faucets and new shower fixture.  They were very respectful of our home. They patiently answered our questions.  They did the job in a timely manner and cleaned up after themselves.  We would definitely call them again.

reviews.author: Christopher Yarborough
reviews.text: I've done business with Plumb It several times over the past 12+ years. Always customer focused, quick, direct, and with fair pricing. Support Scott and his team of trademen. A local small business that you can trust. I wish I could say that about any of the other smaller outfits I use for other needs.

reviews.author: Jody Bruce
reviews.text: Plumb It  Best did a great job at my house. I needed 2 new faucets installed. They showed up on time and had it fixed very quickly. If you need plumbing work, you have to call Plumb It Best!

reviews.author: Tory Tribuzio
reviews.text: They are the  BEST! My old waterheater was removed and a New Highest Quality Bradford- White 40 gallon waterheater was installed PROFESSIONALLY in 2 hours! Thank You PLUMB-IT BEST!

plumbers.name: Quality Plumbing Services, Inc.
plumbers.address: 310 S La Londe Ave, Addison, IL 60101, USA

reviews.author: Gina Marie
reviews.text: Dan from Quality Plumbing came out for my leaky shower cartridge and low water pressure. The part was a pain—he had to track one down and order it, which took a little extra time, but he kept me updated and got it sorted without any hassle on my end. Fixed everything perfectly, pressure's great now, and he was really nice and professional. Super happy—thanks Dan and Quality Plumbing!

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Quality Plumbing Services based on the outstanding work recently completed at my home.  From my initial contact to final cleanup the entire process was handled with exceptional professionalism and efficiency. Dan B. and his partner that were assigned to the project were courteous, knowledgeable and meticulous.  They explained the before and after of the main project and provided details and instructions on maintaining the new product.  I greatly appreciated their dedication to cleanliness the use of drop cloths and thoroughly cleaning up debris and  removal of the part being replaced.
Their technical expertise and commitment to a high standard of service make them a top-tier choice.

reviews.author: Justin Kalber
reviews.text: Kevin and the team at Quality Plumbing were nothing short of amazing to work with. Dealing with a broken pipe in your kitchen in the middle of winter was not easy, however, they made this project run as smooth as it possibly could. Needless to say, when it comes to any and all things plumbing, Quality Plumbing has a customer for life.

reviews.author: Korey Decker
reviews.text: Dan was extremely knowledgeable, patient, understanding, and got everything fixed quick and efficiently for us. He was the first person we had work on our plumbing since we’ve moved in and we haven’t looked anywhere else since, he’s that good. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Victoria B. Wons
reviews.text:
We were dealing with a sump pump emergency when it suddenly stopped working and water began coming into our basement. It was incredibly stressful, and most companies I called were either unavailable or rushed us off the phone and were quick to assume that our sump pump was shot. Quality Plumbing Services was the only company that took the time to really ask questions and understand exactly what was happening with our sump pump.

Even though they weren’t able to come out until the next day, the person I spoke with was calm, knowledgeable, and patient. He walked me through a temporary solution over the phone that helped prevent our basement from flooding. Thanks to this guidance, we were able to get the motor going and avoid major damage.

They  came out right away the next morning. I’m extremely grateful for their professionalism, compassion, and willingness to help during a stressful emergency. I can’t recommend Quality Plumbing  Services enough.

plumbers.name: Abacus Plumbing, Air Conditioning & Electrical
plumbers.address: 708 S Lamar Blvd G, Austin, TX 78704, USA

reviews.author: Sergio Durante
reviews.text:
We had ABACUS come to our home again and install a new faucet, garbage disposal and all the connecting pipes under the new sink.  The experience couldn’t have been better. From start to finish, it was smooth, professional, and super pleasant.

Tim Waltman was our technician, and he was fantastic. Super kind and polite, and clearly knows his craft. He took his time, did a really clean job, and everything works perfectly. He was respectful of our home, easy to talk to, and just had a calm, pleasant way about him that made the whole thing easy.  It’s so nice when someone comes in, does excellent work, and you don’t have to worry about anything. Thanks Tim!

ABACUS continues to impress and continues to earn our trust.

reviews.author: Sherrill Jeter
reviews.text: Not an easy review for me. On a scheduled service time of 11-2 the Electrician finally contacted me and let me know that it would be 3pm before he arrived. I’ve been waiting since 10:30. He was pleasant and professional. There were significant differences in what I was told by the office and the Electrician. He quoted an outrageous price ($568) to change a circuit breaker and I asked him to leave. I have history as a home builder. In conversation he told me what he paid for the circuit breaker ($70) and I told him I thought that was price gouging. We ended up at $386 rather than $550+ and it was still very high. I do not trust this company to act fairly.

reviews.author: Jessica Tran
reviews.text: Had Abacus technician, Ethan, came out for a 2nd opinion. Very honest appraisal and inspection. Will only recommend service that’s needed.  I will use them again in the future for repairs.

reviews.author: Gregory Bow
reviews.text: Great service all around. Great communication around scheduling. Plumber was on time and did a great job. Would definitely use them again for other plumbing services.

reviews.author: Denise Bell
reviews.text: Rory from Abacus came to fix one of the mini splits in my home (or should I say, help me with it, it actually wasn’t broken). I’ve had Abacus service people at my house for various things the last 2 years. Always on time, professional and reliable. I got quotes from 4 a/c companies (even Goettl which my family used to own and operate) and went with Abacus. Very happy with my decision.

plumbers.name: Strada Services
plumbers.address: 1631 Corporate Pl, La Vergne, TN 37086, USA

reviews.author: T. K.
reviews.text:
I want to give five stars, but STRATA, the company itself, as of yet, within one years time, had been unable to properly fix our brand new HVAC system, in our newly built home.
The only reason I’m giving four stars is because we were very pleased with the diligent and professional work completed today by their technician, Scott. He was obviously highly knowledgeable and took his time diagnosing the problem.
Turns out the HVA system was never built correctly from the beginning, but we are happy to know that Strada is extending their warranty in our neighborhood due to these problems. We will definitely be giving them a fair shot at fixing the problems!

In the meantime, thank you, Scott, for trying to help our unit function properly!

reviews.author: Skylar Degalliford
reviews.text: I don’t write a lot of reviews,but I had to come on here and write one for Scott. This guy is awesome,our heat has been working on and off and we were trying to figure out why. Scott took the time to explain everything to me,and also took an extended amount of time thoroughly checking everything to find the problem. If anything goes wrong in the future I will personally be asking for Scott,if everyone was as nice and professional as this guy the world would be a much better place! Give him a huge raise,thank you scott!

reviews.author: Andrew Pagett
reviews.text: This was by far one of the best service appointments I have had since living in TN.  Scott was an absolute pleasure to work with and very informative. He really helped me understand what was going on with our house and what we need to do for next steps. Will 100% be requesting him again for future support. Freddie also came by last week to support our AC system and get it recharged. They both made me feel extremely comfortable with them in my home. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Candice Humphrey
reviews.text:
I was referred to this company by American Home Shield due to a 9-year-old malfunctioning water heater and a dripping bathtub faucet. While the technician himself was very polite and professional, the service process raised serious concerns.
The technician arrived and first looked at my tub faucet. He commented that it was “the slowest drip” he had ever seen, took a photo, and did not physically touch or inspect the faucet at any point. I explained that this issue had occurred before and that there was a prior service call for the same problem.  We then moved on to the water heater.  I shared that my husband had removed the panel and noticed the top thermostat was warm. Again, the technician only took a photo and did not inspect or touch the unit.
He then returned to his truck to call American Home Shield, which was surprising since no inspection had been performed. When he came back inside, he stated that AHS would not cover either the water heater or the dripping faucet due to cold weather. When I asked how that determination could be made without an inspection, he was unable to provide an explanation. However, he did have a prepared invoice for approximately $2,000 for the company to complete the work privately.
The entire visit lasted about 30 minutes. Given the lack of inspection, the immediate denial of coverage, and the ready-made invoice, the experience felt highly unprofessional and raised serious ethical concerns. I would strongly advise homeowners to ask detailed questions and proceed with caution.

reviews.author: Rachel Arnold
reviews.text: This was my first time using strada services in Nashville and I am beyond happy with the service I got! Everyone was quick and responsive in the office for scheduling. The plumbers that came out to my house (Dax and Brandon) were excellent and really worked with me to get my insurance claim approved. They really went above and beyond. The HVAC technician that came out was also very pleasant and polite. I have never met a group of people so kind in this industry. Thank you!!

plumbers.name: Massey Plumbing
plumbers.address: 13820 5th St, Dade City, FL 33525, USA

reviews.author: Ann Payton
reviews.text: I called and asked for help choosing an adjustable shower head that would move higher or lower; Hawn arrived with a shower head that was exactly what we needed. Install was quick and excellent job. My husband says his showers are great now. Massey has done several projects for us and I never hesitate to call them. Thank you.

reviews.author: Lori
reviews.text: Hawn was outstanding!  Completely professional and knowledgeable.  He truly made our first time experience with the company pleasurable.  Very quick and and explained everything to us.  Thank you to the owner for setting the appointment so quickly.  You have a lifetime customer and I will refer anyone looking for plumbing services your way.  Thank you again!!

reviews.author: Leanne Draving
reviews.text: Mike from Massey Plumbing ran lines to install a washer/dryer unit at my mother’s mobile home. He spent an entire day and went above and beyond to do the job correctly. He even took the time to remove and seal the old wheel well where the unit sits. We highly recommended him and Massey Plumbing!

reviews.author: Netta Radice
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with Massey Plumbing, a company which was highly recommended to us by a neighbor. Owner Mike Massey returned my call almost immediately, and we discussed several projects that I needed him to take care of, including a new water heater. He set up a date quickly, gave me a very fair and realistic estimate, and answered all of my questions. The tech who did the work was professional, on time, knowledgeable, courteous and experienced. Mike Massey followed up with me later. I was impressed and pleased to have found a plumber who is honest, and doesn’t try to upsell me on needless stuff. Integrity counts, and Massey has it.

reviews.author: Jen Watkins
reviews.text: Massey Plumbing is always thorough and professional. We’ve used them several times and will continue to do business with them.

plumbers.name: Tipton's Plumbing & Sewer
plumbers.address: 504 Rock Pl, Oklahoma City, OK 73160, USA

reviews.author: Beth Nixon
reviews.text: Was dealing with an underground leak and had already gone through two different plumbers that kept stalling.  Called Tipton's on the recommendation of an employee and they came within an hour.  Did the work and charged a good price.  Will definitely use them in the future for work and home.  They were wonderful.

reviews.author: Donald Madewell
reviews.text: I have used them several times... Never have been disappointed.. Prices are decent and there is no added cost after the job is done..  I believe they are fair and honest .. If you need a great plumber call them..

reviews.author: Amanda MacGhee
reviews.text:
My husband hired this company to fix our water heater. They came out for a $65 service charge and told us our total for parts and labor would be $853. When my husband called to ask that the bill be itemized the owner was difficult and explained they charge a “flat fee” separate from the service charge. Upon deducting parts we were charged $713 over the service fee for an hour long job! In response to my husband’s questions he began belittling his military service saying that my husband surely knew what it is like to lie and steal from people because he had been in the service. I’m appalled by both the price and his opinion of veterans. This job was completed during normal weekday business hours as well.

Re: our bill was not itemized at the time of service or when the contract was signed. We feel that the technician deceptively implied that most of the $853 was for parts. I don’t believe for a second that my husband would use foul language speaking to someone about business over the phone.

reviews.author: lisad62002
reviews.text: Tipton Plumbing responded quickly on a holiday and sent someone out that same day. After finding the problem they returned early the next day & took care of the leak. Awesome professional service, our plumber Lewis did a great job. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Extricated Ray
reviews.text: I installed a new sink to upgrade our shallow one. Got everything installed and discovered I needed to reconfigure the drain lines. Called Tipton’s and they had somebody out sooner than the timeframe we discussed, which was awesome. Lewis got everything taken care of in a timely manner and the quality was superb. I am very happy with the outcome and the fair pricing!!

plumbers.name: All American Drain Cleaning, Llc
plumbers.address: 6920 S Jordan Rd N, Centennial, CO 80112, USA

reviews.author: Callie Withers
reviews.text: Best place. Tyler and his Dad came out (free of charge!) to give us a second quote on our sewage system repair (we were told it needed to be repaired by Roter Rooter after a cleaning). They brought their camera to see our pipes and said that there’s no way we need to pay Roter Rooter 10k for new pipes. These guys are insanely kind and honest. Will use them moving forward for sure. Such a blessing, thank you!

reviews.author: Jeremy
reviews.text: I requested a quote but they completed the work before disclosing the price. The final charge was significantly higher than other companies' quotes. Plus, they were quite pushy about adding extra services, it felt kinda shady. They did the job right tho

reviews.author: Nate Anderson
reviews.text: After dealing with frustration from several other plumbing companies, Dan took the time to truly listen to the problem we were facing. He explained the solution clearly, fixed the issue quickly, and charged a fair price. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.text: They did an absolutely amazing job on the drain blockage in my house. Dan and Anthony were both super friendly and upfront with me about everything, and the prices were way more fair than previous plumbers I used. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Spirit Unique
reviews.text:
I've used All American Drain for the past few years now and Emilio has become like family. He has repaired multiple leaks, mold discovery, my garbage disposal, and replaced a toilet. He is super knowledgeable, very respectful, and just an all around super guy. He is my go to for all plumbing!! They are very budget friendly and provide superior services.
Also a big thank you to scheduling who gets us in ASAP on more pressing issues. You Guys ROCK!!!

plumbers.name: Keemer Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2964 W 4700 S #108, Taylorsville, UT 84129, USA

reviews.author: Shane Franz
reviews.text:
Just wanted to say I had some great service from Derek today. Thanks a million.

Also Jeremy has been great. Highly recommended. Conscientious. Detailed. In a world full of hacks I appreciate the quality.

reviews.author: Jennifer McLaurin
reviews.text: 10/10. called on Monday, Derek and Jeremy came to take a look on Tuesday (today) gave me quotes for 2 options. Offered same day or scheduling a time to come back. I chose same day. They fixed the plumbing between my artesian well and sprinkler manifold quickly! They were professional, kind, friendly. As a DIY nerd, i apologized for being "that homeowner" and watching the repair. But they didn't mind that i was curious about how they would solve the problem. Great guys who did great work and gave me some helpful advice.

reviews.author: Melissa Francis
reviews.text: John and his crew were all wonderful. Everyone was so polite and efficient. They left our house clean and organized. We feel like we have a new house with the new pipes, fixtures and water heater they installed. The cost was very reasonable. We totally recommend Keemer Plumbing to anyone!

reviews.author: Taylor Thurman
reviews.text:
Quality work, integrity, and customer service!

In 2020, I had just bought my home when my water main burst. At this time, it felt scary to find a plumber and hope I could trust them with my first major job. Keemer Plumbing was both responsive and quick. The repairs were fairly painless as they made sure my water was reconnected quickly. During this visit, they were also thoughtful as they noticed that I did not yet have a sprinkler system. They offered to add a stop and waste valve for a small amount while everything was already dug up. It probably saved me $1000 down the road!

Fast forward 5 years, I was finally ready to tackle a sprinkler install. However, when I dug up the valve I realized it wasn’t draining as expected. I called Keemer but did not expect them to even remember me.

Tricia was awesome. She said “we hope to keep our customers for life” and sent out the same guy who had done the install. Not only did he remember me but he also realized the part was not correct due to shortages during Covid. Within two days, they swapped out the right part! It will be easy for me to call Keemer again for any future jobs.

reviews.author: Eddie Garcia
reviews.text: Jeremy, Tricia, and BJ are amazing to work with!  They were on time and detailed on their quote, delivered exceptional service, and took care of our plumbing needs super quick. Other quotes were coming in less yet I chose Keemer’s as my gut told me that they would deliver better quality work than their competitors and I was right!  Hands down best plumbing experience I’ve had in a long time! Keep up the pro work!

plumbers.name: R&L Plumbers
plumbers.address: 39730 Alston Ave Suite 39036, Zephyrhills, FL 33542, USA

reviews.author: B Kemp
reviews.text: this plumbing company is truly the best i've worked with. they responded really fast and were able to come out the same day. the work was done well, and the plumbers were professional, respectful, and friendly. after finishing, they made sure everything was cleaned up perfectly, just like how they did the repairs. i want to mention two of their workers for their great service. brett replaced my water heater and took care of all the latest requirements, even helping me find an electrician for the electrical part. the new water heater is more efficient, so it should help lower my bills. brett also came back another day to fix a leaking toilet. he figured out the problem quickly, explained everything, and answered all my questions so i could make good decisions to avoid future issues. the toilet is now fixed, and he finished the job fast because he clearly knows what he's doing. ian helped with replacing my kitchen faucet and other related parts that needed attention. he looked over everything first, explained my options, and made sure i understood how to use the new shut-off valves, which makes things much easier for me. all the work was done really well, and i appreciated how carefully he cleaned up afterward. overall, i'm very happy with the service and would recommend this plumbing company to anyone needing reliable and efficient work.

reviews.author: Julianna Ayers
reviews.text: when i noticed a small leak in my water heater, i called the plumber and they got back to me really fast, within an hour. they let me know brett would arrive soon to take a look, which was a nice surprise since i expected to wait much longer. brett arrived as promised, inspected the water heater, and said he'd be back shortly with a replacement. he returned quickly and got everything set up with no hassle. years ago, this plumbing company also installed my water heater and have always come out on time for service or repairs. they're always friendly, professional, and happy to answer all my questions about keeping my plumbing in good shape. excellent service every time!

reviews.author: R Zavala
reviews.text: i called R&L Plumbers because i had a shower leak in my second bathroom. my first experience wasn’t the best, but after sharing my concerns, they took care of it right away. i spoke with a project manager who listened to what happened and sent out another plumber, brett, to help. brett checked out my shower stems and valve and thought at first i might need a full valve replacement, which can be a big job. instead, brett tried to find the right knobs to fit the stems already installed, so i wouldn’t have to spend more money on a new valve. he found the right parts and explained the costs clearly, plus told me when he’d get the parts and finish the job. brett fixed my leaky shower faucet without a full replacement, saving me time and money. he was honest, fast, and made sure everything worked right before leaving. it really showed me that one bad experience with a plumber doesn’t mean the whole company is bad. if you ever have issues, just tell them and give them a chance to fix it. i’ve used this company before for a toilet repair, and that plumber did a great job too. brett proved there are still good plumbers who care about their customers. i appreciate the way they handled things and made sure i was happy with the repair. if you need plumbing work done, i recommend them—they really go the extra mile.

reviews.author: Lauren Dougherty
reviews.text: brett came out today and did a fantastic job. he knew just what needed to be done and quickly fixed my plumbing problems. brett also shared helpful advice about remodeling and replacing the sink and toilet in my bathroom. he answered all my questions and took extra time to check out some other small issues around the house. i really appreciate his expertise and attention to detail. all the little tips he gave me will help keep my plumbing in good shape. the office staff was also very friendly and supportive. i'll definitely call them again for any future plumbing work!

reviews.author: Asher Rivers
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with this plumbing company. Their rates were better than any other local plumbers we found, especially for septic tank work. Our plumber, Brett, went above and beyond—he worked hard to dig up the septic tank and made sure it was drained completely, checking everything carefully so there wouldn't be any issues later on. A lot of other plumbing companies just pump out the tank quickly and leave, but here they really took their time to do the job right. With someone like Brett on the team, I feel confident trusting them to handle all our plumbing and septic needs, even for my parents when I can't be there myself. We're very happy and definitely recommend them!

plumbers.name: Pipe Spy
plumbers.address: 1108 26th St, Oakland, CA 94607, USA

reviews.author: Maruthi Nuthikattu
reviews.text:
We recently bought a home in Oakland that required a PSL test. Since the property is part of a private development with no HOA, things quickly became complicated. The testing involved not only our section of the line but also a shared pipeline used by seven other homeowners in the community. Coordinating this required collaboration between the City of Oakland and EBMUD.

To make matters more challenging, the PSL contractor hired by the seller’s agent backed out after two weeks for reasons beyond our control. That’s when I reached out to Alex at PipeSpy. He listened patiently and immediately took action. The very next day, James visited the property to conduct an initial assessment. They clearly explained the entire process—outlining both the best- and worst-case scenarios—so we knew exactly what to expect.

They also provided the necessary documentation to collect our neighbors’ signatures for testing the shared pipeline and guided us through the timeline and escrow options. Their communication and professionalism gave us the confidence to move forward with closing the property.

PipeSpy completed the work exactly within the estimated timeline, and everything went smoothly. Thank you, James, Alex, and the entire PipeSpy team—you turned a stressful situation into a positive experience!

reviews.author: Imie Lam
reviews.text: James Hall-Gallagher and his team did an excellent job on our sewer lateral project, and I am extremely pleased with the outcome. While the work required some trenching, the area was restored so perfectly it looked completely untouched. The team was highly professional and honest. For instance, one of the supervisors not only fixed the immediate issue but also pointed out an additional leak. He repaired one pipe and advised me to address the other to prevent further basement damage. The project was completed in the timely manner they promised. I was very impressed with their workmanship and integrity and would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Tina Kreitz
reviews.text:
The team is professional, communicates clearly and often about what is happening.
They clean up any mess each day, leaving the house clean and accessible.  They delt with our city required sewer lateral on our 130 year old house and were aware of all possible issues. They did a terrific job even completing designs in the new cement to match our stamped cement.  Amazing!

reviews.author: Tim Kim Ware
reviews.text: The Pipe Spy people did a great job in bringing our drainage system into the 21st-century. And it was a big job because we live on a hillside and had to run a very long replacement pipe to connect with the mains. The Pipe Spy folks worked quickly and thoroughly and hopefully I’ll never have to contact them again :) The project manager James was great, friendly and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Faye Keogh
reviews.text:
I've used Pipe Spy  for 30+ years as a real estate professional
They know what they're doing, always do a great job,
Friendly and easy to worth with.
In my opinion, the best in the business!

plumbers.name: Cherokee Plumbing Heat and Air LLC
plumbers.address: 13766 N Lincoln Blvd, Edmond, OK 73013, USA

reviews.author: Benny Chance
reviews.text: Great service and great help with everything. Ty and Rudy were fantastic. They were able to diagnose the issue and help explain to me what was going on. They made sure that everything was working and in good condition before leaving. Very exceptional service and will definitely be using again if I ever have any other issues.

reviews.author: Stacey Riffell
reviews.text: We have had Cherokee Plumbing out twice within the past week.  Once for some burst pipes at our business, and today for a broken and leaking hot water heater at our home.   In both instances they arrived quickly and were able to get things replaced and running again at a reasonable price.  We had two different tech teams for each visit and both were great!  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Stepp
reviews.text: Rudy and Ty were quick to provide a quote and even completed the plumbing job the same day! They were efficient with time and reasonably priced + offer a membership to help with the cost of future plumbing maintenance/repairs. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Chambers Clark
reviews.text: Cherokee Plumbing did an excellent job with our plumbing needs. They were professional, on time, and communicated clearly throughout the entire process. reviews.author: Kaitlyn Lucas
reviews.text: I did not have a good experience with this company. Put in a ticket with my home warranty company and they assigned Mayes to come out to my home due to a clog. The first technician showed up on Friday (2/6/26) and found that there was not an adequate clean out in my house and advised I reach out to city sewer to find the one outside. However, this is not my issue with the company or this technician. While the technician was in my home he seemed to take offence that there was a hose going from my sink next to my washer into the floor/sewer in my basement. He proceeded to rip this hose out of the floor and just left the hole open to the sewer. Unfortunately, I was in meetings the rest of the day and did not realize he did this until well after he left and the company was closed for the day. The city sewer showed up that evening and in the process of them attempting to find/clear the clog issue I had sewage back up through this hole that the first technician left causing damage to rugs, carpeting, and untold number of towels that all had to be thrown out. I called Mayes the next morning (Saturday 2/7/26) and requested they send someone out that day to at least fix this hole and potentially fix the clog I still had. I spoke to three people that day and all seemed pretty surprised that the first tech left my home the way he did and that he would just rip this hose out of the ground. The company only gets 2 stars purely for the second tech. He spent 40 minutes trying to snake the clog before realizing that it needed to be flushed. This was an extra charge which I unfortunately had no choice but to pay. I am incredibly frustrated that at no point did anyone from Mayes apologize or offer any sort of compensation for the damage their tech caused while he was in my home. The first tech needs to be retrained before he is allowed into someone else's home.

reviews.author: Anna Ryzhkova
reviews.text:
We've been using Miracle Plumbing for years, and at first everything was solid and we continued coming back to them. They are a bit pricey, but we thought we were paying for quality. However, things have changed for us in the recent years.

We had a problem with a downstairs toilet where there was a slow leak and water damaged wood around the toilet. MP came and replaced the wax ring, spilling the water all over our wooden floors in the process (this wax ring has been replaced by a few other plumbers before and everything remained dry). It took me hours to clean the floor and even walls after that. They've acknowledged it and even brought over water remediation company that did some treatment (no issues here). However, the leak came back and we called MP again. At this point they recommended that we replace a pipe under the toilet. It was expensive, but we agreed. Pipe was replaced and the toilet installed again. Not much time passes and we see discoloration on the wood floor again indicating a leak. We called them and were told that we are seeing things, this is old discoloration and there is no leak. Discoloration persisted and at some point we saw actual water coming through, but made a mistake of not making a video of it. We called MP again, they came out and told us again that there is no leak and promised that a supervisor will call (still waiting). We saw water again after this (this time we made a video) and just decided to replace the toilet and called a different plumber. When the toilet was removed, we saw that the pipe that was installed by MP is uneven with the floor, one edge sticks above the floor and the other edge is below the floor (photo attached). It is obvious that when the toilet sits on an uneven pipe like this, there will be leaks no matter the wax ring, the toilet was not even stable, you could shake it because of the angle of the pipe to which it is attached. The other plumber brought a level to further demonstrate how uneven it is. Moral of the story is that not only did they make us feel like complete lunatics for "seeing" water, but in the end they did not even do a quality job for which we paid over $1,000. In the end we are out of the money we spent on this pipe replacement and now have to pay someone else do it again to fix the issue with the poor installation, and MP did not offer us to correct it or issue any form of refund (we've informed them of the issue).

The above incident is the one that stands out to me, but in the last few years, we've had complaints about pretty much all of their visits (unfortunately, plumbing issues happen a lot in our old house), from leaving absolute mess to recommending costly replacements of equipment when all that was required is to flip a part that was installed incorrectly (not by them to be fair).

All in all, I would not recommend MP to anyone based on our collective experiences.

reviews.author: Mike Gould
reviews.text:
My 20-year old heat pump catastrophically failed on a Friday night at 6PM when it was 20 degrees out. Within 90 minutes, a young man named Jacob was at my house diagnosing the problem and explaining the details of the issue to the level I requested (which was thorough). He was incredibly friendly and patient, and walked me through all of the options for both repair and replacement. I opted for replacement.

On Tuesday, Steven and John showed up at 8:30AM with my new heat pump and furnace, only to find out that my hot water heater had blown out overnight, drenching my basement. Not only were they easily able to work around that, but they were also able to get me a new hot water heater and tank to install the same day. Steven followed up later that evening and fixed a thermostat issue that was keeping the new system from working, and he and John came back Wednesday to finish some auxiliary installation stuff.

Steven and John were both exceptionally friendly and clean and polite and professional. The installations are flawless and look better than they did before. I have absolutely zero complaints and nothing but compliments for the both of them. Even the ladies who do scheduling and customer service were great (Skylar was the one I interacted with most).

I gave three stars for cost because this was incredibly expensive and, I assume, the industry average. I didn't have the luxury of shopping around because I didn't want my family to freeze, so I went with what was available at the time. I'm not sure how most people would be able to afford these repairs, if I'm being honest. None of this, however, is any fault of the men and women with whom I interacted, and everything I purchased is working flawlessly.

reviews.author: Loren Ventura
reviews.text:
Burtech Plumbing came out right before Thanksgiving for what we thought was a small leak. They were efficient and worked quickly. While the leak itself wasn’t a big issue, once the ceiling was opened we discovered that all of our copper pipes were badly corroded. They recommended a full repipe of our home.

We have a 4,000 square foot house, so this was a huge project. I got multiple quotes, and Burtech landed right in the middle price-wise. What really stood out to me was how willing they were to work with my specific requests. I had major stipulations, especially that they complete the repipe without visually accessing our kitchen, and they made it happen.

They worked with our timeline, and Jose was incredibly communicative throughout the entire process. I’ll admit I was a bit needy with questions, but he was always patient, understanding, and responsive.

The estimate they gave us was exactly what we paid in the end with no surprise costs at all. The repipe itself was major (60+ holes throughout the house), but they worked so efficiently that it never felt overly intrusive. They were very clean, vacuumed and cleaned up every day, and truly respected our home. We have two young kids who nap, and they even worked around nap schedules so they weren’t in certain rooms during that time.

Overall, I’m extremely impressed with Burtech Plumbing. I’ve already recommended them and will continue to do so without hesitation.

reviews.author: Christian Gallagher
reviews.text:
This review is about 10 days overdue, but I would be remiss if I didn't take the time to write about the exceptional service, care, and courtesy that I have received from Burtech Plumbing during 3 different encounters that included pressure regulator installation, mainline repair and locating (Bill is a wizard at finding a hidden mainline), and installation of plumbing in the front yard.

For the most recent experience, I was provided service by Jaime, who spent a considerable amount of time locating a rather tricky mainline in the front yard at an old home that I recently purchased, and instead of giving in (which many would have) after digging a fairly long trench, he instead went with an experiential instinct to successfully locate the mainline needed to create a T line that would ultimately allow for a hose bib to be placed in my front yard in preparation for future landscaping projects. Not having a hose bib in the front yard, I had to run 100 feet of hose around the house from back to front in order to just water the plants and hose off the deck. Because of Jaime's diligence, expertise, and effort, my life has been made exponentially easier in having hose/plumbing access in the front yard. To top it all off, Jaime ensured that my previous irrigation system mainline was properly capped off and deactivated so that no leaks would occur during the artificial turf installation, which was highly appreciated. And the best part of it all, Jaime was courteous, communicative, and informative in walking me through the process. The final piece that day was the installation of a water conditioner at a great value. Happy to now have my appliances and pipes protective from corrosive mineral deposits.

In summary, I would highly recommend Burtech Plumbing to folks living in the San Diego area, and I plan to remain a loyal customer with the level of courtesy and care that I have received. They are experts at their craft and care about their customers. Thank you so much to Bill and his team. You all are fantastic!

reviews.text: Jesse is super friendly and helpful. We’ve called him twice now — once for a water softener replacement and again for an emergency service right after Thanksgiving. He was prompt both times and clearly explained every step of the process. If you need a reliable plumber, he’s the one to call!

reviews.author: scott lopez
reviews.text: Jesse did an amazing job. I called him because my septic pump in the basement was backing up and he was very willing to talk to me about my problem and help diagnose the issue.  He showed up promptly. He was able to fix everything and get us up and running again. We are very appreciative of everything he did. He didn't take advantage of us and his pricing was very fair. Thanks again Jesse!

plumbers.name: Gregory's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 322 E Main St #4600, Batavia, OH 45103, USA

reviews.author: Shelley Summers
reviews.text: Jacob is hands down the best plumber I have ever worked with! He installed a new whole house water filtration system and softener for us, and the quality of the installation was top-notch—everything looked neat and professional. I’ve lived in different places with similar systems, and this was by far the best plumbing job I’ve seen. Jacob also replaced our kitchen water filter, serviced our on-demand water heater, and took the time to teach us about all the plumbing features in our new Batavia home, without charging extra for his advice. I am extremely impressed and truly grateful for such excellent service from Gregory's Plumbing.

reviews.author: Tanya Bullock
reviews.text: The plumber was able to schedule my appointment quickly and showed up on time. Donovan came out to replace my old shower valve and ended up updating all the pipes leading to the shower head as well. He made sure everything was nice and secure, so nothing wobbles anymore. Since my house is pretty old, he even raised the shower head to a more comfortable height. The work was done really well and didn’t take long at all. The price matched what I expected, with no hidden costs or surprises. Overall, I’m happy with the service and would recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work.

reviews.author: lydia chavez
reviews.text: I'm really glad I went with my gut and chose Gregory's Plumbing for my plumbing needs. When I called, the office staff was friendly and respectful, picking up right away and making me feel comfortable. Even though my issue wasn't an emergency, they were able to schedule an appointment quickly—just two days later. I appreciated getting a confirmation call when the plumber was on the way, so I knew exactly when to expect them. Jacob was the plumber who came out, and he was fantastic. He had a great sense of humor, which made the whole experience easier, and he knew exactly how to fix my slow-draining sinks. Everything was explained clearly, with upfront estimates and honest communication about what to expect. If you're looking for a reliable plumber who does quality work and treats you right, I highly recommend reaching out to this company.

reviews.author: Clara Kirk
reviews.text: We woke up to find our basement flooded because our water heater had cracked overnight. We called a local plumbing company right away, and they responded quickly and acted very professionally. Donovan came out to inspect the water heater, explained everything clearly, and gave us a fair price for the replacement. He was friendly and made us feel comfortable throughout the whole process. Jacob, who was helping him, was also very polite and respectful when he introduced himself. Both of them took great care to protect our home while working. We were so glad to have hot water restored the same day. We will definitely call this plumbing team again if we need help in the future.

reviews.author: Veronica F
reviews.text: Gregory's Plumbing provided top-notch service when I needed several plumbing updates after moving into my new home in Batavia. I reached out based on their great reviews, and I’m glad I did. Jacob and Donovan came out to help finish a plumbing project I had started myself but ran into trouble with. They showed up right on time, which I really appreciated. Both Jacob and Donovan were very friendly and took the time to explain each step of the work so I understood what was happening. They replaced my kitchen sink, installed new shutoff valves, hooked up the dishwasher, and swapped out my garbage disposal. They also took care of the shutoff valves for both toilets and even fixed a small leak on the main water line. Everything was completed quickly and looked perfect when they finished. The price for all the work was fair, and I felt like I was getting honest advice the whole time. Later, I scheduled another appointment because I was having issues with my hot water tank. Jacob said he’d try to repair it first to save me money. When the water heater suddenly failed and started leaking everywhere, I called for help right away. The office was very understanding about the emergency and had Jacob and Donovan at my house with a new tank in less than half an hour. Once again, the work was done fast and professionally. I highly recommend them for any plumbing needs in Batavia. The prices are reasonable, the plumbers are trustworthy, and they don’t try to upsell you on things you don’t need. Overall, I am very happy with the service and the results!

plumbers.name: Abend Services
plumbers.address: 407 Bon Air Ave, Baltimore, MD 21225, USA

reviews.author: Audra Russell (Audra)
reviews.text:
I had a slow leak in my toilet that was starting to come through the kitchen ceiling—stressful to say the least! I called Abend Services and they came out the very next day. From start to finish, the experience was fantastic. Communication was clear and timely, and the technician was friendly, professional, and took the time to thoroughly explain the issue and how it would be fixed. They diagnosed the problem quickly and were completely transparent throughout the process. I truly appreciate the excellent service and peace of mind. Highly recommend!

EDITED TO ADD: they saved the day again. Our house was built in 1954, so there are bound to be things that come up. I woke up to water coming from under my stove. Called Abend at 4:37 AM and Katie answered. Richie and Mike were here a few hours later. Showed me what needed to be done and what the price would be before they started and they were done within an hour.

Abend is definitely on speed dial for this old home!

reviews.author: Margaret Henn
reviews.text: They were quick to respond and the technician was very nice.  However, they were unable to clear the clog in the sewer line.  I understood that, but they never followed up and 2 emails were sent.  They only responded to 1 of the email, otherwise they ghosted us.  We hired another local plumber who did the work needed to repair the sewer line.

reviews.author: Brenda Witten
reviews.text: We were very pleased with Richard Koontz. He was very professional and knowledgeable. Everyone at ABend is very easy to talk with and seems willing to help.

reviews.author: Philip Whitebloom
reviews.text: See the pictures below. Upon discovering that my water heater burst, I immediately called ABEND Services (5:30AM) because of my prior positive experiences with them. They answered the phone and had a technician out to my home before 8:30AM. They sized up the problem and went into action. They were meticulous in making sure all details were being addressed. Especially getting the new water heater down the stairs and they old one back up the stairs with no damage to my property. You can see in the pictures the installation very well done. They cleaned up afterwards. It was like they were never here. Don't skimp on what's important. Call the best. I did.

reviews.author: Benita Murphy
reviews.text: I had a leak coming from my toilet and of course, I called Abend Plumbing. When I tell you this is the most professional, knowledgeable and courteous company. I can go on and on. Richard Koontz was the plumber they sent out. He arrived on time. He put his shoe covers on fixed the leak. But then he found another leak that I needed to take care of but I wasn't prepared financially. When I tell you, he showed so much empathy and professionalism. Before leaving he cleaned up and vacuumed. I mean, this guy was the best. Thumbs up all the way for Abend Plumbing.

plumbers.name: Accurate Air Solutions, LLC
plumbers.address: 6737 E Hwy 80, Abilene, TX 79601, USA

reviews.author: Jennifer Rogers
reviews.text: My pipes froze from this last storm and I had Accurate Air Plumbing came out to fix it.  Thank you Jay S and Dillon F for their awesome service! They showed up  quickly and immediately got to work fixing it. They actually took the time to talk to me and explain what the problem was, how they were fixing it and what I can do to prevent it from happening again. Most services come in, do whatever and want their money.  NOT THESE GUYS! They were so polite and even offered to take off their boots so they didn't track snow and mud through my home. AND, they did not drain my bank account! I want them to know how much I truly appreciate everything they did. If you want service where someone comes into your home and treats you like a human being and not just money in their pockets, I promise you will truly appreciate and actually enjoy Accurate Air Plumbing come to your home. Thank you from the bottom of my heart and keep up the awesome work!

reviews.author: Becca Coleman

After scheduling and coordinating with Walter, he promptly sent out Duran and Trey, and they were absolutely AMAZING. They carefully cautioned off the area until work could resume and restored the site as if it had never been touched. This is truly a remarkable team, and I would HIGHLY recommend Duran and Trey for ANY job and will definitely be using Accurate Air again in the future.

reviews.author: Donna Mcadams
reviews.text:

Their pricing is fair, and they’ve earned our trust—this is the only plumbing company we work with.

reviews.author: Jason Skinner

He did not pressure me at all, did not hurry me and did not try to guide me into a needless purchase.  he was honest and went above and beyond when checking to make sure everything is perfect with my system.  Great tech, keep him on your staff at all costs!!!!!

reviews.author: Stephen Capler
reviews.text: Came out late on a Sunday night, I had a leaky water heater, he replaced the whole thing same day, was quick and was honest and direct on his quote. Did great work and my family was back taking hot showers. They did a great job. Appreciate you for all your help

There’s never been a surprise with the costs of his services and he clearly communicates them.

I highly recommend H.C. Edwards Plumbing Company.

reviews.author: Josh Cole
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a plumber in the Dallas area, let me save you the time and effort of finding the right man for the job. Jason, with H.C. Edwards Plumbing is incredible. He was thorough, no BS and all around stellar at his job. The difference in pricing from other services I had looked into was night and day— let alone the quality of service.

I made the mistake of reaching out to corporate owned plumbing services. They came to my house and told me that on top of clearing my pipes, I needed double clean outs installed. The price I was quoted was unbelievably off-putting— hence why I decided to shop around.

I reached out to Jason and explained the issues we were having and what the plumbers had told me. He quotes me for the same services for less than half the price. Jason comes to my house, identifies that we do in fact have double clean outs installed, then proceeds to clear the blockage in the pipes in a timely and efficient manner.

He truly went above and beyond to make sure the issue was resolved on all fronts— no cut corners.

Save your time and money and utilize this amazing family operated plumbing business. I cannot tell you the relief I feel after having him come by.

reviews.author: Sherri Brown
reviews.text: We needed emergency pipe repair due to a leak under our bathroom sink and Jason saved the day. He arrived 20 minutes after our call, quickly assessed the situation and got right to work. He was very professional, experienced, and expeditious. Thank you so much H.C Edwards Plumbing!

reviews.author: D T

reviews.author: Diane Emmrich

We now have a clear lines and a much better understanding of our plumbing if future problems arise.  Everyone was very professional and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: TG Throwaway
reviews.text: Ron H fixed my clogged drain and was very helpful and courteous. He took the time to explain how he was going to fix the problem, and how I could avoid similar issues in the future. I made the appointment at 7:30 am and my drain was fixed by 12:30.

plumbers.name: Jack L Woods Plumbing Co Inc

reviews.author: Robert Ramsey
reviews.text: First off, let me state that my Father was a plumber with his own business out on the West Side of Columbus in the Brookshire Addition. My Dad always gave 100%, his work was the very best, and his standards were stellar, as many of his former customers would attest. So, when i see or need plumbing work done, I definitely know what to expect in quality and fair pricing! Today, we had a current waterline leak in the basement repaired; fifty-six-year-old copper plumbing needs tender care and maintenance, you know. Experiencing a couple of pinhole leaks in our water supply, we called upon Jack L. Woods Plumbing Company, Incorporated located in Westerville to take care of the situation. Previously, they expertly installed a new water heater in our basement which has been totally dependable since installation a few years back. Our repairman, Barry, was professional, on time, and did a superb repair to remedy our current situation. In addition, he repositioned a current shut-off valve close to the main shut-off valve, to make certain we have a complete shutdown of water  in case of future plumbing needs. I cannot recommend this thirty-five-year-old company enough! They give the very best in service for your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Amanda Grissinger
reviews.text: Larry should be fired or not allowed to answer the phones. Rude, impatient, condescending, and just plain heartless. He actually made me cry he was so difficult to talk to. Don't have someone who has shitty people skills talking to customers. Also why do I have to give you my address, phone number, email and name after you were already at my house and did work? Does your company not own a computer? You can't pull up a previous job using one of those pieces of information? I don't understand why I had to repeat all this information again just to have you come back to do more work. Especially after I never received an invoice for the initial service I received a few days prior. How did you expect to get paid if I hadn't called back? Now the guy who did the work at my house was fantastic, which is why I left 3 stars instead of 1. I think his name was Dave but I'm positive. He was not only kind and professional, but he fixed our problem in just a few hours and did an amazing job. He was very knowledgeable and experienced and we had confidence we were in good hands with him.

reviews.author: Charlotte Hyland
reviews.text: Matt did a great job, right on time and let me know when he was on his way. Nice guy, got my drain cleared out and left the area cleaner than when he got there! Definitely recommend Jack Woods Plumbing!

reviews.author: Michael Chambers
reviews.text: They sent Dusty out to take care of a couple plumbing issues I had. He did a fantastic job and was very efficient time wise. Very happy with the service!

reviews.author: Jeremy Glotz
reviews.text: If you want them to catch your house on fire and turn your life upside down then call them, otherwise stay away from these people.  No accountability for what they did either to our lives and 6 months of you know what to get our life back.  Negligence was involved with someone you sent that should have had a mentor.  Ironically he had a mentor on another job the days following our house fire caused by him.  This is the work you get with Jack Woods on a simple spigot repair.  They don’t even deserve a 1 star, but at least people in our neighborhood know not to call them again and have made sure of that.

We would absolutely have him return for future projects!

reviews.author: Deborah Price
reviews.text: Oh my goodness! I am so grateful for AA Plumbing. I had a difficult toilet install on my basement level. . The technicians cleaned up once they were  finished. I  really appreciated the technician providing me a hands on walkthrough inspection of the work done with clarity and to my understanding. I would definitely recommend AA Plumbing to anyone who wants a residential or commercial project. Completed.

reviews.author: Ellie Nelson
reviews.text:
Cannot say enough great things about David & his team. We were out of our house for 2.5 months while we had extensive repair/renovations going on. Once we came back, we started having major plumbing issues only to find out we needed our entire main sewage line replaced (50+ years old) as well as our main plumbing in our basement (existing was back pitched).

David and Sean did a phenomenal job explaining everything to us, coming up with a solution that was better than we expected, and quoted us reasonably for the work being done. They were able to complete the job in a day, left our property looking like nothing ever happened, and made us feel taken care of throughout the entire process.

They’re knowledgeable and passionate about what they do. They will be the only plumbers we call moving forward. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tina
reviews.text: David and his crew are top-notch. They came fast in an emergency and they got the job done no matter how long it took.  They are pleasant efficient, and go above and beyond always. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Tim Bellante
reviews.text:
I can't say enough great things about the service we received from David and Dan! From start to finish, they were professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly thorough in fixing our plumbing issues.

They replaced our pressure regulator with a high-quality dual-chamber brass model, ensuring that our home's water pressure is set within a safe range. They took the time to explain everything and made sure the installation was done with precision and care. Knowing that this upgrade protects our faucets, toilets, and appliances from potential damage gives us great peace of mind.

In addition, they quickly diagnosed and repaired a pinhole leak in our main-level bathroom ceiling. The leak was coming from a 3/4” PEX A waterline, and they expertly cut out the damaged section and made a seamless repair. Their efficiency and skill prevented what could have turned into a much bigger problem!

Lastly, they also replaced our thermal expansion tank, which had failed and was full of water. They didn’t charge us for this replacement, which was an unexpected but much-appreciated bonus!

The quality of their work, the high-grade materials they used, and the 1-year warranty they provided on their repairs truly set them apart. If you're looking for honest, skilled plumbers who take pride in their work, look no further than David and Dan. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Aleena Akbar
reviews.text: Truly professional. David took the time to explain what was causing my plumbing issues. I look forward to working with him for all future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Brian Taylor
reviews.text: I highly recommend ABREEZE for anyone looking for a dependable and honest plumber. David and his team are top notch!

reviews.author: Martha McCain
reviews.text: I had given a call to D R Plumbing because the water faucet in the front of the house would not Turn off. I had someone disengage the water hose and the water was just pouring out. I just absolutely could not get the water to stop. So I looked up plumbers on Google and DR plumbing was the first one I came to. I contacted Josh and he advised it would be today before someone could get to the house. He also advised me that it would cost a certain amount of money and I asked if he would work with me on the cost and he said he would. They finished the work and he had decided out of the graciousness of his heart, that he was not going to charge me for the work done on the water faucet. My mother had just fallen and broke her hip on Tuesday evening, and I was a little out of sorts with everything and my mom and I don’t have a lot of free money laying around but with the water pouring out, it was absolutely necessary that we get this fixed. Today he sent me a text saying that the work had been completed and that he wasn’t going to charge me because we had so much on our plate. reviews.author: Todd Bull
reviews.text: Steven Campbell from JR Putnam came to our house as part of the club membership we belong to where we pay $14.95 each month for maintenance. We've always utilized JR Putman for the biannual air-conditioning and furnace maintenance check-up program ever since they put the system in 13 years ago. Earlier this week we had some clogging issues in the main drain. Steven came in and through a series of skilled steps he diagnosed we had a clog near the street, but unfortunately still on our property. He found the clean out trap near the street, but it only provided access from the trap to the street not from the trap to the house. Tomorrow we'll have the JR Putman team dig out the clogged portion to determine what the issue is (we have some large trees in the area), fix it and install a new two way clean out trap so in the future we can access the main drain both ways. Steven even set us up with financing so we'll pay not interest if we pay off the note in a 24 month period. Every step of the way Steven kept us informed and showed us what his camera was seeing. It stinks we have a new $3200 debt to retire in 23 months, to avoid interest, but this system will be upgraded. We are not the first house on this block to experience a similar issue.  Steven Campbell is a real professional.

reviews.author: skylar ramos
reviews.text: Javier from Jake the Plumbing Pro did a fantastic job when my whole house was backed up in Dallas. I had already called another plumber before, but they couldn’t figure out where the main access line was. Javier used his plumbing know-how and found the right spot to dig by understanding how the pipes run from the crawlspace to the city line. He quickly located the main access, dug it up, and cleared the blockage. While working, Javier noticed the pipes under my house were sagging, which caused all the sewage to back up. He showed me the problem and explained that the pipes were being held by flimsy plastic straps. He spent hours under the crawlspace fixing the slope and replaced the old supports with sturdy metal straps, even giving me a 10-year warranty on the work! Javier went above and beyond by checking the rest of the house for any issues. He fixed my low water pressure for free, and also saw that my sink faucet had buildup, so he cleaned that out at no extra charge. He even raised my water temperature for free and made sure the sewage access lines are now easy to find in the future. I’m really impressed by his knowledge, fair pricing, and how much he cared about getting everything right. Definitely the best plumber I’ve worked with for quality, expertise, and kindness.

He fixed the issue with our tub faucet quickly and did a better job than I expected—the faucet works better now than before it broke. The service was fast, friendly, and honest, and the price was very reasonable. I’m really impressed and highly recommend them if you ever need a plumber.

reviews.author: Katherine Moss

Javier came out to check everything and quickly noticed that the shower drain hadn’t been hooked up right by the last contractor. He also pointed out a few other things that needed to be fixed to meet building codes. Javier and Luis helped us get everything scheduled fast, and took care of all the repairs we needed, not just the shower. They arrived on time and finished the job quickly, making sure everything was done right. The work was very professional, and now everything runs smoothly. We’re happy with how everything turned out and will definitely call on them again for any plumbing repairs or upgrades. Highly recommend for anyone needing a reliable plumber!

plumbers.name: Legacy 4, Inc.
plumbers.address: 2796 Broce Dr, Norman, OK 73072, USA

reviews.author: Victory Reneau Razavi
reviews.text: Legacy 4 Plumbing has absolutely outstanding customer service! From the first phone call to the final fix, they were professional, prompt, and incredibly courteous. They took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I was comfortable with the work being done. It's rare to find a company that truly cares about its customers the way they do. Highly recommend them for anyone looking for reliable and honest plumbing services!

reviews.author: Matthew Brason
reviews.text:
Legacy 4 Plumbing shows constant professionalism and provides timely work and transparency throughout their process.

Our company has multiple facilities always requesting work and every time I speak with the office, a technician arrives on site within 24 hours to assess and repair the issues!

Additionally, pricing is provided fairly, while receiving high quality work!

reviews.author: Leann Huntley
reviews.text: Legacy 4 Plumbing services several locations for the company that I work for, and they do a fantastic job. They are always quick to reply to my emails and phone calls. Top notch service!

reviews.author: Darla D
reviews.text: Shout out to all the good guys at Legacy. We not only had the plumbing side, but the HVAC side as well. They worked together, were professional, efficient, and nice. Thank you.

reviews.author: Michelle Gorum (CGC MCS)
reviews.text: We've been using Legacy 4 for our personal and commercial business for several years and couldn't be happier. We highly recommend them for any plumbing services you may need.

plumbers.address: 2660 Hennig Rd, Hampshire, IL 60140, USA

reviews.author: Linda Kleckner
reviews.text: Our water heater broke late in the day. Ron walked me through shutting off the gas and the water and then directed me on how to drain it before he got there. It minimized the damage and he was able to install a new water heater the next day. Ron is always quick to respond and offers great service at a fair price. We have been using his company for over 10 years for a reason. He and his company are terrific!

reviews.author: Dawn Nowakowski
reviews.text: If I could leave a review for more than 5 STARS I would. In all aspects of business this Company is top notch!! I will definitely be using Ron and Tristan again and again and most likely again! I'm new to the area, and I am so thankful for the referral I was given to use them for all my plumbing needs.How does one achieve and more importantly , Maintain a 5 star status? By excelling in every aspect of the plumbing business!

reviews.author: Anthony Cerrito
reviews.text: Ron responded quickly, was out fast & I didn't have to do a thing. He got me a better water heater for the same price installed as some cheap one I almost bought with half the warranty. He picked up the water heater for me, brought to me and took the old one away. Made it stupid simple for me & removed all the stress from the situation.

reviews.author: Petey Urukalo
reviews.text:
We had a plumbing issue with low water pressure and called A.C.T Plumbing and spoke with the owner Ron and he came out the next morning and got the kitchen sink that was clogged working again. It literally took him two minutes and the pressure was back good again and we were so excited. We asked Ron how much we owe him for his work and he said nothing. It only took a couple of minutes and he didn’t charge us for anything and in this day and age you don’t see that too often so kudos to Ron for being honest and willing to spend his time helping people he just met. We stored his number for future plumbing jobs and plan on passing along his information to anyone that needs a plumber. We Highly recommend Ron and A.C.T. Plumbing to everyone.
Thank you Ron for your Help!

reviews.author: Dolores Alex
reviews.text:
I called A.C.T because I had a problem with a brand new hose for my sump pump that wasn't connected right.

Water was shooting out from the base of the hose. I did ask my landscaper if he could install this brand new hose for me because i was in a pinch and he said yes.  He said he would charge me $60 for a very simple job.

However...i needed this done so i paid him $60 to do this. A couple days later when we had some bad rain i was outside and noticed the  hose was shooting out water of the base of the hose.  The same thing that happened to my old hose that i needed to replace with the new hose.The only difference was the old hose actually had a split in the hose (because it was old) so I needed to buy a new hose.

When A.C.T. came out he told me right away the landscaper didn't tighten the hose in a couple spots leaving water to shoot out from the base of the hose.

Prior to all this i did called the landscaper to tell him what happened he told me it wasn't an emergency and it could wait.  That didn't make me very happy because i paid him $60 to do the job right and when i told him what happened he didn't at all seem alarmed and couldn't be at my house for about 3 days. I was shocked.

Thats when i talked to my neighbor and they recommended A.C.T. and i can see why... he was excellent, and charge me a trip charge which I felt was very fair. He came out on a Sunday and he fixed the problem, and above all done it right the first time.

The purpose of this review is to solely let people know that there are good trusting, reputable companies that truly care about their customers.

A.C.T. the owner Ron did not hesitate to come to my aid to help me out
ASAP and fix the problem.

Easy fix...however, the problem was the landscaper he did not tighten the hoses.

Next time ill go with the professionals.

Thanks to Ron for all his help it meant the world to me.  Now I can sleep knowing the job was done right the first time.

plumbers.name: Pro Services Plumbing, Drains, Sewer Lining
plumbers.address: 318 N Lincolnway St, North Aurora, IL 60542, USA

reviews.author: mark gamble
reviews.text:
I can't say enough good things about Pat and Evan who are the owners of Pro Services! From start to finish, the experience was fantastic. They were incredibly fast and dependable, showing up right on time and getting the job done quickly without cutting any corners.

What really stood out was their honest and hard-working ethic. It was clear they weren't just trying to get the job done; they genuinely wanted to fix the issue the right way. They explained what was wrong, what the repair would involve, and gave me a fair price upfront. No surprises, no pressure, just clear communication and great work.

If you're looking for a plumber who is both skilled and trustworthy, look no further. I'll definitely be calling them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kenneth Simpson
reviews.text:
Called Pro Services to fix a toilet problem I had. After explaining it to Anthony at Pro services, he arranged to have a plumber take care of it on a day and time convenient for me. This was an easy call to make as I had an earlier excellent experience with Joseph from Pro Services.
This time, Michael was the plumber who did an outstanding job playing “Macguyvier” to craft a unique solution to a not typical multi pronged problem. I once did my own  plumbing repairs, but I am too old to even try doing them now. Michael was also personable, professional, knowledgable, informative and the cost was more than reasonable and fair. I do not often make recommendations for anybody or anything, But I wholeheartedly recommend Pro Services for any plumbing work you may need. They are just what people call “Good people.” Pro Services will have all my future business when I need a plumber.

reviews.author: Jacob Smith

reviews.author: Karen Kehl-Rose
