reviews.author: M Harper
reviews.text: I found this plumbing company after searching for a good plumber, and they truly lived up to their reputation as the best I’ve ever called. From the first phone call to the end of the service, they were professional and reliable. My elderly mother’s hot water heater started giving her trouble, so I reached out to them for help. Shawn was the plumber who came out, and he was honest and upfront with us. He let me know that while he could try to fix the old water heater, it was already about 15 years old and beginning to leak from the top. Shawn explained everything clearly and gave us options, so my mother and I decided to go ahead and have him install a brand-new high-efficiency water heater. My mother was so happy with Shawn’s work and his friendly attitude. I really liked how Shawn took the time to explain the situation without using complicated plumbing terms, and he made sure we understood everything. It’s not always easy to find a plumber you can trust, but Shawn made us feel confident in our decision. We feel like we got a great value and even learned something about water heaters along the way. My mom will definitely call Shawn for any future plumbing needs, and my whole family will be using this company from now on. We are truly grateful for the excellent service and care shown to our mom. They really are the best plumbers around!

reviews.author: Yesenia Hodge
reviews.text: I called for a plumber in Broomfield because I had a leak in the ceiling of my hallway bathroom. Tyrone and Shawn showed up right on time and were very professional. They quickly found where the water was coming from and explained everything to me in simple terms. Their plumbing knowledge was impressive, and they made sure I understood exactly what was going on and how they would fix it. Tyrone and Shawn were friendly and easy to talk to, which made the whole process stress-free. I’m very happy with the service and would definitely call them again if I need a plumber in Broomfield. Highly recommend for anyone needing quick and reliable plumbing help!

reviews.author: Michele Church
reviews.text: Max came by today to install a new water heater for us in Broomfield. The job was done quickly and efficiently—there was no mess, and we had hot water running within an hour after he finished. Max even took the extra step to put down new flooring under the tank, which was a nice touch. Earlier, we had new floors put in, so we needed two toilets lifted and reset once the flooring was done. I scheduled an appointment, but it didn’t line up perfectly with the floor installers. Eugene, from the office, went out of his way to squeeze us in, and even called to make sure we had at least one working toilet during the process. We really appreciated his attention and care. Every time Max has come out to help us, he’s shown up right on time and always gives us a call beforehand to let us know he’s on the way. The service has been excellent every time we’ve needed plumbing work. Highly recommend if you need a reliable plumber in Broomfield!

reviews.author: Melvin Bishop
reviews.text: I was really impressed with the plumbing service I received. The team showed up right on time and quickly found the issue with my pipes. I thought it would take a few days to get things fixed, but they had it all working again in just a couple of hours. Both Shawn and Max were very professional, friendly, and really knew what they were doing. Max did a great job installing my new water heater and made sure to remove the old one without any trouble. They kept everything super clean, so I didn’t have to worry about any mess. I highly recommend this plumbing company to anyone looking for fast and reliable service.

reviews.author: Clayton Prince
reviews.text: After coming back home to Broomfield from a trip, I found my water heater leaking. Thankfully, it hadn’t been leaking long. Since it was the weekend and not an urgent plumbing emergency, I waited and called first thing Monday morning. The person I spoke with was friendly, took down all my details, and said the scheduler would get back to me soon. I was told they might not be able to send someone the same day, which was fine—I just wanted the issue fixed properly. To my surprise, the scheduling team called me back in about 15 minutes. They confirmed the type of water heater I had and said a plumber would be over within 30 minutes. Shawn, the technician, called shortly after to let me know he was on his way. He arrived promptly, replaced the water heater, and made sure everything was cleaned up and working before noon. The new install looked very professional. Shawn also suggested and added a couple of handy upgrades, like a new ball valve shutoff and a pan under the new water heater, which I was planning to ask for anyway. I really appreciated the excellent communication, quick response, and quality work. I’ll definitely call them again for any plumbing needs. One suggestion: it would be helpful if their after-hours phone message and website listed their business hours. Otherwise, everything was great!

reviews.author: Emma Baugh
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about Valley Plumbing, Heating, and Cooling. JT, Jay, and Austin were absolutely amazing the whole time.

They replaced our furnace and AC unit, and in the process discovered that our furnace was leaking carbon monoxide. They immediately made our family’s safety their top priority and worked quickly to make our home safe again. Without them, our family could have run the risk of being seriously harmed by the dangerous carbon monoxide in our home. We truly cannot say thank you enough. They found the leak one afternoon and had a brand-new unit installed the very next day, which was incredible.

JT was especially patient and took the time to answer all of my questions thoroughly. He was very genuine in his desire to help our family have a safe, warm, carbon-monoxide-free home. All three technicians were extremely respectful of me, my home, and my family. They even warned me ahead of time if something was going to be extra loud so it wouldn’t scare my baby—which meant so much to me. Jay was so polite and respectful, always addressing me with “Yes, ma’am.”

They explained everything clearly, showed me exactly where to look, and gave easy-to-understand descriptions. This made me feel confident both in my understanding and in the quality of their work. I also really appreciated that when I scheduled my first appointment, I received a text confirmation with a photo and personal bio of the technician who would be coming to my home. That level of professionalism and transparency really stood out.

They were punctual, showed up exactly when they said they would, and communicated clearly through both text and phone calls. Despite the difficult layout of my home, they handled every challenge with ease and made a complicated job look effortless.

Overall, I am incredibly impressed by the honesty, professionalism, and strong moral character of this company. I am seriously considering making cookies to take to their office just to say thank you! You can truly tell this company is run by genuinely good people. I highly recommend Valley Plumbing, Heating, and Cooling.

plumbers.name: Expert Services - Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electrical
plumbers.address: 180 N University Ave #270, Provo, UT 84601, USA

reviews.author: Linda Allred
reviews.text:
I contacted Expert Services in January because we had a leak near our shower. When I made the initial call I could tell I was talking to a computer, but I left my information anyway. I received a callback and a technician was sent the same day to give me a bid. The bid seemed high so I explained I was not able to hire them immediately and told him if could work out financing I would call them back.
I then had a family member come to my aid, the leak was fixed and I thought everything was resolved.
Wrong.
Several days later I started receiving text messages asking me if I still needed to have my leaking pipe fixed. I responded each time explaining the work was completed and I did not need their assistance. After the 3rd exact same message I blocked the number the text messages were coming from and again thought it was over.
Wrong again.
Today, mid February, 6 weeks after my initial call to them, the phone calls started. I was shocked and frustrated that they were not able to have someone look at the responses I had sent to their 3 previous text messages and instead went right to making intrusive phone calls. When I voiced my concern that they were still contacting me, the caller had no explanation as to why they felt a need to continually contact me even though the work is done. She then told to me I should do whatever I feel is needed to prevent them from making additional and repeated contact with me. So I have now blocked a second phone number from which they have called or text me and now I am trying to save their next unsuspecting caller from the same fate as my own.  If you have a plumbing problem and turn to google to find a contractor, keep scrolling, this one will leave your phone number in some dark cycle of repeated messages and phone calls and the only to stop them is by blocking their phone numbers.

reviews.author: Paul Thomas
reviews.text: Great company TJ H. Was extremely friendly and explained to us what the problem was. we were glad to hear that he was able to take care of it. 100% recommending you to my friends.

I worked with Chandler S. He was professional, knowledgeable and also, importantly, not pushy. After dx the problem with my pilot light/water heater, he clearly presented options for what we could do, including the pros and cons of each. Then gave me space to decide. There was no pressure, which was very much appreciated. In the end, I chose to replace my older water heater instead of replacing an expensive part. reviews.author: Kate
reviews.text: Great customer service and quick response time! We've used Country Plumber for several years and have always had a good experience. Every employee we've encountered is helpful and knowledgeable. It's nice to work with a company that has a long-standing history of reputable service. Thank you!

reviews.author: Chris and Heather Mees
reviews.text:
After our septic was pumped, I called a few weeks later to pay the balance. I hadn't received a bill in the mail yet but knew a balance was due and wanted to take care of if. Our bill was for $300 and I gave payment information over the phone.

The next week when I sat down to pay bills, I noticed a charge for $309 on my account. I already knew what was going on but I called to clear it up. "Hey, you charged me $309 when my balance was $300. Please fix this."

I was informed that bc I chose to pay with a credit card and not a debit card, I incurred a 3% fee. The person taking my payment over the phone did not inform me of this. I would have used my debit card and/or just mailed a check. I have both available. The receptionist said she checked with the office manager and says an invoice was mailed to me with this policy so it doesn't matter if the person on the phone told me about the 3% or not when taking my payment.

This is a growing trend of small businesses wanting to punish their customers for paying their bills. Your cost of doing business is not *my concern*, but making me feel like I am doing something wrong by making a payment in a form that you accept will always turn me away from further business with you or reccomending you to others.

Here is a pro-tip that other businesses do: Raise your prices by 3% across the board and then take payments without fees. This is what everyone else who is not openly charging their customers their costs of doing business is doing. Do that.

What you gain from your 3% fee you lose in loyal customers and word of mouth reccomendations.

This disappointment is on top of not being able to get a service call the last 3 times I have called (for non-septic issues).

I am disputing the 3% fee with my bank.

reviews.author: Paul Vollman
reviews.text: The Country Plumber was recommended by the City of Portage Water department due to having a Lateral line potentially plugged by debris/tree roots.  When Country Plumbers was contacted the receptionist was really polite and understood my concern. After checking with Management for response time a voicemail was left on my phone stating they could respond the same day. The Country Plumber team arrived validated the concerns removed necessary equipment and promptly snacked over 75 feet of lateral plumbing pipe finding debris that cause for blockage and basement flooding. Sine their repair the Lateral line is flowing free. Thanks to Country Plumber for the response, service, quality of repair and customer service. I highly recommend this business!

reviews.author: Brad Templin
reviews.text:
If anyone needs their septic pumped anytime soon, I suggest NOT using The Country Plumber and save yourself a headache.

First problem that arose was I called for the service at the end of August and was informed they could take my credit card for payment. Alright, good.

Received a call a day before the service advising that since my appointment was made, they instituted a fee for credit cards and asked what I wanted to do.

I informed the person, when I scheduled the service, I was told it was X amount of dollars and I’d like that price to be honored without the newly added fee. The answer was "Nope".

Second problem arose when they came to perform the service. See the pictures attached, I think they speak for themselves.

Called the business to make them aware of the stains left in my driveway.

I was transferred to a manager who immediately said it would be simply impossible for anything to leak from their vehicle and that the tire marks were from the road, not their tires.

Received the bill the other day, advising that 1400 gallons was pumped out. We moved into the house (brand new build) on May 7th of 2022,  service was performed on September 26th 2024. This is 873 days of waste being collected in the tank.

When a septic tank is pumped, they are removing solids, sludge, and scum from the tank.

If 1,400 gallons (exactly) of solids, sludge and scum was removed, this means two people (only two people occupy the dwelling) would need to be producing 1.60 gallons of "solids" a day which I don't believe adds up given that 1 of the occupants of the dwelling doesn't even "use the bathroom" every day and for one person to create a gallon and a half of solid waste is not simply feasible.

So again, stay away from this company if you want to save yourself a headache. It took forever (about an hour and half of constant brushing and cleaning application) to get the stains out shown in the first two pictures, a trip to the store and out of pocket expenses to clean up this companies . Tire marks are still present.

Wouldn't have felt the need to leave such a review if the company would have heard my initial complaints and attempted to provide some sort of solution to any of the issues that transpired however automatically and immediately, nothing could be done about the credit card fee, and their driver simply couldn't have done anything wrong and their trucks and I quote: "Never leak anything."

reviews.author: BEA
reviews.text:
⭐☆☆☆☆ (1/5 Stars)

I had a very disappointing experience with Country Plumber, Inc. and would not recommend them.

They came to clear a clog and opened it through the downstairs toilet for $275. After finishing, they told me that roots were coming out and that the issue could be due to pipe separation, meaning the problem might come back. They said they couldn’t warranty their work unless they checked further, which would cost an additional $150.

Since I wanted the job done right, I agreed, expecting the total to be $425. But when I received the bill, they had me charged EXTRA $450 instead of the $150 they originally stated, bringing the total to $725.

The real issue isn’t just the cost—it’s that even after I paid extra, they still included a note saying “NO WARRANTY” and admitted that some roots were still left behind. So in the end, there was no pipe separation—just roots, which they didn’t fully remove. If they weren’t going to guarantee their work and didn’t completely fix the problem, why push for the additional service in the first place?

I don’t mind paying for quality work, but I expect honesty and professionalism. Instead, I was left with an inflated bill and an incomplete job. If you’re considering hiring them, I strongly recommend getting all pricing and guarantees in writing before they do anything beyond the initial service.

reviews.text: Facing a sudden leak in my kitchen, I was relieved when a skilled plumber arrived promptly. He quickly diagnosed the issue and had the pipes repaired in under an hour. His professionalism and efficient work left me thoroughly impressed. I appreciated his clear explanations and dedication to ensuring everything was in perfect working order before leaving.

reviews.author: Braeden Alessandro
reviews.text: Discovering a mysterious wet patch on the living room floor had me baffled. I called in a plumber, and their detective-like skills in leak detection were impressive. Within 45 minutes, they pinpointed the leak's origin with precision. They explained every step, ensuring I felt informed and confident about the process. The efficiency and clarity in their work turned a potential headache into a smooth resolution. Highly recommend for anyone needing a sharp eye and quick fix!

reviews.author: Ivan Elisabeth
reviews.text: The plumber arrived promptly and expertly installed our new water tank with impressive precision. He took the time to explain the system and answered all our questions, ensuring we felt comfortable. The entire process was smooth, efficient, and completed in just under two hours.

reviews.author: Korbin Chana
reviews.text: Having a reliable water heater is a game-changer, and I couldn’t be happier with the installation. The plumber arrived promptly, worked efficiently, and explained everything clearly. It’s been a month, and the hot water is steady. Highly recommend for anyone needing a seamless installation experience.

plumbers.name: The Fair Plumber LLC
plumbers.address: 668 E Northwest Hwy #4, Mt Prospect, IL 60056, USA

reviews.author: khrystyna tykhanska
reviews.text: I highly recommend this plumbing company for their quick and professional repair service. The technicians arrived on time, identified the issue right away, and fixed it efficiently. I am very satisfied with their work and will gladly use their services again.

reviews.author: Lindsey Witting
reviews.text: Rolando and Thomas did fabulous work at our house. We weren’t able to use plumbing on one side of our house and they fixed it. They were super professional and would recommend them to anyone. Thank you guys so much!!

reviews.author: Sarah Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Never calling The Fair Plumber again. We used them years ago and spent over $6,000 to replace an outdoor pipe, so when we started having a similar issue, we called them back. They did come out quickly, which I appreciated.

However, they quoted us $17,000 to replace about 20 feet of piping. Thankfully, a friend encouraged me to get a second opinion. Another company came out within an hour, used a different tool, flushed the line, and resolved the issue for $900. I cannot believe I was almost pressured into paying $17,000 for a problem that was fixed for $900.

To make matters worse, the manager was very unpleasant when I told him I wanted to check with another company. Extremely disappointing experience. I would not recommend The Fair Plumber.

reviews.author: Rafal Pachur
reviews.text: The Fair Plumber did a great job installing my Navien tankless water heater. The installation was smooth, and the new system works perfectly. I really appreciate their quality work and attention to detail. Highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing help!

reviews.author: Armando Gomez
reviews.text: Great experiences  with the fair plumber  they replaced a water heater in one of my properties a couple of months ago and when the water heater in my house went bad I knew who to call . Highly recommend them for any plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: McG Krush Plumbing Solutions
plumbers.address: 1610 W Polo Rd, Grand Prairie, TX 75052, USA

reviews.author: Juan Otero
reviews.text: Quality work performed,  the plumber has experience and a very professional positive attitude willing to find solutions for any issues. They were honest and left everything better than before. Highly recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Theresa Hollis
reviews.text: McG Krush plumbing was referred to us and they really came through for us when our water heated was leaking.  Chase found the water heater we wanted, gave us an estimate and came out within a few days to get the water heater installed.  It was so easy to work with them and they did what they said they would do and got the job done.  Thanks for the 5 star service!  Would definitely recommend their services and would use them again!

reviews.author: Shirley
reviews.text: Roger was so helpful & good at his job! He explained everything & was able to take care of our leak quickly. He also gave us a bunch of tips to prevent the same thing happening again which we appreciated. I would totally recommend 100%

reviews.author: Darlene Rodriguez
reviews.text: They did an awesome job. They were very quick ro response to my inquiry and fast at setting up the repair date. They came by when the roads were still icy and got the job done in a couple of hours. If you're looking for plumbers they're the ones you want.

reviews.author: AJ Ailey
reviews.text: Great work and knowledgeable skilled guys..Roger and Chase came out and found my leak under my home and gave me all my options and at that point I knew they were the ones to hire. Then Sam came out and did an excellent job repairing my leak and explained and showed me what was going on and showed me the repairs once completed and verified no more leaks. These gentlemen did an outstanding job and strongly recommend!!

plumbers.name: CPR Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 7204 Bradford Pl, The Colony, TX 75056, USA

reviews.author: Eric Oberto
reviews.text:
In a profession riddled with overcharging and price-gouging for their highly in-demand services (“as the norm”), CPR is the most reasonably priced plumbing service in The Colony.

They don’t try to trap you by charging a fee just to show up; whether they do any work or not. I really appreciate Chad for his “NO NONSENSE” approach to earning the potential customer’s business. Their pricing is transparent, upfront, and usually below the competition’s quotes (not by a landslide, but I’ll take it).

I first used them in 2014 to replace my hot water heater and their quote was below the competition. In addition, the quality of the install was on-point. Finally, he talked me out of buying a more expensive unit (that was recommended by a different plumber) and educated me about why his recommendation had more value. It’s rare when a plumber talks you into spending less money! NOTE: The hot water heater is still working well as of today.

His son-in-law Chis came out to my house yesterday to replace a shutoff valve. He followed right in-line with where Chad left off in 2014.

It’s impressive to see that the same company values are still intact 11 years later!

I recommend choosing CPR for all of your plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Amy Montero
reviews.text: I don't normally write reviews because I'm persnickety and can be brutally honest to a fault. However, after getting a referral to CPR Plumbing, I had to write this review for the benefit of other homeowners in the area that are in need of quality plumbing services. Their level of professionalism and attention to detail is outstanding, and the piece of mind you get from knowing that the job is done right makes the entire experience easier to navigate. We had an emergency plumbing problem right before the impending snow/ice storm and it was, to say the least, super stressful considering the timing and inconvenience this caused. CPR went way above and beyond to get this HUGE job done in just under 2 days, while racing against the weather, and their level of service and knowledge made this situation about as stress free as it could be. I asked an annoying amount of questions during this process. CPR assured me they were honest and credible plumbers and that they had expectations for a high quality of work without exception. I found this to be absolutely true! Thank you so much for coming out in the dark and the cold, after working on other jobs all day, to get our project done!

reviews.author: Mariann Daley
reviews.text:
After losing my husband, I lost my ring and was devastated. I thought it had fallen into my bathroom sink and called CPR Plumbing. Chris returned my call within minutes and came out within a couple of hours in The Colony, TX.
He checked both sinks, and when it wasn't there, he didn't give up - he found the ring on my bed and was genuinely happy as I was. He was kind, professional, respectful, and truly cared.
Chris refused to charge me, saying finding the ring made his day - but it absolutely made mine. Customer for life. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Robin DeSimone
reviews.text: I have been a fan and loyal customer for 20 years. One more time CPR saved me when I sprung a gas leak from my stove.  I love their responsiveness, kindness and service.

reviews.author: Xavier Lopez
reviews.text: First experience with CPR Plumbing. Chris was professional, approachable, reliable and clearly explained everything throughout the process. The work was done quickly and efficiently, and the overall service exceeded my expectations. I would definitely use CPR Plumbing again in the future. Highly recommend them, you cannot go wrong!

plumbers.name: Perfectum Construction and Plumbing
plumbers.address: 18711 Capella Ln, Gaithersburg, MD 20877, USA

reviews.author: Kira Brover
reviews.text:
Over the past five years, the Perfectum team has successfully completed a wide range of projects at my home. Their work included painting the entire house, replacing the roof, and installing a new HVAC system.
They also handled a very complex repair involving a broken sewage line that was pinched between an HVAC duct and a structural support beam, which caused my basement to flood. Perfectum managed the situation professionally at every stage—performing water mitigation, thoroughly drying and disinfecting the area, and completing full flood restoration. This included replacing the entire bamboo basement flooring, repairing damaged drywall, and repainting the space.
The quality of work, attention to detail, and professionalism throughout every project have been outstanding.

reviews.author: george blond
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Perfectum for quite a few years and have always had a great experience. On one occasion, I couldn’t winterize my back hose bib. When Vadim, the owner, arrived, he quickly realized that the original internal shut-off valve installed by the builder also shut off cold water to my kitchen faucet.
Vadim carefully analyzed the piping and was able to install a dedicated shut-off valve in a very tight ceiling space. Thanks to that solution, I can now properly winterize the back hose bib. Over the years, Perfectum has also fixed multiple pinhole leaks, replaced my toilet, and changed my kitchen faucet.
Fair pricing, excellent workmanship, and they always clean up after the job. I highly recommend Perfectum.

reviews.author: Natalia Farrar
reviews.text:
I’ve used Perfectum Construction And Plumbing on multiple occasions in different houses, and they’ve always delivered excellent service.
Last time I had a toilet that was leaking in my crawl space for a while and  completely  destroyed my subfloor and the floor joists. Since these guys do structural work as well they replaced all of them. They also relocated my HVAC ducts,  installed a smaller window and replaced all the bad framing. It was very convenient that I did not have to call a bunch of different companies to do all these jobs. They completely remodeled my bathroom and it was done quickly and efficiently. Very happy with the results!

reviews.author: Howard Sumka
reviews.text:
I first used Perfectum Construction and Plumbing in 2021 and had a great experience. Vadim replaced my water heater, pressure reducing valve, and the main water shut-off valve. He came on short notice (water heaters are always an emergency) and advised me to replace the pressure valve and the main shut-off. His work was very professional. It was clear that he insists on doing things the right way. When he replaced the water heater, he also rearranged the Rube Goldberg water lines that fed our furnace humidifier.

Just a couple of days ago I had Vadim and Peter come back to install a new kitchen faucet and a new garbage disposal with an air-button system. They also fixed a couple of our toilets that were leaking, and capped a gas line that we no longer use since we replaced our gas range with an electric one. They paid attention to the details, and they left the work site clean and neat.

I trusted Vadim’s recommendations for replacement fixtures, and he shopped for them, checking first with me before he made the purchases. If you're looking for a dependable local plumber who does quality work and stands behind it, I highly recommend Perfectum Construction and Plumbing.

reviews.author: Rob Snowhite
reviews.text:
We have been working with Vadim for well over a decade, and he is truly the person you call when you want the job done right. He is often the one fixing inferior plumbing work that others couldn’t get right the first time. He’s excellent with water heater installations, dishwashers, and any plumbing project that requires skill and attention to detail.

One experience really stands out. After installing a brand-new water heater, Vadim noticed a leak coming from the anode rod on top of the unit — a factory defect. Instead of leaving us without hot water or asking us to wait several days, he immediately took action. It was nearly 9:00 p.m., and he rushed to Home Depot, arriving just a minute before closing. He returned the same evening and completed the repair so we wouldn’t be left stranded.

That level of dedication says everything. Vadim genuinely cares about his customers, stands behind his work, and goes above and beyond to make sure the job is done properly.
Highly recommended.

plumbers.name: P & S Plumbing Honolulu

reviews.author: Sherry Dela Cruz
reviews.text: I am so blessed by P & S plumbing Honolulu! I found a slow leak in my apartment. My maintenance man found the problem and called P & S Plumbing Honolulu. To my surprise they came the same day, and was an hour and fifteen minutes earlier than they promised! That was impressive to say the least! Aaron and Mike were professionals in every sense of the word! They were very kind and respectful! Twenty minutes later, they were done! Wow! And they cleaned up to! They are truly a BLESSING! I highly recommend them for ALL your plumbing needs! They will NOT disappoint! Thank you guys so much!!!! Not sure on my review was about the cost. My apartment building paid so I don’t know how much it cost.

reviews.author: Etsuko Minematsu
reviews.text:
We are very happy with their service and communication!

We called them when our hot water tanks suddenly stopped producing hot water. The office staff was incredibly helpful — a lady took the time to walk us through some basic troubleshooting over the phone before even scheduling a service appointment, which we really appreciated.

Since our tanks were nearing the end of their lifespan, we decided to replace them. There was absolutely no sales pressure. They provided a clear quote on the spot and gave us several options to choose from.

Aaron was especially helpful and communicated directly with our electrician to make sure everything was coordinated properly before installation. When they discovered the opening was too narrow to remove the old tanks, instead of cutting into the drywall, they carefully cut the tanks in half to avoid damaging the wall. We truly appreciated that extra effort to keep everything clean and intact.

They are knowledgeable, solution-oriented, and communicate exceptionally well. Thank you so much for the outstanding service!

reviews.author: Romy Feehrer
reviews.text: I almost never write reviews because service rarely meets my expectations-But today it not only met, but absolutely exceeded all expectations! I called P&S Plumbing to install a new gas range and from the first call with Beth, I was impressed. She was kind, professional, and helpful so I booked right away and I’m so glad I did. Aaron arrived the next day, on a Saturday and on time, He was incredibly personable, professional, and efficient. He was direct, honest, and even made me laugh! He went above and beyond-helping move my old stove to the curb (not even part of the job) And working efficiently so I wouldn’t be charged extra time. He could’ve easily taken advantage of the situation, but he didn’t- True integrity! Also, delivery company failed to leave the gas hook up kit I purchased, and Aaron had the foresight to pick up a gas hook up kit on his way to my place even though I had informed him that I had purchased one! If he hadn’t, I would’ve had to reschedule! Customer service, work ethic, honesty, and superior craftsmanship are alive and well at P&S plumbing thanks to Aaron and Beth! I couldn’t be happier with the service and will absolutely call them again. Highly recommend.-Look no further!

100% would recommend!

Call for Aaron or Mikey cause they’re the best!

reviews.author: Jayme Pilione
reviews.text: Todd was super responsive and had someone out to our property within an hour. John was incredibly kind, knowledgeable and helpful as well, had the situation resolved very quickly. Didn’t try to upsell us or make the situation bigger than it needed to be which is always appreciated. Will definitely be our go-to guys from now on.

reviews.author: Dawn Lockart
reviews.text: Todd came out this morning! What great service! It was our washer and sink drain. He explained what was causing and happening. Explained what he was doing to clear drain. Great service! We will always call for him our needs! Thank you Todd!!!

reviews.text: We had an issue with our bathroom sink and thought all the pipes needed to be replaced. Todd came out, on a Saturday, and said that wasn't necessary. He replaced a small part and now its working again. So thankful that he made such a quick, easy fix.

reviews.author: RDA Lumi
reviews.text:
I’m very happy with the professional help, Todd has done for us. I could tell that he’s an experienced plumber that is on a mission when he’s got a task. Doesn’t waist time and he knows what he’s doing. I’m glad that we found him. He’s honest and fast!
Thanks Todd!

plumbers.name: H2Flo Plumbing and Sewer LLC
plumbers.address: 161 Ontario St, Frankfort, IL 60423, USA

reviews.author: GianPaolo Vernazzani
reviews.text:
When you’re in an emergency situation, you don’t have time to research the best company or the best price. You go with your gut and cross your fingers.
Just a few days before New Year’s Eve, our sewer drains started backing up in the house. Thankfully, we realized quickly what was happening and stopped using water. At first, we thought the issue was limited to one bathroom, but it turned out to be much worse.
I started calling several companies, including one I had worked with earlier in 2025. It was Sunday night, and no one answered at first. A few minutes later, H2Flo called me back. Within 30 minutes, two young plumbers were at my house assessing the problem.
They used a camera to inspect the sewer pipes and reached a conclusion almost immediately. The cast iron pipe coming out of the house and connecting to the main sewer line was likely broken and misaligned. Because of this, there was little to no flow, and a large amount of wipes (!!) had accumulated in the gap, blocking what little space water still had to pass through.
They tried removing some of the blockage, but explained that the pipe needed to be replaced and that they would need an excavator. Since they had to rent one, they couldn’t continue that night and would return in the morning.
After they left, we realized that their initial cleaning had actually helped, and the drains were working again. Still, we were very careful with water usage that night, afraid the issue could come back.
The next morning, they arrived (a bit later than planned) with the excavator and got to work. The entire job took about 3–4 hours. They did a great job, worked efficiently, and were very clean and professional inside the house while replacing the pipe.
The other plumber I had worked with in the past later told me he could have done the job for less money. Maybe that’s true — but H2Flo answered an emergency call on a Sunday night, temporarily restored our drainage so we could use water again, and then completed a high-quality repair the very next day. That peace of mind is worth a lot.
In the end, I’m very happy with the work and glad I supported a local, family-owned and operated business. Thank you very much, H2Flo!

reviews.author: Dan Parker
reviews.text: Brian, and his helper Kyle, were very professional.  They arrived on time and fixed the problem in short order. Very satisfied with the work completed. Would definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Michael Manokey
reviews.text: My wife and I were very pleased by the service provided by Zack in replacing our valve connecting the sprinkler system. reviews.author: Kathryn Howser
reviews.text: We had previously used Trust to replace a pressure relief valve and add an expansion tank to our hot water heater. Zack was very thorough and we were really happy with the work. reviews.text: Zack is definitely your go to guy , I could not be more satisfied and pleased with not only his work, his quick response  his willingness to help fix my issue. Most importantly he was completely honest with me from the beginning . I am so thankful that I was connected to him. I will never use anyone else and will refer anyone I know to him.

reviews.author: Richard Davidson

reviews.text: I had a water leak and found myself in need of a plumber but didn’t know who to call.  A friend of mine referred someone who I called, left a message and he never called me back. So if you’re in need of a plumber and you don’t know who to call,  give these guys a call.  I can honestly say, they really took care of me!

reviews.author: Michael Needham
reviews.text:
Buddy the Plumber gave me the best experience I’ve ever had with any service coming to my home — bar none.

Tyler was the technician who came out, and his kindness, knowledge, and professionalism were unmatched. After being over-quoted by multiple “big company” plumbers, I had convinced myself that any plumbing visit was going to cost thousands of dollars. Tyler immediately put us at ease.

He took the time to crawl under the house with me and clearly explain exactly what was going on (twice). He didn’t just fix the problem — he fixed it the right way and made sure it wouldn’t happen again.

Honest, thorough, and incredibly professional. If 1 million stars were an option, that’s what I’d give. Highly recommend Buddy the Plumber — and ask for Tyler if you can.

reviews.author: Ashley Wowk
reviews.text: Tyler did a phenomenal job helping me with a water leak repair. I called on a holiday weekend and they were the only ones to respond, Tyler came out within a few hours and even gave me some amazing recommendations for local contractors. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Antonio and Treva Sands
reviews.text: Tyler was awesome! He took his time explaining everything so we understood what was causing our high water bill. I will recommend them to everyone I know!

Andy came out to service our broken air conditioner when it was 100° outside. He first got dirty and cleaned the condenser outside. He was quick and got it fixed that day. reviews.author: Faelynn Platz

plumbers.name: Clover Contracting: Plumbing, HVAC & Air Purification
plumbers.address: 44679 Endicott Dr Suite 300, Ashburn, VA 20147, USA

reviews.author: Zach
reviews.text:
We received quotes from a lot of HVAC companies and ultimately used Clover. Ryan did an awesome job at helping us figure out the issue with our Furnace - blower motor and inducer was bad. Since the unit was so old (20 years old) we went ahead and replaced that. We noticed major corrosion on our water heater and I asked them about fixing the dryer exhaust pipes in the wall because somehow that was crushed.

Long story short we replaced the furnace, water heater and they fixed the damaged dryer exhaust pipe in the wall. They even replaced/fixed all the old gas and water pipes hooking up to the furnace/water heater.

They did an awesome job. We added on some extras like the Honeywell air filtration system and the extra home air purifier with a humidifier for the home. This has helped tremendously with allergies, and dry nose during the winter.

I only have the “after photos” but compared to before it looks 100% better, our furnace works great now. The piping system is still complicated but they made it way better than before.

Also want to say thanks for the muffins.

reviews.author: Andrew Potocko
reviews.text:
I called 6 different businesses in my area for quotes to have my broken and leaking water heater replaced. Clover hands down had the best value AND the best customer service experience! I was blown away!

While most companies charge for a quote or require a technician visit, Clover offered me a free, no-hassle quote over the phone by simply sending a few pictures (which they offer for certain services). I initially spoke with Lizzie on the phone who helped me get the process started. She was extremely helpful, understanding, and responsive with my primary call and follow up questions. She also walked me through their many guarantees and signature service benefits.

After choosing Clover, they were able to schedule me for next day service to quickly have my water heater replaced. The service technicians (Austin and Ricky) were incredibly professional and walked me through everything they were doing. They are clearly knowledgeable and highly trained in their craft and we’re well equipped to answer any questions I had.

I highly recommend Clover and will plan on using their services again if needed!

reviews.author: Marcus Singleton
reviews.text: I hired Clover Contracting for some plumbing work at my home, and overall, I had a very positive experience. The plumber arrived on time, quickly identified the issue, and explained the repair process in simple terms. They fixed a leaky pipe and also checked the water heater to ensure everything was running smoothly. The service was professional, and the pricing felt fair for the quality of work. The only reason I didn’t give a full 5 stars is because the cleanup could have been a bit more thorough, but I’d definitely call them again.

reviews.author: Shivasish Sindiri
reviews.text:
On Jan 16th I called CLOVER HVAC service because my HVAC was shutting down and home wasn't heating. They sent two technicians to home in short time. They observed the code 31 or 13 flashing on the carrier HVAC and told me it’s the pressure switch that is faulty. Since they claimed they were licensed and experienced technician I trusted them and paid $478 in total ( $99 for the visit  + $379 advance payment o replace the pressure switch for next visit ). After they left, the HVAC system was working, blowing hot air but doesn't take break when indoor temperature reaches thermostat set temperature. (This is quite dangerous for multitude of reasons). It was like furnace inside the home. I called them to visit home and check. They suggested, I should attempt to fix while they instruct me how to do it on phone. WHAT A WORST IDEA. JUST to keep my property safe I attempted it with lot of hesitation and fear of the furnace. Then I see the furnace started accumulating water quite close to the electric/mother circuit board. I was scared because its basic electrical 101, water with active current is a worst scene. They came back on the same evening and fixed it. I was really unsatisfied & frustrated and called their office and ASKED THEM "PLEASE CANCEL MY NEXT SERVICE OF REPLACING THE PRESSURE SWITCH" because of their inexperience and the mess. They told me that they will refund that day visit cost $99 and will send a senior technician to do "FULL SYSTEM DIAGNOSTIC CHECK AND IF AT ALL NECESSARY, THEY WILL REPLACE THE SWITCH". I didn't like the idea but I finally agreed after they repeatedly declining to cancel the next appointment with them. Then the senior tech came and couldn't really pinned down the issue and replaces the pressure switch without concrete evidence. The HVAC ran fine for 4 days and on fifth day it started flashing the same error code 31 or 13 . I called them and they sent same senior tech again as soon as they could. At this visit he claimed he did what he should have done in his earlier visits . i.e HVAC 101. ANY LICENSING SCHOOL WOULD TEACH THIS, WHENEVER HVAC FLASHING PRESSURE SWITCH CODE YOU SHOULD
1) OPEN THE BLOWER FAN, CHECK FOR ANY CLOGS, DEBRIS AND CONDENSATE LIQUID? THEY DIDN'T DO THIS. NOT EVEN TOUCHED IT.
2) CHECK EXHAUST, INTAKE AND DRAIN PIPES TO CHECK FOR ANY CLOGS. THEY DID EXAMINE THIS.
3) CHECK THE ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS FOR ANY ISSUE. THEY TESTED THIS.
WHY DIDN’T YOU CHECK THE BLOWER FAN?? WAS IT TOO SIMPLE AND DOESN’T COST MUCH TO CUSTOMER?

The HVAC stopped working again for the second time and this time knew I will be a total fool if I call them because $379 + three CLOVER technicians + four visits couldn't fix it . Either they knew what was the problem and they choose not to operate and scam me by replacing a well-functioning part or they don’t know above point (1).  By looking at the below attached pictures and not doing HVAC 101 point (1), you might be convinced the first case is likely true. i.e they wanted to do something which would bring more money and not doing simple cleaning which could have done during their first visit for just $99.
After waiting for two cold nights a  genuine technician came and said there is nothing wrong with old pressure switch (he tested it by replacing it) or another component. AND just the ducts and pipes needed further cleaning. IT has been a couple days it’s working.

I called them for a refund since they claim "MONEY BACK GUARANTEE” if their service was unsatisfactory. SINCE YOU COULD FIX THE PROBLEM AND DIDN’T DO THE BASIC CHECK IN YOUR FIRST VISIT YOU SHULD REFUND. They tell me, they already gave $99 discount and cannot offer any further discount. I WANT TO REMIND; YOU GAVE ME $99 BECAUSE YOU PUT MY WHOLE HVAC AT RISK BECAUSE OF THE WATER LEAKING FROM THE EXHAUST PIEPE. IT WAS YOUR FAULT. YOU DIDN’T DO A FAVOUR TO ME. Now I am asking for refund because even after four visits and charging me $379 you couldn't fix the issue AND REPLACED A WELL FUNCTIONING PART WHICH WAS TOTAL UNNECESSARY.
You break my confidence and trust.

reviews.author: Jacquie Burian
reviews.text: Clover Services was one of very few responses I received (and were extremely quick) to respond to my request for an estimate to repair (but most likely replace) my elderly father's old boiler system from the 1970's. They arranged for one of their best technicians to evaluate the system as soon as possible and he spent a lot of time analyzing how best to replace and dispose of the the old system.  Their prices were competitive and the total amount was exactly what we expected it would cost to replace.  The company went above and beyond to get the equipment ordered and installed as quickly as possible so my father would have heat in time for the cold weather. This was not an easy job and not one that many companies wanted to attempt - but Clover Services, Ryan and all of their technicians took this job without hesitation and worked hard for two days to get it done. Ryan, the lead tech, was extremely professional, communicative and friendly (as was Wendy in the office) and they both made sure I understood the estimate, the timeline and all that the job entailed. They also treated my father and his home with dignity and respect. They did a fantastic job and I wouldn't hesitate to hire them again!

reviews.author: Sandy Bellamy
reviews.text: Brad and Christian were amazing. They came out today to fix the burst pipe. They arrived quickly and the job was completed just as fast. The pipe is well insulated and is fantastic after the job they did. Thank you,  guys stay warm and safe.

reviews.text: Best plumbing experts. Nathan, John and Nico were friendly and very professional.  They came out to assess my plumbing issue with a camera and showed were my real issue was. If you are looking for plumbing that will tell you the real truth and are outstanding with their work ethic choose them.

reviews.author: Paris Scott Allen
reviews.text: I’ve used All Pro Plumbing twice now for my property, and both times have been an excellent experience. Mike, Bob, and Dom were all professional, knowledgeable, and went above and beyond to get the job done right. They arrived on time, communicated clearly, and made sure everything was working perfectly before they left. It’s rare to find a team that’s both efficient and personable, but these guys deliver every time. Highly recommend All Pro Plumbing — they’ve definitely earned my trust and continued business!

reviews.author: Crystal Smith
reviews.text:
We had great service today from Mark C.  We woke up the first day in our new home to find that our water heater was not working properly.  We weren't expecting we could find someone to install a new one on the weekend but Prestige had great reviews and weekend hours.  Mark answered right away this morning, let us know of their promotions and said he could be there by early afternoon.
He was prompt and had everything needed to complete the job. He explained in detail what he needed to do to complete the job detailing the expenses.  He also inspected our dryer gas line (we're having a new dryer delivered Monday) and repaired it as well.  We were extremely pleased with his service.  Just an awesome job and by 5 pm he was finished, everything was cleaned up and upgraded for safety.
I would recommend him and Prestige Plumbing without hesitation.  We are so thankful he was able to come out on the weekend!  Thanks, Mark!

reviews.author: James Wodka
reviews.text:
I worked with Mark C. on my water heater. Mark was very professional and cordial both over the phone and while he was out here doing the work. They were able to get it back up and running almost immediately. I will definitely use Prestige again.

EDIT:
A few days after initially repairing the water heater, I couldn't get the heater lit, again. After fiddling with the igniter I could to get it lit, albeit briefly, so that I had enough hot water to shower. I called Prestige and left a message to have someone call me to walk me through opening the new, redesigned front plate so I could attempt to clean the inside. This was on 1/7. I didn't get a call back on 1/8. I called again and left messages on 1/9 and 1/13, with no return calls either time. By the evening of 1/13 my water heater was no longer working at all. I have had the water heater replaced, and because of this poor customer service I went with another company. That's $1,300 that could've been Prestige's if they took the time to make a single phone call.

reviews.author: Steve Wittenborn
reviews.text: Five years ago Prestige installed 2 water heaters in my home.  Today, one of them wasn’t able to keep the pilot going.   Called Prestige, they came out, fixed it in 30 minutes.  Parts still under warranty and was only charged a minimal fee for labor.   Courteous, fast, knowledgeable work.  Very happy.

reviews.author: Vijay Shah
reviews.text: Was not impressed. Father & Son came to my home within a few hours of my call for service on my water heater.  They arrived at the time they said and they called when they were on their way. Took a very quick look at my water heaters and although they got one pilot on, they swiftly decided I needed new heaters.  Quoted me over $3500 which I felt was too high.  They charged me $135 for coming out and lighting the one pilot. They could not get my second heater pilot on.  I immediately called another service company who arrived to my house within 1 hour and told me he could replace them for $2300 (the specs of the heaters and the install were the same, trust me, I went over the details).  This service guy from the other company was able to easily ignite the heater that Prestige could not.  When I asked the second service company what I owed him for coming out and getting this pilot on, he told me...NOTHING, call me when you need to replace them, but for now you're good"........My opinion of Prestige is that they are probably good at what they do, but you will likely overpay or worse get ripped off

reviews.author: Eva Balek
reviews.text: Your service is way above the other plumbing, heating and cooling services.  I have been a customer for the past 20 years and have never had a complaint.  Today was yet another time when I needed your immediate help and there you were within the hour.  Your work is always neat and efficient but what I appreciate the most is the quality of work in every job no matter how small.  Thank you for always being there.  This time I am enjoying my new and cutting edge hot water heater.

reviews.author: Marcus Bernardy
reviews.text: I have spent YEARS looking for a reliable and trustworthy plumber in Lake County. My search has FINALLY come to an end! On the day of the work, everyone arrived on time and were extremely polite throughout. New parts were priced and recommended to me before any work was authorized. Pricing at the end matched what was quoted to me over the phone, and all at a very competitive price! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ray Clark
reviews.text: I called up in a panic because a sump pump alarm was going off.  They walked me through a few steps I could check and see if I could resolve the problem without a need for a service call - they got me back up and running.  Long story short, I don't know of many companies nowadays that take the time to give you a hand rather than just come out and charge you.  This is exceptional.  I would recommend them to anyone needing plumbing service - I will be calling them the next time I have a need and recommending them to my neighbors and friends.

reviews.author: Allison GN
reviews.text: We had a toilet issue and Steve and the crew came out right away. They were able to assess the situation and take care of the problem so quickly. I was so impressed with the guys how professional they were. The new toilet is beautiful. Great job! Definitely will call you again!

reviews.text: I called Water Tight Plumbing & Sewer after finding gas leaks in our pipes to the water heater and dryer. (Who knew you needed a plumber for a gas leak? Not me.) I called Steve, the Owner, who had his guys to my house within the hour. Bill and Chris made all the repairs in a timely fashion. And came back the same day at no charge after the gas company turned the gas back on to make sure everything was good. They took great care of me and my house! Thank you Water Tight Plumbing & Sewer!

reviews.author: Jonathan Eisner
reviews.text: Outstanding service from start to finish! The team at Water Tight Plumbing did an incredible job. Their workmanship was truly exemplary, and it was clear they take immense pride in what they do. They were professional, knowledgeable, and left the work area spotless. I've found my go-to plumber for any future needs. I highly recommend them—they deserve every one of these five stars!

I highly recommend Geoff to anyone who needs professional and reliable plumbing technician.

reviews.author: Osmalyn Walton
reviews.text: Jose Guerra was back in our home installing a water heater, and refitting new pipes in order to bring up to code. Once again truly satisfied customers we are. Should we have any additional concerns he made sure to let us Know Rocket, and the company will be there to answer them and put our minds at ease. He’s the best of the best.

reviews.author: L Y
reviews.text: This is my third time working w/ Luis. I really love that Rocket has the same person come out to you. It's like building a relationship with your barber. They get to know you, they know your house, they  know what your preferences are and what questions you may have--or maybe it's just Luis and he's a very thorough guy. I don't know. I hope I never have to find out. Before he goes Luis tells me exactly what I should to do upkeep the system to prevent future problems. I've never had a problem or had to call him back after he's finished with the work. Never have had to redeem a warranty on anything he's installed. It's the way our nation was built: by vocational programs and blue collared hands. Solid. Predictable.

reviews.author: Stephanie D
reviews.text:
I noticed some water damage on the ceiling below my upstairs bathroom.. I started my search online for a new plumber and chose rocket plumbing because of all the positive reviews I was seeing- the reviews aren’t wrong.

I called in the late afternoon, the receptionist was very kind, helpful, and she was able to send a plumber out the next morning. The plumber, Geoffrey was professional, knowledgeable and patient (I had probably a million questions throughout the whole process since I was communicating the situation with my husband over text, he is the one who typically takes care of these things).

He very quickly identified the leak and to my surprise when i asked if it was a possibility to fix the issue the same day he said yes, and only left to go get the new toilet/replacement parts that we ended up having replaced- he did offer us multiple options to fix the issue at very different price points which was fantastic. And has extremely clear communication with every decision that needed to be made.

Unfortunately after he removed the old toilet he found how badly damaged some of the old plumbing in the floor was, and it became a much larger job than originally anticipated (due to a very poorly done repair in the past by a different plumber/company)Geoffrey still made the commitment to have the work finished the same day and spent most the day seeing this through while still keeping the cost very reasonable.

he even vacuumed, swept, and removed any trash/debris from the job when he was finished. And left contact information for a carpenter (to repair the damaged ceiling) and a restoration company to come look at any potential mold issues from the leak.

My husband and I are very pleased with the work that was done, and will definitely be using Rocket plumbing in the future.

reviews.author: Kevin McGurn
reviews.text: From booking through Vicky, to service by Trevor, Jo-el and Hugo, everyone was great on my line jetting and basin drain. Hard working, good communication no BS or upselling. He kept me informed through every step in the process. I highly recommend Cedar Park Plumbing and Josh for any plumbing work needed.

reviews.text: Josh was wonderful! After four plumbers/HVAC specialists came out to tried to swindler me, Josh was honest, caring, and took the time to listen about the issue, and fixed the problem. I am very grateful after three days of no hot water. Also, he gave me a teacher's discount. There are good, honest people out there! Thank you so very much!!!

reviews.text: Josh very competently evacuated our water heater, made a proposal to replace it along with adding a missing expansion tank and emergency power cutoff, got everything needed, installed everything, cleaned up the area and made sure we understood all that had been done. Excellent job!

reviews.author: Julia Mack
reviews.text: After 22 years in the Verde Valley, they are...the BEST by FAR!!! Prompt, no surprise "Add-Ons". Professional & quick service. Swamp Cooler & Furnace service is excellent. I know who to go to if I ever need Repairs or new systems. Thank you! 5-Stars

reviews.author: charles sullivan
reviews.text: Best By Farr has been servicing our HVAC system for many years. We have been extremely pleased by the knowledge and care of their technicians so we called them with a recent water leak in a bathroom ceiling. Wade quickly found the source of the leak and fixed it. Problem solved.

reviews.author: Tracy Hazelton
reviews.text: Angel was amazing! Very calm & professional compared to me who was in a panic over a failed water heater w/water everywhere. Ruben & Jesus installed the new water heater the same day I called & passed the city’s permit inspection the next day, no problems at all. Angel also gave me great advice on a new faucet for my bathroom. Would definitely use this company again! I felt well taken care of & really appreciated their speed & quality of service. Thanks!

reviews.author: Happyhappy Girl
reviews.text: Very easy to schedule a next day appointment! Our plumber was knowledgeable, personable and provided excellent service. Our kitchen sink drain is working properly!  Very happy with the service we received today!  Plumbing Dynamics is our first choice and strongly recommend!

reviews.author: Casey DeKrey

Their pricing was completely reasonable, and I really appreciated how quickly they responded to my texts throughout the process. Outstanding service from start to finish—highly recommend!

reviews.author: Elliot Robinson
reviews.text:
Let’s be real plumbing issues suck especially as a new homeowner. Plumbing dynamics gave me good advice when it came to dealing with a low water pressure issue, as well as fixing my immediate problem, a pipe that had burst following several days of sub freezing temperatures. They were able to schedule me in quickly, showed up in a reasonable time and solved my issue.

I would recommend them to anyone who is in need of plumbing work as they were very upfront, easy to talk to, walked me along each step of the way and did not pressure me to buy things I did not need.

reviews.author: liza
reviews.text: Very Highly recommended, The job entailed went beyond the scope of initial work assessed. But the issue was quickly resolved. Chad got his crew to come by the following days, Saturday & Sunday to ensure that the leak is fixed and work completed timely. I appreciate Chad’s honesty & going the extra mile to take care of the customers. Thank you for a job well done!!! And NO SERVICE FEE to come out for assessment.

reviews.author: Ben Hadaway
reviews.text:
We had piers put under the house and needed to pass the hydrostatic test. We failed and discovered castiron aged about 50 years had numerous breaks. Chad gave a quick quote , no BS. Paid 1/2 at beginning. Half at end. PRICING WAS GREAT. Had 3 other corp plumbing companies come by with outrageously high bids. Support your local family businesses!

So a full sewer line clean outs and re-pipe and testing was needed. Tunneled about 40 feet under the house and another 40 feet trench in the yard.

Angel and his crew about 4-6 guys worked at our house for 8 days, even on weekends and one nights (with my permission). Hoping to get it all done before a bunch of rain came in. They did! Cleanup was impressive. Managed to save most of my grass.

Solid work ethic on Angel and his crew and they like Bomb Pops.

Found my new plumber.

Pics below.

Edit: 2nd job

Irrigation Valve replacement 10/20/25
Reduced to 1 star after a second service to change an irrigation line. The work itself is good, the reduced rating is because of the awful communication with Chad.

We exchanged texts on possible availability and work to be done but never confirmed a time. He shows up, and begins work and finishes the job while I'm away from home even though I told him I wanted to be there. Took about 4 hours of work.Then he bills me without ever providing an estimate in any form and the cost is about 5x what I was expecting for a simple surface irrigation valve leak repair. The leak was above ground inside the irrigation box.

After discussing he claimed to have emailed me the estimate but then realized my email wasn't on file and he in fact didn't.  His attitude was piss poor to put it nicely and he even tried to make it feel like it was my fault. Keep in mind we are repeat customers and we dropped 15k+ with his company not 6 months ago. He did reduced the charge some but still way over what I was expecting. Still left a sour taste in my mouth with the whole experience.

If you want to change it confirm everything in writing before you even let him step on your property.

Textbook case of how to turn a satisfied customer into a detractor. I posted the text exchange with our very limited communication even though he claimed cost estimate and appointment had been confirmed, then gas lighted me like it was my fault.

I will NOT use him again. As many others have said, his communication and attitude is abysmally poor and not worth the hassle and stress. Just pay a bit more for some peace of mind.

reviews.author: SoCal Wagon Junkie
reviews.text:
These guys are great. We called them after having another plumbing company do repairs a few weeks prior and more leaks popped up.
Upon arrival, the team started looking for the source abs found multiple in our attic. We first started with a partial re-pipe hoping that would fix the problem, but the team determined that we also had a bad main valve which also got replaced.
While pressuring the system another leak popped up so we had to replace more pipe.
Our house is over 21yrs old and the original pipe was CPVC which was failing everywhere.  A majority of the pipe was replaced with PEX.
I would highly recommend this company to anyone. They are extremely professional and thorough.

Regards,
Jason and Deanna Ritter

reviews.author: Jim Lehrer
reviews.text: The is was an excellent plumbing experience.  I called on a late Saturday morning about a clogged kitchen sink drain.  My call was answered quickly by a courteous and efficient dispatcher, who gave me a 2-hour early afternoon window.  David, the plumber, called about an hour and a half later to say he would arrive in about 10 minutes.  He examined the kitchen sink and asked a number of pertinent questions about the house piping.  He checked an exterior cleanout below the kitchen sink, and also checked the crawlspace under the sink.  He quoted a very reasonable charge to snake the drain, and started work right away.  He explained how kitchen sink clogs can be made worse, depending on what goes through the Insinkerator.  He completed the work and cleaned up in about an hour.  The job was well done,, and there were no surprises.  I ended up more knowledgable about how to care for the kitchen drain system, too.  I will call on this outfit for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Denese Davis
reviews.text: I was in need of a new water heater. Matt was referred. So glad he was. Matt is a courteous , kind and professional. Discusses his knowledge of his profession ( learning and working in the plumbing industry with his dad) and enjoys talking about his family, his children and his love of his community and giving back.  I highly recommend him and know you will find him as pleasant and professional as I have. 02.27.26 update. I felt that my water just wasn’t hot enough, gave Matt a call and he showed up the next morning, made necessary adjustments with no charges. Great service!! Thank you Matt! You’re much appreciated.

reviews.author: Zach Molock
reviews.text: Matt was incredible! I called them on Saturday in a panic, but once I told them what was going on along with sending pictures, they quickly calmed the anxiety and put us at ease. We scheduled the repair for first thing Monday morning. He was in and out in about an hour and half. No mess left behind at all. He even put on the new part we had purchased. Which I didn’t think he was doing. So it was a nice surprise to see that he went ahead and took care of it. Matt was a blessing overall! Super nice family owned business and super nice guy himself. Thanks for giving such A++ service!! We will definitely be recommending to our friends and anyone who asks where they can find a good plumber. Oh!! And to top it off… nobody would have been able to beat their pricing. Fairly priced for sure, generous actually. Thanks for that too!

reviews.author: Holly Ware
reviews.text: I'll start by saying I couldn't have been more impressed with Matt and my whole experience with I Know A Guy Plumbing-. Now, the details. My uncle was a plumber, so he took care of all my plumbing needs until he died last year.  I have a lot of trust issues with other plumbers. Right away, I perceived that Matt is a man of integrity, and his ongoing actions reinforced that belief. Plus, he grew up as the son of a Responsible Master Plumber (RPM is the specialized license), so he experienced challenging jobs long before he was a Responsible Master Plumber himself.  So, I was confident he could handle our slab leak, and as a bonus, his price was the lowest out of the 3 quotes we received. Next, the communication was outstanding. Matt's wife, Kayla, is his office manager, and she did a great job of keeping us informed. Naturally, the job being done correctly is of the utmost importance. Matt pulled the permit without us having to ask him to do so, and the city inspector said Matt did a quality repair. That gives me confidence that everything was fixed as it should be. The excavation crew that Matt uses made a beautiful hole in our garage, using very little space, and after the plumbing repair was done, they did a outstanding job packing the dirt back in, and using rebar drilled into our existing cement before pouring new cement. I have confidence that the new cement will stay intact with the rest of the garage floor. Finally, I love that this is a small business, so I know that I'm going to get the same guy and the same quality every time. The only thing I don't like about writing this review is I hope that Matt's business never gets too big for him to be my personal plumber in the future.

I decided to give a different plumber a shot, and I’m glad I did. The dispatcher was polite and straightforward, telling me exactly when to expect the plumbers. I got a call before they arrived, right on time. Roger and Marvin came out, listened to what I needed, and got started right away. They finished the faucet replacement in about 30 minutes, and everything worked perfectly after they were done. Both plumbers were friendly and professional, offering helpful tips and making sure I was happy with the work. The price was much better than other quotes I received, especially since I already had the faucet ready to go. I was really impressed with the quick and reliable service. I’ll definitely call them again the next time I need a plumber in Woodstock.

reviews.author: Garrett Arias
reviews.text: I was really impressed with the plumbing service I received in Woodstock. When I noticed my water heater was leaking, I started looking for a plumber since I knew something was wrong. Usually, dealing with home repairs makes me anxious, especially because I’m on a tight budget, but everyone I spoke to from this company made the process stress-free. I reached out to four different plumbing companies, and Marvin was the only one who got back to me the same day—even on a weekend. He asked me to send pictures and a video of the leak, then quickly gave me a clear and reasonable quote. Scheduling was easy, and they worked with my availability. On the day of the repair, Roger from the office called to let me know Derek was on his way, and he arrived right on time. I highly recommend this plumbing company to anyone in Woodstock looking for reliable, professional help. Five stars!

reviews.text:

Original post: I had Drain Pro go out to my home after receiving a referral from another company. They arrived to my house Friday morning and I received no communication they had arrived, left, if anything needed to be fixed, or if the job was complete. I called repeatedly over the next 4 days and left voicemails that went unanswered. Finally, on Tuesday I received a text message that I needed to get an ejection pump fixed and a part replaced. Due to having no communication, when the bathroom was used Tuesday night after being away over the weekend, the same ejection pump overflowed and sewage backed up into my basement. When I asked why no one reached out to me, I was told "he plugged the pump into the wall and it came on so he assumed it would be ok". That assumption is now costing me $3,300 in sewage clean up fees, another $1500 for a new pump, and another $2k for reconstruction to rip up the flooring in the basement, replace the baseboards and the drywall. When asked if Drain Pro would assist or take responsibility for it, I was told "I'm sorry" and they stopped responding to me completely. They have directly caused me thousands in damages for something they knew was broken, and yet did not take any time to reach out and tell me. The bathroom is also now unusable for at least a week while the repairs get done. Seeking legal advice.

reviews.text: My situation was a little unique - it wasn't a straightforward job, and I really needed someone to come and advise me on how to resolve my situation.  This job required moving an exterior sewer line away from the house.  I searched for a company that focused on that specialty.  APEX did not disappoint.  The first thing I loved was someone actually answered the phone.  The second thing I loved is that I was able to get an appointment within 24 hours of my call.  The third thing I loved is they showed up when they were supposed to.  I had a quote within 30 minutes which I accepted.  Much to my surprise, the guys said – we just need to go get a few parts, but we can do this job today if you want us to.  Whaaat?  Who does that?  Apex does that’s who.  These guys were super polite, explained everything they were going to do, how and why.  They even presented me two solutions and the second solution they suggested installing a check valve / back flow solution, something I had already contemplated but forget to ask them about.  I have worked with probably 5-6 different plumbers over the years but in my mind, APEX exceeded my expectations.   I usually try and get multiple estimates, but I felt the estimate was reasonable, the timing was definitely a plus and the representatives of the company (two gentleman – didn’t get their names) really just made me feel very comfortable.  I don't believe I would have gotten that type of service anywhere else.  The decision was easy for me.  Hopefully this review will make it easy for you.
