reviews.author: Jaime DB
reviews.text: Had a great experience with the Fluid team. Vince is extremely knowledgeable. He helped us with our bathroom remodels. We changed the configuration going from shower to tub and vice versa for the other bathroom. He was very detailed in his explanation of what he was going to be doing which was much appreciated. Also very tidy. I also used their services for a water heater replacement. They were able to help me out in a pinch when our water heater went out on a Friday evening. Ron was able to come to my home the following day on a Saturday afternoon and provide a diagnosis and a solution. Unfortunately my water heater was at the end of its life so a replacement was needed. I needed a replacement quick so he was able to go to the local big box store and get us a replacement and have it installed promptly. Within an hour of returning the new water heater was installed and prepped to go. This family was able to enjoy a nice warm shower thanks to Ron and the Fluid team.

reviews.author: Jonathan Fishpaw
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Fluid Dynamics and would certainty recommend them to others. My commercial water heater broke at my On-Premise-Laundry facility and I reached out to them because I knew their facility was close by and had seen their van around. I heat water constantly and it is an important part of cleaning laundry.

Ronald came out in a couple of hours to inspect my water heater and give me options repairing or replacing it and what might have led me to this point. I appreciated that he wasn't trying to sway me in either direction and was sharing his knowledge about how to evaluate the decision.  I decided to replace it and add a thermal expansion tank. Also got a utility sink quoted and setup for install.

We schedule for the replacement when I could stop operations for a few hours for Vince and Lalo to complete the install. They arrived a few minutes early to get the old water heater draining so when the new one was delivered it could wheel from the truck right into place. Vince worked through the project diligently, was clean in his workspace and left my shop looking good. Took all the trash away and ensured we I was back to washing as fast as possible.

This vendor was excellent to work with. From the initial conversation through delivery, they were organized, responsive, and transparent. I thought the value for the service was good. They handled everything professionally and followed through on every commitment.

reviews.author: Lenny Scarola
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience working with Fluid Dynamics in San Jose, CA. From the first interaction, their team demonstrated a high level of professionalism, knowledge, and attention to detail. It’s clear that they have extensive expertise in fluid systems and engineering solutions, and they took the time to understand the exact requirements of the project before recommending the best approach.

What stood out most was their ability to explain complex technical concepts in a way that was easy to understand. They were transparent about the process, timelines, and expectations, which gave me a lot of confidence throughout the entire project. Their engineers were extremely thorough, and the quality of their work reflected years of experience in the industry.

The project was completed efficiently, and everything was delivered exactly as promised. Communication was excellent the entire time — they kept me updated on progress and were always available to answer questions.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable and trustworthy engineering team in San Jose that specializes in fluid dynamics, system optimization, and technical problem-solving, I highly recommend Fluid Dynamics. Their expertise, professionalism, and commitment to delivering high-quality results make them a standout company in the Bay Area.

reviews.author: Dan Holder
reviews.text:
This past November 12, I called Fluid Dynamics Plumbing in San Jose, and I couldn’t be more impressed with their exceptional service from start to finish. From the initial phone call to the detailed text updates about technician arrival, everything was handled with professionalism and clear communication. When Caesar arrived, he greeted us with a friendly, confident attitude and quickly got to work diagnosing and resolving our plumbing issue. The repair was completed efficiently, and the job site was left spotless — a true sign of pride in workmanship.

As a restaurant, reliable and responsive service is crucial for us, and Fluid Dynamics Plumbing has absolutely earned our trust. I highly recommend them for any commercial or residential plumbing needs they’re now our go-to plumbing company in San Jose!

reviews.author: Mousa Katwan
reviews.text: My family had a great experience with Fluid Dynamic Plumbing. Happy that they showed up on time, and got my bathroom done within the time they estimated. Manny was super friendly and explained everything in a simple way, didn't try and upsell me on things I didn't need. They made the job pretty simple. Would use them again.

reviews.author: Nemanja P
reviews.text:
I've had Drazan come out multiple times to our house to fix our plumbing. One time he came first thing in the morning to fix a leak in our basement. He then discovered that we had a pipe that was broken that was going from the house to the outside. His team came out and worked all day and fixed it. They were very clean, they cleaned after themselves and even wore shoe covers indoors to make sure not to leave any unnecessary dirt.
They also installed a whole house water filter in our basement and a 5 stage in the dining room. Again, they did a fantastic job, and we have great tasting water with no mineral residue. There was a small issue with the five stage water filter and he sent his tech out immediately and it was fixed within 2 hours. I couldn't be happier with their services. They have great prices, the service staff is vert friendly, and they stand behind their work. I would gladly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing services!

They showed up on time and efficiently diagnosed and located my issue (clogged drain pipes). Reasonably priced and exceptional customer service. My wife and I are ecstatic to now have a trusted plumber to call when needed. Highly recommend.

reviews.text: Amir was an outstanding and VERY knowledgeable! He understood the issue and helped explain to the customer what her problem was.

reviews.text: My kitchen tap was dripping non-stop, but these guys came in and fixed it in minutes. Friendly, reliable, and worth every penny.

reviews.author: Berih Awala
reviews.text: Mr. Kozul was so knowledgeable about the drainage issues we had. He diagnosed the problems and fixed them quick. He is very ethical and professional worthy of trust. We look forward to working with him and his Company.

plumbers.name: Above All Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7730 Enterprise Dr # 7, Newark, CA 94560, USA

reviews.author: Curt P
reviews.text:
Going with a trusted plumber/plumbing company is a must - like going to a mechanic you know/trust to fix your car and not worry about being cheated.

We're happy we went with Above All Plumbing (again, pretty sure we also used them years ago to install a toilet at a nearby rental we used to own) after we discovered a small leak underneath the bathroom sink last week.  Another reason we went with Above All is that our condo building of 38 units have been using them for building plumbing work (and installation of the main water heater) for probably more than 10 years (though each owner is free to go with any plumber he/she likes).

Above All phone staff have been friendly, helpful and clearly explained their minimum/hourly pricing.  Junior (JR) came out the following day - he was friendly and experienced/def can tell he's had a lot of experience.  Really appreciate that JR clearly explained the issues/risk of various approaches we could do to address the leak and did what he could to minimize costs for us.  We going to need to replace the sink in the coming months, and we'll likely go with Above All!

reviews.author: Jeni Kelly
reviews.text: From start to finish Above All Plumbing has been superb. We were recommended by a family friend. Rick, the owner answered the call right away and by the end of the day, Dawn had called to fit us in. Corinne was very kind and professional with the confirmation call and Collin was efficient with the plumbing services. I’ll be using them for any future plumbing repairs. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: J Chen
reviews.text: The team is professional and responsive! We asked to replace the pipes and installed a new RO filter under kitchen sink, the new pipes are beautiful!

reviews.author: Nathan
reviews.text:
Ok Above All Plumbing, the staff are amazing and friendly. Ryan and Collin are great at what they do and will make sure they get it right before they leave.

I do a bunch of work in property management in the SF, East Bay and SJ region and they are pretty clutch in the Bay Area.

Ryan is amazing and a wealth of knowledge I actually took a photo of him so if you see him at your door. You are a lucky individual! 6 Stars all around!

A BIG,HUGE Thank you to Ryan and the staff at Above All Plumbing!

- N.

reviews.author: Lorie Mohs
reviews.text:
Well- I have worked with this company a few times and the issues increase with every effort.  The office staff is rude and unwilling to help. They are a barrier to the actual workers.  The work done on our last job had to be corrected twice before it passed inspection.
They also offered to do the job without a permit- CRAZY!  They are making changes to my gas line and they don't want an inspector???
They also tried to charge us for wait times for inspection and called for two inspections verse the one needed.
They also refuse to provide unconditional final waivers for completed jobs.  They state that they only have the 20 pre lim form and don't know how to obtain the waivers.....

Buyer be ware!

I will NEVER do work with them again.

***UPDATE**
Upon seeing my review Rick Brown from Above All Plumbing Call me twice- Yelling at me-
He states that they will now not warrantee  their work because of our bad review.
We finally received our unconditional Final where they incorrectly stated that we owned them an additional $5400.  We paid the contract in full.  WE required them to complete the document correctly.

Above All Plumbing does not have the right to call and harass me for my honest and true review.

***Update 2**
Photos attached.  The incomplete drywall to pass the final was not taken in error.  My husband corrected this issue since Above All did not return on the 1st inspection day to correct the issued.
I have also now been contacted via email which counts as a third harassment issue.

plumbers.name: Streety Plumbing
plumbers.address: 11012 TX-154, Marshall, TX 75670, USA

reviews.author: Murray Hinz
reviews.text: I have renewed faith Humanity again. I called Streety Plumbing for help with make ready for the upcoming freeze and they came out the same day shortly after I called and took care of any and all issues! So Friendly and Professional. Do not hesitate to give them a chance to earn your business! Thank You!

reviews.author: Emma Monroe
reviews.text: I cannot say enough amazing things about Streety Plumbing! We just moved to Marshall and our new “as-is” house was having some plumbing issues after sitting vacant for 1.5 years. Streety Plumbing answered right away and came out within hours. Both were so kind, knowledgeable & helpful. You can’t beat local customer service. We already told them when we re-do our bathrooms and kitchen that they will definitely be the ones to do the installation and handle any other plumbing needs. Affordable & great service! Thank you again, Streety Plumbing!

reviews.author: Dianne Courtney
reviews.text: This company is exceptional. They are very professional, their work is great and they are excellent communicators. We will definitely use them going forward for any of our plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Dianna T
reviews.text: Hands down, such a wonderful experience. I called late evening after a stopped up toilet and a couple leaky sinks. The sinks weren’t as pressing as the toilet, but Chris with Streety Plumbing had someone come out the next day and all of my issues were resolved. Very responsive business, and the technician that came to my house was respectful, knew exactly what to do and was personable as well - thank you again, Easton! Highly, highly recommend Streety Plumbing, I can’t say enough. Cost for the fixes and repairs was super reasonable and I’m so grateful for their help. A+++++ service.

reviews.author: Loren Vargas
reviews.text: I recently used the services of Streety Plumbing, and I highly recommend them! They responded quickly, came to my home right away, and took their time to make sure everything was done right. Their customer service is outstanding, and their work ethic is truly unmatched. I’ll definitely be using them again!

plumbers.name: K.B.I Sewer & Drainage
plumbers.address: 2016 W Indian Ridge Dr, Johnsburg, IL 60051, USA

reviews.author: PermablockTank - FukCal51
reviews.text: Keith and his crew were awesome. They replaced a section of sewer line under my basement floor. Right on time. Super polite. Kept me informed the whole time. Oh, and the work is top notch. Definitely recommend these guys.

reviews.author: Ashleigh Holley
reviews.text: KBI was super respectful and professional when they came to install our new water heater. We had bought our own water heater and had them install it for us. Keith Jr. was so nice and respectful. He did a great job on the installation and even ran out to get a drip pan that we had requested. The price was very reasonable and way less than I expected. We will be using them for all our plumbing needs in the future!

reviews.author: James Kutz
reviews.text:
I had a Sunday afternoon backup of sewage in my basement floor drain. I called and spoke to Keith Jr., who made it by the same day within a couple hours. He talked me through the process and accurately quoted me the cost over the phone. A couple hours later, my sewage line was flowing again. He provided me with some long term solutions and estimates regarding the coming months/years so that I could begin planning for similar issues in the future. He was kind, patient, informative, and diligent considering I needed his services on a Sunday evening. Based on my research, his pricing was very competitive considering the time of the week.

Thank you Keith Jr.!

reviews.author: Jon G
reviews.text: Owner Keith and his team did a wonderful job. Modern equipment , honest, knowledgeable, and great work.  I had drainage issue.  Came out right away for a free estimate.  Access wasn't easy but he showed me using a camera exactly what was going on and offered alternatives.  Keith took care of working with the village and identifying all the lines.  His pricing was good and fair.  The work was done as quickly as possible and was quality work.  Cleaned up everything nicely.  I will use them again and recommend them to everyone.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Bautch
reviews.text: We needed a sewer lateral in our basement repaired and Keith from KBI Plumbing came out immediately to give us a free estimate, which was a great deal more reasonable than the previous contractor had quoted. They were right on time the day the work was scheduled to be done. Their crew was very polite and did a fantastic job. They cleaned everything up, it was left spotless! I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND them! They did an excellent job and were very reasonably priced.

plumbers.name: CJ Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 1906 Greenwood St Unit 2, Evanston, IL 60201, USA

reviews.author: Robert S
reviews.text:
Wish we had not used these plumbers.

1) tried to scam us by using thinner copper than was called out on plans and contract.

2) placed ejector pump float directly below inlet so our basement flooded 3 times with dirty water.

3) no call-no showed seemed like 50% of the time

4) took 3 attempts to pass City rough inspection and 2 tries to pass final

Nitpicking... None of our shower handles are in-line with drains or spouts. And they're off center.

reviews.author: Jawwad Mehmood
reviews.text: I didn't want to leave a negative review. But I am emotionally hurt and overwhelmed for spending $435 for a plumbing Job that took about an hour. I had requested a replacement for Hot and cold water hoses. I also wanted hot and cold water pipes to my washer to be replaced. Yes, I take the blame that I did not communicate effectively about water pipes over the phone which led to my disappointment and dissatisfaction. But for the amount of money I was willing to spend, I deserve better customer service and Job satisfaction I was looking for. During the Job, I had mentioned to Mr. Lenny and Dimitri that I needed new pipes. Lenny became angry and defensive and shifted the blame on me for my lack of communication. I called Dimitri and told him about the escalation. Dimitri did not handle the situation like a true professional. I became really uncomfortable with Lenny and his anger. He demanded Payment with a very rude demeanor.  $435 should be more than enough to cover hot and cold water hoses, and hot and cold water pipes. Again, I don't want to leave a negative review, But I am really upset for not getting the kind of service for my money.

reviews.author: Obi Nnebedum
reviews.text:
Dmitry and Lenny are excellent professionals. They've done two jobs in my 60+ year old building. The first was to help with updating valve fixtures for our basement washer and dryer.

The second was a broken faucet and valve following the cold weather. Though it was a sunday and snowing Dmitry made his way and repaired the faucet. Grateful for them, their transparency and reliability. I do plan to use them again.

reviews.author: Dan Podsedly
reviews.text: CJ plumbing has been our go-to for leaks, frozen pipes, drain issues, etc. Dmitry is always prompt to reply, manages to schedule service same or next day, and the plumbers / technicians always easy to work with and get the job done quickly. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Murray Gordon
reviews.text: We were doing a major remodeling of a 120 year old bathroom. Their work was perfect. They had important, very impactful design ideas that they shared and implemented very cost-effectively. They were cooperative, efficient, and whenever a problem came up, it was solved within an hour. They twisted their schedule around some unpredictabilities on our part. What else could one ask for?

plumbers.name: Midcity Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1425 E Industrial Dr, Itasca, IL 60143, USA

reviews.author: Andrew Bednarz
reviews.text: Local to me company went "ABOVE AND BEYOND" to get our main home bathroom up and running again after a 75 year old cast iron main sanitary pipe, in our basement broke and split in two different areas on the same day! Joe came out and viewed the issue and 24 hrs later, Patrick and Dillon answered the call to duty and cut out the whole house sanitary system and replaced it with PVC professionally done correctly. They also replaced my basement bathroom 20+ yr old ejector pump for my piece of mind...all at a fair price...in less than 8 hours. Midcity plumbing was recommended by multiple employees of my village public works department too!!! They deserve 6 stars...honest!

reviews.author: Carolyn Stocco
reviews.text: I cannot say enough about This company. Every time I’ve used them I’ve been nothing but completely satisfied. I’ve also received compliments from my tenants that the plumbers are always professional, kind and very Skilled at what they do. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Sue C
reviews.text: MidCity Plumbing is a wonderful company to work with and one I would highly recommend. Every person I talked to on the phone, or in person, was competent, efficient, respectful and personable. Billy came to check on a leak and flush my water heater system. He arrived right on time, determined the leak was from the refrigerator line, pulled out the fridge to find the culprit and started the heater flush so I could get the chance to clean under the fridge before he repaired the leak & put the fridge back in place. While the flush was continuing he repaired the leak and moved the refrigerator back. Once the flush was complete he checked all the faucets to make sure all was performing right. He asked if I needed him to check on anything else and was very tolerant of all my stupid questions. I cannot say enough good things about him and the company in general.

reviews.author: Jacqualyn Irmen
reviews.text:
I cant tell you enough good things about Mario, his office help to his plumbling crew just everyone. We have been using midcity for years.
Since I became president of a 49 unit association I new they could help us out when we needed it and they have by   saving  us a couple thousands just on one thing.
They have good employees, good prices and very good work.I appreciate each and every one that works for them.
If you are thinking about calling someone else. What will it hurt to try them.
THANK YOU MIDCITY!!!!!

Very professional and the price was right. I highly recommend them.

Bruce really went above and beyond our expectations and clearly and politely made recommendations for what we should do in the future. We hope to use A&P for our business again in the future.

reviews.author: Dawn Phillips

It’s refreshing to deal with people who know what they’re doing and genuinely care about delivering great service. I’m very happy with the results and wouldn’t hesitate to use them again or recommend them to others!

reviews.author: RzUp
reviews.text:
I contacted Redbeard Plumbing, LLC to repair an internal water pipe that was leaking and had caused a great deal of damage to my basement. I was in need of getting someone out fairly quickly bc my water had to be turned off to prevent further damage. I spoke with Sam and shortly after I was assigned a plumber who was scheduled to arrive within hour. Donovan arrived and immediately diagnosed the issue. He thoroughly explained and demostrated exactly what needed to be done.  He worked on the pipe inside, as well as changing the hose bib outside (despite having to walk through ice). Within a couple hours my repair was completed and I had running water again!
Donovan also provided information on options for future updates to some of my dated equipment which I appreciated. I highly recommend Redbeard Plumbing, from their customer service to their actual plumbing skill. I would definitely contact them again! Thank you!

reviews.author: j B
reviews.text: It’s hard to find genuine, honest professionals these days. Sam was extremely professional, knowledgeable and transparent about the plumbing needs and what to expect. He provided quality services with excellence and was a pleasure to work with. I highly recommend his services and would use him again.

reviews.author: DB Carey
reviews.text: These guys have a 5 star rating in all of their reviews for a reason.  I had an emergency situation and called Tuesday morning.  Fortunately for me they were finishing up a job nearby and were at my house in about 30 minutes.  They were able to diagnose the problem quickly, quoted me a price and started right away. They explained everything clearly as they were working and made suggestions about other things they noticed  (that didn't need immediate repair) as they went along. Sam & Donovan did great work and they will be the first I call in the future!

reviews.author: Eric Hedges
reviews.text: Had a pipe break for my shower and I called this company at 830am. At 11am they were here and spent 3 hours repairing the leak and making it as good as new. Great company and decent price for repair. Would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Jared Rodriguez
reviews.text: Sam explained the process to me and his employee did a great job as well. Just waiting on the final steps for the permit and everything is good to go. Would recommend and use in the future.

plumbers.name: Robbie's Plumbing Service INC
plumbers.address: 14915 US-301, Dade City, FL 33523, USA

reviews.author: ann johnson
reviews.text: Robbie's was called at 7:30am.  They arrived at 9:30am.  Quick service!  Immediately fixed a main water pipe to house.  I kept adding jobs:  undersink "J" pipes, clogged drain, new kitchen faucet.  Craig was extremely patient, polite and efficient.  He knows what he is doing!!!.   Top of my list to use again.

reviews.author: Howard Creps
reviews.text:
Robbie was hired to do an entire replumb of a mobile home. He did a partial amount of the work, I don't even think it was half, which happened to be the master bathroom and it was not done correctly. My floor got flooded twice with brown water because the slope on the pipes he installed was not good enough to pull everything down as it should have been.
Then when it came to the other portion of the work that I prepaid for by the way, it just did not get done so I was ripped off for thousands.
I also had to go through probably at least 20 delays. Excuses that ranged from relatives dying to being in the hospital or a traffic accident happened etcetera every excuse in the book. Then towards the end of things he would flat out make an appointment with me, not show up, not inform me that he wasn't showing up and when I reached out to him he would tell me he was on another job. So I asked him why are you at another job when you're supposed to be here and I get no good or legitimate answer, he got my money and blew me off.
Then there was one thing and one thing only changed from the original plan, which was doing nothing more than adding one single pipe which was only something like 10 ft long and tying it into the rest of the system. it did not span the entire length of the mobile home or anything like that it was just a 10-foot section added and that single addition, he charged me I think it was $1,500 or $2,000 to add this one pipe. Which is one of the pipes that was not put in correctly. it was not at the right angle and everything backed up But he knew that I had already purchased the hot tub so I guess since he thought he had me by the balls he'd overcharge the crap out of me.
I've now had work done by an actual Pro and everything works great and I will be proceeding with a lawsuit against Robbie's plumbing. I have also reported him to every agency I could find out there that had to do with fraud and scams.
If anybody else has a situation like this, feel free to reach out to me and maybe we'll even get a class action thing going. You can find me on Google or Facebook and other social media with the same name I'm posting this under.
I also want to point out that when researching his company there are two registered companies through sunbiz with two different addresses but the same Robert Westmoreland as owner, and both of those addresses are based out of either Dade City or plant City Florida. But if you look at the department of Business and professional regulation website he has an address registered in Chiefland Florida which is where I'm at and this incident occurred and it is this address that is tied to his license number.
Since I will be sending him legal mail I had to figure all of this out and it looks to me like number one he's not updating the information on sunbiz as he should as a professional and number two I've seen similar situations and learned the hard way before that this is usually done purposely to cause confusion in a situation just like mine. Making things unclear and muddying the waters so that it's hard to even properly get ahold of the guy but he does still have the same phone number. There is also no Google listing like this for his Chiefland address. So everything on this listing and the other one is actually old and outdated but I'm still posting in hopes that people see it.
His business listing on Google implies that this is a family-owned and operated business. However I'm a little unsure if that's true. Sometimes he had an assistant with him but this was not his son this was some hired help. Plus I just can't see his wife going along with what he did to me unless she's in on it also and likes to con and scam too.
Happy holidays. Be careful everybody and check the better Business bureau for a credit to the companies through them which his company is not by the way

reviews.author: Jessica Santarelli
reviews.text: Decided to work with Robbie’s Plumbing after calling upwards of 7 different plumbers and so glad we did! Professional office staff, quick turn-around time on a fair and reasonable estimate/job, and work completed professionally and pleasantly. Chris was well-versed and knowledgeable in installing our owner-supplied RO system at our kitchen sink, while making accommodations for future service with our limited under cabinet storage. He also installed our water softener and whole-home filter. When our softener loop wasn’t compatible with our system, he installed a drainage path directly under the utility sink in the pipes. Everything looks so nice and clean! So beyond happy with the work and my new filters!

reviews.author: Terry Rooker
reviews.text: WOW! I called at 10am for a small leak under the kitchen sink and was promised a tech within 2 hours.  Not only did the technician show up within 2 hours, the job was completed by 12pm!!!  Chris communicated the problem, the solution and completed the repairs with efficiency, knowledge and great customer service!  Highly, highly reccommend this company!

reviews.author: Jazmine Daughtry
reviews.text: Chris, Megan and Melissa were absolutely amazing to deal with. Chris completed a complete re-pipe at our home and an addition of a new bathroom… we are completely renovating, Chris made it all very simple and his pricing are very reasonable. He went above and beyond for us and always went the extra mile. Our new plumbing looks amazing and has passed every inspection. Megan and Melissa were also Incredibly helpful and answered any questions I had and always made themselves available. It was great customer service and I would use them again in a heartbeat. Thanks so much.

plumbers.name: Chase & Sons Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1383 N Abby St, Fresno, CA 93703, USA

reviews.author: J Howard
reviews.text: The plumbers did an excellent job finding and fixing my water leak. They carefully checked all the pipes and explained everything before starting the repair. Even though the main water line needed to be replaced, they made sure to do the work in the most cost-effective way possible. Santiago and Blake were always on time, calling ahead before they arrived each day to make sure someone was home. The new main line was installed with great skill, and now I feel much more confident about my plumbing. The whole experience was smooth, and I’m very happy with the results. I would definitely recommend Chase & Sons Plumbing for any future plumbing work.

reviews.author: travis castillo
reviews.text: I recently had a problem with my kitchen sink drain getting clogged and backing up, even though I’m always careful about what goes down the pipes. With guests coming over early the next day, I needed a plumber fast. I called a highly recommended plumbing company after regular hours, hoping for the best. To my surprise, Walter answered right away, even though it was late and he’d already had a busy day. He promised he would come by that night to fix my plumbing issue. Walter showed up at 9pm, ready to tackle the job. Despite my older plumbing system giving him a bit of trouble, he got everything flowing smoothly again in less than 45 minutes. His prices were very fair—much better than what I’ve paid in the past for handyman work that never lasted. Walter was careful, put down drop cloths, and cleaned up completely when he was done. He was also very friendly, taking the time to chat with my young child and making us feel comfortable. Walter is both professional and personable, and it’s clear he really knows his stuff. I would definitely recommend him to anyone in need of a reliable plumber. I also found out he does bathroom remodels, so I’ll be reaching out to him again soon!

reviews.author: krystal morrow
reviews.text: Jerome arrived ahead of schedule for my appointment and quickly took care of all my plumbing issues. He found the leak under my kitchen sink, which turned out to be a problem with the drain seal, and he also figured out that a loose toilet upstairs was causing a water stain on my kitchen ceiling. Jerome cleared out two slow drains—one in the tub and one in the laundry sink—and even replaced the old faucet on my laundry sink, which hadn’t been shutting off properly for years. He shared some helpful tips on keeping drains clear without using harsh chemicals. I’m very happy with the quality of work and would definitely call Jerome again, though everything is working so well now that I probably won’t need to for a while.

reviews.author: Carmen Briggs
reviews.text: I’ve had to call for emergency plumbing help twice—once for a big leak, and another time when our basement flooded because the sump pump stopped working. Both times, Chase & Sons Plumbing responded right away. Curtis showed up in less than 20 minutes after I called about the flood, and had everything fixed and the new pump installed in under an hour. He also took the time to explain what we could do to avoid this kind of problem in the future and suggested the best products for our needs. We just moved to Fresno and needed a reliable plumber, and I’m really glad we found them. The prices are fair, and it’s clear that they care about doing honest work and making sure customers are happy. I would definitely recommend them to anyone in need of plumbing services in the area.

reviews.author: Lyla Wilcox
reviews.text: Walter and the owner were a pleasure to work with. When other local plumbers couldn’t fit me in, Chase & Sons Plumbing showed up at my door within an hour of my call. They quickly figured out the issue with my newer water heater and took care of the warranty process by working directly with the manufacturer and a parts supplier. The repair and installation were completed in less than an hour, and everything was left neat and tidy. Friendly, professional, and reliable—definitely the kind of team you want handling your plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: 24/7 Rescue Plumbing Services inc
plumbers.address: 7359 Kester Ave #2, Van Nuys, CA 91405, USA

reviews.author: Shannon Peiper
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with George from 24/7 Rescue, and I couldn’t be more impressed. From start to finish, George was professional, punctual, and incredibly helpful. He took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all of my questions, and made what could have been a stressful situation feel completely manageable.

Not only did he resolve the plumbing issue quickly and efficiently, but he also went above and beyond to ensure everything was working perfectly before he left. His friendly demeanor and dedication to excellent service truly set him apart.

I highly recommend George and 24/7 Rescue to anyone in need of reliable, high-quality plumbing work. It’s not often you come across such trustworthy and pleasant professionals—thank you, George!

reviews.author: Eli Carrillo
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Rescue Plumbing Services Inc.! From the moment I called, the customer service was friendly and professional. He took the time to explain everything in detail and answered all my questions. The work was completed quickly, and the pricing was fair and transparent. I highly recommend them for any plumbing needs and will definitely call them again for future services!

reviews.author: Jason G

The price was very fair and George was outstanding , took the time to explain everything that he was going to do and how much it was going to cost all before he started. I would not hesitate to call 24/7 rescue plumbing in the future for plumbing issues with the outstanding service that George provided.

reviews.author: Michelle Yoo

It was late at night, and true to their name, 24/7 really means 24/7! Not only were they fast, but they were also honest and straightforward, which I truly appreciated in a stressful situation. Thank you for the prompt and reliable service. You really came through when I needed it most!

reviews.author: Sarah Etheridge
reviews.text: George was beyond nice and helpful. Came out immediately and fixed my urgent issue. He was personable and explained every step of the process and tried to do everything he could to save me money. I will be using him for all plumbing issues moving forward and can't recommend him enough!

reviews.author: Roger Trigo
reviews.text: Balkan Plumbing is the best. Fast friendly service. They have done big projects for me replacing water heater and smaller plumbing projects replacing bathtub faucets. I always recommend them.

reviews.author: Max Albert
reviews.text: I had a pipe leak and needed reliable plumbing help quickly. I contacted Balkan Plumbing Littleton, and their team arrived on time, diagnosed the issue fast, and completed the repair with great quality and care. They explained everything clearly and made sure everything was fixed perfectly before leaving. The service was professional, friendly, and fairly priced. reviews.author: Rebecca Bullock Jarrett
reviews.text:
We have used After Hours in the past and have always gotten fantastic service, although I should note that my husband usually does the easy plumbing jobs. My husband is currently remodeling our bathrooms. In an attempt to be a sweet, loving wife, I suggested he call After Hours when he discovered that the shut off valve (pretty sure that is what he called it) to one of the toilets needed to be replaced. And, here is where I made my big mistake, I told him to have After Hours install our 2 new faucets (including 2 new p traps) in the sinks in the 2 baths as well. He kept saying that he could do, but I insisted because the tile job hasn't been fun. We noticed one sink was leaking at the p trap that night. I told him to call After Hours back but he said it was was easier to fix it himself. Then last weekend, I discovered the one in my kids' bathroom had been leaking a good bit (thankfully, I had put all my painting supplies in there including a very absorbant dropcloth). At that point, even though my husband could fix it, I insisted he call After Hours because we paid over $700 for this service. The next day, the original plumber returned, said he tightened the seal, and, less than 5 minute in our house, left. Within 5 minutes, we saw it was still leaking. The owner came two days later and insisted it was our brand new faucet and replaced it with another new one that I have. Guess what?!? He leaves and the p trap is STILL LEAKING!! I am not a plumber - heck,  I am not even handy - and even I can tell where the leak is. I cannot for the life of me figure out why After Hours will not admit that they bought very cheap, crappy p traps, but they will not. So my trying to be a good wife has backfired. And my husband gets to keep pointing out that he would have done it right the first time for a lot less than $700.
Edit: It was the p traps that were leaking.  Changing out the p traps wouldn't have stopped the leak if it was a faulty faucet.  Additionally, you changed the faucet, and we still had a leak. Thus far, I haven't asked for a refund, but I am about to do.
Mistakes happened. It is how you handle it that matters.

He was very upfront about all pricing and what he was working on and explaining everything he had done and what future options could be if I wanted to replace it. My hot water heater is now working as intended and we can now take hot showers again.

reviews.author: Cecil Clarke Jr.
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with Brian the plumber and his partner Bill today. I was dealing with a persistent water hammer issue that caused loud banging and inconsistent water pressure. From the very first interaction, Brian was incredibly respectful, transparent, and detail-oriented. Both Brian and Bill arrived promptly for the consultation and the actual repair. They were courteous, respectful, and took the time to answer every question I had. Their work was clean and thorough, and Brian even provided additional insights and recommendations for future plumbing needs my home may require.

I truly appreciate Brian’s honesty, fair pricing, and high-quality workmanship. I will absolutely be using Brian and his company for any future plumbing projects. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Linda Paese
reviews.text:
Brian of Carter Quality Plumbing installed a new sump pump for us.  He provided outstanding customer service from start to finish. He was punctual, professional, and thorough in explaining everything.  He gave us honest options and provided quality service.  He made sure everything was working and left the basement spotless. I now have peace of mind that our basement will not flood. He also fixed a toilet that I mentioned was having problems while he was here.
If you need a reliable plumber who does quality work I highly recommend Carter Quality Plumbing

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 21057 AL-251, Athens, AL 35614, USA

reviews.author: Micheal Maggard
reviews.text: Water leak from a previous frozen pipe. Was in a very tight spot, but  Travis figured out how to get to. His experience and can do attitude resulted in a quick and neat repair. Thanks for a job well done

reviews.author: Lanier greenhaw
reviews.text: Was given a price range for rerouting a sewer line. The estimate had a $2,000 spread (to cover any unforeseen things.) The work ended up being minimal with no digging under house, just a 8 ft straight trench. Was charged towards the higher price. Pleased with the work, not with the price. Would not use again.

reviews.author: Jenny Bramlette
reviews.text: My appointment was set at 8AM-10AM. Received a text saying tech was on his way at 08:24. He did not show up until 11:00 AM. My time is as valuable as anyone else’s. Cancelled appointment and sent him on his way. I am not doing business with a company that cannot keep appointments. No reasonable explanation given as to why it took 21/2 hours to get to my home.

reviews.author: Chelsea Ray
reviews.text: We had our 1,000 gallon septic tank pumped and the filter cleaned. They were able to come next day. The timing was great. It was a little more than I was hoping to pay at $575, but I guess prices have risen with inflation. The workers that came were very kind, professional, and efficient. They called to give a 30 minute lead time. The job only took about 30 minutes.

reviews.author: Annette Barnes
reviews.text: We have a historic home and were having problems with the kitchen sink backing up.  The technician arrived as promised and determined that we would have to replace all the plumbing in the kitchen.  He arrived promptly the next morning and had us fixed up by noon.  The technicians were extremely courteous, friendly, knowledgeable and professional.  They explained the cost involved and we though it was fair and reasonable.  I will definitely use them again for any future plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: Dam Plumbing and Drain
plumbers.address: 3980 Tampa Rd Suite 205P, Oldsmar, FL 34677, USA

reviews.author: Vincent Saunders
reviews.text:
I can't say enough good things about Lucy, Derrick, and the fantastic team at Dam Plumbing and Drain! From the moment their technician arrived, we felt valued and understood. He was not only friendly but also took the time to thoroughly explain the plumbing issues we were facing and outlined each step of the repair process in detail.

We discovered a significant problem when water began to leak into our garage. It turned out that some pipes installed on the exterior of our home had no UV protection, and after getting baked by the Florida sun, they became almost undetectable misting machines, creating a flood we couldn’t ignore. To make matters worse, our water softener had seen better days and was doing more harm than good.

Thanks to Dam Plumbing and Drain, we now have a brand-new softener system, and they did an amazing job patching our pipes. Their team is incredibly efficient, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about their customers. The best part? Our water bill, which used to hover between $350 and $400 a month, just dropped to an astonishing $83! That's right, you read that correctly. This alone speaks volumes about their service.

If you're looking for reliable plumbing solutions, I wholeheartedly recommend Dam Plumbing and Drain. They truly deserve a Grade A for their exceptional service! Thank you, Lucy, Dan, and the team, for everything

reviews.author: Evrosina Ibrahim
reviews.text:
Dam Plumbing is truly the best in the area. Derrick is incredibly responsive, knowledgeable, and professional. When we discovered a leak, he came out the same day, quickly diagnosed the issue, and immediately put a plan in place.

The leak unfortunately led to mold, and Derrick didn’t skip a beat — he coordinated with water restoration professionals the very next day to make sure everything was handled properly and safely. I’m currently pregnant and on a strict timeline, and he went out of his way to prioritize our project and make sure everything stayed on schedule. That level of care and consideration meant so much to us.

This isn’t my first time working with Derrick and his team. As an interior designer, I’ve trusted Dam Plumbing with client projects, and they consistently exceed expectations. They finish on time (often ahead of schedule), communicate clearly, and are always fair and honest and the best part is you know what you're getting every single time (which is the best quality of work).

If you’re looking for a plumbing company you can trust completely, Dam Plumbing is it. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dan Bova
reviews.text:
Dam Plumbing exceeded expectations. They came out on Thanksgiving for us after our toddler flushed a pool ball down the toilet.
Professional, responsive, and efficient. It’s refreshing to work with a company that values quality workmanship and customer service. Highly recommend to anyone needing reliable plumbing services.

Chris even took out all the mess I created before calling them.

reviews.author: jerold strahan
reviews.text: Derrick and Lucy at Dam Plumbing and Drain are great people to work with and true professionals. We refer work to each other regularly, and it’s been a solid partnership because I know their team takes care of our customers the right way. Whether it’s a service call, a larger plumbing issue, or plumbing work needed during a remodel, they’re reliable, responsive, and easy to communicate with. I trust them with anyone we send their way, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone I know who needs quality plumbing work done.

reviews.author: John Loiudice
reviews.text: I recently had plumbing issues where my toilet would clog regularly.  I checked several companies online and spoke to a few. I chose Dam Plumbing because there wasn’t a trip fee and they were very responsive. Chris arrived on time and explained potential costs before doing any work. He inspected my line and the issue was with my toilet which had the Flushmate assist feature which was crating the problem. He offered me low cost alternatives such as replacing the valve or possibly the tank but I’ve had problems with this toilet since a few months afternoon installation. He recommended that I replace the toilet which I decided was the best move. I was very pleased with his professionalism and he was able to replace the toilet although it was afternoon on a Friday. It was done at a reasonable price. Chris, as well as Lucy at the office went above and beyond to make sure I was satisfied with the results.  I’ll definitely be using Dam Plumbing in the future and I highly recommend them for any one looking for quality service.

plumbers.name: Supreme Home Services
plumbers.address: 988 Mercury Cir, Lone Tree, CO 80124, USA

reviews.author: Lindsey
reviews.text: Elias was very knowledgeable and solved our heating issue quickly! He was friendly and helped us to understand how the furnace works and how he identifies the issue. He went above and beyond! Also, Kay reached out to us quickly to schedule the appointment. Supreme Home Services provided great customer service and I would highly recommend using them!

reviews.author: Kate Brewer
reviews.text: Do not hire this person for a ductless minisplit system, he is dishonest and work is below industry standard.  He installed the system incorrectly, including 4 leaks in the copper lines, and did not detect the leaks upon installation.  After those leaks were fixed, his leak detection system continued to be inaccurate, and he cut holes in my new drywall to try to locate leaks behind the drywall that did not exist.  He refuses to pay to fix the drywall damage.  He installed the drains wrong for all 7 ceiling cassettes, which resulted in water backing into all the unites.  One unit had a large electrical explosion from the water, which could have caused a house fire.  He accidentally cut my new PEX water supply line and water poured into my basement.  He did not correctly install the clamps for two drain fitting, where the clamps were just on the pipe and not the fitting itself, resulting in additional leaks.  I had to hire another company to get my system working, as Uli said there were leaks in the condenser unit and line, which did not exist.  He wanted to charge me over $2k to replace a new condenser that was not damaged.  Instead of paying the bill for the new company to diagnose what he misdiagnosed, he hired an attorney.  Dishonest in other regards as well throughout installation.

reviews.author: Julie F
reviews.text: Ulysses diagnosed and repaired my furnace very quickly.  They were very willing to deal with my warranty company as well.  Great folks and very decent to work with.

reviews.author: Ryan Bonneau
reviews.text: Eli Alfaro is the best! He made multiple trips out of his way, he was very informative and honest about what was happening with the Furnace. I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for help with HVAC plumbing or electric.

reviews.author: Jose Padilla
reviews.text: After talking to the owner about the first service call not at my satisfactory the owner send another tech to do the furnace tune up at no cost to me and the tech did a fantastic job! This company stepped up to the plate and got my total approval of the work. I will not hesitate to use this company again! I have them on my contact list so I can use them again.

plumbers.name: Budget Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 10 Hilltop Ave, Greenville, SC 29609, USA

reviews.author: Drew Pearce
reviews.text: After calling for an estimate, Budget Plumbing came out to make a much needed repair today. As usual, Tom and Sean did an excellent job.   Tom assessed the situation, explained what was required to make the repair and confirmed the estimated cost.  He and Sean worked together, finished the job promptly, and everything looked great.  They inspected the work, tested the system and as a courtesy, inspected the plumbing for a shower drain as well.  The cost ended up being exactly as estimated over the phone and in person.  No up-charges, no surprises.  We have used Budget many times over the years.  They do quality work, at a reasonable price, promptly.  They also clean up behind themselves and leave things better than they found them.  We couldn’t be more pleased to do business with Budget!

reviews.author: David Payne
reviews.text: Budget Plumbing is among the most reliable service providers I have ever used. I have trusted their services for over 25 years, and they have consistently demonstrated exceptional professionalism. They are always punctual, respectful of my property, and prompt in addressing any issue. Their workmanship is consistently excellent, and they reliably resolve problems correctly the first time. I highly recommend Budget Plumbing without reservation—they are simply the best in the industry.

reviews.author: Jessie Modlin
reviews.text: So happy with our service! Budget is our go to plumber and is always good work at the most fair price. They will also never try to suggest work that you don't *actually* need. When we have searched for pricing, they are consistently the most affordable, so we don't even call around anywhere now!

reviews.author: Lacy Tapp Wilder
reviews.text: I’ve had a great experience with this plumber on multiple jobs. They’re quick to respond, always show up on time, and explain everything clearly. The work is done professionally, the pricing is very fair, and the service is honest and reliable. I’d definitely hire them again and recommend them to anyone needing plumbing work!

reviews.author: Susan Carroll
reviews.text: Tom and his crew did a great job replacing defective toilet seals (wax rings), toilet tank parts, leak detection (cutting open a wall) and installation of a new p-trap under the sink. I highly recommend Budget Plumbing. They are prompt, efficient, and leave all areas they’ve repaired very clean, with no trace that they’ve even been there. Tom is very fair with job prices, as well.

plumbers.name: Valley Plumbing Heating & Cooling
plumbers.address: 406 S Jordan Pkwy W #440, South Jordan, UT 84095, USA

reviews.author: Tyler Hiebert
reviews.text:
Jeremy Gellersen from Valley Plumbing Heating & Cooling was absolutely outstanding! He responded quickly and arrived at our home the same day we called about a leaking pipe behind the shower wall.
From the moment he stepped inside, Jeremy was incredibly respectful of our home—careful with our belongings, using drop cloths and booties, and leaving everything spotless when he finished. He took the time to thoroughly explain what was causing the leak, walked us through the repair process step by step, and answered every question with patience and clarity. No rush, no jargon we couldn’t understand—just honest, informative communication.
He expertly accessed and repaired the leaking pipe behind the wall, and the job was done cleanly and efficiently. We’re so grateful for his professionalism, skill, and genuinely kind demeanor. Jeremy is a true professional and we wouldn’t hesitate to call him again or recommend him to anyone needing top-notch plumbing service.
If you want great work done right the first time, ask for Jeremy Gellersen—you won’t be disappointed! 5 stars all the way.

reviews.author: Maria Oliver
reviews.text: Eddie and Lae did a great job with plumbing at my home today. They installed two new toilets for me. Eddie has helped us in the past as well replacing some piping and installing a new shower faucet for us. Professional, efficient, and friendly. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tiffany Walters
reviews.text: My heater was blowing only cold air.  Technician  JT was excellent and very knowledgeable. He quickly and efficiently resolved the issue at a very reasonable price.  I would highly recommend him in the future.

reviews.author: M Tuttle
reviews.text: Eddie and Landon did a great job cutting in a new clean-out and auguring our under-the-basement sewer line.  Then sent a camera down to assure us it had been cleaned out and had no major issues.  Since the line was quite scaled up, Eddie recommended a product that would clean the sludge up and do an even better job - in a 50year old line.  we had major work done 10 months ago, replacing part and relining part of the sewer line from the house to the main line. Valley did a great job.  At that time I purchased the membership which was around $80. And due to that, we saved over $200 on this project. I believe Valley plumbing is honest, Efficient, does quality work and to top it off, cleans up after themselves afterwards. I would recommend them to anyone needing plumbing inside or out.

reviews.author: Chad Gord
reviews.text: Jay Hardman came to my home today and did a tune up and repair on my furnace. He was friendly, knowledgeable and very helpful in getting things fixed up and running great. I’m very happy with his service and professionalism.

plumbers.name: That Plumber
plumbers.address: 2398 Smith Kramer St NE, Hartville, OH 44632, USA

reviews.author: Roger Schuler
reviews.text:
I had a pipe break behind the wall in my shower. I called and talked to Stacy who was very nice and helpful. They got me scheduled within 24 hours. Jason came out to fix the shower. He was very knowledgeable and very careful fixing my shower.
If you are looking for an honest knowledgable plumber. Look no further.

Roger Schuler

reviews.author: Kelly Maddock
reviews.text: Great service and very fair pricing!! I was able to get a next day appointment, Steve the plumber came to the house on time, was very respectful and had the job done professionally and with no delays! Great communication from the office staff as well. Would not hesitate to call again or recommend!

reviews.author: Dianna Mamo
reviews.text:
@thatplumber
I recently had a bathroom Reno done by this company. What an amazing experience from start to finish. Clayton went to great lengths with prepping my villa so that the rest of my villa would not be impacted by the Reno. So I can highly recommend this company and as you can see they did an" Absolutely Stunning" job.
Can't Thankyou Enough Clayton Sellings
Regards Dianne Mamo

reviews.author: Dee Beeman
reviews.text: Our second time using That Plumber. They got us on the schedule for next day hot water tank replacement. They arrived as scheduled,  prepped area to leave no mess & had the job done in short order. Prices are fair, quality work. We won’t hesitate to contact them again.

reviews.author: Jason Ross
reviews.text: Work was fine but definitely overpriced for the task and time required. Didn’t have all material needed to complete task and had to leave to get more even though they knew what they were getting into so that was a little unprofessional. When asked for an itemized receipt after getting the overpriced bill it seemed like we were inconveniencing them. Partially our fault for not asking for an estimate before the work was done, lesson learned there. If we use them again we will be price checking with other companies.

plumbers.name: Maryland Clover Plumbing and Gas
plumbers.address: 8081 Snouffer School Rd, Gaithersburg, MD 20879, USA

reviews.author: Aisha Satterwhite Chavers
reviews.text: Our hot water heater died and we were able to get Maryland Clover out for a service call on the same day. They scoured local suppliers to find a new unit in stock that fit our very specific setup - it required a power vent - and we were back in business with hot water within 2 days! They also replaced a bad pipe in the process. A few days later, our kitchen faucet broke, so we asked Maryland Clover to come back out and install a new faucet. Both jobs were seamless and clean and the guys were great. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sue Bunting
reviews.text: I’m so happy with the work done by Maryland Clover Plumbing! They installed a new sink, garbage disposal, and faucet during my kitchen renovation last year, and did such a great job that I asked them to help with updating a powder room by re-setting the toilet and installing a new sink. The whole crew is friendly, efficient, and meticulous about cleaning up after themselves. I highly recommend Maryland Clover!

reviews.author: Mz. Diamond
reviews.text: I wanted a fireplace installed in my master bedroom.  It had always been my dream.  I reached out to Maryland Clover and they sent out Trevor.  From the moment he walked in my home, his mannerisms, knowledge etc. was A1.  He didn't know it but he had already won the bid on the job.  And when he told me the price it confirmed I had made the correct choice.  My project took a lot longer than we all had expected due to my work schedule.  Through it all Trevor was patient with me, if I ever had a question he answered promptly.  I am happy to say today 8.27.2021 we are all done.  I will be hiring these guys for any future projects, as well as recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Front Desk
reviews.text: Treavor from Maryland Clover Plumbing was incredibly helpful and courteous! He promptly arrived at our site and efficiently diagnosed the issue within an hour. We scheduled another appointment for him to resolve everything, and he arrived promptly, working diligently to fix the problem. His politeness and hard work were evident throughout, and now we have hot water again! Additionally, Kimberly provided excellent customer service, responding quickly to our inquiries. Highly recommended for their excellent service.

reviews.author: Nanthini K.
reviews.text:
Contacted Maryland Clover for an estimate about replacing my bathroom faucet. They managed to schedule me in the same day I called, and we were greeted by Correy D at our door.

Correy was extremely pleasant and professional. He was also very easy to talk to and friendly. He gave me an estimate of how much the replacement would cost and told me he could do it the same day. Price was reasonable and he did an amazing job. Definitely would want to work with him again in future for any plumbing issues.

plumbers.name: Peter Paul's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1902 US-80, White Oak, TX 75693, USA

reviews.author: james white
reviews.text: I am super pleased with the work and professionalism with my Water Heater replacement. The crew was super knowledgeable, courteous,and great to talk with. Extreme care was taken with my property , and they went through great lengths to make sure I knew what they were doing.  The main office is a pleasure to deal with and never made me feel like an annoying customer.  I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Billy Brown
reviews.text: Both plumbers were very courteous and easy to talk to about my plumbing problem. They fixed it in about an hour and did a professional job. I will definitely have them come out and do more jobs in the future .

reviews.author: vicky king
reviews.text: Prompt replies and response from the office and the job was completed timely and done expertly.  Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Larry Hibbert
reviews.text: They hooked up the gas for our new pool heater and re-lit my fireplace pilot light. Kyle was great like always! Peter Paul is definitely my go to for any future service

reviews.author: Tracy White
reviews.text: I thought the original price was high for the helper who didn't do much except observe.  We had problems with one bathroom sink and the washing machine plugging with debris stirred up from the outdoor valve replacement.  Peter Paul Plumbing came back and fixed these problems for free which I felt made up for the original charge being high.

plumbers.name: Allstar Plumbing Experts
plumbers.address: 709 Little John Cove, La Vergne, TN 37086, USA

reviews.author: Sam Moxley
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough great things about Allstar Plumbing Experts! From start to finish, the experience was seamless. Nicole’s customer service is absolutely awesome; she was friendly, responsive, and made scheduling everything incredibly easy. You can tell she genuinely cares about customers and making sure things run smoothly.

James and the rest of the team were quick, professional, and clearly knew exactly what they were doing. They showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and got the job done efficiently without cutting corners. It’s such a relief to work with a team that’s both skilled and respectful of our time and home.

If you’re looking for reliable plumbing experts who deliver top-notch service, I cannot recommend Allstar Plumbing Experts enough!

reviews.author: Linda Glover
reviews.text: I needed a kitchen faucet replaced and after calling around to different plumbers I had someone come out because their service fee was the cheapest but when he got here and gave me the quote he wanted over $800 to install a simple kitchen faucet I sent him on his way. Luckily All Star Plumbing had also gotten back with me and while their assessment fee was not the lowest their pricing ended up being the best and Christopher and Bradley were very quick to get my faucet installed and make the Minor Adjustments needed to set it to my satisfaction and I couldn't be more pleased and it cost me $150 I would highly recommend I'll start Plumbing for their honest and fair pricing and good service

reviews.author: Tanya Sykes
reviews.text: We  had a water leak we could NOT locate, and it was a gusher. We were racking up those water bills. We finally got American Leak Detection out and they located it. Apparently this is a BUSY time and it was going to be a while before they could do the repair. They graciously referred us to their trusted partner, Allstar Plumbing Experts.  These guys worked so hard yesterday, working in the dark till about 9:30 to ensure we’d have water this morning. They came back today to clean up and sow some grass seed. They did end up having to saw through the aggregate, but this could have been sooo much worse. James charged me a fair price and was very helpful. We’re thankful the leak wasn’t in our slab (old house) and that these guys have been wonderful to work with. I highly recommend both services should you need them, but hopefully you won’t! Just another thing to be thankful for this season.

reviews.author: Julie Phillips
reviews.text: Highly recommend All Star Plumbing and James. We had a major burst pipe under our foundation and James was able to correctly diagnose the problem (multiple other plumbers could not) and fixed it with very responsive, professional service. He did excellent work, cleaned up after himself and was on time. He really stands out for great communication and quality. We obviously used him for our next project- a basement bathroom addition. He went above and beyond to make sure everything was correct. We recommend him to all our friends. I trust his work and his advice.

reviews.author: Chris Champion
reviews.text: James gave me a estimate, and was able to replace my water heater in the same day, even though they were busy from the extreme cold and recent ice storm.

plumbers.name: Wave Plumbing & Heating-Hayward Plumber
plumbers.address: 2416 W Tennyson Rd #258, Hayward, CA 94545, USA

reviews.author: Joy Schelin
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Wave Plumbing. They replaced my water heater and did an excellent job. Their pricing was very competitive, they were easy to work with, and communication was clear and consistent from start to finish.They also replaced a toilet for me. I am extremely happy with the quality of the work they provided. They also addressed some of my other plumbing concerns and explained the ins and outs of plumbing to which I am very  grateful for. I would definitely recommend Wave Plumbing to anyone looking for reliable plumbing services.

reviews.author: Ngoc T Dang
reviews.text: My landlord reached out to Wave Plumbing and Heating after the water heater at our condo started to make rumbling noise like a running motor. Once we sent them the pictures, video, and description of the issue, their plumber provided a ETA and he showed up on time. He ended up replacing the whole water heater due to severe leaking signs which took him around 7 hours. Even that, he stayed late to ensure we fully understand what needs to be on the look out for the next couple days and steps to take in case there's sign of leaking or strange noise.

reviews.author: Yulei Aung
reviews.text: I was in need for plumber on Sunday morning. He picked up my early morning call. Told me will be there between 10:30-11:30 and he showed up within the time frame. Unclog the toilet. Recommend me to get a new one and of course explained why I should replace. I have dealt with other plumbers they said the same thing to replace but do not give reasons. But I like the way he approaches the issue. I have decided to replace it. His cost for plumbing job is below market for emergency Sunday . Thank you and I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Shameel Hassan
reviews.text:
I recently had a kitchen faucet installed and couldn’t be happier with the service! Fareed was on time, professional, and very knowledgeable. He explained everything clearly, worked efficiently, and made sure the installation was done perfectly. The area was left clean, and the new faucet looks and works great.

Highly recommend for anyone needing quality plumbing work, excellent service from start to finish. I am also a repeat customer due to the quality of job he did.

reviews.author: Samara Holmes
reviews.text: I had Wave Plumbing & Heating come out to replace my sink, and they did an excellent job! The work was quick, clean, and professional. I’m really happy with the result and will definitely call them again for future plumbing needs. Highly recommend if you need a reliable plumber in the northern Cali area with reasonable prices.

plumbers.name: Bukowski Plumbing Inc.
plumbers.address: 14 Stiles Ave, Maple Shade, NJ 08052, USA

reviews.author: Jennifer Buongiorno
reviews.text: I wish I could give this review 10 stars. Robert is without a doubt the most honest man and plumber I have ever had the pleasure of meeting. He does the absolute best work and communicates with the customer to tell them exactly what’s going on and how he will fix it. Since moving to my new house, I’ve had to call in for two emergencies and he was able to come same day within an hour. It is clear how knowledgeable he is and there is literally no plumbing issue that he can’t do or fix. It’s very clear he cares about what he does and wants to ensure safety and happiness for all of his customers. He’s incredibly responsive, follows up, and makes sure he gets the job done right - every single time. His two sons, Dylan and Jesse, are also wonderful. If you live in the New Jersey area, this is the only plumber you should be using!!!!

reviews.author: Michael Baker
reviews.text: Rob and his assistant were excellent! I called for an issue with my shower and they were at my door WITHIN ONE HOUR. They were able to resolve my issue quickly and efficiently. I will definitely call them again for all of my plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Jay Lo
reviews.text:
was told by two other “big name” plumbing companies in the past few years that eventually my main drain will need to be dug up and replaced bc they hit roots while snaking from the inside of the house...
last week at 11:30pm my basement flooded after my kid and i showered (yuck!) called around the next morning and Mr. Robert and his son were out within the hour and solved my issue in about an hour once arriving literally from the street. pulled out a plug and everything has been draining perfectly ever since.
10/10. fast. friendly. helpful.

reviews.author: Dana Zambito
reviews.text:
Great experience with Bukowski Plumbing!
The main sewer line in our home was clogged.
We first called a large national chain in for service.  They attempted to snake the line, which was unsuccessful.  That evening another individual was called out to view the line with a camera, which detected roots blocking the main sewer outlet.  This was followed with quotes that required replacing the sewer line on our property, and removing pieces of concrete in the driveway costing >$10,000!

The next day we called Bukowski Plumbing.  Robert answered both my and my husband's questions over the phone and he was out to our house in the early afternoon.  He snaked the line and successfully removed the roots within 30 minutes!

He was professional, timely, explained everything, and was very funny!  If you live in the Cherry Hill area, I highly recommend Bukowski Plumbing.

reviews.author: Roger Garrett
reviews.text: Called Robert this morning at 8:00 AM about a P trap leaking from my garbage disposal that was installed by another big name company. I sent him pictures of the problem so he knew what he was dealing with. The trap was installed wrong and the company wanted to charge me to come back out to look at it since I bought the disposal and they just installed it. Robert and Dylan arrived at 9:15 and they re configured the trap with heavy duty PVC. It's now actually out of the way so we can have easy access to items underneath the sink and it doesn't leak. Robert explained everything  in detail. Then I had him look at the vacuum on the bib outside and he replaced that as well. It wasn't part of my original call as I just happened to remember the outside issue. I will use Bukowski plumbing for now on, we are extremely satisfied them.

plumbers.name: Jif plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 7648 Quivas St, Denver, CO 80221, USA

reviews.author: Warren Linn
reviews.text: Jose is a stand-up guy! He was incredibly prompt to respond via text after hours and came for the repair the next day. He offered me a discount and was flexible on all fronts, it was a great experience. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Lisa Hinderlider
reviews.text: Was referred by a friend to JIF Plumbing as I needed to get a drain snaked. I really try to find good service companies that are locally owned to support small businesses. His quote was higher than the 99.00 rooters all over the area but I took a chance. Jose is an excellent tech. He gave me great information about plumbing issues as well as preventative steps. He is trained and fully understands all aspects of his job. He is not just a guy who was trained by another guy who had.no proper training. He was quick, efficient and cleaned it all up to my satisfaction.You get what you pay for. 10 out of 10.

reviews.author: Julia Zoukhri
reviews.text: Jose was the best! We had a leak in our crawl space and he came out to inspect it. He initially advised that we recaulk our tub to see if that would help. When we told him the issue persisted, he was able to come back and figure out the issue (a lose pipe behind our dry wall). He quickly repaired it and our leak is gone!! He was friendly, thorough, and communicative. He explained everything that was going on and what needed to be done. I will definitely use Jose and the company again in the future and cannot recommend him enough!!!

reviews.author: Deborah Terada
reviews.text:
Jose came and diagnosed our problem within minutes. He was very polite and professional, all the while keeping me informed of the course of action for the repairs. I would highly recommend JIF Plumbing.
Update, I had a drain problem at a rental home of mine and again Jose came through like the professional he is. I was scheduled for Monday, but he was able to unclog my drain on the Saturday before. Thank you for great service.

reviews.author: T. S.
reviews.text: I had a great experience with JIF plumbing! I called Jose in the morning about a possible leak that a tenant reported in a rental property and he was able to come over later the same day. Was very thorough and got the problem fixed. Will definitely use them again for future plumbing work!

reviews.author: Vanessa A.
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Neace Plumbing for anyone in need of dependable, high-quality plumbing services. From start to finish, their team demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction.

They responded promptly, arrived on time, and took the time to clearly explain the issue and the best solution. The work was completed efficiently and with great attention to detail. It’s clear they take pride in doing the job right the first time. The pricing was fair and transparent, and they left the area clean once the work was finished.

It’s not easy to find a plumbing company you can fully trust, but Neace Plumbing truly stands out for their reliability and integrity. I wouldn’t hesitate to call them again for future plumbing needs and confidently recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Christina Snyder
reviews.text: I’m very impressed with the work that was done. He responded quickly, showed up when he said he would, and fixed the issue without any hassle. He was honest about pricing and made sure everything was working properly before leaving. It’s such a relief to find someone dependable. I wouldn’t hesitate to call again!

reviews.text: Great experience from beginning to end. My father-in-law had a great experience with them prior and recommended them. (Other) Zach arrived right on time, gave me a fair quote for my leaking water heater, and said he could replace it right away.
