The area around the water heater was even cleaner after they were done than it was when they started. Team at D. Martel are professional, punctual, friendly, and highly efficient. Definitely my new go-to plumbers. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: M C
reviews.text: We are loyal customers. In the past, Martel plumbing  replaced our water heater and fixed our leaky copper pipes. Lately there is a weird throttling when turning on faucet. My husband called in the morning and a technician arrived in an hour. Turned out its a stupid thing with our faucet valve. He didn't even charge us. They are local, fast reliable and honest. Truly the best in el dorado hills.

reviews.author: Tonya Alhona
reviews.text: We have used D Martel Plumbing several times and we’ve received excellent service every time. They have always been able to send someone out the next day or within a short timeframe. We’ve had the same plumber each time and he’s always friendly and courteous. Our first encounter was for a toilet installation and the second was for a water heater flush. With the toilet installation we initially bought the wrong toilet. Zac explained what we needed, we ordered it and he came back for the install. He explained everything he did thoroughly. We will always call D Martel for our future plumbing needs and we highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: Nancy Bradford
reviews.text:
Just had leaking  pipe repair in kitchen and they just replaced our daughter Laura Bradford's garbage
Disposal...I can't say enough positive things about them...so nice even woman in office...so friendly...excellent service neat and tidy...positive attitudes!!!thank you!!!

reviews.author: Elizabeth
reviews.text: I called DMartel Plumbing on in December to seek specific service/product, etc. The technician that came out spent much of our conversation bad-mouthing competitors whom I won’t mention names, claiming they were unreliable to position their own service as superior. This felt manipulative rather than helpful. Despite clearly stating my needs and budget, they aggressively pushed an unnecessary upsell for bad mouthing the original installer. Then called the original installer and was told those parts aren’t needed. Then went the distance and called the manufacturer to further confirm these parts were not needed as DMartel pressured me by saying these guys ruined your warranty per manufacturer, premium add-ons costing $5,000! I walked away feeling pressured and distrustful. Companies should focus on honest service, not tactics that undermine trust. They’ve showed me they are actually afraid of these certain companies as these companies were correct and ultimately superior, and DMartel was/is not!

plumbers.name: 24/7 Plumber - Shark Plumbing Services
plumbers.address: 42 S White Rd, San Jose, CA 95127, USA

reviews.author: Ricardo Meza
reviews.text:
I have to say that shark took care of my my water pipe emergency in three days. I called them on Saturday and he responded that same night. He couldn't come Sunday because it was raining but as soon as it stopped raining his crew went to work.

They did an excellent job and replaced all my 75 year old pipes. I'm very happy with there work and how quickly they were able to get it done.

I would definitely use them again and recommend them for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: risa anav
reviews.text:
It never fails how your house decides for an emergency right at a big holiday.  Our 65 year old plumbing line from the water main to the house gave way and was leaking water from under our landscaping, down our driveway, and into the street Wednesday late afternoon before Thanksgiving.   I googled emergency plumbers in our area.  Luckily, Julio (Shark Plumbing) was nearby and was able to come by in 10 minutes.   It was a substantial project to replace the line with copper pipe and would entail digging a trench through our front landscaping. He was knowledgable and able to give us a detailed explanation of the job and relevant codes.  Julio gave us a fair quote for an emergency job and told us that it would look like he was never there. I was thinking, 'we shall see.'

He connected a bypass Wednesday evening to stop the leak and let us have water.  Then 8 am Thanksgiving morning he came out with his crew and started digging.  They were organized and moved the mulch and garden drips, dug the trench to have minimal impact to my plants. They got everything dug (heavy wet clay) and the pipe laid before only turning off the water for the final connections. We were only without water for about 2 hours.  He was great with communication and his crew were hardworking, clean, and worked with minimal disruption to us.  I was cooking a turkey inside.  When they were finished around 3 pm, I was amazed at how my front yard looked.  They did indeed put it back together as if they were never there.  They took all garbage away with them.  The copper front connections looked great.  They even repaired the small drywall that they had to cut open to run the connection into the garage.

My experience with Shark plumbing was extremely positive and I only have praise for their work and professionalism.  They saved our Thanksgiving.  I appreciated their work and hope they were able to spend the evening with their families.

reviews.author: Jill Aceves
reviews.text:
Can’t say enough about this company!
He came recommended by my sister, and did major plumbing at my moms.   We were hearing water running when we had nothing turned on??
Julio, (the owner), came in right away and after checking everything, gave us an estimate on Repiping our home, (which was way over due).  During the repipe they found we as well needed sewer pipe replacement, which we were not thrilled with.  But after showing us photos,  and actual leaky pipes, we needed to get it done as well.
His team of plumbers, were Extreemly polite, considerate. Worked in sync, lot’s of communication the whole time.  Julio, checked in on everything, equipment,  pipe fittings, the digging process, always asking us if everything was ok!!  They taped off where they were working, cleaned it all up at night, and then put it back up to protect our home.
Sorry that I’ve gone on and on, I could say a lot more.
But Illyend it with this…….We highly recommend Shark plumbing.  We have dealt with a lot of contractors, and these guys are the tops. A company that I feel you can truly trust and appreciate the work that they do. They went above and beyond!!!!

reviews.author: Karen Majors
reviews.text: I needed to replace my main sewer line. Julio came out and diagnosed the issue. He showed me what was going on inside of my 60+ year old pipes by using a camera. His team worked hard to complete the job in a timely fashion. They were all so conscientious of my yard and landscaping. They restored it back to better than it looked originally. Highly recommend Shark Plumbing!

reviews.author: Shirley Pangilinan
reviews.text: The problem we encountered in our house was huge. More and more problems keep adding up almost everyday. One of the major resolutions was repiping. I don't know anyone or not familiar with any company. I read reviews of 3 companies, and I based my choice by these reviews and star rating. Shark Plumbing had 5 stars and Julio is the owner. I chose this company, and the business relationship began. It was a huge journey with ups and downs due to more problems in our house that were being uncovered as the work went on. Julio is a great partner all the way, who gave his support, professional advise, and has a crew of trusted workers. In its entirety, the huge project was a learning curve for us, from the beginning to the end and even after the job was done. Julio was always there, physically, and answers phone and texts promptly. Julio is courteous and respectful. He is professional and always try to be composed even in the middle of stressful situations. He understands and is considerate. The professional fee is reasonable.It is good to know that a good, healthy relationship was established, and now I know someone I can call and go to when it comes to plumbing.

plumbers.address: 1901 N Moore Ave #17, Moore, OK 73160, USA

reviews.author: Sara Jones
reviews.text:
Does not know how to pour concrete. Price was quoted at $1200-$1500 to fix the crooked pipe and replace the cast iron flange that we had already cut off, we paid close to $2000 for them to bust up our concrete and add a PVC attachment and flange. Pipe is still crooked and now the left side of where the toilet should sit is a half an inch higher than our original foundation and the front of it is about a quarter inch lower than the original foundation area.
They offered to come out for free if we had issues, but what can we expect from someone who doesn't understand how to use a level.
Pictures include the starting point, which is the circler and the end result which has the level on it. The blacked floor is the original foundation level.

reviews.author: matt newton
reviews.text:
We called D and D drain in need of installing a waterline for our fridge. We've been in the house for almost a year and had bought a fridge for the house not realizing we didn't have a waterline/faucet for the fridge to connect to. Upon calling they seemed very professional, upfront and communicated well on got me on the schedule. Even offered to come out and take a look at what I needed installed at no charge. Some places were charging $80 just to get an estimate.

The plumbing was installed and is running fine. My issues began when they left my house and left the box for the line connection behind my fridge looking as pictured in the photo. I reached out to them explaining my concern and that this so far was my only issue with our experience. I was greeted with responses of "we don't do drywall work" "we don't trust anyone to outsource and pay for it to be done."

As the conversation took place I voiced my concern as I felt this was left undone and didn't look professionally installed. I had worked in trim carpentry for a couple years and when mistakes were made we fixed them. Didn't just leave them for the customer to foot more money to have someone else repair them.

I'm unsatisfied with how this situation was treated after the fact. Communication with them has been timely but the issue is left unresolved.

Will not be using them again. And honestly surprised I'm not seeing more bad reviews. Hopefully they aren't deleting them to maintain face.

reviews.author: Bon M
reviews.text:
We were experiencing a bad clog in our bathroom which resulted in water coming up in the shower when the bathroom sink would run and the water was draining VERY slowly. We tried snaking ourselves and used Liquid Drano MAX w/ boiling water flush to no avail. I finally gave in and decided to call a plumber.

I usually let Google reviews guide me to the right professionals and chose D and D Drain because of their stellar Google review score and affordability/honesty seemed to be common themes within their reviews, two qualities that mean the most to me when having someone work on my house. Robert was literally at my house within an hour of making the call and had the clog gone an hour after that - for an affordable price to boot!  He was kind and courteous and did a great job cleaning up afterward. Will definitely be using D and D again for any future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Kai Carver
reviews.text: I called to get an appointment for a kitchen sink installation and some updates done to some pipes under the sink. They were able to get us worked into their schedule fairly quickly and never once hesitated when the job ended up being a lot more than anticipated (we have an older house with kind of rough plumbing). Dustin was able to get all the pipes and fixtures up to date and the sink installed even while having to make changes due to unforeseen issues. They are very quick to communicate and kept us involved with every step. Will definitely use again!

reviews.author: Katie Howell
reviews.text: Our tub and toilet were not draining in the only bathroom we had. We had company staying with us and were panicking trying to find a same day plumber to come fix our drains. They were out within 2 hours of the call and had it fixed in less than 20 minutes. They are very kind people and knowledgeable about what they do. We will be keeping them in our back pocket for the next plumbing issue we have.

reviews.text: I called around 6pm to set up an appt for a quote. Rolando was able to come within minutes (just so happened to be nearby), gave me a quote and immediately started work. I'd recommend them for anyone looking for reliable and communicative service.

reviews.author: Darlene Moore
reviews.text: I hired Oakland Rooter & Plumbing after speaking to several plumbing companies.  I was frustrated with no shows, differing opinions and estimates. He explained things so well, was patient to make sure I understood the options and costs he presented.  He expedited the work, was very thorough, kept me well informed and was reasonable in pricing.  After having worked with many contractors, I really appreciate having trustworthy trades that keep their word and have a passion for quality work and happy customers.  As far as I'm concerned there is only one Plumbing company that I will call from now on and that's saying a lot.

reviews.author: Chase BFD
reviews.text: Oakland Rooter is far and away the most trustworthy, thoughtful, and honorable company in the Bay Area.  They have simply reformed my 1946 home including a whole house repipe, new line from the street, new bathtub, bathroom sink, kitchen plumbing, and all the finishes. They complete jobs on time and on budget, take great care to protect your home while the work is being done, and most of all the plumbers are the best people you’ll ever run across (specifically Jose and the owner Ygnacio)! I am a lifetime customer.

reviews.author: Mandy Chiang
reviews.text:

Cesar let me know about the mistake and not only fixed the clog, but also corrected the pipe sizing and fixed the leak!

reviews.author: Albert Ok

plumbers.address: 14710 W Colfax Ave #90A, Lakewood, CO 80401, USA

reviews.author: ethan mendez
reviews.text: After checking out a lot of reviews, we decided to reach out to Brian's Emergency Water Heaters for help with a new water heater installation at our home in Lakewood. I called several plumbing companies, but Pedro took the time to answer all my questions about different water heater options and explained the warranty in detail. That helpful phone call, along with what we read about the company’s commitment to their work, made us feel confident choosing them. When it was time for the installation, Wayne came out and did a fantastic job. He made sure our shutoff valves were up to code, and was very professional, friendly, and clearly experienced. You can tell he really enjoys what he does. The new water heater is working perfectly, and we notice a real difference in our hot water supply. It’s been a couple of weeks since the install and everything is running smoothly. We’re very satisfied with the whole process and highly recommend this plumbing service to anyone in Lakewood looking for reliable help.

reviews.author: Kari Patel
reviews.text: I highly recommend Brian's Emergency Water Heaters. When our sewer pipe burst, Wayne came out quickly and explained everything that needed to be done, step by step. He was very professional and made sure we understood the whole process. The work was done to a high standard, and we felt the price was fair for the quality of service we received. What really stood out was how fast they responded, even though they were busy—they made sure our urgent plumbing problem in Lakewood was taken care of without delay. We're very grateful for their quick and reliable help.

reviews.author: Kylie Montes
reviews.text: Wayne was the plumber who came out to fix our leaking kitchen sink at our home in Lakewood. He replaced the basket strainers and all the pipes under the sink to make sure everything was running smoothly. Since he only had two different types of basket strainers on the truck, he used those to get us up and running right away. While working, I asked Wayne about getting a whole-house water filter. He offered a free water test and explained what kind of system would work best for us, since our water had higher iron and some bacteria from lack of chlorine. Wayne showed me the options and gave me a clear estimate for the filtration system. After the visit, I called the office because I wanted matching basket strainers in our newer sink. The team was very helpful and scheduled another visit for the next day without any hassle. Wayne came back and quickly switched out the part, making sure everything looked perfect. He was very friendly, professional, and took the time to explain everything to me. Everyone I spoke to at the company was polite and knowledgeable, and I liked that they always called ahead before coming over. I highly recommend their plumbing services to anyone in Lakewood!

reviews.author: Emilia Kennedy
reviews.text: After recently moving into our new home in Lakewood, my husband and I wanted to make sure our plumbing was set up perfectly. We decided to get a water softener system along with a reverse osmosis filter, not just to protect our pipes and appliances, but also to avoid buying bottled water all the time. At our old house, the hard water made my hair dry and left a buildup on our fixtures, so we wanted to avoid those problems this time around. I checked out some local recommendations online, and a lot of people in our neighborhood had great things to say about a local plumbing company. Their Google reviews were all 5 stars, so I gave them a call. From the moment I spoke with Jerry, I could tell he was really knowledgeable about plumbing and water filtration systems. He helped us choose the best setup for our family. The installation was scheduled quickly, and the plumber arrived right on time. After everything was installed, we noticed an immediate improvement in our water quality. The water felt softer and tasted great, and we’re definitely drinking more of it now thanks to the reverse osmosis system at our sink. I highly recommend adding that feature—it really makes a big difference! After the installation, the company followed up to make sure everything was working smoothly. Charles even came out to test the water and walked us through how to use the system and what to do if we ever have questions. It was such a smooth, stress-free experience from start to finish. If you’re looking for a plumber in Lakewood, you really can’t beat their quality or prices. We’re so happy with our new water system and would definitely recommend this team to anyone needing plumbing services.

reviews.author: Elaine Mccarthy
reviews.text: I wish I could give more stars! Brian's Emergency Water Heaters is a reliable and skilled plumbing company with fair prices, and I often see them recommended on social media. When I reached out about my overflowing laundry drain and a clogged kitchen drain pipe, the owner called me back quickly to help. Wayne came out to handle the job and did excellent work—he really knew his stuff and had a great attitude. I’m now a very happy customer and will definitely call again for any plumbing issues. I’d recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy plumber.

plumbers.name: King Family Plumbing & HVAC
plumbers.address: 272 Arapahoe Ave, Boulder, CO 80302, USA

reviews.author: ryleigh curry
reviews.text: Charles did an excellent job! He really knows his stuff when it comes to septic systems and gave me helpful advice about how to prevent issues with the leech field that can come up after years of use. I was also impressed with how quickly and professionally everything was handled. At a time when plumbing costs seem to keep going up in Boulder, King Family Plumbing & HVAC offered rates that were much more affordable than other companies I looked into. The team was also very polite and always kept me updated about the plumber’s arrival time if there were any delays. Overall, I’ll definitely call them again for any plumbing needs and would happily recommend their services to others.

reviews.author: Esther Robinson
reviews.text: After finishing a long remodel of our home, we woke up to find that our main sewer line was badly clogged, leaving our master bathroom, guest bathroom, and kitchen all out of order. We called first thing in the morning, and the helpful lady who answered quickly scheduled a plumber to come out within a couple of hours. Wayne arrived right on time, took a look around, and gave us two options: a cheaper fix that might only last a while, or a proper repair to solve the problem for good. We chose the long-term solution. Wayne explained everything clearly and said he'd return soon with the right equipment and another plumber, Charles. They both showed up as promised, checked the property, and got right to work. They spent a few hours snaking the pipes and using a camera to inspect the lines. Once they saw the blockage, they used a high-pressure jet to clean the pipes thoroughly. Afterward, they ran the camera through the pipes again to make sure everything was clear. They did a great job cleaning up after themselves, and both plumbers were very friendly and respectful of our home. The service was excellent and the price was fair. We highly recommend this plumbing company and would definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs, though hopefully we won't need to!

reviews.author: Isabella Castro
reviews.text: I needed to replace a leaking water heater and fix some plumbing issues in my home. I called a local plumbing company in Boulder, and Charles came out to inspect everything and explain the different repair options to me. We talked about what work needed to be done, how long it would take, and found a schedule that worked for me. Charles and his team arrived right on time and were always friendly and willing to answer any questions I had. Charles kept me updated on their progress throughout the job, but was never pushy. The crew made sure to protect my home from any mess while they worked, and cleaned up completely when they were finished. I’m very satisfied with the quality of their plumbing work and my overall experience. I’ll definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs and would recommend them to anyone in Boulder.

reviews.author: Herbert Fisher
reviews.text: We recently had a great experience with King Family Plumbing & HVAC here in Boulder. Communication throughout the whole process was clear and helpful, which really put us at ease. After setting up an appointment to have our plumbing lines checked and our drains cleaned, we got a confirmation call the day before. Charles, the plumber, gave us a heads-up call when he was on his way, so we knew exactly when to expect him. After the work was done, we even received a follow-up call to make sure everything was working properly and that we were happy with the results. The plumbers were very professional—explaining what they were doing, sharing photos of the work, and making sure everything was tested before finishing up. We’re very satisfied and would definitely recommend them to anyone needing plumbing help in Boulder.

reviews.author: kim bradley
reviews.text: I had a clogged drain in my kitchen sink and needed help fast. After my first plumber didn’t show up, I started searching online and saw great recommendations for a local plumbing company here in Boulder. I gave them a call, and they were able to send Charles out the same afternoon. Charles arrived right on time, quickly fixed the clogged drain, and made sure everything was running smoothly. He also explained some helpful tips for keeping my pipes clear and talked with me about some future plumbing projects I’m considering. I’m really happy with the service and will definitely call them again whenever I need a plumber.

plumbers.name: Michael Gardner Plumbing
plumbers.address: 16038 Vía Nueva, San Lorenzo, CA 94580, USA

reviews.author: Nathanael Lima
reviews.text:
We had an emergency issue with our water heater and Michael came out on a call at 8pm, which already showed incredible responsiveness and customer service. He diagnosed the problem quickly and came back the next day to get everything fully fixed.

One thing we really appreciated was that he explained all of our options clearly, from lowest cost to highest cost, and allowed us to choose what worked best for us without any pressure. Super honest and transparent.

Michael was clean, professional, and respectful of our home the entire time.
Great experience, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Rebecca F
reviews.text:
Michael was recommended by another plumber, who didn't have any appointments for at least two days. I had a toilet leak, which fortunately wasn't an overflow. Michael communicated with where he was at with his current job. He was dealing with an emergency repair at another home which took hours.

He arrived the following day and also gave me a discount since I was patient in waiting for him to do the repair. I had a fill valve replacement done. He also explained what situations would warrant more extensive and higher cost repairs as far as the function of the toilet parts.  I would highly recommend Michael Gardner Plumbing.

reviews.author: Honey B
reviews.text:
I find Michael on Google
I left him a voice mail and he called back very quickly. He fixed a leak coming from the water heater....I was stressing over this but he worked his magic and did a FANTASTIC job.
He is from now on my to go plumber
Thank you 😊

reviews.author: VOLBOLDEN
reviews.text:
Had a pipe issue at my home. Sewage was backing up into our yard through out clean out. We tried snaking it ourselves for hours with no success, called a local plumber I knew out and he cleaned it out and he sent a camera down and we saw there was a disconnected pipe or offset from my house’s pipe to the main city pipe which was causing the backup. It needed to be dug up and replaced which obviously was not the news I wanted to hear but it needed to be fixed.   He recommended Michael as he does this type of pipe replacement. Michael came right out and checked the camera view told us what needed to be done and gave us an estimate.

We called Michael out when we got the money together, he came right out, set up everything, walked us through the process, did all the permits, met with and pge to mark all the gas lines and then the next day he and his crew got to work.

Got it fixed up, there was minimal to no disruption to our daily life at all during the repair. He and his crew were very thorough and the job was well done. You can tell when contractors cut corners and there were no corners cut at all, all work was documented and he gave updates. Job as done well and water is flowing and haven’t had issues since. Thanks

reviews.author: Fred W.
reviews.text: Quick responds. a nice guy got the job done professionally. Got a main sewer line clog last night. Found this plumber locally in Google. Called this morning and he came in an hour. After I explained my finding, he confirmed the main sewer line clogged. Did the snake in first cleanout, not working. Then moved and Snake in the cleanout (2nd) closer to the street . It really took some effort. We both started wondering if a big issue underneath the sidewalk thru the city sewer line. Lucky, at the last , the snake went thru, the dirt was drained. Clog was removed. Then we went thru the camera detection together. A pipe connection has issue, as shown. He explained the issue and quoted for future solutions , budget or pricy. Overall, a good and smooth experience.

plumbers.name: JTS Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 629 S 27th St, Easton, PA 18045, USA

reviews.author: Karen Collinge
reviews.text: They did a great job! Our water heater broke. They installed the new one and took the old one all within an hour the same day we called. The price was much less than another place we inquired at. Will keep their number for any future plumbing repairs needed.

reviews.author: Danny Akacki
reviews.text:
I have found my forever crew for my homes plumbing and heating. Some companies have to try to convince and market excellence, for JTS they don’t know how to apply their craft any other way.

From the first phone call, to the visit, to the execution, everything about them screams professional. Anyone can be skilled at a thing, but delighting the customer while you do it takes real work and talent. And that’s where JTS has the market cornered.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Carlton
reviews.text:
JTS was the lowest bid for our AC replacement, but they also came highly recommended. I mentioned a problem that we have had with air flow in the top level and no one was able to offer any suggestions.  However, when Tyler & Connor from JTS were here, they quickly saw the issue and took steps to fix it - at no extra charge.

We were VERY pleased with their service!

reviews.author: Roger Guilfoyle
reviews.text: Called J T plumbing and they scheduled the very next day. They arrived when they said they would .  Alan was very professional and polite. He analyzed the problems and corrected each item quickly.  I highly recommend J T plumbing for any plumbing problems.  Very fair pricing and worked very quickly to take care of the problems.  Everything taken care of in less than an hour.  Great job.

reviews.author: Jessica Autumn
reviews.text:
Professionalism at its best!!!

We had a very large job which completed timely and exceeded our expectations.   The technicians were both knowledgeable and hard working.  They regularly checked in with us regarding installation locations.
I highly recommend JTS for any project!!!!

plumbers.name: B & A Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 619 Estes Ave, Schaumburg, IL 60193, USA

reviews.author: Sanjay Joshi
reviews.text:
The two main water shutoff valves on either side of the water meter were about 35 years old and were not properly shutting off the water, so I called a few plumbing companies for estimates. B&A Plumbing was the most reasonable one and since their reviews were good, I decided to try this company. One company with good reviews quoted double of what B&A charged me.

Dean from B&A Plumbing came in today and I showed him the location and he quickly replaced the two valves. He then asked me to call the village to turn on the water and when they did, he checked to make sure there were no leaks before leaving. Overall, Dean was easy to work with, friendly, and I am happy with his service.

The only area of improvement is that since I had to coordinate with the Village, B&A could have been more detailed in their explanations on what was expected. Also, while giving out an estimate, give a final number so the customer can get a sense of the what it entails. Just quoting hourly rate isn't enough. I almost went with another company but decided to persist and get a total estimate. The final cost was lesser than the estimate which was a nice surprise.

Overall, 5 stars and I will call them in the future in case I need service. Price was reasonable, I paid by check to avoid a 3.5% fee. It's great to support a local Schaumburg business!

reviews.author: Laura Davey
reviews.text: So happy with my experience working with B & A plumbing!  From the start Ilga was so helpful and kind and then when Dean and Jesus came out they were wonderful!  Dean is so calming and knowledgeable and knew exactly what to do!  In addition, he very patiently answered so many of my questions and addressed my concerns with empathy and expertise.  He is a great asset to your business and customers.  Thank you all for being great to work with!  I will definitely recommend you to others!

reviews.author: Bill Dunn
reviews.text: The sump pump that ejects the water that drains from my furnace and basement kitchen sink went out on News Years Day. The pit had already overflowed and I had a mess. Fortunately, I was able to get a plumber to come out on an emergency service call. The plumber picked up the new pump before he came. He removed the old pump and installed a new one in less than an hour. He was very careful not to make a mess and cleaned up after he was done. He was professional, knowledgeable and polite. B & A Plumbing saved my New Years.

reviews.author: James Koziarz
reviews.text: I Had a garbage disposal needed to be replaced. I called B&A made an appointment for the next day. the man showed up on time, he was very nice and efficient. He had the job done in under an hour. I had called several other plumbers before B&A one quoted me a price over twice what i was charged by B&A. I was very pleased with the service B&A provided.

reviews.author: Laurie Jezuit
reviews.text: These guys are SO GREAT. My garbage disposal FELL DOWN (yikes!) and they were able to come at exactly the time I needed. Bobby and Ilga helped me over the phone, and Dean knew exactly what to do - he installed a new one and made sure everything was working. I feel so much better now!

I really cannot say enough good things! First, due to a miscommunication at home, no one was available when the technician showed up for our first scheduled appointment. And, did an amazing job to boot! The price, in my opinion, was incredibly fair. The work definitely wonderful!

I do not have pictures of outside where the spigot was replaced with a new one that is resistant to freezing. I am beyond pleased and will definitely reach out again when needed.

reviews.author: Travis Booth
reviews.text: JD Plumbing did an excellent job replacing our water heater. Communication was clear, they showed up on time, explained everything, and the work was done efficiently and professionally. reviews.author: Patrick McSweeney
reviews.text: Love this company!  Jeni calls you back and gets you answers fast.  Great work and very reasonable prices, prompt, and clean work.  The techs clean up after themselves and make you feel comfortable while they work, not creepy!! Would very much recommend Jd's Plumbing to everyone.  Thanks for your great work Jd's, keep it up!

reviews.author: Margery Slatz
reviews.text:
Jeff is a very nice guy and does excellent work, but the prices are outrageous! I paid $460 to have our tankless hot water heater flushed out. Per Google the Average cost is $150–$350.

I paid the bill and it was my fault for not asking for an estimate price before they came out. It costs less to pump my septic tank and cart away all of the contents than to run some chemicals through my tankless and wait.

I even ran all the water through the faucets because the two employees, Mike and Ben, did not have protective shoe coverings on and I did not want them walking on my carpet.

I know you have to pay your staff and inflation has caused prices to go up, but I am just in shock! Wow!

reviews.author: Jesseca G
reviews.text: The Jd plumbing company is amazing. They are the only company I deal with, they’re trustworthy and their work is top notch. Whether you have an emergency or just need work done I would highly recommend. My water heater busted and they were here within an hour to replace it.

reviews.author: angie gustke

Woke to water flowing out of my water heater! LM & rcvd a call from Jeni… who was absolutely amazing… got the ball rolling & now I have hot water again! Michael was great! Explained everything to me!

reviews.text: He was able to get to my home really quickly and take care of the sewer line issue. He explained everything as he did the job while answering my questions on how to prevent future issues, etc. I highly recommend him for your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: 72afam (Aamir)
reviews.text: If you want honest, dependable, and skilled plumbers then the Malozi father and son team is the best. They did some kitchen work for me and did not leave till I tested everything and was satisfied. They also offered free advice on things I had questions about. Just really skilled, honest, and fair priced. A rare find in the plumbing world.

reviews.author: Ashish Rai
reviews.text: Tommy and his nephew were very gracious in helping us on a Friday night with our sewage pump in our basement.  The Malozi's were the initial installers of said pump many years ago, Tommy took time out from a family celebration, patiently described how to resolve the problem over the phone and we later completed the task and of course it worked and fixed our issue.  I can't tell you how helpful this was in our situation and the fact that Tommy took the time to explain the solution to us was beyond what we expected.  This company was helpful, knowledgeable and, friendly during our initial install years ago and went the extra mile to help us again with an issue years later.  I highly recommend them since they take care of all their customers in the same way and we truly appreciate their efforts.

reviews.author: Euzkadi Lezako
reviews.text: Tommy & Jimmy were professional, personable, prompt and priced fair. They did a great job and came when promised. The plumbing issue was diagnosed and fixed within less than an hour.  I definitely will call on then when next there is a plumbing issue and recommend them 100% for their services.

reviews.author: anaise morel
reviews.text: Wow !!! Is all I can say. This family operated business was absolutely exceptional. Quick response time , excellent communication and honest. I appreciate the time Jimmy and Tommy took to explain the issues and what they did to fix it because let’s be honest the plumbing jargon can sound like another language haha. They sent pictures of everything!!!  I am very pleased with their  expertise and excellent customer service skills and will recommend them. Look no further … and hire them for your needs.

plumbers.address: 4120 Placid Lake Ct, Chantilly, VA 20151, USA

reviews.author: Kudret Ute
reviews.text: Aydin and Halil (Plumber Bee) were awesome installing my new heat pump water heater. They left my place clean and called to check on me and the new water heater later) After 2 months, it is working flawlessly and I was able to set water temp down to 115 F (saving energy and money) on the new device. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Aytac Canbaz
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Plumberbee! They replaced my faucet and garbage disposal, cleaned my bathtub drain, and fixed a toilet that wasn’t flushing right — all in one visit. The plumber came on time, got everything done super fast, and explained what he was doing along the way. The price was really fair too, especially for how efficient they were. Definitely my go-to for any plumbing work from now on!

reviews.author: Ali Akel
reviews.text:
I highly recommend the services of PlumberBee, specifically the work done by Halil.

Recently, I experienced several serious plumbing issues at my home. The main waterline shut-off valve was not operating correctly, and I had multiple leaks, including the master bathroom toilet valves and showerhead, as well as the shut-off valves and faucets in the two half-bathrooms. These issues created a high risk of significant water damage.

I have known Halil for many years; he previously replaced my kitchen faucet and garbage disposal, and his work was excellent. Based on that positive experience, I hired him again to address the issues affecting almost the entire house's waterline system. As expected, Halil did a great job. He was highly professional, detail-oriented, and provided exceptional service.

I highly recommend PlumberBee.

reviews.author: ahmet yildiz
reviews.text: I had our toilet replaced by PlumberBee, and Aiden did an amazing job! He was on time, professional, and very careful with his work. The installation looks perfect, and everything is working great. Highly recommend PlumberBee for anyone needing plumbing services — they’re reliable, clean, and friendly!

reviews.author: Hasan Gurel
reviews.text: I had a clogged kitchen drain, and Halil from PlumberBee came to fix it. He was on time, super friendly, and did a great job! The drain works perfectly now. I really appreciate how clean and professional he was. Definitely recommend PlumberBee if you need a reliable plumber!

plumbers.address: 2020 Hill Ave, Hayward, CA 94541, USA

reviews.author: Abe Amerie
reviews.text: Fito Plumbing was incredibly responsive and provided fast, professional service. They showed up quickly, explained everything clearly what the job entails without any hassle. Really appreciate the prompt turnaround.

reviews.author: Patti Moran
reviews.text: Fito and his crew did a fantastic job on our lateral sewer replacement.  The whole process was very fast, only took 2.5 days to complete. They answered all our questions and cleaned up at the end of each day, and were very friendly and personable.  We highly recommend Fito's Plumbers for any plumbing job and will use them again!

reviews.author: Slava K
reviews.text: I’m a renter and our water heater started to leak all over the floor last Friday evening. I tried to reach out to  local Castro Valley plumbers, but those who answered the phone were booked for week ahead. Fito was just next door in Hayward and picked up the phone around 8pm. Since we are renters, he requested to speak to the owner, and after talking to them he scheduled his crew for next day morning. His team showed up on Saturday morning on time. Water heater was over 20 years old and was not repairable. They covered the floor around the work area and proceeded with replacement. They installed the new heater on the pedestal and added new drain line so it does not flood the floor in the future. Work was done in timely manner. Very happy with their service. Our landlord mentioned that the final bill was also reasonable. Thank you!

reviews.author: Catherine Pool
reviews.text: FITO plumbing is excellent! Beat other bids and provided quick service with excellent workmanship. Responded to questions quickly and showed up on time and left the site clean upon completion. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nunu Kidane
reviews.text: Fito and his crew are lifesavers! They entirely re-routed our plumbing system and did so much more than what was stated on the contract. Our home was built in 1908, the piping system is old and of course unexpected surprises are found, like water damage and rotting wood. They repaired all of it, with slight adjustments to cost and walked us through it all the way. Fito helps us choose the best quality items, and made suggestions on what would work best. I would choose this company over any other!

plumbers.name: Moorestown Rapid Local Plumbing
plumbers.address: 200 W Camden Ave #1790, Moorestown, NJ 08057, USA

reviews.author: Caitlin Campbell
reviews.text: After just moving into my new home in Moorestown, I thought my old water heater and pipes would last a while longer. I was shocked to wake up one morning and find my basement covered in several inches of water—the tank had burst overnight. After shutting off the main water valve and spending hours with a wet vac, I knew I needed a plumber fast, even though it was early Sunday morning. I searched online for emergency plumbing help and found Moorestown Rapid Local Plumbing. Calvin arrived quickly to check out the situation and get things under control. My water heater isn’t a standard model, and I definitely didn’t feel comfortable trying to replace it myself. Calvin made some calls and was able to get the right replacement tank delivered quickly. While he was working, Calvin also noticed my boiler had some issues I hadn’t known about. He explained everything clearly and was very professional and respectful throughout the whole process, never making me feel bad about not knowing much about plumbing. He replaced the old, corroded pipes and flushed out the system to make sure there wasn’t any leftover debris from the broken tank. He also pointed out that some parts of the boiler needed maintenance, and asked if I wanted him to take care of it, but never pressured me. I’m really happy with the quality of the work and how honest and helpful Calvin was. Now I know who to call not just for emergencies, but for regular plumbing jobs too. I highly recommend this company to anyone in Moorestown looking for a reliable plumber.

reviews.author: Preston Fowler
reviews.text: Here's your revised and improved customer review, following all instructions: I can’t say enough good things about the plumbers who came out to help me in Moorestown. Wyatt was fantastic—he quickly figured out what was wrong with my toilet in under a minute and had it fixed in just a few minutes after that. He really helped me save a lot of money compared to another plumbing company, who just opened the tank and started listing expensive options, like a tank rebuild, a new toilet, and even a water treatment system that was way more than I needed. I will definitely use this plumbing company again and recommend them to my friends and neighbors. Great people make all the difference! Another time, Robert came out right on schedule, did a great job, and took the time to show me everything he had repaired. The team here really cares about their work and their customers. On a separate occasion, Wyatt once again went above and beyond what was expected. I’m very happy with the service and would definitely recommend this company to anyone needing plumbing work. Calvin also did a great job, double-checking everything and setting up the job perfectly. We had a complete re-plumbing done on our slab house, which wasn’t easy. Robert, Wyatt, and Calvin worked hard, even handling the tough heat in the attic. The whole crew did an amazing job. I couldn’t be happier with the work or the team. Highly recommend this company for any plumbing needs in Moorestown!

reviews.author: Harry Orozco
reviews.text: I've always had great experiences with Moorestown Rapid Local Plumbing whenever I've needed plumbing help. Most recently, I had a major issue with my main sewer drain that needed some serious attention. At first, I made the mistake of calling another plumber because they had a 'Clear or it's free' coupon for $49.99. That ended up being a costly error, since they kept raising the price with each visit, going from a small fee to thousands of dollars, and even tried to pressure me into expensive work I wasn't sure I needed. Thankfully, I reached back out for a second opinion. Wyatt came out, checked everything thoroughly, and confirmed there were real problems with my main sewer drain, like cracks and roots breaking through, but his estimate was much lower than the other place—less than half the price! I decided to move forward and hired Wyatt and his crew for the job. They ended up lining about 90 feet of both the upper and lower lateral sewer drain, right down to the city connection. The whole process only took about 4 hours, and when they showed me the video inspection of the new lining, it looked like brand new pipe—smooth and seamless. I was really impressed with how fast and professionally everything was done. The work even comes with a 15-year warranty on the lining and 10 years for labor, including free clearing if there's ever a clog again with normal use. Both I and my tenants are very happy with how smoothly everything went. Highly recommend for any plumbing problems in Moorestown!

reviews.author: Cooper Lawson
reviews.text: We manage a busy shopping center with a couple of restaurants, which means we get a lot of grease build-up that sometimes clogs our main sewer line. Recently, we had a plumbing team come out quickly to handle the issue. Wyatt arrived within a day, bringing all the right equipment to rod and jet the pipes. He worked thoroughly to clear the blockage and made sure everything was flowing smoothly before leaving. The service was very professional, the price was fair, and the results were great. After working with many plumbers over the years, I can honestly say this team stands out for their honesty and reliability. We truly appreciate their hard work and will definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Leroy P
reviews.text: I recently needed help from Moorestown Rapid Local Plumbing when I noticed I was losing a huge amount of water every day—hundreds of gallons—but couldn’t figure out where it was going. I checked all the toilets and even turned off the main valve, but I could still hear water running somewhere. I thought maybe my main shutoff was broken, but Wyatt quickly found the real problem: an old pipe, over 50 years old, just outside my wall had started leaking. I was worried that fixing it would mean tearing up my entire yard and having to redo all my landscaping. But they did a fantastic job! They located the exact spot of the leak, dug it up carefully, fixed the pipe, and put everything back so neatly that you’d never know any work had been done. Wyatt was extra careful not to damage the yard—even with the equipment, he made sure everything was handled gently. What really impressed me was how they set up a temporary water diversion while waiting for the utility lines to be marked, and then did such precise work on the repair. Their attention to detail saved me a lot of money and stress. On top of that, everyone was friendly, caring, and respectful—they treated me like an old friend. I truly appreciate their hard work and kindness, and I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Furuta Plumbing
plumbers.address: 98-023 Hekaha St #11, Aiea, HI 96701, USA

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.text: We were having difficulty with our shower. Our property manager called Furuta and they sent out Elijah. We were sent a photo of Elijah so it was easy to identify who was showing up at our home. Elijah was very prompt. Super professional. He accessed the problem, rounded up the necessary parts and within an appropriate amount of time our shower was back up abs running. We were quite satisfied and would recommend Furuta Plumbing.

reviews.author: Wataknobs
reviews.text: They are professional at first, but after I sent the requested photos for a tub-to-shower proposal, communication completely stopped. I tried multiple employees and sent follow-up emails, but no one could reach the person responsible for my proposal—and then they stopped responding again. If this is their communication during the proposal phase,sheesh. I definitely do not recommend them.

reviews.author: Dave Jonh
reviews.text:
The moment you make appointment, you should think of it as being robbed.

Definitely going to keep using them for any jobs I need on Oahu. And if they ever expand to the Big Island or Seattle (where I live and do business), they'd be my first call, no doubt. Mahalo Furuta Plumbing — you guys are the real deal!

reviews.text: Outstanding! Excellent! Grateful! Anyone who has dealt with serious plumbing issues can understand how horrible that experience can be. I could only describe Iverson Plumbing with positivity and gratefulness. I wish I had met Eric and his family at Iverson Plumbing years ago when my sewer issues started. From my first contact with Kelly, her compassion and patience with me as I poured my frustrations and concerns, to meeting Erik with his calming and reassuring demeanor, I was confident I could trust them. I struggled with a previous plumber, who took great advantage causing me great distress. Eric helped me to understand my sewer and pipe issues, giving me opportunity to ask questions and do research. He worked with me on price, and came out quickly to perform services right before Thanksgiving (it also took several visits for which he did as a courtesy). The work him and his team did was awesome! He explained each step and made room for me to document with photos. It was just as important for him as it was for me to be knowledgeable and confident of the service work. They cleaned up the area before leaving, i was grateful. I can't express enough how thankful I am for the Iversons. I will be a customer for life and will always recommend them!

It was an extensive job and I appreciated their thorough work. They explained everything they were doing, and I felt that the price quoted was very in line with the work they had to do. The county inspector said that the work was top notch. I was happy to hear that although I thought so myself.

reviews.text:

I’ll just be blunt… Eric and his team at Iverson Plumbing are absolutely the best. Not only is Eric himself the definition of professional. He talked me through all the possible outcomes of when he completes his assessment. Long story short, he completes his assessment, figures out the issue, does the repair, forwards the report to the adjuster, and now the ball continues to be rolling.

Thank You Eric and Kelly! You guys are truly the best. My family and I appreciate you so much. The community appreciates you so much. Keep up the great work!

reviews.author: B Nielsen
reviews.text: I was very impressed with how quickly and professionally the plumber, Josiah, responded to our call in Lafayette. He was friendly and really knew his stuff, taking the time to explain what was causing our bathtub drain to clog up. Josiah got right to work and fixed the problem in no time at all. He also recommended using a drain treatment once a month to help keep everything flowing smoothly, and pointed out a pipe that might need replacing in the future. We had tried to clear the drain ourselves without any luck, so calling the plumber was definitely the right choice. The service was excellent, the price was fair, and we will definitely ask for Josiah again if we need plumbing help. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Selena Mahoney
reviews.text: I had an outdoor leak at my home in Lafayette and needed a plumber quickly. My warranty company said it would be a week before anyone could come out, and their price seemed pretty high. I decided to call a local plumbing service, and Marc arrived at my place in just 10 minutes, even though it was late on a Friday. He checked everything and found the leak was between the water meter and my house. Marc told me he’d come back early Monday to fix it. To my surprise, when I stepped outside on Sunday morning, the digging had already started. Marc returned early Monday and finished the repair. He explained each step and kept me updated the whole time. The price was much lower than the quote I got before. Marc did a fantastic job, and I’d definitely call them again if I need plumbing help.

reviews.author: Kylie Sampson
reviews.text: As a returning customer, I recently reached out to Lewis Brothers Plumber & HVAC on a Saturday when I had a clogged pipe. Jaime arrived within the hour and got straight to work. I was impressed by how quickly they started the job, which took two days to replace the main sewage pipe from my house to the septic tank. Throughout the process, everyone was knowledgeable, professional, and courteous both inside and outside my home. I also asked about adding another drain on the other side of the house, and that was handled quickly and at a reasonable price as well. I am very pleased with their prompt service, excellent customer care, and the high quality of their plumbing work. Highly recommend for anyone needing plumbing help!

reviews.author: Nazareth Abovian
reviews.text: I had a major sewer issue at my home in Glendale and called Drip Too Hard Plumbing after getting a few different opinions. Their team came out, diagnosed the problem quickly, and explained everything clearly before starting the work. They ended up performing a sewer line repair, hydro jetting to clear the line, and a trenchless sewer line replacement for the damaged section. What impressed me the most was how organized and efficient they were. They carefully exposed the line, showed me the damage, and walked me through the trenchless process so I understood exactly what was being done. The job required digging near the walkway and foundation, but they worked cleanly and kept the disruption to a minimum. After the hydro jetting and new line installation, everything is draining perfectly again. It’s hard to find contractors who are both knowledgeable and honest, but these guys clearly know what they’re doing. If you’re in Glendale or nearby areas and need sewer repair, hydro jetting, or trenchless sewer replacement, I highly recommend Drip Too Hard Plumbing. Professional, transparent, and high-quality work.

reviews.author: Tyler Henderson
reviews.text:
Darlene quoted $499 to pump the septic tank. They sent a woman that had just came off of maternity leave to come pump it knowing there was a concrete riser lid on the solids tank. I ended up helping her remove it because that is what good people around here do. She was nice but unprofessional; the girl was frustrated by the weight of the lid and cussing like a sailor. She noticed the outlet for the pump had burned out so the office sent 2 other people out here. One of them was Jordan Randall who seemed to takeover the job.

While waiting to pay them, Jordan Randall and the woman fresh of maternity leave were telling each other stories of the jobs they had just come off reveling in the fact that Jordan and a previous customer had a verbal stand off about if a former plumber had done their job correctly. When they finally came over to let me pay them, the woman’s tablet didn’t work and so Jordan had the ability to accept payment by phone.

They billed me $1,080 with no explanation as to why and gave me a digital receipt that had no written lines at all. It did not say what they did, what they didn’t do, what a set price was for any task they feel that they completed; nothing. The next morning, water backed up in every bath tub and shower in the house. Come to find out it is because they never cleared the main line.

After calling Darlene we were forwarded to Jordan Randall who only came back to the house on that day because he feared an insurance claim knowing that with 3 employees out here the previous day, they still couldn’t do a simple job correctly. He came out with a truck that let him spray a water jet up the pipe and cleared the main line, like what should have happened the previous day.

If it had happened the previous day, they would have pumped everything they cleared from the main line up, as is customary. Instead he cleared my main line, acted like it was charity, even though he came to complete a job they didn’t complete yesterday, and this time magically had a paper receipt needing signatures with descriptions of the work that he did.

However, this leaves me in a situation of having no pump working in the tank and in his description one of them is 1/2 full and the other is 1/4 full. Mind you this 20 hours after their pump service and we don’t have the ability to add anything to the tanks because they had left the main line clogged up. He tried to tell me it was all ground water. In his opinion it certainly was not the fact that he had to empty the whole main line into the tanks, didn’t pump anything out, as it should have been, and as if he didn’t clear everything with a high pressure water jet. The truth is he left me in a position where their pumping service the previous day was null and void even though they got paid.

If you pay someone to pump the tank, they have to come out twice because they failed at completing their job correctly, and then they leave you with tanks that are 50% pumped out. I would say that it is a fraudulent company.

My experience has been that they are: dishonest, unprofessional, and shady.

Also heads up, when you confront them about their price discrepancy Jordan Randall will tell you they charge by the tank even though Darlene will tell you that it is by the 1,000 gallon. Who knows who is honest there? I assume Darlene because every single septic pump company that I called in the area charges by the 1,000 gallon. Also those places have lower prices, more reviews, and more trusted.

For real, try Metro plumbing - Poop Guys - literally anyone else.

TL;DR: If you want unprofessional people overcharging you and not doing the job correctly, leaving you in almost as bad of a spot as the original service, while they act like they have done you favor, then this 20+ year long business with only 92 reviews (likely because they delete the bad ones) is for you.

reviews.text: I needed a natural gas line installed for a new gas dryer and range in my house, but there wasn’t an existing line and there was ceiling drywall in the way. I thought it would require a big mess and lots of drywall removal, but I was pleasantly surprised when Jude came out, figured out a way to run the gas line, and did all the calculations for the long stretch needed. Then, Trenton and Hunter showed up soon after to put the plan into action. They did a fantastic job—installed an extra shutoff valve on the new gas line, only needed to make a small hole in the drywall, and brought every tool they needed. I was ready to help with cutting through floor tile, but they handled everything quickly and left no mess behind. The new gas piping looks really solid and is actually impressive to look at—it's almost a shame to cover it up with drywall because the connections are neat and precise. I even feel like my gas stove is working better than before! I usually like to handle water line work myself, but it was great to watch their plumbing skills in action. They went above and beyond with safety, including an added gas gap for the dryer hookup, even though there was already a shutoff, since I didn’t have the dryer yet. Trenton also offered to hook up my gas stove after finishing the install. Before leaving, they pressure-tested all the lines and cleaned up so well there wasn’t a speck of drywall dust left. reviews.author: Tom Zambito
reviews.text: I recently purchased a new home, the appliances, not so new, so I requested a home warranty from the seller. Our 17 yr old hot water heater went out with all the fun stuff, water leaking all over, etc. Dealing with the home warranty co. was exhausting, and said 3-5 days to fix it, plus $1200. Nice. I went on Angi and JVS immediately called to see what was up. Spoke with the tech, explained the issue and I wanted to go tankless, and he told me he would get back to me in 20 minutes. In 15 minutes, a JVS tech was at my fence flagging me down. I showed him the mess, called his supervisor, his exact words were "I am confident about this". I have never heard those words from a tech about anything. The first contact called, sent a quote, it was $1800 more than the cost from the home warranty and their cheap replacement. He told me that they can install it the next day (Saturday). By 8am, the tech was on time, and began working. Done by 3pm, I had hot water. The entire experience at a time of turmoil was breathtaking. Some companies, just want to work to get stuff done, and JVS Plumbing is one that I shall be calling them the next time something goes boom. The overall service was impeccable, the quality of work was well worth every cent. No BS, no hidden fees, just great work and excellent value.

reviews.author: Kathryn
reviews.text:
We recently discovered water damage coming through our bedroom ceiling. While it wasn’t an immediate emergency, we knew we needed a proper inspection, so we called a few local plumbers for quotes. After reading the excellent reviews for Murati Plumbing, we decided to reach out — and we are so glad we did.

Denis was extremely professional from the very first call and let us know he could come by for an inspection that same week. After taking a thorough look, he clearly explained what the issue was and what needed to be repaired. We suspected our PVC pipes were leaking, but we had no idea the root cause was actually a poorly done job by a handyman hired by the previous homeowners. The glue on multiple connecting joints had completely deteriorated, causing leaks in several directions.

Denis immediately recognized the problem, explained exactly what each pipe was for, and walked us through how he planned to fix it. His knowledge is outstanding — and the fact that he offers a 10-year warranty is a huge testament to the confidence and quality behind his work.

We were scheduled for the repair within just three days, and Denis and his team replaced the piping, connectors, and elbows in about an hour. The workmanship was excellent, and we were genuinely amazed by how efficiently everything was handled.

Even more impressive, Denis noticed several problem areas in our attic roofing while he was working — areas where water had been coming in through attic vents. We would have never discovered this until it caused significant damage. His attention to detail quite literally saved us from future headaches.

Having worked with multiple large plumbing corporations in the past (which shall remain unnamed), we’ve dealt with situations where several technicians came out over months without providing real answers. Denis is the complete opposite — knowledgeable, reliable, and able to diagnose and resolve problems quickly and correctly.

We cannot recommend Murati Plumbing highly enough. Denis is truly exceptional, and we will absolutely be reaching out to him for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.text:
My landlord contacted Gladiator Plumbing to fix a bathroom sink leak. They came by a total of 3 times. They installed a new faucet to hopefully take care of the leak. After it was installed I saw it was still leaking shortly after he left.

I contacted the installer to tell him it was still leaking. he came by again and said don’t put water on top of the bathroom faucet. He seemed annoyed to come back.
I’m confused because it is impossible to avoid water on or around the faucet (handles or base). The installer said he couldn’t help me and that it was user error. What????? He recorded a video to send to the landlord showing it wasn’t leaking. He said I probably need a more expensive faucet that won’t leak. He said something that costs $500. I said I don’t need an expensive faucet nor do I know what they cost. I need a faucet that functions as it should.

Once the installer sent his recorded test (poring water on the sides of the faucet) -the outcome—-all of few minutes later their was water on the baseboard of the bathroom sink. The installer ran out quickly because he didn’t want to fix the problem. I contacted gladiator to tell them I don’t want the same installer to come back to address the problem. Gladiator is claiming they completed the job. I said you didn’t fix the issue because the bathroom sink is still leaking. Gladiator claims they might need to do more and they need approval from my landlord to tell them what they want to do now. They are trying to get more money and dragging it out. It’s been a week. The plumbers kept my house clean throughout the work, were friendly with my dog as they went in and out, and even gave me advice on how to take better care of my plumbing moving forward. If you need honest, hardworking plumbers in Louisville, I highly recommend calling this crew. I’ll definitely use their services again in the future.

reviews.author: marco santos

reviews.author: Lisa Bankins

Great service.

reviews.text: If you’re in the Solley Road, Marley Neck area, he’s around and can get to you. He fit me in same day for a water heater replacement in my rental house. Called/texted at 10 AM, new water heater by 2 PM. Jason makes it look easy! Before on the left -After on the right.

reviews.author: Kathy Burrier
reviews.text:
After a horrifying experience with a sewer line backing up into the house, we contacted big-name plumbing company. They seemed like aggressive sales-people rather than anything else. They only gave me 1 and only 1 option which would cost about as much as a new car.

So we found Calvert Plumbing and Backflow Services online. I called the number and actually spoke directly to Jason, the owner of the company. Within a couple of days, he sent out Jeremy and Kyle who did everything they could for us (they were also really good with my dogs!). They were able to show me what the problem was and discuss different options available to get us back in working order (the sewer line had to be replaced due to alllllll the tree roots).

Jason and Jeremy came back out to do the actual sewer line replacement. They were very thorough in explaining what was going on and even took pictures of inside the part of the line that goes under the street - also with alllllll the tree roots. They were a big-time life saver and fixed the problem on our end!

All in all, Calvert Plumbing and Backflow was very professional, friendly, helpful, knowledgeable, and affordable. I would highly recommend them and would contact them again in the future for plumbing issues.

reviews.text:
Wish there was an option for below 1. They lie to the elderly, waist weeks of delay to an emergency situation and only come clean when asked for specifics. After going back and forth with her association for 6 months she contacted Reedy directly to come look and fix the issue, even willing to pay for it directly. At the first appointment they stated she would need to hire a sonar company to determine the depth and what pipe is leaking. She hired Hydrascan and on October 29th they indicated it was the water main over 6 feet deep. Reedy stated to my mother they would file a claim with the county to be present upon work since it could be their issue. She called 2 weeks ago to see if the county had responded and if a date was set yet for work. The concern being if it's a main line it could explode and the continued erosion under her driveway that could cause a collapse. 2 weeks ago Reedy indicated they had not heard from the county but would follow up and contact her back. This morning, she contacted them again for an update but this time requested the application # filed with county so we could follow up directly. It was only then they admitted they had never filed anything with the county and "would not be able to do work due to extent of the project" WHAT!! Why have you waisted 6 weeks of valuable time and possible extreme danger to my Mother? I will be filing additional grievances regarding this incompetent company!

It won't allow me to respond to your review response. But ask Stacy in your office who refused to give me the contact information for the owner when I requested it 3 times. She just wanted me to email her.

I sent a contact request with my information on your site.

reviews.text: Working with Avon Lake Plumbing has been nothing short of excellent. Dennis Gareau and his team are reliable, professional, and extremely knowledgeable. reviews.author: Dan Simon
reviews.text:
I do not recommend Avon Lake Plumbing after the experience I have had with them.

Avon Lake Plumbing won our business in December 2023 via a quote that was, at best, inadequately thought out. At worst, it was a bait and switch tactic. Specifically, they quoted us $5,000 all-in to fix a cracked pipe underneath our basement floor, repair a backwater (aka backflow) valve underneath our front porch, AND rough-in a basement bathroom. We eagerly scheduled this job as this was an extraordinarily competitive quote. What has transpired since then has been very unpleasant.

When the owner (Dennis) arrived with a large crew to start cutting into our floors and started camera-ing our sewer lines, the price started jumping up. Suddenly it would cost $4,500 to fix the cracked pipe, $6,000 to rough-in the bathroom, and $6,000 to install a new backwater valve. We called that project off and regrouped.

We decided to have Avon Lake Plumbing install a new backwater valve on our main sanitary sewer line in 2024. When we had questions during the process about whether our storm sewers were connected to the sanitary sewer, Dennis responded defensively but reassured us that he would camera the sewer lines ahead of time, that the sanitary sewers are separate from the storm sewer lines, and that "It will work exactly like it should and you won't flood".  When we asked about maintaining it, he told us it doesn’t need to be maintained as long as the flap is opening.

Another company camera-ed our sewer lines in late 2024 and noted the backwater valve was holding water. We contacted Dennis directly to lodge a warranty claim.  After finding out that there was an issue with the valve due to incompetent installation, Dennis stopped taking our calls. We have reached out to Avon Lake Plumbing countless times. We have called Dennis directly, and we are sent straight to voicemail every time.

Imagine our surprise on 7/29/2025 when water started coming into our (now finished) basement through the sanitary sewer lines during a heavy rain. This is the exact issue we paid Avon Lake Plumbing thousands of dollars to prevent, and which Dennis explicitly guaranteed would not happen.

If trying to call Dennis directly is bad, calling the Avon Lake Plumbing “office” isn’t any better since all the messages they take for Dennis seem to get lost and we never get a call back. The one time the office didn’t lose our message and Dennis promised he would come look at his faulty work, he never showed up! When we finally got through to him, Dennis offered many explanations and after-the-fact disclaimers for why his plumbing work is subpar (none of which were mentioned before he accepted our thousands of dollars).

The most alarming of his disclaimers was that a downspout might be tied into our sanitary sewer line. Such a suggestion on his part exposes his lack of adequate diligence, including a lack of proper dye testing and camera inspection prior to installation. His offering of this excuse amounts to an admission of negligence on his part for installing a backwater valve on a sanitary sewer line without doing an adequate inspection. Completely unacceptable business practices by Avon Lake Plumbing. There were other excuses offered...but the reality is that Avon Lake Plumbing installed a faulty backflow valve and happily accepted over $5,000 for below average work and are not willing to do anything to make it right. Stay away!

Prior to posting this review, I shared these points with Avon Lake plumbing and asked them for satisfactory resolution. That has yet to occur.

Speaking of reviews, please note that as of 8/1/2025, one of the five star reviews on this business is from the Avon Lake Plumbing office manager (it uses their actual name). Several of the other five star reviews also appear to be fake. The other negative reviews more closely align with my experience- the surliness, lack of professionalism, the "it's your fault" attitude. Please think twice before engaging with this organization.

reviews.author: Mike Jensen
reviews.text: I phoned Amazing Plumbing Solutions on 9/8/25 @ 11: 15 AM because the pressure relief valve on our hot water heater had failed and the heater was leaking water at a rapid rate thru the failed valve.  Dave Contreras made a house call within 2 hours.  He diagnosed our problem as a failed pressure regulator on the incoming water line to our home. This allowed water at too high a pressure to be fed to the hot water tank and led to the failure of its pressure relief valve.  Dave was able to replace the incoming pressure relief valve and install a small expansion tank in lieu of the pressure relief valve on the hot water tank.  Repairs were completed less than 3 hours after Dave's arrival & that included a visit to a nearby hardware store to pick up a needed part.  We were impressed with his diagnosis of the problem and with his workmanship & demeanor.  We'd recommend him to anyone with a plumbing problem or emergency.
