reviews.author: Bridget M
reviews.text: *AVOID* Cost me thousands of dollars because they did not want to do the job assigned by my home warranty company, American Home Shield. MacLin Plumbing CO. was assigned to my service ticket regarding my leaking hot water tank. As many Texas residents, my gas water tank is in the attic. When MacLin came to look at the tank, they told me that due to Texas regulations, they needed 25 in. clearance to get the new tank up in the attic, my clearance was only around 24 in., so I would need to provide the clearance in order for them to complete the job. They told me they do not provide access and my only other option would be a tankless water heater, which would not be covered by the warranty and cost thousands more. As a first time home owner that knows nothing about this stuff, I trusted that the plumber would have the experience with attic tanks to advise me honestly on my options. When I proposed if I could remove the attic stairs myself, which would give the necessary 25" clearance, he refused, and said it would not be safe for his men. Foolishly, I took his word that this was my only option, and agreed to their service provided I gave them 25" access. After consulting multiple people, and two plumbing companies about this, I not only realized it would be structurally impossible to carve out the clearance MacLin supposedly needed to complete the job, but also both plumbers told me their team would simply remove the pieces of wood trim to give enough clearance to complete the job. I was pressured to sign the service contract on the spot, then after getting my second opinions, AHS refused to allow me to reassign a new plumber to the service ticket, my only option was a cash out for far less than it would now cost me to replace out of pocket. A neighbor recommended Proven Plumbing. I called at 8:30am on a Friday, they showed up within an hour, & returned to do the job on Monday. They had NO problem cutting the wood trim to make enough clearance for the tank, even replacing it after the job was completed. I HIGHLY recommend using Proven Pluming for your water heater needs, especially if it is in the attic.

reviews.author: angelin abraham
reviews.text: I just had a simple service from them through my home insurance company. My plumber, Jerry Hamlin was early, quick, quiet, clean and considerate to wear shoe covers and not mess up my floors. He was also kind enough to give me some advice for future repairs. Never had a bad experience with this company!

reviews.author: Christina Dienner
reviews.text:
I had a very troubling experience with this plumbing service. A plumber came to our house on a Friday to address an issue covered by our homeowner’s insurance. He identified the problem and said a crew would return on Monday. I didn’t sign any paperwork at that time, and despite asking him to call my husband for approval, no call was made. My husband left multiple messages that Friday during business hours and no one from the office followed up with him.

On Monday, a crew arrived, completed the work, and left without any paperwork or prior communication. Later, the plumber contacted my husband demanding payment, but we requested the paperwork first to ensure insurance coverage. The plumber agreed but still did not provide the necessary documents.

Things escalated when the plumber showed up at our house unannounced, banging aggressively on the door for ten minutes while I was home alone with my children. Feeling threatened, I called my husband. He spoke to the plumber, who then threatened him over the phone stating “he better pay or else”. He stayed on our property for 45 minutes.

My husband contacted the office, which stated that this behavior was unacceptable and that the owner would follow up. However, we never received any communication from the owner.

The unprofessional and aggressive conduct was deeply distressing. If you value respectful and transparent service, I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

reviews.author: Cari G.
reviews.text:
A plumber came to my home WED, saw the drywall damage in the ceiling that’s coming from the upstairs bath; plumber goes upstairs to the bath, sees a saturated bath mat, tells me it’s a sloppy shower and leaves. He doesn’t even cut into the drywall to see if there is the possibility of a plumbing leak.
THURS I pay to get the drywall cut out and mold is discovered - too much mold to be caused by a ‘sloppy shower.’ This has been growing over time and we’ve only been in this home 4 weeks. Contractor says he has never met a plumber that didn’t cut drywall to see what’s going on behind it.
Today/FRI, I called my home warranty company (AHS) to find out the status of Maclin coming back and finding the leak only to discover Maclin has cancelled the follow up service call. I’m so frustrated I don’t want another Maclin employee in my home. AHS has found a different plumbing company for me.🤞

reviews.text: Matt was extremely prompt and professional. He arrived on time, was able quickly identify the leak in our upstairs plumbing and fixed it right away. His prices were extremely reasonable. Very happy with the service. We would use this company again.

reviews.author: Ned Mansour
reviews.text:
Amazing service and great Company all around.  I had the opportunity to work with Mathew directly.  He came immediately to trouble shoot my tankless water heater - 1 day later he installed a new Navien S2 - and we are very happy customers.

- would recommend 100% 5 star

Thank you again!

reviews.author: Chris Roberts
reviews.text:
Matt did a great job for us. We initially called for help fixing a leaky faucet. plumbers.name: ABC Plumbing, Sewer, Heating, Cooling & Electric
plumbers.address: 1544 45th St #1c, Munster, IN 46321, USA

reviews.author: LaTonya Woodfaulk
reviews.text: Tony was very professional and did a fabulous job. He went above and beyond to make sure everything was working on my furnace. He told me the year that it was made. He also checked my AC unit and told me a year that that was made and made me feel very comfortable with everything that he did. He’s a wonderful technician & he’s very passionate and caring about the work that he’s doing which makes a big difference. I would like to recommend him to anyone that’s getting service done or a tuneup. Also, I want him to return to do all my other tune ups & maintenance in the future. I can’t thank him enough!

reviews.author: Pamela Johnson
reviews.text: Mr. Jesse Yeargain was the ultimate technician. He was pleasant. He was smart and knowledgeable. He was so very accommodating.  He took time to explain the issues to me and my family members. Showed us the different parts that Were not working and why. Carefully made sure the heat vents were prepared for the work to be  done to prevent further damage. Jesse was prompt and constantly answered all of my concerns and questions. I joined the ABC CLUB per my request. For my family being in a house with no heat for almost two weeks, we were very happy with Jesse's demeanor and understanding of our dilemma.  His knowledge of a boiler was so grateful to us since so many other companies I had called didn't work on boilers. We were need help and he delivered it with no problem. Going above and beyond to give us his expertise immediately.  Mr. Jesse Yeargain was a blessing for our family in trouble. I pray if we ever need any future assistance we will get another technician with a heart for the job and the customer. He is amazing. Thank you ABC.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.text: Extremely helpful and knowledgeable. Diagnosed problem quickly and accurately. Scheduling the appointment was easy and fast same day. My technician was very professional, personable, and explained things clearly. This was my first time with ABC, I was skeptical but know I will use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Carrie Portis
reviews.text: Mr. Tyrell and Mr. Reigus was very polite and explained everything in detail. Didnt rush through visit without explaining everything. Recommended different options and explained about those in detail. Explained why getting  certain things done were better overall.  Made sure to keep floor clean. Great customer service. Showed me everything not just talked about issues. Would recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Wally Budzielek
reviews.text: Aiden Moran, our technician, was one of the most polite, courteous and professional individuals we’ve had the pleasure of dealing with.  He pinpointed the problem immediately and made absolutely certain it was repaired correctly before he left.  You have a real gem of an employee with Aiden and hope you take good care of him.  Aiden is the definition of customer service satisfaction!

plumbers.name: Gaithersburg Plumbing Pros
plumbers.address: 30 Orchard Dr, Gaithersburg, MD 20878, USA

reviews.author: Jessica R.
reviews.text: We were extremely pleased with the top-notch service we received from Gaithersburg Plumbing Pros, particularly thanks to Berto's reliable and friendly demeanor, as well as Christopher's expert handling of the toilet replacement, which included installation of a new flange and shut off valve. From scheduling to completion, the whole experience was seamless, timely, and professional, leaving us feeling confident in the team's ability to tackle any emerging plumbing issues, whether unexpected or routine.

reviews.author: Barton
reviews.text: We  noticed  dampness  in  the  basement  wall.  Antonio  did leak  detection  and  found  a  hidden  pipe  issue.  He  repaired  it right  away,  saving  us  from  bigger  damage.  I  was  very thankful  for  his  thorough  work.

reviews.author: Valentyn Stadnytskyi
reviews.text:
Short story: The worse service I have ever received. Lower than industry service with higher then industry level charge. Just stay away and find someone trustworthy. I looked into other low rating reviews and there seems to be a pattern of misleading customers with prices and later charge way over.

Long story: Plumber came to check my water heater. He did not check anything except flushed the heater, a $50 job if you with other plumbers. When I asked about the anode rod, he told me it was a return plug for commercial use of the heater. He had no idea what else needs to be inspected and checked in the water heater. Also he had no idea how much services cost, so while I reported that not everything was checked, plumber said he does not handle billing. Promised me it will be all sorted out over a phone with billing. I made huge mistake and accepted the job. So plumber came spent 30 minutes and rushed away home, it was his last call for the day. No wonder he did not want to check the rest. Very unprofessional. However, this is not it… while job was barely done, I was charged full price $500 for a 30-min job. After seeing the charge I got in touch with the plumbing company. Oh man… how unprofessional they are: it takes several emails and phone calls to actually get someone to respond.

And I forgot, he did not close the drain valve properly so I had to get someone to finish the job.

Note, They have refunded portion of the charge after a lot of back and forth. It still was $300 to drain the water heater.

reviews.author: Todd Krusey
reviews.text: Christopher was responsive and very thorough in diagnosing my problem. He came out the same day and thoroughly explainedwhat needed to be done. He was on time, very professional and left my house clean. I will definitely use Gaithersburg Plumbing pros in the future.

reviews.author: Veronica Cannon
reviews.text: Had an emergency situation and Gaithersburg Plumbing Pros had a technician at my home first thing in the morning.  After an evaluation the technician promptly resolved the issue.  Excellent attention provided by this company by the technician and from Christopher of their office!

plumbers.name: Captain Rooter Emergency Plumbers
plumbers.address: 1252 W Chicago Ave, Chicago, IL 60642, USA

reviews.author: James Gilbert
reviews.text:
Jesse waked away from the job without finishing...as soon as he received the final payment of $8400 CASH.
He installed a toilet without a cover to the tank.
One of the workers left the basement door open on the coldest day of the winter, resulting in a burst copper pipe and 2 inches of water in the basement. He did not come close to completing the job he was paid to do and less than 24 hours later, the sink he installed leaked.
His response: "I'm not going to be bullied because I did you a cash favor." Would you call $8400 cash a favor to the customer or a way of evading taxes? You make the call.
I have attempted to contact him on his business and personal line to secure the name and contact information of his bonding and insurance company...he hung up on me and does not return text messages.
Do yourselves a favor and DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH THIS MAN OR HIS COMPANY. Nefarious and shoddy at best.

reviews.author: Monica B. Anthony
reviews.text: Just wanted to take a moment to commend Oz for a job well done. He came right in explained everything, and was determined to  leave with results. He was very professional, concerned, and determined. If you need a honest plumber who will fix your problem please ask for Oz. Thank you!

reviews.author: Mark Matich
reviews.text: Oz came not long after I requested a "Pro" online. Roxane called before I even got off line, and had a Tech coming soon. Oz did a great job, fixing the tank leak on the toilet. He had a great work attitude, and customer care attitude. I would call them again.

reviews.text: I called S.J. Eaton for help with a clogged basement drain. My call was made after 1PM. Chris arrived shortly after that, He went right to work and resolved my clog in short order. Chris was friendly and professional. We will recommend S.J. Eaton to our friends.

reviews.author: Brianna Campbell
reviews.text: Sj&eaton are always readily available for emergencies or typical updates needed in home with heating and plumbing. They are wonderful and I refer them to anyone I know in our area for there plumbing and heating needs!

reviews.author: Margie Brown
reviews.text:
Best place ever fast reliable, experienced workers ,great prices ,I really can't say enough about this company, I go never even think about going elsewhere.

reviews.author: Chris Adamsky
reviews.text: Totally unprofessional and poorly trained.  Tech came to my house to diagnose water heater for coverage under my home warranty.  Upon arrival tried to install new water heater in spite of my clear verbal instructions to the office about needing approval. Tech then claimed he didn’t know how to diagnose problem and water heater was just old.  Tech then claimed there was no power to unit and I needed to call an electrician.   However upon checking when I returned from work I found with a tester there was indeed power to the unit(see photo).  Also tech left a puddle of water in my basement.   I called to complain about the service and was greeted with a very rude and condescending secretary, who tried to speak over me and then hung up when I would not put up with it.  I was very frustrated but did not curse, I wanted my complaint to be heard.  Her lack of customer service skills would have her fired from most respectable companies. I do not recommend this company and will tell anyone I come in contact with to avoid them at all costs.

plumbers.name: TJM Sewer and Plumbing
plumbers.address: 31W070 Rohrssen Rd, Elgin, IL 60120, USA

reviews.author: Robin Fomusa
reviews.text:
I hate to leave a bad review, especially for a local business, but I’ve given TJM Sewer & Plumbing plenty of time to fix things to no avail. On December 26, I paid a $125 estimate fee and was quoted $4,500 to replace a pump and tank and redo plumbing. I was told the $125 would be credited if we moved forward. When the work was done, they determined the tank did not need to be replaced, yet I was still charged the full $4,500 and the estimate fee was not deducted.

Shortly after installation, the pump was not functioning properly. When I asked them to return to fix it, they attempted to sell me a whole-house filtration system instead of addressing the issue. I declined. They later blamed our problems on an issue with the well and claimed they could not fix it. I hired a well contractor who resolved the problem in 30 minutes without touching the well, leading me to believe there was never an issue with the well.

I requested an itemized invoice, which did not align with the work performed. Based on labor and materials, the job appears significantly overpriced (almost double). I formally requested a partial refund on January 12 and followed up multiple times, most recently on February 6, and have received no response.
I am incredibly disappointed with the lack of response and professionalism. I’ve also since been informed that they were never even licensed to have done the work they performed. I am sharing my experience in hopes that it can save someone else the headache and loss of money.

reviews.author: Andy Jeser
reviews.text:
TJM Saves the day!  Todd, Chris, and the TJM team were outstanding.    We had an excellent experience with TJM.

We  noticed strong sewer gas odor on a Friday morning.   Todd and Chris quickly came out and determined we had a broken sewer pipe. They were back at my house Saturday morning with a big crew to fix the issue.

Our repair was very involved.  It was big and extensive repair.  It  required saw cutting our driveway, opening the foundation,  and major excavating to access the broken pipes and fix the issue.      Todd, Chis, & crew had our plumbing fixed that afternoon.    They were back Monday to finish things up and closed things out with the inspector.

TJM was honest, professional, knowledgeable, delivered on quality, and was priced fairly.

My family and I were in a very bad spot with an unexpected broken sewer pipe that required major repairs.   TJM walked us through every step and did their best to help us out during a stressful situation.   No matter how many questions or issues we had-  Todd always took his time to address our concerns.  He wants to help and he does great work.

I 100% recommend TJM for any plumbing and sewer job.      They will get the job done right.

reviews.author: Gina Postelli
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with TJM Plumbing. They were right on time. They were knowledgeable and efficient, finishing everything they said they would in 2 hours. And that included an unexpected trip to Home Depot to ensure they had a part which would not leak. He charged exactly what his estimate said he would charge. I would call them again for any job in my home.

reviews.author: Neil Hollister
reviews.text:

Highly recommend TJM!!!!

reviews.text: We were so grateful that Gabe saved us with a next day repair. He did fantastic work and was very helpful. We will be hiring him with all our future plumbing needs. Can’t recommend enough!

reviews.author: Rachel Doss

Thank you!

reviews.author: Mickey McGrenaghan

reviews.author: Melissa Hendrick
reviews.text: I always love supporting local merchants in my area and CPS didn't let me down.  I recently received a water bill that was 4x the prior month, with not add'l water usage.  I called CPS and the very next day they sent Luke and Jared out to test for leaks.  The guys could have jumped straight into a more expense test with the main box, but instead they were methodically, went water device by water device (ie, sinks, faucets, washing machine, each toilet to see if any of those were leaking - also finding the fittings to my toilets were original to the 1983 house (which I had them replace - for a reasonable price).  The last test proved (we hope - havent' received a bill yet) was a leaky toilet. Yet they went ahead and then tested the main controller, first the house then the irrigation system. Fortunately no pressure change - so all was good (whew!). Best of all Luke explained all the way through what he was doing and spoke in a way I could understand what he was doing.  CPS management these guys are awesome.  Beverly thanks for booking me so fast!!! Cheers CPS, keep up the great work!

reviews.author: Luis Lozano
reviews.text: I contacted Reliable HVAC after discovering water leaking from my furnace/AC. Assuming a faulty condensate pump, I requested a repair. Ian responded and replaced the pump. However, he left without testing or confirming that the leak had stopped. Unfortunately, the water continued even after he left. I was billed $235, but the issue wasn’t resolved. I was overcharged for incomplete work and left without an actual solution. When the issue continued, I investigated further and discovered a block of ice had formed around the evaporator coils. All of this was visible and diagnosable with basic HVAC troubleshooting, which the technician did not perform. If you’re seeking truly reliable service, I recommend looking elsewhere.

reviews.author: Amarilys Clarke
reviews.text: I felt compelled to leave this review as I never had such a great experience when it came to resolving plumbling issues. Our water heater went on Tuesday and we happened to noticed right away around 2:38 p.m., my husband called Reliable and they came out right away.  They were here around 3:10p.m. same day.  Hunter was extremely professional, easy to communicate with him, personable, very knowledgeable.  They never asked for a service call fee, he immediately told us the price, recommended a better product.  We immediately said to go ahead and within 45 minutes he was back with a new water heater.  He promptly installed it, hawl the old one out to take with him and cleaned after himself. He was prompt and efficient. He replaced the copper pipe that had multiple welding from how many times the water heater had been replaced.  He also replaced few valves.  It looks clean and professional. After installation he explained everything about the water heater and how to trouble shoot different scenarios. He was done by 6 p.m. I have to say, I was very impressed with how prompt and efficient they were (specially Hunter) to resolve our problem.  Highly recommend!!!!!

reviews.author: Riane S
reviews.text: I cannot thank Ian enough. Came out within 30 minutes of an early Sunday morning call. Figured out the issue and is scheduling the solution for the same week. Finally a company that answers the phone and helps when in need. They will be our new and only HVAC and plumber.

reviews.author: Paul Marinucci
reviews.text:
Reliable HVAC and Plumbing is absolutely fantastic!!  From the moment I called and spoke to Alex who arranged the service call and she scheduled their tech I knew I was in the best of hands. Tech Eric called me as he was on his way and arrived exactly on time as he’d said. Eric listened patiently and intently as I explained the issue with my furnace.  He detailed what the usual possible causes could be and explained all the diagnostics he would do to rule them out and hone in on what the problem could be. Eric explained in great detail what he was doing and why.  Eric narrowed it down and quickly found that the communications between the Thermostat and the furnace were faulting out and causing the furnace to trip off and fail to run properly. Eric quickly installed a new digital thermostat and tested it and the furnace thoroughly. He showed me how to operate the thermostat, set date and time, heating and cooling - I dont even have to read the owners manual - Eric explained everything in great detail, with a smile, taking his time answering all my questions. It’s clear that Eric and Reliable HVAC are the best I’ve ever dealt with and I’m
Happy to be their customer for life. Great work and thank you for getting me back up and running so quickly!  Huge kudos!!

reviews.text:

No questions were asked— a team was dispatched immediately to assess the situation.

They also took full ownership of the entire MASS SAVE refund process, which was seamless. I highly recommend this business if you're looking for excellent after-sales support.

reviews.author: Allykat500
reviews.text:
If I could give 0 stars I would. It started last night when my punch guy/handyman cut a stub out line for my whole house water filtration system. The line was Pex material and he didn't have the proper tools to make the connection.  It's a new construction house so I wasn't concerned that there wasn't water running to the house last night but wanted to line up a plumber for today (I'm the builder). I called Conroe plumbing and described the situation.  The lady on the phone scheduled the appointment,  said it would be $125 trip charge, $85 for each additional hour and $35 more if they brought a "helper"....then said she would get a plumber to call me to make sure they could do the work. 90 minutes later he called. I told him the situation and even texted him a photo of the pipe. He said no worries, they had the tools, and it would take one guy less than an hour. The next morning on time a young man showed up with a "helper". I showed them to the garage and he began looking at the pipe. From the onset I knew I was in trouble. This kid knew nothing and the helper knew even less. They made 3 trips to their truck, then a 25 minute phone call to their office telling someone over the phone all about the job and asking what to do. He walked back into the garage to tell me the repairs would take all day, because he DIDN'T HAVE THE TOOLS so he had to go back for the right tools and parts, and because it was so complicated he would be charging me $700. Please see pictures below. I told him "no thanks and have a blessed day". $125+ tax = wasted. I then called Moore plumbing supply and talked to them. I drove over purchased 2 shark bite connectors and a section of CPVC (I paid for 10 feet but only needed about 2 feet). Total cost $58 and time taken in the garage to bring water back on by myself = 15 minutes. I'm sure they have helped a lot of people in the community but I shudder to think of the lies and the costs.

Update: Today the owner contacted me and apologized for the experience.  He stated that there was miscommunication between himself and his worker and wanted to make the situation right. He has offered to refund the trip charge and even went so far as to hold a meeting with his staff using this as a "teachable moment" and vowing to offer more value to his customers. Even though my experience wasn't good their response let me know that was an isolated event and they will work to do the right thing.

reviews.text: Extremely unprofessional. I hired Plumbing Ministry to install a Moen automatic water shutoff in my new home. The technician was given access to my home before we moved in. A month later, I was inspecting my crawl space and noticed that my $700 sleeping bag was in the corner where the installation had been done. It was covered in dust and had a hole in it. The technician had clearly taken it from my belongings and used it as a pad while working under my house and left it there! The technician is the ONLY person who had access to my crawl space since the home was purchased, but Plumbing Ministry denied that their employee did this and refused to compensate me for the loss.

reviews.author: Arjmand Yousefian
reviews.text: I recently had sewer drain replacement work done by  The Plumbing Ministry , and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From start to finish, the team was professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. They explained the process clearly, completed the job on time, and made sure everything was done right. The quality of their work really shows, and they left the area clean when finished. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable plumbing services!

reviews.author: Deborah W.
reviews.text:
I called the Plumbing Ministry from a referral, and I am so glad I did.
They came to inspect my sewer lateral, only to discover that a previous sewer job one year prior (by a pretend plumber) was not up to code. Image how disappointed I was over the large amount of money literally down the sewer.
The Plumbing Ministry came and made the repair, did my sewer lateral, and it passed both the City & EBMUD standards. The staff was always timely, courtesy, respectful, and hard working. KUDOS to Louis and his team!!

reviews.author: Seido Karasaki
reviews.text:
EDIT: ***See the owner's response. Note the total lack of empathy or ownership for the mistake. Do you really want to do business with plumbers who don't even try to help when something goes wrong, especially when it affects somebody who had nothing to do with the job? I would encourage everyone who is thinking of hiring this company to think twice - read all the negative yelp and google reviews to see what you're really getting into when you hire the Plumbing Ministry. One review even notes that the only positive reviews are from real estate agents who want the bare minimum done. I would highly encourage anyone reading this review who has had problems with the Plumbing Ministry to reach out to the El Cerrito City Department, Better Business Bureau, California Department of Consumer Affairs, and California Attorney General's Office to file a complaint.***

My neighbors hired the Plumbing Ministry to do some plumbing work. This involved the company coming on July 24th and digging up the pipes in the street area between my neighbors place and residence. They then proceeded to accidentally cut our cable and wifi service line, which resulted in a brief interruption to cell service. As of today, July 28th, the wifi service still has not been fixed.

The Plumbing Ministry has not offered to resolve this situation in any way whatsoever. They first tried to deny they had anything to do with it, but after confronting them, they told me they would contact the office and the right people to get this fixed. Since I had not heard anything from them and no work had been done to restore access, I called the office number for the plumbing ministry. I talked to the owner who was apathetic at best, denied all wrongdoing by stating that our cables were unmarked (which does not seem like a reason to cut them in the first place), and told me that there is nothing they can do.

Wifi may seem unimportant to most, but as somebody who works remotely, I find the apathy and the lack of ownership taken by the Plumbing Ministry to be appalling. I believe my experience to be indicative of the work they perform and the service that they provide as a business.

reviews.author: Kristine Mezger-Ashbaugh
reviews.text: Matthew and Will were extremely professional and did an awesome job installing new toilets. I will always work with local small businesses before corporate America. Honest. Dedicated. Positive. Enjoys the profession. Definitely keeping contact handy for future issues.

reviews.author: Frank Crone
reviews.text:
Matt came recommended to us by our son-in-law whose grandparents paid an astronomical price for a service that once investigated by Matt , was mostly temporary fixes at an inflated price. Matt worked with his elderly grandparents and repaired and replaced it permanently for a fraction of the cost.

We decided to do a bathroom remodel in our older home and were shocked at the 100k price tag. My wife, via TikTok, YouTube and other platforms decided she could do it at a fraction of the price. Until we met the plumbing issues. Enter Frontline and its owner Matt. Matt cane by at a moments notice to discover the problems and immediately cane up with cost-effective solutions and gave a quote that we couldn’t refuse. I might also add my wife “added” a few more things out of his comfort zone-an electrical add on. Instead of subbing it out, he added it in (he can do it, just not a preference of his) at minimal cost. That’s great business folks. He came as scheduled and promised and delivered phenomenal work. So much so, a friend, about to do a new residential build, saw the work, and immediately asked for his card not even knowing the value we were given. Just based upon his promise to come when agreed (it was during the ice storm) and  doing high-quality work. Now my wife can continue on with her project.

Folks there are  far too many scammers out there. Matt is not one of them. Great work at a great price. We look forward to him coming out this summer to add a pool heater and run the gas lines to it on our 26,000 gallon pool. I trust this company 100 percent. I recommend them double that.
Dr. C

reviews.author: Caleb Anderson
reviews.text:
As a builder in the Upstate South Carolina market, having a dependable plumbing contractor is critical. Frontline Plumbing has been a strong partner on our new construction homes in Greenville, Greer, and Spartanburg.

They understand modern plumbing systems, tankless water heaters, whole-home filtration, gas piping, and full residential rough-ins. Their work is clean, inspections go smoothly, and homeowners are always impressed at final walkthrough.

Frontline Plumbing brings professionalism and craftsmanship to every build. We look forward to continuing to work together.

— Elevate Homes

reviews.author: John Thomas
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough great things about Matthew Johnson and Frontline Plumbing! From start to finish, the experience was absolutely top-notch. Matthew was professional, honest, and incredibly knowledgeable. He showed up on time, explained everything clearly, and took the time to make sure the job was done perfectly.

What really stood out was his attention to detail and the pride he takes in his work. He didn’t cut corners, and he treated my home with respect—cleaning up everything before he left and making sure I was completely satisfied.

It’s hard to find someone you can truly trust, but Matthew is the real deal. Fair pricing, excellent workmanship, and outstanding customer service. If you need plumbing work done, Frontline Plumbing is the company to call. I won’t use anyone else!

Highly recommend to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and high-quality plumbing service!

His professionalism, honesty, and knowledge made a stressful situation much easier. If you’re looking for a true professional, Matthew Johnson with Frontline Plumbing is the way to go. You won’t find anyone better to assist you with your plumbing needs

Heating can now be programmed in separate areas of the house which is wonderful because the rooms where we spend the most time are heated without having to heat the entire house. [Update 7/23] The folks at Planet Pluming went above and beyond to help address the issue at my house and help explain the work. [Original 7/21] I've used Planet Plumbing for years and have always been happy with their service and prices--and have widely recommended them. But my technician today over-stressed my system, leaving gray water pouring in my basement (for me to clean up), left a mess in my shower, was not able to fix a dripping bathroom sink faucet, spent several hours trying to clear a mainline without camera-scoping it first--taking out my toilet in the process (which didn't seem to have any issues). I never leave reviews, but I am extremely disappointed in the service, price, and lack of communication about the process and options during the project. reviews.author: martin loroima
reviews.text:
I own a rental house in Cedar Park and I had an emergency with a couple of projects that needed to be fixed ASAP. First, my water heater is in the attic and my tenant informed me that there was no hot water in the whole house. The second problem was that when the tenant flushed the toilet there was water backing up to the bathtub. He tried to use the plunger to see if he could get the toilet unclogged but after spending almost an hour trying to unclog it he finally gave up.

All this happened over the weekend and I was out of town. I needed a plumber ASAP cause the tenant had some visitors and he was already frustrated. After calling multiple plumbing companies in the area nobody was available or they simply did not pick up the phone.

Finally, I found Cedar Park Plumbers and I was surprised they picked up the phone at 8pm on a Saturday. I explained what was going on and within 30 minutes they sent a plumber out to my property. He took pictures of the water heater and sent them to me explaining that it was an old unit and needed to be replaced. My water heater has an expansion tank and he gave me a detailed explanation of why I needed another expansion tank.

After that, he ran a camera to find the problem of the clogged line and found some tree roots in the sewer line. The toilet paper could not go through and got stuck causing the clog. He read his machine to remove the roots and unclogged the line. He told me that that was a temporary solution but once you have roots in the pipe they will grow again to the point where they can brake the pipe much worse.

Anyways, he had a brand new water heater and also installed it and the same night he fixed the 2 problems that were causing stress. I’m very very grateful to Cedar Park Plumbers for their availability and for helping me solve these 2 problems. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: P C Kenar
reviews.text:
Have a serious sewer or water line issue? These are the guys. They are the best! They were not daunted by an issue of long standing regarding a broken sewer pipe that was causing issues well beyond unpleasant.

Other companies did not seem to know how to solve the issue without massive unnecessary work. They couldn’t even find where the breaks in the pipe were. All they did was tell us how long the run is, like I didn’t know that, how it’s an old pipe, also not news, and that they couldn’t really give a quote. Calumet City came out, identified two breaks and their exact locations within an hour. Other companies couldn’t even figure out how to scope the line, and did not understand that the line had two clean outs. They didn’t know what that was in the backyard, and said it would have to go. It didn’t and it is an integral component to the system. It’s the second clean out for an unusually long run. And they believed me when I said there was a broken rodder in the line, and they identified that it was the cause of the breaks in the first place. And that had to have happened a long time ago. We’ll never know just who did the damage.

They prepared a very fair quote in a very timely fashion that included all aspects of the work. This included the entire job, like new concrete, and even the garage door weather strip, so everything is as it was. Other companies only really offered recommendations for most of the work. These
other companies also wanted open-ended contracts, so they could charge whatever they wanted. Do people really not understand what could result by signing a contract like that?

It was well worth living with an issue until we found a company, the right company, that knows about old, and new, sewer and water lines. So glad we did wait, even if it was unpleasant.

The team leader and team were terrific. They are all knowledgeable, arrive on time, friendly, have a sense of humor while doing pretty unpleasant work. And they took the time to explain what was going on before, during, and after.

Understand, there are many companies that will tell you issues like an old broken sewer line will cost tens of thousands, maybe more. And from what was actually done that solved this long standing problem, those companies would not only have cost me well over treble the cost, but would have caused a whole lot of damage, and maybe the building. They said they’d need to tear out part of a fence, tear up a large established garden, and tear up the concrete floor of a large garage. One company wanted to completely reroute the entire line and tear up the basement, the long driveway and the newly done street and new sewer and water lines. They didn’t even know where to get an excavator of the proper size. And all they need to do was look from that second clean out they didn’t understand to find the problem. They wouldn’t do that when I asked them to. They gave excuses as to why they couldn’t.

reviews.text: Carlos was great. Came as soon as I called late at night , found the problem and did a great job on fixing everything.  Will definitely keep him in my contacts for any of my plumbing issues and will totally recommend him to anyone. Great Job. Thank you Carlos for saving us.

plumbers.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Water Cleanup
plumbers.address: 895 Hampshire Rd, Stow, OH 44224, USA

reviews.author: Charles Honsinger
reviews.text: purchase new water heater back in 12/12/2024 water heater under warranty but labor to install new water heater was 1600.00 the biggest ripoff I would never recommend rotor rooter out stow Ohio for any plumbing issues

reviews.author: Abbey kavanagh Marshall
reviews.text: So extremely disappointed by this company. We had a sewer back up in our basement, they came out in a timely manner which I appreciated. However, the guy looked into the pipe with flashlight and determined it was a “sludge buildup” and recommended we got hydro jetting for 738 dollars. Turns out after the problem getting worse and getting a second opinion it was tree roots.

reviews.author: Michael Junewicz
reviews.text: I had an emergency at my home with a couple of drains backed up. I didn't know what to expect about how the issues would be addressed. Roto Rooter sent a plumber on the same day that I called, and he addressed both drains quickly. I worried that the second drain might be a big ordeal, but the plumber was able to snake it without changing the price he'd already quoted for the first drain. One of the drains was a floor drain, and it finally has a proper cover on it, as it has needed for a while. I'm very happy with my service.

reviews.author: Ron Long
reviews.text:
Well, I had about as good of an experience as a person with sewage in his basement can have! Brian, my technician, was polite, punctual, articulate and informed! He answered all of my questions and understood my reservations about how we needed to proceed. In the end, it was taken care of professionally and efficiently. I was educated as to what caused the problem (That camera that can go out the sewer line was pretty cool!) and given some reasonable recommendations on follow up service.
I called Roto-Rooter because of their good reputation and I was not disappointed!
Lee
Stow, Ohio

reviews.author: Steve Shimko
reviews.text: My 86 year old grandmother paid $5,000 to have a 150 foot section of downspout pipe that goes to the street replaced. We had a technician out initially to try and snake the drain. The tech worked for 20 minutes with a hydro jet and decided that the pipe was broken underground. They charged $500 for a 20 minute service. He then told us that another tech would be out the following day to run a camera and locator through the pipe to decide what further action needed to be taken. That tech was there for another 20 minutes and did nothing but right a quote for having the pipe replaced. He initially told us that it would cost $3,900 dollars, he then spoke on the phone with a supervisor who told us that it would cost an additional $4,500 to have it fixed. So that’s how we got to $5,000. We were told they would call the day before before they came to do the work which they did not. They did the work in 1 day. It wasn’t a small job, but hardly worth $5,000.  They left a huge mess  of boulders, roots and broken concrete on my grandmas yard and told her that it would “settle out in 5 to 8 months” and that they weren’t landscapers. For 5k they could’ve tried harder to clean up their mess. They also took $20 worth of corrugated pipe that I had temporarily rigged up so that her basement wouldn’t flood. Sure, she now has a good piece of pipe in the ground but I’m pretty unhappy with the way they treated my grandmother and her property. They didn’t cover the concrete that they put in and it rained on it. The day after, my grandma is almost in tears because of the way they left her yard.

plumbers.name: Dewey's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 230 S 6th Pl, Cottonwood, AZ 86326, USA

reviews.author: Janie Z
reviews.text: Dewey's Plumbing saved me! Jason came out on an emergency overflow and worked diligently to get it unclogged. Gary and an apprentice followed up a week later, with suggestions on troubleshooting options for prevention so this nightmare doesn't keep happening. Great company, very knowledgeable and sincerely caring employees. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Samuel Needham
reviews.text: They came out promptly , and they were fantastic. I would highly recommend them to anyone. They changed the filters for our house R o system and as they were doing that , they fixed every other problem that arised. They were able to give me a lot of information about my system and answered any questions or concerns I had. Will Be using them again in the future.

reviews.author: Julie Clark
reviews.text: Emilio and Cole provided excellent service in the repair of our broken water line to our new refrigerator.  The delivery people from the store we purchased it from pulled out the line and water started spraying everywhere, even under the house.  We called Dewey’s in a panic and they sent Emilio and Cole within 30 minutes!  They were able to stop the spraying and capped off the broken line until they could come back today and thoroughly repair everything.  They also installed a valve and shutoff switch so this can never happen again.  We were so impressed with Emilio and Cole’s professionalism, expertise, kindness and care.  Also, thanks to the person who answered our frantic call for help.  She jumped on it right away and dispatched assistance immediately.  Kudos and thank you Dewey’s Plumbing!

reviews.author: Christina Murray
reviews.text: Have used Deweys Plumbing over the last 9 years for several issues including new hot water heater, new toilet installation, and major leak when ice maker line broke —and they have always done a great job. Gary and Dylan handled this appointment and they were professional, efficient, knowledgable, and friendly. They identified and repaired the leaks under the kitchen sink and installed new faucet.  They were great about answering all my questions and cleaned up everything before they left. Great service! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Sally Caruso
reviews.text: I have an older home in Sedona that so many different repairs have been done to that it was a confusing mess - both gas & water piping.  Gary trouble shot both systems until he understood what was causing mixing of hot & cold water and tracked a outdoor gas leak. I now have hot & cool water where they should be and gas lines working. Dewey’s listened to Gary’s recommendation to reduce costs as it was time consuming to track down the issues & best solutions - expensive but finally all resolved.  Just in time for my putting on a family reunion here.  I appreciate Gary & Dewey’s.  Will not let anyone else fix my plumbing.

plumbers.name: Anne Arundel Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 7930 Wooded Glen Ct, Pasadena, MD 21122, USA

reviews.author: Jill Grempler
reviews.text: I am glad I started using this company after purchasing a new home in Pasadena.  I started using them initially for my annual backflow water testing required by the county; they were significantly cheaper than other plumbers I called…  I recently had an emergency leak and they were beyond excellent!  Jeff & the company saved me and my house by also connecting me with a water mitigation company that was equally responsive and they immediately came to my house that same day once the plumbing portion was repaired.  Any time I call Anne Arundel Plumbing, they are extremely friendly, trustworthy, dependable, knowledgable, and respond very fast!   Highly respected and strongly recommended!!

reviews.author: A. Nicole
reviews.text: We had a small basement flood and Anne Arundel Plumbing came and immediately identified the issue. After a few bad experiences with other companies, I located them and I have never used anyone else in the last three years. They are friendly, patient, respectful of your property, and won’t cheat you for the work that they do! I will never use another Plumbing company as long as this company is in business! Family owned and operated and trusted. You won’t go wrong!

reviews.author: christopher ominelli
reviews.text: Jeff and his son were great! They helped with an emergency grinder pump replacement. Before coming, Jeff helped me diagnose everything over the phone to make sure I wasn't paying for something I didn't need. His son came on time and was extremely professional. Thanks for the great service!

reviews.author: Amber Woods
reviews.text: Quick responses, exceptional service, fair prices. Where others push costly replacements without enough investigation, Anne Arundel Plumbing investigates, tries solutions, and tests results right before your eyes. Literally saved me thousands in less than an hour.

reviews.author: Cathie Eid
reviews.text: Called on a Thursday to have a new dishwasher installed.  Jeff said he couldn’t do it Friday but he could Tues or Wed.  He said he would call.  We called him Wednesday and he said he could do it Thursday and would call in the morning to set up a time.  Never called.  We called Chesapeake Plumbing on Friday.  They came Monday Morning.  Did a great job.  Don’t waste your time with Anne Arundel Plumbing.  If he didn’t want to do it just say so!!

plumbers.name: Hard Hat Rooter and plumbing
plumbers.address: 416 E Cypress Ave, Burbank, CA 91501, USA

reviews.author: Talin Shah
reviews.text: I had a broken pipe  Under my house and I went online to find plumbers. They were the first ones to reply and able to come that same day. I use them they were great and just recently something else happened. I called them and they  Came. I would definitely recommend them. I do feel like they’re honest 100%.

reviews.author: Allen Avedissian
reviews.text: I use Raffi for all my real estate deals and property management needs, and he’s been rock solid every time. He does exactly what he says he’s going to do, shows up when he says he will, and gets the job done right. Honest, reliable, and always puts full customer satisfaction first. Someone you can actually trust in this business.

reviews.author: Steven Safarloo
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with [Hard Hat Plumbing]! My water heater suddenly stopped working, and they were able to schedule a same-day visit. The plumber, [Raffi], arrived right on time, explained everything clearly, and had the issue fixed within an hour.

What impressed me most was the professionalism and transparency—no hidden fees, and they walked me through the repair options without any pressure. The price was fair, and the service was top-notch.

Highly recommend them for anyone looking for honest and efficient plumbing work. I’ll definitely be using them again in the future!

reviews.author: Ani Bazil
reviews.text:
I recently had a major issue with my sewer line and called Hard Hat Plumbing based on a recommendation—and I’m so glad I did.

From the first phone call, they were clear, honest, and reassuring. The team came out quickly, diagnosed the issue with a camera inspection, and walked me through exactly what needed to be done. No upselling, no pressure—just facts.

Replacing a sewer line is no small job, but they handled it professionally from start to finish. They secured the permits, coordinated everything, and finished the work faster than expected. The crew was respectful of my property, kept the work area tidy, and left everything cleaner than I expected once the job was done.

Pricing was fair and transparent, and the quality of the work gave me real peace of mind. I highly recommend Hard Hat Plumbing for anyone dealing with serious plumbing issues—they truly know what they’re doing and treat you with respect.

reviews.author: Jonathan
reviews.text: They take ownership of their work and are extremely efficient and professional. Work is top notch and well-priced. They are incredibly quick to respond and schedule work as well. Definitely the best plumbers I've ever used.

plumbers.name: Durance Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7304 Carroll Ave #149, Takoma Park, MD 20912, USA

reviews.author: Jessica Mahajan
reviews.text: Adam cares about his customers and does wonderful work efficiently. We have an older home that has been repaired and renovated to varying degrees; we call Durance because Adam brings his wealth of experience and patience to figure out the current problem and fix any poorly done work-arounds from previous owners. Adam always leaves our home looking better than when he arrived and leaves us feeling safer because we trust in the quality of his work. I highly recommend Durance!

reviews.author: Emma Wilson
reviews.text: Kirk Durance did a great job inspecting the backflow on my sprinkler system.  He let me know what the cost would be for the inspection and the water companies fee in advance, worked with me to find a date and time that would work with my schedule, arrived a promptly, and the inspection was done quickly.  In addition, he also answered my question on what he was doing and what a passing score was while he did the testing.  The same day, he filed the report with WSSC and sent me a copy.  I would definitely recommend him.

reviews.author: Opera Critic
reviews.text:
My experience was the opposite, overpriced, borderline competent, and untrustworthy.
Don’t believe all those glowing reviews. When  I returned the feedback survey to the company of one star, the service manager called me next morning and after long conversation saying he wanted us to “part amicably” that  he would credit $187 part of the (over) charge. But he never did. That is a disreputable company. There are many more reputable, competent and lower priced plumbers in the DMV. Use those. Don’t call Durrance Plumbing.

reviews.author: Sarah Elliot
reviews.text:
We had a collapsed drain overflowing and were told we would have to punch a hole in our foundation which we had just waterproofed. We called Durance for a second opinion and Allan had a smart, creative solution that saved us great trouble and expense. All of the men who worked on our house were courteous and competent. They were quick, communicative and the job was well done.
It's very nice to finally know who to call!

reviews.author: Washington Pediatric Dentistry
reviews.text: Year after year, we’ve relied on Durance Plumbing for our annual backflow water test in our pediatric dental office. Service is always top-notch. Scheduling is always simple, and Kirk always shows up on time. The whole process is quick and efficient. It’s a huge relief knowing we’re staying compliant without any stress. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Mia's Master Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3454 Forestbrook Rd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29588, USA

reviews.author: Amanda Almeida Leavitt
reviews.text: This is u second time requesting their services. I have the best experience with the Mia’s Master Plumbing Team. They are highly skilled, fast, friendly and fairly priced. They can develop any project in just under a week, and always have quality and client satisfaction as their primary goal. Thank you so much for the great work, I know I will keep you guys in my contacts for future jobs.

reviews.author: Alex Rosmus
reviews.text: Victor was referred to me by the Pro Desk at my local Home Depot. I was going to have the existing shower replaced in the home I had just moved into, with a shower surround, basin, and glass doors. Victor contacted me and told me he could do that for a price that was about 1/3 of what ReBath told me their STARTING price was. But he also suggested I consider a much nicer approach, with tiled walls and floor, and he sent me some pictures of other projects he had done. I picked the tile I wanted, and then he suggested the floor tiles for me, and they look great. Ripping out the old shower was no picnic for his crew and it involved more work than they anticipated, including re-routing some pipes. But the work is just about complete today and I am thrilled with the appearance of the new shower. In addition his people are replacing my exhaust fans, light fixtures, and mirrors in both bathrooms. He suggested the (lighted & anti-fog) mirrors for me as well and they are much nicer than what I was looking at originally. Thanks to his suggestions I will end up with a much nicer bathroom than I would have if I had gone with my first plans. The mirrors and lights are going in today so I can't include pictures of them (yet...if I can edit this review later I'll include those as well). I highly recommend Victor, Roberto, and Miguel. Their commitment to excellence and making sure I was happy with the results were very welcome.

reviews.author: George Ama
reviews.text: Great company to work with. They hooked up my gas grill to the main in lass than 20 minutes. Fast, efficient, courteous and all around great guys Victor and Roberto are the best. They are my go to plumbers here in MYR.

reviews.author: Adam Ervin
reviews.text:
🚨 Beware of Scammers in Town! 🚨

We recently got scammed by this so-called “service provider.” They took $150 from us and completely disappeared. No follow-up, no work done, no professionalism whatsoever.

It’s honestly disappointing to see people running fake operations and taking advantage of others’ trust. We’re sharing this to warn everyone — please don’t use their services or fall for their fake promises.

If you care about your time and money, stay away from them. They’re dishonest, unreliable, and only after your payment.

We learned our lesson — hoping this helps others avoid being scammed too!

reviews.author: Safaa Yacoub
reviews.text: Master plumbing installed our house filter a year ago in waterway subdivision they charge us for brand I Spring WF150K filters and texted us the pictures we agree about it but Mr. Victor installed a generic filter with the same brand name money and we chase him to give us the filter catalog and he never responded. Today we try to shut the main house water but we found out the water did not shut off except from the master bathroom which mean the filter is contacted to the master bedroom only. The Master  plumbing company Mr. Victor screw us twice this company is not professional and we never recommended to anyone. Today we call the main line to request someone to come to see the main shut off and the filter connection and we are planing to file a complaint to the small claim department and the consumer association to get our problem to be solved , we already have pictures and text message to support out issue for our complaint.

plumbers.name: AHS/TOPTEC Plumbing & Sewer Repair
plumbers.address: 345 E Park Ave, Libertyville, IL 60048, USA

reviews.author: Benjamin Ferdinand
reviews.text:
I just moved into a new house and called Dan at AHS Plumbing twice for two separate plumbing emergencies within our first week!  First up was a sewer line clog.  Dan arrived quickly, cleared the clog and offered recommendations to avoid future problems.  Call #2 was at 4am during a heavy rain storm as my old sump pump and the battery backup were failing to keep up with the rain.  Dan answered the phone on the first try, and after I explained the problem, he was at my house in 40 mins.!  We ended up replacing two sump pumps and battery backup systems for a very fair price, especially considering it was all done same day.

Is AHS Plumbing cheap?  No, but you get what you pay for.  Done right quickly and the first time.  No BS add-on charges.  Very skilled and professional service.  Incredibly responsive.  Dan earned my trust and will be my “go to” plumber for all future needs.

reviews.author: Linda Louis
reviews.text: I had a plumbing issue in my kitchen last night and called at 5:30 pm. By 8am this morning, Dan was at my door! He had booties to walk through the house, offered thorough explanations and practical advice, and fixed the problem in about an hour. He also checked out the pipes in my basement to make sure that everything was in proper order there, explaining what had completely mystified me about our plumbing. Thank you so much, Dan! I hope I won't have to call again, but I definitely will go with AHS if I do experience more issues in the future!

reviews.author: Mathew Joseph
reviews.text: Dan did an amazing job installing shutoff valves for my homes existing outdoor hydrants. He also installed one for me in my garage. He was on-time, courteous and very helpful. I highly recommend Dan to anyone with any type of plumbing repair or installation!

reviews.author: Kim W.
reviews.text: Dan and his partner worked on changing Several faucets and even came back to my house few days later when our laundry machine backed up with water. They did a great job in all the work they did. I had alot of questions about our plumbing and he answered all of them without being annoyed by all my questions. I trust them when it comes to doing plumbing around my home and am grateful for the work they did. They are honest, do quality work and are affordable, my husband and I are so glad we had them fix our plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Brittani Michela
reviews.text: To say that Dan at AHS Plumbing is a superhero doesn’t reflect the magnitude of how outstanding he is. We called Dan in an emergency situation - out sewage pipe sheared away from foundation. We had major backup with raw sewage leaking onto our foundation. Dan answered our call and drove right over to talk to us. He was calm, knowledgeable, friendly, and reassuring. He quoted us half of what local plumbers and bigger companies (Roto-Rooter) were wanting to charge. He fixed our issue and brought the plumbing up to code. Turns out, it’s a very common problem in the Mundelein area, so Dan knew what to do...he’s done it, literally, a hundred times, in this area. We were so lucky to have called him. Not only was he extremely efficient with this job, he took the time to explain everything he and his team was doing. We felt that communication was totally transparent and honest. If you need plumbing help, call AHS Plumbing!

plumbers.name: Wendricks-White Plumbing
plumbers.address: 912 W Greenwood Ave, Waukegan, IL 60087, USA

reviews.author: Mike Carlson
reviews.text: Leaky exterior faucet was replaced by Ed, who was friendly and worked efficiently and quickly. I'm satisfied with the work performed and will certainly use them again. Thanks!

reviews.author: Doug Carlson
reviews.text: Mario and Fernando were very personable, friendly and professional from the first minute. They told me what they were going to do and how much it would cost. And kept to both their time and cost estimates with a smile.

reviews.author: Frances Groves
reviews.text: Tom arrived on time with a smile to perform an emergency repair on the leak from one of the pipes in my basement.  He did an excellent job and left the work site clean and tidy.  I have been using Wendricks for all my plumbing work for more than 20 years and am very happy with their prompt and excellent services.

reviews.author: Linda Kerby
reviews.text:
Great company. Amazingly attentive and prompt to fix our plumbing problem. Ed was very  professional and knew exactly what to do. The job was over in no time! We have used Wendrick’s for many years and will continue to do so. The best!
Also, the young lady setting up appointments was very helpful.  She went above and beyond to accommodate our situation.  She actually seems to care about her job and providing service. Not at all like other companies that act like they’re “doing you a favor” by even talking to you! Keep up the great work!

reviews.author: Darin Kuklis
reviews.text: David did a fantastic job.  Very professional and personable.  He explained everything he was doing and showed respect for my home and property.

plumbers.name: Clog Doc
plumbers.address: 556 Tallmadge Rd, Cuyahoga Falls, OH 44221, USA

reviews.author: Evan Matthews
reviews.text: Jonathan and his crew could not have been more efficient and professional. They quickly diagnosed the pipe issue I was having and provided a quick solution. They were informative and worked hard over the course of 2 days to get my plumbing back in shape! I highly recommend ClogDoc!

reviews.author: B. Johnson
reviews.text: We highly recommend Jonathan and his team (John, Joe, and others). They are one of the best contractors we have ever worked with, demonstrating honesty, expertise, efficiency, and exceptional skill. We have hired them for projects ranging from simple drain cleaning to extremely large, complex new system installation job. In every case, they orchestrated the work with remarkable confidence and competency, making each project truly a work of art.

reviews.author: Stefanie Cardinal
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Clog Doc! The owner, Jonathan and his crew, Phil, Francisco and Joe were all super nice and really pay attention to detail. They spent 12 -14 hrs over 2 days really looking inside the pipe, hydro-jetting, snaking, re-jetting and looking again to ensure they didn’t miss anything. Due to the condition of our pipe we went with their re-lining process for our situation. Jonathan and the guys really took the time to show us how it worked and what to expect. They actually use a high-power UV light to set the epoxy liner that they put in place. They are very thorough and Phil is funny as hell! Unfortunately for our situation, we had to have a hole dug in our yard so they could gain access to our pipe, however just know that this relining process can also be done without them having to dig at all! From start to finish, the men were all great to work with considering the situation at hand. And they are also very reasonable! We got the vibe that they cared way more about the job they were doing instead of the payment. They really cared and their cost came in WAY lower than other companies we had estimates from. Definitely give them a call if you’re having any issues! We can’t thank them enough and if we ever any issues with anything again we will call them first for sure!

reviews.author: Krystal Mudery
reviews.text: If anyone is looking to have a sewer repair done. This is the place to call. Very knowledgeable staff. Timely and efficient.  Step by step communication the entire way from start to finish.  I was never left wondering what was the next steps or process.  Johnathan was in constant communication while job was being performed,  as well sent videos of before and after . I am.very pleased with the service they provided.  I couldn't recommend a better company.

reviews.author: James Tolley
reviews.text: Clog Doc did an excellent job of cleaning the main drain in my house. They showed me (via camera) the condition of the pipe before and after. They went above and beyond and had to work longer than expected. But they stayed until the job was complete. They were friendly, and considerate about cleaning up. I highly recommend them.

plumbers.name: Mint Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 11921 Freedom Dr Suite 550, Reston, VA 20190, USA

reviews.author: Adam Hall
reviews.text: Josh did a great job with our water heater! He gave us a fair price and the product was excellent. More importantly, when there was a small issue nine months later and we reached out to him, he got back with us that night and was at our house early the next morning where he promptly fixed the problem. We highly recommend Josh to anyone looking for a plumber!

reviews.author: Omar
reviews.text: I got a quick response from Josh after my initial outreach. He came in the next day and saw a major issue with a badly leaking pipe that he able to fix within a few hours. He explained everything that was going on, kept me informed of how my system was set up, and set up a better system for our home.

reviews.author: Carl Hutzler
reviews.text:
You can’t go wrong with Josh and Mint Plumbing. Extremely detail oriented. Extremely professional. He solves plumbing problems the first time! Just call him and get on the schedule.

Josh fixed a crappy plumbing job that my original installer did and added a couple of vibration damping/anti hammer attractors. And my problem is solved!

I think it’s beautiful too!?

___________

I had Josh come out a second time to look at a new vibration issue and it turns out the water pressure adjustment valve was the culprit. It provided 65lbs/in2 and was not adjustable. My shower DTV control has a rating of 45lb/in2 MAX and the higher pressure was the cause of the knocking. Josh arrived and had a sense that this may be the issue and even brought a new pressure adjustment valve. We tested everything first and then replaced the adjustment valve. Everything is working once again! So nice to have someone with as much experience as Josh to know ahead of time what the issue might be. You don't find people like this everywhere!

reviews.author: Michel Heflin
reviews.text: As a property manager, it is hard to find good subcontractors and I need to say I have found one of the best plumbers out there that I have worked with in my field of over 35 years. I have had several emergency calls and surgical centers that need to be absolutely sterilized. He has come in and done work. You could never tell that he was there, and it was always cleaner when he left from his arrival. He has helped me do everything from installing new fixtures, plumbing and even a major leak on a 2 inch main hotline for an entire building, he had it so much patched to help slow the water leak down until we could shut the building totally down and drain it. He was absolutely fantastic and doing this. His prices are always extremely reasonable and sometimes I scratch my head on the price on a couple of occasions , I thought the price was way too low from my past experience dealing with other contractors. He’s extremely honest and will explain things to you. You cannot find a better man than him. I trust him and don’t need to stand over him while he’s doing his job because I know it’ll be right when he is done  with no cut corners which is strange and today’s time. I hope this help people realize on when you find somebody good you hold onto them so I definitely recommending him for anybody that needs plumbing work larger small and I would like to thank him personally for all of his hard work , and responding quickly to all emergency calls that I’ve had to place with him and his timing.

reviews.author: Sandy Norris
reviews.text: Josh is very detailed and professional.  He provides prompt service and warranties his work for a year. Highly recommend this vendor!

plumbers.name: X-Stream Drain & Excavating
plumbers.address: 700 St Francis Ave, Smyrna, TN 37167, USA

reviews.author: Brooke Correll
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about Mark at X-Stream Drain & Excavating. He completely rebuilt the pipes in my kitchen and replaced a large section of the main drainage system in the crawl space beneath the kitchen. He did all of this at night, in 30-degree weather, and never complained once. His attitude was outstanding from start to finish, professional, positive, and focused.
Mark worked extremely efficiently and clearly knows his craft. On top of the repairs, he redesigned the main pipework under my house in a way that dramatically improved the drainage. My house was built in 1969 and the system now flows 100% more efficiently than it did before. The quality of the work done by X-Stream Drain is excellent, and everything was done at a very, VERY reasonable price.
If you’re looking for a plumber who is hardworking, skilled, and genuinely cares about doing the job right, Mark at X-Stream Drain is the one… Highly Recommend! “Call These Guys!” - Jeff Correll

reviews.author: Haleigh Black
reviews.text: Out of the gate, Mark was extremely reliable and prompt responding to our emergency. He gave fair pricing and helped us throughout the entire process with everything we had questions about or concerns with. We also had other concerns regarding plumbing within the house. They had nothing to do with the septic system he installed, and he helped without hesitation. I would recommend Mark 10 out of 10 anytime you need any kind of plumbing/Septic repairs or inquiries. He will be our go to from here on out.

reviews.author: rachel runner
reviews.text: Had my main sewer line cleaned and couldn’t be happier. The plumber was professional, on time, and explained everything clearly. They cleared the blockage fast and left the area clean. Great plumbing company—highly recommend for sewer line cleaning and drain services. Extremely professional and helpful.

reviews.author: Justen Hamilton
reviews.text: Had a backup from my sewage pipe into my house and called at 6am for an emergency.  They came out promptly in a few hours and copped roots from my sewage pipe and got everything going great. Very well priced for the service.

reviews.author: Zach Lykins
reviews.text: Mark responded quickly, communicated clearly, identified an issue that others missed, and quickly got our drain cleared. Really appreciate his level of service and would absolutely use them again and recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Misha S
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Freddy and his team at Freedom Underground at my Menlo Park residence.

It was a hairy situation where I needed to install a new sewer line down a shared driveway and into the public street. Various permits and inspections from the city as well as the sanitary district were needed, I had some concerned neighbors to deal with, and we had to do it in a way that protects a large heritage tree right near the work.

Freddy was extremely patient and creative during the scoping process. He understood the requirements and concerns of all parties involved and offered different solutions based on what the needs were. He and his office manager Fiona did a good job of managing all the admin stuff as well. I never felt like the team didn't know what they were doing or didn't have a plan.

Once the job started, Miguel did an excellent job managing the work and the team. His communication was great and he quickly corrected course based on any concerns or requirements raised. Miguel was a good foreman.

I felt in good hands the whole time and I thought the team was very diligent in cleaning up each day, keeping me updated on progress, etc. I'd definitely work with them again.

reviews.author: Mahmud Ischanov
reviews.text:
My 60 year old galvanized main water line pipe decided to spring a leak one cold Saturday evening... I had to scramble to turn the water off at the meter. As soon as I did, I started calling around plumbers that could come out quick to help me fix the pipe, as i had no water in the house of 5 people. No showers, washing hands or using toilets.
4 guys came out, Freddy from Freedom was 2nd lowest offer. What sold me on his quote was that he was going to use a trenchless tunneling system called the HammerHead (minimize trenching and destruction of 50 feet of my yard) and the fact that he suggested that he install a pressure regulator without being asked (unlike the other plumbers). The pressure regulator is important because after replacing a 60 year old corroded galvanized steel pipe with brand new copper line, the water pressure in the house could go up dramatically, causing damage to appliances and pipes in the house. Freddy even agreed to install a Flo by Moen leak detection system at no additional charge.
I am glad I decided to go with Freddy, his guys showed up on time the next morning, as agreed. His crew of guys (Christian and 4 others) worked non-stop, tirelessly and professionally. I could definitely tell the guys take pride in their work, they all did a fantastic job.
I would recommend Freddy and Freedom Underground, they are awesome!

reviews.text: Miguel and Alex did a bang-up job fixing the main water line leak in my front yard. They were able to find and fix the leak in one visit, having to dig through both clay and roots. Highly recommended.... Although I hope to never need to call upon their services again! 😁

“Five stars for Felix and Drain Guys — honest, skilled, and truly exceptional service.”

Felix and his team at Drain Guys did a fabulous job. They repaired our sewer line and replaced the clean out, digging about eight feet down with care and precision.

I first noticed the soil around my old clean out starting to sink. Felix came out quickly, scoped the line with a camera, and clearly explained what was happening and why it should be fixed. He never pressured me, and I chose to move forward before a bigger problem developed.

During the repair, Felix taught me about the installation and how the system works. As a lifelong learner and DIY type, I really appreciated that he and the crew took time to explain each step.

Photos (Before and After): Felix explained how the backfill, or ‘spoil,’ settles naturally after a deep repair. It may look like extra soil now, but it evens out as it compacts.

The team was professional, courteous, and left everything clean and organized. I’m very grateful for their honesty, skill, and pride in their work. Highly recommend Drain Guys to anyone in the Greater Chicagoland area.

reviews.text:
We were disappointed with our most recent experience replacing the faucet and under-sink hot water heater in our kitchen.

First, I requested an appointment online. The form said we would hear back within a day; we didn't. I called to schedule an appointment, and they told me someone would come by 8-9 AM the next day, provide an estimate, and do the work if I approved the estimate.. After 10 AM, they called to say they had an emergency and would call me back in a few hours with an updated time; they didn't. I called the next day and was told someone would come 10-11 AM; they didn't, and we didn't receive a call this time. I telephoned again and was told they would call back to give me a new appointment time; they didn't. A plumber did come by when I was out; fortunately, my husband was home.

The plumbing work seems to have been done well, although a circuit breaker tripped because of where the water heater was plugged in. The plumber took away the old faucet and heater (good) and also the box with the new items, including the documentation and receipt (bad). I asked my husband what the work cost, and he said the plumber said that we would be invoiced, so we didn't get an estimate first; granted, I could have told my husband to request one.

reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Alf Plumbing. Their team was professional, punctual, and very easy to communicate with from start to finish.
