reviews.author: K Washington
reviews.text: A 12 yrs experience plumber arrived 2x an stated he was unable to install my newly purchased sink. He insisted that it couldn't be done and insistes for me to purchase a facet along with a amother new sink. So today the drain remains slow exiting and clogged. The price that was paid was outrageous for the service that was supposed to be completed.

reviews.author: Michael Perry
reviews.text: Benjamin Franklin plumbing did an excellent job clearing out my plumbing clean out. My technician was very experienced and explained everything to me. He also educated me on the other systems at my home. I highly recommend Benjamin Franklin plumbing. Thank you for the great job. Also the office staff was excellent.

reviews.author: JD Aeon
reviews.text: This past week l had my house sump pump replaced. They came in as scheduled and did an excellent job! As l also have some other jobs to be done such as replacement of sinks and toilets, they offered me membership on their services and products sort of club which comes with discounts and other benefits associated to products and services, etc. l was pleasantly surprised and quite pleased! They get the job done and keep you informed of all possibilities.  My special thanks for the two polite, efficient and nice professional plumbers they sent to my house! Cheers!

reviews.author: Jay Volk
reviews.text: Justin was Awesome!  Very helpful, worked hard, and was done in a timely manner. The cost was a bit more than we hoped, but the work came with a multiple year warranty so it's all good. We'll be using them for any and all plumbing needs from this point forward.

plumbers.name: Ray's Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 948 Estes Ct, Schaumburg, IL 60193, USA

reviews.author: Jerry Mcwilliams
reviews.text: Parked next to one of there vehicles at a Menards in Glendale Hts,IL and there driver put a dent in my passenger rear qtr panel, I called and talked with there phone staff and was told i would get a call back, well that never happened of course. Take ownership when you damage someone's vehicle!

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.text:
Purchased an AC and Furnace from Ray's for my parents home because they touted their warranty on April of 2021. Today November of 2023, the furnace would not heat, so we called for service. Under the impression that the warranty should cover all labor for 5 years, and parts for 10, we thought this should be covered. Instead, they arrived (charged 78 dollars to drive to our home) then charged my parents156 dollars to diagnose the issue, then charged them 82.80 to clean and test the flame sensor. So they were charged 316.80 for a unit that is fully covered under warranty, less than two years old.

I would avoid doing business with this company as there are hundreds of HVAC companies that stand behind their products. This was my mistake for choosing Ray's for my parents HVAC needs. The company I chose for my own home doesn't charge me a penny to do service on my unit as that's what the warranty was for. If it inoperative, they take care of it as it should be. Ray's does not have that level of service.

reviews.author: Laura Michalak
reviews.text: They came to our rescue just in time!!  Our furnace was just about to quit all together and they came out the same day to install a new one. Very efficient and friendly installers, did a great job. Would definitely use Ray's again and recommend to everyone.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.text:
Worked with Marshall and Dan, they repiped my entire home with all new copper.

System has great pressure, in and out in a day! Absolutely recommended to anyone needing to transition from galvanized to copper.

reviews.author: Carrie
reviews.text: Ray's Plumbing did an amazing job replacing my old A/C unit. The installers were polite, thorough and kept me updated throughout the process. Thank you for the friendly, high quality, and affordable service!

plumbers.name: T. Lenard Plumbing & Drain Inc.
plumbers.address: 206 Crenshaw Dr, Murfreesboro, TN 37128, USA

reviews.author: Jonathon Hobstetter
reviews.text: We had an issue with our water heater and bathroom plumbing after the freezes that occurred this winter. He was very nice on the phone, but when we set an appointment he rescheduled several times. When he finally arrived to assist, he did fix the water heater. When working on the shower, he told us we needed to order a part off Amazon to complete the repair. Once the part arrived, he never came out to finish the job. He was paid in full at this point. We reached out several times to confirm a time which he never came through on. It has been months. Finally, he stopped answering completely.

reviews.author: tammy miller
reviews.text: Todd was very quick to get us scheduled and was here the next day. Our hot water heater was installed quickly with a lot of attention paid to our wood floors, general neatness, etc. We hired him for a second job of disconnecting a water softener system which required under the house crawling around. While under the house he discovered a potential disaster where a wire holding up a copper pipe was wearing through the pipe, about to open the pipe. He corrected it while under the house. So he was very aware of all the plumbing system not just what he was called in for. Great guy, Great service. Thanks Todd.

reviews.author: Jaylyn Shanklin
reviews.text: Todd did amazing same day service at my house. He was very kind, and helped me very quickly. I had a leak in an outside faucet & the pipes under my house were shaking. He fixed the leak and secured the pipes for an excellent price. He is my permanent plumber.

reviews.author: Kellye Johnson
reviews.text: We had no idea of what plumber in the area could fit us in on a holiday weekend and this was the first place we called. After telling him our issues, he said he could come the next morning, then called back and said he could come that very night if that was okay. Heck yes! Super friendly and knowledgeable! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Matthew Kroeger
reviews.text:
Todd is just the best.  I called the first company about a bad smell coming from my water and they quoted me $2300 to replace my water heater over the phone without even looking at it.

I called Todd and he said he would come check it out.  Told me I had a few more years at least with my water heater and flushed it to kill the smell.

Todd is an expert and a professional and he absolutely earned me a s a customer for life.  I cannot recommend Todd enough. :)

plumbers.name: Reliable Plumbing & Sewer Service Inc
plumbers.address: 9013 Peachtree Dr, Tinley Park, IL 60487, USA

reviews.author: John Gutierrez
reviews.text: We called Reliable Plumbing about an issue we were having with the  pedestal sink faucet in our bathroom and John from Reliable came out to check out the problem and after he was finished he found several additional issues with the sink and we decided to remove and replace it with a new vanity sink which we agreed on after he explained the other issues he found with the original sink... John was very professional, knowledgeable,     and a nice guy, he also explained everything he was doing and he even replaced the two shut off valves for the sink which were very old and after he was finished with the installation it looked beautiful. Oh and I forgot to mention that John was even nice enough to help us pick out the new vanity.We would definitely recommend and use Reliable Plumbing  again.

reviews.author: Kevin Gordon
reviews.text: John and the team at Reliable Plumbing are professional and knowledgeable. They resolved a stubborn kitchen sink drain clog that was too far down the pipe for me to access and now it drains like new. Thank you Reliable Plumbing!

reviews.author: Susan Quillin
reviews.text:
I was referred to Reliable plumbing by a neighbor who had a good experience. Contacting the company & scheduling an appointment was quick & easy. The plumber arrived on time, as promised. John "diagnosed" the problem with my outdoor water spigot & promptly corrected the problem. I was happy with his services & glad to be able to resume watering my flowers! I recommend his company to others in need of an experienced plumber.

Sue (Tinley Park)

reviews.author: Andrew Edborg
reviews.text: Had a plumbing emergency not too long ago and could not get any plumbers out. Was Referred to reliable plumbing by a buddy and called. John the owner was super helpful and got to me almost immediately.  John was very knowledgeable and delivered quick efficient quality work. He was able to solve all the issues I was having and was very fair with his price. I highly recommend reliable plumbing for any plumbing services.

reviews.author: Natalia Zecca
reviews.text: Just had Reliable out to fix a leak under my kitchen sink, and they were AWESOME!!! Super friendly and easy to talk to, the plumber showed up when he said he would (which was not too long after I called!), and got the issue diagnosed quickly. He explained what was going on in a way that actually made sense, and the whole thing was fixed way faster than I expected. No trying to upsell you or use a ton of jargon so you don’t even know what you’re paying for. No mess left behind either, which I really appreciated. You can tell they actually care about doing a good job. 10/10 highly recommend Reliable Plumbing!!!

plumbers.name: Joey’s Plumbing
plumbers.address: 132 Frank Ln, Keller, TX 76248, USA

reviews.author: Sean Taylor
reviews.text: Posting this review on behalf of my parents who have had various unrelated plumbing issues the past year. Joey’s Plumbing has been incredibly professional and personable in their responses, especially in emergency situations my folks have had. The Joey’s Plumbing team has gone above and beyond to fix our issues all for a very reasonable price. Our gratitude for their very quality service cannot be overstated.

reviews.author: Stuart Gans
reviews.text: We had to shut our water off on Christmas because we had a leak inside the wall behind the sheet rock. I called Israel the morning after Christmas, he came right out, and fixed it. He was also very reasonable on the price. I will be using Joey's Plumbing again in the future. I absolutely recommend them !

reviews.author: Andy
reviews.text:
Israel is amazing and very professional.
Came out next day to fix a hose bib that I tried to fix but didn’t want to deal with any issues that could’ve transpired.
Very fair pricing and quality service.
A+

reviews.author: Debra DeBusk
reviews.text: We had a terrible leak under the kitchen sink due to pipe separation.  I came home to clean new pipes in a better configuration.  We also had a toilet with a broken seal that was replaced. Once the appointment was set, the serviceman kept in touch via text or call.  Very friendly. Paid using Zelle. Easy peasy!

reviews.author: Matthew Simmons
reviews.text: Awesome experience! Joey’s Plumbing showed up right on time, figured out the problem fast, and had everything fixed up without any hassle. Super easy to work with, explained what was going on , and the price was really fair. I’ll definitely be calling them again next time we need a plumber. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Poseidon Plumbing
plumbers.address: 970 Quail Cir, Brighton, CO 80601, USA

reviews.author: Rebecca Phillips
reviews.text: Owen was the technician sent out - 5 stars for him. He was polite, respectful, diagnosed and fixed the issue very quickly while explaining to me what was going on, as well as next steps should I notice the problem come back and how to reach out to AHS. The company also reached out quickly to schedule my service. The only downside to my experience is that the morning of my scheduled appointment I got a text that their truck was having issues and they'd have to reschedule so it did push my appointment back a week, which luckily I didn't have an urgent issue or a gushing leak, just a slow leak that was manageable until they could come out.

reviews.author: B58
reviews.text:
The technician and employees were professional and performed their jobs to a satisfactory standard. However, their customer service was outrageously unacceptable. I had to have two things done to the my house, which one they completed (water heater), and a clogged sink, which they advised would require a jetter. The water heater we payed for which was around 1200.00$. The price we were given was around 350 for the jetter, as shown in the picture. When we went to schedule to have it fixed they upped the price and gave an excuse why they increased the price that wasn't part of the original agreed price. I still agreed to have to pay the new price at around 550 but advised this was unprofessional and they responded with denying me service. Completely unprofessional way to bargain with customers on price when there was a set price that they gave and then still deny service when there where called out on it. Also know when it comes to communication with them it is very difficult due to them not answering calls or texts. You can read other negative comments before mine to verify this.

Overall when the work was conducted it was done satisfactorily and professionally by their technicians.

There customer service needs improvement and is unsatisfactory due to bargaining price with customers after it was already agreed apon and then denying service because of reason unknown besides being called out on how unprofessional the way they treated us was.

reviews.author: Samantha Snellbaker
reviews.text: Craig was the tech who visited my condo and ket me tell you, I have never felt so respected while he was fixing my leaking tub! The professionalism was amazing! He explained everything he was doing and was on time and so nice to work with! I didnt feel like an idiot as he explained things. I can not recommend Poseidon plumbing enough and I will 100% be calling them again with any other issues I have with plumbing. If I could give more stars I would. Thank you so much Craig and Poseidon Plumbing!

reviews.author: Kaite M. G.
reviews.text:
No hot water for the past 4 days. I understand there was a holiday in the middle but it’s supposed to be a “priority”. Can’t get a call back to schedule anything. As others, AHS sent us to them for our hot water tank and a slow drain. They came out a day later, checked things out and haven’t heard back since.

When I checked the app with AHS today it’s been marked as “service completed” which is a complete lie. Tried to call again to figure this out as I have an 8m old and we are trying our best.

Willing to change review after clarification from the owner but until I have hot water to sterilize my babies bottles, do dishes and take care of our hygiene I can only give 1 star on this so far.

reviews.author: K. Hardin
reviews.text:
I’m seriously impressed with Poseidon’s fast and professional service. They worked around my schedule, which is rare these days. Craig—the technician they sent—showed up right on time with a great attitude and got straight to business. He listened, checked everything I mentioned, explained the problem in plain language, then grabbed the right tools and handled it without wasting a minute. Clean work, no mess, no excuses.

I’ll be calling Poseidon again for anything plumbing in my home. Quality service like this still matters.

– BiggDaddyToo, because quality and craftsmanship still matter.

plumbers.name: San Diego Emergency Plumbing & Leak Detection
plumbers.address: 1192 N Johnson Ave, El Cajon, CA 92020, USA

reviews.author: Mitch S
reviews.text: Couldn’t recommend these guys enough. They were super communicative about price and what it would take to fix a gas leak to my bar b que. We ended up capping the line. It was great working with David and Tommy who got the work done fast. Hansel was kind enough to drop by the next day to ensure everything was done right. I was quoted way higher pricing by other plumbers, but a lot of it wasn’t needed. Call these guys first!

reviews.author: Jake Chamberlain
reviews.text: Eduardo did a fantastic job. He went above and beyond to help fix a problem with my hot water heater. I have work with this company many times now and they are always very professional and easy to work with. I would highly recommend them for any plumbing issues whether it’s an emergency or routine.

reviews.author: Gus Morg
reviews.text: If you have a leak, Hansel is your man. We had a leak and they helped us find it and troubleshoot it. Great company, definitely give them a call if you have a leak inside or outside your home!

reviews.author: Mike Brasseau
reviews.text: Eduardo showed up and was amazing. Knowledgeable and friendly even when all the kids wanted to see. He definitely earned the company more business.

reviews.author: INNOCENT NTAMAG
reviews.text: San Diego Emergency Plumbing and Leak Detection were quick with a rapid response. I first contacted them a 12:22 pm and they fixed my Plumbing issue at 2:00 pm. They gave an emergency plumbing service for a non emergency plumbing issue. I definitely recommend them to any customer who is looking for a quick response and a guaranteed satisfaction. Good Plumbing Company! Keep up the good work!

plumbers.name: Blue Whale Backflow, Plumbing, & Excavating
plumbers.address: 801 N Raddant Rd, Batavia, IL 60510, USA

reviews.author: David C
reviews.text: I've used Blue Whale for several plumbing issues in the past, and I've always had an great experience.  The owner (Ken) is very responsive and friendly.  Always patient and explains the issues. The work is done right the first time, and they show up when they say the will!  Just yesterday (a Saturday), my water heater was leaking.  I called early in the morning, and within a couple hours, Tony was out here replacing it.  Completely done by 1 pm, and I initially called at about 8:30 am. Amazing, especially for a Saturday!  I will only call Blue Whale for my plumbing issues...I have them stored in my phone! Great people to do business with!

reviews.author: Jeremy Hesselink
reviews.text:
A great experience with Blue Whale today.

Responsive, efficient and fairly priced. They showed up in a great looking vehicle and had everything they needed stocked on the truck for a garbage disposal replacement.

Ken and crew took great care, made no messes and were very polite. I'd recommend anyone needing a residential service plumber to give this company a call.

Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Bob Cohoon
reviews.text: Ken and crew replaced my old clay sewer line that had major problems in Woodridge. They were very responsive and helpful during the quoting of the job. During the job, they took a lot of steps to preserve my lawn and keep the dig site safe. The new sewer line is great and I am very happy with the work that was performed. Overall, I had a very good experience with Blue Whale Plumbing and Sewer and the work was high quality at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Uallknowme22
reviews.text:
BEST EXPERIENCE EVER!!!!

I stumbled upon this company because the previous homeowners used them and left the contact info behind when I bought this house.  I contacted them to install a toilet and I have to say the professionalism and level of customer service I received was outstanding!  They arrived on time, worked quickly to get the toilet installed and best part of all is they did not leave a mess behind.  I was impressed with the knowledge the plumber shared about things to do around my home to keep plumbing issues at bay and the price point was great.  I would not hesitate to recommend them to family, friends and coworkers.  I salute you BWP&S for the level of service you provided me today and putting my mind at ease in this new space of homeownership.  Thank you, thank you, thank you Tony & Zion.

reviews.author: J Hilton
reviews.text: Blue Whale Plumbing is a great local option to consider for your plumbing needs. I have used Blue Whale for both an emergency plumbing issue a few years ago and just recently to install a utility sink in my laundry room. On both occasions they were on time and extremely professional/knowledgeable. For the utility sink, I received multiple quotes which were all within $50.00 of each other so Blue Whale’s pricing is very competitive…licensed plumbers aren’t cheap. Also, in my experience(s), their office coordinator was very responsive to calls/emails about the scheduling/quote. Thanks Blue Whale!

plumbers.name: Huntsville Plumbing Inc
plumbers.address: 9582 Madison Blvd Ste 14, Madison, AL 35758, USA

reviews.author: Linda Odom
reviews.text: Huntsville Plumbing responded to our emergency plumbing issue within a few hours of my call and installed a new shower valve professionally, quickly, and courteously. I would recommend them to anyone with a plumbing problem.   Give them a call.

reviews.author: Sam Digesu
reviews.text: Huntsville Plumbing recently installed a tankless hot water heater system in my home after my old electric tank began leaking. I decided to switch to a gas tankless system, and I couldn't be happier with the installation, their knowledge of the system, and their plumbing expertise. The owner, Jason, explained everything that was needed and how it would be done. During the installation, he suggested improvements like hiding the water lines in the wall and the best way to run the ventilation pipe. The installation looks very professional and neat. Jason was very communicative, informing me of the arrival times of his workers and checking in regularly to see if I had questions. The cost was very reasonable.  This was my first experience with Huntsville Plumbing, and I was thoroughly impressed. I will definitely use their services again for future plumbing needs and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Kevin Morris
reviews.text: Had a leak from a copper supply line in bathroom wall, and of course it was in the worst spot imaginable.  Called a couple plumbers who insisted the tub had to be pulled to fix it, and wanted to charge an arm and a leg.  Had a friend tell me to call Jason at Huntsville Plumbing.  Jason responded immediately and was easy to work with.  He fully expected he may have to pull the tub based on what I told him was happening, but he wanted to come see it for himself before sending a crew out.  He spent time assessing the situation and explored all options.  He felt there was a good possibility he could make the repair without pulling the tub.  He went to work and successfully fixed the leak in the copper line.  Very grateful for what he did, and saved me a lot of time, headache and money!  Would give a 100 stars if possible!

reviews.author: Jennifer Marsden
reviews.text: Jason Osborne fit us in the next day. He also kindly waited for us to get a better part when we had the wrong size faucet and dealt with some prior installation issues which required redrilling, reattaching, and recaulking the sink. Our go to plumbers!

reviews.author: Brad Murphy
reviews.text: Huntsville Plumbing (Jason) had been here multiple times and they provide excellent customer service.  They are responsive, timely, efficient, and provide a high quality repair service.  The team always comes tooled with the right things and parts to make the job happen on site.  I highly recommend Huntsville Plumbing Inc

plumbers.name: Pine Country Plumbing
plumbers.address: 3623 Crossings Dr Suite 228, Prescott, AZ 86305, USA

reviews.author: Ron Martina
reviews.text: Mike was great. He did an outstanding job on our tankless water heater and soft water unit. We are very pleased with Pine Country plumbing and will be using them for our future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Dennis Osgood
reviews.text: Highly recommend. This is a family business and the service was terrific. We had all our cutoff valves replaced. The work was professional, the owner friendly and informative. We have found our plumber.

reviews.author: Ryan Sutton
reviews.text: Very impressed with Mike.  Happy with my sewer service which required a hydro jet and chain grinder clean out.  Pine Country Plumbing is professional and has experience to get it done right.

reviews.author: Mike Anders
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Great reliable plumbers that know what they’re doing, reliable and easy to communicate with. 5 star experience from a phone call to job completion.

reviews.author: Dustin Rigg
reviews.text: Mike is great! honest... looked at the clamp done on the leak, and stated nothing needs to be done... Because I have buyers who wanted it to be replaced, he did it so it had a "3" year warranty... super fast and professional!

plumbers.name: Story's Plumbing & More, LLC
plumbers.address: 1352 Cedarbrook Ln, Moore, OK 73170, USA

reviews.author: Katrina Mucker
reviews.text:
Revised: I was going to update my review and rate higher because the issue was mostly resolved but the company’s reply is false!!!
I tried to contact them to address concerns via email Dec. 18th. Only AFTER I gave them a one star review on Dec. 31st, the owner called and texted me that same evening. We had a phone conversation.
The billing issue I had was related to a “new program/billing system” they’re using. That’s not mentioned anywhere in their reply. Tell the whole “story”.
The labor rate on the final invoice was still higher than what the owner told me via a telephone conversation we had.
And yes, I was aware of the credit card or ACH fee. However when paying, I still had to pay for both CC and ACH fee because you can only pay in full and BOTH were on the invoice.
I went ahead and paid to be done with the situation but please don’t come on here with false replies.

BEWARE!!! Shady billing practices!! (Also operates under Foundry Construction Group; that’s who’s billing me anyway)

Initial invoice had a charge for the Service Call Fee although work was completed with them.
Second invoice took off the Service Call Fee and then added the parts, lol.

And there’s an additional Credit Card Fee or ACH Fee; neither can be adjusted when trying to paying the invoice.

Repair time/“truck and labor” cost: 2 hours ….$300+/hr! Pretty wild considering the backfill job was subpar.

Wouldn’t recommend them to anyone. And I’ve yet to receive the pictures of the work/repair.

reviews.author: Bobby KF5GTX
reviews.text: Houston and his staff are amazing! I called after ONG found a gas leak and he came right out and found the problem. Once it was repaired, ONG came back out and I still had a leak. So, Houston came back out and repaired the leak and it has been working very well ever since! I would highly recommend Story's Plumbing & More, LLC for anyone who has a gas leak or plumbing needs. He even added a teacher discount to my invoice which made the service so affordable! Thanks Houston and the staff for an amazing experience!

reviews.author: Nita McClanahan
reviews.text: I had called Story Plumbing and Travis and his team arrived within a few hours to check my toilet leak. Travis found a crack in the toilet tank and since it was a very old unit, we decided to replace it. I’m very pleased with their work. Mr. Story (Houston) was most helpful with the final cost. I will be calling Story Plumbing if I need a plumber in the future.

reviews.author: Stacy Lopez
reviews.text: I have been working with Story’s Plumbing for over 5 years as a contractor and would never hire anyone else. Houston and his team  always takes care of my customers, they are great with communication, timeliness, are highly knowledgeable and make sure to explain what they are doing and why. I would recommend them 100 percent! Prices are reasonable and service is exceptional.

reviews.author: F'lesson Wood
reviews.text: Called yesterday, and they came out the following morning. They were knowledgeable, nice, and super respectful, great prices and reliable! They fixed the issue! They made our experience a really smooth and awesome! My wife and I, are definitely recommending Story’s Plumbing to all!

plumbers.name: Capitol Plumbing Co.
plumbers.address: 4914 Pflaum Rd #3, Madison, WI 53718, USA

reviews.author: Megan Wise
reviews.text: Jake was here to replace our water heater. He was very efficient and was available for any questions that I had. Did great work and very quickly. Prices are great. Stan seems to always be available to answer calls when they come in and it is really nice being able to get a hold of them easily. We are very satisfied with the work and service this company provides. Thank you!

reviews.author: Tina Willits
reviews.text: They installed a new water softener for us. They were by far the most affordable, they were able to come out in just a few days and the technicians were very professional. I tried very hard to give the technician Jake a cash tip, he said it was against company policy and stood his ground on that. He was very knowledgeable and took his time to explain everything to me. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Frames4U Audrey DeBeir
reviews.text: Stan and his crew are my heroes!  Through the years, I've used their services several times and they always come through!  Quality work, efficient, responsive...I can't say enough good things about them.  The latest incident stemmed from a problem created by a questionable plumber hired by a contractor I used and Capitol Plumbing came to the rescue!  I called them at 6:30 a.m. on a Monday, and by mid-day, Jake had fixed the problem and life was good.  I really appreciate these guys.  Very Happy Customer!

reviews.author: Sandy Schroeder
reviews.text: I’m very happy with the recent services provided by Capitol Plumbing. I had many plumbing issues, and Doug was able to take care of all of them, including a couple of things that another plumber had said could not be fixed and needed to be replaced. I was a little nervous about what the cost would be because he was here for six hours, but the charges were very reasonable. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: C
reviews.text: Happy Customer! I had my water heater go out recently and they were there quickly to professionally install the new one and remove the old one. I was very happy with the service provided by Stan and his team. I would highly recommend them for any of your plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: S&L Plumbing Co. LLC
plumbers.address: 2907 N 3550 W, Lehi, UT 84048, USA

reviews.author: Jordana Campos Gtz
reviews.text:
Sly was wonderful!
It turns out that the person who was supposed to do our sprinkler blowout back in October, never turned off our water, so now we got an irrigation issue!
Sly was so great to guide me over the phone and ask me to send him photos.
He explained to me what the problem could be and showed up to my house late at night, he spent some time with a flashlight, looking at a way to stop the leak while we made a decision to fix the situation.

He was kind and professional and understood my emotional state due to the stressful situation.

reviews.author: TheCander1312
reviews.text: S&L plumbing did our shower/tub remodel and did an excellent job. Blake and Sly were awesome. Always on time and friendly. Great at communicating and explaining everything. We love our shower/tub and will use them again. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Angie P
reviews.text: I had Sly come by to help replace my water heaters and water softener. He's awesome and very professional. This is the first time I've ever had a plumber come by to test the hardness of my water to ensure we got a softener that worked for us. He was so thorough. You can tell the man takes pride in his work. I'm immunocompromised and Sly was very accommodating. 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: Peggy Ann Williams
reviews.text:
I contacted Sly at S&L Plumbing with a plumbing issue I was having.  Sly spent time with me to understand the problem  and got it resolved with professionalism and in a timely manner.

I am grateful for the peace of mind to have a trusted plumber who does great work.

Highly recommend Sly and S&L plumbing!

reviews.author: Brooklyn Williams
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Sly. He has come to help us multiple times. He is available as soon as we need him. He is so knowledgeable, thorough and helpful. 10/10 recommend.

plumbers.name: Dismuke Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1707 W Main St, Duncan, OK 73533, USA

reviews.author: Chad Girnus
reviews.text:

reviews.author: aaron randall
reviews.text: I bought a new house on 11-12-24.   On 11-13-24 I had Red Plains install a water softener and filtration system.  I had to use Red Plains to keep the warranty for the plumbing since they did the plumbing on the house.  When they installed the system they did not check the water pressure.  On 2-6-25 the canister on filtration system exploded and was notified that water was running out the garage.   Red Plains came out and said the canister had frozen.   I tried to explain that that the canister did not freeze.   The plumber replaced the canister.  On 3-14-25 the canister explode again.  I called Red Plains and told them that it was due to high water pressure.   Red plains was getting ready to replace the filtration system but they could not get the one they wanted.  The checked the water pressure at it was at 150psi and it should be about 70psi.   The plumber told me that I need a PRV and would be responsible for the repair.   I did some research and learned that the water pressure in my neighborhood should be between 110 and 130 psi and should have had a PRV.  The builder also used another company and they installed PRVs.   Red plains did install the PRV and the Builder paid for it.   I requested Red Plains to rep replace the water softener since I don't know what kind of damage to the water softener with double the water pressure.  Angela emailed "We feel that since the inline filter was there it protected the water softener from any damages that could have occurred."   To me they can't guarantee me that there was no damage.   She also emailed, "there is nothing wrong or caused any damages that would be an issue at this time for us to replace your water softener."  I am not concerned with at this time my concern is after the warranty is up.   I expect a softener to last longer than 18 months.   I spoke to a couple of water softener companies and the check water pressure before installation and high water pressure can cause damage to other parts or could place stress on the tanks.   The water softener should have been installed with high water pressure.   Red Plains would extend the warranty from 12 to 18 months.

reviews.author: Justin Manning
reviews.text:
They destroyed my yard putting in a sewer line.  Hit every line in the yard whether it was marked or not, broke my fence, and then covered everything up and pretended like they didn't hit anything.  It took weeks to undue all the damage they did.  They take no responsibility for their actions.  They don't return calls, they refused to come out and discuss the situation.  Would highly recommend finding another company to do business with.

Most everything said in their response is a blatant untruth.  Specifically, the communication with DJ.  He did not communicate with me at all.  I attempted to track him down daily, every conversation ended with unkept promises.  He never called back.   They did not send someone out to reset the fence.  That absolutely did not happen.  They never attempted to communicate or solve any of the issues that led to my frustrations.  I don’t know who the owner is, but he never spoke with me.  Horrible company, never do business with them

reviews.author: Matthew Fong
reviews.text:
Some guys from Red Plains Plumbing came out to clear a slow washer drain but they just managed to get their snake stuck in my washer standpipe. Instead of apologizing and figuring out how to fix it, they claimed that this happened because of my drain and they would have to go straight to digging up the sewer line for $7,000 to $10,000! I told them I would not be doing that and asked for other options so they said a supervisor would call me back and left, abandoning their snake in my drain which was now completely clogged and backed up into my washer and kitchen sink...

Fast forward through a couple of days of frantic calls to Red Plains which they didn't even bother returning and I called another plumber for emergency service. They were NOT complimentary and let me know the snake should not have been put through the washer standpipe and its four 90 degree turns, should never have been forced in until it knotted up, and after they removed it that Red Plains had used the wrong kind of head on the snake which was broken off inside the drain! What was just a slow drain was now a serious issue and I had spent over $700 but was much worse off than I started!

I want to support small businesses like Red Plains because they're supposed to care more about their customers.  Unfortunately with Red Plains, they weren't able to provide the resources,  professionalism, and knowledge that a larger company would.  Their office manager called and tried to help figure out a way forward but must have been overruled because a return visit to fix the problem lasted less than 15 minutes and Red Plains sent me an email saying there was nothing they could do.  When I tried to find out what happened (again leaving many messages with no return calls) they just told me I should go with another plumber!

Following their advice, I called a larger, more reputable company and what a difference it made!  In less than the time it took Red Plains to get their snake stuck and block up my drain, the experienced plumbers found exactly where the head of the snake was lodged in the Y with a nearby floor drain, sent a camera down the floor drain to look at what it would take to remove the stoppage, and cleared the stoppage through a nearby cleanout that the Red Plains plumbers had just ignored! Instead of defaulting to the most destructive (and expensive) option, the new plumber had the tools and experience to correctly diagnose the problem and figure out a way to fix it where Red Plains couldn't. To cap it all off, Red Plains flatly refused to refund the charges for their "drain cleaning" which started this mess (be careful with all the fine print they put in their invoices which make you wave their liability for damages they do) so this was a costly lesson for me.

In the end, what it comes down to is that you want to work with a company who will do what they say they will and help you even after they make a mistake. Based on what happened to me, I want to warn everyone that company is not Red Plains Plumbing.  If you're considering hiring them then I hope the same thing doesn't happen to you too!

reviews.text: Steve came within an hour of our call on a Saturday.  He was very polite and forthcoming about the cost and diagnosed it quickly, and did the repair in a timely manner.  Have used WTP multiple times and never felt bad afterwards...high recommendation.

plumbers.name: Orem Plumbers & Drain Cleaning
plumbers.address: 1178 S State St, Orem, UT 84097, USA

reviews.author: Kennedi Rudy
reviews.text: The water in our home was making strange noises in the pipes. Their team inspected the system and found loose mounting brackets. They secured everything properly. The banging sounds have completely stopped.

reviews.author: Theodore Zain
reviews.text: Early one morning, we discovered our toilet overflowing. I contacted their team immediately. They handled the blockage quickly and sanitized the area. Everything was back to normal in no time.

reviews.author: Isai Kamila
reviews.text: The bathtub overflow leaked during long baths. The technicians replaced the gasket, sealed the connections and tested thoroughly. They explained the cause and gave maintenance tips. The tub now fills safely and the team was professional, courteous and careful.

reviews.author: Lindsey Cristopher
reviews.text: Water occasionally backed up from the shower drain with a glugging sound. The plumber found a partially blocked vent that was affecting airflow. He cleared the vent and flushed the entire line. The shower drain worked quietly and smoothly once he was done. Great understanding of plumbing airflow issues.

reviews.author: Archie Adams
reviews.text: This service stood out for its calm and organized approach, with each step handled professionally. Minor enhancements were made to support better performance and the results were confirmed before completion. The overall experience felt dependable.

plumbers.name: Monkey Wrench Plumbing, Sewer & Drain
plumbers.address: 466 E 500 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111, USA

reviews.author: Zack Myers
reviews.text: Carlos was great! I have an old home (built in 1908) & he added a shut off valve for my gas range at a very reasonable price. He also caught that I had a loose vent on my water heater & he fixed it free-of-charge. Highly recommend Monkey Wrench & I plan on using them on all future plumbing projects! :)

reviews.author: J G
reviews.text: We Love Monkey Wrench Jerry and Tony came and replaced the main drain in our house and they did awesome work. I would post a photo but am technically challenged lol but it looks great. Have used them in the past and will continue in the future best prices and very honest just what you want for repair/ home improvements. Thanks Monkey Wrench

reviews.author: Kalen Abraham
reviews.text: They came out to repair the sewer line for my neighbor to discover it’s a joint line and connects to mine. They came over and asked if they could cut out a section of my driveway to access the line I said that was fine then the plumber assured me they would fix the spot they cut out and it would look fantastic better then before. We exchanged contact info and he would let me know when they would be out to do it. They came out fixed it and then left it for a little to make sure they addressed the matter. Week later they came out and finally fixed the driveway. Or so I thought a week passed and it started to rain after two hours I go out to find that the slab they laid was now sinking 2 inches and had a massive hole under it making it useless. It appears they just put dirt back in the hole but didn’t pack it so when it got wet it washed out and sunk down. That section of the drive way is useless and it is where I usually park. I text the plumber that set it up all with pictures of what it looked like and he told me he would send his guys out asap to address the matter I let a week pass and texted him checking to see when they picked a date. I was ignored it’s now been another week with no response. I’m writing this review to warn others of what kinda of work they do and promises they will make to you and not uphold.

reviews.author: Cindy Hall
reviews.text: Carlos Luna is a jewel to work with. Completed job as he said and very efficiently. He explained things well

reviews.author: Craig Poland
reviews.text:
Carlos is awesome! He was polite, professional and friendly. He cleaned up the little mess he made (no questions asked) and did a good job fixing the issues we were having.
Definitely coming back if we have issues in the future!

plumbers.name: Round Rock Plumbing
plumbers.address: 201 University Oaks Blvd STE 540 #5008, Round Rock, TX 78665, USA

reviews.author: Nolan McCandless
reviews.text: This is just one of the few plumbing companies in Round Rock that offers 24 hours emergency services. This is great for our community.

reviews.author: Ann Marie Tubman
reviews.text: We had a leak late in the evening and Round Rock Plumbing was able to get out to us quickly. They were professional, and were able to repair the leak before any further damage had been done.

reviews.author: Kristal Castro
reviews.text: Justin at Round Rock Plumbing was a pleasure to work with. He was prompt in answering the phone and came out to us later that afternoon. Quick response and a fair price for our clogged drains. Storing their phone number in my phone to use this plumbing again! Thanks guys

reviews.author: Christopher Eargle
reviews.text: We hired Round Rock Plumbing to replace a water heater that was on the fritz. We were greatful for Justin's expertise and speed in getting this replaced for us before a family gathering over the weekend. We really appreciate you for that!! We recommend this plumbing company.

reviews.author: B T
reviews.text: I don't often write reviews but decided to today.  Justin was my tech and was very professional, skilled, and fast.  He and his partner showed up within the 2 hr time window I was allotted, and texted me about 30 minutes before he got here.  He correctly diagnosed the issue within minutes, and had it fixed and out the door within 30 minutes.  Plumbers aren't inherently cheap but the cost was within the range that I figured it would be.  I felt the cost was reasonable.  I have saved their number in my contacts in case I have an unfortunate Plumbing emergency in the future.  The van that they showed up in does have a different company name on it, but it's the same company.  I highly recommend them.

plumbers.name: Dulles Plumbing, Heating and Air
plumbers.address: 44675 Cape Ct # 150, Ashburn, VA 20147, USA

reviews.author: Derek Smoot
reviews.text:
I recently had a no-heat situation and reached out to Dulles Plumbing, Heating & Air. Their Service operations Manager was able to quickly get a technician out to my home, which was a huge relief.

The technician was very professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain exactly what was going on with my system. What really stood out was that they provided multiple options for repair rather than pushing just one solution. They clearly explained each option so I could choose what worked best for my home and budget.

Overall, the service was prompt, honest, and very professional. I highly recommend the team at Dulles Plumbing, Heating & Air to anyone needing reliable HVAC service.

reviews.author: Andrew Colon
reviews.text:
We have used Dulles Plumbing multiple times for multiple projects. They have always done a great job and completed the work in a timely manner. We have always had a pleasure speaking with the team and scheduling appointments. Chris does a great job making sure each job is completed to perfection and clarifies what exactly is needed for each job.

I would recommend this company for all your plumbing needs.
-Andrew

reviews.author: Damandeep Singh
reviews.text: So we had a Sewer line grading issue and we talked a 3-4 different plumbing companies. The main plumber from Dulles Plumbing group was  the most accurate in identifying the problem and gave a very clear plan of what needs to be done. He was accessible by phone and extremely good at explaining everything. The price and warranty provided to us was very competitive and we moved forward with the project. David and his team (Bobby and Pablo) was very professional and neat in their work from Day1. The project had some complications which David was able navigate through. I was really impressed by the problem solving and ingenuity from him. Due to complications the project went into the second day and Dulles Plumbing group did not hesitate to finish it properly on the next day. I would definitely recommend these guys. One of the best experiences I have had with a plumbing company.

reviews.author: Jake Yezzi
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Service and Professionalism

I recently had a leak in the water line between the meter and my house, and Dulles Plumbing did an outstanding job troubleshooting and fixing the issue. From the moment I contacted them, their team was responsive, professional, and knowledgeable.

They quickly identified the problem, explained the necessary repairs clearly, and completed the work efficiently with high-quality craftsmanship. The team was courteous and made sure everything was cleaned up afterward. I truly appreciate their expertise and dedication to getting the job done right.

I highly recommend Dulles Plumbing to anyone in need of reliable and professional plumbing services!

reviews.author: Matthew Fitzgerald
reviews.text: Dulles plumbing did a great job replacing a cracked toilet for us.  They were fast, courteous and professional.  Pricing was very fair. Thank you for helping us with our plumbing needs!

plumbers.name: TMK Plumber Pflugerville
plumbers.address: 610 E Wells Branch Pkwy #17207, Pflugerville, TX 78660, USA

reviews.author: Andres Vanguardia
reviews.text: TMK Plumber Pflugerville is the best in the business. They will tell you what the problem is and they will give you a quote without trying to sell you more or take advantage of your plumbing needs. I recommend them

reviews.author: Mike Kennedy
reviews.text: I had a great experience with TMK Plumber Pflugerville. Their rates were super competitive (another company tried to charge me 3X what TMK charged). They were able to help within hours of my initial call, and Irvan was super knowledgeable and friendly.  I won't hesitate to give them a call in the future when I need a plumber I can trust.

reviews.author: Mr. Brian
reviews.text: Beware of them scam. I called them because I had a sewage backup at my house in round rock. I called and they sent a plumber to come to my house. The guy who came looked like he did drugs and was super rude. He wanted 600 dollars to clear my clog and after me telling him it was too much money and I would pass he started insulting my family about how he drove all this way for nothing and was cursing all over my face in the driveway. Keep in mind on their website they claimed free estimates. After long talks he wouldn't leave and then said he could do it for $475. I agreed and he used his auger to try to clear my pipe. While he was clearing my pipe he started to complain that it was only for 45 minutes of work and if I wanted him to continue clearing the pipe he would have to charge more. What a sketchy business practice. Keep in mind he was smoking all over my face at the same time. After 15 minutes he said he couldn't clear my clog and still had the means to charge me $475 for 15 minutes of nothing. Keep in mind the whole time he was smoking in my face with all his drug smell and kept insisting he would have to dig my pipe up for $5000. Later in the day I called a different plumber who was able to clear the clog with their augur for only $175 dollars that took them 2hr+ because of a plastic piece was stuck in the pipe. What a scam, I never seen someone so willing to scam and rudly smoke in customers faces. I don't why this place has so much good review but they got to be fake. Keep in mind they put their location on google maps as the northtown mud apartment but they aren't even there. A locaton for them doesn't exist. Whatever you do if you call them expect a crazy rude drugged plumber to come to your house to scam you. They guy the sent me he drove a white chevy truck. Just be careful if you call I got scammed by them and the guy was rude and smoked all over my face. Better off calling someone else.

reviews.author: Aiyana Franco
reviews.text:
When I discovered a foundation water leak I called several plumbing companies to come asses the issue and within 2 hours of the initial call TMK was at my door.

Edwin, Benny (the plumber and his team) checked all the boxes for being professional, courteous, on time, knowledgable, economical, all my questions were answered, the crew cleaned up, follow up was excellent and most importantly they fixed the water leak.

They went above and beyond and for that I am grateful.
Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jill Lara
reviews.text: I had 4 other plumbing companies bid on a pluming project for my house. I needed to reroute the plumbing lines. The best prices was from TMK. They sent the main technician with 2 helpers and finished the project in 2 days. I'm very pleased with them

We will definitely be going with them again if the time comes.

reviews.author: Clyde Fowler

We chose Plumbers of Greenville because of their name.  It communicates confidence.  And these fellows have the right to be confident. We offer this recommendation with no hesitation.
Clyde and Debbie Fowler

Thanks to his actual knowledge and experience, Ross was able to make an accurate diagnose, and found that there was no actual issue at all with the bathroom. He was able to save us some money, definitely recommend using them!

reviews.author: Alejandro Rios
reviews.text: Pablo and Ross were very professional in planning and executing my project in a professional and technical manner. They are the best contractors I have worked with in many years. I took the time to do this review even without them asking because they deserve the best. the successes, thanks again Pablo and Ross

reviews.author: Jan-Hendrik Pretorius
reviews.text: Ross was responsive, professional and extremely accommodating. He worked us in within 24 hours of connecting via phone and fixed one issue on the spot and made time to come back the next day for the other issue. He gave us an honest evaluation of the necessary repairs without trying to sell superfluous upgrades. Pricing was upfront and fair. We will definitely be calling him again in the future.

plumbers.name: Valley Plumbing
plumbers.address: 137 Mesa Dr, St Albans, WV 25177, USA

reviews.author: Leah
reviews.text: Thank you Valley Plumbing! My sink recently fell into my bottom cabinet, and they came out and fixed it!

reviews.author: Savanna Vance
reviews.text: These guys did a great and quick job! I couldn’t recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Frank Hardin
reviews.text:
I called Valley Plumbing due to having a clogged main sewer line. I called them after a few days of trying to troubleshoot this myself. By the time I called them, the whole system was very backed up. They were able to send someone out the same day. I called at 0830 and they were able to get someone scheduled and at the house for that afternoon.
They worked for 3 hours until they (and myself) were happy with what they had to do. At the 1.5 hour point they thought they had it and were packing their equipment up, when we found something else. With no complaining they just went back to work for another 1.5 hours. They were very professional, thorough, and knowledgeable. I will definitely use them again if ever I need plumbing services.

reviews.author: Jayne Hanstine
reviews.text: I highly recommend this company.  They did an excellent job.  They came the same morning I called for service.  We expected to have a new tank installed, but they were able to repair the old one.  We appreciated their honesty… they could have replaced the hot water tank just to make more money.  The repairmen were very nice and professional.

reviews.author: David Murphy
reviews.text: They came out to fix leak and replaced two valves. There was much corrosion to hot water side that was ignored. It was still leaking so I called them back. They replace corroded copper and charged me 3 hours work for 1 hour and 50 minutes work saying they knocked off $40 dollars off the third hour. My guy doing the construction work laughed at the fact that they couldn’t even level the valves.

plumbers.name: 1st Fresno Plumbing
plumbers.address: 7225 N First St # 101, Fresno, CA 93720, USA

reviews.author: Lucille Ella
reviews.text: After comparing a few quotes for pipe repair, we chose this company. Their evaluation felt thorough and not rushed. The repair was completed within the estimated timeframe and the results have held up well. I would consider using their service again if needed.

reviews.author: Camille Jaliyah
reviews.text: Booked them for water heater installation after our old unit failed. The consultation covered sizing, recovery time, and energy use, which helped us decide. Installation took a few hours, and hot water was back the same day. The team worked efficiently and answered questions patiently.

reviews.author: Dillon Archer
reviews.text: Scott came out to check our water heater because we thought it might need replacing. We were prepared for a big plumbing bill, but Scott carefully inspected everything first. He was completely honest and let us know that a replacement wasn't needed yet, which was a relief. Scott also took the time to explain how the water heater works and even adjusted the temperature to make sure it was safe for our home. He was friendly and knowledgeable, and we really appreciated his honesty and the time he spent helping us understand the system. It's rare to find plumbing companies that care this much about their customers, and we are grateful for the great service.

reviews.author: Owen Lawson
reviews.text: I highly recommend this plumbing company. They gave me a free estimate and kept in touch with great communication throughout the process. From Scott in the office to Pedro and his assistant who came out for the job, everyone was friendly and really knew what they were doing. They installed a new water heater, a water softener, and a whole house filter for me, plus took care of a few smaller plumbing fixes. Their advice was helpful and made a big difference. Now I have great-tasting water from every tap and feel confident my appliances are protected from hard or corrosive water. Excellent service and quality work!

reviews.author: Brianna Scott
reviews.text: Had a great experience with this plumbing company in Fresno. They’re a local family-run business that really cares about doing quality work. I called them and they showed up the very next day. I’m sure if it had been an emergency, they would have come out the same day. Todd was my plumber—he was very professional, polite, and really knew what he was doing. He made sure everything was working perfectly before he left and even double-checked his work. Their prices were fair compared to other places. I’ve definitely found my new go-to plumber. Highly recommend giving them a call!

plumbers.name: M.D. Wells Plumbing Service LLC
plumbers.address: 211 Co Rd 368, Crane Hill, AL 35053, USA

reviews.author: Kaye Cannon
reviews.text: Mr. Wells and his team were super-responsive for us in a recent emergency situation, and he’s done super-quality work for us several times in the past. I feel so much better about our septic pump now that he’s fixed it. Very, very professional. I highly recommend! 👍👍

reviews.author: Oriana Godbee
reviews.text:
Ive had an experience to say the least. In 2022 I had them come out to give me a quote to replumb my entire house. I was given a quote and signed an agreement to that quote. The employee sent out told me they would call me to schedule when they would return to start the work after a week I called them to see if they were still coming out to do the work we agreed on. They quickly stated they were coming out the next day and did. The employee sent out at that time "completed" the job in two days.
The unfortunate part is they only completed the job to the point of connecting new pipes to old pipes under the house while I paid for ALL NEW PIPES TO BE RAN, avoiding replacing the pipes to the dishwasher entirely, not replacing any of the pipes to the hot water heater, not replacing the pipes to the washer in the laundry room and not connecting the house up to the main at all after I paid an additional amount for that to be done.
In 2 years I and the other home owner have called repeatedly to be given dates when the job would be handled only for no one to show up to the home. Myself and the other homeowner have been told that we were not answering the phone when called or not allowing voicemails to be left or that the other all around was not cooperating with the owner of this business. We are told the other refuses to set a time or date which sounds very odd since we both want the work completed. We have been unable to even live in the home due to this hold up. We can not finish closing in the shower/tub in the bathroom due to the pipes not being done. We can not rebuild the laundry room due to the work not being done and taking up the floor was the only way to access the pipes going into the home.
Being polite gets us no where and being up front and blunt with the owner that we have paid the entire 6,000 dollars for the work and need it completely in a timely manner means nothing.
I have my receipts from the business stating what I agreed to and it is obvious to the eyes what has not been done on the list. Appointment after appointment have been scheduled by the business owner and yet he is unable to show up and if someone is sent out they are only able to take pictures of the work that is not completed or done wrong.
I truly hope he does not continue to run his business like this so that others are not ripped off and unable to live in their homes. The idea that I should pay another company to come out and complete the work is ridiculous since this business took the full amount for the job.
I now have been left with finding ways to take legal action.

reviews.author: Jim Glasscock
reviews.text: Mr. Wells and his workers do an EXCELLENT job. They are honest, dependable, and know what they are doing. I HIGHLY recommend this company for any and all plumbing and hot water needs. Great people!

reviews.author: Megan Mann
reviews.text: I’ve had MD Wells out to fix all kinds of plumbing issues with the home that I renovated. They’ve changed out my tankless HW heater, plumbed sinks, replaced toilets, fixed existing fixtures, fixed leaks, etc. They are always professional, on time, do great work, and charge a fair price. They are the best plumbing team I’ve ever worked with, definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Michelle Richardson
reviews.text: I cannot express how wonderful Mike Wells and his guys are. He re-piped my whole house and (surprisingly) had to replace a toilet and still only charged me the quote he gave me. They are honest and hard working. Highly recommend!!

plumbers.name: Waker Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1770 E David Rd, Kettering, OH 45440, USA

reviews.author: Bruce Stapleton
reviews.text: Best pricing (based on five quotes), fast and professional installation, friendly, and committed to their customer's satisfaction.  Replaced old tank water heater and water softener with new tankless water heater and new water softener.   Very pleased with the installation and the entire process.  They even came back out during the inspection to make sure everything was good and we were satisfied.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Wanda Krebs
reviews.text:
Steve Waker and his crew were exceptional in the repair of our water main leak in September of 2024. My husband and I secured 3 bids for the repair and Steve’s quote was WELL, (by $2000-$5000), under the other 2 plumbing companies quotes. Steve also spoke knowledgeably about our situation. Steve knows all rules and regulations regarding water main repair as it pertains to the City of Oakwood. Our yard was NOT torn up as we had seen a yard on our street that experienced a similar water main issue and was serviced by a different plumbing contractor. Steve also worked with our insurance company in completing necessary paperwork. Grass seed and straw was used to patch the very small area that was disturbed by the repair.
We have lived in our current home for over 27 years and this was our first time using Waker Plumbing. Steve Waker is now our plumber of choice!

reviews.author: Amanda Gibson
reviews.text: Had a portion of our gas line and key valve for our fireplace replaced. Crew did a wonderful job and in a timely manner. Will be using their services again in the future and would highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Greg Sexton
reviews.text: The Waker Plumbing crew relocated my gas service line in my side yard and installed a new meter at my house.  I was very pleased with the service and quality of work.  They arrived promptly at the agreed upon start time, 8:00 am, we walked the site and they explained what they would do.  They went about their work, and stayed on the job.  The crew was courteous, taking time to answer my questions when I went out to check on progress.  At the end of the job the yard was put back into shape, grass seed applied.  Their equipment appeared as new/newer and in good working order.  I would hire them again.

reviews.author: Mehdi Zahedi
reviews.text: Waker Plumbing is awesome, and has an A+ crew! Our street has been getting new gas pipes and gas meters from Centerpoint Energy, and Waker is the contractor for them. From the first knock on the door to the last minute when the job was finished  they were absolutely professional and courteous, explaining everything they were going to do. They had to drill through the side of the foundation and into the basement to accomplish the task and not only that, they left the basement as clean as they started, with the pipe beautifully tucked away and out of site. In an age that professionalism and prompt service is declining it is absolutely refreshing to see that we still have quality service as this outfit has offered me and my neighborhood. I highly recommend them to anyone.

Will definitely recommend to friends and family and will use again.

reviews.author: Daniel Funari
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Cory Hoover

reviews.author: Sam Razo
reviews.text:
This is a locally owned family business. Joey, one of the owners, was very friendly and easy to talk to. They are competitively priced. In fact, when talking to the owner, you don't feel like they're trying to nickel and dime you out of your money. On several occasions, to my surprise, Joey talked me out of unnecessary repairs, even though it would have meant more money for their business.

We had the sewer lines and supply lines replaced and re-piped. This is a big labor intensive job. I called around to four other plumbing companies for estimates and Rieck Plumbing offered the best prices, by far. Shockingly, most plumbing businesses won't be bothered to do this kind of work because there's more money to be made doing simple service calls and less hassle.

To be critical, I would have to include that Rieck Plumbing's biggest weakness would have to be poor communication. This project would take several weeks. On many occasions, I didn't know if I should expect plumbers to show up that day or not because one of the phases had been completed. Also, we were never given an option to choose between copper and PEX pipes. It was assumed that we wanted PEX because we showed concern over the overall cost. You will need to be proactive in asking questions, getting clarification, and letting them know what your preferences are. The good thing is, their staff is more than happy to answer questions and they don't make you feel like you are burdening them with your inquiries. Also, I wish they would have installed the PEX lines more thoughtfully . Perhaps higher up where they would be out of the way for future projects that involve accessing my attic.

It's worth mentioning, that the plumbers working in my house, Nick and Jose, were completely professional and trustworthy. They weren't snooping around the house or taking things that didn't belong to them. *Cough* Oliveira's *Cough*

Overall, I would recommend Rieck Plumbing. They are competent, hard working plumbers. They're reasonably priced. Over the years, I've used many different local plumbers.

I highly recommend Nick and Choice City plumbing!!!!!

reviews.text:
Nick Flores of Choice City Plumbing helped us with a basement remodel addition of a bar, laundry hook ups, and a switch from gas to heat pump hot water heater. The inspector and subsequent plumbing professionals who have viewed his work all were impressed. As a person who buys semi-distressed homes, lives in them, and fixes them, Nick is one of the best plumbers I've worked with.  Nick is great to work with, smart and kind.

reviews.author: Teri White
reviews.text: Ira is hard working and will tackle any issue that he faces. He's prompt and gets the job done.  We've hired him to repair shower leak, install whole house water filter and replace a shut off valve. We highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Brenda
reviews.text: By far the best experience I've had with a plumbing company. When I called a very nice lady told me the guys were out on calls and she took all my info and the problem I was having, she told me she would let me know soon. Wow, was I wonderfully surprised when they showed up within 30 minutes. They were super nice and very knowledgeable about the leaking problem. They took a pipe out and had a new one put in within 30 mins and were gone. And they are very very reasonable.  My new plumber for sure. Thank you Jim and your wonderful crew.

reviews.author: Kaytlin Sanders
reviews.text: I called this morning and spoke with a lady who I’m assuming is the owners wife. She was very pleasant and said she would try to contact him to see if he could come out today since he already left for work. I was contacted within the next hour and informed he would be coming right then! The two men that arrived were very nice and did an awesome job in no time! I honestly don’t have 1 complaint. Great services and great prices. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Richard Barbosa
reviews.text:
Mere words could never express the level of service that was provided.  Truly amazing.  From my initial emergency call to job completion 2 hrs later.  And to top it off quality parts and workmanship were implemented.
Finally, a bill that was beyond reasonable.  By far the best experience I have ever had with any type of repair contractor.  Take my word you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Mimi Bee
reviews.text: First time using Ira for plumbing! Had leak spring up and he was here to fix it after he finished another job! Wife kept in contact to let me know when he would be here! Great service, friendly, and affordable! Most def recommend them to anyone!

plumbers.name: Drain Flo Plumbing
plumbers.address: 10213 N Ninevah Rd, Tampa, FL 33617, USA

reviews.author: Ruby Little
reviews.text: Thank you for your Speedy and Professional Service. I was Really In a plumbing Jam. Dwayne listened to my issues and took Excellent Care of Getting The Job Done. Definitely recommend and you have a for sure Customer for any and all my future plumbing needs. 10/10 Rating ⭐

reviews.author: Noah Corrado
reviews.text: After dealing with a few crooked companies in Tampa, that price gouge and have hidden fees, I found Drain Flo. Dwayne is by far the most honest and reliable plumber in Tampa. He is a man of his word and does high quality, efficient work. He goes above and beyond to ensure you are satisfied with his work. I highly recommend Dwayne & his team of experts.

reviews.author: Wes Schaaf
reviews.text:
We had a plumbing emergency in the middle of the night on a Friday, and after calling nearly 20 other plumbers, I found Drain Flo. One phone call was all it took at nearly 1:30am for Dwayne came to our house. When he got here, he immediately went to work diagnosing the issue and working out a fix.

The fix he proposed wasn’t an easy one. It required him to be uncomfortable and work in a tightly-cramped area (how our house was constructed made the repair nearly inaccessible).

Instead of going with an expensive fix that required the removal and reinstallation of our water heater, Dwayne chose a repair that was less expensive and more physically demanding on him in order to help stay within my family’s budget.

That’s the kind of man he is. Dwayne didn’t have to work out a creative and cost-effective solution for our family, but he did it because he’s a good man and runs his business in the most honest way you might imagine.

I cannot speak highly enough of his service, demeanor, professionalism, work quality, and- most importantly for me- his moral compass.

Dwayne has found himself a new customer and an evangelist for his business. I cannot recommend him highly enough.

Thank you Dwayne.

reviews.author: Kyle Ohrt
reviews.text: Dwayne is GREAT! It can be hard to find good quality honest people to hire for a job but Dwayne is just that. He came and gave me a free quote for the job I needed done, best part he was able to come within an hour. (reasonable pricing) After a few days I called him back to schedule an appointment and he came the same day. I would 100% recommend drain flo to any and all of my friends and neighbors for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Jase
reviews.text: I recently hired the plumbing company for a routine repair, and the experience was disappointing. Dwayne, the technician assigned to the job, was incredibly unprofessional. He arrived late without any explanation, seemed disinterested in the task at hand, and his workmanship left much to be desired. Overall, I would not recommend this company due to the lack of professionalism displayed by their staff.

reviews.author: Jonathan Shoaf
reviews.text: We have used O'Neill Bros. Plumbing twice and they will be the company we call IF we need plumbing work. They are extremely prompt and professional and very experienced. They were able to due a same-day estimate and next-day installation on a new hot water heater this week and we are very happy with their work and their pricing was more than fair for top quality work.

reviews.author: Katherine
reviews.text: Fantastic company! Seamus did a great job with our shower and toilet. He is very knowledgeable and could answer all our questions. We’ll definitely stick with O’Neill Bros if anything comes up in the future.

reviews.author: Ursula Perano
reviews.text: We got an exorbitant quote from a large company in the DMV area (FH Furr) for a handful of plumbing items and decided to call O'Neill Bros for a comparison. reviews.author: bob actuary
reviews.text: These guys are terrific! Had a water pipe leak in my kitchen ceiling on Sat which then burst onto the floor. I called them in the morning and they came by noon. Chris and Seamus were the absolute best! Capped the pipes so no more leak and explained the alternatives for a needed re-piping. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Maxime Fischer-Zernin
reviews.text: Life savers. Our boiler went out resulting in no heat in our home. This lasted several days as two HVAC companies came and failed to repair the boiler. One of the HVACs guys told us it was a job for O'Neill Bros.--who are very well regarded among their peers. Patrick was able to come by the house the same day that we called (despite it being a busy holiday season) and had us up and running in just a few hours. Not only was the service timely and professional, but it also saved us from the expensive headache of a boiler replacement that the other vendors were trying to push on us. We are grateful!

plumbers.name: MF Mitchell Plumbing HVAC & Drain Cleaning
plumbers.address: 7 Loring St, Worcester, MA 01606, USA

reviews.author: Steve SanSoucie
reviews.text: I had such a great experience with MF Mitchell Plumbing! He replaced my bathroom faucet and did an awesome job — everything looks perfect and works great. He was super friendly, professional, and let me know when he would be showing up.  The best part was his fair pricing — I didn’t feel ripped off like I have with the big plumbing companies that charge a small fortune. You can tell he really takes pride in his work and cares about doing right by his customers. I’m so glad I found him and will definitely call him again for any future plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Essentially Esther
reviews.text: My kitchen sink started leaking randomly one day and a good friend of mine recommended Mitch who also did work for him and his family, very well from what how he described it. Mitch came that same day I called him and fixed the problem, such great service. He's so nice and kind and such a pleasure to work with. Then the next month sadly my boiler broke and I did not have any heat or hot water for weeks, it was a very hard time for me. It was an old brand and the parts weren't common and were available overseas so it wouldn't benefit me to fix it so I decided to just replace the whole system. I called Mitch and he and his team replaced everything with a Navien system and I was so pleased and satisfied with all their hard work. He actually finished the installation coincidentally on my birthday so that was nice. I included a picture of the finished product showcasing his high quality of work. I would highly recommend MF Mitch Plumbing to anyone looking for any and all HVAC services. He is definitely someone I will always reach out to for future work because of the amazing quality of work and professionalism he provided me.

reviews.author: Anne Kisiel
reviews.text: We cannot say enough good about Mitchell Plumbing!  We called late Thursday afternoon after hours, as our water tank burst a leak, and we had been working with our heating company for 2 days between a service call and a “sales” call to get a quote for a new tank.  Mitch called us back literally less than one minute after we left a message, and asked us to forward pictures of the tank .. half hour later he came back with a quote $1,000 LESS than our own heating co with whom we have a service contract and with whom we have been doing business for well over 10 years!   He made arrangements to order the tank first thing in the AM… then he and his helper showed up and expertly did the installation!   All quite amazing response considering we never used this company before!   He took care of us promptly and professionally on a Friday afternoon!   Definitely keeping his card for future needs!  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

reviews.author: Robert Levin
reviews.text: Hi Everyone - I hardly ever sit down and write a review, either pro or con.  I will be brief then.    His name is Bobby.  This plumber was absolutely terrific, from start to finish.  I live in a fairly large garden-style condo complex, and should I need work done, it must always be by a licensed professional.  Bobby helped me with the installation of a hot water heater, a toilet, and a dishwasher.  Every detail in each process was done with great care.  It took a while for each installation - but he made sure everything was perfect.  Time and effort, very well spent. Honest, and exceptionally fair priced too.  Thank You Bobby - for everything.

reviews.author: Karina Herrera
reviews.text:
Bobby did an excellent job, and Mitch was more than fair with the pricing. Not only he made sure to stay within my budget, but after the job was completed he waited for payment until I had the funds. No one has ever done that for me. He understood the situation that I was going through, and for that I’m more than grateful.
Thank you Mitch for a job well done, your kindness, and empathy.

I would definitely recommend Five Guys Plumbing Schaumburg to anyone needing trustworthy plumbing services.

reviews.text: I recently hired Five Guys Plumbing Schaumburg to install a new kitchen sink. The technician was punctual and very skilled. reviews.author: Brooks Devan

reviews.author: Ky Reed
reviews.text: Jeremiah provided excellent service. Not only did he fix my problem , he also explained to me what he was doing. I felt very comfortable with him in my home! Will definitely reach out again if ever in need of plumbing service.

reviews.author: Jesse Marinelli
reviews.text: Great service and very knowledgeable! I was able to get an appointment quickly. Jeremiah, the plumber, showed up right in time. He took the time to understand my problem. He thoroughly checked the solution in multiple locations in my home to help me feel comfortable my problem was solved. It was a very good experience.
