He also labels drain lines to avoid confusion.

reviews.author: Kita Sexton
reviews.text: TJ has helped with two plumbing problems. Clogged main pipe from the toilet and new pipes under the sink.  Thank you TJ for your quick help !

reviews.text: TJ did a fantastic job replacing the lines going into, and out of, my hot water tank.  He made me a priority during a holiday week and I am grateful for the service he provided.  He is polite and professional and I would recommend his services to anyone in the area needing plumbing  repair or installation.

reviews.text: He will over charge you like crazy and lie quite a bit. Took advantage of my wife while I was at work and over charged for 2 extra hours of work when he was only at our house for 20 mins. Then lied to me about how much the rental for the machine he used was.

reviews.author: William Leno
reviews.text:
The Mr. Rooter professionals were outstanding in their knowledge, skills and abilities to complete the sewer lateral project ahead of schedule.  From start to finish, the communication response was always timely and the customer service exceed my expectations. The pricing for the project was competitive and reasonable among the estimates I received. I will recommend your company to everyone !!!!!!!...
Thanks for everything 👍🏽💯

reviews.author: donna hook
reviews.text: Mr. Rooter returned to my home, today 10/28/25 at my request to do a hydro-jet cleaning the drain in my basement.  Uriel arrived on time and explained to me the process involved.  Due to the accumulation of matter over the years it was a bit more difficult and after using the cable (snake) to break through and then utilizing the hydro-jet he completely cleared my drain.  He even had me go outside and i could hear the water and feel the air that was being emitted from the street trap/vent,  the gismos that we all have in front of our homes at the curb, which indicated that my pipe was open and cleared.  Having my drain hydro-jet cleaned was a new experience for this senior.  My washing machine d rain hose empties directly into a pipe and not my sink as it had done prior to a change and not able to attach a lint collector on the drain hose.  I asked Uriel if it would be to my benefit if I switch the drain hose to drain in the sink so that a lint collector would be attached, thereby avoid having  lint accumulate in my pipes.  He agreed that this would help.  So -my recommendation for anyone who has drain issues or other plumbing issues call Mr. Rooter, they have friendly, courteous and helpful technicians who will resolve your problem.  This senior citizen is very grateful for Uriel's excellent service.

reviews.author: Wigbert J. Siekhaus

reviews.author: zu
reviews.text: An angle valve under my sink started leaking so fast I had to shut off the main house valve. They were able to get someone out the next day to replace it and a few other old valves. Great friendly service. My go to plumber.

reviews.author: Gale Anne
reviews.text: Very neat. Cleaned up after opening the ceiling to figure out the  problem. Left letting me know we will receive a call about returning for the repair and that the repair should be able to happen within a single day.

It doesn’t look like anybody was there and I appreciated their service so if you’re looking for a good plumber, I would recommend L&R plumbing You won’t be disappointed

reviews.author: Sesha Logan

reviews.author: Maverick Robertson
reviews.text: I can't say enough about Nate and Jason.  I am converting my enclosed porch into a laundry room and needed a washer hookup + drain.  They came out and gave me a fair estimate and date to return.  When many contractors are NO Shows, they came and did a excellent professional job.  I would highly recommend them for any plumbing job you need done in the future.

reviews.author: Jerri Heath
reviews.text: The first time Nathan came out he installed a water pump for us.  That experience was amazing.  He put in a new fixture in our bathroom and today he dealt with a major problem with the kitchen sink drain.He is always so nice and communicate s very well with us.  He gives us helps along the way . We highly recommend him and his business. You can't go wrong with him.   It has been two years since Nat installed pump.  We just had a problem with it.  He came out figured what the problem was ,fixed it and didn't charge us anything ,not even a service call.  He warranted the parts he put in.   He is a good honest man.  He does his job with integrity.

reviews.author: Richard Crowley
reviews.text: Nate did a tremendous job for my family. We had a new house built, and Nate took over near the end when the original plumber didn't work out. Everything was working fine except we had no hot water in our kitchen sink. It took a couple different tries for him to figure out what the first guy had done that was causing the issue, but he stuck with it and got it resolved. I really appreciated his tenacity and knowledge. Plus, he's a genuinely good person and was always extremely respectful, courteous, professional, and fun to talk with. I highly recommend his services!

reviews.author: Stan Kovarik
reviews.text: Nate and Philip installed our new house plumbing system after the slab was poured.  They also installed gas plumbing and all gas appliances and faucets.  You will not find a more thorough and knowledgeable plumber anywhere.  They did an excellent job and care about the quality of their work.  It’s becoming progressively more difficult to find professional contractors who take pride in what they do.  I highly recommend them for any plumbing needs you might have.

reviews.author: Kevin Hollingsworth
reviews.text:
First of all, the technician was nice and friendly. The problem was an easy one, washing machine drain was backing up. I’ve dealt with service issues at different properties for years. In all my years I’ve never seen such a price gouging. My issue wasn’t even resolved. For them to snake 1 drain with a cheap handheld snake and after not succeeding pouring a $30 bottle of sulfuric acid charged me over $700. It’s common sense to also clear the roof access as well to allow ventilation but that service was going to be over $1100! For 1 drain, one….
Thankfully my neighbor recommended another company, whose 70 year man with a helper came out and within 30 minutes had me up and running. They also cleared every drain while they were in the roof. All for half the price of the original cost of the failed service.

plumbers.name: Drainmaster Sewer & Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 1302 Raymond St, South Elgin, IL 60177, USA

reviews.author: Rachael Ivanovic
reviews.text:
Stop searching and hire The Tim’s. 100/5 stars. If you need someone who is honest, does great work, is extremely knowledgeable, goes above and beyond AND has fair pricing, you found them.

We are SO lucky we found them. Our situation sucked but it could have been way worse (and frankly, 5x the cost). They communicated at every stage of the project, explained what was going on and what to expect and prepare for. They worked in single digit weather, early mornings/weekend/late nights, did everything possible to limit the cost, and really went the extra mile to complete the job although they had to move their schedule around.

We had a leak in a pipe in the yard. It became urgent when we started to get water in the basement. They moved their schedule around, got the permits, rented the equipment, etc in the matter of about a day. Most people would have told us “oh well you’ll have to wait”, but the Tims CARE and that’s the difference. When they identified another issue, they already had the plan of attack in motion. Although they told us it was most likely impossible, they worked literal magic so that we didn’t have to replace concrete that was poured this past year, saving us a lot of money, stress, and time. Overall, they did EVERYTHING they could to take care of us and our situation, and made a really stressful situation as pain free as possible. I cannot even begin to express how grateful I am.

reviews.author: Mark Whipple
reviews.text:
Drain Masters was recommended to me by two friends at the gym for what I thought was a plugged toilet drain line.  They came by within a day of my call, diagnosed the problem at no charge, and told me I could fix it myself, or have them repair the issue at what I thought was a pretty reasonable price.

Then today Associated Plumbing called saying that I had an outstanding $300 bill and needed to pay it immediately. They never in the past SEVEN MONTHS called, emailed or sent a mailed invoice until today (July 26th!).  But today they were demanding money over the phone immediately.  I explained that the job wasn't completed and that this phone call today was aggressive and terse and the first time I am hearing of a bill due. I am not giving you my card information over the phone for an incomplete job that was SEVEN months ago with no prior billing or communication. I needed them to provide me with proof that they finished the job and proof that they had contacted me previously regarding the invoice. He then hung up the phone on me.

reviews.author: David Hornor
reviews.text:
When you’re searching for a plumber, what do you look for?
I was looking for a local family-owned business because I like to support the small business owners in my community.  Next, I wanted a quick response from a tradesman who could provide quality work at reasonable prices.  Finally, I wanted someone who would show up when they say, do the work they quoted, and complete the work with no add on expenses.  Sounds like too much to hope for doesn’t it.
Wow, did we hit the jackpot with Callahan Plumbing.  All the above, and more.  From the first call asking for a quote on our kitchen remodel project, to the final visit to connect the sinks and faucets, Dan was great.  He was always on time, extremely polite, and totally professional.  His work reflected a philosophy that our home was respected as if it was his own.
Without question, we will call Callahan Plumbing for any and all our future plumbing work and encourage you to do the same.  Your trust will be well placed and your money well spent.
As stated on his truck, “We get it right the first time”.

reviews.author: Stephen Vitello
reviews.text: When you have a sump pump problem, it's usually an emergency.  Callahan Plumbing understood and they were here an hour after I called them.  Dan Callahan and Gary assessed the issue, explained what they needed to do to get things right, gave me a fair quote on the job before they started and were done in 45 minutes from arriving.  This was a great save with a great local company.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: My mom and I needed a toilet fixed and a shower unclogged. Dan and Richard arrived 10 minutes before the arrival window which was nice. Dan is very intelligent and personable. I appreciate that he didn’t try to fix something that wasn’t broken just to make the extra money. Highly recommend Dan and will be using him in the future!

reviews.author: Vito F

reviews.text: Called Allstar for help when I noticed my slab floor was unusually warm. Highly recommend Allstar!

reviews.author: Gracie Green
reviews.text:
Would not recommend, hands down one of the worst professional experiences I've had. We hired all-star to do a tub/shower replacement and they completely installed an incorrect unit (wrong style and wrong size). When I informed them of the mistake I was basically told it was my fault and they only agreed to fix their mistake because I had text messages showing where we clearly communicated the unit we wanted/needed with the technician. It took a month for them to come back and replace the tub/shower and they left a hole in my brand new shower walls that I now have to fix to prevent water from getting into my wall. Save yourself the headache and call someone else for plumbing services.

Edited 7/21/25
Updating this review and improving the rating from 1 star to 3 stars. After the folks of All-Star Pro Services read my above review they called and asked for an opportunity to fix their mistakes and they were more willing to fix their mistakes this time around rather than trying to play the blame game. They sent in a team from their sister company All-Star plumbing and we were very pleased with the level of professionalism and the quality of the job. Still disappointed that a job that should've taken 1 visit took 3 and that my bathroom was a construction zone for 2 months but I do appreciate that the company had enough integrity to make sure the job was done right no matter how many attempts it took.

reviews.author: nataya mn
reviews.text:
Exceptional service from New Image Plumbing. We faced a sudden flood at 5:30 PM, and Pierre managed to have everything under control and repaired within the hour. The turnaround time was impressive, and the quality of work was spotless.
What truly stood out was his professional guidance; Pierre took the time to clearly explain the situation, identifying what required immediate action and what could wait. Even for an after-hours call-out, his pricing was incredibly fair and transparent. Truly a seamless and stress-free experience during a chaotic situation. Pierre is a true professional.

reviews.author: Natasha Chu
reviews.text:
I wish Google would let me give 10 stars for New Image Plumbing & Rooter. I almost never write reviews, but they truly earned this one.

We had a sewage backup at our commercial office — easily one of the worst types of surprises — and they were onsite in under 2 hours from my call. That alone was a huge relief.

Pierre, the owner, showed up himself. He was incredibly friendly, straightforward, and easy to communicate with. While his technician handled the repair quickly, Pierre walked me through what was happening and provided transparent pricing before every step. They ended up snaking both the main sewage line outside and the bathroom drain pipe.

And here’s the part that really stood out: it was late on a Friday, the building janitor was unavailable, and we were left with a mess to clean. Without me even asking, Pierre stayed and helped me mop and clean the two bathrooms and the lobby. No complaints, no rushing — he just genuinely cared about helping us get the space back to normal. I’ve never seen a contractor go that far for a client.

A situation that could’ve been incredibly stressful ended up feeling manageable because of how much effort and care he put in.

If you want a plumbing team that’s responsive, professional, and sincerely invested in helping their customers, I highly recommend New Image Plumbing & Rooter. Huge thank you to Pierre and the team!

You’re officially our go-to plumber from now on!

reviews.author: Johanna Kammerer
reviews.text: I'm so glad I found this local company! They were able to come out the same day after I called in a panic since we had no hot water. They replaced an old/dysfunctional water heater with a tankless system the next day. Also noticed some old pipes that were leaking that they repaired. Amazing customer service from the office staff to all of the team- Pierre, Refugio, Pedro and Pedro have all been super nice, trustworthy and do good work. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: John Michael Higgins
reviews.text:
The service experience I had with New Image Plumbing was exemplary in every detail.  From my initial call to New I mage all the way through to completion and payment, the experience was expert, pleasant, honest, dignified — even friendly and amusing.
It goes without saying that the team fixed my problem perfectly and set me up for even better plumbing in my future.
I had an emergency plumbing failure, a back-up that was caused by a damaged line to the city.  From my initial call to Tina, ON A SUNDAY  NIGHT, to my initial assessment with George (about whom I cannot summon enough praise—I consider it an honor to have met him, quite apart from any plumbing problem I may have had).  That goes for the rest of his whole staff as well.
Hiring New Image was the smartest thing I have ever done for my home maintenance and my real estate investment.
The job was a big one, and so was their success in setting it right.
I recommend New Image in the highest terms and without a single qualification.  A big Thank You, to the whole superb team.

reviews.author: Michael Brown

We were worried about cost but NIP helped us from A to Z, not only identifying areas we could adjust to make our budget, but they completed everything way faster than expected. reviews.text:

They’ve always been dependable, honest, and fair. No pressure, no upselling — just solid work done the right way. You can tell they take pride in their craft and truly care about the families and businesses they serve.

It’s hard to find contractors you can trust, and Barkley is absolutely one of those rare ones. They show up, they communicate, and they get the job done well. We’ve felt completely taken care of every time.

If you need plumbing work done and want someone reliable who treats you like more than just another job, call Barkley Plumbing Contractors. Grateful to call them friends and our go-to plumbers. 💛

reviews.author: Donovan Wilson
reviews.text: I contacted seven plumbing companies for quotes and they were the only people to respond promptly with a fair price. Good communication, good price, and good work completed in one day.

reviews.author: Alan Rudicil
reviews.text: I would first say to anyone reading the reviews to really look at all the critical reviews and ask if you want to be that customer.  My experience is that Barkley Plumbing was called by me to come out and fix a leaking shower head that would not turn off.  4 workers came to my home and completed the repairs in approximately 15 mins. All that was needed was a Delta Shower Cartridge, yet I received a bill in the mail, (not at the time of service, and never got any price info from the workers- that should have been my red flag) several weeks later for $410.00.  Materials - 200.00 for parts that included, a shower cartridge, fill valve and flapper, then 210.00 for labor. Upon receiving this puzzling bill, I responded asking how they came up with this amount, let alone how a fill valve and flapper work in a shower? In my initial response, I did say I would pay as soon as Barkley Plumbing could answer my questions and send me an itemized bill with the breakdown and how they came to the amount of labor that they were charging. I then got a revised invoice that changed the labor to 135.00, and the same materials were now 127.00 that included the cartridge, fill valve and flapper, and still no response as to how the fill valve and flapper work on a shower. For 9 months I received a bill asking me to pay and I would reply, yet they would not respond to my simple question about how those two parts work on a shower head. Finally after 9 months, I sent an email stating that this would be my final attempt to settle this and would be happy to pay, but it was my final attempt, only then did I get a reply that they would take off the charges for parts that do not fit on a shower, but on a toilet (that was never called about nor worked on) and in this reply, I was threatened with a collection agency if I did not pay. Well, I paid, and now I am just giving a friendly heads up to those that are searching for an honest plumbing company, look elsewhere, Bark-ley Plumbing is not it. It is not just me who has had this sort of experience, once is a mistake but several is a scam. The 4 workers that showed up? They were nice and professional and were in and out with a completed job. It is the billing and communication that I warn potential customers about. My documented experience is still considering the BBB.

reviews.author: Taylor B.
reviews.text:
Take your money elsewhere. Don't get me wrong, they did a good job. They were prompt to get here and they did work fast to compete the job in a timely manor. When I asked the man on site what the charges would be so I could pay for their services, he said he didn't have any tickets on him and didn't know how much it would cost so they would send a bill in the mail.

When the bill came in the mail I was in shock at the price. I called to ask how they come up with their price for service and I got the run around. They don't charge by the hour nor do they charge by the job. I guess they make it up as they go.

Not to mention charging me for parts and materials that they bill to the gas company that I have to pay there. Yes, the materials are billed to me from the gas company. So for their parts and materials I have to pay for them twice on top of their insane labor cost.

I don't mind paying someone a fair price for their services. I would like to keep my arm and leg that they are charging though.

reviews.author: David Hudson
reviews.text:
The 2 times I have used this company, they have been on time and done great work, at prices that were probably comparable to other companies.

Ordinarily, I would give at least a 4-star review. But I'm giving a 1-star review now because I've been waiting a little over 3 weeks just to talk to someone about a plumbing issue at a rental property I own. I have called each week and talked with a lady at the office, and she tells me they are really busy but that she will tell them to call me soon as they can.

The plumbing issue isn't urgent, but I need a 5 minute conversation with someone who does the actual plumbing work, to help determine what my options are. I explained that to the lady I spoke with.... that for now, I only need a short 5 minute or less conversation so I can give at least some kind of response to my tenant about what's going to happen next (and hopefully an idea of when).

All I get are excuses about how busy they are. After 3 weeks of trying and waiting, I'm no longer buying the idea that any plumbing company is so busy they can't find the time to have a 5 minute phone conversation with an existing customer.

He got us up and running quickly and scheduled a day to come back and fix the problem (roots in the sewer line). That was done just like he said he would and we didn’t even have to be there. Harley was very professional, did what he said he would do, when he said he would do it and we feel his prices were very fair. We are from a small town and have grown to expect this kind of service. The installation was quick and precise. I’ve used them to install heaters in my personal garage which turned out perfect for Chicago winters. They have worked for my company when other plumbers were perplexed and confused what the issue was to backing up toilets. They came back 4 times finally breaking up concrete and finding an old antiquated piece of pipe that was leaking underground from the 70 year old building They fixed the pipe, hauled out all the insane amount of broken concrete from jackhammering. I have to take a second to compliment AT&T’s associates Logan and Scott. They hauled bucket after bucket of broken concrete for 8 hours up 2 flights of stairs then brought back pre mix concrete bags and finished with a concrete slab that looked perfect when finished.  I would recommend this company to anyone who is sick of dealing with plumbers who don’t show up, don’t accurately quote jobs and can just generally not be counted on. reviews.author: Gary S
reviews.text:
Let me tell you about how refreshing it was to find a company who focuses on customer service and relations rather than profit margins.

On the week of Christmas I had my line from the house to the municipal sewer break and we were unable to use water because the water would not be able to drain from the house.  I called three plumbers: 1) Plumb Rite 2) Knights Mechanical and 3) The 24HR Plumber.

One company quoted me $1200 for the repair and would not be out for a week.   That's a long time for a family of 4 with two young kids.

The other company quoted $600 but wouldn't work in the rain which we had a lot of during this time.  They also refused to come out unless I paid time and a half because of the Christmas weekend (even though Christmas was on Friday).

Then there is the 24HR Plumber.  They came out on Saturday to look at the problem and by Monday the 24HR Plumber was on site and fixed my sewer line.  It was drizzling, it was cold and it was a mess and the 24HR Plumber did it with a smile on their face; not to mention the final bill came out cheaper than the other two companies.

The plumbers Damon and Mark were fantastic and was a pleasure to work with.  I --FINALLY-- found a plumber that I can trust not to screw me with outrageous charges.

Thank you guys - you're a life saver!

reviews.text: I had a commercial water heater go out in one of my apartment complexes on a weekend.Called GPS and they were on it within a few hours. No stress tenants were happy.

plumbers.name: Village Plumbing & Sewer Service Inc.
plumbers.address: 3224 W Lake Ave, Glenview, IL 60026, USA

reviews.author: Jennifer Loring
reviews.text: Cody was very nice and helpful. He explained what needed to be done and was a clean and efficient worker.  He solved our problem promptly.

reviews.author: Kimberley Hemminger
reviews.text: We had Village Plumbing come out and replace our two water heaters. They were on time, friendly, and cleaned up after themselves. The guy who came, Eric, was very knowledgeable and gave us several tips on how to maintain your water heaters to live long life. Will definitely use them again in the future

reviews.author: TOM YONAN
reviews.text:
They just were on the news for working on someone's home when a fire was started in the basement where they were working.  Use them at your own risk
Always ask to see the person's plumbing license before letting them preform plumbing tasks in you're family's home

reviews.author: Nilima Nanisetty
reviews.text:
Eric has incredible plumbing experience and knowledge. We have a fairly new home and the hot water stopped working. Eric was prompt in problem solving the issue and resolving it.

While working on our water heater, Eric pointed out that we had a missing a component that prevented hot water reaching the other side of the house. I just assumed the hot water just took a long time to warm up. He installed the correct part and now my boys are so happy now to get hot water quickly to their shower!

We always call Village Plumbing for all our plumbing needs - broken sump pump pipe; sump pump battery back ups; hot water issues, etc.

reviews.author: Larry Smith
reviews.text: Had a leaking water filter in the  basement. Chuck from Village Plumbing did his usual excellent job of repairing it. Nice guy, great plumber and a great company. They have been taking good care of our place for 23 years.

plumbers.name: 911 Plumbing & Drain Rescue Inc.
plumbers.address: 1026 W El Norte Pkwy #42, Escondido, CA 92026, USA

reviews.author: Ryan Jamieson
reviews.text: I'm a real estate professional and exclusively use Javier from 911 Plumbing & Drain Rescue for all my personal and client's plumbing related needs.  The work is always done quickly, correctly and for a fair price.  From big jobs to small things like replacing angle stops, he's done it all for me and there is no other plumber I'd call.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Hetal Patel
reviews.text: Javier is an outstanding professional with strong morals and ethics—someone I would gladly work with anytime. For an urgent issue at our rental, he arrived quickly at 8:30 p.m. and provided a clear, reasonable assessment. The only reason we didn’t use his service was that our regular plumber, who had done related work, happened to be available to fix the problem.

reviews.author: steven fischer
reviews.text:
I'm satisfied with the quality of their work and professionalism performing it. There was a quotation of 400 for leak detection which would be applied to any subsequent repair. They identified and repaired a crack in an apparently defective "T" junction by replacing the junction and splicing it into the  3 associated pipes.
I have used them on two prior occasions with satisfaction. The initial quoted charge was high but subsequent negotiation resulted in a reasonable charge.  I would recommend 911 Plumbing & Drain and will keep their card on hand for future services again.

reviews.author: Jason Stark
reviews.text: Obviously, when you call a plumber, it’s usually because you need them now.  Javier provided service the same day.  He came out and found that my external drainage collapsed.  He gave a fair price and agreed to start that very same day.  They worked Saturday and Sunday to resolve the issue and replace the full run.  They actually had to run further to get the correct drainage run.  Javier was there working to get it completed also.  This reminds me of old time businesses that worked for customer satisfaction.

reviews.author: Eginardo Mendoza
reviews.text: 911 Plumbing was quick to respond when called about my plumbing issue. They diagnosed the problem quickly and were able to fix it the same day. They also added root suppressant to help reduce the problem in the future. I was very pleased with the work and how quickly they fixed it.

plumbers.name: Albert Ellis Inc
plumbers.address: 124 Mill St, Moorestown, NJ 08057, USA

reviews.author: Avi
reviews.text: We have consistently had excellent experiences with Albert Ellis. We have used them for both HVAC and plumbing services, and each time their pricing has been fair, their staff professional, and their work high quality. They consistently go above and beyond, and we highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Anthony “Andy” Yanka
reviews.text: I have one of the sewer line warranty products and that company has sent out two different contractors to fix the problem and it kept coming back.  I had another sewer blockage recently and the warranty company didn't have any of their contractors available so I called Albert Ellis indepentantly and they came out within an hour of my call.  They did a much more thorough evaluation and found a problem that the other contractors did not.  They clear the blockage and solved the problem.  The technicians were very kind and curtious.  They explained the situation well.  The pricing was very transparent and fair.  I got a good value for the price.  I'll be cancelling my warranty and self-insuring so I can use Albert Ellis on my own going forward.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Miller-McGrail
reviews.text: Excellent service! Able to come out quickly and solve our problem. Brett was an excellent plumber and knowledgeable of older homes! Will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: J G
reviews.text: Called Albert Ellis plumbing for a pipe/toilet issue. Eric came out the same day to cut the copper pipe and he installed the toilet. He was quick, professional, and very friendly. The price was fair, and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. Highly recommend if you need a reliable plumber on short notice! Will definitely use them again!

reviews.author: David Kassabian
reviews.text: Great experience with Albert Ellis. Eric came over in a timely manner, explained the issue, and worked very quickly to help resolve the problem. He cleaned everything as if he was never there. Would recommend Albert Ellis, specifically Eric for any plumbing issue.

plumbers.name: Montgomery Plumbing & Heating
plumbers.address: 3003 W St Louis Ave, Vandalia, IL 62471, USA

reviews.author: Dianna Carter
reviews.text: Honest fast friendly service. I will recommend him to anyone who needs plumbing work done. Other plumbers said they would have to dig up my sewer and replace the whole thing. Not Kenny he got the issue solved in a matter of a couple hours. No new lines and it's fixed. Wish I had called him first instead of wasting my time with other plumbers.

reviews.author: Amber Koontz
reviews.text: Called at 8am and he was here and problem fixed within the hour! Very nice,down to earth guy. Definitely recommend  👌

reviews.author: Danny BALLA
reviews.text: When plumbing issues arise it's a "no brainer " pick up the phone and give Kenny a call you will be happy you did. On time, courteous,  and throughl are just a few adjectives I use to describe this man. He's a man of action in a town of talk !

reviews.author: Randy Vincent
reviews.text: Ive called this company 5 times this morning left a message finally got a call back in which they left me a message telling me im to blame for them not calling back because i didnt explain what kind of plumbing issue i had. REALLY!!!!!!

reviews.author: Chris Klitzing
reviews.text:
Called them in the early morning. I got a voice mail. A few hours later they showed up and fixed my leaky pipe.
Real fast service

plumbers.name: Big State Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2217 Washita Trail, Edmond, OK 73003, USA

reviews.author: DK
reviews.text: Needed a new water heater and should have called Big State right away, unfortunately I called another company out first who quoted a replacement WAY too high. After another full day of cold showers I messaged Big State after hours and got an immediate response. I was told a tech would be out in the morning to get me squared away with a new 50 gallon tank at what I thought was a more reasonable price. Cody showed up and was eager to help. Turned out the new 50 gallon tank would not fit in the tight space the previous tank had been incorrectly installed. Longer story short Cody got me hooked up the same day with a tankless system after I inquired about it versus the traditional tank. I appreciated her was determined to get the new tank to fit and didn't try to up sale me. Glad I have a new go to plumbing company

reviews.author: Katie Hightower
reviews.text: Cody and Jacob were absolutely awesome. We had a horrible experience with MDO trying to get a new range installed and it was a nightmare. Those fellas took care of our range install so quickly, and were super nice too. Will 100% be using this company for any plumbing needs moving forward.

reviews.author: Benjamin Boling
reviews.text: Cody is amazing! Honest, reliable, and knows his stuff. I wouldn’t recommend using anyone else for your work plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Tyler Muchmore
reviews.text: Our toilet was backing up in our shower. I called 4 plumbing companies at 10pm. Big state was 1 of 2 companies that called me back. They had availability the next morning. Kevin and Cody were very professional and they got our situation handled until they can get us scheduled for a dig to remove roots. We will 100% recommend and use then in the future!!

reviews.author: Sydney Reneau
reviews.text: Chris and Kevin did an exceptional job with replacing an old valve and all the fittings. They were very kind, professional and were quick to answer any questions I had. Would highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Lawhorn Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 2700 N Lake Valley Rd G7, Prescott Valley, AZ 86314, USA

reviews.author: Bree Fitzgerald
reviews.text: Lawhorn did a fabulous job working with us on our remodel! Moved the water heater to a whole new room, fixed various other water and gas leaks they found along the way, plus much more! They collaborated and communicated with my contractor to make sure everything was done smoothly. Skip and Kassandra are awesome! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Alex Crapo
reviews.text: Super happy with my new tankless water heater! Over the last couple months this company has helped me on several projects in my new home with great results. They are quick to respond, pleasant to work with, reasonable pricing, and did an excellent job on the water heater installation. I really appreciate the extra effort that went into fixing the old venting and running pipe so that I can keep an eye on the relief line for the unit. Can not recommend them enough.

reviews.author: K L
reviews.text: Awesome company, came out to check on my water heater I've been having issues with. Gave me a diagnosis on the water heater and an estimate if I wanted to replace it. The technician Skip was extremely helpful very understanding and answered all questions I had. I highly recommend this company for anyone's plumbing needs. 10/10 service.

reviews.author: Jessie Weber
reviews.text: We were notified by the town of Prescott Valley that our water usage exceeded 500 gallons two days ago and 900 gallons the day before. I called Lawhorn Plumbing and was greeted by Kassandra.  I asked her if they would be able to accommodate an emergency same-day service call. She said she would check and promptly called me back within five minutes. Within one hour the owner, Skip, was at my house.  He did a thorough diagnosis of all of my bathrooms, toilets, and outside spigots.  He then proceeded to run a test of usage at the water main.  It was the determined that the issue was with the water meter. Skip proceeded to correct an issue that I was having with low water pressure on one of the outdoor spigots by clearing the sediment and adjusted the water level on both of our toilets. The total cost was more than reasonable for the education and prompt,, courteous, and outstanding customer service that I received. We have found a new plumber for life andI cannot recommend this company enough.

reviews.author: A Rebmann
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about this company! Lawhorn does an amazing job! They are the only company we ask to do our repairs. Since moving out of state l, we have had a few issues come up at our home in Prescott Valley. Kassandra got us scheduled in a timely manner, kept us updated on the price, and progress along with photos of the repair. The communication from this company is top tier! Any questions were answered quickly by either Skip or Kassandra. All of their crew have been amazing. I loved that they also recommended a local landscaper to fix our property after the repair. Love supporting small family owned businesses!

plumbers.name: LZ Plumbing Inc.
plumbers.address: 104 Butterfield Ct, Lake Zurich, IL 60047, USA

reviews.author: Alyssa Gummerson
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with LZ Plumbing in Lake Zurich. From start to finish, everyone I worked with was fantastic. Maria was incredibly helpful and communicative, making the scheduling process easy and stress-free. John and Boris were professional, honest, and took the time to clearly explain everything that needed to be done.

It’s not always easy to find contractors you can truly trust, but this team made the whole experience smooth and reassuring. I really appreciated their transparency and the quality of their work. I would absolutely recommend LZ Plumbing to anyone I know who needs plumbing assistance. Great service all around!

reviews.author: SYED HUSSAIN
reviews.text: We hired this company for a project in Niles and, unfortunately, had a very disappointing experience. They completed only half of the work and never returned to finish the job. Despite paying them in full, we have been unable to get any response. We’ve called multiple times and sent several texts with no reply. Based on our experience, we cannot recommend this company.

reviews.author: Kellyn Cochran
reviews.text: Boris and John were both very professional and knowledgeable when replacing my garbage disposal. Not only were they professional, they are both very personable and went above and beyond to make sure that I understood what was the problem. They continually took the time to answer my questions and concerns, and Boris even took my nosey German shepherd under his wing as an apprentice at points. I highly recommend both of these professionals and will be using them again if the time ever calls.

reviews.author: Beth de Anda
reviews.text: Boris from LZ Plumbing came to my rescue again.  I first started using him when I bought a new home and no one could determine the point of a water leak that I was having sporadically.  Boris was able to zero in on a bad connection with the dishwasher and fixed it. This time he was able to quickly fix a water heater problem I was having in my rental unit. Highly recommend this business!

reviews.author: Graham Grochocinski
reviews.text: Boris was able to diagnose and repair our water heater which had a bad valve control unit. He was friendly, professional, and took the time to be careful with our old home’s galvanized pipes. He also adjusted his schedule and came by an entire day earlier when he learned the part needed had arrived earlier than expected. He also checked for gas leaks using a sensor after the repair was finished — which gave us some peace of mind. :) We’ll definitely be calling him again for any future plumbing needs. Thanks Boris!

plumbers.name: Peach Plumbing & Drain
plumbers.address: 10 Glenlake Pkwy NE Suite 130, Sandy Springs, GA 30328, USA

reviews.author: Roger Fleenor
reviews.text: This company came to inspect small leak at rental property. They disassembled the piping and did not want to put it back without charging me $700 to replace pipe. I personally drove 5 hours to fix this and all that was needed was a bead of silicone and a pipe extension. Spent $20 max with 30 mins of work. Don’t waste your time and money they are shady and manipulative. From one business owner to another, a 1 star review isn’t worth a few hundred bucks.

reviews.author: Michael Smith
reviews.text: Excellent from start to finish. Replaced 1 toilet with Washlet and repaired another toilet. Technician Billy was the best - and I am very picky. Used them before to replace some faucets, did a great job then so I went back for more. You will not be disappointed - ask for Billy to do the work.

reviews.author: melanie Cruz sanchez
reviews.text: Billy Ochoa is an excellent plumber. he has great service and knows what he’s taking about. i called him out for an issue i was having with my toilet and before he even arrived he already knew what the problem was and what the solution was. he fixed my plumbing quicker then any other plumber i had hired. after 3 great experience with Billy I would definitely recommend him. Whenever I call and I only ask for Billy.

reviews.author: Bill Corley
reviews.text:
When you need a plumber, you usually NEED one!
Peach Plumbing has handled my plumbing work on multiple occasions, showing up on time and completing the repairs professionally and quickly. Timeliness, performance and a fair price, usually you have to sacrifice one of those three, but not with Peach. These are the Guys you should call for Plumbing or Drain work in the Sandy Springs area

reviews.author: Taylor Freeman
reviews.text: We needed an emergency plumber late on a Saturday afternoon. Called Peach Plumbing based on a referral and within 2 hours a technician arrived. He assessed the problem within a few minutes and by the end of the hour our problem was solved. Very professional and respectful. Thanks.

plumbers.name: Service Time Plumbing LLC
plumbers.address: 332 N La Quinta Cir N, Keller, TX 76248, USA

reviews.author: Brianna Salyer
reviews.text: I can’t speak highly enough of Service Time Plumbing!  We’ve used Marq several times now & each time he’s done a phenomenal job. As a Master Plumber, he’s incredibly knowledgeable & does great work. Just this week I contacted Marq about our water heater leaking & he was quick to respond to my call & came out immediately. Our existing water heater had been installed by the previous owners & there were several things that hadn’t been done correctly. Marq not only installed our new water heater, but was happy to address those things as well. Everything was spotless when he was finished too. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him & plan on continuing to use him for all our plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Bart M
reviews.text: I needed a leaky shower and faucet repaired and didn't want to deal with the large corporate-style plumbing companies that try to sell you on annual plumbing inspections and other services I'm not needing.  Marq was on-time, professional, and great to communicate with; he even went above and beyond to make trips to Lowe's at no extra cost for parts to fit the old shower, but I insisted he bill us for his time.  Marq is a perfect example of the type of pros I try to find when needing specialized home repairs.

reviews.author: Gary Lunsford
reviews.text: Marques came out for a busted backyard faucet in nearly freezing temperatures at a late hour.  Not only did he fix the faucet, but gave some practical advice on how to manage the pipe in the future.  We truly appreciate how quick and professional he was with us.

reviews.author: A S
reviews.text: Honest, hard working, trustworthy and professional. I have used Marques a couple of times now and never been dissatisfied. Good rates, won't try to upsell you and will tell you straight. Best local plumber I have ever dealt with.

reviews.author: Chris Hurst
reviews.text: Mark has provided professional plumbing services for me many times.  He is honest, very good at what he does, and very fair with pricing.  He is a hard worker and very trustworthy.  Highly recommend him.

plumbers.name: R & T Yoder Plumbing, Inc - Dublin
plumbers.address: 25 North St Ste 117B, Dublin, OH 43017, USA

reviews.author: Gary
reviews.text: We had a water main leak in the basement. Cameron diagnosed the issue as a faulty repair done 4 years ago by another company. The solution was to replace the water line between the house and the street.  He fully explained why we needed that as opposed to a “quick fix” which I agreed with in spite of the expense. If that had been done on the previous repair, I wouldn’t have had the problem again.  The company dealt with dealing with permits and inspections.  They did the work yesterday and did a great job.  Also want to thank Chris and Wyatt for their invaluable work.  I’ve dealt with the electrical side as well and received great service from them as well. I will be calling R&T Yoder for my future needs.

reviews.author: Michael Boes
reviews.text: Cameron Rung did an amazing job! He really knows his stuff and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand. I could tell he paid attention to the details and made sure everything was done right. Super helpful, professional, and easy to talk to — overall just a great experience. I’ll definitely be calling again if I ever need plumbing work and would highly recommend Cameron to anyone!

reviews.author: Adam Borland
reviews.text: Patrick was excellent! He checked with us on our availability, came earlier than scheduled (after checking that it was okay), and proceeded to do great and efficient work!

reviews.author: Carole Watson
reviews.text: Great Service, competitive prices but the awesome service and quality work was worth it. Finally have my outside water faucet working without leaking! Thanks Patrick for the quality work.

reviews.author: Clayton Petry
reviews.text: Great work by Yoder! They reworked most of the drain piping in my house. The work disturbed some associated plumbing and caused a leak - they were back first thing next morning and straightened things out. Drains work well now and no complaints!

plumbers.name: Fastrack Plumbing
plumbers.address: 2576 Lawrenceburg Rd, Frankfort, KY 40601, USA

reviews.author: Bill Rice
reviews.text:
I received a referral from a close friend for Fastrack Plumbing. Spoke with Calvin first thing in the morning about my water heater that stopped working.

Within a few hours his technician Sean was here. He was very friendly, made friends with my dog and I was comfortable having him in our home. He quickly diagnosed the issue, made the necessary repairs and took the time to explain the issue that was brought on by our record cold temperatures. No sales pressure, just an honest assessment and a reasonable service call fee. Will recommend and use them again.

reviews.author: Anthony Davis
reviews.text:
I honestly can’t say enough good things about FasTrak. From the very beginning, their communication was great and clear, responsive, and professional the whole way through.

The first day the tech came out, he was incredibly patient with me. As a first time homeowner, I had a lot of questions, and he took the time to show me everything underneath the house and explain exactly what he was looking at. That alone meant a lot and really helped put me at ease.

Our main water line repair did end up costing us a good amount, but what stood out most was how honest FasTrak was throughout the entire process. There were no surprises, no upselling, just straightforward explanations and quality work.

It’s hard to find companies that are this professional and trustworthy. FasTrak has definitely earned our trust, and they’ll always have our business moving forward. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them.

reviews.author: Klaude Kocan
reviews.text: Calvin and his team were great when it came to pricing and being on time for the rough in plumbing and then the final install of showers, toilets, sump pump and sewer lines. We love it! Happy Homeowners in Frankfort KY!

reviews.author: Judy Dickerson
reviews.text: I had what I thought was a large project. Turned into a little more than expected. All the work by Calvin's team was completed timely and efficiently.  I know there is another project in the future I will need a plumber. I will not hesitate to call Fastrack Plumbing.

reviews.author: Jason Glass
reviews.text: Calvin and his team were on time and extremely professional. They fixed my main sewer line in the Lexington, KY area quickly and on budget

plumbers.name: Holiday Enterprises
plumbers.address: 219 Race St, Sunbury, PA 17801, USA

reviews.author: The Knee Center
reviews.text: Super nice people who responded promptly to my broken water heater and set up an appointment right away to replace it.

reviews.author: M Uli
reviews.text:
I am a Home Serve Customer with my gas company UGI. I pay for heat repair and others. Holiday is one of their contractors.
Have a new boiler still under warranty that installer will not service. I am not happy with the way its heating my house. 35 year old boiler worked better.
Tech showed up and basically was not there to try and help me figure out what to do. I had to pull out of him every bit of information. He then basically said that Home Serve would not pay $$$ for anything he could do to troubleshoot the unit , so it was pointless for him to do anything.
I froze last winter and am afraid to freeze again this winter, so I bought another home with an oil furnace and 3 mini splits. I am trying to keep both homes going and it is difficult enough to keep one going.
He said gas units don't need cleaning but he'd do it for $200. I saw the oil furnace get cleaned out for 3.5 hrs and the bill was $250. This makes no sense to me. Holiday wasted my time bc they are only about making $ not helping people which in my opinion is not the kind of place that I want to call 🤙 when I need help with heating my home. What is wrong with this place and the people who treat others in this manner? Go elsewhere and keep trying new places until you find some people who are human and humane. Not 🚫 HOLIDAY. Nope keep looking..

reviews.author: Pam Malfara
reviews.text: We use Homeserve and this is the company they sent to us.  The repairman who showed up were very nice and explained things to us as to what they are going to do.  I am glad they came on Christmas Eve due to a sewer smell in my home.  The smell was making me sick and happy to have it fixed.

reviews.author: Carolyn McGlinn
reviews.text: Highly recommend these folks.  Prompt service, diagnose the problem and fix quickly.   Quality of work is outstanding.  I use Holiday Enterprises on a regular basis for all our properties.   Pricing is very reasonable.

reviews.author: K Z
reviews.text: They are professional, quick response and took care of our issue out in the backyard with our sewer line. They treated my mom very nicely and were polite. Communicated well with her and she couldn’t stop talking about how nice the man she was in contact with and all of the workers who came to the property. Got it done in a timely matter. Would definitely recommend!!  Thank you for being so nice and reliable, it’s a rare find now a days.

plumbers.name: The Plumbing Smith
plumbers.address: 160 E River Rd, Des Plaines, IL 60016, USA

reviews.author: Bill Plasschaert
reviews.text: The Plumbing Smith is a fantastic company. I use them to service my clients and every single job I ask them to do turns out great! They are timely, efficient and their rates are very reasonable. Highly recommend them for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Oriana Dougherty
reviews.text: Mr Kevin Smith came out to my house today to do some upgrades and changes to our radiators/ boiler system. He was a delight, as was his team member Terrence. He came on short notice and gives me confidence that we found our “heating guy” and “plumbing guy” all in one. Really great experience from end to end with this local company

reviews.author: Bill Ulivieri
reviews.text:
A huge shout out to The Plumbing Smith, who came out today in 21° degree weather and fixed our sump pump to sewer pipe for $190 bucks.

We dug the hole last week to make it easier for him, but Reed arrived early, cleaned up what I missed, redid the entire connection and was gone within 60 minutes.

Trustworthy, punctual and good workmanship.

Highly recommend

reviews.author: susanna johnson
reviews.text: This is my 4th project using The Plumbing Smith and I just want to compliment both Reed and Kevin.Today I had a kitchen sink and a faucet installed. Reed was punctual and courteous and did an amazing job, he also took the the time to repair my outside faucet. The price was very reasonable, I'm very thankful to have such fantastic plumbers in our area...I would give them 6 stars if I could!!

reviews.author: J D
reviews.text: Do NOT hire him. I had already figured out the issue but he didn't want to listen to me until he saw it for himself after testing.  That caused water to back up in the sewer pipes.  The plumber Kevin Smith attempted to rod my main sewer line unsuccessfully.  He created a mess of sewer water all over my garage and left it like that.  He told me he thought 2 pipes were misaligned and 1 was sagging so I needed a camera to see into the pipes since he couldn't get his rod through.  That was going to be an extra cost and he was going to have to come back with his "$10,000 camera" (another hourly charge too).  Then he said he would have to cut into my garage floor concrete and dig down to get to the pipes, which was going to be $6000 - $7000!!!  He cut into a sewer pipe in my basement capped 1 side and left the other side open.  Which connected to a toilet and had sewage coming out onto my water heater, and plastic pipe bits he left all over.  He left it dripping onto the water heater. Didn't clean it up after I asked him to.  He and his assistant broke my light switch and water heater.  He left a huge mess and didn't clean it up.  I got another plumber to come out the next day.  He was easily able to rod the sewer line to clear it, fixed the pipe Kevin cut, and told me Kevin was probably trying to scam me.  I asked for a refund and Kevin kept talking over me and cutting me off. He did not fix my issues and caused further damage.  He charges $150 hourly, $300 for main sewer rodding, and tried justifying due to his time.  Do NOT hire him!

plumbers.name: McHenry Plumbing, Inc.
plumbers.address: 1903 State Rte 31, McHenry, IL 60050, USA

reviews.author: Judy Macdonald
reviews.text: McHenry Plumbing just completed a big job for me and I was very pleased with the results. The technicians knew their job and proceeded very efficiently to get the work done as quickly as possible. What I really appreciated was that they answered my questions about the work very clearly and in sufficient detail. They were careful about my house and cleaned up thoroughly when finished. I plan to use this company again!

reviews.author: corey lersch
reviews.text: Michael was very professional and kind when he did his initial visit. He came up with a great plan and was able to execute it to great affect! I had many plumbers come out and his plan was the best and for the best price. Will be using them for any other plumbing projects I need.

reviews.author: Donna Chapman
reviews.text:
Highly recommend McHenry Plumbing and Heating!  It was their no call day but they sent a very nice friendly look alike Santa gentleman out. He came right away and fixes my problem.
I have had McHenry plumbing before and they are definitely the best!!!

reviews.author: Lori Rotolo
reviews.text: I've used McHenry Plumbing for my AC/Furnace/water heater needs for years.  Recently I had several plumbing issues needing attention.  Johnny came over and took the time to show and explain what was needed and gave me some great suggestions as well.  I called back a week later for something else and Johhny was able to come over that same day.  He's a total professional with a wealth of knowledge and I would recommend him to anyone!  Honestly you do get your moneys worth with this company!

reviews.author: Moises P
reviews.text: I'm extremely happy with the quality and responsiveness of McHenry Plumbing, Inc. They sent out Jeremy Sheldon to do a diagnostic on a leaking shower. He called ahead of time to notify us that he was on his way. Once onsite, he was quick to figure out the issue and we got the shower unit back to normal in no time. I would definitely recommend the entire team to anyone in need of plumbing repairs! Thanks McHenry Plumbing, Inc!

plumbers.name: Plumb Xpress Plumbing & Drain, LLC
plumbers.address: 3620 Kennesaw North Industrial Pkwy ste d, Kennesaw, GA 30144, USA

reviews.author: Shawn Bartlett
reviews.text: I cannot recommend these guys enough. They were amazing. I had an emergency sewer issue. I'll save you the details... It was bad. Of course the three emergency 24/7 plumbers we had on the fridge had no one available. Then we found Plumb Xpress. They came out that night (Saturday) and worked through the weekend to get us back up and running. My house was built in the 40's and had the original orangeburg lines. They were able to offer a reasonable price. Really amazing. Thank you Donnie, Rick and Wayne. You've made a life long customer.

reviews.author: Michelle Abbott
reviews.text: HUGE shout out to Plumb Xpress for sending out Joey so fast!! We were having surges in water pressure and was so worried my appliances were going to be damaged from it!!!! We tried replacing the pressure reducing valve and still no change! Joey made sure everything was installed correctly and our pressure gauge was hooked up in the correct spot and determined our regulator was faulty and explained what happens sometimes with them! Super awesome people to work with!! Thank you soooo much!!

reviews.author: Jeff Murray
reviews.text:
Plumb Xpress should be your first choice and call for all your plumbing and drain needs. They are also experts in copper pipe replacements as they did our entire home and did an incredible job! Donnie and his team are experts at replacing the old pipes with a minimum of wall cuts and ceiling damage. They are fast but efficient and always clean up…and left us with a water supply every evening until the job was completed.
The best part is they handle the entire job from start to finish…no need to have to go out and find a drywall repairman or a painter unless you chose to!
We honestly could not have been happier with their work and are aware of a number of others that have been equally satisfied. You will not go wrong with Plumb Xpress I assure you…

reviews.author: Doreen Davey
reviews.text: Had to have whole house replumbed last year due to leaking copper pipes. Plumb XPRESS did great job, always had water, good price, friendly but professional, and totally cleaned up before they left. He arranged for everything including Sheetrock replace and repainting of areas redone, Great caring service and have had no problems.

reviews.author: R P
reviews.text: We have been using Plumb Xpress for several years at several of our locations. We've had pipes leak, valves needing replacement, water heaters installed.  In all they have been quick to respond and very competent commercial plumbers.  I have been very satisfied with their work and their pricing is reasonable.  I would recommend them to friends and family.

plumbers.name: GUSTAFSON PLUMBERS
plumbers.address: 1035 Millbury St, Worcester, MA 01607, USA

reviews.author: Leslie Seymour
reviews.text:
The plumbers texted and arrived early.  They were cheerful and helpful.  They installed our new garbage disposal, but went further to replace the piping to minimize spots likely to clog. They pointed out unusual features of the new unit.  Also he showed us the gunk in the old pipes and recommended flushing much longer after grinding to prevent future clogs.  They swept up thoroughly after they finished.

We were immediately put at ease by their cheerfulness and competence.  They worked quickly and efficiently.

We are very happy with Gustafson and have used them multiple times over the last 10 years.

reviews.author: Brandon Fusaro
reviews.text: Gustafson replaced the water line from the street to my mother's home, and we couldn’t be more pleased with the experience. Their team was knowledgeable, professional, and truly stood behind the quality of their work. I highly recommend Gustafson for any water line replacement needs.

reviews.author: Dave D
reviews.text: I can’t recommend Gustafson enough. From start to finish, they were outstanding. I needed a sewer line repair, and Shayna went above and beyond to get us scheduled quickly. Bruce came out to provide a quote, which was more than fair. The crew—Drew, Sean, Connor, and Javaughn—were professional, punctual, and transparent throughout the entire process. They took the time to explain what they were doing every step of the way, which I really appreciated. I never once felt like I was getting the runaround. I’ll be using Gustafson for all my future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Michael Parker
reviews.text:
Drew & Joe came to clear the main drain in my condo. I was not home when they did the job, but my gf said both of them were professional, polite and helpful.
They did a great job and I highly recommend Gustafson Plumbers.

reviews.author: Kristine Jones
reviews.text: We have used Gustavson Plumbing for multiple projects and Derek went above and beyond for each service. We had a leaking toilet while our family house was for sale and he immediately took care of the issue- despite being very busy.He also repaired a  leak in the attic from a heating hy vent along with other items on our plumbing checklist for the sale. We very much appreciate the professionalism, skill and service we received for every service. Highly recommend!

plumbers.name: Northland Plumbing
plumbers.address: N, W State Rte 89A, Sedona, AZ 86336, USA

reviews.author: Daniel Sloan
reviews.text:
Northland Plumbing was outstanding. I had a leaky propane valve and a stubborn clog at my remote cabin, and none of it was straightforward. Weather conditions were rough, power was limited, and access wasn’t easy. None of that slowed him down.

He showed up with great energy, stayed focused on doing the job right, and worked through every obstacle without complaint. The enthusiasm and professionalism he brought to a challenging situation really stood out. Everything was fixed properly, and I felt confident in the work when he was done.

If you need someone reliable who doesn’t get rattled by less-than-ideal conditions, Northland Plumbing is the real deal.

reviews.author: Rick
reviews.text: As a former contractor myself(not plumbing) this is exactly the kind of place I want coming to take care of my home. First real humans answer the phone. He worked us in, didn’t upsell a bunch of bullsh and work was done quickly at a fair price. Not many places left like this. Let’s support the real ones.

reviews.author: Collin Woolsey
reviews.text:
While I cannot say that they do good or bad work.  they have never actually showed up to work on our plumbing, I have tried to schedule 3+ times and either never gotten a contact back, or Today they never showed up or called about the scheduled appointment. Just left us sitting there all afternoon.
We purchased a new home in Sedona 12-2-24. I called (left message) and submitted an online Service request the second week of December. Never got a return contact.
Just before Christmas I spoke with Jerry, whom remembered the homes previous owner and they system he serviced, to get the water filters for the home replaced as they are way overdue. He said he would get the availability on the filters and call me back to schedule. I replied no problem, please just order all 4 of them and let me know when you can get to it.
I called back Late January and left a message. No response
I spoke with Jerry Monday 4-14, asked about getting the filter replaced, they are making noise and could possible have another issue. Jerry told me he would look up the parts availability and call me back in the afternoon.
No call back Monday  or Tuesday.
I called and spoke to Jerry this morning (Wednesday) and he says he can be there with the filters in 1.5 hours. This was 10:30 am. I told him the name of the contact person at the house and he said no problem.
Now it is 4pm and still haven't heard from anyone and no one arrived at the home.

I have no idea if they do good service or bad, but if it is this hard just to get a call back or a service appointment that someone actually shows up to, I will just find someone else. It would have been nice to use the people that evidently installed and serviced the original system, but Im confident a new company will figure it out.

reviews.author: Christine haenschel
reviews.text:
I have used Northland Plumbing many times before and I am very happy with their service.
They are always on time, diagnosed my problem throughly, explained to me what was going on and even gave me several options of how I could solve my problems effectively.
The last service  I was pressured with the schedule due to my  AirBnB customer arriving that day . Jerry the owner came up with a temporarily solution during their stay which absolutely was perfect and I did not have to inconvenience my customers at all .
Then after check out, Jerry and his help immediately came to fix it for good.
Jerry has been in the plumbing business for more than 30 years and one must say that he is a professional from old school
I highly recommend Northland Plumbing especially since you will save time in having your problem diagnosed
Thank you Jerry for all your help

reviews.author: Mitch Steidl
reviews.text: My experience was great! I had a leak under my kitchen sink. The guys showed up and diagnosed the problem and made a correction to the dishwasher drain hose and the leak seemed to be corrected. A few days later, the leak issue came up again. The guys came back out and made a different correction as the new leak seemed to be a different cause than the first. The did not charge me for the return visit. As with any diagnostic, it may not have been perfect...we are all human after all. However, they were willing to stand up for their work and correct it without charge. That's solid customer service! BTW, the second trip, they came immediately after the call to them and they had to stay about 90 minutes to make sure it was perfect. I'll hire them for all plumbing needs in the future!

reviews.author: Kayne Khoury
reviews.text:
Tib and his sons have provided numerous plumbing solutions from simple to complex. Any job I need done, they can figure it out quickly, efficiently, enthusiastically, and all reasonably priced. We’ve grown to be good friends with them and will trust them for any future job.

I can’t recommend them enough, the absolute best plumbing company in Austin.

reviews.author: Escobar
reviews.text:
Stepping on wet carpet and seeing swollen base board at 10pm isn’t ideal. I spent hours cleaning up and cutting out wet drywall and flooring. I traced a leak that ended up under the slab.  I am well rounded and can fix many things around the house but I know when I need a pro. The next morning I called 4 major plumbing companies. Not a single one of them called me back so I decided to head to Home Depot and pick up some supplies.
That trip was worth every penny and more.
The vehicle I parked next to was AQUAMAN PLUMBING!  On his day off Tib showed up to my house within 30 minutes.  He listened to all the steps I took and checked all lines, meter etc. the leak was so slow it was not registering from the meter.  The rear hose bib was cut and capped isolating and stopping the leak.  I asked lots of questions from running a new line, changing from copper to pex, adding bibs, water pressure (90-92psi) and adding a PRV from the meter.  Tib answered all without missing a beat.  He noticed I had installed a water softener and made some adjustments to the overflow lines.  He mentioned the benefit of having a filtration system pre softener and potential layout of bypass and cutoff incase of leaks or maintenance.

We discussed 3 items with 0 sales pressure.   Tib, Raul, Andre and Tata (grandfather) showed up and tackled all 3 tasks.  Tib advised he would be back the following day for a 30min to an hour visit to check connections and button everything up.  I had to delay an additional day. Tib and Andre returned and I am going to say this was a godsend.  The water heater flex line was leaking, and had been leaking since we bought the house 4 years ago or longer!!!  The line was barely screwed on, no sealant tape, no pipe dope just hanging on by a thread and prayer.  Cut off the gas, sealed up and checked all gas lines inside and out.  Thank you again for your prompt service and attention to detail.  You saved us from a disaster and we are very grateful.

10/10

reviews.author: Moto M
reviews.text:
They were amazing. AMAZING experience and I highly recommend to ANYONE for ANY plumbing needs. I am going to be a repeat after he's done my water filter installation. Inviting him back to check my water heater as well.

Top notch knowledge, expertise and value for money! You would be in safe hands!

reviews.author: Eric Esquivel
reviews.text:
Great Experience!
I had my garbage disposal replaced by Tib (owner), and I couldn’t be happier with the service. He was friendly, honest, and did a great job at a very fair price. The work was done quickly and professionally. I highly recommend him for any plumbing needs!

reviews.author: John L
reviews.text: Tib @ Aquaman was superb. I had a main water line leak somewhere in my yard in Lakeway and my main plumber had to call in reinforcements since it was such a laborious operation digging 2.5 foot deep holes trying to find the leak in a 70 foot stretch of yard. Tib and Raul showed up and they were great. They kept digging and triangulating until they found and fixed the leak. They stayed until 10PM to get the job done. Yes, you heard that right. This is why you always want to hire tradesman that are owner operators rather than big outfits with salaried employees. Ain't no way an employee would have had the resolve to stay that late to knock out the job in 1 visit. Can't recommend Aquaman enough. Great job and great attitude in a difficult situation.

reviews.author: Amanda Hand
reviews.text: I came home to find a leaking water heater. The first place I called did offer after hours service but nothing was available. I called Chandlers based on their rating. That 5 stars is well deserved. Andrew had his tech (Bob) here in 30 minutes. Bob was very thorough in explaining what was wrong and the replacement. I highly recommend them

reviews.author: Dan S
reviews.text: Andrew came promptly and was very careful in our new house to keep things clean.  He gave us sound advise on not doing some things we thought we needed to do.  He installed some bidets for us quickly and well and for a good price.  We will be using him to change our shower head soon.

He arranged for Bob B., a Chandler employee, to stop by and assess my faucet problem the next day.   Bob arrived on time and quickly solved the problem.  Bob took a quick look at our intake water pressure regulator to make sure everything was satisfactory. I highly recommend Chandler Plumbing for any plumbing services you might have.  They are professional, trustworthy, and take pride in their work.

He walked through the process while clearing the drain, which made everything easy to understand. The service felt honest, professional, and well done.

reviews.text: Best plumber in the area by far! Extremely knowledgeable and good at what he does.

reviews.text: Needed shower faucet fixed. I've had 3 different plumbers out. reviews.author: Jeff Parker
reviews.text: I called the plumbing solution because I read a review of another customer getting recommended to call a county service number. I thought that was interesting so I wanted to see what they would say to my issue. After briefly describing my issue to Dawn, she recommended I call the same number and have them look at my sewer line. I did as she suggested, they came out same day to fix the issue. The line was snaked and jetted and my service was returning to normal. I can't comment on the plumbing solution's services but I can say it is respectable to see a company turn away profit when there is a free solution for customers.

reviews.author: Christine Polaczynski
reviews.text: I highly recommend The Plumbing Solution because of their skill, punctuality, and expertise. reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Highly recommend and will definitely use them again for any future plumbing needs!

reviews.author: O Harmon
reviews.text: Called for a rocking toilet. The job ended up being much bigger than expected- had a brass flange installed that required cutting through tile and cement. Mike and Dawn explained everything the whole way through and quoted a great price, especially considering the work that needed to be done. They cleaned up after themselves. I was so impressed! Thank you for a job well done- the right way! Glad I found a plumbing company we can trust.

reviews.author: Dan Dress
reviews.text: Let me start by saying wow!  I called today as our tenants mentioned issues with the drains backing up.  I left a message and was promptly called back by Dawn.  She was super knowledgeable and asked questions about what was going on.  After the questions she said they would be happy to come out and take a look, but recomended we call the county out first as it really sounded like the main.  She provided me with the number to call and said I can call or text her back.  The county came out and sure enough there was a giant root ball blocking the main.  They asked how I knew to call them and I said it was The Plumbing Solution.  They said it is good to know that there are honest companies out there still as a majority of companies would have come out, charged their fee then tell us to call the county.  Thank you Dawn for your knowledge and honestly.  You and your company have earned a customer for any future issues we may have as well as a solid referral to anyone I know who is in need of services.
