reviews.text: Cesar has been the most professional plumber that I have dealt with. Water heater went out. He arrived within 1 hour and provided a fair estimate which was lower that all other competitors. He was extremely clean. He showed respect to my family. I would highly recommend him in any situation.

reviews.author: Ben Sances
reviews.text: We had a problem with our toilet and the person who answered was very helpful in setting up a time. Didn't give a crazy 8 hour window like some places do. He even asked me what time worked best for me. Nam was our plumber and he called about 20 mins before arriving. He checked the sink, the shower as well as the toilet to narrow down the problem. He explained the possible issues and gave an estimate before starting the work and luckily it did not require removal of the toilet. Overall, we felt like they were very professional and good at explaining things too. Please keep up the good work!

plumbers.name: Norm's Plumbing, Heating and Supply, INC
plumbers.address: 2629 Spruce St, Boulder, CO 80302, USA

reviews.author: Charlotte Obermeier
reviews.text: Norm’s plumbing is exceptional!  Ernie, Doug and Samantha have taken care of our plumbing and heating needs for generations. They are such good, honest people!  Their work ethic is amazing. They have shown up and fixed our plumbing and heating issues at all times of day and night. They are best!

reviews.author: Graham Davis
reviews.text: Norm’s Plumbing is highly professional, they give you an accurate quote before starting the work, and clean up after the job so that you don’t even know they were there. Norm’s has a terrific crew working at this small family-owned Boulder business. While other companies price gouge you because they can, Norm’s rates are reasonable.

reviews.author: DJ Cultifader
reviews.text: Norm’s provides unmatched service that’s difficult to come by these days. Extremely friendly and dependable small business folks that I’d repeatedly give my business to. Being in unincorporated Boulder county, most other companies won’t even consider making the trip (yet some still advertise on their website…) My most recent experience with Norm’s was my third and consisted of a leaking water heater. Samantha and Ernie understood the urgency to get the problem resolved and performed the job after hours to have me up and running 24 hours after the problem began. They also came in 20% less than what I had been quoted. I had spoke with another local company before hearing back from Samantha as this was an emergency that I needed addressed ASAP. The other company took all my info and was supposed to call in the morning but straight up ghosted me. Norm’s really care about their customers and I hope they continue bringing this level of excellence for years to come.

reviews.author: Ron Spalding
reviews.text: Ernie of Norm's Plumbing is the consummate professional! He installed a replacement high efficiency hot water for me in the most efficient and timely manner. Ernie informed me that according to code I needed an expansion valve which I completely forgot about. He went out, got the part and finished the job quicker than I expected. I have used Norm's Plumbing in the past and it is my go to plumber for all my work. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Lisa Kistner
reviews.text:
Ernie and Samantha were awesome. It is hard to find experts in construction who both know their field and bring empathy and professionalism to the job. Our boiler went out Friday afternoon. Samantha returned my call, got Ernie in touch, and helped me trouble shoot through FaceTime. We ordered parts. They started work on Monday when it arrived. When we found that our boiler needed replacing, they gave us the best deal and squeezed us in to get it back working as soon as possible. When the weather turned cold this week, they came with electric heaters in case we needed them if they couldn’t finish in time. They did finish in time by staying late.
This is a 3rd generation family company. And a pioneer family company. They truly care about their work. Refreshing to see!

plumbers.name: Brighton Plumbing and Drain
plumbers.address: 125 W Bridge St #165, Brighton, CO 80601, USA

reviews.author: Kenya Aurora
reviews.text: A small leak developed behind the refrigerator water line. I contacted their experts to handle it. They replaced the brittle tubing and tested the pressure carefully. Everything is secure now and their work was thorough.

reviews.author: Samuel Torres
reviews.text: Brighton Plumbing resolved an issue with inconsistent hot water at fixtures. Their plumber flushed the system and corrected buildup. Water temperature stabilized afterward. The improvement has held up well.

reviews.author: Christopher Hernandez
reviews.text: The outdoor drainage line was blocked with debris. Their crew cleared it thoroughly. Water now flows away from the house properly. Professional and efficient service.

reviews.author: Canty Aaron
reviews.text: An unpleasant odor kept coming from the bathroom drain despite regular cleaning. The plumber found that debris was trapped deeper in the pipe where surface cleaners couldn’t reach. A thorough cleaning removed the buildup completely. The smell hasn’t returned since.

reviews.author: Jazlene Donna
reviews.text: Water pressure feels balanced across every tap after their specialists team replaced the aging regulator and checked the system.

plumbers.name: Yunke's Plumbing
plumbers.address: 380 Quarry Ln, Algonquin, IL 60102, USA

reviews.author: Tom S
reviews.text: Had issues with a rusty sludge filled water heater and a problem of having to wait for nearly 5 mins to get hot water to our master bath.  Matt switched out our tank type water heaters with a tankless system.  Install is super clean and I no longer have rust water from the tap and hot water flows to all taps in under 30 seconds.  He is a true master plumber!  Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Norma Peterson
reviews.text: Yunkie’s Plumbing (Matt) is wonderful!  Very responsive, knowledgeable, respectful. Great quality & he cleaned up everything before he left.  We are so thrilled we finally found a trustworthy plumber!  Do NOT hesitate to hire him.  Our relatives will soon be using him too!

reviews.author: John Rebmann
reviews.text: Matt is awesome, we have used him for a few repairs over the past couple years, he always takes great care of us & his work is excellent.

reviews.author: Kat
reviews.text: I picked this plumber because of 5 star reviews on Google. And he deserves 5 stars. Matt was personable, nice, and responsive. He answered my calls, and communicated well to when he'd be out. Bill was reasonable. Fixed my toilet clog 👍

reviews.author: Jeanette Reinhardt
reviews.text: Matt Yunke had to install a new well pressure tank in our basement.   We called and the next day he was at our home.  Matt gave us a reasonable estimate and we hired him on the spot.  He did an excellent job of installing, soldering and updating all the old pipes attached to the tank.  I am quite happy and would definitely recommend Yunke's Plumbing to anyone who needs a plumber.

plumbers.name: First Response Plumbing
plumbers.address: 176 Detroit St, Cary, IL 60013, USA

reviews.author: Caitlyn O'Brien
reviews.text: If I could leave one star I would. We were serviced by Joey. Very disappointed with this company. Poor communication, unclear pricing, and the issue wasn’t properly fixed. The whole experience felt unprofessional and frustrating. I wouldn’t use them again.

reviews.author: Megan Zdeb
reviews.text: FRP has done a lot for my business & in my home. Very professional and great work. I had my bathrooms redone, new floors and a lot of plumbing work & electrical work. I highly recommend as they have qualified workers for everything.

reviews.author: Kristy L
reviews.text: Joey and his team did a great job swapping out our 50 gallon electric hot water heater with a 75 gallon gas power vent hot water heater. His team knew what they were doing and did a great job. Everyone we worked with from First Response was very kind and happy to help. Joey even worked with my teenage son to help troubleshoot a different issue we were having.  Thanks Joey and Team!

reviews.author: Jon Del Vicario
reviews.text: I CANNOT recommend First Response Plumbing enough! I’ve called First Response Plumbing multiple times now to fix major issues left behind by a former DIY homeowner — including blown pipes that could’ve been a disaster during Memorial Day Weekend. I've had Joe, Nicole, and Dwayne come out to my house, and each time, First Response Plumbing showed up fast, explained everything clearly, and got the job done right without breaking the bank. They're honest, affordable, and get it done with zero hassle. I won’t call anyone else.

reviews.author: Tim Alonso
reviews.text:
First Response truly lives up to their name. I called when our hot water heater sprung a leak around 11:30pm on a Saturday.  Joey was at our door by midnight for a diagnosis, back with a replacement unit bright and early on Sunday morning, and completed the installation before noon.

On top of the quick response, he gave us a fair price and took the time to walk me through the details of the installation and warranty.  To say that we're blown away is an understatement! I called when we were in a bind and am happy to now have a go-to resource for any of our future plumbing needs.

plumbers.name: Smart Rooter & Plumbing
plumbers.address: 1290 Kilcrease Cir, El Sobrante, CA 94803, USA

reviews.author: Anthony McMullen
reviews.text:
A Five-Star Experience from Start to Finish!

From my initial phone call about a clogged sink, their team was incredibly responsive, offering to be at my house in less than an hour.

I also inquired about replacing my outdoor water taps, as they were old and leaking when on.

Since it wasn't a true emergency, I was happy to wait.
Their scheduler was wonderfully accommodating and immediately booked me for the following day at my earliest convenience. The technician arrived on time, and was highly professional.
The quality of work was outstanding. Not only did they use top-tier materials like all-brass fittings, but they also took the time to explain what they were doing and why.

I couldn't be more satisfied and will definitely be a returning customer. They also gave me a 90 day warranty on the work done.

reviews.author: Bryan Butawan
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Sam at Smart Rooter & Plumbing! From the start, he impressed me with his speedy response—he was on-site quicker than I expected, which gave me peace of mind right away. The price was fair and transparent, which is something I really appreciate when it comes to plumbing work.

What stood out most was Sam’s thorough follow-up and professionalism. He didn’t just fix the immediate issue and leave; he took the time to explain how the main sewer lines work, what warning signs to look for, and the potential problems that can arise if certain issues aren’t addressed early. I walked away not only with the problem solved but also feeling more educated about how to prevent future headaches.

If you’re looking for someone reliable, fair, and who takes pride in educating his customers, I’d highly recommend Sam and Smart Rooter & Plumbing.

reviews.author: Anuja Kumari
reviews.text: Smart Rooter & Plumbing did an awesome job! They showed up right on time, quickly figured out what was wrong, and explained it in a way that made sense. The repair was done fast, everything was cleaned up, and the price was exactly what they said it would be—no surprises. Super friendly and professional crew. I’ll definitely call them again for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Satnam Singh
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Sam for a recent plumbing job in my bathroom . He was very friendly, professional, and easy to talk to. The quality of his work was excellent—everything was done neatly and efficiently. What impressed me the most was that Sam followed up with me a few weeks later to make sure everything was still working well. It’s rare to find someone who truly cares about their work and their customers. Highly recommend his services!

reviews.author: andy bedi
reviews.text: I see a Sam came to my job tonight. They fix up the shower leak and fix our toilet. Very great job. He did. I highly recommend Sam and his crew to come by and do plumbing were definitely highly qualified. No worries doing a little pricey, but good thing he knows very clean cover his shoes, Clean uniform representative definitely show his company to others around my area. Thank you Sam for the great job.

He obviously intended to take advantage of my lack of plumbing knowledge I'm order to half fix or less and leave with the cash. This fella is trying to hustle people. DO NOT USE EVER even if there is a fire!

reviews.text: We had a hot water heater issue that was rapidly escalating into a dangerous situation because of adjacent electrical wiring. Matt squeezed us into his schedule, accurately assessed what we needed, and completed the repairs less than one complete day after being contacted. Our hot water and electrical problems have both disappeared thanks to Matt. I highly recommend him for his workmanship, compassionate approach, and professionalism.

reviews.author: Kevin Rowe
reviews.text: Horrible ethics.  Flooded my basement after a shark bite fitting that wasn't tested let go.  Refused to clean up because he "had stuff to do at his house"...  Received zero financial help and lost hundreds and hundreds of dollars in flood damaged items.  Also screwed over another relative.  Stay far away from this one.

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.text:
Matt and his crew have done quite a bit of plumbing work for us, including water heater installation, sink installation and fixing leaks. We've also had them come by to quote us on repair items we're planning on doing soon, and they graciously scheduled time for us to give us an idea of what the cost would be to do the work.

They do great work for a very reasonable price, and for that reason they're in high demand in this area. We will be hiring Bralley's Plumbing Services again to do more work for us, and appreciate them very much!

reviews.author: Cathy Abernathy
reviews.text: Had to get our water turned off last night because of a broken tub faucet.  Called 4 plumbers today - Bralley's is the only one who responded.  He knew what was wrong from my description, and had me text him a picture of the faucet so he could get the right parts.  Had us back up and running within a hour or so of our first contact.  Reasonable price, friendly and fast service - will call him again!  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: James Hamiter
reviews.text: Pacific Plumbing work with me to meet a certain schedule for replacing a water heater in Fremont, and did the job in two hours. I really appreciate their service and work! And, they cover the whole Bay Area,

reviews.author: Josh Turner
reviews.text:
Fast reliable  24 hrs service great
customer  service with expert staff  there techs are talor fit to meet your expected needs as they have multiple teams that handle a variety of jobs
No job is too small or big. I'm glad to have them for small jobs like a clogged sink  to larger jobs like a pipe broken underground  below the concrete

reviews.author: Z Ja
reviews.text:
About 20 years ago, a friend of mine recommended Pacific Plumbing.  Since them, I have been using Pacific Plumbing for all our plumbing work in our home.  We have used them numerous times and have been very happy every time.  We like them for two reasons: their competence and their honesty.  First, they are competent.  Their plumbers are very skilled and experienced.  Their customer service is excellent.  Second, they are honest.  They do not try to gouge or sell unnecessary work.  They use excellent parts.  They do the work with integrity and skill.  The business reflects the business owner who is an honest and competent person.  For about 20 years, they have consistently been competent and honest.

Today, they replaced our water heater.  Their customer service before the job was very responsive.  Their price was very competitive.  The plumber and his assistant arrived on time, worked meticulously, and cleaned after themselves.  They did an outstanding job.  They gave me a fixed price upfront, yet they replaced all the water and gas flex pipes, the gas valve, and the vent connection, for the same fixed price, which really impressed me.

I am delighted.

(Andrea will not come on phone and shows that there is mismanagement and poor team work.) Note that there was no argument or abusive  language on either side. reviews.text: Prompt and expert sump pump fix—saved us from a wet basement!

reviews.author: canyon pritchard
reviews.text:
First off, we had a lot of work to do at our new (to us), old house. After being ghosted by other plumbers, we appreciated how  communicative Ryan was! If he was running into any issues, or needed to run to grab something, he would explain to you why, and what he was doing all the way through.
He is obviously knowledgeable when it comes to plumbing, as he has to update our fixtures from very old/amateur fixes of the past and had to get creative while staying up to code. He was willing to take on our projects that other plumbers deemed impossible. Ryan crushed it! He also made sure he cleaned up well after himself. His prices were fair for the work he did. All and all we are very happy with the end result and will be using Synergy Plumbing for any future needs!

reviews.author: Fran Koch
reviews.text: I found a rare gem! Ryan was amazing. I’d highly recommend @Synergy Plumbing and Backflow Testing. I needed some bathroom faucets replaced. He was polite, knowledgeable, gave great recommendations on product and options.. turnaround time for installation was just days, because I wanted to purchase from his recommendation. Arrived on time, friendly, knowledgeable and answered all my questions and as I watched because I love to learn and see how it’s all done. If I needed anything after he left he said just to call. Faucets are beautiful.. Thank you!

reviews.author: chris hanson
reviews.text: Ryan provided prompt, reasonably priced service on a Saturday; while many of the other plumbers I called weren't interested in helping out, or if they were, their prices were outrageous. I would recommend Ryan and Synergy to anyone looking for great plumbing service.

reviews.author: Sherri Scott
reviews.text: Ryan was prompt, professional and straightforward. I had him out to my 93 year old Grandmother's home and my own.  He didn't try to upsell me on things that wernt needed like Ive had with other experiences. He gave knowledgeable and clear information about my choices with no pressure.  Ive been so unhappy with the other "big" name plumbing companies in the area and I can't begin to say what a difference Synergy is, or express the appreciation I have for their honesty and integrity.  I would 10/10 recommend to anyone- whether it's an emergency such as my issue was, or maintenance such was my Grandmother's need.

reviews.author: M Mejia
reviews.text: Ryan is awesome. First we needed late night emergency help in which he was very responsive. We got a reasonable estimate and he finished all the work in a timely manner. The second time was also an emergency call, but during the day. He happened to be close by and was there in 10 minutes. Checked everything and figured out the problem. The third time he replaced a hot water heater on short notice as well. Great work and very professional!

reviews.author: Greg Dollar

reviews.author: Bre Pickett
reviews.text: Alex was great to work with! We had them do all the plumbing for a basement finish and full remodel. They were reliable, on time, and did great work. Great experience from start to finish!

reviews.author: That dude

reviews.author: Janie Kelley

Now fast forward 2 years and they were performing some sort of pipe cleaning on a higher level garage which somehow ended up flooding my entire storage unit down below due to negligence and incompetence. reviews.text: We had a pipe break in the basement on Sunday, we called and Joe came out, he arrived quickly was courteous, knowledgeable and focused on getting our issue addressed quickly.  He completed the repair efficiently and made sure everything was corrected also offering suggestions for better water pressure in this 100+ year old house!  Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.text: Joe was fantastic! He installed all new kitchen faucets+ about three months ago. He worked quickly, but diligently. He just did his job without chit chatting, complaining - very respectable... Our instant hot tank had a small issue with a short tube connection, but he came up with a creative solution. Said nothing about difficulty to park (another plumber showed up and left without doing the install due to parking). I would highly recommend Joe and will hire him again!

reviews.author: gretchen collins
reviews.text: No hot water.  I called Norman Mechanical, spoke with Billy and within 2 hours plumber was at my house.  Joe inspected and found 4 gas leaks.  Very lucky my house didn’t blow up!  Joe replaced gas lines, double checked everything and hot water is back on.  Thank you Norman Mechanical!

reviews.author: Nick Schmitt
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience working with Billy and Norman Mechanical. They did an excellent job resolving my sewer drain issue and they explained everything thoroughly and clearly. I was impressed by the communication we received from Billy and the plumber who came over. They were very professional and I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Jeff Nagel
reviews.text: We've always had good experiences with Boston Plumbing. Mike has come out on calls and takes the time to resolve the issue. The other day he took some extra time to ensure both pumps were in good working order and made necessary adjustments. It's hard to find a good trustworthy plumber.  Give them a try.

reviews.author: Robert Lackowski
reviews.text: Boston Plumbing came out to replace my water heater exactly at the time promised and did a great job. The new water heater was a professional grade Bradford White that is on only sold to plumbers and is made in the USA. After some research I found it is among the best available. Boston Plumbing did an excellent installation, quick, and left the area clean. Their pricing was fair. Great company to work with.

reviews.author: Christine Lemke
reviews.text: Once again, they exceeded our expectations...Shout out to Dan & Mike of Boston Plumbing!! Excellent, efficient, reasonably priced service! Just had our hot water heater replaced and they were timely, friendly, and quick! After my initial call, Dan came out right away to assess the situation. After hiring them for the job, they were in and out within a couple hours! They even made recommendations on how to most efficiently arrange our pipes/vents and took care of it all for us. Then they took the time to teach us about maintaining our new water heater. Mike remembered me from last time and had a great memory recalling our issues from the last time he serviced us a few years ago! Dan took the time to get to know my kids. Nicest guys really and took great care of us. Hire them..you’ll be happy you did! 😊

reviews.author: Autumn Notter Graef

I truly appreciated the transparency and support, and I’m very satisfied with how everything was handled.

reviews.author: Magdalena Milagros

Very satisfied with the service, and I highly recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Jonathan Yusuf

reviews.author: Leonardo Tyson

plumbers.name: Five Cities Plumbing
plumbers.address: 949 Huber St, Grover Beach, CA 93433, USA

reviews.author: Ashley Burns
reviews.text:
We’ve had a handful of experiences with local plumbers over the years, and not all of them were great. After one especially frustrating situation, we decided to call 5 Cities Plumbing based on recommendations from friends. I wish we had called them years ago!

No hassle. No waiting around. No runaround or shady upsells like we’ve dealt with before. They were straightforward, honest, and actually fixed the problem the first time. What a relief to finally find a plumbing company that does exactly what they say they’ll do.

From here on out, we’ll only be using 5 Cities Plumbing for any plumbing issues. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: RJordans Gaming
reviews.text:
They replaced a faulty bathtub mixer cartridge on Jan 14, which began leaking at an alarming rate on Saturday Feb 21 (good solid flow as the valve failed to close). Couldn't reach them all weekend. Spoke with them Monday morning, kept saying they were sending someone out, then delayed multiple times and never came, said Tuesday first thing... no show / no call. Around 11am, I received a hostile phone call from the owner, Chad, accusing me of trying to get free work, refusing to pay, and pissing him off with multiple phone calls. Not sure how he arrived at any of those conclusions. I had simply asked the receptionist if they would guarantee their prior work (which was paid promptly on the day of service btw).

Chad did eventually come out on Tuesday around 11, pushed past me at the front door and began demanding payment immediately before performing any work. I asked him to communicate with the home owner (who I had standing by on the phone), which Chad refused to do. Instead he left abruptly hurling profanity, yelling insults, and speeding away. Chad wouldn’t budge on his 30-day guarantee policy, even though the bath valve was becoming increasing difficult to fully shut-off since well within the 30-day window. Meanwhile my bathtub had now been hemorrhaging probably hundreds of gallons over 3 days.

So my issue was not fixed and I was a bit shook by the unhinged way the owner suddenly raged quit. I called another plumbing service who came out in less than 1-hour and replaced the cartridge for $280. They also confirmed that Five Cities Plumbing had installed the prior cartridge incorrectly. Won’t be using this company again.

reviews.author: John B

the man is very smart, and he improve the old pipe system, and replace a new sump pump quickly. the price is fair, and the work well done. I will use this service later.

reviews.author: Tonya Mondelli
reviews.text: Quick to call you back when you need work done. However once they get their money they ignore you. They came out and installed a new water heater. No refund and they won’t return our phone calls. We have called THREE times. First time spoke with a woman and said she would get back to us and never heard back. The last two times we have left messages and silence. Still waiting for my reimbursement.... Not people you can trust. Stole $700 from us.

reviews.author: Larry Watt
reviews.text: The service I got was perfect I went and told him I had a bad water heater they came over checked out the part that was bad I suggested I get a new one then they were over the next day to install the new one with no delay the gentleman was kind add explained everything to me I needed to know about the future of this water heater and proper preventive maintenance thank you for your service and I would suggest Community Plumbing to anybody in this community and Beyond.

The job took a little longer than originally thought, but they stuck to the quoted price and didn't try to up charge me.  I will certainly use they again in the future.

reviews.author: Concerned Coloradan
reviews.text:
This place is a total rip-off. They charge $250 to remove backed up hair from drains, don't actually DO anything (they didn't even bring a snake, nor did I see any hair from the drain), send 2 plumbers (lol, it takes 2 plumbers to unclog a bathroom drain?), and then pretend you have the wrong place when you call to complain because the drain is backed up a week later.

The owner, Pete, doesn't even say the name of the place when he answers the phone. Do not use this "business", they are total quacks just looking to rip you off. Spending 10 minutes vaping on a customer's dime so you can avoid actually unclogging a drain isn't a service. It's a rip-off and this place should be shut down.

reviews.author: Kimberly Chandler
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Pete, Byron and Tristan. Pipe Works came highly recommended by multiple neighbors. I was only out of service for less than 24 hours only because they had to locate a new unit. Call Pete for all your plumbing needs. A fine company and person.

reviews.author: Nealie Morgan
reviews.text: Pete's brother, Rob, came out the same day that I called and did such a great job with connecting all the plumbing for our new sink. Will definitely refer them!

reviews.author: Becky Allred

The parts were still under warranty and the safety of my family was always top priority!

reviews.author: Adrianne Poe
reviews.text: Mr. Pete and Byron did an amazing job uninstalling my old water heater and putting in my new one. Mr. Pete came right away when I called and said my old water heater broke and water was all over the house after returning home from work one evening. They came back the very next morning and had everything done in less than 24 hours!! Cleanest job I’ve seen. I’m so thankful and pleased. I will always call Pipe Works for my plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Stephanie Marsili
reviews.text:
Richard is the best!! The Pro Rooter team has helped me many times over the years, and Richard has been wonderful.
Thank you!!!'

reviews.author: Justin Brillo
reviews.text:

Overall, I was thoroughly impressed with the service provided by Hector. The combination of punctuality, professionalism, courtesy, and willingness to educate made the experience exceptional. I would highly recommend this plumber to anyone looking for reliable and knowledgeable plumbing services.

reviews.author: Hamilton
reviews.text: Pro Rooter checked our sewage drain with a camera for no cost and changed 45 ft of pipe from our house to the street within 7 hours. They were efficient and clean and both the water district and city inspectors told me that they are good at what they do and never cut any corners. This was one of the most hassle and pain free plumbing experiences we've had so we plan to use Pro Rooter again if needed.

reviews.author: Jia Guo
reviews.text:
The guy Chilo came because we had asked to fix a sewage drain caused by roots and dirt stuck in the storm drain for years caused by the previous house owner. We agreed on a $300 since the pipe went straight, but at the end he asked for $400 even though spent a total of an hour cleaning the pipes. The worst part is after he left it was still clogged with a bunch of roots throughout the pipe that we had to get out ourselves.

Before he left, he also misinformed us about a misalignment in the pipes and asked us if we wanted to fix it for $900. We opened it up ourselves to find out that there was no misalignment but a bunch of roots clogged that was causing what he though was the misalignment.

That was a total scam.

reviews.text:

I spoke with Ryan and he said they could perform the service and put the invoice in my mailbox and I could send in a check afterwards.  SWEET!

The day of the service came and they came right on time and performed the service and on the invoice wrote exactly what they performed and detailed their findings as they in fact found roots in my pipe!

I wish I could have gotten to the original company that I called.

reviews.text: I was referred to Yeti plumbing by a friend and when I called I got Kyle the owner, I explained that I thought I may have a two fold issue in that it appeared I may have had the water heater go and that there appeared to be a clogged floor drain also. Kyle agreed to come out after hours to look at the issue, it turned out that I had a sewer back up which he routed on the spot and also informed us that the water heater did not need to be replaced. There are really no words to express the relief of not only having the issue fixed in a timely manner but the honestly and helpfulness we experienced. It's rare to find people not looking to take advantage of a bad situation but I can say that is exactly what we got from Kyle and Yeti plumbing, I won't use anyone else going forward and would recommend trying this company for any of your plumbing needs.

reviews.text: Jason was fast and efficient and fixed our flooding issue in less than an hour! Was able to determine it was from a clogged kitchen sink that connected to our basement. Great at explaining everything and very friendly to have in our home.

reviews.author: Joe Szillat
reviews.text:
Ever have a great start to a day, and in a split second everything just goes down the drain? Well it wasn’t going down the drain for me; it was being pumped out of my basement sump pump. That’s when I knew I needed help. I called Big Apple; best thing I could have done!  They were out to my house within a hour!! He took a look where the main water was coming into my house and pointed out to me where the water leak was coming from. He explained that it could be in the cement or in my yard…. Either way he could get it back into operation the same day!

Long story short…. He showed me the issued piping, and I opted to have a brand new pipe installed from the water main to my house. They just dig out a hole around the water main now and don’t have to trench and dig out the whole yard.

I couldn’t have asked for a better expert or quicker response!

Thanks for saving the day!!!!

Mike came first thing Monday morning (7am) and he had a crew out later to dig to find the leak. House was built in 1969 so the water line was done next to the sewer line almost 5ft down!

Mike was extremely responsive and kept me updated every step of the way. HIGHLY recommend for any plumbing service needs.

reviews.author: J Meyer
reviews.text: I own a business in Coppell, and we were given the number for Rob and Mike by one of my customers who had used them for their businesses. They completed the work quickly and were always very fair with their pricing.  Both Mike and Rob have reached out to make sure my issue was resolved after the work was complete.  They will always be my first call, and gladly given recommendation!

reviews.author: Ellen
reviews.text:
Home Town Plumbing does excellent work!  My initial phone call was promptly returned. An appointment was scheduled for the following day and  Mike and Robb arrived as promised.  They worked quickly and efficiently to analyze my repair issues with three outside faucets.  Two of the faucets were repaired within minutes.  They used appropriate tools to make the repairs quickly.  The third faucet had to be replaced.  They were extremely experienced in locating the connection inside the wall, cut through the sheetrock in the garage, and quickly connected new piping to existing inside the wall, and sealed the opening in the sheetrock with a cover, so no need for additional repair costs for covering the hole in the sheetrock!!  I now have a brand new outside faucet that will last many years.
This company offers experienced, knowledgeable, and efficient service  and are fairly priced as a result. My expectations were exceeded, and I would definitely call them for any future plumbing needs.

Jeff and Norma are a great duo who do a great job while charging fair prices. I will only be calling J Carrillo Plumbing and Drains moving forward.

Very honest and kind...I'll definitely keep their number and call for any plumbing issues.

Ana G

reviews.author: Tamara Scott
reviews.text: Be sure to ask if they are sending a licensed plumber to your home. They charge licensed plumber prices but may send an apprentice, alone. I agreed to their pricing, expecting a plumber. Came out quickly, but sent an apprentice alone. Sump pump was bubbling up in floor drain of crawl space. 5 hours of looking for the problem, there was no answer. $850. Had them back out to install back flow valve to stop water from coming up in drain, another $650 and alone apprentice. I have nothing against apprentices, they have to learn, but should be working with a licensed plumber in person. After $1500, hope the problem is solved. The apprentice was very respectful.

reviews.author: James
reviews.text: It’s hard to find a company that you’re impressed with, which is why I’m writing this review. First and foremost this is a family company, which has roots in the region for 100 years. How cool is that? Them being in business for that long tells you they’re doing something right. I called Salyer plumbing early this year as my water main broke. They came out that day to do an assessment. The person that came out was friendly, courteous, and empathetic. He told me to expect a call later that day, which I did. The owner called me and explained everything and sent over quotes. She was very understanding and answered every question I had. This meant the world to me as I’m a first time home owner and this was all new to me. The crew came out did a wonderful job without destroying my yard. Other companies wanted to dig out the yard while Salyer could do most of it with a small hole. I highly recommend this company. Support a local family owned business, you won’t regret it.

Greg was at my house first thing in the morning...explained what he was doing and why, and was very pleasant.  Greg completed the job quickly and at a very fair cost especially on a holiday. I would HIGHLY recommend Greg and Plumbing Solutions!

reviews.author: Adam Dabb
reviews.text: I called Plumbing Solutions at around 4:30 in the afternoon when I discovered a small hole in my refrigerator’s water line, which was causing water to leak down into my basement. I spoke with Greg and he was the only local company willing and able to fit me in that evening to install a new and much stronger water line. Had I called a much larger company and deemed it an emergency call, they would have tacked on an additional emergency charge, but he didn’t charge any more than his normal rate, which was more reasonable than other plumbers I have used in the past.  I have found my regular plumber for future needs!

reviews.author: david oetzel
reviews.text: Greg came out on a Sat. to help us with a small leak from our upstairs shower and explained how we could do an easy fix ourself and then he even gave me the caulk!! reviews.author: Gradient Descent
reviews.text:
We recently had a broken sewer line in our front yard and called MJ Plumbing. Matt and his team were professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. He diagnosed the issue quickly, clearly explained the necessary repairs (even educated me on the process which I personally appreciate), and completed the sewer line replacement promptly with high-quality work. Matt and MJ Plumbing made the process super smooth and resolved our issue completely.

I highly recommend their services and will be using them for plumbing issues in the future!

reviews.author: John Great
reviews.text: Hands down the only plumbing service I'll ever call going forward they were very responsive to my call and questions. The water heater they installed is so much better then the one we had before and instalation was fast and easy. They were personable and thoughtful.

reviews.author: Endless Chapters
reviews.text:
After 2 visits and getting the run around a bit from another plumbing company in Woodstock, I sought recommendations from our town FB page on good and fair plumbers to repair a broken sewer line. The responses were overwhelmingly in favor MJ Plumbing. And I am so grateful they were. Matt was at our house the next day to properly diagnose the issue and explore repair options. Unlike the other company, he took the time to map the issue and do the necessary leg work to find the best repair solution. Whereas the other company handed us an estimate for $5,200 and said they "thought" they knew what the issue was. My husband who is inherently interested in knowing the interworkings of everything, was involved in the entire diagnostic process. Everything was communicated clearly to us. Matt even communicated with us while out of state visiting family, as he knew we were at limited capacity to use water sources in our house for fear of water backing up into our basement. Him and his crew repaired the broken sewer line in just a few hours. During the repair they identified another issue that definitely needed rectifying and only cost us $200 now, but would have cost us thousands later (B Box, which offers access to the water shut off valves, was improperly buried under a foot of dirt, packed with soil, and had no cap. So they raised it, cleared it out, and will be fitting it with a cap to allow appropriate access in the event of an emergency.)

Very grateful to have found MJ Plumbing. Matt and his entire crew were kind and extremely efficient. I feel at ease knowing this issue was handled by competent workers, and won't be an issue 6 months or 6 years down the road. Will be using them going forward for any Plumbing needs!

reviews.author: Doug Kulie

I now have multiple outlets that are not working and he is refusing to repair the damages he caused. As a reasonable solution I requested half of the payment I sent him back so that I could hire an electrician to repair the damages he caused and he refused. If you are looking for a reliable plumber that takes responsibility for their actions look elsewhere!

reviews.text: These are the guys you want to call for your plumbing needs!  They replaced my water service line in my front yard after another plumber's worked failed. reviews.author: R Weinstein
reviews.text:
Jimmy and the rest of the team were great! I interacted with 3 members of the team and all were kind, courteous and professional.

My experience with them started off as a non-emergency consultation. Enrique came out right on schedule, we walked thru the issues, and I got a text with the official estimate. He was very clear about what needed to be done and how. He didn't try to scare me into a remodel (yes someone else tried that). I also got estimates from 2 others,  but SR was the best. Their estimate wa comfortably within my budget. NOTHING WAS LEAKING AT THAT TIME so I planned to schedule work early January.

Then I came home to leaking ceiling.  Since they're available 24/7, i called their office. Maria was able to schedule Jimmy to come out within a couple hours. He made sure the pipes were OK, then found the bad seal on my tub. Four hours after coming home my ceiling was no longer leaking, my tub was sealed, and we had plans to fix the rest before the end of the week.

Finally,  the day of the planned project arrived. Jimmy came out early because I had an afternoon commitment. Everything went exactly as he said it would. Time and cost matched my estimate/ consultation EXACTLY. (Luckily no surprises midway thru the project). He wrapped up,  checked his work, and cleaned up.

Will 100% be saving this business to my favorites.

reviews.text: The Quality was poor and so were their public relations.  I am a plumber in Arizona, visiting my sister in Lampasas. As soon as I saw the job, I recognized some problems with their workmanship.  The standpipe coming from the ground was not straight up and down (ugly).  This standpipe was for the washer drain.  The size of the pipe should have been 2in and it was 1 ½.   The vent ended under a window with a “under counter” quick vent.  In the house, behind the washer, there was not a “P” trap.  Sewer gases was venting into the house.  I questioned the plumber (the “master plumber”) about these deficient issues.  His answer was that he had to check on who had done the work and would get back to us.   Two week passed before we saw anyone from Sanders Plumbing and that was because we called several times and insisted.  Sanders bill stated that work included the hooking up of the washing machine (previously a “gray water” drain) to the main sewer line.  The return trip Sanders Plumbing “father” quoted a price of $800.00 to make the job right.  The first part of the job, the putting in the “clean-out”, was billed at $900.00 after a discount.  As a plumber from another location, I thought that price was steep, that was not the issue.  Sanders, you have a reputation in Lampasas (as I heard it) “the highest priced and the worst plumber in Lampasas”.  You need to change the direction you have taken.

Once he got to work, it was like watching magic unfold. Joel's skill and precision were mesmerizing. He swiftly removed the old wax ring and installed the new one with absolute accuracy. It was evident that he had performed this task countless times, and his confidence was contagious.

Throughout the entire process, Joel maintained a clean and organized workspace. He treated my home with respect, and when he finished, there was no mess left behind—just a perfectly functioning toilet.

Even after completing the job, Joel went above and beyond by sharing valuable tips on toilet maintenance to prevent future issues. His commitment to customer satisfaction was truly remarkable.

In conclusion, if you ever encounter a plumbing problem, especially involving your toilet, Joel is the plumber to call. He's not just a plumbing wizard; he's a genuine professional with a passion for his craft. Thank you, Joel, for your exceptional service and for saving the day (and my bathroom!). reviews.author: Alora K
reviews.text: Called homeland on a Saturday night for my parents due to the plumbing backing up the washer drain and the hot water drain. It flooded a couple different parts of the house. When we called an talked to their dispatch they said they would be available to come out with in the house and the weekend rate would be $175 service fee. They said we would get a quote when the tech Martin came out and they did not charge an hourly rate but charged by the job needing to be done. Martin did arrive within the hour. He got out the shop vacuum to pull out the water from the hot water tank drip pan and got out the rooter to start working on this clog. He didn’t say we would have any additional charge at this point. He tried the drain at the hot water tank and missed. Then tried a clean out drain outside and was unable to get the clog so he resorted to the washer vent drain. At that point he was able to remove the clog. When the time came for the bill it was $135 service charge and another $371 to remove the clog! That was a shock! He never said there was another charge, he never gave us a quote. He said the $371 was an hourly rate for his time out here not by the job. So the communication we had from dispatch and the communication we got from Martin was completely different! We won’t consider this company in the future. We don’t like surprises .

reviews.author: Mark F
reviews.text: Due to my own recent experience today, I will personally never use Ralph (Above All Plumbing) as a plumber again, as he walked off the job just as it got started. I had asked him to swap a toilet out in my son's bathroom. My son was super excited about this new toilet and was watching him closely, as he started to drain the toilet. My son is a very curious boy and loves to know how things work and why people are doing certain things. I then asked my son to move back and give Ralph some room to work. After I said this, Ralph stated, "yeah, I don't like an audience", which I replied, "well, I'm paying for this, and my son likes watching." My son then says, "yeah, even I might be a plumber one day". At this point, Ralph left the bathroom, took off his gloves, grabbed his stuff, shook my hand, and proceeded to leave. When I asked Ralph why he was leaving, he stated that he doesn't get paid for people to watch him. I then clarified to him that we are paying for the "service" not paying to "watch" him. With that said, he is inside my house performing a service that I am paying for, so asking someone to not watch him is actually a tad concerning to me. If someone was building a house and hired a framing crew, would the framers stop and tell the homeowner, not to watch them work? If someone had painters in their house, would the painters ask the homeowner not to watch them work at all? I understand giving him some space to work freely, and that is why I asked my son to move back to begin with. So much for a plumber helping our society to attract younger children into the Plumbing trade. In my opinion, this was not a professional example to set in front of my 10-yr old, that watched him walk off the job like that. Very disappointing to say the least.

So I bought her a new fridge because hers was only maintaining temps in the low 40's. And I bought and installed a used dish washer for her. I just needed a drain line and hot water connection installed under the sink.
I asked Matt if he could just give me a ball park figure for the job. I sent him pictures of the existing plumbing and he quoted me between $400 and $600. I thought it was a little high. But I was willing to pay it just to get her a washer.
I did however, text Matt and asked if there was anyway he could keep as close to $400 as possible. He texted back and said "if your under some budget restraints, maybe you should call another plumber". Well, at the time I couldn't find another plumber to do work in union.
So i told him it wasnt a matter of money. I has plenty of funds. It was just a request to do whatever he could to maybe cut a corner here or there to maybe save a couple of buck.

reviews.author: Brenda Grant
reviews.text: I do not like to write a negative review, but I feel I must to help others who may be experiencing the problems we had.  After reading the positive reviews, we contacted The Plumbing Doctor to help figure out why both toilets were running quite often.  He came on July 26 and even though my husband stated he had already replaced the flapper, the representative said this had to be the problem and purchased a new flapper.  He charged $145 for the service call and $20 for the flapper we did not need and ordered another flapper for the other toilet.  The flapper was not the issue.  We had to be the ones to always call and find out where the part was.  My husband finally convinced the representative it was not the flapper, therefore the representative ordered another part (what part we do not know).  After being told again the part was on back order, and the plumber thinking we might consider replacing both toilets (house is only 4 years old) because the plumber was unsure what the problem could be, we decided to take matters into our own hands. We contacted the water supply company which came out to make sure our water pressure was good.  They suggested we replaced the float in each toilet.  My husband went to Lowe's -- purchased two floats on Tuesday -- replaced both floats on Wednesday, and as of today (Friday- September 6) no more running toilets.  Therefore if you have running toilets, replace the flapper---if that does not work---replace the float--and if still doesn't help, I suggest calling a different plumber.  We received no service for the money we paid.

reviews.author: Michael Das
reviews.text:
TLDR: Hire this company; they are friendly, reasonable, and extremely honest. You want people like this in moments of worry and confusion. They will not take advantage of you.

The reason there aren't more reviews is because these brothers, Ottie and Don, are very old school. They don't demand reviews, they don't have a giant organization behind them, and they completely focused on being good to their customers. When you call the number, you'll have to leave a message because they don't have a huge staff. But they'll call you back because they care about people who need their help.

I had the pleasure of working with Ottie. I don't know much about houses and I was extremely nervous I would need extensive repairs/troubleshooting. Ottie took the time to explain what he was doing, work through possible solutions with me, and utilize his decades of experience to diagnose the issue. He stayed to walk me through basic maintenance for other parts of my home and really put our minds at ease. His price was incredibly reasonable given the amount of work and explanation he gave us.

We look at these reviews because we're worried we'll get overcharged by some faceless organization who views us as a bunch of dollar signs. Things are expensive for average Americans. We want a little bit of safety in a world with prices spiraling out of control. We were so lucky to be recommended Salmon Plumbing and Heating because they're just good guys doing good work. I don't know the person reading this but I'm going to give you a little luck: try these guys. Explain your problem, give them some time to respond because it's just two brothers, and, most importantly, come back to write a review after they do a good job.

They're old school good but they deserve a little new school reward; let other knows how good Salmon Plumbing and Heating are.

reviews.author: Alyssa Daugherty
reviews.text:
As a new homeowner, finding the right repair people for various things has been tough - it's hard to know you're getting a good deal when you've never paid for that type of service before.  I had a main sewer line clog over the holiday weekend and knew that I needed my sewer line snaked.  Several plumbers that I called prior to Redi-Rooter would not quote their prices for a snake over the phone.  They needed to send someone to diagnose the problem which would cost  $85+  for the "service call."  And no - that price would not come off the price of the actual work.  Those that would estimate a price came in around $250 with an additional $85-100 "service call charge."

I called Redi-Rooter on Labor day and the person I spoke to was very friendly and helpful, offering tips to see if we could work around the situation ourselves.  He offered us a price over the phone (much less than previous quotes without the service charge) for snaking our sewer, with the obvious caveat - could be more if there are bigger problems.  He offered to send someone that day, or if we could to wait until first thing Tuesday, he could save us at least $45 dollars, avoiding the holiday rates.  (We opted for the cheaper Tuesday option)

The plumber called at 8:15 am, prior to showing up at my door, and was at the house by 8:30 as promised. They were polite, efficient, answered all my questions, and were done within an hour, after making sure every drain was draining, every toilet was flushing, etc.  The final price actually came in less than what I was quoted over the phone!!  (And was a fraction of the previous quotes I had gotten from other plumbers)  I was 100% happy with the customer service, actual service, and the price!

Thanks so much!  I hope I don't have to call you any time soon, but if anything plumbing-related happens, Redi-Rooter is my new go-tol!

reviews.text: I called this company based on other good Google reviews.  Chris from Redi-Rooter came out and was on-time, friendly, effective and offered a good value.  I'll call them again, and recommend.

reviews.text:
The person on the phone was nice and waived the $59 dollar before 6pm service call fee.  After 6pm its $99.  They asked me to write this review.  I just needed someone to hook up my new condensor fan motor for my ground level outdoor central air.  Just a simple wire job.  I had given up after some bad instructions and not being sure about the wires I was tracing for the new motor.  I really didnt want to burn anything up trying, so I called All Hours.  They were able to get a tech out same day.

He quoted $280 to wire my fan and compressor to the switch and capacitor.  I denied service, but he did me a favor and said he would help me get started by putting wires in the right place.  Long story SHORT he "plugged" my compressor onto the condensor coil and then plugged my fan into the capacitor like an extension cord into itself!  Granted, he was using reference photos and notes to help me out, however, when he plugged the breaker back in, he used the sound of my compressor shorting out to try selling me a new AC system.  I agreed to buy a new AC system knowing something wasnt right.  Another guy was called to help me out.

The sales/supervisor as the first guy called him, saw that I had figured it out before he got to my house to set me up with a new $5000 to $10000 dollar AC system.  When he got there, I told him what the last tech had done and that I was able to get everything running.  This second tech was cool.  He cleaned up the unused wires from the old fan and checked on a few things.  He said my system still had life in it and that he didnt want me to think poorly of the company.  I didnt pay anything in the end for their services.

AC systems are modular.  There is no need to replace an entire system if you can change a few cheap parts.  You dont need special tools unless you sprang a refrigerant leak or ACTUALLY need a new compressor.  YouTube is a great way to learn how to fix things.  Just use your brain like I should have.  If you need professional help, always get second opinions.

Thank you second guy for making things right!!

reviews.text: On a Thursday night we had an irrigation line shut off valve get crushed by a delivery driver backing out of our driveway. I was able to cap the line but still had no water pressure coming into our house after, so we were without water that night. On Friday morning at 7:30 am I began calling plumbing companies to see if we could get someone out same day. Brian called me back and we were able to talk through my issue for about 20 min. He gave me his word that he’d be out late afternoon but had a jam packed day. Brian kept his word and arrived to our house on a Friday afternoon. He and Cody were able to flush out our water lines in reverse to remove all of the silt and sediment that had come into the system when I cut the water off at the meter the night before. I also elected to replace the pressure reducing valve while they were here. Brian made sure to give me an estimate of our cost as soon as he was able to figure out what might be going on and he kept me updated the entire time of what he was doing, I appreciated that. We’ve used two other plumbing companies in recent years that I have been dissatisfied with. I will be calling Brian and On Point again for our home’s plumbing needs. Thanks Brian, Cody and On Point Plumbing for helping us out!

reviews.author: TK Clemons
reviews.text: Of course there is no convenient time to have a plumbing issue. So, a Saturday when the husband is away on a golf trip with the boys was inevitable, right? I heard the sound of water running in the walls. No water was running that I could find. Something was not right and I knew it. I called a well known plumbing company describing my situation and they said they couldn’t get anyone out until Tuesday. That wasn’t working for me. I Googled “emergency plumbers” and Big B’s had the highest ratings and lots of them. I was hesitant to go with a company I’d never heard of but gave them a call. They said they could have someone out that afternoon and sent me a picture of the tech who would be arriving with a short bio. I was lucky enough to get Ryan Witowich. He quickly and professionally diagnosed the issue (slab leak) isolated which pipe was leaking, showed and explained everything in terms I could understand as he did his job, and talked to my husband so we could make the decision on how best to move forward with repairs and ensured we were “stable” to use water through the rest of the weekend. We had a team of about 10 show up punctually Monday morning to begin work to replace all of our pipes and get them off the slab. These guys are amazing! They knocked out the whole project in under a week with drywall and stucco guys done, and everything cleaned up. Everyone we worked with were absolute professionals. These are 100% the people you want when you have a plumbing emergency.

I imagine that communication makes people like single Moms or elderly residents feel safe knowing who's going to be knocking on their door.
